3.3.s:
.. ṛṣayaḥ ūcuḥ .. ..
bhagavanvikramākhyānakālo'yaṃ bhavatoditaḥ ..
śatadvādaśamaryādo dvāparasya samo bhuvi .. .. 1 ..
3.3.d:
॥ ऋषयः ऊचुः ॥ ॥
भगवन्विक्रमाख्यानकालोऽयं भवतोदितः ॥
शतद्वादशमर्यादो द्वापरस्य समो भुवि ॥ ॥ 1 ॥
3.3.m:
The sages said:
O venerable one, you have described this period of the narrative of Vikrama,
which on earth has a span of twelve hundred [years], equal to the Dvāpara age.

3.3.s:
asminkāle mahābhāga līlā bhagavatā kṛtā ..
tāmetāṃ kathayāsmānvai sarvajño'sti bhavānsadā .. 2 ..
3.3.d:
अस्मिन्काले महाभाग लीला भगवता कृता ॥
तामेतां कथयास्मान्वै सर्वज्ञोऽस्ति भवान्सदा ॥ 2 ॥
3.3.m:
At this time, O fortunate one, pastimes were enacted by the Lord.
Relate that to us, for you are indeed always omniscient.

3.3.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
nārāyaṇaṃ namaskṛtya naraṃ caiva narottamam ..
devīṃ sarasvatīṃ vyāsaṃ tato jayamudīrayet .. 3 ..
3.3.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
नारायणं नमस्कृत्य नरं चैव नरोत्तमम् ॥
देवीं सरस्वतीं व्यासं ततो जयमुदीरयेत् ॥ 3 ॥
3.3.m:
Sūta said:
Having bowed down to Nārāyaṇa and to Nara, the foremost of men,
as well as to the goddess Sarasvatī and to Vyāsa, one should then utter "Victory!"

3.3.s:
bhaviṣyākhye mahākalpe prāpte vaivasvatentare ..
aṣṭāviṃśaddvāparānte kurukṣetre raṇo'bhavat .. 4 ..
3.3.d:
भविष्याख्ये महाकल्पे प्राप्ते वैवस्वतेन्तरे ॥
अष्टाविंशद्द्वापरान्ते कुरुक्षेत्रे रणोऽभवत् ॥ 4 ॥
3.3.m:
When the great cosmic age named Bhaviṣya had arrived in the Vaivasvata interval,
at the end of the twenty-eighth Dvāpara, the battle took place at Kurukṣetra.

3.3.s:
pāṃḍavairnirjitāḥ sarve kauravāḥ yuddhadurmadāḥ ..
aṣṭādaśe ca divase pāṃḍavānāṃ jayo'bhavat .. 5 ..
3.3.d:
पांडवैर्निर्जिताः सर्वे कौरवाः युद्धदुर्मदाः ॥
अष्टादशे च दिवसे पांडवानां जयोऽभवत् ॥ 5 ॥
3.3.m:
All the Kauravas, arrogant in battle, were vanquished by the Pāṇḍavas,
and on the eighteenth day, victory belonged to the Pāṇḍavas.

3.3.s:
dinānte bhaga vānkṛṣṇo jñātvā kālasya durgatim ..
śivaṃ tuṣṭāva manasā yogarūpaṃ sanātanam .. 6 ..
3.3.d:
दिनान्ते भग वान्कृष्णो ज्ञात्वा कालस्य दुर्गतिम् ॥
शिवं तुष्टाव मनसा योगरूपं सनातनम् ॥ 6 ॥
3.3.m:
At the close of the day, Lord Kṛṣṇa, knowing the calamity of the times,
praised in his mind the eternal Śiva whose form is yoga.

3.3.s:
.. kṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
namaḥ śāṃtāya rudrāya bhūte śāya kapardine..
kālakartre jagadbhartre pāpahartre namonamaḥ .. 7 ..
3.3.d:
॥ कृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
नमः शांताय रुद्राय भूते शाय कपर्दिने॥
कालकर्त्रे जगद्भर्त्रे पापहर्त्रे नमोनमः ॥ 7 ॥

3.3.s:
pāṃḍavānrakṣa bhagavanmadbhaktānbhūtabhīrukān ..
iti śrutvā stavaṃ rudro naṃdiyānoparisthitaḥ ..
rakṣārthaṃ śibirāṇāṃ ca prāptavāñchūlahastadhṛk .. 8 ..
3.3.d:
पांडवान्रक्ष भगवन्मद्भक्तान्भूतभीरुकान् ॥
इति श्रुत्वा स्तवं रुद्रो नंदियानोपरिस्थितः ॥
रक्षार्थं शिबिराणां च प्राप्तवाञ्छूलहस्तधृक् ॥ 8 ॥
3.3.m:
Protect the Pāṇḍavas, O Lord, who are devoted to me and timid towards spirits!
Having heard this praise, Rudra, mounted upon the vehicle Nandi,
holdin a trident in his hand, arrived for the protection of the encampments.

3.3.s:
tadā nṛpājñayā kṛṣṇaḥ sa gato gajasāhvayam ..
pāṃḍavāḥ paṃca nirgatya sarasvatyā staṭe'vasan .. 9 ..
3.3.d:
तदा नृपाज्ञया कृष्णः स गतो गजसाह्वयम् ॥
पांडवाः पंच निर्गत्य सरस्वत्या स्तटेऽवसन् ॥ 9 ॥
3.3.m:
Then, by the king’s command, Kṛṣṇa went to Gajasāhvaya,
and the five Pāṇḍavas departed and dwelt on the bank of the Sarasvatī.

3.3.s:
niśīthe drauṇibhojau ca kṛpastatra samāyayuḥ ..
tuṣṭuvurmanasā rudraṃ tebhyo mārgaṃ śivodadāt .. 3.3.1.10 ..
3.3.d:
निशीथे द्रौणिभोजौ च कृपस्तत्र समाययुः ॥
तुष्टुवुर्मनसा रुद्रं तेभ्यो मार्गं शिवोददात् ॥ 3.3.1.10 ॥
3.3.m:
At midnight, the son of Droṇa, the Bhoja, and Kṛpa arrived there;
they praised Rudra in their minds, and Śiva gave them way.

3.3.s:
aśvatthāmā tu balavāñchivadattamasiṃ tadā ..
gṛhītvā sa jaghānāśu dhṛṣṭadyumnapuraḥsarān .. 11 ..
3.3.d:
अश्वत्थामा तु बलवाञ्छिवदत्तमसिं तदा ॥
गृहीत्वा स जघानाशु धृष्टद्युम्नपुरःसरान् ॥ 11 ॥
3.3.m:
Then the mighty Aśvatthāman, having taken the sword given by Śiva,
swiftly slew those headed by Dhṛṣṭadyumna.

3.3.s: hatvā yatheṣṭamagamaddrauṇistābhyāṃ samanvitaḥ .. 12 ..
3.3.d: हत्वा यथेष्टमगमद्द्रौणिस्ताभ्यां समन्वितः ॥ 12 ॥
3.3.m: Having killed as he wished, the son of Droṇa departed, accompanied by the two of them.

3.3.s:
pārṣatasyaiva sūtaśca hataśeṣo bhayāturaḥ ..
pāṃḍavānvarṇayāmāsa yathā jāto janakṣayaḥ .. 13 ..
3.3.d:
पार्षतस्यैव सूतश्च हतशेषो भयातुरः ॥
पांडवान्वर्णयामास यथा जातो जनक्षयः ॥ 13 ॥
3.3.m:
The charioteer of Pārṣata himself, surviving the slaughter, distressed with fear,
recounted to the Pāṇḍavas how the destruction of their men had occurred.

3.3.s:
āgaskṛtaṃ śivaṃ jñātvā bhīmādyāḥ krodhamūrcchitāḥ ..
svāyudhaistā ḍayāmāsa devadevaṃ pinākinam .. 14 ..
3.3.d:
आगस्कृतं शिवं ज्ञात्वा भीमाद्याः क्रोधमूर्च्छिताः ॥
स्वायुधैस्ता डयामास देवदेवं पिनाकिनम् ॥ 14 ॥
3.3.m:
Knowing that Śiva had committed the offence, Bhīma and the others, overcome with wrath,
struck the god of gods, the bearer of the Pināka, with their own weapons.

3.3.s:
astraśastrāṇi teṣāṃ tu śivadehe samāviśan ..
dṛṣṭvā te vismitāḥ sarve prajaghnustalamuṣṭibhiḥ .. 15..
3.3.d:
अस्त्रशस्त्राणि तेषां तु शिवदेहे समाविशन् ॥
दृष्ट्वा ते विस्मिताः सर्वे प्रजघ्नुस्तलमुष्टिभिः ॥ 15॥
3.3.m:
Their magical missiles and weapons, however, entered Śiva’s body.
Seeing this, all of them, astonished, struck him with their palms and fists.

3.3.s:
tāñchaśāpa tadā rudro yūyaṃ kṛṣṇaprapūjakāḥ ..
ato'smābhī rakṣiṇīyā vadhayogyāśca vai bhuvi .. 16 ..
3.3.d:
ताञ्छशाप तदा रुद्रो यूयं कृष्णप्रपूजकाः ॥
अतोऽस्माभी रक्षिणीया वधयोग्याश्च वै भुवि ॥ 16 ॥
3.3.m:
Then Rudra cursed them: "You are worshippers of Kṛṣṇa;
therefore you should be protected by me, and yet [now] you deserve to be slain on earth.

3.3.s:
punarjanma kalau prāpya bhokṣyate cāparādhakam ..
ityuktvāntardadhe devaḥ pāṃḍavā duḥkhitāstadā .. 17 ..
3.3.d:
पुनर्जन्म कलौ प्राप्य भोक्ष्यते चापराधकम् ॥
इत्युक्त्वान्तर्दधे देवः पांडवा दुःखितास्तदा ॥ 17 ॥
3.3.m:
Having obtained rebirth in the Kali age, you shall suffer for your transgression."
Having spoken thus, the god disappeared; then the Pāṇḍavas were sorrowful.

3.3.s:
hariṃ śaraṇamājagmuraparādhanivṛttaye ..
tadā kṛṣṇayutāḥ sarve pāṃḍavāḥ śastravarjitāḥ .. 18 ..
3.3.d:
हरिं शरणमाजग्मुरपराधनिवृत्तये ॥
तदा कृष्णयुताः सर्वे पांडवाः शस्त्रवर्जिताः ॥ 18 ॥
3.3.m:
They went to Hari for refuge to remove their transgression;
then all the Pāṇḍavas, together with Kṛṣṇa, devoid of weapons,

3.3.s:
tuṣṭuvurmanasā rudraṃ tadā prādurabhūcchivaḥ ..
varaṃ varayata prāha kṛṣṇaḥ śrutvābravīdidam .. 19 ..
3.3.d:
तुष्टुवुर्मनसा रुद्रं तदा प्रादुरभूच्छिवः ॥
वरं वरयत प्राह कृष्णः श्रुत्वाब्रवीदिदम् ॥ 19 ॥
3.3.m:
praised Rudra in their minds, and then Śiva manifested.
He said, "Choose a boon!"; hearing this, Kṛṣṇa said this:

3.3.s:
śastrāṇyastrāṇi yānyeva tvadaṃge kṣapitāni vai..
pāṃḍavebhyaśca dehi tvaṃ śāpasyānugrahaṃ kuru .. 3.3.1.20 ..
3.3.d:
शस्त्राण्यस्त्राणि यान्येव त्वदंगे क्षपितानि वै॥
पांडवेभ्यश्च देहि त्वं शापस्यानुग्रहं कुरु ॥ 3.3.1.20 ॥
3.3.m:
"Whatever weapons and missiles were spent upon your body,
give them back to the Pāṇḍavas, and show grace regarding your curse!"

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā śivaḥ prāha kṛṣṇadeva namo'stu te ..
aparādho na me svāminmohito'haṃ tavājñayā .. 21 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा शिवः प्राह कृष्णदेव नमोऽस्तु ते ॥
अपराधो न मे स्वामिन्मोहितोऽहं तवाज्ञया ॥ 21 ॥
3.3.m:
Having heard this, Śiva said: "O divine Kṛṣṇa, homage be to you!
It is not my fault, O Lord; I was deluded by your command.

3.3.s:
tadvaśena mayā svāmindattaḥ śāpo bhayaṃkaraḥ ..
nānyathā vacanaṃ me syādaṃśāvataraṇaṃ bhavet .. 22 ..
3.3.d:
तद्वशेन मया स्वामिन्दत्तः शापो भयंकरः ॥
नान्यथा वचनं मे स्यादंशावतरणं भवेत् ॥ 22 ॥
3.3.m:
Under its sway, O Master, a dreadful curse was pronounced by me;
my word cannot be otherwise, [so] there shall be a descent of portions.

3.3.s:
vatsarājasya putratvaṃ gamiṣyati yudhiṣṭhiraḥ ..
balakhāniriti khyātaḥ śirīṣākhyapurādhipaḥ .. 23 ..
3.3.d:
वत्सराजस्य पुत्रत्वं गमिष्यति युधिष्ठिरः ॥
बलखानिरिति ख्यातः शिरीषाख्यपुराधिपः ॥ 23 ॥
3.3.m:
Yudhiṣṭhira shall attain sonship to Vatsarāja,
renowned as Balakhāni, the ruler of the city named Śirīṣa.

3.3.s:
bhīmo durvacanādduṣṭo mlecchayonau bhaviṣyati ..
vīraṇo nāma vikhyātaḥ sa vai vanarasādhipaḥ .. 24 ..
3.3.d:
भीमो दुर्वचनाद्दुष्टो म्लेच्छयोनौ भविष्यति ॥
वीरणो नाम विख्यातः स वै वनरसाधिपः ॥ 24 ॥
3.3.m:
Bhīma, corrupted because of harsh speech, will be born in a Mleccha womb,
renowned by the name Vīraṇa, ruler of Vanarasa.

3.3.s:
arjunāṃśaśca madbhakto janiṣyati mahāmatiḥ ..
putraḥ parimalasyaiva brahmānanda iti smṛtaḥ..25..
3.3.d:
अर्जुनांशश्च मद्भक्तो जनिष्यति महामतिः ॥
पुत्रः परिमलस्यैव ब्रह्मानन्द इति स्मृतः॥25॥
3.3.m:
A portion of Arjuna, devoted to me and very wise, shall be born
as the son of Parimala, known as Brahmānanda.

3.3.s:
kānyakubje hi nakulo bhaviṣyati mahābalaḥ..
ratnabhānusuto sau vai lakṣmaṇo nāma viśrutaḥ..26..
3.3.d:
कान्यकुब्जे हि नकुलो भविष्यति महाबलः॥
रत्नभानुसुतो सौ वै लक्ष्मणो नाम विश्रुतः॥26॥
3.3.m:
Nakula of great strength will be in Kānyakubja,
the son of Ratnabhānu, renowned indeed by the name Lakṣmaṇa.

3.3.s:
sahadevastu valavāñjaniṣyati mahāmatiḥ..
bhīṣmasiṃha suto jāto devasiṃha iti smṛtaḥ ..27..
3.3.d:
सहदेवस्तु वलवाञ्जनिष्यति महामतिः॥
भीष्मसिंह सुतो जातो देवसिंह इति स्मृतः ॥27॥
3.3.m:
The mighty and highly intelligent Sahadeva will be born
as the son of Bhīṣmasiṃha, known as Devasiṃha.

3.3.s:
dhṛtarāṣṭrāṃśa evāsau janiṣyatyajamerake ..
pṛthivīrāja iti sa dropadī tatsutā smṛtā ..28..
3.3.d:
धृतराष्ट्रांश एवासौ जनिष्यत्यजमेरके ॥
पृथिवीराज इति स द्रोपदी तत्सुता स्मृता ॥28॥
3.3.m:
A portion of Dhṛtarāṣṭra himself will be born in Ajameraka
as Pṛthivīrāja, and Draupadī is known as his daughter,

3.3.s:
velā nāmnā ca vikhyātā tārakaḥ karṇa eva hi ..
raktabījastathā rudro bhaviṣyati mahītale ..29..
3.3.d:
वेला नाम्ना च विख्याता तारकः कर्ण एव हि ॥
रक्तबीजस्तथा रुद्रो भविष्यति महीतले ॥29॥
3.3.m:
renowned by the name Velā; Karṇa will indeed be Tāraka;
likewise, Raktabīja will be Rudra on the surface of the earth.

3.3.s:
kauravāśca bhaviṣyanti māyāyuddhaviśāradāḥ..
pāṃḍupakṣāśca te sarve dharmiṇo balaśālinaḥ ..3.3.1.30..
3.3.d:
कौरवाश्च भविष्यन्ति मायायुद्धविशारदाः॥
पांडुपक्षाश्च ते सर्वे धर्मिणो बलशालिनः ॥3.3.1.30॥
3.3.m:
The Kauravas will be skilled in illusionary warfare,
and all those on the side of Pāṇḍu will be righteous and strong."

3.3.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
iti śrutvā hariḥ prāha vihasya parameśvaram ..
mayā śaktyavatāreṇa rakṣaṇīyā hi pāṃḍavāḥ ..31..
3.3.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
इति श्रुत्वा हरिः प्राह विहस्य परमेश्वरम् ॥
मया शक्त्यवतारेण रक्षणीया हि पांडवाः ॥31॥
3.3.m:
Sūta said:
Having heard this, Hari smiled and said to the Supreme Lord:
"Indeed, the Pāṇḍavas are to be protected by me through an incarnation of Śakti.

3.3.s:
mahāvatī purī ramyā māyādevīvinirmitā ..
deśarājasutastatra mamāṃśo hi janiṣyate .. 32 ..
3.3.d:
महावती पुरी रम्या मायादेवीविनिर्मिता ॥
देशराजसुतस्तत्र ममांशो हि जनिष्यते ॥ 32 ॥
3.3.m:
In the delightful city of Mahāvatī, constructed by the goddess Māyā,
a portion of me will be born as the son of Deśarāja;

3.3.s:
devakījaṭhare janmodayasiṃha iti smṛtaḥ ..
āhlādo mama dhāmāṃśo janiṣyati gururmama .. 33 ..
3.3.d:
देवकीजठरे जन्मोदयसिंह इति स्मृतः ॥
आह्लादो मम धामांशो जनिष्यति गुरुर्मम ॥ 33 ॥
3.3.m:
birth will be in the womb of Devakī, known as Udayasiṃha.
Āhlāda, a portion of my splendour, will be born as my elder brother.

3.3.s:
hatvāgnivaṃśajānbhūpānsthāpayiṣyāmi vai kalim ..
iti śrutvā śivo devastatraivāṃtaradhīyata .. 34 ..
3.3.d:
हत्वाग्निवंशजान्भूपान्स्थापयिष्यामि वै कलिम् ॥
इति श्रुत्वा शिवो देवस्तत्रैवांतरधीयत ॥ 34 ॥
3.3.m:
Having slain the kings born of the fire lineage, I shall establish the Kali age."
Having heard this, the divine Śiva vanished right there.

3.3.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
prātaḥ kāle ca saṃprāpte pāṃḍavāḥ putraśokinaḥ ..
pretakāryāṇi te kṛtvā bhīṣmāntikamupāyayuḥ .. 1 ..
3.3.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
प्रातः काले च संप्राप्ते पांडवाः पुत्रशोकिनः ॥
प्रेतकार्याणि ते कृत्वा भीष्मान्तिकमुपाययुः ॥ 1 ॥
3.3.m:
Sūta said:
When morning arrived, the Pāṇḍavas, grieving for their sons,
performed the funeral rites and approached Bhīṣma.

3.3.s:
rājadharmānmokṣadharmāndānadharmānvibhāgaśaḥ ..
śrutvāyajannaśvamedhaistribhiruttamakarmabhiḥ ..2..
3.3.d:
राजधर्मान्मोक्षधर्मान्दानधर्मान्विभागशः ॥
श्रुत्वायजन्नश्वमेधैस्त्रिभिरुत्तमकर्मभिः ॥2॥
3.3.m:
Having heard the duties of kings, the duties of liberation, and the duties of charity in their divisions,
they worshipped with three horse sacrifices, the foremost of rites.

3.3.s:
ṣaṭtriṃśadabdarājyaṃ hi kṛtvā svargapuraṃ yayuḥ ..
janiṣyante tadaṃśā vai kalidharma vivṛddhaye .. 3 ..
3.3.d:
षट्त्रिंशदब्दराज्यं हि कृत्वा स्वर्गपुरं ययुः ॥
जनिष्यन्ते तदंशा वै कलिधर्म विवृद्धये ॥ 3 ॥
3.3.m:
Having ruled the kingdom for thirty-six years, they went to the city of heaven.
Portions of them will be born for the increase of the dharma of the Kali age.

3.3.s:
.. vyāsa uvāca .. ..
ityuktvā sa muniḥ sarvānpunaḥ sūto vadiṣyati ..
gacchadhvaṃ munayaḥ sarve yoganidrāvaśo hyaham ..
cakratīrthe samādhistho dhyāye'haṃ triguṇātparam .. 4 ..
3.3.d:
॥ व्यास उवाच ॥ ॥
इत्युक्त्वा स मुनिः सर्वान्पुनः सूतो वदिष्यति ॥
गच्छध्वं मुनयः सर्वे योगनिद्रावशो ह्यहम् ॥
चक्रतीर्थे समाधिस्थो ध्यायेऽहं त्रिगुणात्परम् ॥ 4 ॥
3.3.m:
Vyāsa said:
Having said this to all, the sage Sūta will speak again:
"Go, all you sages; for I am under the sway of yogic sleep;
established in absorption at Cakra-tīrtha, I meditate on what is beyond the three guṇas."

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā tu munayo naimiṣāraṇyavāsinaḥ ..
yogasiddhiṃ samāsthāya gamiṣyaṃtyātmanontike .. 5 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा तु मुनयो नैमिषारण्यवासिनः ॥
योगसिद्धिं समास्थाय गमिष्यंत्यात्मनोन्तिके ॥ 5 ॥
3.3.m:
Having heard this, the sages residing in the Naimiṣa forest,
resorting to yogic perfection, will go near to the Self.

3.3.s: dvādaśābdaśate kāle'tīte te śaunakādayaḥ .. 6 ..
3.3.d: द्वादशाब्दशते कालेऽतीते ते शौनकादयः ॥ 6 ॥
3.3.m: When a time of twelve hundred years has passed, those headed by Śaunaka,

3.3.s:
utthāya devakhāte ca snānadhyānādikāḥ kriyāḥ ..
kṛtvā sūtāntikaṃ gatvā vadiṣyaṃti punarvacaḥ .. 7 ..
3.3.d:
उत्थाय देवखाते च स्नानध्यानादिकाः क्रियाः ॥
कृत्वा सूतान्तिकं गत्वा वदिष्यंति पुनर्वचः ॥ 7 ॥
3.3.m:
having arisen and performed rites such as bathing and meditation at the Devakhāta,
will approach Sūta and speak their words again.

3.3.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
vikramākhyānakālo'yaṃ dvāpare ca śivājñayā ..
vinītānbhagavanbhūmau tadā tānnṛpatīnvada .. 8 .. ..
3.3.d:
॥ ऋषय ऊचुः ॥ ॥
विक्रमाख्यानकालोऽयं द्वापरे च शिवाज्ञया ॥
विनीतान्भगवन्भूमौ तदा तान्नृपतीन्वद ॥ 8 ॥ ॥
3.3.m:
The sages said:
This is the time of the narrative of Vikrama; and, O venerable one, speak now
of those kings who, by the command of Śiva in the Dvāpara age, were humbled on earth.

3.3.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
svargate vikramāditye rājāno bahudhā'bhavan ..
tathāṣṭādaśa rājyāni teṣāṃ nāmāni me śṛṇu .. 9 ..
3.3.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
स्वर्गते विक्रमादित्ये राजानो बहुधाऽभवन् ॥
तथाष्टादश राज्यानि तेषां नामानि मे शृणु ॥ 9 ॥
3.3.m: Sūta said: / When Vikramāditya went to heaven, many kings arose; / likewise there were eighteen kingdoms—hear their names from me:

3.3.s:
paścime siṃdhunadyaṃte setubandhe hi dakṣiṇe ..
uttare badarīsthāne pūrve ca kapilāntike ..3.3.2.1 0..
3.3.d:
पश्चिमे सिंधुनद्यंते सेतुबन्धे हि दक्षिणे ॥
उत्तरे बदरीस्थाने पूर्वे च कपिलान्तिके ॥3.3.2.1 0॥
3.3.m: In the west, up to the river Indus; at the Setubandha in the south; / in the north, at the shrine of Badarī; and in the east, near Kapilā,

3.3.s:
aṣṭādaśaiva rāṣṭrāṇi teṣāṃ madhye babhūvire ..
iṃdraprasthaṃ ca pāṃcālaṃ kuru kṣetraṃ ca kāpilam .. 11 ..
3.3.d:
अष्टादशैव राष्ट्राणि तेषां मध्ये बभूविरे ॥
इंद्रप्रस्थं च पांचालं कुरु क्षेत्रं च कापिलम् ॥ 11 ॥
3.3.m: precisely eighteen realms arose within those borders: / Indraprastha, Pañcāla, Kurukṣetra, and Kāpila,

3.3.s:
antarvedī vrajathyaivājameraṃ marudhanva ca ..
gaurjjaraṃ ca mahārāṣṭraṃ drāviḍaṃ ca kaliṃgakam .. 12 ..
3.3.d:
अन्तर्वेदी व्रजथ्यैवाजमेरं मरुधन्व च ॥
गौर्ज्जरं च महाराष्ट्रं द्राविडं च कलिंगकम् ॥ 12 ॥
3.3.m: Antarvedī, Vraja, Ajmer, and Marudhanva, / Gurjara, Mahārāṣṭra, Drāviḍa, and Kaliṅga,

3.3.s:
āvaṃtyaṃ coḍupaṃ vaṃgaṃ gauḍaṃ māgadhameva ca ..
kauśalyaṃ ca tathā jñeyaṃ teṣāṃ rājā pṛthakpṛk .. 13 ..
3.3.d:
आवंत्यं चोडुपं वंगं गौडं मागधमेव च ॥
कौशल्यं च तथा ज्ञेयं तेषां राजा पृथक्पृक् ॥ 13 ॥
3.3.m: Āvantya, Uḍupa, Vaṅga, Gauḍa, Māgadha, / and Kauśalya should also be known; each of these had a separate king.

3.3.s:
nānābhāṣāḥ sthitāstatra bahudharmapravartakāḥ ..
evamabdaśataṃ jātaṃ tataste vai śakādayaḥ ..14..
3.3.d:
नानाभाषाः स्थितास्तत्र बहुधर्मप्रवर्तकाः ॥
एवमब्दशतं जातं ततस्ते वै शकादयः ॥14॥
3.3.m: Various languages were established there, promoting diverse religious ways. / A hundred years passed in this manner; then indeed the Śakas and other [barbarians],

3.3.s:
śrutvā dharmavināśaṃ ca bahuvṛṃdaiḥ samanvitāḥ ..
kecittīrtvā siṃdhunadīmāryyadeśaṃ samāgatāḥ .. 15 ..
3.3.d:
श्रुत्वा धर्मविनाशं च बहुवृंदैः समन्विताः ॥
केचित्तीर्त्वा सिंधुनदीमार्य्यदेशं समागताः ॥ 15 ॥
3.3.m: having heard of the destruction of dharma and gathering in numerous hosts, / crossed the river Indus and entered the land of the Āryas.

3.3.s:
himaparvatamārgeṇa siṃdhumārgeṇa cāgaman ..
jitvāryyāllām̐ṭhayitvā tānsvadeśaṃ punarāyayuḥ .. 16 ..
3.3.d:
हिमपर्वतमार्गेण सिंधुमार्गेण चागमन् ॥
जित्वार्य्याल्लाम्̐ठयित्वा तान्स्वदेशं पुनराययुः ॥ 16 ॥
3.3.m: They came by way of the snow mountains and along the course of the Indus; / having conquered the Āryas and plundered them, they returned to their own land.

3.3.s:
gṛhītvā yoṣitasteṣāṃ paraṃ harṣamupāyayuḥ ..
etasminnantare tatra śālivāhanabhūpatiḥ .. 17 ..
3.3.d:
गृहीत्वा योषितस्तेषां परं हर्षमुपाययुः ॥
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे तत्र शालिवाहनभूपतिः ॥ 17 ॥
3.3.m: Carrying off their women, they rejoiced exceedingly. / In the meantime, right there King Śālivāhana,

3.3.s:
vikramādityapautraśca pitṛrājyaṃ gṛhītavān ..
jitvā śakāndurādharṣāṃścīnataittirideśajān .. 18 ..
3.3.d:
विक्रमादित्यपौत्रश्च पितृराज्यं गृहीतवान् ॥
जित्वा शकान्दुराधर्षांश्चीनतैत्तिरिदेशजान् ॥ 18 ॥
3.3.m: the grandson of Vikramāditya, seized his ancestral kingdom. / Having defeated the invincible Śakas, those born in China and the Taittiri realm,

3.3.s:
bāhlīkānkāmarūpāṃśca romajānkhurajā cchaṭhān ..
teṣāṃ kośāngṛhītvā ca daṃḍayogyānakārayat .. 19 ..
3.3.d:
बाह्लीकान्कामरूपांश्च रोमजान्खुरजा च्छठान् ॥
तेषां कोशान्गृहीत्वा च दंडयोग्यानकारयत् ॥ 19 ॥
3.3.m: the Bāhlīkas, Kāmarūpas, and the treacherous folk born in Rome and Khura, / he seized their treasuries and made them liable to tribute.

3.3.s:
sthāpitā tena maryyādā mlecchāryāṇāṃ pṛthakpṛthak ..
siṃdhusthānamiti jñeyaṃ rāṣṭra māryyasya cottamam ..3.3.2.20..
3.3.d:
स्थापिता तेन मर्य्यादा म्लेच्छार्याणां पृथक्पृथक् ॥
सिंधुस्थानमिति ज्ञेयं राष्ट्र मार्य्यस्य चोत्तमम् ॥3.3.2.20॥
3.3.m: He established a boundary dividing the mlecchas and the Āryas: / the region known as Sindhusthāna was deemed the foremost land of the Ārya,

3.3.s:
mlecchasthānaṃ paraṃ sindhoḥ kṛtaṃ tena mahātmanā ..
ekadā tu śakādhīśo himatuṃgaṃ samāyayau .. 21 ..
3.3.d:
म्लेच्छस्थानं परं सिन्धोः कृतं तेन महात्मना ॥
एकदा तु शकाधीशो हिमतुंगं समाययौ ॥ 21 ॥
3.3.m: while the realm beyond the Indus was made by that great-souled one the abode of the mlecchas. / But on one occasion the lord of the Śakas came to the snowy peak.

3.3.s:
hūṇadeśasya madhye vai giristhaṃ puruṣaṃ śubham ..
dadarśa balavānrājā gaurāṃgaṃ śvetavastrakam .. 22 ..
3.3.d:
हूणदेशस्य मध्ये वै गिरिस्थं पुरुषं शुभम् ॥
ददर्श बलवान्राजा गौरांगं श्वेतवस्त्रकम् ॥ 22 ॥
3.3.m: In the midst of the Hūṇa country, the mighty king beheld / an auspicious person seated on a mountain, fair-complexioned and dressed in white garments.

3.3.s:
ko bhavāniti taṃ prāha sa hovāca mudānvitaḥ ..
īśaputraṃ ca māṃ viddhi kumārīgarbhasaṃbhavam .. 23 ..
3.3.d:
को भवानिति तं प्राह स होवाच मुदान्वितः ॥
ईशपुत्रं च मां विद्धि कुमारीगर्भसंभवम् ॥ 23 ॥
3.3.m: He said to him, 'Who are you?' and he, filled with joy, answered: / 'Know that I am the Son of God, born from the womb of a maiden,

3.3.s:
mlecchadharmasya vaktāraṃ satyavrataparāyaṇam ..
iti śrutvā nṛpaḥ prāha dharmaḥ ko bhavato mataḥ .. 24 ..
3.3.d:
म्लेच्छधर्मस्य वक्तारं सत्यव्रतपरायणम् ॥
इति श्रुत्वा नृपः प्राह धर्मः को भवतो मतः ॥ 24 ॥
3.3.m: a teacher of the mleccha religion, devoted to the vow of truth.' / Having heard this, the king said: 'What religion is favoured by you?'

3.3.s:
śrutvovāca mahārāja prāpte satyasya saṃkṣaye ..
nirmaryāde mlecchadeśe masīho'haṃ samāgataḥ .. 25 ..
3.3.d:
श्रुत्वोवाच महाराज प्राप्ते सत्यस्य संक्षये ॥
निर्मर्यादे म्लेच्छदेशे मसीहोऽहं समागतः ॥ 25 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing [this], he said: 'O great king, when truth had fallen into ruin / in the lawless land of the mlecchas, I arrived as the Messiah.

3.3.s:
īśāmasī ca dasyūnāṃ prādurbhūtā bhayaṃkarī ..
tāmahaṃ mlecchataḥ prāpya masīhatvamupāgataḥ .. 26 ..
3.3.d:
ईशामसी च दस्यूनां प्रादुर्भूता भयंकरी ॥
तामहं म्लेच्छतः प्राप्य मसीहत्वमुपागतः ॥ 26 ॥
3.3.m: A terrible [darkness of] Jesus-the-Messiah had appeared among the robbers; / receiving it from the mlecchas, I attained Messiahship.

3.3.s:
mleccheṣu sthāpito dharmo mayā tacchṛṇu bhūpate ..
mānasaṃ nirmalaṃ kṛtvā malaṃ dehe śubhāśubham ..27.
3.3.d:
म्लेच्छेषु स्थापितो धर्मो मया तच्छृणु भूपते ॥
मानसं निर्मलं कृत्वा मलं देहे शुभाशुभम् ॥27.
3.3.m: The religion established by me among the mlecchas—hear that, O protector of the earth: / having purified the mind and cleansed the body of auspicious and inauspicious impurities,

3.3.s:
naigamaṃ japamāsthāya japeta nirmalaṃ param..
nyāyena satyavacasā manasaikyena mānavaḥ .. 28 ..
3.3.d:
नैगमं जपमास्थाय जपेत निर्मलं परम्॥
न्यायेन सत्यवचसा मनसैक्येन मानवः ॥ 28 ॥
3.3.m: taking recourse in Vedic repetition of sacred texts, one should repeat the pure, supreme [name]. / A man, with justice, truthful speech, and singleness of mind,

3.3.s:
dhyānena pūjayedīśaṃ sūryamaṃḍalasaṃsthitam .
acalo'yaṃ prabhuḥ sākṣāttathā sūryocalaḥ sadā .. 29 ..
3.3.d:
ध्यानेन पूजयेदीशं सूर्यमंडलसंस्थितम् ।
अचलोऽयं प्रभुः साक्षात्तथा सूर्योचलः सदा ॥ 29 ॥
3.3.m: should worship through meditation the Lord abiding in the solar orb. / This Lord is truly immovable, and the sun is ever moving;

3.3.s:
tattvānāṃ calabhūtānāṃ karṣaṇaḥ sa samaṃtataḥ ..
iti kṛtyena bhūpāla masīhā vilayaṃ gatā .. 3.3.2.30 ..
3.3.d:
तत्त्वानां चलभूतानां कर्षणः स समंततः ॥
इति कृत्येन भूपाल मसीहा विलयं गता ॥ 3.3.2.30 ॥
3.3.m: He is the attractor on all sides of the elements that have become mobile. / By such practice, O protector of the earth, the Messiah-status dissolved [into the divine];

3.3.s:
īśamūrtirhṛdi prāptā nityaśuddhā śivaṃkarī ..
īśāmasīha iti ca mama nāma pratiṣṭhitam .. 31 ..
3.3.d:
ईशमूर्तिर्हृदि प्राप्ता नित्यशुद्धा शिवंकरी ॥
ईशामसीह इति च मम नाम प्रतिष्ठितम् ॥ 31 ॥
3.3.m: the form of God, eternally pure and auspicious, was attained within my heart, / and my name was established as Jesus the Messiah.'

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā sa bhūpālo natvā taṃ mlecchapūjakam..
sthāpayāmāsa ta tatra mlecchasthāne hi dāruṇe .. 32 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा स भूपालो नत्वा तं म्लेच्छपूजकम्॥
स्थापयामास त तत्र म्लेच्छस्थाने हि दारुणे ॥ 32 ॥
3.3.m: Having heard this, the king bowed to that worshipful one among the mlecchas / and settled him right there in that harsh abode of the mlecchas.

3.3.s:
svarājyaṃ prāptavānrājā hayamedhamacīkarat ..
rājyaṃ kṛtvā sa ṣaṣṭyabdaṃ svargalokamupāyayau..
svargate nṛpatau tasminyathā cāsīttathā śṛṇu .. 34 ..
3.3.d:
स्वराज्यं प्राप्तवान्राजा हयमेधमचीकरत् ॥
राज्यं कृत्वा स षष्ट्यब्दं स्वर्गलोकमुपाययौ॥
स्वर्गते नृपतौ तस्मिन्यथा चासीत्तथा शृणु ॥ 34 ॥
3.3.m: Having returned to his own kingdom, the king performed the horse sacrifice. / Having ruled for sixty years, he went to heaven. / Hear what took place when that king had departed to heaven:

3.3.s:
śrīsūta uvāca.. ..
śālivāhanavaṃśe ca rājāno daśa cābhavan..
rājyaṃ paṃcaśatābdaṃ ca kṛtvā lokāntaraṃ yayuḥ.. 1..
3.3.d:
श्रीसूत उवाच॥ ॥
शालिवाहनवंशे च राजानो दश चाभवन्॥
राज्यं पंचशताब्दं च कृत्वा लोकान्तरं ययुः॥ 1॥
3.3.m: The venerable Sūta said: / In the lineage of Śālivāhana there were ten kings; / having ruled for five hundred years, they passed into the other world.

3.3.s:
maryyādā kramato līnā jātā bhūmaṃḍale tadā..
bhūpatirdaśamo yo vai bhojarāja iti smṛtaḥ ..
dṛṣṭvā prakṣīṇamaryyādāṃ balī digvijayaṃ yayau .. 2 ..
3.3.d:
मर्य्यादा क्रमतो लीना जाता भूमंडले तदा॥
भूपतिर्दशमो यो वै भोजराज इति स्मृतः ॥
दृष्ट्वा प्रक्षीणमर्य्यादां बली दिग्विजयं ययौ ॥ 2 ॥
3.3.m: Gradually, the established order in the terrestrial orb vanished. / The tenth king is recalled as King Bhoja; / seeing the established order severely diminished, the mighty one set out on a world-conquest.

3.3.s:
senayā daśasāhasryā kālidāsena saṃyutaḥ ..
tathānyairbrāhmaṇaiḥ sārddhaṃ siṃdhupāramupāyayau .. 3 ..
3.3.d:
सेनया दशसाहस्र्या कालिदासेन संयुतः ॥
तथान्यैर्ब्राह्मणैः सार्द्धं सिंधुपारमुपाययौ ॥ 3 ॥
3.3.m: Accompanied by an army of ten thousand and by Kālidāsa, / as well as along with other brahmins, he reached the further bank of the Indus.

3.3.s:
jitvā gāṃdhārajānmlecchānkāśmīrānnāravāñchaṭhān ..
teṣāṃ prāpya mahākośaṃ daṃḍayogyānakārayat ..4..
3.3.d:
जित्वा गांधारजान्म्लेच्छान्काश्मीरान्नारवाञ्छठान् ॥
तेषां प्राप्य महाकोशं दंडयोग्यानकारयत् ॥4॥
3.3.m: Conquering the mlecchas of Gandhāra, the Kāśmīras, and the deceitful Nāravals, / he seized their vast treasuries and made them liable to tribute.

3.3.s:
etasminnantare mleccha ācāryyeṇa samanvitaḥ..
mahāmada iti khyātaḥ śiṣyaśākhāsamanvitaḥ..5..
3.3.d:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे म्लेच्छ आचार्य्येण समन्वितः॥
महामद इति ख्यातः शिष्यशाखासमन्वितः॥5॥
3.3.m: In the meantime, a mleccha accompanied by his preceptor, / renowned as Mahāmada, [arrived] together with a branch of disciples.

3.3.s:
nṛpaścaiva mahādevaṃ marusthalanivāsinam..
gaṃgājalaiśca saṃsnāpya paṃcagavyasamanvitaiḥ..
caṃdanādibhirabhyarcya tuṣṭāva manasā haram..6..
3.3.d:
नृपश्चैव महादेवं मरुस्थलनिवासिनम्॥
गंगाजलैश्च संस्नाप्य पंचगव्यसमन्वितैः॥
चंदनादिभिरभ्यर्च्य तुष्टाव मनसा हरम्॥6॥
3.3.m: The king bathed Mahādeva, the dweller in the desert, / with waters of the Gaṅgā combined with the five products of the cow, / worshipped him with sandalwood and other perfumes, and praised Hara in his heart.

3.3.s:
bhojarāja uvāca..
namaste girijānātha marusthalanivāsine ..
tripurāsuranāśāya vahumāyāpravarttine .. 7 ..
3.3.d:
भोजराज उवाच॥
नमस्ते गिरिजानाथ मरुस्थलनिवासिने ॥
त्रिपुरासुरनाशाय वहुमायाप्रवर्त्तिने ॥ 7 ॥
3.3.m: King Bhoja said: / 'Salutations to you, O Lord of the Mountain's Daughter, dweller in the desert, / destroyer of the demon Tripura, instigator of manifold illusions!

3.3.s:
mlecchairguptāya śuddhāya saccidānandarūpiṇe ..
tvaṃ māṃ hi kiṃkaraṃ viddhi śaraṇārthamupāgatam..8 ..
3.3.d:
म्लेच्छैर्गुप्ताय शुद्धाय सच्चिदानन्दरूपिणे ॥
त्वं मां हि किंकरं विद्धि शरणार्थमुपागतम्॥8 ॥
3.3.m: Concealed by the mlecchas, pure, whose nature is being, consciousness, and bliss— / know me indeed as your servant who has come for refuge.'

3.3.s:
..sūta uvāca .. ..
iti śrutvā stavaṃ devaḥ śabdamāha nṛpāya tam ..
gaṃtavyaṃ bhojarājena mahākāleśvarasthale .. 9 ..
3.3.d:
॥सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
इति श्रुत्वा स्तवं देवः शब्दमाह नृपाय तम् ॥
गंतव्यं भोजराजेन महाकालेश्वरस्थले ॥ 9 ॥
3.3.m: Sūta said: / Having heard this hymn of praise, the god uttered these words to the king: / 'King Bhoja must proceed to the shrine of Mahākāleśvara.

3.3.s:
mlecchaissudūṣitā bhūmirvāhīkā nāma viśrutā ..
āryyadharmo hi naivātra vāhīke deśadāruṇe .. 3.3.3.10 ..
3.3.d:
म्लेच्छैस्सुदूषिता भूमिर्वाहीका नाम विश्रुता ॥
आर्य्यधर्मो हि नैवात्र वाहीके देशदारुणे ॥ 3.3.3.10 ॥
3.3.m: The land renowned as Vāhīka has been utterly defiled by the mlecchas; / indeed, the religion of the Āryas does not exist here in this dread Vāhīka land.

3.3.s:
babhūvātra mahāmāyī yo'sau dagdho mayā purā..
tripuro balidaityena preṣitaḥ punarāgataḥ .. 11 ..
3.3.d:
बभूवात्र महामायी योऽसौ दग्धो मया पुरा॥
त्रिपुरो बलिदैत्येन प्रेषितः पुनरागतः ॥ 11 ॥
3.3.m: He who was a great illusionist and was burned by me in ancient times / has arisen here: Tripura, dispatched by the demon Bali, has returned again.

3.3.s:
ayoniḥ sa varo mattaḥ prāptavāndaityavarddhanaḥ ..
mahāmada iti khyātaḥ paiśācakṛtitatparaḥ .. 12 ..
3.3.d:
अयोनिः स वरो मत्तः प्राप्तवान्दैत्यवर्द्धनः ॥
महामद इति ख्यातः पैशाचकृतितत्परः ॥ 12 ॥
3.3.m: Having obtained from me a boon of non-womb birth, that enhancer of the demons, / renowned as Mahāmada, is intent on acts worthy of a piśāca.

3.3.s:
nāgantavyaṃ tvayā bhūpa paiśāce deśadhūrtake ..
matprasādena bhūpāla tava śuddhiḥ prajāyate .. 13 ..
3.3.d:
नागन्तव्यं त्वया भूप पैशाचे देशधूर्तके ॥
मत्प्रसादेन भूपाल तव शुद्धिः प्रजायते ॥ 13 ॥
3.3.m: You must not come, O king, into this roguish land of piśācas; / by my grace, O protector of the earth, your purification will be brought about.'

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā nṛpaścaiva svadeśānpunarāgamat..
mahāmadaśca taiḥ sārddhaṃ siṃdhutīramupāyayau .. 14 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा नृपश्चैव स्वदेशान्पुनरागमत्॥
महामदश्च तैः सार्द्धं सिंधुतीरमुपाययौ ॥ 14 ॥
3.3.m: Having heard this, the king returned to his own lands; / and Mahāmada, along with his followers, arrived at the bank of the Indus.

3.3.s:
uvāca bhūpatiṃ premṇā māyāmadaviśāradaḥ ..
tava devo mahārāja mama dāsatvamāgataḥ .. 15 ..
3.3.d:
उवाच भूपतिं प्रेम्णा मायामदविशारदः ॥
तव देवो महाराज मम दासत्वमागतः ॥ 15 ॥
3.3.m: Skilled in the intoxication of illusion, he said with affection to the ruler of the earth: / 'O great king, your god has become my servant.

3.3.s:
mamocchiṣṭhaṃ sabhuṃjīyādyathā tatpaśya bho nṛpa ..
iti śrutvā tathā dṛṣṭvā paraṃ vismayamāgataḥ .. 16 ..
3.3.d:
ममोच्छिष्ठं सभुंजीयाद्यथा तत्पश्य भो नृप ॥
इति श्रुत्वा तथा दृष्ट्वा परं विस्मयमागतः ॥ 16 ॥
3.3.m: See how he eats my leftovers, O king!' / Having heard this and seen it thus, [the king] fell into utmost astonishment;

3.3.s: mlecchadharme matiścāsīttasya bhūpasya dāruṇe..17..
3.3.d: म्लेच्छधर्मे मतिश्चासीत्तस्य भूपस्य दारुणे॥17॥
3.3.m: and the mind of that king was turned toward the terrible mleccha religion.

3.3.s:
tacchrutvā kālidāsastu ruṣā prāha mahāmadam ..
māyā te nirmitā dhūrta nṛpamohanahetave .. 18 ..
3.3.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा कालिदासस्तु रुषा प्राह महामदम् ॥
माया ते निर्मिता धूर्त नृपमोहनहेतवे ॥ 18 ॥
3.3.m:
Hearing that, Kālidāsa angrily addressed Mahāmada:
“An illusion has been created by you, rogue, in order to delude the king!

3.3.s:
haniṣyāmi durācāraṃ vāhīkaṃ puruṣādhamam ...
ityuktvā sa dvijaḥ śrīmānnavārṇajapatatparaḥ .. 19 ..
3.3.d:
हनिष्यामि दुराचारं वाहीकं पुरुषाधमम् ॥।
इत्युक्त्वा स द्विजः श्रीमान्नवार्णजपतत्परः ॥ 19 ॥
3.3.m:
I shall kill that wicked, lowest of men from the Vāhīka [country]!”
Having spoken thus, that glorious twice-born devoted himself to the recitation of the nine-syllabled mantra.

3.3.s:
japtvā daśasahasraṃ ca taddaśāṃśaṃ juhāva saḥ ..
bhasma bhūtvā sa māyāvī mlecchadevatvamāgataḥ..3.3.3.20...
3.3.d:
जप्त्वा दशसहस्रं च तद्दशांशं जुहाव सः ॥
भस्म भूत्वा स मायावी म्लेच्छदेवत्वमागतः॥3.3.3.20॥।
3.3.m:
Reciting it ten thousand times, he offered a tenth of that in the fire.
Reduced to ashes, that illusionist attained the status of a god of the Mlecchas.

3.3.s:
bhayabhītāstu tacchiṣyā deśaṃ vāhīkamāyayuḥ ..
gṛhītvā svagurorbhasma madahīnatvamāgatam .. 21 ..
3.3.d:
भयभीतास्तु तच्छिष्या देशं वाहीकमाययुः ॥
गृहीत्वा स्वगुरोर्भस्म मदहीनत्वमागतम् ॥ 21 ॥
3.3.m:
Terrified, his disciples returned to the Vāhīka land,
taking the ashes of their guru who had been subdued.

3.3.s:
sthāpitaṃ taiśca bhūmadhye tatroṣurmadatatparāḥ ...
madahīnaṃ puraṃ jātaṃ teṣāṃ tīrthaṃ samaṃ smṛtam .. 22 ..
3.3.d:
स्थापितं तैश्च भूमध्ये तत्रोषुर्मदतत्पराः ॥।
मदहीनं पुरं जातं तेषां तीर्थं समं स्मृतम् ॥ 22 ॥
3.3.m:
It was placed by them in the ground, and there they dwelt, devoted to intoxication.
A city called Madahīna arose, considered by them an equal pilgrimage site.

3.3.s:
rātrau sa devarūpaśca bahumāyāviśāradaḥ ..
paiśācaṃ dehamāsthāya bhojarājaṃ hi so'bravīt..23..
3.3.d:
रात्रौ स देवरूपश्च बहुमायाविशारदः ॥
पैशाचं देहमास्थाय भोजराजं हि सोऽब्रवीत्॥23॥
3.3.m:
At night, having assumed a divine form, skilled in many illusions,
and having taken on a ghostly body, he spoke to King Bhoja:

3.3.s:
āryyadharmo hi te rājansarvadharmottamaḥ smṛtaḥ..
īśājñayā kariṣyāmi paiśācaṃ dharmadāruṇam .. 24 ..
3.3.d:
आर्य्यधर्मो हि ते राजन्सर्वधर्मोत्तमः स्मृतः॥
ईशाज्ञया करिष्यामि पैशाचं धर्मदारुणम् ॥ 24 ॥
3.3.m:
“O King, the Āryan religion is considered the highest of all religions.
By the command of the Lord, I will establish a terrible ghostly religion.

3.3.s:
liṃgacchedī śikhāhīnaḥ śmaśrudhārī sa dūṣakaḥ ..
uccālāpī sarvabhakṣī bhaviṣyati jano mama .. 25 ..
3.3.d:
लिंगच्छेदी शिखाहीनः श्मश्रुधारी स दूषकः ॥
उच्चालापी सर्वभक्षी भविष्यति जनो मम ॥ 25 ॥
3.3.m:
My people shall cut the foreskin, lack a tuft of hair, bear a beard, and be polluters;
they will speak loudly and eat everything.

3.3.s:
vinā kaulaṃ ca paśavasteṣāṃ bhakṣyā matā mama ..
musalenaiva saṃskāraḥ kuśairiva bhaviṣyati .. 26 ..
3.3.d:
विना कौलं च पशवस्तेषां भक्ष्या मता मम ॥
मुसलेनैव संस्कारः कुशैरिव भविष्यति ॥ 26 ॥
3.3.m:
Except without a rite, animals will be considered edible by them;
their purification will be by a pestle, just as with kuśa grass.

3.3.s:
tasmānmusalavanto hi jātayo dharmadūṣakāḥ ..
iti paiśācadharmaśca bhaviṣyati mayā kṛtaḥ .. 27 ..
3.3.d:
तस्मान्मुसलवन्तो हि जातयो धर्मदूषकाः ॥
इति पैशाचधर्मश्च भविष्यति मया कृतः ॥ 27 ॥
3.3.m:
Therefore, they will be the Musalavān peoples, defilers of righteousness.
Thus this ghostly religion will be established by me.”

3.3.s:
ityuktvā prayayau devaḥ sa rājā gehamāyayau ..
trivarṇe sthāpitā vāṇī sāṃskṛtī svargadāyinī .. 28 ..
3.3.d:
इत्युक्त्वा प्रययौ देवः स राजा गेहमाययौ ॥
त्रिवर्णे स्थापिता वाणी सांस्कृती स्वर्गदायिनी ॥ 28 ॥
3.3.m:
Having spoken thus, the god departed, and the king returned home.
Among the three castes, the Sanskrit speech that yields heaven was established.

3.3.s:
śūdreṣu prākṛtī bhāṣā sthāpitā tena dhīmatā ..
paṃcāśadabdakālaṃ tu rājyaṃ kṛtvā divaṃ gataḥ .. 29 ..
3.3.d:
शूद्रेषु प्राकृती भाषा स्थापिता तेन धीमता ॥
पंचाशदब्दकालं तु राज्यं कृत्वा दिवं गतः ॥ 29 ॥
3.3.m:
Among the Śūdras, the Prakrit speech was established by that wise king.
Having ruled the kingdom for fifty years, he went to heaven.

3.3.s:
sthāpitā tena maryyādā sarvadevopamāninī ..
āryyāvartaḥ puṇyabhūmirmadhyaṃ viṃdhyahimālayoḥ .. 3.3.3.30 ..
3.3.d:
स्थापिता तेन मर्य्यादा सर्वदेवोपमानिनी ॥
आर्य्यावर्तः पुण्यभूमिर्मध्यं विंध्यहिमालयोः ॥ 3.3.3.30 ॥
3.3.m:
He established the proper order resembling that of all the gods:
Āryāvarta, the sacred land, is the region between the Vindhya and the Himālaya.

3.3.s:
āryya varṇāḥ sthitāstatra viṃdhyānte varṇasaṃkarāḥ ..
narā musalavantaśca sthāpitāḥ siṃdhupārajāḥ .. 31 ..
3.3.d:
आर्य्य वर्णाः स्थितास्तत्र विंध्यान्ते वर्णसंकराः ॥
नरा मुसलवन्तश्च स्थापिताः सिंधुपारजाः ॥ 31 ॥
3.3.m:
The Āryan castes dwelt there, and mixed castes at the border of the Vindhyas;
and the Musalavān men were placed beyond the Indus River.

3.3.s:
barbare tuṣadeśe ca dvīpe nānāvidhe tathā ..
īśāmasīhadharmmāśca surai rājñaiva saṃsthitāḥ .. 32 ..
śrīsūta uvāca.. ..
śālivāhanavaṃśe ca rājāno daśa cābhavan..
rājyaṃ paṃcaśatābdaṃ ca kṛtvā lokāntaraṃ yayuḥ.. 1..
maryyādā kramato līnā jātā bhūmaṃḍale tadā..
bhūpatirdaśamo yo vai bhojarāja iti smṛtaḥ ..
dṛṣṭvā prakṣīṇamaryyādāṃ balī digvijayaṃ yayau .. 2 ..
senayā daśasāhasryā kālidāsena saṃyutaḥ ..
tathānyairbrāhmaṇaiḥ sārddhaṃ siṃdhupāramupāyayau .. 3 ..
jitvā gāṃdhārajānmlecchānkāśmīrānnāravāñchaṭhān ..
teṣāṃ prāpya mahākośaṃ daṃḍayogyānakārayat ..4..
etasminnantare mleccha ācāryyeṇa samanvitaḥ..
mahāmada iti khyātaḥ śiṣyaśākhāsamanvitaḥ..5..
nṛpaścaiva mahādevaṃ marusthalanivāsinam..
gaṃgājalaiśca saṃsnāpya paṃcagavyasamanvitaiḥ..
caṃdanādibhirabhyarcya tuṣṭāva manasā haram..6..
3.3.d:
बर्बरे तुषदेशे च द्वीपे नानाविधे तथा ॥
ईशामसीहधर्म्माश्च सुरै राज्ञैव संस्थिताः ॥ 32 ॥
श्रीसूत उवाच॥ ॥
शालिवाहनवंशे च राजानो दश चाभवन्॥
राज्यं पंचशताब्दं च कृत्वा लोकान्तरं ययुः॥ 1॥
मर्य्यादा क्रमतो लीना जाता भूमंडले तदा॥
भूपतिर्दशमो यो वै भोजराज इति स्मृतः ॥
दृष्ट्वा प्रक्षीणमर्य्यादां बली दिग्विजयं ययौ ॥ 2 ॥
सेनया दशसाहस्र्या कालिदासेन संयुतः ॥
तथान्यैर्ब्राह्मणैः सार्द्धं सिंधुपारमुपाययौ ॥ 3 ॥
जित्वा गांधारजान्म्लेच्छान्काश्मीरान्नारवाञ्छठान् ॥
तेषां प्राप्य महाकोशं दंडयोग्यानकारयत् ॥4॥
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे म्लेच्छ आचार्य्येण समन्वितः॥
महामद इति ख्यातः शिष्यशाखासमन्वितः॥5॥
नृपश्चैव महादेवं मरुस्थलनिवासिनम्॥
गंगाजलैश्च संस्नाप्य पंचगव्यसमन्वितैः॥
चंदनादिभिरभ्यर्च्य तुष्टाव मनसा हरम्॥6॥
3.3.m:
In Barbara, the Tuṣa land, and various continents,
the religions of Īśāmasīha were maintained by the gods and by kings.
Śrī Sūta said:
In the lineage of Śālivāhana there were ten kings;
having ruled the kingdom for five hundred years, they departed to the other world.
The proper order gradually collapsed on the earth at that time.
The tenth king, remembered as King Bhoja,
seeing the decline of the proper order, set out strong on a world conquest.
Accompanied by an army of ten thousand and with Kālidāsa,
and together with other Brahmins, he reached the other bank of the Indus.
Having conquered the Mlecchas born in Gandhāra, the Kashmirians, and the deceitful Arabs,
and having seized their great treasury, he made them fit for punishment.
Meanwhile, accompanied by a teacher,
a Mleccha known as Mahāmada, together with a band of disciples, [appeared].
And the king bathed Mahādeva, who dwells in the desert,
with waters of the Gaṅgā mixed with the five products of the cow;
having worshipped Hara with sandalwood and other offerings, he praised him in his mind.

3.3.s:
bhojarāja uvāca..
namaste girijānātha marusthalanivāsine ..
tripurāsuranāśāya vahumāyāpravarttine .. 7 ..
mlecchairguptāya śuddhāya saccidānandarūpiṇe ..
tvaṃ māṃ hi kiṃkaraṃ viddhi śaraṇārthamupāgatam..8 ..
..sūta uvāca .. ..
iti śrutvā stavaṃ devaḥ śabdamāha nṛpāya tam ..
gaṃtavyaṃ bhojarājena mahākāleśvarasthale .. 9 ..
mlecchaissudūṣitā bhūmirvāhīkā nāma viśrutā ..
āryyadharmo hi naivātra vāhīke deśadāruṇe .. 3.3.3.10 ..
babhūvātra mahāmāyī yo'sau dagdho mayā purā..
tripuro balidaityena preṣitaḥ punarāgataḥ .. 11 ..
ayoniḥ sa varo mattaḥ prāptavāndaityavarddhanaḥ ..
mahāmada iti khyātaḥ paiśācakṛtitatparaḥ .. 12 ..

3.3.d:
भोजराज उवाच॥
नमस्ते गिरिजानाथ मरुस्थलनिवासिने ॥
त्रिपुरासुरनाशाय वहुमायाप्रवर्त्तिने ॥ 7 ॥
म्लेच्छैर्गुप्ताय शुद्धाय सच्चिदानन्दरूपिणे ॥
त्वं मां हि किंकरं विद्धि शरणार्थमुपागतम्॥8 ॥
॥सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
इति श्रुत्वा स्तवं देवः शब्दमाह नृपाय तम् ॥
गंतव्यं भोजराजेन महाकालेश्वरस्थले ॥ 9 ॥
म्लेच्छैस्सुदूषिता भूमिर्वाहीका नाम विश्रुता ॥
आर्य्यधर्मो हि नैवात्र वाहीके देशदारुणे ॥ 3.3.3.10 ॥
बभूवात्र महामायी योऽसौ दग्धो मया पुरा॥
त्रिपुरो बलिदैत्येन प्रेषितः पुनरागतः ॥ 11 ॥
अयोनिः स वरो मत्तः प्राप्तवान्दैत्यवर्द्धनः ॥
महामद इति ख्यातः पैशाचकृतितत्परः ॥ 12 ॥
नागन्तव्यं त्वया भूप पैशाचे देशधूर्तके ॥
मत्प्रसादेन भूपाल तव शुद्धिः प्रजायते ॥ 13 ॥
3.3.m:
King Bhoja said:
“Salutations to you, Lord of the Daughter of the Mountain, Dweller in the desert,
Destroyer of the demon Tripura, Initiator of many illusions!
Concealed by Mlecchas, pure, whose nature is being, consciousness, and bliss!
Know me as your servant, who has come for refuge.”
Sūta said:
Having heard this hymn of praise, the god uttered these words to the king:
“King Bhoja must go to the place of Mahākāleśvara.
This land, known as Vāhīka, has been utterly defiled by Mlecchas;
indeed, the Āryan religion does not exist in this terrible Vāhīka land.
Here arose that great illusionist whom I burned long ago;
Tripura, sent by the demon Bali, has come once again.
He of non-uterine birth, who increases the demons, received a boon from me;
known as Mahāmada, he is intent upon ghostly actions.
You must not go, O King, to that deceptive, ghostly land;
by my grace, O protector of the earth, your purification will take place.”

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā nṛpaścaiva svadeśānpunarāgamat..
mahāmadaśca taiḥ sārddhaṃ siṃdhutīramupāyayau .. 14 ..
uvāca bhūpatiṃ premṇā māyāmadaviśāradaḥ ..
tava devo mahārāja mama dāsatvamāgataḥ .. 15 ..
mamocchiṣṭhaṃ sabhuṃjīyādyathā tatpaśya bho nṛpa ..
iti śrutvā tathā dṛṣṭvā paraṃ vismayamāgataḥ .. 16 ..
mlecchadharme matiścāsīttasya bhūpasya dāruṇe..17..
tacchrutvā kālidāsastu ruṣā prāha mahāmadam ..
māyā te nirmitā dhūrta nṛpamohanahetave .. 18 ..
haniṣyāmi durācāraṃ vāhīkaṃ puruṣādhamam ...
ityuktvā sa dvijaḥ śrīmānnavārṇajapatatparaḥ .. 19 ..
japtvā daśasahasraṃ ca taddaśāṃśaṃ juhāva saḥ ..
bhasma bhūtvā sa māyāvī mlecchadevatvamāgataḥ..3.3.3.20...
bhayabhītāstu tacchiṣyā deśaṃ vāhīkamāyayuḥ ..
gṛhītvā svagurorbhasma madahīnatvamāgatam .. 21 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा नृपश्चैव स्वदेशान्पुनरागमत्॥
महामदश्च तैः सार्द्धं सिंधुतीरमुपाययौ ॥ 14 ॥
उवाच भूपतिं प्रेम्णा मायामदविशारदः ॥
तव देवो महाराज मम दासत्वमागतः ॥ 15 ॥
ममोच्छिष्ठं सभुंजीयाद्यथा तत्पश्य भो नृप ॥
इति श्रुत्वा तथा दृष्ट्वा परं विस्मयमागतः ॥ 16 ॥
म्लेच्छधर्मे मतिश्चासीत्तस्य भूपस्य दारुणे॥17॥
तच्छ्रुत्वा कालिदासस्तु रुषा प्राह महामदम् ॥
माया ते निर्मिता धूर्त नृपमोहनहेतवे ॥ 18 ॥
हनिष्यामि दुराचारं वाहीकं पुरुषाधमम् ॥।
इत्युक्त्वा स द्विजः श्रीमान्नवार्णजपतत्परः ॥ 19 ॥
जप्त्वा दशसहस्रं च तद्दशांशं जुहाव सः ॥
भस्म भूत्वा स मायावी म्लेच्छदेवत्वमागतः॥3.3.3.20॥।
भयभीतास्तु तच्छिष्या देशं वाहीकमाययुः ॥
गृहीत्वा स्वगुरोर्भस्म मदहीनत्वमागतम् ॥ 21 ॥
3.3.m:
Having heard this, the king returned to his own country;
and Mahāmada, along with his followers, arrived at the bank of the Indus.
Skilled in illusion and arrogance, he spoke affectionately to the king:
“O Great King, your god has become my servant!
He shall eat my leftovers—see that, O King!”
Having heard that and having seen it thus, [the king] was filled with supreme astonishment.
And the mind of that king turned toward the dreadful religion of the Mlecchas.
Hearing that, Kālidāsa angrily addressed Mahāmada:
“An illusion has been created by you, rogue, in order to delude the king!
I shall kill that wicked, lowest of men from the Vāhīka [country]!”
Having spoken thus, that glorious twice-born devoted himself to the recitation of the nine-syllabled mantra.
Reciting it ten thousand times, he offered a tenth of that in the fire.
Reduced to ashes, that illusionist attained the status of a god of the Mlecchas.
Terrified, his disciples returned to the Vāhīka land,
taking the ashes of their guru who had been subdued.

3.3.s:
sthāpitaṃ taiśca bhūmadhye tatroṣurmadatatparāḥ ...
madahīnaṃ puraṃ jātaṃ teṣāṃ tīrthaṃ samaṃ smṛtam .. 22 ..
rātrau sa devarūpaśca bahumāyāviśāradaḥ ..
paiśācaṃ dehamāsthāya bhojarājaṃ hi so'bravīt..23..
āryyadharmo hi te rājansarvadharmottamaḥ smṛtaḥ..
īśājñayā kariṣyāmi paiśācaṃ dharmadāruṇam .. 24 ..
liṃgacchedī śikhāhīnaḥ śmaśrudhārī sa dūṣakaḥ ..
uccālāpī sarvabhakṣī bhaviṣyati jano mama .. 25 ..
vinā kaulaṃ ca paśavasteṣāṃ bhakṣyā matā mama ..
musalenaiva saṃskāraḥ kuśairiva bhaviṣyati .. 26 ..
tasmānmusalavanto hi jātayo dharmadūṣakāḥ ..
iti paiśācadharmaśca bhaviṣyati mayā kṛtaḥ .. 27 ..
ityuktvā prayayau devaḥ sa rājā gehamāyayau ..
trivarṇe sthāpitā vāṇī sāṃskṛtī svargadāyinī .. 28 ..
3.3.d:
स्थापितं तैश्च भूमध्ये तत्रोषुर्मदतत्पराः ॥।
मदहीनं पुरं जातं तेषां तीर्थं समं स्मृतम् ॥ 22 ॥
रात्रौ स देवरूपश्च बहुमायाविशारदः ॥
पैशाचं देहमास्थाय भोजराजं हि सोऽब्रवीत्॥23॥
आर्य्यधर्मो हि ते राजन्सर्वधर्मोत्तमः स्मृतः॥
ईशाज्ञया करिष्यामि पैशाचं धर्मदारुणम् ॥ 24 ॥
लिंगच्छेदी शिखाहीनः श्मश्रुधारी स दूषकः ॥
उच्चालापी सर्वभक्षी भविष्यति जनो मम ॥ 25 ॥
विना कौलं च पशवस्तेषां भक्ष्या मता मम ॥
मुसलेनैव संस्कारः कुशैरिव भविष्यति ॥ 26 ॥
तस्मान्मुसलवन्तो हि जातयो धर्मदूषकाः ॥
इति पैशाचधर्मश्च भविष्यति मया कृतः ॥ 27 ॥
इत्युक्त्वा प्रययौ देवः स राजा गेहमाययौ ॥
त्रिवर्णे स्थापिता वाणी सांस्कृती स्वर्गदायिनी ॥ 28 ॥
3.3.m:
It was placed by them in the ground, and there they dwelt, devoted to intoxication.
A city called Madahīna arose, considered by them an equal pilgrimage site.
At night, having assumed a divine form, skilled in many illusions,
and having taken on a ghostly body, he spoke to King Bhoja:
“O King, the Āryan religion is considered the highest of all religions.
By the command of the Lord, I will establish a terrible ghostly religion.
My people shall cut the foreskin, lack a tuft of hair, bear a beard, and be polluters;
they will speak loudly and eat everything.
Except without a rite, animals will be considered edible by them;
their purification will be by a pestle, just as with kuśa grass.
Therefore, they will be the Musalavān peoples, defilers of righteousness.
Thus this ghostly religion will be established by me.”
Having spoken thus, the god departed, and the king returned home.
Among the three castes, the Sanskrit speech that yields heaven was established.

3.3.s:
śūdreṣu prākṛtī bhāṣā sthāpitā tena dhīmatā ..
paṃcāśadabdakālaṃ tu rājyaṃ kṛtvā divaṃ gataḥ .. 29 ..
sthāpitā tena maryyādā sarvadevopamāninī ..
āryyāvartaḥ puṇyabhūmirmadhyaṃ viṃdhyahimālayoḥ .. 3.3.3.30 ..
āryya varṇāḥ sthitāstatra viṃdhyānte varṇasaṃkarāḥ ..
narā musalavantaśca sthāpitāḥ siṃdhupārajāḥ .. 31 ..
barbare tuṣadeśe ca dvīpe nānāvidhe tathā ..
īśāmasīhadharmmāśca surai rājñaiva saṃsthitāḥ .. 32 ..
3.3.d:
शूद्रेषु प्राकृती भाषा स्थापिता तेन धीमता ॥
पंचाशदब्दकालं तु राज्यं कृत्वा दिवं गतः ॥ 29 ॥
स्थापिता तेन मर्य्यादा सर्वदेवोपमानिनी ॥
आर्य्यावर्तः पुण्यभूमिर्मध्यं विंध्यहिमालयोः ॥ 3.3.3.30 ॥
आर्य्य वर्णाः स्थितास्तत्र विंध्यान्ते वर्णसंकराः ॥
नरा मुसलवन्तश्च स्थापिताः सिंधुपारजाः ॥ 31 ॥
बर्बरे तुषदेशे च द्वीपे नानाविधे तथा ॥
ईशामसीहधर्म्माश्च सुरै राज्ञैव संस्थिताः ॥ 32 ॥
3.3.m:
The Prakrit language was established among the Śūdras by that wise king. / Having ruled for a period of fifty years, he went to heaven.
A boundary was established by him, respected by all the gods: / Āryāvarta is the holy land, lying between the Vindhyas and the Himalayas.
The noble classes were settled there, and mixed classes at the edge of the Vindhyas; / the people who possess clubs (Musalmāns) were settled beyond the Indus,
and likewise in Barbara, the Tuṣa country, and various islands. / The faiths of Īśā Masīha (Jesus Christ) were established there by the gods through the king.

3.3.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
svargate bhojarāje tu saptabhūpāstadanvaye ..
jātāścālpāyuṣo mandāstriśatābdāntare mṛtāḥ .. 1 ..
3.3.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
स्वर्गते भोजराजे तु सप्तभूपास्तदन्वये ॥
जाताश्चाल्पायुषो मन्दास्त्रिशताब्दान्तरे मृताः ॥ 1 ॥
3.3.m: Sūta said: / When King Bhoja had gone to heaven, seven kings were born in his lineage; / short-lived and weak, they died within the space of three hundred years.

3.3.s:
bahubhūpavatī bhūmisteṣāṃ rājye babhūva ha ..
vīrasiṃhaśca yo bhūpaḥ saptamaḥ saṃprakīrtitaḥ .. 2 ..
3.3.d:
बहुभूपवती भूमिस्तेषां राज्ये बभूव ह ॥
वीरसिंहश्च यो भूपः सप्तमः संप्रकीर्तितः ॥ 2 ॥
3.3.m: During their rule, the earth came to possess many kings. / King Vīrasiṃha is proclaimed as the seventh [among them].

3.3.s:
tadanvaye tribhūpāśca dviśatābdāntare mṛtāḥ ..
gaṃgāsiṃhaśca yo bhūpo daśamaḥ sa prakīrtitaḥ .. 3 ..
3.3.d:
तदन्वये त्रिभूपाश्च द्विशताब्दान्तरे मृताः ॥
गंगासिंहश्च यो भूपो दशमः स प्रकीर्तितः ॥ 3 ॥
3.3.m: In his lineage three kings died within the space of two hundred years; / King Gaṅgāsiṃha is proclaimed as the tenth.

3.3.s:
kalpakṣetre ca rājyaṃ svaṃ kṛtavāndharmato nṛpaḥ ..
antarvedyāṃ kānyakubje jayacandro mahīpatiḥ .. 4 ..
3.3.d:
कल्पक्षेत्रे च राज्यं स्वं कृतवान्धर्मतो नृपः ॥
अन्तर्वेद्यां कान्यकुब्जे जयचन्द्रो महीपतिः ॥ 4 ॥
3.3.m: That king ruled his kingdom righteously in the Kalpakṣetra. / In the Antarvedī region, in Kānyakubja, Jayacandra was king,

3.3.s:
iṃdraprasthenaṃgapālastomarānvayasaṃbhavaḥ ..
anye ca bahavo bhūpā babhūvurgrāmarāṣṭrapāḥ .. 5 ..
3.3.d:
इंद्रप्रस्थेनंगपालस्तोमरान्वयसंभवः ॥
अन्ये च बहवो भूपा बभूवुर्ग्रामराष्ट्रपाः ॥ 5 ॥
3.3.m: and in Indraprastha was Aṅgapāla, born of the Tomara lineage; / and there were many other kings who ruled villages and realms.

3.3.s:
agnivaṃśasya vistāro babhūva balavattaraḥ ..
pūrve tu kapila sthāne vāhīkānte tu paścime .. 6 ..
3.3.d:
अग्निवंशस्य विस्तारो बभूव बलवत्तरः ॥
पूर्वे तु कपिल स्थाने वाहीकान्ते तु पश्चिमे ॥ 6 ॥
3.3.m: The expansion of the Agni lineage became exceedingly powerful: / reaching the abode of Kapila in the east, the edge of Vāhīka in the west,

3.3.s:
uttare cīnadeśānte setubaṃdhe tu dakṣiṇe ..
ṣaṣṭilakṣāśca bhūpālā grāmapā balavattarāḥ .. 7 ..
3.3.d:
उत्तरे चीनदेशान्ते सेतुबंधे तु दक्षिणे ॥
षष्टिलक्षाश्च भूपाला ग्रामपा बलवत्तराः ॥ 7 ॥
3.3.m: the border of the country of Cīna in the north, and Setubandha in the south. / There were six million very powerful kings and village rulers,

3.3.s:
agnihotrasya kartāro gobrāhmaṇahitaiṣiṇaḥ ..
babhūvurdvāparasamā dharmakṛtyaviśāradāḥ ..8..
3.3.d:
अग्निहोत्रस्य कर्तारो गोब्राह्मणहितैषिणः ॥
बभूवुर्द्वापरसमा धर्मकृत्यविशारदाः ॥8॥
3.3.m: performers of the Agnihotra, seeking the welfare of cows and brāhmaṇas, / equal to [men of] the Dvāpara age, skilled in righteous acts.

3.3.s:
dvāparākhyasamaḥ kālaḥ sarvatra parivartate ..
gehegehe sthitaṃ dravyaṃ dharmaścaiva janejane ..9..
3.3.d:
द्वापराख्यसमः कालः सर्वत्र परिवर्तते ॥
गेहेगेहे स्थितं द्रव्यं धर्मश्चैव जनेजने ॥9॥
3.3.m: A time resembling the Dvāpara age revolved everywhere: / wealth was present in every house, and righteousness in every person.

3.3.s:
grāmegrāme sthito devo deśedeśe sthito makhaḥ ..
āryadharmakarā mlecchā babhūvuḥ sarvatomukhāḥ ..3.3.4.10..
3.3.d:
ग्रामेग्रामे स्थितो देवो देशेदेशे स्थितो मखः ॥
आर्यधर्मकरा म्लेच्छा बभूवुः सर्वतोमुखाः ॥3.3.4.10॥
3.3.m: In every village stood a deity, and in every region a sacrifice. / Even the mlecchas followed the Aryan dharma in all quarters.

3.3.s:
iti dṛṣṭvā kalirghoro mlecchayā saha bhīrukaḥ ..
nīlādrau prāpya matimānhariṃ śaraṇamāyayau ..11..
3.3.d:
इति दृष्ट्वा कलिर्घोरो म्लेच्छया सह भीरुकः ॥
नीलाद्रौ प्राप्य मतिमान्हरिं शरणमाययौ ॥11॥
3.3.m: Seeing this, terrible Kali became fearful together with his mleccha wife; / reaching the Nīla mountain, the intelligent one took refuge in Hari.

3.3.s:
dvādaśābdamite kāle dhyānayogaparo'bhavat..
dhyānena saccidānaṃdaṃ dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇaṃ sanātanam..12...
3.3.d:
द्वादशाब्दमिते काले ध्यानयोगपरोऽभवत्॥
ध्यानेन सच्चिदानंदं दृष्ट्वा कृष्णं सनातनम्॥12॥।
3.3.m: For a period measuring twelve years he engaged in the yoga of meditation; / through meditation, he beheld eternal Kṛṣṇa, who is truth, consciousness, and bliss.

3.3.s:
tuṣṭāva manasā tatra rādhayā sahitaṃ harim ..
purāṇamajaraṃ nityaṃ vṛṃdāvananivāsinam ..13..
3.3.d:
तुष्टाव मनसा तत्र राधया सहितं हरिम् ॥
पुराणमजरं नित्यं वृंदावननिवासिनम् ॥13॥
3.3.m: There in his mind he praised Hari who was accompanied by Rādhā, / the ancient, ageless, eternal dweller in Vṛndāvana.

3.3.s:
.. kaliruvāca .. ..
sāṣṭāṃgaṃ daṃḍavatsvāmingṛhāṇa mama ceśvara ..
.pāhi māṃ śaraṇaṃ prāptaṃ caraṇe te kṛpānidhe .. 14 ..
3.3.d:
॥ कलिरुवाच ॥ ॥
साष्टांगं दंडवत्स्वामिन्गृहाण मम चेश्वर ॥
।पाहि मां शरणं प्राप्तं चरणे ते कृपानिधे ॥ 14 ॥
3.3.m: Kali said: / Accept my prostration with all eight limbs, like a staff, O Lord and Master! / Protect me, an ocean of compassion, who have sought refuge at your feet!

3.3.s:
sarvapāpaharastvaṃ vai sarvakālakaro hariḥ ..
bhavāngauraḥ satyayuge tretāyāṃ raktarūpakaḥ .. .. 15 ..
3.3.d:
सर्वपापहरस्त्वं वै सर्वकालकरो हरिः ॥
भवान्गौरः सत्ययुगे त्रेतायां रक्तरूपकः ॥ ॥ 15 ॥
3.3.m: You are indeed the remover of all sins, Hari, the creator of all time. / You were fair in the Satyayuga and red-complexioned in the Tretā;

3.3.s:
dvāpare pītarūpaśca kṛṣṇatvaṃ mama diṣṭake ..
matputrāśca smṛtā mlecchā āryyadharmatvamāgatāḥ.. 16 ..
3.3.d:
द्वापरे पीतरूपश्च कृष्णत्वं मम दिष्टके ॥
मत्पुत्राश्च स्मृता म्लेच्छा आर्य्यधर्मत्वमागताः॥ 16 ॥
3.3.m: you were yellow in the Dvāpara, and black in my appointed time. / The mlecchas, regarded as my sons, have adopted the Aryan dharma.

3.3.s:
caturgehaṃ ca me svāmindyūtaṃ madyaṃ suvarṇa kam ..
strī hāsyaṃ cāgnivaṃśyaiśca kṣatriyaiśca vināśitam .. 17 ..
3.3.d:
चतुर्गेहं च मे स्वामिन्द्यूतं मद्यं सुवर्ण कम् ॥
स्त्री हास्यं चाग्निवंश्यैश्च क्षत्रियैश्च विनाशितम् ॥ 17 ॥
3.3.m: And my four dwellings, O Lord—gambling, liquor, gold, / and sport with women—have been destroyed by the Kṣatriyas of the Agni lineage.

3.3.s:
tyaktadehastyaktakulastyaktarāṣṭro janārdana ..
tvatpādāṃbujamādhāya sthito'haṃ śaraṇaṃ tvayi ..18..
3.3.d:
त्यक्तदेहस्त्यक्तकुलस्त्यक्तराष्ट्रो जनार्दन ॥
त्वत्पादांबुजमाधाय स्थितोऽहं शरणं त्वयि ॥18॥
3.3.m: Forsaking my body, forsaking my family, forsaking my realm, O Janārdana, / holding fast to your lotus feet, I have taken refuge in you.

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā sa bhagavānkṛṣṇaḥ prāha vihasya tam ..
bho kale tava rakṣārthaṃ janiṣyehaṃ mahāvatīm ..19..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा स भगवान्कृष्णः प्राह विहस्य तम् ॥
भो कले तव रक्षार्थं जनिष्येहं महावतीम् ॥19॥
3.3.m: Hearing this, the Blessed Kṛṣṇa laughed and said to him: / "O Kali, for your protection I will be born in Mahāvatī.

3.3.s:
mamāṃśo bhūmimāsādya kṣayiṣyati mahābalān ..
mlecchavaṃśasya bhūpālānsthāpayiṣyati bhūtale .. 3.3.4.20 ..
3.3.d:
ममांशो भूमिमासाद्य क्षयिष्यति महाबलान् ॥
म्लेच्छवंशस्य भूपालान्स्थापयिष्यति भूतले ॥ 3.3.4.20 ॥
3.3.m: A portion of mine, descending upon the earth, will destroy the exceedingly powerful [kings], / and will establish the rulers of the mleccha lineage on the face of the earth."

3.3.s:
ityuktvā bhagavānsākṣāttatraivāntaradhīyata ..
kalistu mlecchayā sārdhaṃ paramā naṃdamāptavān .. 21 ..
3.3.d:
इत्युक्त्वा भगवान्साक्षात्तत्रैवान्तरधीयत ॥
कलिस्तु म्लेच्छया सार्धं परमा नंदमाप्तवान् ॥ 21 ॥
3.3.m: Having spoken thus, the Blessed One vanished right there before his eyes, / and Kali, along with his mleccha wife, attained supreme delight.

3.3.s:
etasminnantare vipra yathā jātaṃ śṛṇuṣva tat ..
ābhīrī vāksare grāme vratapā nāma viśrutā .. 22 ..
3.3.d:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे विप्र यथा जातं शृणुष्व तत् ॥
आभीरी वाक्सरे ग्रामे व्रतपा नाम विश्रुता ॥ 22 ॥
3.3.m: In the meantime, O brāhmaṇa, hear what came to pass: / In the village of Vāksara, an Ābhīra woman known by the name of Vratapā

3.3.s:
navadurgāvrataṃ śreṣṭhaṃ? navavarṣaṃ cakāra ha ..
prasannā caṃḍikā prāha varaṃ varaya śobhane .. 23 ..
3.3.d:
नवदुर्गाव्रतं श्रेष्ठं? नववर्षं चकार ह ॥
प्रसन्ना चंडिका प्राह वरं वरय शोभने ॥ 23 ॥
3.3.m: performed the excellent Navadurgā observance for nine years. / Pleased, Caṇḍikā said: "Choose a boon, O fair one!"

3.3.s:
sāha tāṃ yadi me mātarvaro deyastvayeśvari ..
rāmakṛṣṇasamau bālau bhaveyāḥ mamānvaye .. 24 ..
3.3.d:
साह तां यदि मे मातर्वरो देयस्त्वयेश्वरि ॥
रामकृष्णसमौ बालौ भवेयाः ममान्वये ॥ 24 ॥
3.3.m: She said to her: "If a boon is to be given to me by you, O Mother, O Sovereign, / let two boys equal to Rāma and Kṛṣṇa be born in my lineage."

3.3.s:
tathetyuktvā tu sā devī tatraivāntaradhīyata ..
vasumānnāma nṛpatistasyā rūpeṇa mohitaḥ .. 25 ..
3.3.d:
तथेत्युक्त्वा तु सा देवी तत्रैवान्तरधीयत ॥
वसुमान्नाम नृपतिस्तस्या रूपेण मोहितः ॥ 25 ॥
3.3.m: Saying "So be it," the goddess vanished right there. / A king named Vasumān, enchanted by her beauty,

3.3.s:
udvāhya dharmato bhūpaḥ svagehe tāmavāsayat ..
tasyāṃ jātau nṛpātputrau deśarājastu tadvaraḥ .. 26 ..
3.3.d:
उद्वाह्य धर्मतो भूपः स्वगेहे तामवासयत् ॥
तस्यां जातौ नृपात्पुत्रौ देशराजस्तु तद्वरः ॥ 26 ॥
3.3.m: married her according to righteousness, and the king settled her in his house. / From the king two sons were born of her: Deśarāja, the elder,

3.3.s:
āvāryo vatsarājaśca śatahastisamo bale ..
jitvā tau māgadhāndeśānrājya vaṃtau babhūvatuḥ .. 27 ..
3.3.d:
आवार्यो वत्सराजश्च शतहस्तिसमो बले ॥
जित्वा तौ मागधान्देशान्राज्य वंतौ बभूवतुः ॥ 27 ॥
3.3.m: and the younger, Vatsarāja, who was equal to a hundred elephants in strength. / Having conquered the Magadha lands, the two became kings.

3.3.s:
śatayattaḥ smṛto mlecchaḥ śūro vanarasādhipaḥ ..
tatputro bhīmasenāṃśo vīraṇobhūcchivājñayā .. 28 ..
3.3.d:
शतयत्तः स्मृतो म्लेच्छः शूरो वनरसाधिपः ॥
तत्पुत्रो भीमसेनांशो वीरणोभूच्छिवाज्ञया ॥ 28 ॥
3.3.m: A mleccha named Śatayatta was a hero, the ruler of Vanarasa; / his son was Vīraṇa, a portion of Bhīmasena by the command of Śiva.

3.3.s:
tālavṛkṣapramāṇena .cordhvavego hi tasya vai ..
tālano nāma vikhyātaḥ śatayattena vai kṛtaḥ .. 29 ..
3.3.d:
तालवृक्षप्रमाणेन ।चोर्ध्ववेगो हि तस्य वै ॥
तालनो नाम विख्यातः शतयत्तेन वै कृतः ॥ 29 ॥
3.3.m: His upward leap was as high as a palm tree; / he was made known as Tālana by Śatayatta.

3.3.s:
tābhyāṃ nṛpābhyāṃ tadyuddhamabhavallomaharṣaṇam ..
yuddhena hīnatāṃ prāptastālano balavattaraḥ .. 3.3.4.30 ..
3.3.d:
ताभ्यां नृपाभ्यां तद्युद्धमभवल्लोमहर्षणम् ॥
युद्धेन हीनतां प्राप्तस्तालनो बलवत्तरः ॥ 3.3.4.30 ॥
3.3.m: A hair-raising battle took place between those two kings and him; / in the fight, the exceedingly powerful Tālana was reduced to defeat.

3.3.s:
tadā maitrī kṛtā tābhyāṃ tālanena samanvitā ..
jayacaṃdraparīkṣārthe trayaḥ śūrāḥ samāyayuḥ .. 31 ..

bahubhūpavatī bhūmisteṣāṃ rājye babhūva ha ..
vīrasiṃhaśca yo bhūpaḥ saptamaḥ saṃprakīrtitaḥ .. 2 ..

3.3.d:
तदा मैत्री कृता ताभ्यां तालनेन समन्विता ॥
जयचंद्रपरीक्षार्थे त्रयः शूराः समाययुः ॥ 31 ॥
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
स्वर्गते भोजराजे तु सप्तभूपास्तदन्वये ॥
जाताश्चाल्पायुषो मन्दास्त्रिशताब्दान्तरे मृताः ॥ 1 ॥
बहुभूपवती भूमिस्तेषां राज्ये बभूव ह ॥
वीरसिंहश्च यो भूपः सप्तमः संप्रकीर्तितः ॥ 2 ॥
तदन्वये त्रिभूपाश्च द्विशताब्दान्तरे मृताः ॥
गंगासिंहश्च यो भूपो दशमः स प्रकीर्तितः ॥ 3 ॥
कल्पक्षेत्रे च राज्यं स्वं कृतवान्धर्मतो नृपः ॥
अन्तर्वेद्यां कान्यकुब्जे जयचन्द्रो महीपतिः ॥ 4 ॥
इंद्रप्रस्थेनंगपालस्तोमरान्वयसंभवः ॥
अन्ये च बहवो भूपा बभूवुर्ग्रामराष्ट्रपाः ॥ 5 ॥
अग्निवंशस्य विस्तारो बभूव बलवत्तरः ॥
पूर्वे तु कपिल स्थाने वाहीकान्ते तु पश्चिमे ॥ 6 ॥
3.3.m:
Then an alliance was made by the two [brothers] together with Tālana; / the three heroes came to put Jayacandra to the test.
Sūta said: / When King Bhoja had gone to heaven, seven kings were born in his lineage; / short-lived and weak, they died within the space of three hundred years.
During their rule, the earth came to possess many kings. / King Vīrasiṃha is proclaimed as the seventh [among them].
In his lineage three kings died within the space of two hundred years; / King Gaṅgāsiṃha is proclaimed as the tenth.
That king ruled his kingdom righteously in the Kalpakṣetra. / In the Antarvedī region, in Kānyakubja, Jayacandra was king,
and in Indraprastha was Aṅgapāla, born of the Tomara lineage; / and there were many other kings who ruled villages and realms.
The expansion of the Agni lineage became exceedingly powerful: / reaching the abode of Kapila in the east, the edge of Vāhīka in the west,

3.3.d:
उत्तरे चीनदेशान्ते सेतुबंधे तु दक्षिणे ॥
षष्टिलक्षाश्च भूपाला ग्रामपा बलवत्तराः ॥ 7 ॥
अग्निहोत्रस्य कर्तारो गोब्राह्मणहितैषिणः ॥
बभूवुर्द्वापरसमा धर्मकृत्यविशारदाः ॥8॥
द्वापराख्यसमः कालः सर्वत्र परिवर्तते ॥
गेहेगेहे स्थितं द्रव्यं धर्मश्चैव जनेजने ॥9॥
ग्रामेग्रामे स्थितो देवो देशेदेशे स्थितो मखः ॥
आर्यधर्मकरा म्लेच्छा बभूवुः सर्वतोमुखाः ॥3.3.4.10॥
इति दृष्ट्वा कलिर्घोरो म्लेच्छया सह भीरुकः ॥
नीलाद्रौ प्राप्य मतिमान्हरिं शरणमाययौ ॥11॥
द्वादशाब्दमिते काले ध्यानयोगपरोऽभवत्॥
ध्यानेन सच्चिदानंदं दृष्ट्वा कृष्णं सनातनम्॥12॥।
तुष्टाव मनसा तत्र राधया सहितं हरिम् ॥
पुराणमजरं नित्यं वृंदावननिवासिनम् ॥13॥
3.3.m:
the border of the country of Cīna in the north, and Setubandha in the south. / There were six million very powerful kings and village rulers,
They were performers of the agnihotra, seekers of the welfare of cows and Brahmins; / they became equal to the Dvāpara age, proficient in religious duties.
A time equal to the age named Dvāpara turned everywhere: / in every house wealth was established, and righteousness in every person.
In every village a deity was established, and in every country a sacrifice; / the Mlecchas, performing the Aryan dharma, were turned in every direction.
Seeing this, the terrible Kali, along with his Mleccha woman, became fearful; / reaching the Blue Mountain (Nīlādri), the intelligent one sought refuge in Hari.
For a period of twelve years he was devoted to the yoga of meditation; / through meditation, having seen Kṛṣṇa, the eternal reality, consciousness, and bliss,
he praised Hari there with his mind, accompanied by Rādhā— / the ancient, ageless, eternal dweller of Vṛndāvana.

3.3.d:
॥ कलिरुवाच ॥ ॥
साष्टांगं दंडवत्स्वामिन्गृहाण मम चेश्वर ॥
।पाहि मां शरणं प्राप्तं चरणे ते कृपानिधे ॥ 14 ॥
सर्वपापहरस्त्वं वै सर्वकालकरो हरिः ॥
भवान्गौरः सत्ययुगे त्रेतायां रक्तरूपकः ॥ ॥ 15 ॥
द्वापरे पीतरूपश्च कृष्णत्वं मम दिष्टके ॥
मत्पुत्राश्च स्मृता म्लेच्छा आर्य्यधर्मत्वमागताः॥ 16 ॥
चतुर्गेहं च मे स्वामिन्द्यूतं मद्यं सुवर्ण कम् ॥
स्त्री हास्यं चाग्निवंश्यैश्च क्षत्रियैश्च विनाशितम् ॥ 17 ॥
त्यक्तदेहस्त्यक्तकुलस्त्यक्तराष्ट्रो जनार्दन ॥
त्वत्पादांबुजमाधाय स्थितोऽहं शरणं त्वयि ॥18॥
इति श्रुत्वा स भगवान्कृष्णः प्राह विहस्य तम् ॥
भो कले तव रक्षार्थं जनिष्येहं महावतीम् ॥19॥
ममांशो भूमिमासाद्य क्षयिष्यति महाबलान् ॥
म्लेच्छवंशस्य भूपालान्स्थापयिष्यति भूतले ॥ 3.3.4.20 ॥
3.3.m:
Kali said: / Accept my prostration with eight limbs, like a staff, O Lord and Master! / Protect me who have come for refuge to your feet, O treasure of mercy!
You are indeed the remover of all sins, Hari, the maker of all time; / you were white in the Satya age, and of red form in the Tretā.
In the Dvāpara you were of yellow form, and Kṛṣṇa in my destined time; / my sons are known as the Mlecchas, but they have taken to the Aryan dharma.
My four abodes, O Lord—gambling, liquor, gold, / and womanising—have been destroyed by the Kṣatriyas of the Fire lineage (Agrivaṃśa).
My body abandoned, my family abandoned, my kingdom abandoned, O Janārdana, / holding fast to your lotus feet, I have taken refuge in you.
Having heard this, the blessed Lord Kṛṣṇa laughed and said to him: / 'O Kali, for your protection I shall be born in Mahāvatī.
A portion of mine, descending upon the earth, will destroy the exceedingly powerful ones; / he will establish kings of the Mleccha lineage upon the face of the earth.'

3.3.s:
ityuktvā bhagavānsākṣāttatraivāntaradhīyata ..
kalistu mlecchayā sārdhaṃ paramā naṃdamāptavān .. 21 ..
etasminnantare vipra yathā jātaṃ śṛṇuṣva tat ..
ābhīrī vāksare grāme vratapā nāma viśrutā .. 22 ..
navadurgāvrataṃ śreṣṭhaṃ? navavarṣaṃ cakāra ha ..
prasannā caṃḍikā prāha varaṃ varaya śobhane .. 23 ..
sāha tāṃ yadi me mātarvaro deyastvayeśvari ..
rāmakṛṣṇasamau bālau bhaveyāḥ mamānvaye .. 24 ..
tathetyuktvā tu sā devī tatraivāntaradhīyata ..
vasumānnāma nṛpatistasyā rūpeṇa mohitaḥ .. 25 ..
udvāhya dharmato bhūpaḥ svagehe tāmavāsayat ..
tasyāṃ jātau nṛpātputrau deśarājastu tadvaraḥ .. 26 ..
āvāryo vatsarājaśca śatahastisamo bale ..
jitvā tau māgadhāndeśānrājya vaṃtau babhūvatuḥ .. 27 ..
śatayattaḥ smṛto mlecchaḥ śūro vanarasādhipaḥ ..
tatputro bhīmasenāṃśo vīraṇobhūcchivājñayā .. 28 ..
3.3.d:
इत्युक्त्वा भगवान्साक्षात्तत्रैवान्तरधीयत ॥
कलिस्तु म्लेच्छया सार्धं परमा नंदमाप्तवान् ॥ 21 ॥
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे विप्र यथा जातं शृणुष्व तत् ॥
आभीरी वाक्सरे ग्रामे व्रतपा नाम विश्रुता ॥ 22 ॥
नवदुर्गाव्रतं श्रेष्ठं? नववर्षं चकार ह ॥
प्रसन्ना चंडिका प्राह वरं वरय शोभने ॥ 23 ॥
साह तां यदि मे मातर्वरो देयस्त्वयेश्वरि ॥
रामकृष्णसमौ बालौ भवेयाः ममान्वये ॥ 24 ॥
तथेत्युक्त्वा तु सा देवी तत्रैवान्तरधीयत ॥
वसुमान्नाम नृपतिस्तस्या रूपेण मोहितः ॥ 25 ॥
उद्वाह्य धर्मतो भूपः स्वगेहे तामवासयत् ॥
तस्यां जातौ नृपात्पुत्रौ देशराजस्तु तद्वरः ॥ 26 ॥
आवार्यो वत्सराजश्च शतहस्तिसमो बले ॥
जित्वा तौ मागधान्देशान्राज्य वंतौ बभूवतुः ॥ 27 ॥
शतयत्तः स्मृतो म्लेच्छः शूरो वनरसाधिपः ॥
तत्पुत्रो भीमसेनांशो वीरणोभूच्छिवाज्ञया ॥ 28 ॥
3.3.m:
Having spoken thus, the Lord visibly disappeared right there; / Kali, for his part, together with his Mleccha woman, attained supreme joy.
In the meantime, O Brahmin, hear what took place: / in the village of Vāksara, there was an Ābhīrī known by the name of Vratapā.
Indeed, she performed the excellent Navadurgā vrata for nine years; / pleased, Caṇḍikā said: 'Choose a boon, O beautiful lady!'
She said to her: 'If a boon is to be given to me by you, O Mother and Goddess, / let two boys equal to Rāma and Kṛṣṇa be born in my lineage.'
Having said, 'So be it,' that goddess vanished right there; / a king named Vasumān became infatuated with her beauty.
Having married her according to dharma, the king housed her in his own palace; / from the king, two sons were born of her: the elder was Deśarāja,
and the younger was Vatsarāja, equal to a hundred elephants in strength; / having conquered the lands of Magadha, the two possessed kingdoms.
A Mleccha remembered as Śatayatta was a heroic lord of the forest-region; / his son, born by Śiva’s command as a portion of Bhīmasena, was Vīraṇa.

3.3.s:
tālavṛkṣapramāṇena .cordhvavego hi tasya vai ..
tālano nāma vikhyātaḥ śatayattena vai kṛtaḥ .. 29 ..
tābhyāṃ nṛpābhyāṃ tadyuddhamabhavallomaharṣaṇam ..
yuddhena hīnatāṃ prāptastālano balavattaraḥ .. 3.3.4.30 ..
tadā maitrī kṛtā tābhyāṃ tālanena samanvitā ..
jayacaṃdraparīkṣārthe trayaḥ śūrāḥ samāyayuḥ .. 31 ..
3.3.d:
तालवृक्षप्रमाणेन ।चोर्ध्ववेगो हि तस्य वै ॥
तालनो नाम विख्यातः शतयत्तेन वै कृतः ॥ 29 ॥
ताभ्यां नृपाभ्यां तद्युद्धमभवल्लोमहर्षणम् ॥
युद्धेन हीनतां प्राप्तस्तालनो बलवत्तरः ॥ 3.3.4.30 ॥
तदा मैत्री कृता ताभ्यां तालनेन समन्विता ॥
जयचंद्रपरीक्षार्थे त्रयः शूराः समाययुः ॥ 31 ॥
3.3.m:
His upward leap was indeed the height of a palmyra tree; / he was made famous by Śatayatta under the name Tālana.
With those two kings, there took place a battle that made the hair stand on end; / in battle, the extremely powerful Tālana was reduced to defeat.
Then friendship was formed between the two along with Tālana; / to test Jayacandra, the three heroes set out.

3.3.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
iṃdraprasthe'naṃgapālonapatyaśca mahīpatiḥ ..
putrārthaṃ kārayāmāsa śaivaṃ yajñaṃ vidhānataḥ .. 1 ..
3.3.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
इंद्रप्रस्थेऽनंगपालोनपत्यश्च महीपतिः ॥
पुत्रार्थं कारयामास शैवं यज्ञं विधानतः ॥ 1 ॥
3.3.m: Sūta said: / In Indraprastha, King Anaṅgapāla was childless; / for the sake of a son, he duly performed a Śaiva sacrifice.

3.3.s:
kanyake ca tadā jāte śivabhāgaprasādataḥ ..
caṃdrakāṃtiśca jyeṣṭhā vai dvitīyā kīrtimālinī .. 2 ..
3.3.d:
कन्यके च तदा जाते शिवभागप्रसादतः ॥
चंद्रकांतिश्च ज्येष्ठा वै द्वितीया कीर्तिमालिनी ॥ 2 ॥
3.3.m: Then two daughters were born by the grace of Śiva's portion: / Candrakānti was the elder, and the second was Kīrtimālinī.

3.3.s:
kānyakubjādhipāyaiva caṃdrakāntiṃ pitādadat ..
devapālāya śuddhāya rāṣṭrapālānvayāya ca .. 3 ..
3.3.d:
कान्यकुब्जाधिपायैव चंद्रकान्तिं पिताददत् ॥
देवपालाय शुद्धाय राष्ट्रपालान्वयाय च ॥ 3 ॥
3.3.m: The father gave Candrakānti to the ruler of Kānyakubja, / the pure Devapāla of the Rāṣṭrapāla lineage.

3.3.s:
someśvarāya bhūpāya capahānikulāya tu ..
ajamerādhipāyaiva tathā vai kīrtimālinīm .. 4 ..
3.3.d:
सोमेश्वराय भूपाय चपहानिकुलाय तु ॥
अजमेराधिपायैव तथा वै कीर्तिमालिनीम् ॥ 4 ॥
3.3.m: And likewise, Kīrtimālinī to King Someśvara, / of the Cāpahāni family, the ruler of Ajamer.

3.3.s:
jayaśarmā dvijaḥ kaścitsamādhistho himālaye ..
dṛṣṭvā bhūpotsavaṃ ramyaṃ rājyārthe svamano'dadhat .. 5 ..
3.3.d:
जयशर्मा द्विजः कश्चित्समाधिस्थो हिमालये ॥
दृष्ट्वा भूपोत्सवं रम्यं राज्यार्थे स्वमनोऽदधत् ॥ 5 ॥
3.3.m: A certain Brahmin named Jayaśarman, seated in absorption on the Himālayas, / having seen a delightful royal festival, set his mind on gaining a kingdom.

3.3.s:
tyaktvā dehaṃ sa śuddhātmā caṃdrakāṃtyāḥ sutobhavat ..
jayacaṃdra iti khyāto bāhuśālī jitendriyaḥ ..
ratnabhānuśca saṃjajñe śūrastasyānujo balī .. 6 ..
3.3.d:
त्यक्त्वा देहं स शुद्धात्मा चंद्रकांत्याः सुतोभवत् ॥
जयचंद्र इति ख्यातो बाहुशाली जितेन्द्रियः ॥
रत्नभानुश्च संजज्ञे शूरस्तस्यानुजो बली ॥ 6 ॥
3.3.m: Leaving his body, that pure-souled one became the son of Candrakānti; / he was renowned as Jayacandra, mighty-armed and self-controlled; / and his younger brother was born, the heroic and strong Ratnabhānu.

3.3.s:
sa jitvā gauḍavaṃgādīnmarudeśānmadotkaṭān ..
daṃḍyānkṛtvā gṛhaṃ prāpya bhrātrājñā tatparo'bhavat ..7..
3.3.d:
स जित्वा गौडवंगादीन्मरुदेशान्मदोत्कटान् ॥
दंड्यान्कृत्वा गृहं प्राप्य भ्रात्राज्ञा तत्परोऽभवत् ॥7॥
3.3.m: Having conquered Gauḍa, Vaṅga, and other haughty desert regions, / and having exacted tribute, he returned home and became devoted to his brother's command.

3.3.s:
gaṃgāsiṃhasya bhaginī nāmnā vīravatī śubhā ..
ratnabhānośca mahiṣī babhūva varavarṇinī .. 8 ..
3.3.d:
गंगासिंहस्य भगिनी नाम्ना वीरवती शुभा ॥
रत्नभानोश्च महिषी बभूव वरवर्णिनी ॥ 8 ॥
3.3.m: The auspicious sister of Gaṅgāsiṃha, named Vīravatī, / an excellent lady, became the queen of Ratnabhānu.

3.3.s:
nakulāṃśastadā bhūmau tasyāṃ jātaḥ śivājñayā ..
lakṣaṇo nāma balavānkhaḍgayuddhaviśāradaḥ ..
sa saptābdāntare prāpte pitustulyo babhūva ha .. 9 ..
3.3.d:
नकुलांशस्तदा भूमौ तस्यां जातः शिवाज्ञया ॥
लक्षणो नाम बलवान्खड्गयुद्धविशारदः ॥
स सप्ताब्दान्तरे प्राप्ते पितुस्तुल्यो बभूव ह ॥ 9 ॥
3.3.m: Then, by Śiva's command, a portion of Nakula was born of her upon the earth, / named Lakṣaṇa, powerful and skilled in sword combat; / when seven years had passed, he became equal to his father.

3.3.s:
trayaśca kīrtimālinyāṃ putrā jātā madotkaṭāḥ ..
dhuṃdhakāraśca prathamastataḥ kṛṣṇakumārakaḥ ..
pṛthivīrāja evāsau tatonuja iti smṛtaḥ .. 3.3.5.10 ..
3.3.d:
त्रयश्च कीर्तिमालिन्यां पुत्रा जाता मदोत्कटाः ॥
धुंधकारश्च प्रथमस्ततः कृष्णकुमारकः ॥
पृथिवीराज एवासौ ततोनुज इति स्मृतः ॥ 3.3.5.10 ॥
3.3.m: Three arrogant sons were born to Kīrtimālinī: / Dhuṃdhakāra was the first, then Kṛṣṇakumāraka; / and Pṛthivīrāja was remembered as the younger brother after them.

3.3.s:
dvādaśābdavayaḥ prāptaḥ siṃhakhelastato'bhavat ..
śrutvā cānaṃgapālaśca tasmai rājyaṃ svayaṃ dadau ..
gatvā himegiriṃ ramyaṃ yogadhyānaparobhavat .. 11 ..
3.3.d:
द्वादशाब्दवयः प्राप्तः सिंहखेलस्ततोऽभवत् ॥
श्रुत्वा चानंगपालश्च तस्मै राज्यं स्वयं ददौ ॥
गत्वा हिमेगिरिं रम्यं योगध्यानपरोभवत् ॥ 11 ॥
3.3.m: Reaching twelve years of age, he then played like a lion; / and having heard this, Anaṅgapāla himself gave him the kingdom; / having gone to the pleasant snow-mountain, he became devoted to yoga and meditation.

3.3.s:
mathurāyāṃ dhuṃdhakāro'jamere ca tatonujaḥ ..
rājā babhūva nītijñastau sutau piturājñayā .. 12 ..
3.3.d:
मथुरायां धुंधकारोऽजमेरे च ततोनुजः ॥
राजा बभूव नीतिज्ञस्तौ सुतौ पितुराज्ञया ॥ 12 ॥
3.3.m: Dhuṃdhakāra became king in Mathurā, and the brother after him in Ajamer; / those two sons, knowing statecraft, ruled by their father's command.

3.3.s:
pradyotaścaiva vidyotaḥ kṣatriyau cadravaṃśajau ..
maṃtriṇau tasya bhūpasya balavaṃtau madotkaṭau .. 13 ..
3.3.d:
प्रद्योतश्चैव विद्योतः क्षत्रियौ चद्रवंशजौ ॥
मंत्रिणौ तस्य भूपस्य बलवंतौ मदोत्कटौ ॥ 13 ॥
3.3.m: Pradyota and Vidyota, two Kṣatriyas born of the lunar lineage, / were the two ministers of that king, powerful and haughty.

3.3.s:
pradyotatanayo jāto nāmnā parimalo balī ..
lakṣasenādhipaḥ so hi tena rājñaiva saṃskṛtaḥ .. 14 ..
3.3.d:
प्रद्योततनयो जातो नाम्ना परिमलो बली ॥
लक्षसेनाधिपः सो हि तेन राज्ञैव संस्कृतः ॥ 14 ॥
3.3.m: Pradyota's son was born, named the powerful Parimala; / he, the commander of a hundred thousand troops, was consecrated by that very king.

3.3.s:
vidyotādbhīṣmasiṃhaśca gajasenādhipo'bhavat ..
svargate'naṃgapāle tu bhūmirājo mahīpatiḥ .. 15 ..
3.3.d:
विद्योताद्भीष्मसिंहश्च गजसेनाधिपोऽभवत् ॥
स्वर्गतेऽनंगपाले तु भूमिराजो महीपतिः ॥ 15 ॥
3.3.m: From Vidyota was born Bhīṣmasiṃha, commander of the elephant army; / but when Anaṅgapāla went to heaven, King Bhūmirāja,

3.3.s:
dṛṣṭvā tānvipriyānsarvānnijarājyānnirākarot ..
pradyotādyāśca catvāraḥ svaśūrairdviśatairyutāḥ .. 16 ..
3.3.d:
दृष्ट्वा तान्विप्रियान्सर्वान्निजराज्यान्निराकरोत् ॥
प्रद्योताद्याश्च चत्वारः स्वशूरैर्द्विशतैर्युताः ॥ 16 ॥
3.3.m: seeing them all to be hostile, banished them from his own realm; / and the four, beginning with Pradyota, accompanied by two hundred warriors of their own,

3.3.s:
kānyakubjapuraṃ prāpya jayacaṃdramavarṇayan ..
jayacaṃdra mahīpāla tvanmātṛṣvasṛjo nṛpaḥ .. 17 ..
3.3.d:
कान्यकुब्जपुरं प्राप्य जयचंद्रमवर्णयन् ॥
जयचंद्र महीपाल त्वन्मातृष्वसृजो नृपः ॥ 17 ॥
3.3.m: reached the city of Kānyakubja and described it to Jayacandra: / 'O King Jayacandra! The king born of your mother's sister...'

3.3.s:
mātāmahasya te rājyaṃ prāptavānnirbhayo balī ..
nyāyena kathito'smābhirarddharājyaṃ hi te smṛtam .. 18 ..
3.3.d:
मातामहस्य ते राज्यं प्राप्तवान्निर्भयो बली ॥
न्यायेन कथितोऽस्माभिरर्द्धराज्यं हि ते स्मृतम् ॥ 18 ॥
3.3.m: "Fearless and mighty, he has seized your maternal grandfather's kingdom. / We told him justly, 'Half the kingdom is considered yours.

3.3.s:
sarvarājyaṃ kathaṃ bhuṃkṣe śrutvā tena nirākṛtāḥ ..
bhavantaṃ śaraṇaṃ prāptā yathāyogyaṃ tathā kuru .. 19 ..
3.3.d:
सर्वराज्यं कथं भुंक्षे श्रुत्वा तेन निराकृताः ॥
भवन्तं शरणं प्राप्ता यथायोग्यं तथा कुरु ॥ 19 ॥
3.3.m: How can you enjoy the whole kingdom?' Hearing this, he drove us away. / We have come to you for refuge; do as you see fit."

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā mahīpālo jayacaṃdra uvāca tān ..
aśvasainye madīye cādhikārī te suto bhavet .. 3.3.5.20 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा महीपालो जयचंद्र उवाच तान् ॥
अश्वसैन्ये मदीये चाधिकारी ते सुतो भवेत् ॥ 3.3.5.20 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing this, King Jayacandra said to them: / "Your son shall be a commander in my cavalry,

3.3.s:
nāmnā parimalaḥ śūrastvaṃ manmaṃtrī bhavādhunā ..
vidyotaśca tathā maṃtrī gajasainye hi bhīmakaḥ .. 21 ..
3.3.d:
नाम्ना परिमलः शूरस्त्वं मन्मंत्री भवाधुना ॥
विद्योतश्च तथा मंत्री गजसैन्ये हि भीमकः ॥ 21 ॥
3.3.m: the hero named Parimala. You shall now be my minister, / and Vidyota too shall be a minister, while Bhīmaka [shall lead] the elephant corps.

3.3.s:
vṛttyarthe ca mayā vo vai purī dattā mahāvatī ..
mahīpateśca bhūpasya nagarī sā priyaṃkarī..22..
3.3.d:
वृत्त्यर्थे च मया वो वै पुरी दत्ता महावती ॥
महीपतेश्च भूपस्य नगरी सा प्रियंकरी॥22॥
3.3.m: And for your livelihood I have granted you the city of Mahāvatī; / it is the lovely city of King Mahīpati."

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā tu te sarve tathā matvā mumodire .
mahīpatistu balavānduḥkhātsaṃtyajya tāṃ purīm..23..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा तु ते सर्वे तथा मत्वा मुमोदिरे ।
महीपतिस्तु बलवान्दुःखात्संत्यज्य तां पुरीम्॥23॥
3.3.m: Hearing this and agreeing, they all rejoiced. / But the powerful Mahīpati, in distress, abandoned that city,

3.3.s:
kṛtvaurvīyāṃ purīmanyāṃ tatra vāsamakārayat ..
agamā malanā caiva bhaginyau tasya cottame .. 24 ..
3.3.d:
कृत्वौर्वीयां पुरीमन्यां तत्र वासमकारयत् ॥
अगमा मलना चैव भगिन्यौ तस्य चोत्तमे ॥ 24 ॥
3.3.m: and, having founded another city in the territory of Aurvī, he took up residence there. / He had two excellent sisters, Agamā and Malanā.

3.3.s:
agamā bhūmirājāya cānyā parimalāya sā ..
dattā bhrātrā vidhānena paramānaṃdamāpatuḥ .. 25 ..
3.3.d:
अगमा भूमिराजाय चान्या परिमलाय सा ॥
दत्ता भ्रात्रा विधानेन परमानंदमापतुः ॥ 25 ॥
3.3.m: Agamā was given to Bhūmirāja, and the other to Parimala, / by their brother in accordance with proper rites; they attained supreme joy.

3.3.s:
vivāhāṃte ca bhūrājā durgamanyamakārayat ..
kṛtvā ca nagarīṃ ramyāṃ caturvarṇanivāsinīm .. 26 ..
3.3.d:
विवाहांते च भूराजा दुर्गमन्यमकारयत् ॥
कृत्वा च नगरीं रम्यां चतुर्वर्णनिवासिनीम् ॥ 26 ॥
3.3.m: At the conclusion of the marriage, King Bhūrāja had another fortress built, / and laid out a delightful city inhabited by the four varnas.

3.3.s:
dehalī sumūhūrtena durga dvāre suropitā ..
gatā sā yojanānte vai vṛddhirūpā sukālataḥ .. 27 ..
3.3.d:
देहली सुमूहूर्तेन दुर्ग द्वारे सुरोपिता ॥
गता सा योजनान्ते वै वृद्धिरूपा सुकालतः ॥ 27 ॥
3.3.m: At an auspicious hour, a threshold (dehalī) was placed well at the gate of the fort; / in due course, through prosperity, it extended to the end of a yojana.

3.3.s:
vismitaḥ sa nṛpo bhūtvā dehalī nāma cākarot ..
dehalīgrāma iti ca prasiddho'bhūnnṛpājñayā .. 28 ..
3.3.d:
विस्मितः स नृपो भूत्वा देहली नाम चाकरोत् ॥
देहलीग्राम इति च प्रसिद्धोऽभून्नृपाज्ञया ॥ 28 ॥
3.3.m: Astonished, the king gave it the name Dehalī. / And by the king's command it became famous as the village of Dehalī.

3.3.s:
trivarṣāṃte ca bho viprā jayacandro mahīpatiḥ ..
lakṣaṣoḍaśasainyāḍhyastatra patramacodayat .. 29 ..
3.3.d:
त्रिवर्षांते च भो विप्रा जयचन्द्रो महीपतिः ॥
लक्षषोडशसैन्याढ्यस्तत्र पत्रमचोदयत् ॥ 29 ॥
3.3.m: At the end of three years, O Brahmins, King Jayacandra, / possessing an army of sixteen hundred thousand, dispatched a letter there:

3.3.s:
kimarthaṃ pṛthivīrāja maddāyaṃ me na dattavān ..
mātāmahasya vai dāyaṃ cārddhaṃ me ca samarpaya .. 3.3.5.30 ..
3.3.d:
किमर्थं पृथिवीराज मद्दायं मे न दत्तवान् ॥
मातामहस्य वै दायं चार्द्धं मे च समर्पय ॥ 3.3.5.30 ॥
3.3.m: "Why, Pṛthivīrāja, have you not given me my inheritance? / Hand over half of our maternal grandfather's inheritance to me.

3.3.s:
no cenmacchastrakaṭhinaiḥ kṣayaṃ yāsyaṃti sainikāḥ ..
iti jñātvā mahīrājo viṃśallakṣādhipo balī .. 31 ..
3.3.d:
नो चेन्मच्छस्त्रकठिनैः क्षयं यास्यंति सैनिकाः ॥
इति ज्ञात्वा महीराजो विंशल्लक्षाधिपो बली ॥ 31 ॥
3.3.m: Otherwise, your soldiers shall perish by my hard weapons." / Knowing this, the mighty King Mahīrāja, lord of two million [men],

3.3.s:
dūtaṃ vai preṣayāmāsa rājarājo madotkaṭaḥ ..
jayacaṃdra mahīpāla sāvadhānaṃ śṛṇuṣva tat .. 32 ..
3.3.d:
दूतं वै प्रेषयामास राजराजो मदोत्कटः ॥
जयचंद्र महीपाल सावधानं शृणुष्व तत् ॥ 32 ॥
3.3.m: a king of kings arrogant with pride, sent a messenger: / "O King Jayacandra, listen carefully to this:

3.3.s:
yadā nirākṛtā dhūrtā mayā te caṃdravaṃśinaḥ ..
tataḥ prabhṛti senāṅgaṃ viṃśallakṣaṃ samāhṛtam..33..
3.3.d:
यदा निराकृता धूर्ता मया ते चंद्रवंशिनः ॥
ततः प्रभृति सेनाङ्गं विंशल्लक्षं समाहृतम्॥33॥
3.3.m: From the time those knaves of the Lunar dynasty were expelled by me, / an army of two million has been assembled.

3.3.s:
tvayā ṣoḍaśalakṣaṃ ca yuddhasainyaṃ samāhṛtam ..
sarve vai bhārate bhūpā daṃḍayogyāśca me sadā ..34..
3.3.d:
त्वया षोडशलक्षं च युद्धसैन्यं समाहृतम् ॥
सर्वे वै भारते भूपा दंडयोग्याश्च मे सदा ॥34॥
3.3.m: You have gathered an army of sixteen hundred thousand for war. / All the kings in Bhārata are ever subject to punishment by me.

3.3.s:
bhavānna daṃḍyo balavānkaraṃ me dātumarhati ..
no cenmatkaṭhinairbāṇaiḥ kṣayaṃ yāsyaṃti sainikāḥ ..35..
3.3.d:
भवान्न दंड्यो बलवान्करं मे दातुमर्हति ॥
नो चेन्मत्कठिनैर्बाणैः क्षयं यास्यंति सैनिकाः ॥35॥
3.3.m: You, who are powerful, are not to be punished, [yet] you ought to pay me tribute. / Otherwise, your soldiers shall perish by my hard arrows."

3.3.s:
iti jñātvā tayorghoraṃ vairaṃ cāsīnmahītale ..
bhūmirājaśca valavāñjayacandrabhayārditaḥ ..36..
3.3.d:
इति ज्ञात्वा तयोर्घोरं वैरं चासीन्महीतले ॥
भूमिराजश्च वलवाञ्जयचन्द्रभयार्दितः ॥36॥
3.3.m: Realising this, terrible enmity arose between the two on earth. / And the mighty Bhūmirāja was distressed by fear of Jayacandra,

3.3.s:
jayacaṃdraśca balavānpṛthivīrājabhīrukaḥ ..
jayacandraścāryadeśamarddharāṣṭramamakalpayat.. ..37..
3.3.d:
जयचंद्रश्च बलवान्पृथिवीराजभीरुकः ॥
जयचन्द्रश्चार्यदेशमर्द्धराष्ट्रममकल्पयत्॥ ॥37॥
3.3.m: while the mighty Jayacandra was afraid of Pṛthivīrāja. / Jayacandra held half the realm of the land of the Āryas,

3.3.s:
pṛthivīrāja evāsau tathārddhaṃ rāṣṭramānayat ..
evaṃ jātaṃ tayorvairamagnivaṃśapraṇāśanam ..38..
3.3.d:
पृथिवीराज एवासौ तथार्द्धं राष्ट्रमानयत् ॥
एवं जातं तयोर्वैरमग्निवंशप्रणाशनम् ॥38॥
3.3.m: and Pṛthivīrāja brought the [other] half of the realm under his control. / In this way arose their enmity, which brought about the destruction of the Fire dynasty.

3.3.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
ekadā ratnabhānurhi mahīrājena pālitām ..
diśaṃ yāmyāṃ sa vai jitvā teṣāṃ kośānupāharat ..1..
3.3.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
एकदा रत्नभानुर्हि महीराजेन पालिताम् ॥
दिशं याम्यां स वै जित्वा तेषां कोशानुपाहरत् ॥1॥
3.3.m: Sūta said: / Once Ratnabhānu conquered the southern region / ruled by Mahīrāja and carried off their treasures.

3.3.s:
mahīrājastu tacchutvā paraṃ vismayamāgataḥ ..
ratnabhānośca tilako babhūva bahuvistaraḥ ..2..
3.3.d:
महीराजस्तु तच्छुत्वा परं विस्मयमागतः ॥
रत्नभानोश्च तिलको बभूव बहुविस्तरः ॥2॥
3.3.m: Hearing that, Mahīrāja was greatly astonished. / Ratnabhānu had an extensive coronation.

3.3.s:
tilakā nāma vikhyātā yā tu vīravatī śubhā ..
śreṣṭhā dvādaśarājñīnāṃ jananī lakṣaṇasya vai .. 3 ..
3.3.d:
तिलका नाम विख्याता या तु वीरवती शुभा ॥
श्रेष्ठा द्वादशराज्ञीनां जननी लक्षणस्य वै ॥ 3 ॥
3.3.m: His auspicious wife, heroic and renowned by the name Tilakā, / was the foremost of twelve queens, the mother of Lakṣaṇa.

3.3.s:
jayacaṃdrasya bhūpasya yoṣitaḥ ṣoḍaśābhavan ..
tāsāṃ na tanayo hyāsītpūrvakarmavipākataḥ .. 4 ..
3.3.d:
जयचंद्रस्य भूपस्य योषितः षोडशाभवन् ॥
तासां न तनयो ह्यासीत्पूर्वकर्मविपाकतः ॥ 4 ॥
3.3.m: King Jayacandra had sixteen wives; / through the ripening of past deeds, they had no son.

3.3.s:
gauḍabhūpasya duhitā nāmnā divyavibhāvarī ..
jayacaṃdrasya mahiṣī taddāsī surabhānavī .. 5 ..
3.3.d:
गौडभूपस्य दुहिता नाम्ना दिव्यविभावरी ॥
जयचंद्रस्य महिषी तद्दासी सुरभानवी ॥ 5 ॥
3.3.m: The daughter of the king of Gauḍa, named Divyavibhāvarī, / was Jayacandra's chief queen; her maidservant was Surabhānavī.

3.3.s:
rūpayauvana saṃyuktā ratikeliviśāradā ..
dṛṣṭvā tāṃ sa nṛpaḥ kāmī bubhuje smarapīḍitaḥ ..6..
3.3.d:
