रूपयौवन संयुक्ता रतिकेलिविशारदा ॥
दृष्ट्वा तां स नृपः कामी बुभुजे स्मरपीडितः ॥6॥
3.3.m: Endowed with beauty and youth, skilled in love-play, / the lustful king, seeing her, enjoyed her, afflicted by love.

3.3.s:
tasyāṃ jātā sutā devī nāmnā saṃyoginī śubhā ..
dvādaśābdavayaḥ prāptā sā babhūva varāṃganā .. 7 ..
3.3.d:
तस्यां जाता सुता देवी नाम्ना संयोगिनी शुभा ॥
द्वादशाब्दवयः प्राप्ता सा बभूव वरांगना ॥ 7 ॥
3.3.m: On her was born an auspicious daughter, a goddess named Saṃyoginī; / reaching twelve years of age, she became an exquisite woman.

3.3.s:
tasyāḥ svayaṃvare rājāhvayadbhūpānmahāśubhān ..
bhūmirājastu balavāñchrutvā tadrūpamuttamam .. ..
vivāhārthe manaścāsīccaṃdrabhaṭṭamacodayat ..
maṃtripravara bho mitra caṃdrabhaṭṭa mama priya .. 9 ..
3.3.d:
तस्याः स्वयंवरे राजाह्वयद्भूपान्महाशुभान् ॥
भूमिराजस्तु बलवाञ्छ्रुत्वा तद्रूपमुत्तमम् ॥ ॥
विवाहार्थे मनश्चासीच्चंद्रभट्टमचोदयत् ॥
मंत्रिप्रवर भो मित्र चंद्रभट्ट मम प्रिय ॥ 9 ॥
3.3.m: For her svayaṃvara, the king invited most auspicious monarchs. / But the mighty Bhūmirāja, hearing of her supreme beauty, / set his heart on marriage and sent Candra Bhaṭṭa: / "O best of ministers, O friend Candra Bhaṭṭa, dear to me,

3.3.s:
kānyakubjapurīṃ prāpya manmūrtiṃ svarṇanirmitām.. ..
sthāpaya tvaṃ sabhāmadhye yadvṛttāṃtaṃ tu me vada .. 3.3.6.10 ..
3.3.d:
कान्यकुब्जपुरीं प्राप्य मन्मूर्तिं स्वर्णनिर्मिताम्॥ ॥
स्थापय त्वं सभामध्ये यद्वृत्तांतं तु मे वद ॥ 3.3.6.10 ॥
3.3.m: reach the city of Kānyakubja and set up an image of me made of gold / in the midst of the assembly, and tell me what occurs."

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā caṃdrabhaṭṭo bhavānībhaktitatparaḥ ..
gatvā tatra bhṛguśreṣṭha yathā proktastathākarot .. 11 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा चंद्रभट्टो भवानीभक्तितत्परः ॥
गत्वा तत्र भृगुश्रेष्ठ यथा प्रोक्तस्तथाकरोत् ॥ 11 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing this, Candra Bhaṭṭa, devoted to Bhavānī, / went there, O best of the Bhṛgus, and did as he was told.

3.3.s:
svayaṃvare ca bhūpāśca nānādeśyāḥ samāgatāḥ ..
tyaktvā saṃyoginī tānvai nṛpamūrtivimohitā .. 12 ..
3.3.d:
स्वयंवरे च भूपाश्च नानादेश्याः समागताः ॥
त्यक्त्वा संयोगिनी तान्वै नृपमूर्तिविमोहिता ॥ 12 ॥
3.3.m: And to the svayaṃvara kings arrived from diverse lands. / Rejecting them, Saṃyoginī was captivated by the statue of the king.

3.3.s:
pitaraṃ prāha kāmākṣī yasya mūrtiriyaṃ nṛpa ..
bhaviṣyati sa me bhartā sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitaḥ .. 13 ..
3.3.d:
पितरं प्राह कामाक्षी यस्य मूर्तिरियं नृप ॥
भविष्यति स मे भर्ता सर्वलक्षणलक्षितः ॥ 13 ॥
3.3.m: The lovely-eyed girl said to her father: "O king, he whose image this is / shall be my husband, marked with all auspicious signs."

3.3.s:
jayacaṃdrastu tacchrutvā caṃdrabhadramuvāca tam ..
yadi te bhūpatiścaiva sarvasainyasamanvitaḥ .. 14 ..
3.3.d:
जयचंद्रस्तु तच्छ्रुत्वा चंद्रभद्रमुवाच तम् ॥
यदि ते भूपतिश्चैव सर्वसैन्यसमन्वितः ॥ 14 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing that, Jayacandra said to Candrabhadra: / "If your king, accompanied by his entire army,

3.3.s:
sañjayedyoginīmetāṃ tarhi me'tipriyo bhavet ..
caṃdrabhaṭṭastu tacchrutvā tattu sarvamavarṇayat .. 15 ..
3.3.d:
सञ्जयेद्योगिनीमेतां तर्हि मेऽतिप्रियो भवेत् ॥
चंद्रभट्टस्तु तच्छ्रुत्वा तत्तु सर्वमवर्णयत् ॥ 15 ॥
3.3.m: can win this Yoginī, then he shall be very dear to me." / Hearing that, Candra Bhaṭṭa related all of it [to him].

3.3.s:
pṛthivīrāja evāsau śrutvā sainyamacodayat ..
ekalakṣā gajāstasya saptalakṣāsturaṃgamāḥ .. 16 ..
3.3.d:
पृथिवीराज एवासौ श्रुत्वा सैन्यमचोदयत् ॥
एकलक्षा गजास्तस्य सप्तलक्षास्तुरंगमाः ॥ 16 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing this, Pṛthivīrāja mobilised his army: / his elephants were one hundred thousand, his horses seven hundred thousand,

3.3.s:
rathāḥ paṃcasahasrāśca dhanurbāṇaviśāradāḥ ..
lakṣāḥ padātayo jñeyā dvādaśaiva mahābalāḥ .. 17 ..
3.3.d:
रथाः पंचसहस्राश्च धनुर्बाणविशारदाः ॥
लक्षाः पदातयो ज्ञेया द्वादशैव महाबलाः ॥ 17 ॥
3.3.m: his chariots were five thousand, [manned by warriors] skilled with bow and arrow, / and his foot soldiers are to be known as twelve hundred thousand, of great might.

3.3.s:
rājānastriśatānyeva mahīrājapadānugāḥ ..
sārddhaṃ dvābhyāṃ ca bandhubhyāṃ kānyakubje nṛpo'gamat .. 18 ..
3.3.d:
राजानस्त्रिशतान्येव महीराजपदानुगाः ॥
सार्द्धं द्वाभ्यां च बन्धुभ्यां कान्यकुब्जे नृपोऽगमत् ॥ 18 ॥
3.3.m: Three hundred kings followed in Mahīrāja's footsteps; / along with his two kinsmen, the king marched to Kānyakubja.

3.3.s:
dhundhukāraśca tadbandhurgajānīkapatissadā ..
hayānīkapatiḥ kṛṣṇa kumāro balavattaraḥ .. 19 ..
3.3.d:
धुन्धुकारश्च तद्बन्धुर्गजानीकपतिस्सदा ॥
हयानीकपतिः कृष्ण कुमारो बलवत्तरः ॥ 19 ॥
3.3.m: His kinsman Dhundhukāra was ever the commander of the elephant division; / the commander of the cavalry division was the exceedingly strong Prince Kṛṣṇa.

3.3.s:
padātīnāṃ nṛpatayaḥ patayastatra cābhavan ..
mahānkolāhalo jātaḥ sthalīṃ śūnyāmakārayan .. 3.3.6.20 ..
3.3.d:
पदातीनां नृपतयः पतयस्तत्र चाभवन् ॥
महान्कोलाहलो जातः स्थलीं शून्यामकारयन् ॥ 3.3.6.20 ॥
3.3.m: Kings were the commanders of the infantry there; / a tremendous uproar arose, and they emptied the countryside.

3.3.s:
viṃśatkośapramāṇena sthitaṃ tasya mahābalam ..
jayacaṃdrastu saṃjñāya mahīrājasya cāgamam .. 21 ..
3.3.d:
विंशत्कोशप्रमाणेन स्थितं तस्य महाबलम् ॥
जयचंद्रस्तु संज्ञाय महीराजस्य चागमम् ॥ 21 ॥
3.3.m: His mighty army encamped across an extent of twenty kos. / Jayacandra, learning of Mahīrāja's arrival,

3.3.s:
svasainyaṃ kalpayāmāsa lakṣaṣoḍaśasaṃmitam ..
ekalakṣā gajāstasya saptalakṣāḥ padātayaḥ .. 22 ..
3.3.d:
स्वसैन्यं कल्पयामास लक्षषोडशसंमितम् ॥
एकलक्षा गजास्तस्य सप्तलक्षाः पदातयः ॥ 22 ॥
3.3.m: marshalled his own army, numbering sixteen hundred thousand: / his elephants were one hundred thousand, his foot soldiers seven hundred thousand.

3.3.s:
vājinaścāṣṭalakṣāśca sarvayuddhaviśāradāḥ ..
dviśatānyeva rājānaḥ prāptāstatra samāgame .. 23 ..
3.3.d:
वाजिनश्चाष्टलक्षाश्च सर्वयुद्धविशारदाः ॥
द्विशतान्येव राजानः प्राप्तास्तत्र समागमे ॥ 23 ॥
3.3.m: and eight hundred thousand horses, all skilled in warfare. / Exactly two hundred kings arrived at that assembly.

3.3.s:
āgaskṛtaṃ mahīrājaṃ matvā te śuklavaṃśinaḥ ..
yuddhārthinaḥ sthitāstatra puramāgaskṛtaṃ hyabhūt .. 24 ..
3.3.d:
आगस्कृतं महीराजं मत्वा ते शुक्लवंशिनः ॥
युद्धार्थिनः स्थितास्तत्र पुरमागस्कृतं ह्यभूत् ॥ 24 ॥
3.3.m: Considering Mahīrāja an offender, those of the Śukla lineage, / desiring war, stood there, for the city had indeed been offended.

3.3.s:
īśanadyāḥ pare kūle taddolā sthapitā tadā ..
nānā vādyāni ramyāṇi tatra cakrurmahāravam .. 25 ..
3.3.d:
ईशनद्याः परे कूले तद्दोला स्थपिता तदा ॥
नाना वाद्यानि रम्याणि तत्र चक्रुर्महारवम् ॥ 25 ॥
3.3.m: Her palanquin was then placed on the other bank of the river Īśā; / there various pleasant musical instruments made a great sound.

3.3.s:
ratnabhānurgajānīke rūpānīke hi lakṣaṇaḥ ..
tasyāṃ senāpatibhyāṃ tau saṃguptau balavattarau .. 26 ..
3.3.d:
रत्नभानुर्गजानीके रूपानीके हि लक्षणः ॥
तस्यां सेनापतिभ्यां तौ संगुप्तौ बलवत्तरौ ॥ 26 ॥
3.3.m: Ratnabhānu [stood] in the elephant army, and Lakṣaṇa in the infantry division. / They, exceedingly strong, were protected by the two generals of that [army].

3.3.s:
pradyotaścaiva vidyoto ratnabhānuṃ rarakṣatuḥ ..
bhīṣmaḥ parimalaścaiva lakṣaṇaṃ caṃdravaṃśajaḥ .. 27 ..
3.3.d:
प्रद्योतश्चैव विद्योतो रत्नभानुं ररक्षतुः ॥
भीष्मः परिमलश्चैव लक्षणं चंद्रवंशजः ॥ 27 ॥
3.3.m: Pradyota and Vidyota protected Ratnabhānu; / and Bhīṣma and Parimala, born of the lunar dynasty, [protected] Lakṣaṇa.

3.3.s:
bhūpāḥ padātisainye ca saṃsthitā madavihvalāḥ ..
tayoścāsīnmahadyuddhaṃ dāruṇaṃ sainyasaṃkṣayam .. 28 ..
3.3.d:
भूपाः पदातिसैन्ये च संस्थिता मदविह्वलाः ॥
तयोश्चासीन्महद्युद्धं दारुणं सैन्यसंक्षयम् ॥ 28 ॥
3.3.m: The kings stood among the infantry forces, maddened with excitement. / And between the two [armies] arose a great battle, terrible and destructive to the troops.

3.3.s:
hayā hayairmṛtā jātā gajāścaiva gajaistathā ..
padātayaḥ padātaiśca mṛtāścānye kramādraṇe .. 29 ..
3.3.d:
हया हयैर्मृता जाता गजाश्चैव गजैस्तथा ॥
पदातयः पदातैश्च मृताश्चान्ये क्रमाद्रणे ॥ 29 ॥
3.3.m: Horses were killed by horses, and elephants by elephants; / foot soldiers were killed by foot soldiers, and others likewise in succession in the battle.

3.3.s:
bhūpaiśca rakṣitāḥ sarve nirbhayā raṇamāyayuḥ ..
yāvatsūryaḥ sthito vyomni tāvadyuddhamavartata .. 3.3.6.30 ..
3.3.d:
भूपैश्च रक्षिताः सर्वे निर्भया रणमाययुः ॥
यावत्सूर्यः स्थितो व्योम्नि तावद्युद्धमवर्तत ॥ 3.3.6.30 ॥
3.3.m: Protected by the kings, all went fearlessly into battle. / As long as the sun stood in the sky, so long did the battle continue.

3.3.s:
evaṃ paṃcadinaṃ jātaṃ yuddhaṃ vīrajanakṣayam ..
gajā daśasahasraṇi hayā lakṣāṇi saṃkṣitāḥ .. 31 ..
3.3.d:
एवं पंचदिनं जातं युद्धं वीरजनक्षयम् ॥
गजा दशसहस्रणि हया लक्षाणि संक्षिताः ॥ 31 ॥
3.3.m: Thus for five days the battle went on, destroying heroic men. / Ten thousand elephants and hundreds of thousands of horses were slain.

3.3.s:
paṃcalakṣaṃ mahībharturhatāstatra padātayaḥ ..
rājāno dve śate tatra rathāśca triśataṃ tathā .. 32 ..
3.3.d:
पंचलक्षं महीभर्तुर्हतास्तत्र पदातयः ॥
राजानो द्वे शते तत्र रथाश्च त्रिशतं तथा ॥ 32 ॥
3.3.m: Five hundred thousand foot soldiers of the lord of the earth were killed there, / along with two hundred kings and three hundred chariots.

3.3.s:
kānyakubjādhipasyaiva gajā navasahasrakāḥ ..
sahasraikaṃ rathā jñeyāstrilakṣaṃ ca padātayaḥ .. 33 ..
3.3.d:
कान्यकुब्जाधिपस्यैव गजा नवसहस्रकाः ॥
सहस्रैकं रथा ज्ञेयास्त्रिलक्षं च पदातयः ॥ 33 ॥
3.3.m: Of the lord of Kānyakubja, nine thousand elephants, / one thousand chariots are to be known, and three hundred thousand foot soldiers,

3.3.s:
ekalakṣaṃ hayāstatra mṛtāḥ svargapuraṃ yayuḥ ..
ṣaṣṭhāhe samanuprāpte pṛthivīrāja eva saḥ .. 34 ..
3.3.d:
एकलक्षं हयास्तत्र मृताः स्वर्गपुरं ययुः ॥
षष्ठाहे समनुप्राप्ते पृथिवीराज एव सः ॥ 34 ॥
3.3.m: [and] one hundred thousand horses died there and went to the city of heaven. / When the sixth day arrived, that very Pṛthivīrāja,

3.3.s:
duḥkhito manasā devaṃ rudraṃ tuṣṭāva bhaktimān ..
saṃtuṣṭastu mahādevo mohayāmāsa tadbalam .. 35 ..
3.3.d:
दुःखितो मनसा देवं रुद्रं तुष्टाव भक्तिमान् ॥
संतुष्टस्तु महादेवो मोहयामास तद्बलम् ॥ 35 ॥
3.3.m: pained in his mind, devoutly praised the god Rudra. / Mahādeva, well pleased, bewildered that army [of his enemy].

3.3.s:
prasannastu mahīrājo gataḥ saṃyoginīṃ prati ..
dṛṣṭvā tatsundaraṃ rūpaṃ mumoha vasudhādhipaḥ .. 36 ..
3.3.d:
प्रसन्नस्तु महीराजो गतः संयोगिनीं प्रति ॥
दृष्ट्वा तत्सुन्दरं रूपं मुमोह वसुधाधिपः ॥ 36 ॥
3.3.m: Glad at heart, Mahīrāja went towards Saṃyoginī. / Seeing her beautiful form, the ruler of the earth was enchanted.

3.3.s:
saṃyoginī nṛpaṃ dṛṣṭvā mūrcchitā cābhavatkṣaṇāt ..
etasminnaṃtare rājā taddolāmanayadbalāt.. 37 ..
3.3.d:
संयोगिनी नृपं दृष्ट्वा मूर्च्छिता चाभवत्क्षणात् ॥
एतस्मिन्नंतरे राजा तद्दोलामनयद्बलात्॥ 37 ॥
3.3.m: Seeing the king, Saṃyoginī fainted in an instant. / In the meantime, the king carried off her palanquin by force.

3.3.s:
jagāma dehalīṃ bhūpaḥ sarvasainyasamanvitaḥ ..
yojanānte gate tasminbodhitāste madodbhaṭāḥ .. 38 ..
3.3.d:
जगाम देहलीं भूपः सर्वसैन्यसमन्वितः ॥
योजनान्ते गते तस्मिन्बोधितास्ते मदोद्भटाः ॥ 38 ॥
3.3.m: The king went to Dehalī, accompanied by all his troops. / When he had gone the distance of a yojana, those furious men awakened.

3.3.s:
dṛṣṭvā naiva tadā dolāṃ prajagmurvegavattarāḥ ..
śrutvā kolāhalaṃ teṣāṃ mahīrājo nṛpottamaḥ .. 39 ..
3.3.d:
दृष्ट्वा नैव तदा दोलां प्रजग्मुर्वेगवत्तराः ॥
श्रुत्वा कोलाहलं तेषां महीराजो नृपोत्तमः ॥ 39 ॥
3.3.m: Not seeing the palanquin then, they rushed forth with great speed. / Hearing their tumult, Mahīrāja, the best of kings,

3.3.s:
arddhasainyaṃ ca saṃsthāpya svayaṃ gehamupāgamat ..
ubhau tadbhrātarau vīrau cārddhasainyasamanvitau .. 3.3.6.40 ..
3.3.d:
अर्द्धसैन्यं च संस्थाप्य स्वयं गेहमुपागमत् ॥
उभौ तद्भ्रातरौ वीरौ चार्द्धसैन्यसमन्वितौ ॥ 3.3.6.40 ॥
3.3.m: stationed half his army and went home himself. / Both his heroic brothers, accompanied by half the army,

3.3.s:
sūkarakṣetramāsādya yuddhāya samupasthitau ..
etasminnantare sarve pradyotādimahābalāḥ ..41..
3.3.d:
सूकरक्षेत्रमासाद्य युद्धाय समुपस्थितौ ॥
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे सर्वे प्रद्योतादिमहाबलाः ॥41॥
3.3.m: reached Sūkarakṣetra and drew up for battle. / In the meantime, all the mighty warriors such as Pradyota,

3.3.s:
svasainyaiḥ saha saṃprāpya mahadyuddhamakārayan..
hayā hayaiśca saṃjagmurgajā atha gajaiḥ saha .. 42 ..
3.3.d:
स्वसैन्यैः सह संप्राप्य महद्युद्धमकारयन्॥
हया हयैश्च संजग्मुर्गजा अथ गजैः सह ॥ 42 ॥
3.3.m: arriving with their own armies, engaged in a great battle. / Horses collided with horses, and elephants with elephants.

3.3.s:
saṃkulaśca mahānāsīddāruṇo lomaharṣaṇaḥ ..
dinānte saṃkṣayaṃ yātaṃ tayoścaiva mahadbalam .. 43 ..
3.3.d:
संकुलश्च महानासीद्दारुणो लोमहर्षणः ॥
दिनान्ते संक्षयं यातं तयोश्चैव महद्बलम् ॥ 43 ॥
3.3.m: There was a great melee, terrible and hair-raising. / At the end of the day, their mighty armies were reduced to destruction.

3.3.s:
bhayabhītā pare tatra jñātvā rātriṃ tamovṛtām ..
pradudruvurbhayādvīrā hataśeṣāstu dehalīm ..44 ..
3.3.d:
भयभीता परे तत्र ज्ञात्वा रात्रिं तमोवृताम् ॥
प्रदुद्रुवुर्भयाद्वीरा हतशेषास्तु देहलीम् ॥44 ॥
3.3.m: Frightened with fear, the survivors among the other heroes, knowing the night was covered in darkness, / fled in terror to Dehalī.

3.3.s:
pradyotādyāśca te vīrā dehalīṃ prati saṃyayuḥ ..
punastayormahadyuddhaṃ hyabhavallomaharṣaṇam .. 45 ..
3.3.d:
प्रद्योताद्याश्च ते वीरा देहलीं प्रति संययुः ॥
पुनस्तयोर्महद्युद्धं ह्यभवल्लोमहर्षणम् ॥ 45 ॥
3.3.m: Pradyota and those [other] heroes marched toward Dehalī. / Again a great battle occurred between them, causing the hair to stand on end.

3.3.s:
dhuṃdhukāraśca pradyotaṃ hṛdi bāṇairatāḍayat ..
tribhiśca viṣanirdhūtairmūchitaḥ sa mamāra ca .. 46 ..
3.3.d:
धुंधुकारश्च प्रद्योतं हृदि बाणैरताडयत् ॥
त्रिभिश्च विषनिर्धूतैर्मूछितः स ममार च ॥ 46 ॥
3.3.m: Dhundhukāra struck Pradyota in the chest with arrows; / struck by three [arrows] smeared with poison, he fainted and died.

3.3.s:
bhrātaraṃ nihataṃ dṛṣṭvā vidyotaśca mahāvalaḥ ..
ājagāma gajārūḍho dhuṃdhukāramatāḍayat .. 47 ..
3.3.d:
भ्रातरं निहतं दृष्ट्वा विद्योतश्च महावलः ॥
आजगाम गजारूढो धुंधुकारमताडयत् ॥ 47 ॥
3.3.m: Seeing his brother slain, the mighty Vidyota / advanced mounted on an elephant and struck Dhundhukāra.

3.3.s:
tribhiśca tomaraiḥ so'pi mūrchito bhūmimāgamat ..
mūrchitaṃ bhrātaraṃ dṛṣṭvā dhuṃdhukāraṃ mahābalam .. 48 ..
3.3.d:
त्रिभिश्च तोमरैः सोऽपि मूर्छितो भूमिमागमत् ॥
मूर्छितं भ्रातरं दृष्ट्वा धुंधुकारं महाबलम् ॥ 48 ॥
3.3.m: Struck by three javelins, he too fainted and fell to the ground. / Seeing his mighty brother Dhundhukāra fainted,

3.3.s:
tadā kṛṣṇakumāro'sau gajasthastvarito yayau ..
rūpāviṣṭaśca taṃ vīraṃ bhallenaivamatāḍa yat .. .. 49 ..
3.3.d:
तदा कृष्णकुमारोऽसौ गजस्थस्त्वरितो ययौ ॥
रूपाविष्टश्च तं वीरं भल्लेनैवमताड यत् ॥ ॥ 49 ॥
3.3.m: Kṛṣṇakumāra, mounted on an elephant, went swiftly at that moment, / and overcome with anger, he struck that hero with a spear.

3.3.s:
bhallena tena saṃbhinno mṛtaḥ svargapuraṃ yayau ..
vidyote nihate tasmitsarvasainyacamūpatau .. 3.3.6.50 ..
3.3.d:
भल्लेन तेन संभिन्नो मृतः स्वर्गपुरं ययौ ॥
विद्योते निहते तस्मित्सर्वसैन्यचमूपतौ ॥ 3.3.6.50 ॥
3.3.m: Pierced by that spear, he died and went to the city of heaven. / When Vidyota, the commander of their entire army, was slain,

3.3.s:
ratnābhānurmahāvīro'yudhyattena samanvitaḥ ..
etasminnaṃtare rājā sahasragajasaṃyutaḥ .. 51 ..
3.3.d:
रत्नाभानुर्महावीरोऽयुध्यत्तेन समन्वितः ॥
एतस्मिन्नंतरे राजा सहस्रगजसंयुतः ॥ 51 ॥
3.3.m: the great hero Ratnabhānu, joined by him, fought. / In the meantime, the king, accompanied by a thousand elephants,

3.3.s:
lakṣaṇaṃ sahitaṃ tābhyāṃ kruddhaṃ taṃ samayudhyata ..
śivadattavaro rājā bhīṣmaṃ parimalaṃ ruṣā .. .. 52 ..
3.3.d:
लक्षणं सहितं ताभ्यां क्रुद्धं तं समयुध्यत ॥
शिवदत्तवरो राजा भीष्मं परिमलं रुषा ॥ ॥ 52 ॥
3.3.m: fought angrily against Lakṣaṇa along with the two of them. / The king, granted a boon by Śiva, in anger [struck] Bhīṣma and Parimala;

3.3.s:
rudrāstrairmohayāmāsa lakṣaṇaṃ balavattaram ..
mūrchitāṃstānsamālokya ratnabhānuḥ śarairnijaiḥ .. 53 ..
3.3.d:
रुद्रास्त्रैर्मोहयामास लक्षणं बलवत्तरम् ॥
मूर्छितांस्तान्समालोक्य रत्नभानुः शरैर्निजैः ॥ 53 ॥
3.3.m: with Rudra-weapons he bewildered the mighty Lakṣaṇa. / Seeing them fainted, Ratnabhānu, with his own arrows,

3.3.s:
dhuṃdhukāraṃ mahīrājaṃ vaiṣṇavaiḥ samamojayan ..
kṛṣṇako ratnabhānuśca yuyudhāte parasparam ..54..
3.3.d:
धुंधुकारं महीराजं वैष्णवैः सममोजयन् ॥
कृष्णको रत्नभानुश्च युयुधाते परस्परम् ॥54॥
3.3.m: bewildered Dhundhukāra and Mahīrāja with Vaiṣṇava [weapons]. / Kṛṣṇaka and Ratnabhānu fought against one another.

3.3.s:
ubhau samabalau vīrau gajapṛṣṭhasthitau raṇe ..
anyonyanihatau nāgau khaṅgahastau mahī tale .. 55 ..
3.3.d:
उभौ समबलौ वीरौ गजपृष्ठस्थितौ रणे ॥
अन्योन्यनिहतौ नागौ खङ्गहस्तौ मही तले ॥ 55 ॥
3.3.m: Both heroes of equal strength were mounted on the backs of elephants in battle. / Their elephants having killed each other, sword in hand on the surface of the earth,

3.3.s:
yuyudhāte bahūnmārgānkṛtavaṃtau sudurjayau ..
praharāntaṃ raṇaṃ kṛtvā maraṇāyopajagmatuḥ .. 56 ..
3.3.d:
युयुधाते बहून्मार्गान्कृतवंतौ सुदुर्जयौ ॥
प्रहरान्तं रणं कृत्वा मरणायोपजग्मतुः ॥ 56 ॥
3.3.m: the two very invincible [heroes] fought, executing many maneuvers. / Having fought until the end of a prahara, they met their deaths.

3.3.s:
hate tasminmahāvīrye kānyakubjā bhayāturāḥ ..
mūrchitāṃstrīnsamādāya paṃcalakṣabalairyutāḥ .. 57 ..
3.3.d:
हते तस्मिन्महावीर्ये कान्यकुब्जा भयातुराः ॥
मूर्छितांस्त्रीन्समादाय पंचलक्षबलैर्युताः ॥ 57 ॥
3.3.m: When that [warrior] of great prowess was slain, the people of Kānyakubja, afflicted with fear, / taking the three who were unconscious, accompanied by an army of five hundred thousand,

3.3.s:
raṇaṃ tyaktvā gṛhaṃ jagmurnṛpaśokaparāyaṇāḥ ..
ratnabhānau ca nihate hatotsāhāśca bhūmipāḥ .. 58 ..
3.3.d:
रणं त्यक्त्वा गृहं जग्मुर्नृपशोकपरायणाः ॥
रत्नभानौ च निहते हतोत्साहाश्च भूमिपाः ॥ 58 ॥
3.3.m: abandoned the battle and went home, devoted to grief for their king. / And when Ratnabhānu was slain, the kings, dispirited,

3.3.s:
svaṃsvaṃ niveśanaṃ jagmurmahīrājabhayāturāḥ ..
devānārādhayāmāsuryatheṣṭaṃ te gṛhe gṛhe .. 59 ..
3.3.d:
स्वंस्वं निवेशनं जग्मुर्महीराजभयातुराः ॥
देवानाराधयामासुर्यथेष्टं ते गृहे गृहे ॥ 59 ॥
3.3.m: went each to his own encampment, terrified of Mahīrāja. / In house after house, they worshipped the gods as they wished.

3.3.s:
mahīrājastu balavānsaptalakṣabalānvitaḥ ..
dhuṃdhukāreṇa sahito vaṃdhukṛtyordhvamācarat .. 3.3.6.60 ..
3.3.d:
महीराजस्तु बलवान्सप्तलक्षबलान्वितः ॥
धुंधुकारेण सहितो वंधुकृत्योर्ध्वमाचरत् ॥ 3.3.6.60 ॥
3.3.m: The mighty Mahīrāja, accompanied by an army of seven hundred thousand, / together with Dhundhukāra, having taken [him] captive, performed the funeral rites.

3.3.s:
tathā bhīṣmaḥ parimalo lakṣaṇaḥ pitaraṃ svakam..
gaṃgākūle samāgamya caurdhvadaihikamācaran .. 61 ..
3.3.d:
तथा भीष्मः परिमलो लक्षणः पितरं स्वकम्॥
गंगाकूले समागम्य चौर्ध्वदैहिकमाचरन् ॥ 61 ॥
3.3.m: Likewise Bhīṣma, Parimala, and Lakṣaṇa, having come / to the bank of the Gaṅgā, performed the funeral rites for their father.

3.3.s:
bhūmirājasya vijayo jayacaṃdayaśo raṇe ..
prasiddhamabhavadbhūmau gehegehe janejane ..62..
3.3.d:
भूमिराजस्य विजयो जयचंदयशो रणे ॥
प्रसिद्धमभवद्भूमौ गेहेगेहे जनेजने ॥62॥
3.3.m: The victory of Bhūmirāja and the glory of Jayacandra in battle / became famous on earth in every house and among every person.

3.3.s:
jayacaṃdraḥ kānyakubje dehalyāṃ pṛthivīpatiḥ ..
utsavaṃ kārayitvā tu paramānandamāyayau .. 63 ..
3.3.d:
जयचंद्रः कान्यकुब्जे देहल्यां पृथिवीपतिः ॥
उत्सवं कारयित्वा तु परमानन्दमाययौ ॥ 63 ॥
3.3.m: Jayacandra in Kānyakubja and the lord of the earth in Dehalī, / having celebrated a festival, attained supreme joy.

3.3.s:
.. sūta uvāca ..
bhīṣmaḥ siṃhasthite gaṃgākūle śakraprapūjakaḥ ..
śakraṃ sūryamayaṃ jñātvā tapasā samatoṣayat .. 1 ..
3.3.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥
भीष्मः सिंहस्थिते गंगाकूले शक्रप्रपूजकः ॥
शक्रं सूर्यमयं ज्ञात्वा तपसा समतोषयत् ॥ 1 ॥
3.3.m: Sūta said: / When [the sun] stood in Leo, Bhīṣma, a worshipper of Śakra on the bank of the Gaṅgā, / knowing Śakra to be composed of the sun, propitiated him through asceticism.

3.3.s:
māsāṃte bhagavāniṃdro jñātvā tadbhaktimuttamām ..
varaṃ varaya ca prāha śrutvā śūrobravīdidam .. 2 ..
3.3.d:
मासांते भगवानिंद्रो ज्ञात्वा तद्भक्तिमुत्तमाम् ॥
वरं वरय च प्राह श्रुत्वा शूरोब्रवीदिदम् ॥ 2 ॥
3.3.m: At the end of the month, the lord Indra, recognizing his supreme devotion, / said, 'Choose a boon.' Hearing [this], the hero spoke these words:

3.3.s:
dehi me vaḍavāṃ divyāṃ yadi tuṣṭo bhavānprabhuḥ ..
iti śrutvā tadā tasmai vaḍavāṃ hariṇīṃ śubhām .. 3 ..
3.3.d:
देहि मे वडवां दिव्यां यदि तुष्टो भवान्प्रभुः ॥
इति श्रुत्वा तदा तस्मै वडवां हरिणीं शुभाम् ॥ 3 ॥
3.3.m: "Grant me a divine mare, if you, my lord, are pleased with me." / Hearing this, Lord Indra then gave him a splendid, swift mare,

3.3.s: dadau sa bhagavāniṃdrastatraivāntarhitobhavat .. 4 ..
3.3.d: ददौ स भगवानिंद्रस्तत्रैवान्तर्हितोभवत् ॥ 4 ॥
3.3.m: and vanished right there.

3.3.s:
tasminkāle parimalaḥ pitṛśokaparāyaṇaḥ ..
pārthivaiḥ pūjayāmāsa mahādevamumāpatim ..
parīkṣārthaṃ śivaḥ sākṣātsarparogeṇa taṃ grasat .. 5 ..
3.3.d:
तस्मिन्काले परिमलः पितृशोकपरायणः ॥
पार्थिवैः पूजयामास महादेवमुमापतिम् ॥
परीक्षार्थं शिवः साक्षात्सर्परोगेण तं ग्रसत् ॥ 5 ॥
3.3.m: At that time, Parimala, overwhelmed with grief for his father, / worshipped Mahādeva, the lord of Umā, with earthen liṅgas. / In order to test him, Śiva himself afflicted him with a serpent-disease.

3.3.s:
vyatīte paṃcame māse nṛpaḥ śaktivivarjitaḥ ..
na tatyāja mahāpūjāṃ mahākleśasamanvitaḥ .. 6 ..
3.3.d:
व्यतीते पंचमे मासे नृपः शक्तिविवर्जितः ॥
न तत्याज महापूजां महाक्लेशसमन्वितः ॥ 6 ॥
3.3.m: When the fifth month had passed, the king, bereft of strength / and afflicted with great suffering, did not abandon the great worship.

3.3.s:
maraṇāya yayau kāśīṃ svapatnyā sahito nṛpaḥ ..
uvāsa vaṭamūlāṃte rātrau rogaprapīḍitaḥ .. 7 ..
3.3.d:
मरणाय ययौ काशीं स्वपत्न्या सहितो नृपः ॥
उवास वटमूलांते रात्रौ रोगप्रपीडितः ॥ 7 ॥
3.3.m: The king went to Kāśī with his wife to meet his death. / Tormented by the disease, he stayed at night at the foot of a banyan tree.

3.3.s:
etasminnantare kaścitpannago mūlasaṃsthitaḥ ..
śabdaṃ cakāra madhuraṃ śrutvā rudrāhirāyayau .. 8 ..
3.3.d:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे कश्चित्पन्नगो मूलसंस्थितः ॥
शब्दं चकार मधुरं श्रुत्वा रुद्राहिराययौ ॥ 8 ॥
3.3.m: Meanwhile, a serpent dwelling at the root [of the tree] / made a sweet sound; hearing it, the serpent of Rudra came there.

3.3.s:
rudrāhiṃ pannagaḥ prāha bhavānnirdaya mandadhīḥ ..
śivabhaktaṃ nṛpamimaṃ pīḍayetpratyahaṃ khalaḥ .. 9 ..
3.3.d:
रुद्राहिं पन्नगः प्राह भवान्निर्दय मन्दधीः ॥
शिवभक्तं नृपमिमं पीडयेत्प्रत्यहं खलः ॥ 9 ॥
3.3.m: The serpent said to Rudra's serpent: "You are merciless and foolish; / wicked one, you torment this king every day, though he is a devotee of Śiva!

3.3.s:
mūrkho'yaṃ bhūpatiḥ sākṣādāranālaṃ pibennahi ..
iti śrutvā sa rudrāhirāha re pannagādhama .. 3.3.7.10 ..
3.3.d:
मूर्खोऽयं भूपतिः साक्षादारनालं पिबेन्नहि ॥
इति श्रुत्वा स रुद्राहिराह रे पन्नगाधम ॥ 3.3.7.10 ॥
3.3.m: This king is a fool indeed, since he does not drink sour gruel!" / Hearing this, Rudra's serpent said: "O vile serpent!

3.3.s:
rājño dehe paraṃ harṣaṃ pratyahaṃ prāptavānaham ..
svagehaṃ duḥkhatastyājyaṃ kathaṃ tyājyaṃ mayā śaṭha .. 11 ..
3.3.d:
राज्ञो देहे परं हर्षं प्रत्यहं प्राप्तवानहम् ॥
स्वगेहं दुःखतस्त्याज्यं कथं त्याज्यं मया शठ ॥ 11 ॥
3.3.m: Every day I have attained supreme delight in the king's body. / One's own home is abandoned only out of sorrow; why should I abandon it, villain?

3.3.s:
mūrkhotra bhūpatiryo vai tailoṣṇaṃ yanna dattavān ..
ityuktvāntargato dehe śrutvā sā malanā satī .. 12 ..
3.3.d:
मूर्खोत्र भूपतिर्यो वै तैलोष्णं यन्न दत्तवान् ॥
इत्युक्त्वान्तर्गतो देहे श्रुत्वा सा मलना सती ॥ 12 ॥
3.3.m: The fool here is the king, who has not poured hot oil [into the hole]!" / Having said this, he re-entered the body. Hearing that, the virtuous Malanā

3.3.s:
cakāra pannagoktaṃ tadgatarogo nṛpo'bhavat ..
tailoṣṇairbilamāpūrya cakhāna ca satī svayam .. 13 ..
3.3.d:
चकार पन्नगोक्तं तद्गतरोगो नृपोऽभवत् ॥
तैलोष्णैर्बिलमापूर्य चखान च सती स्वयम् ॥ 13 ॥
3.3.m: did what the serpent had said, and the king became free from disease. / Having filled the hole with hot oil, the virtuous woman dug it up herself.

3.3.s:
tato jātaṃ svayaṃ liṃgamaṃguṣṭhābhaṃ sanātanam ..
jyotīrūpaṃ cidānaṃdaṃ sarvalakṣmasamanvitam .. 14 ..
3.3.d:
ततो जातं स्वयं लिंगमंगुष्ठाभं सनातनम् ॥
ज्योतीरूपं चिदानंदं सर्वलक्ष्मसमन्वितम् ॥ 14 ॥
3.3.m: Then there appeared of itself an eternal liṅga the size of a thumb, / of the nature of light, conscious bliss, endowed with all auspicious marks.

3.3.s:
niśīthe tama udbhūte dikṣu sūryatvamāgatam ..
dṛṣṭvā sa vismito rājā pūjayāmāsa śaṃkaram .. 15 ..
3.3.d:
निशीथे तम उद्भूते दिक्षु सूर्यत्वमागतम् ॥
दृष्ट्वा स विस्मितो राजा पूजयामास शंकरम् ॥ 15 ॥
3.3.m: At midnight, when darkness arose, the brightness of the sun appeared in all directions. / Seeing it, the king was astonished and worshipped Śaṅkara.

3.3.s:
mahimnastavapāṭhaiśca tuṣṭāva girijāpatim ..
tadā prasanno bhagavānvaraṃ brūhi tamabravīt .. 16 ..
3.3.d:
महिम्नस्तवपाठैश्च तुष्टाव गिरिजापतिम् ॥
तदा प्रसन्नो भगवान्वरं ब्रूहि तमब्रवीत् ॥ 16 ॥
3.3.m: With recitations of the Mahimnastava, he praised the lord of Girijā. / Then the Lord was pleased and said to him: "Choose a boon!"

3.3.s:
śrutvāha nṛpatirdevaṃ yadi tuṣṭo maheśvara ..
śrīpatirme gṛhaṃ prāpya vasenmatpriyakārakaḥ .. 17 ..
3.3.d:
श्रुत्वाह नृपतिर्देवं यदि तुष्टो महेश्वर ॥
श्रीपतिर्मे गृहं प्राप्य वसेन्मत्प्रियकारकः ॥ 17 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing this, the king said to the god: "If you are pleased, O Maheśvara, / may Śrīpati come to my home and dwell there, bringing me delight."

3.3.s:
tathetyuktvā mahādevo liṃgarūpatvamāgataḥ ..
pratyahaṃ bhāramekaṃ ca suvarṇaṃ suṣuve tanoḥ .. 18 ..
3.3.d:
तथेत्युक्त्वा महादेवो लिंगरूपत्वमागतः ॥
प्रत्यहं भारमेकं च सुवर्णं सुषुवे तनोः ॥ 18 ॥
3.3.m: Saying "So be it," Mahādeva took the form of a liṅga, / and daily produced from his form a bhāra of gold.

3.3.s:
tadā malastu saṃtuṣṭaḥ prāpto gehaṃ mahāvatīm ..
bhīmasiṃhena sahitaḥ paramānaṃdamāyayau .. 19 ..
3.3.d:
तदा मलस्तु संतुष्टः प्राप्तो गेहं महावतीम् ॥
भीमसिंहेन सहितः परमानंदमाययौ ॥ 19 ॥
3.3.m: Then Mala, well contented, reached his home, Mahāvatī. / Together with Bhīmasiṃha, he attained supreme joy.

3.3.s:
tataḥprabhṛti varṣāṃte jayacaṃdrapurīṃ yayau ..
dṛṣṭvā parimalaṃ rājā kṛtakṛtyatvamāgataḥ .. 3.3.7.20 ..
3.3.d:
ततःप्रभृति वर्षांते जयचंद्रपुरीं ययौ ॥
दृष्ट्वा परिमलं राजा कृतकृत्यत्वमागतः ॥ 3.3.7.20 ॥
3.3.m: From that time forth, at the end of the year he went to Jayacandra's city. / Seeing Parimala, the king felt his purpose accomplished [and said]:

3.3.s:
diṣṭyā te saṃkṣito rogo diṣṭyā te darśitaṃ mukham ..
bhavānnijapurīṃ prāpya sukhī bhavatu mā ciram .. 21 ..
3.3.d:
दिष्ट्या ते संक्षितो रोगो दिष्ट्या ते दर्शितं मुखम् ॥
भवान्निजपुरीं प्राप्य सुखी भवतु मा चिरम् ॥ 21 ॥
3.3.m: "By good fortune your disease has been destroyed! By good fortune I have seen your face! / Go to your own city and be happy without delay.

3.3.s:
yadā me vighna ābhūyāttadā tvaṃ māṃ samācara ..
iti śrutvā parimalo gatvā sthānamavāsayat .. 22 ..
3.3.d:
यदा मे विघ्न आभूयात्तदा त्वं मां समाचर ॥
इति श्रुत्वा परिमलो गत्वा स्थानमवासयत् ॥ 22 ॥
3.3.m: Whenever an obstacle arises for me, then come to my aid!" / Hearing this, Parimala departed and settled in his place.

3.3.s:
tadā tu lakṣaṇo vīro bhagavantamuṣāpatim ..
jagannāthamupāgamya samabhyarccāparo'bhavat .. 23 ..
3.3.d:
तदा तु लक्षणो वीरो भगवन्तमुषापतिम् ॥
जगन्नाथमुपागम्य समभ्यर्च्चापरोऽभवत् ॥ 23 ॥
3.3.m: Then the heroic Lakṣaṇa approached the Lord, the husband of Uṣā, / Jagannātha, and devoted himself to worshipping him.

3.3.s:
pakṣamātrāṃtare viṣṇurjagannātha uṣāpatiḥ ..
varaṃ brūhi vacaśceti lakṣaṇaṃ prāha harṣataḥ .. 24 ..
3.3.d:
पक्षमात्रांतरे विष्णुर्जगन्नाथ उषापतिः ॥
वरं ब्रूहि वचश्चेति लक्षणं प्राह हर्षतः ॥ 24 ॥
3.3.m: After an interval of just a fortnight, Viṣṇu, Jagannātha, the husband of Uṣā, / said with delight to Lakṣaṇa: "Choose a boon!"

3.3.s:
ityuktaḥ sa tu taṃ devaṃ natvovāca vinamradhīḥ ..
dehi me vāhanaṃ divyaṃ sarvaśatruvināśanam .. 25 ..
3.3.d:
इत्युक्तः स तु तं देवं नत्वोवाच विनम्रधीः ॥
देहि मे वाहनं दिव्यं सर्वशत्रुविनाशनम् ॥ 25 ॥
3.3.m: Thus addressed, he bowed down to the god with a humble mind and said: / "Give me a divine mount that destroys all enemies."

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā jagannāthaḥ śaktimairāvatādgajāt ..
samutpādya dadau tasmai divyāmairāvatīṃ mudā .. 26 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा जगन्नाथः शक्तिमैरावताद्गजात् ॥
समुत्पाद्य ददौ तस्मै दिव्यामैरावतीं मुदा ॥ 26 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing this, Jagannātha produced a power from the elephant Airāvata / and joyfully gave him the divine female elephant Airāvatī.

3.3.s:
āruhyairāvatīṃ rājā lakṣaṇo gehamāyayau ..
sa vai parimalo rājā jagāma ca mahāvatīm .. 27 ..
3.3.d:
आरुह्यैरावतीं राजा लक्षणो गेहमाययौ ॥
स वै परिमलो राजा जगाम च महावतीम् ॥ 27 ॥
3.3.m: Mounting Airāvatī, King Lakṣaṇa went to his home. / And that King Parimala went to Mahāvatī.

3.3.s:
etasminnaṃtare vīrāstālanādyā madotkaṭāḥ ..
mahāvatīṃ purīṃ prāpya dadṛśustaṃ mahīpatim .. 28 ..
3.3.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे वीरास्तालनाद्या मदोत्कटाः ॥
महावतीं पुरीं प्राप्य ददृशुस्तं महीपतिम् ॥ 28 ॥
3.3.m: Meanwhile, the heroes headed by Tālana, furious with pride, / arrived at the city of Mahāvatī and saw that king.

3.3.s:
tena sārddhaṃ ca mahatīṃ prītiṃ kṛtvā nyavāsayan ..
māsānte ca punaste vai rājāno vinayānvitāḥ .. 29 ..
3.3.d:
तेन सार्द्धं च महतीं प्रीतिं कृत्वा न्यवासयन् ॥
मासान्ते च पुनस्ते वै राजानो विनयान्विताः ॥ 29 ॥
3.3.m: Forming a great friendship with him, they stayed there. / And at the end of a month, those kings, filled with modesty,

3.3.s:
ūcustaṃ śṛṇu bhūpāla vayaṃ gacchāmahe purīḥ ..
tadā rājāpi tānprāha sarvānkṣitipatī natha ..
dattvādhikāraṃ putrebhyastadā''yāsyāmi vo'ntikam .. 3.3.7.30 ..
3.3.d:
ऊचुस्तं शृणु भूपाल वयं गच्छामहे पुरीः ॥
तदा राजापि तान्प्राह सर्वान्क्षितिपती नथ ॥
दत्त्वाधिकारं पुत्रेभ्यस्तदा'ऽयास्यामि वोऽन्तिकम् ॥ 3.3.7.30 ॥
3.3.m: said to him: "Listen, O king, we are departing for our cities." / Then the king also said to all those rulers of the earth: / "Having given authority to my sons, I shall then come to you."

3.3.s:
tathetyuktāstu te rājñā svagehaṃ punarāyayuḥ ..
sānujo deśarājastu dvijebhyaḥ svapuraṃ dadau .. 31 ..
3.3.d:
तथेत्युक्तास्तु ते राज्ञा स्वगेहं पुनराययुः ॥
सानुजो देशराजस्तु द्विजेभ्यः स्वपुरं ददौ ॥ 31 ॥
3.3.m: Told "So be it" by the king, they returned to their own homes. / And Deśarāja, along with his younger brother, gave his city to the brahmins.

3.3.s:
putrebhyastālano vīro dadau vārāṇasīṃ purīm ..
alikollāmatiḥ kālaḥ patra puṣpodarī varī .. 32 ..
3.3.d:
पुत्रेभ्यस्तालनो वीरो ददौ वाराणसीं पुरीम् ॥
अलिकोल्लामतिः कालः पत्र पुष्पोदरी वरी ॥ 32 ॥
3.3.m: The heroic Tālana gave the city of Vārāṇasī to his sons. / Alika, Ullāmati, Kāla, Patra, Puṣpodarī, Varī,

3.3.s:
karīnarī sulalitasteṣāṃ nāmāni vai kramāt ..
dvau dvau putrau smṛtau teṣāṃ pitustulyaparākramau .. 33 ..
3.3.d:
करीनरी सुललितस्तेषां नामानि वै क्रमात् ॥
द्वौ द्वौ पुत्रौ स्मृतौ तेषां पितुस्तुल्यपराक्रमौ ॥ 33 ॥
3.3.m: Karī, Narī, and Sulalita were their names in order. / Two sons each are remembered for them, equal in valor to their fathers.

3.3.s:
sa vai putrājñayā śūrastālano rākṣasapriyaḥ ..
yātudhānamayaṃ devaṃ tuṣṭāva mlecchapūjanaiḥ .. 34 ..
3.3.d:
स वै पुत्राज्ञया शूरस्तालनो राक्षसप्रियः ॥
यातुधानमयं देवं तुष्टाव म्लेच्छपूजनैः ॥ 34 ॥
3.3.m: That hero Tālana, dear to rākṣasas, by his sons' command / praised the god consisting of yātudhānas with rites of mleccha worship.

3.3.s:
tathā vasumataḥ putrau bhūpatīdeśavatsajau ..
śakraṃ sūryyaṃ samārādhya kṛtakṛtyau babhūvatuḥ .. 35 ..
3.3.d:
तथा वसुमतः पुत्रौ भूपतीदेशवत्सजौ ॥
शक्रं सूर्य्यं समाराध्य कृतकृत्यौ बभूवतुः ॥ 35 ॥
3.3.m: Likewise the two sons of Vasumat, the rulers of the earth born as Deśa and Vatsa, / worshipped Indra and Sūrya and had their desires fulfilled.

3.3.s:
siṃhinīnāma vaḍavāṃ yā tu dattā bhayānakā ..
āruhya balavāñchūro gamanāya mano dadhau .. 36 ..
3.3.d:
सिंहिनीनाम वडवां या तु दत्ता भयानका ॥
आरुह्य बलवाञ्छूरो गमनाय मनो दधौ ॥ 36 ॥
3.3.m: Mounting the terrifying mare named Siṃhinī that had been given [to him], / that powerful hero set his mind on departing.

3.3.s:
paṃcaśabdaṃ mahānāgamindradattaṃ manoramam ..
deśarājastamāruhya gamanāya mano dadhe .. 37 ..
3.3.d:
पंचशब्दं महानागमिन्द्रदत्तं मनोरमम् ॥
देशराजस्तमारुह्य गमनाय मनो दधे ॥ 37 ॥
3.3.m: Mounting the delightful great elephant named Pañcaśabda given by Indra, / Deśarāja set his mind on departing.

3.3.s:
hayaṃ papīhakaṃ nāma sūryadattaṃ narasvaram ..
vatsarājastamāruhya gamanāya mano dadhe .. 38 ..
3.3.d:
हयं पपीहकं नाम सूर्यदत्तं नरस्वरम् ॥
वत्सराजस्तमारुह्य गमनाय मनो दधे ॥ 38 ॥
3.3.m: Mounting the horse named Papīhaka given by Sūrya, which possessed a human voice, / Vatsarāja set his mind on departing.

3.3.s:
trayaḥ śūrāḥ samāgamya nagarīṃ te mahāvatīm ..
ūṣustatra mahātmāno bahumānena satkṛtāḥ .. 39 ..
3.3.d:
त्रयः शूराः समागम्य नगरीं ते महावतीम् ॥
ऊषुस्तत्र महात्मानो बहुमानेन सत्कृताः ॥ 39 ॥
3.3.m: Those three heroes arrived together at the city of Mahāvatī; / honored with great respect, those noble ones dwelled there.

3.3.s:
senā ṣaṣṭisahasraṃ tatteṣāṃ svāmī sa tālanaḥ ..
maṃtriṇau bhrātarau tau ca nṛpateścandravaṃśinaḥ .. 3.3.7.40 ..
3.3.d:
सेना षष्टिसहस्रं तत्तेषां स्वामी स तालनः ॥
मंत्रिणौ भ्रातरौ तौ च नृपतेश्चन्द्रवंशिनः ॥ 3.3.7.40 ॥
3.3.m: Their army numbered sixty thousand, and their master was Tālana; / the two brothers were the ministers of the king of the lunar lineage.

3.3.s: tairvīrai rakṣito rājā kṛtakṛtyatvamāgataḥ .. 41 .. ..
3.3.d: तैर्वीरै रक्षितो राजा कृतकृत्यत्वमागतः ॥ 41 ॥ ॥
3.3.m: Protected by those heroes, the king attained complete fulfillment.

3.3.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
jambuko nāma bhūpālo mahīrājo bhayāturaḥ ..
kāliyena yutaḥ prāpto narmadāyāstaṭe śubhe .. 1 ..
3.3.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
जम्बुको नाम भूपालो महीराजो भयातुरः ॥
कालियेन युतः प्राप्तो नर्मदायास्तटे शुभे ॥ 1 ॥
3.3.m: Sūta said: / A king named Jambuka, terrified of Mahīrāja, / came along with Kāliya to the auspicious bank of the Narmadā.

3.3.s:
pārthivaiḥ pūjayāmāsa devadevaṃ pinākinam ..
ṣaṇmāsānte mahādevo jambukaṃ prāha bhūpatim .. 2 ..
3.3.d:
पार्थिवैः पूजयामास देवदेवं पिनाकिनम् ॥
षण्मासान्ते महादेवो जम्बुकं प्राह भूपतिम् ॥ 2 ॥
3.3.m: He worshipped Pinākin, the god of gods, with earthen liṅgas. / At the end of six months, Mahādeva spoke to King Jambuka:

3.3.s:
varaṃ varaya te'bhīṣṭaṃ bhūpa āha kṛtāṃjaliḥ ..
ajitatvaṃ nṛpaiḥ sarvairdehi me karuṇānidhe .. 3 ..
3.3.d:
वरं वरय तेऽभीष्टं भूप आह कृतांजलिः ॥
अजितत्वं नृपैः सर्वैर्देहि मे करुणानिधे ॥ 3 ॥
3.3.m: "Choose the boon you desire!" With folded hands, the king said: / "Grant me invincibility against all kings, O treasure of compassion!"

3.3.s:
tathetyuktvā mahādevastatraivāntarhitobhavat ..
kāliyasta tsuto labdhvā vīro māheśvaraṃ varam .. 4 ..
3.3.d:
तथेत्युक्त्वा महादेवस्तत्रैवान्तर्हितोभवत् ॥
कालियस्त त्सुतो लब्ध्वा वीरो माहेश्वरं वरम् ॥ 4 ॥
3.3.m: Saying "So be it," Mahādeva vanished right there. / That hero, his son Kāliya, having obtained the boon of Maheśvara,

3.3.s:
mohanaṃ sarvasainyānāṃ pituraṃtikamāyayau ..
pitaraṃ prāha namrātmā dehyājñāṃ tāta matpriyām .. 5 .
3.3.d:
मोहनं सर्वसैन्यानां पितुरंतिकमाययौ ॥
पितरं प्राह नम्रात्मा देह्याज्ञां तात मत्प्रियाम् ॥ 5 ।
3.3.m: [and] a stupefying [arrow] for all armies, he approached his father. / Bowing low, he said to his father, "Father, grant me my cherished command:

3.3.s:
gamiṣyāmi balaiḥ sārddhaṃ gaṃgāṃ śuddhajalāṃ śubhām ..
tathetyuktvā pitā tasmai yayau tu svaṃ niveśanam .. 6 ..
3.3.d:
गमिष्यामि बलैः सार्द्धं गंगां शुद्धजलां शुभाम् ॥
तथेत्युक्त्वा पिता तस्मै ययौ तु स्वं निवेशनम् ॥ 6 ॥
3.3.m: I shall march with the forces to the auspicious Gaṅgā of pure waters." / Saying "So be it," the father went to his own dwelling.

3.3.s:
bhaginīṃ prāha balavānvijayaiṣiṇi śobhane ..
kimicchasi śubhaṃ vastu tadājñāṃ dehi mā ciram .. 7 ..
3.3.d:
भगिनीं प्राह बलवान्विजयैषिणि शोभने ॥
किमिच्छसि शुभं वस्तु तदाज्ञां देहि मा चिरम् ॥ 7 ॥
3.3.m: The strong warrior said to his sister, "Fair one who desires victory! / What auspicious thing do you desire? Command it without delay!"

3.3.s:
sāha graiveyakaṃ hāraṃ maṇimuktāvibhūṣitam ..
matpriyaṃ dehi me vīra tathetyuktvā yayau gṛhāt .. 8 ..
3.3.d:
साह ग्रैवेयकं हारं मणिमुक्ताविभूषितम् ॥
मत्प्रियं देहि मे वीर तथेत्युक्त्वा ययौ गृहात् ॥ 8 ॥
3.3.m: She said, "Give me my cherished necklace adorned with gems and pearls, / O hero!" Saying "So be it," he went forth from the house.

3.3.s:
kāliyo lakṣaturagaiḥ saṃyutastvarito'gamat ..
prāpya gaṃgāṃ sāgaragāṃ kṛtvā snānaṃ vidhānataḥ .. 9 ..
3.3.d:
कालियो लक्षतुरगैः संयुतस्त्वरितोऽगमत् ॥
प्राप्य गंगां सागरगां कृत्वा स्नानं विधानतः ॥ 9 ॥
3.3.m: Accompanied by one hundred thousand horses, Kāliya swiftly set out. / Reaching the ocean-going Gaṅgā and performing his bath according to rite,

3.3.s:
dattvā dānāni viprebhyo jayacandrapurīṃ yayau ..
nirdhanaḥ samabhūdrājā bāhuśālī mahābalaḥ .. 3.3.8.10 ..
3.3.d:
दत्त्वा दानानि विप्रेभ्यो जयचन्द्रपुरीं ययौ ॥
निर्धनः समभूद्राजा बाहुशाली महाबलः ॥ 3.3.8.10 ॥
3.3.m: and giving gifts to the Brahmins, he went to the city of Jayacandra. / The king, strong-armed and mighty, had become impoverished;

3.3.s:
kānyakubje mahāhārau na prāpto bahumūlyakaḥ ..
tadorvīyādhipenaiva mahīśena prabodhitaḥ ..11..
3.3.d:
कान्यकुब्जे महाहारौ न प्राप्तो बहुमूल्यकः ॥
तदोर्वीयाधिपेनैव महीशेन प्रबोधितः ॥11॥
3.3.m: in Kānyakubja, two great necklaces of immense value were not to be obtained. / Then, prompted by the lord of the earth himself, the ruler of the realm,

3.3.s:
yayau mahāvatīṃ ramyāṃ śivadattavaro balī ..
rurodha nagarīṃ sarvāṃ śrutvā rājā bhayāturaḥ ..12..
3.3.d:
ययौ महावतीं रम्यां शिवदत्तवरो बली ॥
रुरोध नगरीं सर्वां श्रुत्वा राजा भयातुरः ॥12॥
3.3.m: the mighty warrior, endowed with the boon given by Śiva, went to lovely Mahāvatī. / He besieged the entire city; hearing this, the king, stricken with fear,

3.3.s:
rudraṃ kapardinaṃ śaṃbhuṃ śaraṇyaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayau ..
śivājñayā nṛpo dhīmānbalaiḥ ṣaṣṭisahasrakaiḥ .. 13 ..
3.3.d:
रुद्रं कपर्दिनं शंभुं शरण्यं शरणं ययौ ॥
शिवाज्ञया नृपो धीमान्बलैः षष्टिसहस्रकैः ॥ 13 ॥
3.3.m: went for refuge to Rudra, the matted-haired Sambhu, the refuge of all. / By Śiva's command, the wise king, with sixty thousand troops

3.3.s:
sārddhaṃ purādbahiryātastribhiḥ śūraiḥ surakṣitaḥ ..
tasya nāgāḥ sahasraṃ ca deśarājaśca tatpatiḥ .. 14 ..
3.3.d:
सार्द्धं पुराद्बहिर्यातस्त्रिभिः शूरैः सुरक्षितः ॥
तस्य नागाः सहस्रं च देशराजश्च तत्पतिः ॥ 14 ॥
3.3.m: and well-guarded by three heroes, marched out of the city. / His elephants were a thousand, and Deśarāja was their commander;

3.3.s:
hayāḥ ṣoḍaśasāhasrā vatsarājastu tatpatiḥ ..
śeṣāḥ padātayastasya tālanenaiva rakṣitāḥ .. 15 ..
pranaṣṭo mulaṃ yuddhaṃ teṣāṃ vīravarakṣayam ..7
3.3.d:
हयाः षोडशसाहस्रा वत्सराजस्तु तत्पतिः ॥
शेषाः पदातयस्तस्य तालनेनैव रक्षिताः ॥ 15 ॥
प्रनष्टो मुलं युद्धं तेषां वीरवरक्षयम् ॥7
3.3.m:
the horses were sixteen thousand, and Vatsarāja was their commander; / the rest were his foot-soldiers, protected indeed by Tālana.
A fierce battle began among them, causing the destruction of choice warriors;

3.3.s: ahorātrapramāṇena mahadghoramavartata .. 16 ..
3.3.d: अहोरात्रप्रमाणेन महद्घोरमवर्तत ॥ 16 ॥
3.3.m: for the duration of a day and night, it raged exceedingly terribly.

3.3.s:
te hatvā śātravīṃ senāṃ cakrurjayaravānmuhuḥ ..
bhayārtā nārmadeyāśca māhiṣmatinivāsinaḥ .. 17 ..
3.3.d:
ते हत्वा शात्रवीं सेनां चक्रुर्जयरवान्मुहुः ॥
भयार्ता नार्मदेयाश्च माहिष्मतिनिवासिनः ॥ 17 ॥
3.3.m: Having slain the enemy host, they raised shouts of victory again and again. / Stricken with fear, the people of the Narmadā, inhabitants of Māhiṣmatī,

3.3.s:
dudruvuḥ sarvato vipra dṛṣṭvā tānkāliyo nṛpaḥ ..
āśvāsya prayayau yuddhamarddhasainyasamanvitaḥ .. 18 ..
3.3.d:
दुद्रुवुः सर्वतो विप्र दृष्ट्वा तान्कालियो नृपः ॥
आश्वास्य प्रययौ युद्धमर्द्धसैन्यसमन्वितः ॥ 18 ॥
3.3.m: fled in every direction, O Brahmin. Seeing them, King Kāliya / comforted them and marched into battle accompanied by half his army.

3.3.s:
hṛdi kṛtvā mahādevaṃ mohanaṃ bāṇamādadhat ..
siddhamantraprabhāveṇa mohitāste babhūvire .. 19 ..
3.3.d:
हृदि कृत्वा महादेवं मोहनं बाणमादधत् ॥
सिद्धमन्त्रप्रभावेण मोहितास्ते बभूविरे ॥ 19 ॥
3.3.m: Holding Mahādeva in his heart, he fitted the stupefying arrow; / by the power of the perfected mantra, they became bewitched.

3.3.s:
śeṣāste śatravaḥ sarve ripughātāya saṃyayuḥ ..
alasāṃstānkapāleṣu jaghnuste bhayavarjitāḥ .. 3.3.8.20 ..
3.3.d:
शेषास्ते शत्रवः सर्वे रिपुघाताय संययुः ॥
अलसांस्तान्कपालेषु जघ्नुस्ते भयवर्जिताः ॥ 3.3.8.20 ॥
3.3.m: All the remaining enemies went forth to strike the foe; / devoid of fear, they struck those languid ones upon their heads.

3.3.s:
bhīṣmasiṃhastathā dṛṣṭvā bodhayāmāsa sainikān ..
sūryadattena bāṇena saṃjñākhyānena tatra vai .. .. 21 ..
3.3.d:
भीष्मसिंहस्तथा दृष्ट्वा बोधयामास सैनिकान् ॥
सूर्यदत्तेन बाणेन संज्ञाख्यानेन तत्र वै ॥ ॥ 21 ॥
3.3.m: Seeing this, Bhīṣmasiṃha revived the soldiers / there with the arrow named Saṃjñākhyāna, given by Sūrya.

3.3.s:
bhairavākhyena bhallena śatrudehamatāḍayat ..
mūrcchitaḥ so'patadvīro gajapṛṣṭhe śarārditaḥ .. 22 ..
3.3.d:
भैरवाख्येन भल्लेन शत्रुदेहमताडयत् ॥
मूर्च्छितः सोऽपतद्वीरो गजपृष्ठे शरार्दितः ॥ 22 ॥
3.3.m: With a broad-headed arrow named Bhairava, he struck the enemy's body. / Tormented by the arrows, that hero fell unconscious on the back of his elephant.

3.3.s:
tadā māhiṣmatī senā niryayau sā diśau daśa ..
muhūrtaṃ kaśmalaṃ prāpya punarutthāya kāliyaḥ .. 23 ..
3.3.d:
तदा माहिष्मती सेना निर्ययौ सा दिशौ दश ॥
मुहूर्तं कश्मलं प्राप्य पुनरुत्थाय कालियः ॥ 23 ॥
3.3.m: Then the army of Māhiṣmatī fled in the ten directions. / Overcome by faintness for a moment, Kāliya arose once more;

3.3.s:
bhallena tacchiraḥ kāyādapāharata bhūmipaḥ ..
hate tasminmahāvīrye tālanādyā mahā balāḥ .. 24 ..
3.3.d:
भल्लेन तच्छिरः कायादपाहरत भूमिपः ॥
हते तस्मिन्महावीर्ये तालनाद्या महा बलाः ॥ 24 ॥
3.3.m: with a broad-headed arrow, the king severed his head from his body. / When that hero of great valor was slain, the mighty Tālana and the others,

3.3.s:
kāliyaṃ te parājitya taṃ śatruṃ pratyaṣedhayan ..
mahākaṣṭānvito bhūpo dhyātvā manasi śaṃkaram .. 25 ..
3.3.d:
कालियं ते पराजित्य तं शत्रुं प्रत्यषेधयन् ॥
महाकष्टान्वितो भूपो ध्यात्वा मनसि शंकरम् ॥ 25 ॥
3.3.m: having defeated Kāliya, repelled that enemy. / In great distress, the king, meditating on Śaṅkara in his mind,

3.3.s:
mohayitvā ripūnsarvān yayau svaṃ niveśanam ..
arddhasainyena sahitā hataśeṣāstrayastathā .. 26 ..
3.3.d:
मोहयित्वा रिपून्सर्वान् ययौ स्वं निवेशनम् ॥
अर्द्धसैन्येन सहिता हतशेषास्त्रयस्तथा ॥ 26 ॥
3.3.m: bewitched all his enemies and went to his own abode, / as did the three survivors along with half the army.

3.3.s:
tadā parimalo rājā dṛṣṭvā śatruparājayam ..
pariṣvajya mahāvīrānsva gehaṃ punarāyayau .. 27 ..
3.3.d:
तदा परिमलो राजा दृष्ट्वा शत्रुपराजयम् ॥
परिष्वज्य महावीरान्स्व गेहं पुनराययौ ॥ 27 ॥
3.3.m: Then King Parimala, seeing the defeat of the enemy, / embraced the great heroes and returned to his house.

3.3.s:
jayacandrastu tacchutvā paraṃ vismayamāgataḥ ..
tālanaṃ ca samāhūya senādhīśamakarāyat .. 28 ..
3.3.d:
जयचन्द्रस्तु तच्छुत्वा परं विस्मयमागतः ॥
तालनं च समाहूय सेनाधीशमकरायत् ॥ 28 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing of this, Jayacandra was filled with great astonishment; / summoning Tālana, he appointed him commander of the army.

3.3.s:
bhīṣmasiṃhe gate loke paṃcamāsāntare nṛpe ..
tatpatnī janayāmāsa putraratnaṃ śubhānanam .. 29 ..
3.3.d:
भीष्मसिंहे गते लोके पंचमासान्तरे नृपे ॥
तत्पत्नी जनयामास पुत्ररत्नं शुभाननम् ॥ 29 ॥
3.3.m: When five months had passed after King Bhīṣmasiṃha departed to the [other] world, / his wife gave birth to an excellent jewel of a son with an auspicious face.

3.3.s:
sā tu gurjarabhūpasya tanayākhyā madālasā ..
divyaṃ putraṃ samālokya mumude sagaṇā bhṛśam .. 3.3.8.30 ..
3.3.d:
सा तु गुर्जरभूपस्य तनयाख्या मदालसा ॥
दिव्यं पुत्रं समालोक्य मुमुदे सगणा भृशम् ॥ 3.3.8.30 ॥
3.3.m: She, the daughter of the king of Gurjara named Madālasā, / seeing her divine son, rejoiced greatly together with her attendants.

3.3.s:
śrutvā tajjanma nṛpatirvitatāra dhanaṃ bahu ..
āhūya gaṇakānprājñāñjātakarma hyakārayat .. 31 ..
3.3.d:
श्रुत्वा तज्जन्म नृपतिर्विततार धनं बहु ॥
आहूय गणकान्प्राज्ञाञ्जातकर्म ह्यकारयत् ॥ 31 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing of his birth, the king distributed abundant wealth; / summoning wise astrologers, he had the birth-rites performed.

3.3.s:
sahadevāṃśa evāsau bhuvi jātaḥ śivājñayā ..
devasiṃhaḥ kṛto nāma gaṇakaiḥ śāstraciṃtakaiḥ .. 32 ..
3.3.d:
सहदेवांश एवासौ भुवि जातः शिवाज्ञया ॥
देवसिंहः कृतो नाम गणकैः शास्त्रचिंतकैः ॥ 32 ॥
3.3.m: He was an incarnation of a portion of Sahadeva, born on earth by Śiva's command. / The astrologers, scholars of the śāstras, gave him the name Devasiṃha.

3.3.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
kāliyaṃ tau parājitya bhrātarau nṛpasevakau ..
gatau gopālake rāṣṭre bhūpatirdalavāhanaḥ .. 1 ..
3.3.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
कालियं तौ पराजित्य भ्रातरौ नृपसेवकौ ॥
गतौ गोपालके राष्ट्रे भूपतिर्दलवाहनः ॥ 1 ॥
3.3.m: Sūta said: / Having defeated Kāliya, those two brothers, servants of the king, / went to the kingdom of Gopālaka, whose ruler was Dalavāhana.

3.3.s:
sahasracaṃḍikāhome nānābhūpasamāgame ..
gṛhītau mahiṣau tābhyāṃ bhūpairanyaiśca durjayau .. 2 ..
3.3.d:
सहस्रचंडिकाहोमे नानाभूपसमागमे ॥
गृहीतौ महिषौ ताभ्यां भूपैरन्यैश्च दुर्जयौ ॥ 2 ॥
3.3.m: At a Sahasra-Caṇḍikā homa, when various kings had assembled, / two buffaloes, invincible to the other kings, were seized by the two of them;

3.3.s:
pūrvaṃ hi nṛpakanyābhyāṃ pratyahaṃ baṃdhanaṃ gatau ..
tau saṃpūjya vidhānena dadau tābhyāṃ ca kanyake .. 3 ..
3.3.d:
पूर्वं हि नृपकन्याभ्यां प्रत्यहं बंधनं गतौ ॥
तौ संपूज्य विधानेन ददौ ताभ्यां च कन्यके ॥ 3 ॥
3.3.m: for previously they had daily been tied up by the king's two daughters. / Having honored them duly, [the king] gave the two maidens to them:

3.3.s:
devakīṃ deśarājāya brāhmīṃ tasyānujāya vai ..
dadau durgājñayā rājā rūpayauvanaśāli nīm .. 4 ..
3.3.d:
देवकीं देशराजाय ब्राह्मीं तस्यानुजाय वै ॥
ददौ दुर्गाज्ञया राजा रूपयौवनशालि नीम् ॥ 4 ॥
3.3.m: Devakī to Deśarāja, and Brāhmī to his younger brother, / the king gave by Durgā's command, maidens endowed with beauty and youth.

3.3.s:
lakṣāvṛttiṃ tathā veśyāṃ gītanṛtyaviśāradām ..
kanyayośca sakhīṃ ramyāṃ meghamallārarāgiṇīm .. 5 ..
3.3.d:
लक्षावृत्तिं तथा वेश्यां गीतनृत्यविशारदाम् ॥
कन्ययोश्च सखीं रम्यां मेघमल्लाररागिणीम् ॥ 5 ॥
3.3.m: [He gave] Lakṣāvṛtti, a courtesan skilled in song and dance, / a delightful friend to the two maidens, adept in the Meghamallāra melody,

3.3.s:
śataṃ gajānrathānpaṃca hayāṃścaiva sahasrakān ..
catvāriṃśacca śibikāḥ pradadau dalavāhanaḥ .. 6 ..
3.3.d:
शतं गजान्रथान्पंच हयांश्चैव सहस्रकान् ॥
चत्वारिंशच्च शिबिकाः प्रददौ दलवाहनः ॥ 6 ॥
3.3.m: a hundred elephants, five chariots, a thousand horses, / and forty palanquins did Dalavāhana give.

3.3.s:
bahudravyayutāṃ kanyāṃ dāsadāsīsamanvitām ..
udūhya vedavidhinā prāpatuśca mahāvatīm .. 7 ..
3.3.d:
बहुद्रव्ययुतां कन्यां दासदासीसमन्विताम् ॥
उदूह्य वेदविधिना प्रापतुश्च महावतीम् ॥ 7 ॥
3.3.m: Having married the maidens, accompanied by great wealth and servant men and women, / according to the Vedic rite, the two went to Mahāvatī.

3.3.s:
malanā tāṃ vadhūṃ dṛṣṭvā tasyai graiveyakaṃ dadau ..
brāhmyai ṣoḍaśaśṛṃgāraṃ tathā dvādaśabhūṣaṇam .. 8 ..
3.3.d:
मलना तां वधूं दृष्ट्वा तस्यै ग्रैवेयकं ददौ ॥
ब्राह्म्यै षोडशशृंगारं तथा द्वादशभूषणम् ॥ 8 ॥
3.3.m: Seeing that bride, Malanā gave her a necklace; / to Brāhmī she gave the sixteen embellishments and the twelve ornaments.

3.3.s:
rājā ca paramānandī deśarājāya śūriṇe ..
dadau daśapuraṃ ramyaṃ nānājananiṣevitam .. 9 ..
3.3.d:
राजा च परमानन्दी देशराजाय शूरिणे ॥
ददौ दशपुरं रम्यं नानाजननिषेवितम् ॥ 9 ॥
3.3.m: And the king, exceedingly delighted, gave the heroic Deśarāja / lovely Daśapura, frequented by diverse peoples.

3.3.s:
ūṣatustatra tau vīrau rājamānyau mahābalau ..
etasminnantare jāto devasiṃho harājñayā .. 3.3.9.10 ..
3.3.d:
ऊषतुस्तत्र तौ वीरौ राजमान्यौ महाबलौ ॥
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे जातो देवसिंहो हराज्ञया ॥ 3.3.9.10 ॥
3.3.m: The two heroes, highly esteemed by the king and possessed of great might, lived there. / In the meantime, Devasiṃha was born by the command of Hara.

3.3.s:
jāte tasminkumāre tu devakī garbhamādadhau ..
dāsaśrutā paterdevī suṣuve putramūrjitam .. 1 1..
3.3.d:
जाते तस्मिन्कुमारे तु देवकी गर्भमादधौ ॥
दासश्रुता पतेर्देवी सुषुवे पुत्रमूर्जितम् ॥ 1 1॥
3.3.m: When that boy was born, Devakī conceived; / the queen of the husband famed as a servant gave birth to an energetic son,

3.3.s:
gaurāṃgaṃ kamalākṣaṃ ca dīpyamānaṃ svatejasā ..
tadānaṃdamayo devaḥ śakraḥ suragaṇaiḥ saha .. 12 ..
3.3.d:
गौरांगं कमलाक्षं च दीप्यमानं स्वतेजसा ॥
तदानंदमयो देवः शक्रः सुरगणैः सह ॥ 12 ॥
3.3.m: fair-limbed, lotus-eyed, and blazing with his own splendor. / Then the god Śakra, filled with joy, together with the host of gods,

3.3.s:
śaṃkhaśabdaṃ cakāroccairjayaśabdaṃ punaḥpunaḥ ..
diśaḥ praphullitāścāsangrahāḥ sarve tathā divi .. 13 ..
3.3.d:
शंखशब्दं चकारोच्चैर्जयशब्दं पुनःपुनः ॥
दिशः प्रफुल्लिताश्चासन्ग्रहाः सर्वे तथा दिवि ॥ 13 ॥
3.3.m: sounded his conch loudly and uttered cries of victory again and again. / The directions blossomed, and so did all the planets in the sky.

3.3.s:
āyātā bahavo viprā vedaśāstraparāyaṇāḥ ..
cakruste jātakarmāsya nāmakarma tathāvidham .. 14 ..
3.3.d:
आयाता बहवो विप्रा वेदशास्त्रपरायणाः ॥
चक्रुस्ते जातकर्मास्य नामकर्म तथाविधम् ॥ 14 ॥
3.3.m: Many Brahmins devoted to the Vedas and śāstras arrived; / they performed his birth-rites and the naming-rites accordingly.

3.3.s:
rāmāṃśaṃ taṃ śiśuṃ jñātvā prasannavadanaṃ śubham ..
bhādrakṛṣṇatithau ṣaṣṭhyāṃ candravāre'ruṇodaye .. 15 ..
3.3.d:
रामांशं तं शिशुं ज्ञात्वा प्रसन्नवदनं शुभम् ॥
भाद्रकृष्णतिथौ षष्ठ्यां चन्द्रवारेऽरुणोदये ॥ 15 ॥
3.3.m: Knowing that child of bright and auspicious face to be a portion of Rāma, / on the sixth lunar day of the dark fortnight of Bhādrapada, on a Monday at dawn,

3.3.s:
saṃjātaḥ kṛttikābhe ca pitṛvaṃśayaśaskaraḥ ..
āhlādanāmnā hyabhavatpraśritaśca mahītale .. 16 ..
3.3.d:
संजातः कृत्तिकाभे च पितृवंशयशस्करः ॥
आह्लादनाम्ना ह्यभवत्प्रश्रितश्च महीतले ॥ 16 ॥
3.3.m: Born under the asterism Kṛttikā, he brought renown to his paternal lineage; / he was named Āhlāda, and he became obedient upon the earth.

3.3.s:
māsānte ca sute jāte brāhmī putramajījanat ..
dharmajāṃśaṃ tathā gauraṃ mahābāhuṃ suvakṣasam .. 17 ..
3.3.d:
मासान्ते च सुते जाते ब्राह्मी पुत्रमजीजनत् ॥
धर्मजांशं तथा गौरं महाबाहुं सुवक्षसम् ॥ 17 ॥
3.3.m: At the end of a month after the son was born, Brāhmī gave birth to a son / who was a portion of Dharma's son [Yudhiṣṭhira], fair-complexioned, with mighty arms and a broad chest.

3.3.s:
tadā ca brāhmaṇāḥ sarve dṛṣṭvā bālaṃ śubhānanam ..
prasannavadanaṃ cāruṃ padmacihnapadasthitam .. 18 ..
3.3.d:
तदा च ब्राह्मणाः सर्वे दृष्ट्वा बालं शुभाननम् ॥
प्रसन्नवदनं चारुं पद्मचिह्नपदस्थितम् ॥ 18 ॥
3.3.m: Then all the brāhmaṇas, seeing the boy with an auspicious face, / delightful countenance, handsome, bearing lotus marks upon his feet,

3.3.s:
tairdvijaiśca kṛto nāmnā balakhānirmahābalaḥ ..
varṣānte vatsaje jātaṃ mūlagaṃḍāntasaṃbhavaḥ .. 19 ..
3.3.d:
तैर्द्विजैश्च कृतो नाम्ना बलखानिर्महाबलः ॥
वर्षान्ते वत्सजे जातं मूलगंडान्तसंभवः ॥ 19 ॥
3.3.m: were given the name Balakhāni, possessed of great strength, by those twice-born ones. / At the year's end, born of Vatsarāja under the conjunction of Mūla and Gaṇḍānta,

3.3.s:
cāmuṇḍo devakisuto nijavaṃśabhayaṃkaraḥ ..
janitāraṃ tatastyājya ityūcurdvijasattamāḥ ..
na tatyāja sutaṃ rājā bālatve'pi dayāparaḥ .. 3.3.9.20 ..
3.3.d:
चामुण्डो देवकिसुतो निजवंशभयंकरः ॥
जनितारं ततस्त्याज्य इत्यूचुर्द्विजसत्तमाः ॥
न तत्याज सुतं राजा बालत्वेऽपि दयापरः ॥ 3.3.9.20 ॥
3.3.m: was Cāmuṇḍa, the son of Devakī, terrifying to his own family. / The best of the twice-born said, 'He must be abandoned by his progenitor.' / Yet the king, filled with compassion, did not abandon his son, though he was an infant.

3.3.s:
trivarṣāṃte gate tasminbalakhānau sute śubhe ..
śūdryāṃ jātaḥ śikhaṃḍayaṃśo rūpaṇo nāma viśrutaḥ .. 21 ..
3.3.d:
त्रिवर्षांते गते तस्मिन्बलखानौ सुते शुभे ॥
शूद्र्यां जातः शिखंडयंशो रूपणो नाम विश्रुतः ॥ 21 ॥
3.3.m: When three years had passed for that auspicious son Balakhāni, / there was born of a Śūdrā woman an incarnation of Śikhaṇḍin, renowned by the name Rūpaṇa.

3.3.s:
vatsarājo yayau deśe gurjare ca madālasām.
sa sutāṃ ca samādāya dine tasminsamāgataḥ .. 22 ..
3.3.d:
वत्सराजो ययौ देशे गुर्जरे च मदालसाम्।
स सुतां च समादाय दिने तस्मिन्समागतः ॥ 22 ॥
3.3.m: Vatsarāja went to the Gurjara country for Madālasā; / taking that daughter, he returned on that very day.

3.3.s:
prāpte tasminvatsarāje jambukaḥ svabalairvṛtaḥ ..
saptalakṣaiśca saṃprāpto bāhuśālī yateṃdriyaḥ .. 23 ..
3.3.d:
प्राप्ते तस्मिन्वत्सराजे जम्बुकः स्वबलैर्वृतः ॥
सप्तलक्षैश्च संप्राप्तो बाहुशाली यतेंद्रियः ॥ 23 ॥
3.3.m: When Vatsarāja arrived, Jambuka, surrounded by his own forces, / arrived with seven hundred thousand men, mighty-armed and self-controlled.

3.3.s:
rurodha nagarīṃ sarvāṃ rājñaḥ parimalasya vai ..
trilakṣaiśca māhāvatyai sārddhaṃ tau jagmatuḥ purāt .. 24 ..
3.3.d:
रुरोध नगरीं सर्वां राज्ञः परिमलस्य वै ॥
त्रिलक्षैश्च माहावत्यै सार्द्धं तौ जग्मतुः पुरात् ॥ 24 ॥
3.3.m: He besieged the entire city of King Parimala. / With three hundred thousand men, the two set forth from the city of Mahāvatī.

3.3.s:
māhiṣmataiḥ saptalakṣaiḥ sārddhaṃ yuddhamabhūnmahat ..
trirātraṃ dāruṇaṃ ghoraṃ yamarāṣṭravivarddhanam .. 25 ..
3.3.d:
माहिष्मतैः सप्तलक्षैः सार्द्धं युद्धमभून्महत् ॥
त्रिरात्रं दारुणं घोरं यमराष्ट्रविवर्द्धनम् ॥ 25 ॥
3.3.m: A great battle took place with the seven hundred thousand men of Māhiṣmatī; / it was dread and terrifying, lasting three nights, swelling the realm of Yama.

3.3.s:
śivasya varadānena bhrātrorjātaḥ parājayaḥ ..
baddhvā tau jambuko rājā luṃṭhayitvā mahāvatīm .. 26 ..
3.3.d:
शिवस्य वरदानेन भ्रात्रोर्जातः पराजयः ॥
बद्ध्वा तौ जम्बुको राजा लुंठयित्वा महावतीम् ॥ 26 ॥
3.3.m: By virtue of Śiva's boon, defeat befell the two brothers. / King Jambuka, having bound them both and plundered Mahāvatī,

3.3.s:
veśyāṃ lakṣāratiṃ tasya taṃ hataṃ tadgajaṃ tathā ..
graiveyakaṃ tathā hāraṃ maṇiratnavibhūṣitam .. 27 ..
3.3.d:
वेश्यां लक्षारतिं तस्य तं हतं तद्गजं तथा ॥
ग्रैवेयकं तथा हारं मणिरत्नविभूषितम् ॥ 27 ॥
3.3.m: and [taken] his courtesan Lakṣārati, killed that elephant of his, / and [taken] his necklace and string adorned with jewels and gems,

3.3.s:
gṛhītvā nagarīṃ sarvāṃ bhasmayitvā gṛhaṃ yayau ..
ye guptā bhūtale śūrāste śeṣāśca tadā'bhavan ..28 ..
3.3.d:
गृहीत्वा नगरीं सर्वां भस्मयित्वा गृहं ययौ ॥
ये गुप्ता भूतले शूरास्ते शेषाश्च तदाऽभवन् ॥28 ॥
3.3.m: took [them], burned the entire city to ashes, and departed for home. / The heroes who were hidden on earth alone remained at that time.

3.3.s:
durgeṣu yāni ratnāni tāni prāpya mudā yayau ..
luṃṭhite nagare tasmindevakī garbhamuttamam .. 29 ..
3.3.d:
दुर्गेषु यानि रत्नानि तानि प्राप्य मुदा ययौ ॥
लुंठिते नगरे तस्मिन्देवकी गर्भमुत्तमम् ॥ 29 ॥
3.3.m: Having obtained the jewels that were in the forts, he departed joyfully. / When that city was plundered, Devakī conceived an excellent womb,

3.3.s:
kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ saptamāsyaṃ hi cādadhāddaivatapriyā ..
jñātvā kulādhamaṃ putraṃ cāmuṃḍaṃ devakī satī .. 3.3.9.30 ..
3.3.d:
कृष्णांशं सप्तमास्यं हि चादधाद्दैवतप्रिया ॥
ज्ञात्वा कुलाधमं पुत्रं चामुंडं देवकी सती ॥ 3.3.9.30 ॥
3.3.m: for the beloved of the gods bore a portion of Kṛṣṇa for seven months. / The virtuous Devakī, knowing her son Cāmuṇḍa to be the disgrace of the family,

3.3.s:
kalpakṣetraṃ samāgamya kāliṃdyāṃ tamapātayat..
yojanānte gate tasmitmahīrājapurohitaḥ ..31..
3.3.d:
कल्पक्षेत्रं समागम्य कालिंद्यां तमपातयत्॥
योजनान्ते गते तस्मित्महीराजपुरोहितः ॥31॥
3.3.m: came to Kalpakṣetra and cast him into the Kālindī. / When a yojana had passed, the royal priest of Mahīrāja,

3.3.s:
sāmanto nāma taṃ gṛhya śvaśurālayamāyayau ..
jātastu daśamāsānte rātrau ghoratamovṛte .. 32 ..
3.3.d:
सामन्तो नाम तं गृह्य श्वशुरालयमाययौ ॥
जातस्तु दशमासान्ते रात्रौ घोरतमोवृते ॥ 32 ॥
3.3.m: named Sāmanta, took him and arrived at his father-in-law's house. / But at the end of ten months, in the night enveloped in pitch darkness,

3.3.s:
bhādrakṛṣṇāṣṭamīsaumye brāhmanakṣatrasaṃyute ..
prādurāsījjagannātho devakyāṃ ca mahottamaḥ .. 33 ..
3.3.d:
भाद्रकृष्णाष्टमीसौम्ये ब्राह्मनक्षत्रसंयुते ॥
प्रादुरासीज्जगन्नाथो देवक्यां च महोत्तमः ॥ 33 ॥
3.3.m: on the Bhādrapada dark aṣṭamī, a Wednesday joined with the brāhma asterism [Rohiṇī], / the Lord of the World, most supreme, manifested from Devakī.

3.3.s:
śyāmāṃgaḥ sa ca padmākṣa iṃdranīlamaṇidyutiḥ ..
vimānānāṃ sahasrāṇāṃ prakāśaḥ samajāyata .. 34 ..
3.3.d:
श्यामांगः स च पद्माक्ष इंद्रनीलमणिद्युतिः ॥
विमानानां सहस्राणां प्रकाशः समजायत ॥ 34 ॥
3.3.m: He was dark-limbed, lotus-eyed, with the lustre of a sapphire gem; / a radiance like that of a thousand celestial chariots came into being.

3.3.s:
vismitā jananī tatra dṛṣṭvā bālaṃ tamadbhutam ..
nagare ca mahāścaryaṃ jātaṃ sarve samāyayuḥ .. 35 ..
3.3.d:
विस्मिता जननी तत्र दृष्ट्वा बालं तमद्भुतम् ॥
नगरे च महाश्चर्यं जातं सर्वे समाययुः ॥ 35 ॥
3.3.m: The mother was astonished there, seeing that wondrous child. / A great marvel occurred in the city, and everyone gathered together.

3.3.s:
udayaḥ kimaho jāto devānāṃ sūryarūpakaḥ ..
ityāścaryyajujāṃ teṣāṃ vāguvācāśarīriṇī .. 36 ..
3.3.d:
उदयः किमहो जातो देवानां सूर्यरूपकः ॥
इत्याश्चर्य्यजुजां तेषां वागुवाचाशरीरिणी ॥ 36 ॥
3.3.m: 'Has there arisen a sun of the gods?' / As they were thus filled with wonder, a bodiless voice spoke:

3.3.s:
kṛṣṇāṃśo bhūtale jātaḥ sarvānandapradāyakaḥ ..
sa nāmnodayasiṃho hi sarvaśatruprakāśahā .. 37 ..
3.3.d:
कृष्णांशो भूतले जातः सर्वानन्दप्रदायकः ॥
स नाम्नोदयसिंहो हि सर्वशत्रुप्रकाशहा ॥ 37 ॥
3.3.m: 'A portion of Kṛṣṇa is born on earth, bestowing joy upon all. / Truly, he shall be named Udayasiṃha, the destroyer of the glory of all foes.'

3.3.s:
ityākāśavacaḥ śrutvā te paraṃ harṣa māyayuḥ ..
yasminkāle suto jātastadā ca malanā satī .. 38 ..
3.3.d:
इत्याकाशवचः श्रुत्वा ते परं हर्ष माययुः ॥
यस्मिन्काले सुतो जातस्तदा च मलना सती ॥ 38 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing this speech from the sky, they experienced supreme joy. / At the time the son was born, the virtuous Malanā then

3.3.s:
śyāmāṃgaṃ sundaraṃ bālaṃ sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitam ..
suṣuve paramodāraṃ phālgunāṃśaṃ śivājñayā .. 39 ..
3.3.d:
श्यामांगं सुन्दरं बालं सर्वलक्षणलक्षितम् ॥
सुषुवे परमोदारं फाल्गुनांशं शिवाज्ञया ॥ 39 ॥
3.3.m: gave birth, by the command of Śiva, to a dark-limbed, handsome boy marked with every auspicious sign, / exceedingly generous, a portion of Phālguna [Arjuna].

3.3.s:
tadā tu nagarī sarvā harṣabhūtā babhūva ha ..
ṣaṣṭhāhani sute jāte brahmānandaguṇākare .. 3.3.9.40 ..
3.3.d:
तदा तु नगरी सर्वा हर्षभूता बभूव ह ॥
षष्ठाहनि सुते जाते ब्रह्मानन्दगुणाकरे ॥ 3.3.9.40 ॥
3.3.m: Then indeed the entire city was filled with rejoicing. / On the sixth day after the son, a mine of the virtues of Brahman's bliss, was born,

3.3.s:
brāhmī tu suṣuve putraṃ pārṣadāṃśaṃ mahābalam ..
śyāmāṃgaṃ kamalākṣaṃ ca dṛḍhaskandhaṃ mahābhujam .. 41 ..
3.3.d:
ब्राह्मी तु सुषुवे पुत्रं पार्षदांशं महाबलम् ॥
श्यामांगं कमलाक्षं च दृढस्कन्धं महाभुजम् ॥ 41 ॥
3.3.m: Brāhmī gave birth to a son of great might, an incarnation of a divine attendant, / dark-limbed, lotus-eyed, with firm shoulders and mighty arms.

3.3.s:
brāhmaṇāśca tadāgatya jātakarma hyakārayan ..
sukhakhānirdvijairnāmnā kṛtastu gaṇakottamaiḥ .. 42 ..
3.3.d:
ब्राह्मणाश्च तदागत्य जातकर्म ह्यकारयन् ॥
सुखखानिर्द्विजैर्नाम्ना कृतस्तु गणकोत्तमैः ॥ 42 ॥
3.3.m: The brāhmaṇas arrived then and performed his birth rites; / he was named Sukhakhāni by the twice-born foremost among astrologers.

3.3.s:
krameṇa varddhitā bālāḥ sarvalokaśivaṃkarāḥ ..
teṣāṃ kālī mahacchreṣṭhā pitṛmātṛpriyaṃkarī .. 43 ..
3.3.d:
क्रमेण वर्द्धिता बालाः सर्वलोकशिवंकराः ॥
तेषां काली महच्छ्रेष्ठा पितृमातृप्रियंकरी ॥ 43 ॥
3.3.m: Gradually the boys grew, bringing auspiciousness to all the world; / superior among them was Kālī, who gave delight to his father and mother.

3.3.s:
tṛtīyābde vayaḥ prāpte kṛṣṇāṃśe balavattare ..
śakrastaddarśanakāṃkṣī hayārūḍho jagāma ha .. 44 ..
3.3.d:
तृतीयाब्दे वयः प्राप्ते कृष्णांशे बलवत्तरे ॥
शक्रस्तद्दर्शनकांक्षी हयारूढो जगाम ह ॥ 44 ॥
3.3.m: When the portion of Kṛṣṇa reached the age of three years and grew very strong, / Śakra, desiring to see him, rode on his horse and went there.

3.3.s:
krīḍansa candanāraṇye kṛṣṇāṃśo bhrātṛbhiḥ saha ..
nabhasthaṃ puruṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā sahasrākṣaṃ jahāsa vai .. 45 ..
3.3.d:
क्रीडन्स चन्दनारण्ये कृष्णांशो भ्रातृभिः सह ॥
नभस्थं पुरुषं दृष्ट्वा सहस्राक्षं जहास वै ॥ 45 ॥
3.3.m: While playing in the sandalwood forest with his brothers, / the portion of Kṛṣṇa, seeing the thousand-eyed one standing in the sky, laughed.

3.3.s:
aśvinī hariṇī divyā uccaiḥśravasamantike ..
gatvā garbhamupādāya svagehaṃ punarāyayau .. 46 ..
3.3.d:
अश्विनी हरिणी दिव्या उच्चैःश्रवसमन्तिके ॥
गत्वा गर्भमुपादाय स्वगेहं पुनराययौ ॥ 46 ॥
3.3.m: A divine mare went near Uccaiḥśravas, / and having conceived, returned once more to her abode.

3.3.s:
varṣāṃtare ca suṣuve kapotaṃ tanayaṃ śubham ..
pañcābdaṃ ca samāyāte vidyādhyanamāsthitāḥ .. 47 ..
3.3.d:
वर्षांतरे च सुषुवे कपोतं तनयं शुभम् ॥
पञ्चाब्दं च समायाते विद्याध्यनमास्थिताः ॥ 47 ॥
3.3.m: After a year, she gave birth to an auspicious colt named Kapota. / When they reached the age of five years, they applied themselves to the study of sciences.

3.3.s:
brāhmaṇaṃ śivaśarmāṇaṃ sarvavidyāviśāradam ..
svabhaktyā sevanaṃ kṛtvā te cakrurvedapāṭhikām .. 48 ..
3.3.d:
ब्राह्मणं शिवशर्माणं सर्वविद्याविशारदम् ॥
स्वभक्त्या सेवनं कृत्वा ते चक्रुर्वेदपाठिकाम् ॥ 48 ॥
3.3.m: Serving with devotion the brāhmaṇa Śivaśarman, who was skilled in all disciplines of knowledge, / they engaged in the recitation of the Vedas.

3.3.s:
aṣṭābde caiva kṛṣṇāṃśo nāmapatrādikāṃ kriyām ..
likhatāṃ bālakānāṃ ca kṛṣṇāṃśaḥ śreṣṭhatāmagāt .. 49 ..
3.3.d:
अष्टाब्दे चैव कृष्णांशो नामपत्रादिकां क्रियाम् ॥
लिखतां बालकानां च कृष्णांशः श्रेष्ठतामगात् ॥ 49 ॥
3.3.m: At the age of eight years, the portion of Kṛṣṇa, among the boys writing / in the practice of letters and the like, attained pre-eminence.

3.3.s:
sūta uvāca .. ..
navamābdaṃ vayaḥ prāpte kṛṣṇāṃśo balavattaraḥ ..
paṭhitvānvīkṣikīṃ vidyāṃ catuḥṣaṣṭikalāstathā .. 1 ..
3.3.d:
सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
नवमाब्दं वयः प्राप्ते कृष्णांशो बलवत्तरः ॥
पठित्वान्वीक्षिकीं विद्यां चतुःषष्टिकलास्तथा ॥ 1 ॥
3.3.m: Sūta said: / When the portion of Kṛṣṇa reached the age of nine years, being exceedingly strong, / having studied the science of logic and the sixty-four arts,

3.3.s:
dharmaśāstraṃ tathaivāpi sarvaśreṣṭhaṃ babhūva ha ..
tasminkāle bhṛguśreṣṭha mahīrājo nṛpottamaḥ .. 2 ..
3.3.d:
धर्मशास्त्रं तथैवापि सर्वश्रेष्ठं बभूव ह ॥
तस्मिन्काले भृगुश्रेष्ठ महीराजो नृपोत्तमः ॥ 2 ॥
3.3.m: as well as the treatises on dharma, he became the foremost of all. / At that time, O best of the Bhṛgus, the noble king Mahīrāja

3.3.s:
karārthaṃ preṣayāmāsa svasainyaṃ ca mahāvatīm ..
te vai lakṣaṃ mahāśūrāḥ sarvaśastrāstradhāriṇaḥ .. 3 ..
3.3.d:
करार्थं प्रेषयामास स्वसैन्यं च महावतीम् ॥
ते वै लक्षं महाशूराः सर्वशस्त्रास्त्रधारिणः ॥ 3 ॥
3.3.m: sent his army to Mahāvatī for the sake of tribute. / Those one hundred thousand great warriors, bearing all weapons and missiles,

3.3.s:
ūcuḥ parimalaṃ bhūpaṃ śṛṇu caṃdrakulodbhava ..
sarve ca bhārate varṣe ye rājāno mahābalāḥ .. 4 ..
3.3.d:
ऊचुः परिमलं भूपं शृणु चंद्रकुलोद्भव ॥
सर्वे च भारते वर्षे ये राजानो महाबलाः ॥ 4 ॥
3.3.m: said to King Parimala: 'Listen, O descendant of the lunar race! / All the mighty kings in the land of Bhārata

3.3.s:
ṣaḍaṃśaṃ karamādāyāsmadrājāya dadaṃti vai ..
bhavānkare hi tasyaiva yogyo bhavati sāṃpratam .. 5..
3.3.d:
षडंशं करमादायास्मद्राजाय ददंति वै ॥
भवान्करे हि तस्यैव योग्यो भवति सांप्रतम् ॥ 5॥
3.3.m: take a one-sixth tribute and pay it to our king. / You too are now subject to his tribute.

3.3.s:
adyaprabhṛti cedrājñe tasmai dadyātkaraṃ na hi ..
mahīrājasya raudrāstraiḥ kṣayaṃ yāsyati sainikaiḥ .. 6 ..
3.3.d:
अद्यप्रभृति चेद्राज्ञे तस्मै दद्यात्करं न हि ॥
महीराजस्य रौद्रास्त्रैः क्षयं यास्यति सैनिकैः ॥ 6 ॥
3.3.m: If from this day forth you do not pay tribute to that king, / you shall meet destruction at the hands of Mahīrāja's soldiers with dread weapons.

3.3.s:
ye bhūpā jayacaṃdrasya pakṣagāste hi tadbhayāt ..
dadaṃte bhūmirājāya daṃḍaṃ tanmānasatkṛtāḥ .. 7 ..
3.3.d:
ये भूपा जयचंद्रस्य पक्षगास्ते हि तद्भयात् ॥
ददंते भूमिराजाय दंडं तन्मानसत्कृताः ॥ 7 ॥
3.3.m: Those kings who side with Jayacandra, through fear of him, / pay tribute to Bhūmirāja, being respected in their minds.'

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā sa nṛpatistasmai rājñe mahātmane..
karaṃ ṣaḍaṃśamādāya dadau prītisamanvitaḥ .. 8 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा स नृपतिस्तस्मै राज्ञे महात्मने॥
करं षडंशमादाय ददौ प्रीतिसमन्वितः ॥ 8 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing this, that king, taking a one-sixth tribute, / gave it to that great-souled king, filled with goodwill.

3.3.s:
daśalakṣamitaṃ dravyaṃ gṛhītvā te samāyayuḥ ..
mahīrājaḥ prasannātmā pūrvavairamapāharat .. 9 ..
3.3.d:
दशलक्षमितं द्रव्यं गृहीत्वा ते समाययुः ॥
महीराजः प्रसन्नात्मा पूर्ववैरमपाहरत् ॥ 9 ॥
3.3.m: Taking wealth to the amount of one million, they returned. / Mahīrāja, his mind appeased, cast aside the former enmity.

3.3.s:
tadā te lakṣaśūrāśca kānyakubjamupāyayuḥ ..
jayacaṃdraṃ tu natvocuḥ śṛṇu lakṣaṇakovida .. 3.3.10.10 ..
3.3.d:
तदा ते लक्षशूराश्च कान्यकुब्जमुपाययुः ॥
जयचंद्रं तु नत्वोचुः शृणु लक्षणकोविद ॥ 3.3.10.10 ॥
3.3.m: Then those hundred thousand warriors went to Kānyakubja. / Bowing before Jayacandra, they said: “Listen, expert in marks [of majesty]!

3.3.s:
pṛthvīrājo mahārājo daṃḍaṃ tvattaḥ samicchati ..
ityuktastairvaiṣṇavāstrī lakṣaṇastānuvāca ha .. 11 ..
3.3.d:
पृथ्वीराजो महाराजो दंडं त्वत्तः समिच्छति ॥
इत्युक्तस्तैर्वैष्णवास्त्री लक्षणस्तानुवाच ह ॥ 11 ॥
3.3.m: Great King Pṛthvīrāja demands tribute from you.” / Thus spoken to by them, Lakṣaṇa, master of the Vaiṣṇava missile, said to them:

3.3.s:
maddeśe maṃḍalīkāśca bahavaḥ saṃti sāṃpratam ..
bhūmirājo māṃḍaliko mayi jīvati mā bhavet .. 12 ..
3.3.d:
मद्देशे मंडलीकाश्च बहवः संति सांप्रतम् ॥
भूमिराजो मांडलिको मयि जीवति मा भवेत् ॥ 12 ॥
3.3.m: “In my realm there are many feudatory rulers at present. / Bhūmirāja shall not be my feudatory while I live!”

3.3.s:
ityuktvā vaiṣṇavāstraṃ tānkruddhaḥ sa ca samādadhat ..
tadastrajvālataḥ sarve bhayabhītā pradudruvuḥ .. 13 ..
3.3.d:
इत्युक्त्वा वैष्णवास्त्रं तान्क्रुद्धः स च समादधत् ॥
तदस्त्रज्वालतः सर्वे भयभीता प्रदुद्रुवुः ॥ 13 ॥
3.3.m: Having spoken thus, enraged, he hurled the Vaiṣṇava weapon at them. / From the fire of that weapon, terrified, they all fled.

3.3.s:
mahīrājastu tacchrutvā mahadbhayamupāgamat ..
daśābdaṃ ca vayaḥ prāpte kṛṣṇāṃśe mallakovide .. 14 ..
3.3.d:
महीराजस्तु तच्छ्रुत्वा महद्भयमुपागमत् ॥
दशाब्दं च वयः प्राप्ते कृष्णांशे मल्लकोविदे ॥ 14 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing of that, Mahīrāja experienced great fear. / When Kṛṣṇāṃśa, expert in wrestling, reached the age of ten years,

3.3.s:
nānāmallāḥ samājagmustena rājñaiva satkṛtāḥ ..
teṣāṃ madhye sa kṛṣṇāṃśo bāhuśālī babhūva ha .. 15 ..
3.3.d:
नानामल्लाः समाजग्मुस्तेन राज्ञैव सत्कृताः ॥
तेषां मध्ये स कृष्णांशो बाहुशाली बभूव ह ॥ 15 ॥
3.3.m: various wrestlers arrived, honoured by the king himself. / In their midst that mighty-armed Kṛṣṇāṃśa stood supreme.

3.3.s:
urvīyādhipateḥ putraḥ ṣoḍaśābdavayā balī ..
śatamallaiśca sahitaḥ kadācitsa samāgataḥ .. 16 ..
3.3.d:
उर्वीयाधिपतेः पुत्रः षोडशाब्दवया बली ॥
शतमल्लैश्च सहितः कदाचित्स समागतः ॥ 16 ॥
3.3.m: The son of the ruler of Urvīyā, mighty and sixteen years of age, / once arrived accompanied by a hundred wrestlers.

3.3.s:
pitṛṣvasṛpatiṃ bhūpaṃ natvā nāmnā'bhayo balī ..
uvāca śṛṇu bhūpāla kṛṣṇo'yaṃ madamattaraḥ .. 17 ..
3.3.d:
पितृष्वसृपतिं भूपं नत्वा नाम्नाऽभयो बली ॥
उवाच शृणु भूपाल कृष्णोऽयं मदमत्तरः ॥ 17 ॥
3.3.m: Bowing to the king, the husband of his father's sister, the mighty youth named Abhaya / said: “Listen, O protector of the earth! This Kṛṣṇa is exceedingly haughty.

3.3.s:
tena sārddhaṃ bhavenmallayuddhaṃ mama nṛpottama ..
iti vajrasamaṃ vākyaṃ śrutvā rājā bhayāturaḥ .. 10 ..
3.3.d:
तेन सार्द्धं भवेन्मल्लयुद्धं मम नृपोत्तम ॥
इति वज्रसमं वाक्यं श्रुत्वा राजा भयातुरः ॥ 10 ॥
3.3.m: Let there be a wrestling match between him and me, O best of kings!” / Hearing these words resembling a thunderbolt, the king, anxious with fear,

3.3.s:
uvāca śyālajaṃ premṇā bhavānyuddhaviśāradaḥ ..
aṣṭābdo'yaṃ sutaḥ snigdho mama prāṇasamo bhuvi .. 19 ..
3.3.d:
उवाच श्यालजं प्रेम्णा भवान्युद्धविशारदः ॥
अष्टाब्दोऽयं सुतः स्निग्धो मम प्राणसमो भुवि ॥ 19 ॥
3.3.m: spoke with love to his brother-in-law's son: “You are skilled in combat. / This boy is only eight years old, dear and equal to my life on earth.

3.3.s:
kva bhavānvajrasadṛśaḥ kva suto'yaṃ sukomalaḥ ..
anyairmallairmadīyaiśca sārddhaṃ yogyo bhavānraṇe ..3.3.10.20..
3.3.d:
क्व भवान्वज्रसदृशः क्व सुतोऽयं सुकोमलः ॥
अन्यैर्मल्लैर्मदीयैश्च सार्द्धं योग्यो भवान्रणे ॥3.3.10.20॥
3.3.m: Where are you, like a thunderbolt, and where this tender child? / You are suited to fight in battle with other wrestlers of mine.”

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā nṛpaḥ syālo mahīpatiriti smṛtaḥ ..
sa tamāha ruṣāviṣṭo bālo'yaṃ balavattaraḥ .. 21 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा नृपः स्यालो महीपतिरिति स्मृतः ॥
स तमाह रुषाविष्टो बालोऽयं बलवत्तरः ॥ 21 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing this, the king, his brother-in-law known as Mahīpati, / filled with anger, said to him: “This boy is remarkably strong.

3.3.s:
śṛṇu tatkāraṇaṃ bhūpa yathā jñāto mayā śiśuḥ ..
āgaskṛtaṃ mahīrājaṃ matvā satilakaḥ sutam .. 22 ..
3.3.d:
शृणु तत्कारणं भूप यथा ज्ञातो मया शिशुः ॥
आगस्कृतं महीराजं मत्वा सतिलकः सुतम् ॥ 22 ॥
3.3.m: Hear the reason, O king, how this child became known to me. / Considering that Mahīrāja had committed an offense, having marked his son with the tilaka,

3.3.s:
paṃḍitāṃśca samāhūya muhūrtaṃ pṛṣṭavānmudā ..
gaṇeśo nāma matimāñjyotiśśāstraviśāradaḥ .. 23 ..
3.3.d:
पंडितांश्च समाहूय मुहूर्तं पृष्टवान्मुदा ॥
गणेशो नाम मतिमाञ्ज्योतिश्शास्त्रविशारदः ॥ 23 ॥
3.3.m: he called the learned scholars and gladly asked for an auspicious moment. / The wise Gaṇeśa, an expert in the science of astrology,

3.3.s:
lakṣaṇaṃ vacanaṃ prāha mahīrājamanuttamam ..
śivadattavaro rājankubera iva sāṃpratam .. 24 ..
3.3.d:
लक्षणं वचनं प्राह महीराजमनुत्तमम् ॥
शिवदत्तवरो राजन्कुबेर इव सांप्रतम् ॥ 24 ॥
3.3.m: spoke this supreme word concerning the marks of Mahīrāja: / ‘O king, having received a boon from Śiva, he is now like Kubera.

3.3.s:
kṛṣṇāṃśastasya yogyo'yaṃ deśarājasuto'varaḥ ..
nānyo'sti bhūtale rājansatyaṃ satyaṃ bravīmyaham ... 25 ..
3.3.d:
कृष्णांशस्तस्य योग्योऽयं देशराजसुतोऽवरः ॥
नान्योऽस्ति भूतले राजन्सत्यं सत्यं ब्रवीम्यहम् ॥। 25 ॥
3.3.m: Kṛṣṇāṃśa, the younger son of Deśarāja, is worthy of him; / there is no other on the surface of the earth, O king; I speak the absolute truth.’

3.3.s:
tacchrutvā lakṣaṇo vīraḥ pūrve barhiṣmatīṃ prati ..
kalpakṣetraṃ dakṣiṇe ca bhūmigrāmaṃ tu paścime .. 26 ..
3.3.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा लक्षणो वीरः पूर्वे बर्हिष्मतीं प्रति ॥
कल्पक्षेत्रं दक्षिणे च भूमिग्रामं तु पश्चिमे ॥ 26 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing that, the heroic Lakṣaṇa established his kingdom / towards Barhiṣmatī in the east, Kalpakṣetra in the south,

3.3.s:
uttare naimiṣāraṇyaṃ svakīyaṃ rāṣṭramādadhat ..
ataḥ śreṣṭhaḥ kumāro'yaṃ kānyakubje mayā śrutaḥ .. 27 ..
3.3.d:
उत्तरे नैमिषारण्यं स्वकीयं राष्ट्रमादधत् ॥
अतः श्रेष्ठः कुमारोऽयं कान्यकुब्जे मया श्रुतः ॥ 27 ॥
3.3.m: Bhūmigrāma in the west, and the Naimiṣa forest in the north. / Hence I heard of this eminent prince in Kānyakubja.

3.3.s:
nāgotsave ca bhūpāla paṃcamyāṃ ca nabhassite ..
dṛśyamātraṃ kumārāṃgaṃ tasmādyogyo hyayaṃ sutaḥ .. 28 ..
3.3.d:
नागोत्सवे च भूपाल पंचम्यां च नभस्सिते ॥
दृश्यमात्रं कुमारांगं तस्माद्योग्यो ह्ययं सुतः ॥ 28 ॥
3.3.m: And on the Nāga festival, O ruler of the earth, on the fifth day of the bright half of Śrāvaṇa, / the prince's body was merely to be seen; therefore this son is worthy indeed.”

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā sa kṛṣṇāṃśo vākchareṇa prapīḍitaḥ.
abhayaṃ bhujayoḥ śīghraṃ gṛhītvā so'yudhadbalī .. 29 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा स कृष्णांशो वाक्छरेण प्रपीडितः।
अभयं भुजयोः शीघ्रं गृहीत्वा सोऽयुधद्बली ॥ 29 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing this, Kṛṣṇāṃśa, pierced by that arrow of words, / quickly seized Abhaya by the arms, and the mighty boy fought.

3.3.s:
kṣaṇamātraṃ raṇaṃ kṛtvā bhūmimadhye tamakṣipat ..
abhayasya bhujo bhagnastatra jāto balena vai .. 3.3.10.30 ..
3.3.d:
क्षणमात्रं रणं कृत्वा भूमिमध्ये तमक्षिपत् ॥
अभयस्य भुजो भग्नस्तत्र जातो बलेन वै ॥ 3.3.10.30 ॥
3.3.m: Fighting for just a moment, he hurled him to the ground; / indeed, Abhaya's arm was broken then by his strength.

3.3.s:
mūrcchitaṃ svasutaṃ jñātvā khaḍgahasto mahīpatiḥ ..
preṣayāmāsa tānmallānkṛṣṇāṃśasya prahāraṇe .. 31 ..
3.3.d:
मूर्च्छितं स्वसुतं ज्ञात्वा खड्गहस्तो महीपतिः ॥
प्रेषयामास तान्मल्लान्कृष्णांशस्य प्रहारणे ॥ 31 ॥
3.3.m: Seeing his son unconscious, Mahīpati, sword in hand, / dispatched those wrestlers to strike Kṛṣṇāṃśa.

3.3.s:
ruṣāviṣṭāṃśca tāñjñātvā kṛṣṇāṃśo balavattaraḥ ..
tānekaikaṃ samākṣipya vijayī sa babhūva ha .. 32 ..
3.3.d:
रुषाविष्टांश्च ताञ्ज्ञात्वा कृष्णांशो बलवत्तरः ॥
तानेकैकं समाक्षिप्य विजयी स बभूव ह ॥ 32 ॥
3.3.m: Perceiving them overcome with wrath, the exceedingly mighty Kṛṣṇāṃśa / threw down each one of them and emerged victorious.

3.3.s:
parājite mallabale khaḍgahasto mahīpatiḥ ..
maraṇāya matiṃ cakre kṛṣṇāṃśasya prabhāvataḥ ..33..
3.3.d:
पराजिते मल्लबले खड्गहस्तो महीपतिः ॥
मरणाय मतिं चक्रे कृष्णांशस्य प्रभावतः ॥33॥
3.3.m: When the army of wrestlers was defeated, Mahīpati, sword in hand, / resolved to slay Kṛṣṇāṃśa because of his power.

3.3.s:
jñātvā tamīdṛśaṃ bhūpaṃ vārayāmāsa bhūpatiḥ ..
abhayaṃ nīrujaṃ kṛtvā premṇā gehamavāsayat .. 34 ..
3.3.d:
ज्ञात्वा तमीदृशं भूपं वारयामास भूपतिः ॥
अभयं नीरुजं कृत्वा प्रेम्णा गेहमवासयत् ॥ 34 ॥
3.3.m: Seeing that king behaving in this way, the protector of the earth stopped him. / Making Abhaya free from injury, he settled him in his house with affection.

3.3.s:
navābdāṃge ca kṛṣṇāṃśe cāhlādādyāḥ kumārakāḥ..
mṛgayārthe dadhuścittaṃ tamūcurbhūpatiṃ priyam ..35..
3.3.d:
नवाब्दांगे च कृष्णांशे चाह्लादाद्याः कुमारकाः॥
मृगयार्थे दधुश्चित्तं तमूचुर्भूपतिं प्रियम् ॥35॥
3.3.m: When Kṛṣṇāṃśa was nine years old, Āhlāda and the other princes / turned their minds to hunting, and they spoke to that beloved ruler of the earth:

3.3.s:
namaste tāta bhūpāgrya sarvānaṃdapradāyaka ..
asmabhyaṃ tvaṃ hayāndehi matpriyānkaruṇākara .. 36 ..
3.3.d:
नमस्ते तात भूपाग्र्य सर्वानंदप्रदायक ॥
अस्मभ्यं त्वं हयान्देहि मत्प्रियान्करुणाकर ॥ 36 ॥
3.3.m: “Obeisance to you, father, foremost of earth-protectors, bestower of joy upon all! / O compassionate one, grant us our favorite horses.”

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā vacasteṣāṃ tathetyuktvā mahīpatiḥ ..
bhūtale vāsino'śvānvai divyānrāṭ caturo varān .. 37 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा वचस्तेषां तथेत्युक्त्वा महीपतिः ॥
भूतले वासिनोऽश्वान्वै दिव्यान्राट् चतुरो वरान् ॥ 37 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing their words, the king, saying “So be it,” / the king, filled with joy, gave them four excellent divine steeds

3.3.s:
dadau tebhyo mudā yukto hariṇīgarbhasaṃbhavān ..
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ ..
tvanmukhena śrutaṃ sūta hariṇī vaḍavā yathā..38 ..
3.3.d:
ददौ तेभ्यो मुदा युक्तो हरिणीगर्भसंभवान् ॥
ऋषय ऊचुः ॥
त्वन्मुखेन श्रुतं सूत हरिणी वडवा यथा॥38 ॥
3.3.m: dwelling on the earth, born from the womb of the mare Hariṇī. / The sages said: / “From your mouth, O Sūta, it was heard how the mare Hariṇī

3.3.s:
bhīṣmasiṃhāya saṃprāptā śakrāddeveśato mune ..
idānīṃ śrotumicchāmaḥ kuto jātāsturaṃgamāḥ .. 39 ..
3.3.d:
भीष्मसिंहाय संप्राप्ता शक्राद्देवेशतो मुने ॥
इदानीं श्रोतुमिच्छामः कुतो जातास्तुरंगमाः ॥ 39 ॥
3.3.m: was obtained by Bhīṣmasiṃha from Śakra, the lord of the gods, O sage. / Now we wish to hear from where those horses were born,

3.3.s:
divyāṃgā bhūṣaṇāpannā nabhassalilagāminaḥ ..
.. sūta uvāca ..
deśarājena bhūpena purā dharmayutena vai..3.3.10.40..
3.3.d:
दिव्यांगा भूषणापन्ना नभस्सलिलगामिनः ॥
॥ सूत उवाच ॥
देशराजेन भूपेन पुरा धर्मयुतेन वै॥3.3.10.40॥
3.3.m: possessing celestial forms, adorned with ornaments, traversing both the sky and water.” / Sūta said: / “Formerly by the king Deśarāja, endowed with righteousness,

3.3.s:
sevanaṃ bhāskarasyaiva kṛtaṃ ca dvādaśābdikam ..
sevānte bhagavānsūryo varaṃ brūhi tamabravīt.. .. 41 ..
3.3.d:
सेवनं भास्करस्यैव कृतं च द्वादशाब्दिकम् ॥
सेवान्ते भगवान्सूर्यो वरं ब्रूहि तमब्रवीत्॥ ॥ 41 ॥
3.3.m: service was rendered to the Sun for twelve years. / At the end of his service, the blessed Sun said to him: ‘Ask for a boon!’

3.3.s:
prāha deva namastubhyaṃ yadi deyo varastvayā ..
hayaṃ divyamayaṃ dehi nabhasthalajalātigam .. 42 ..
3.3.d:
प्राह देव नमस्तुभ्यं यदि देयो वरस्त्वया ॥
हयं दिव्यमयं देहि नभस्थलजलातिगम् ॥ 42 ॥
3.3.m: He said: ‘O Lord, obeisance to you! If a boon is to be granted by you, / give me a divine horse capable of traversing the sky and water.’

3.3.s:
tathetyuktvā raviḥ sākṣāddadau tasmai papihakam ..
lokānpāti papīrjñeyastasyedaṃ nāma cottamam .. 43 ..
3.3.d:
तथेत्युक्त्वा रविः साक्षाद्ददौ तस्मै पपिहकम् ॥
लोकान्पाति पपीर्ज्ञेयस्तस्येदं नाम चोत्तमम् ॥ 43 ॥
3.3.m: Saying “So be it,” the Sun visibly gave him Papihaka. / One who protects the worlds is known as Papī; this is his supreme name.

3.3.s:
ataḥ papīhako nāma lokapālanakarmavān ..
sa hayo madamattaśca hariṇīṃ divyarūpiṇīm .. 44 ..
3.3.d:
अतः पपीहको नाम लोकपालनकर्मवान् ॥
स हयो मदमत्तश्च हरिणीं दिव्यरूपिणीम् ॥ 44 ॥
3.3.m: Hence he was named Papīhaka, having the role of protecting the world. / That impassioned horse, driven by the urge of desire,

3.3.s:
bubhuje smaravegena tasyāṃ jātāsturaṃgamāḥ ..
manorathaśca pītāṃgaḥ karālaḥ kṛṣṇarūpakaḥ .. 45 ..
3.3.d:
बुभुजे स्मरवेगेन तस्यां जातास्तुरंगमाः ॥
मनोरथश्च पीतांगः करालः कृष्णरूपकः ॥ 45 ॥
3.3.m: coupled with Hariṇī of divine form; from her the horses were born: / Manoratha of yellow body, Karāla of black form,

3.3.s:
ekagarbhe samudbhūtau śaibyasugrīvakāṃśakau ..
yasmindine samudbhūtau jiṣṇuviṣṇukalāṃśataḥ .. 6 ..
3.3.d:
एकगर्भे समुद्भूतौ शैब्यसुग्रीवकांशकौ ॥
यस्मिन्दिने समुद्भूतौ जिष्णुविष्णुकलांशतः ॥ 6 ॥
3.3.m: the two born from one womb, portions of Śaibya and Sugrīva. / On the day those two were born from parts of the portions of Jiṣṇu and Viṣṇu,

3.3.s:
tadā jātau hariṇyāśca meghapuṣpabalāhakau ..
bindulaśca suvarṇāṃgaḥ śvetāṃgo harināgaraḥ.. 47 ..
3.3.d:
तदा जातौ हरिण्याश्च मेघपुष्पबलाहकौ ॥
बिन्दुलश्च सुवर्णांगः श्वेतांगो हरिनागरः॥ 47 ॥
3.3.m: there were then born from Hariṇī Meghapuṣpa and Balāhaka, / and Bindula of golden body, and Harināgara of white body.

3.3.s:
divyāṃgāste hi catvāraḥ pūrvaṃ jātā mahābalāḥ ..
paścādaṃśāvatārāśca jātāsteṣāṃ mahātmanām .. 48 ..
3.3.d:
दिव्यांगास्ते हि चत्वारः पूर्वं जाता महाबलाः ॥
पश्चादंशावताराश्च जातास्तेषां महात्मनाम् ॥ 48 ॥
3.3.m: Those four of celestial bodies were born first, possessed of great strength; / afterwards, partial incarnations of those great souls were born.

3.3.s:
iti te kathitaṃ vipra śṛṇu tatra kathāṃ śubhām ..
bhūtale te hayāḥ sarve prāptāścoparibhūmigāḥ .. 49 ..
3.3.d:
इति ते कथितं विप्र शृणु तत्र कथां शुभाम् ॥
भूतले ते हयाः सर्वे प्राप्ताश्चोपरिभूमिगाः ॥ 49 ॥
3.3.m: Thus it has been related to you, O brāhmaṇa; listen now to that auspicious story. / All those horses, though traversing upper realms, were obtained on earth.

3.3.s:
devasiṃhāya baline dadau cāśvaṃ manoratham ..
āhlādāya karālaṃ ca kṛṣṇāṃśāyaiva bindulam .. 3.3.10.50 ..
3.3.d:
देवसिंहाय बलिने ददौ चाश्वं मनोरथम् ॥
आह्लादाय करालं च कृष्णांशायैव बिन्दुलम् ॥ 3.3.10.50 ॥
3.3.m: To the mighty Devasiṃha he gave the horse Manoratha, / to Āhlāda, Karāla, and to Kṛṣṇāṃśa, Bindula.

3.3.s:
brahmānaṃdāya putrāya pradadau harināgaram ..
te catvāro hayārūḍhā mṛgayārthaṃ vanaṃ yayuḥ .. 51 ..
3.3.d:
ब्रह्मानंदाय पुत्राय प्रददौ हरिनागरम् ॥
ते चत्वारो हयारूढा मृगयार्थं वनं ययुः ॥ 51 ॥
3.3.m: To his son Brahmānanda he gave Harināgara. / Mounted on their horses, the four went to the forest for hunting.

3.3.s:
hariṇīṃ vaḍavāṃ śubhrāṃ balakhāniḥ samāruhat ..
tadanu prayayau vīro vanaṃ siṃhaniṣevitam .. 52 ..
3.3.d:
हरिणीं वडवां शुभ्रां बलखानिः समारुहत् ॥
तदनु प्रययौ वीरो वनं सिंहनिषेवितम् ॥ 52 ॥
3.3.m: Balakhāni mounted the white mare Hariṇī. / Thereupon that hero went toward the forest frequented by lions.

3.3.s:
āhlādenaiva śārdūlo hataḥ prāṇibhayaṃkaraḥ ..
devasiṃhena siṃhaśca sūkaro balakhāninā .. 53 ..
3.3.d:
आह्लादेनैव शार्दूलो हतः प्राणिभयंकरः ॥
देवसिंहेन सिंहश्च सूकरो बलखानिना ॥ 53 ॥
3.3.m: Āhlāda killed a tiger that terrified living beings, / and Devasiṃha [killed] a lion, and Balakhāni a boar.

3.3.s:
