brahmānaṃdena hariṇo hatastatra mahāvane ..
mṛgāḥ śataṃ hatāstaiśca tāngṛhītvā gṛhaṃ yayuḥ .. 54 ..
3.3.d:
ब्रह्मानंदेन हरिणो हतस्तत्र महावने ॥
मृगाः शतं हतास्तैश्च तान्गृहीत्वा गृहं ययुः ॥ 54 ॥
3.3.m: Brahmānanda killed a deer there in the great forest; / and they killed a hundred beasts, took them, and went home.

3.3.s:
etasminnaṃtare devī śāradā ca śubhānanā ..
mṛgī svarṇamayī bhūtvā teṣāmagre pradhāvitā ..55..
3.3.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे देवी शारदा च शुभानना ॥
मृगी स्वर्णमयी भूत्वा तेषामग्रे प्रधाविता ॥55॥
3.3.m: Meanwhile, the goddess Śāradā of auspicious face, / having turned into a golden doe, ran before them.

3.3.s:
dṛṣṭvā tāṃ mohitāḥ sarve svaiḥ svairbāṇairatāḍayan ..
śarāstu saṃkṣayaṃ jagmurmṛgyaṃge balavattarāḥ ..56..
3.3.d:
दृष्ट्वा तां मोहिताः सर्वे स्वैः स्वैर्बाणैरताडयन् ॥
शरास्तु संक्षयं जग्मुर्मृग्यंगे बलवत्तराः ॥56॥
3.3.m: Seeing her, they were all enchanted and struck her with their various arrows; / but the very mighty arrows perished upon the body of the doe.

3.3.s:
āhlādādyāśca te śūrā vismitāśca babhūvire ..
tasminkāle sa kṛṣṇāṃgo bāṇenaiva hyatāḍayat ..57..
3.3.d:
आह्लादाद्याश्च ते शूरा विस्मिताश्च बभूविरे ॥
तस्मिन्काले स कृष्णांगो बाणेनैव ह्यताडयत् ॥57॥
3.3.m: Āhlāda and those other heroes were astonished. / At that time Kṛṣṇāṅga struck her with an arrow.

3.3.s:
tadā ca pīḍitā devī bhayabhītā yayau vanam ..
kṛṣṇāṃśaḥ krodhatāmrākṣastatpaścātprayayau balī ..58..
3.3.d:
तदा च पीडिता देवी भयभीता ययौ वनम् ॥
कृष्णांशः क्रोधताम्राक्षस्तत्पश्चात्प्रययौ बली ॥58॥
3.3.m: Then, distressed and struck with fear, the goddess fled to the forest; / and the mighty Kṛṣṇāṃśa, his eyes red with rage, pursued her.

3.3.s:
vanāṃtaraṃ ca saṃprāpya devī dhṛtvā svakaṃ vapuḥ ..
tamuvāca prasannākṣī parīkṣā te mayā kṛtā .. 59 ..
3.3.d:
वनांतरं च संप्राप्य देवी धृत्वा स्वकं वपुः ॥
तमुवाच प्रसन्नाक्षी परीक्षा ते मया कृता ॥ 59 ॥
3.3.m: Reaching another forest, the goddess assumed her own form / and, with gracious eyes, said to him: “I was testing you.

3.3.s:
yadā te ca bhayaṃ bhūyāttadā tvaṃ māṃ sadā smara ..
sādhayiṣyāmi te kāryaṃ kṛṣṇāṃśo hi bhavānvibhuḥ .. 3.3.10.60 ..
3.3.d:
यदा ते च भयं भूयात्तदा त्वं मां सदा स्मर ॥
साधयिष्यामि ते कार्यं कृष्णांशो हि भवान्विभुः ॥ 3.3.10.60 ॥
3.3.m: Whenever you experience danger, remember me always; / I shall accomplish your goal, for you, Kṛṣṇāṃśa, are an all-pervading lord.”

3.3.s:
ityuktvāntarhitā devī śāradā sarvamaṃgalā ..
kṛṣṇāṃśastu yayau gehaṃ taiśca sārddhaṃ mudā yutaḥ .. 61 ..
3.3.d:
इत्युक्त्वान्तर्हिता देवी शारदा सर्वमंगला ॥
कृष्णांशस्तु ययौ गेहं तैश्च सार्द्धं मुदा युतः ॥ 61 ॥
3.3.m: Having spoken thus, the goddess Śāradā, all-auspicious, vanished; / and Kṛṣṇāṃśa, filled with joy, went home along with them.

3.3.s:
tadā parākramaṃ teṣāṃ dṛṣṭvā rājā sukho'bhavat ..
gṛhe gṛhe ca sarveṣāṃ lakṣmīrdevī samāviśat .. 62 .. ..
3.3.10.43
papīhakaḥ -- papi kṣāntau (sahane) - kāśakṛtsnadhātukośaḥ 9.35 (curādigaṇaḥ)
3.3.d:
तदा पराक्रमं तेषां दृष्ट्वा राजा सुखोऽभवत् ॥
गृहे गृहे च सर्वेषां लक्ष्मीर्देवी समाविशत् ॥ 62 ॥ ॥
3.3.10.43
पपीहकः -- पपि क्षान्तौ (सहने) - काशकृत्स्नधातुकोशः 9.35 (चुरादिगणः)
3.3.m:
Then, seeing their prowess, the king was happy; / and the goddess Lakṣmī entered the house of each and every one.
3.3.10.43
papīhakaḥ — papi in the sense of endurance (bearing) — Kāśakṛtsna-dhātukośa 9.35 (curādi class)

3.3.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
daśābde ca vayaḥ prāpte viṣṇoḥ śaktyavatārake ..
vasaṃtasamaye ramye yayuste pramadāvanam .. .. 1 ..
3.3.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
दशाब्दे च वयः प्राप्ते विष्णोः शक्त्यवतारके ॥
वसंतसमये रम्ये ययुस्ते प्रमदावनम् ॥ ॥ 1 ॥
3.3.m: Sūta said: / When the energetic incarnation of Viṣṇu reached ten years of age, / they went to the pleasure grove in the delightful springtime.

3.3.s:
ūṣustatra vratācāre mādhave kṛṣṇavallabhe ..
snātvā ca sāgare prātaḥ pūjayāmāsuraṃbikām .. 2 ..
3.3.d:
ऊषुस्तत्र व्रताचारे माधवे कृष्णवल्लभे ॥
स्नात्वा च सागरे प्रातः पूजयामासुरंबिकाम् ॥ 2 ॥
3.3.m: They dwelt there practicing a votive observance during Mādhava, dear to Kṛṣṇa; / and having bathed in the ocean at dawn, they worshipped Ambikā.

3.3.s:
ṛtukālodbhavaiḥ puṣpairdhūpairdīpairvidhānataḥ ..
japtvā saptaśatīstotraṃ dadhyuḥ sarvakarīṃ śivām .. 3 ..
3.3.d:
ऋतुकालोद्भवैः पुष्पैर्धूपैर्दीपैर्विधानतः ॥
जप्त्वा सप्तशतीस्तोत्रं दध्युः सर्वकरीं शिवाम् ॥ 3 ॥
3.3.m: With flowers born of the season, with incense and lamps according to the rules, / and reciting the hymn of seven hundred verses, they meditated upon Śivā, who accomplishes everything.

3.3.s:
kaṃdamūlaphalāhārā jīvahiṃsāvivarjitāḥ ..
teṣāṃ bhaktiṃ samālokya māsāṃte jagadaṃbikā ..4 ..
3.3.d:
कंदमूलफलाहारा जीवहिंसाविवर्जिताः ॥
तेषां भक्तिं समालोक्य मासांते जगदंबिका ॥4 ॥
3.3.m: Eating roots, tubers, and fruits, abstaining from harm to living beings, / at the end of the month, the Mother of the Universe, beholding their devotion,

3.3.s:
dadau tebhyo varaṃ ramyaṃ tacchṛṇudhvaṃ samāhitāḥ..
āhlādāya suratvaṃ ca balatvaṃ balakhānaye .. 5 ..
3.3.d:
ददौ तेभ्यो वरं रम्यं तच्छृणुध्वं समाहिताः॥
आह्लादाय सुरत्वं च बलत्वं बलखानये ॥ 5 ॥
3.3.m: Granted them a delightful boon; listen to that with concentrated minds: / divinity to Āhlāda and strength to Balakhāni;

3.3.s:
kālajñatvaṃ ca devāya brahmajñatvaṃ nṛpāya ca...
kṛṣṇāṃśāyaiva yogatvaṃ dattvā cāṃtardadhe śivā .. 6 ..
3.3.d:
कालज्ञत्वं च देवाय ब्रह्मज्ञत्वं नृपाय च॥।
कृष्णांशायैव योगत्वं दत्त्वा चांतर्दधे शिवा ॥ 6 ॥
3.3.m: Knowledge of time to Deva, and knowledge of brahman to the king; / and having granted yoga to Kṛṣṇāṃśa, Śivā vanished.

3.3.s:
kṛtakṛtyāstadā te vai svagehaṃ punarāyayuḥ ..
teṣāṃ prāpte vare ramye malanā putramūrjitam ..7..
3.3.d:
कृतकृत्यास्तदा ते वै स्वगेहं पुनराययुः ॥
तेषां प्राप्ते वरे रम्ये मलना पुत्रमूर्जितम् ॥7॥
3.3.m: Having accomplished their purpose, they then returned to their own home. / When they had obtained this delightful boon, Malanā [gave birth to] a mighty son;

3.3.s:
śyāmāṃgaṃ sātyakeraṃśaṃ suṣuve śubhalakṣaṇam ..
sa jñeyo raṇajicchūro rājanyapriyakārakaḥ .. 8 ..
3.3.d:
श्यामांगं सात्यकेरंशं सुषुवे शुभलक्षणम् ॥
स ज्ञेयो रणजिच्छूरो राजन्यप्रियकारकः ॥ 8 ॥
3.3.m: She bore Śyāmāṅga, an amanuensis of Sātyaki, possessing auspicious marks; / he was known as a hero who conquers in battle and brings joy to the warrior class.

3.3.s:
āṣāḍhe māsi saṃprāpte kṛṣṇāṃśo hayavāhanaḥ ..
urvīyāṃ nagarīṃ prāpta ekākī nirbhayo valī .. 9 ..
3.3.d:
आषाढे मासि संप्राप्ते कृष्णांशो हयवाहनः ॥
उर्वीयां नगरीं प्राप्त एकाकी निर्भयो वली ॥ 9 ॥
3.3.m: When the month of Āṣāḍha arrived, Kṛṣṇāṃśa, mounted on a horse, / reached the city of Urvīyā alone, fearless and mighty.

3.3.s:
dṛṣṭvā sa nagarīṃ ramyāṃ caturvarṇaniṣevitām ..
dvijaśālāṃ yayau śūro dvijadhenuprapūjakaḥ .. 3.3.11.10 ..
3.3.d:
दृष्ट्वा स नगरीं रम्यां चतुर्वर्णनिषेविताम् ॥
द्विजशालां ययौ शूरो द्विजधेनुप्रपूजकः ॥ 3.3.11.10 ॥
3.3.m: Seeing that delightful city served by the four castes, / the hero, who reveres brāhmaṇas and cows, went to the hall of the brāhmaṇas.

3.3.s:
dattvā svarṇaṃ dvijātibhyaḥ saṃtarpya dvijadevatāḥ ..
mahīpatigṛhaṃ ramyaṃ jagāma balavattaraḥ .. 11 ..
3.3.d:
दत्त्वा स्वर्णं द्विजातिभ्यः संतर्प्य द्विजदेवताः ॥
महीपतिगृहं रम्यं जगाम बलवत्तरः ॥ 11 ॥
3.3.m: Having given gold to the twice-born and satisfied the gods of the twice-born, / the most mighty one went to the delightful house of the king.

3.3.s: natvā sa mātulaṃ dhīmāṃstathānyām̐śca sabhāsadaḥ .. 12 ..
3.3.d: नत्वा स मातुलं धीमांस्तथान्याम्̐श्च सभासदः ॥ 12 ॥
3.3.m: Having bowed to his maternal uncle, the wise one, and to the other courtiers,

3.3.s:
tadā nṛpājñayā śūrā baṃdhanāya samudyatāḥ ..
khaṅgahastāḥ samājagmuryathā siṃhaṃ gajāḥ śaśāḥ .. 13 ..
3.3.d:
तदा नृपाज्ञया शूरा बंधनाय समुद्यताः ॥
खङ्गहस्ताः समाजग्मुर्यथा सिंहं गजाः शशाः ॥ 13 ॥
3.3.m: Then, by the king's command, heroes prepared to bind him, / and with swords in hand they approached, as elephants [approach] a lion, or hares [an elephant].

3.3.s:
mohitaṃ taṃ nṛpaṃ kṛtvā duṣṭabuddhirmahīpatiḥ ..
kṛtvā lohamayaṃ jālaṃ tasyopari samādadheḥ .. 14 ..
3.3.d:
मोहितं तं नृपं कृत्वा दुष्टबुद्धिर्महीपतिः ॥
कृत्वा लोहमयं जालं तस्योपरि समादधेः ॥ 14 ॥
3.3.m: Having bewildered that prince, the evil-minded king / made an iron net and threw it over him.

3.3.s:
etasminnaṃtare vīro bodhito devamāyayā ..
āgaskṛtānripūñjñātvā khaṅgahastaḥ samāvadhīt .. 15 ..
3.3.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे वीरो बोधितो देवमायया ॥
आगस्कृतान्रिपूञ्ज्ञात्वा खङ्गहस्तः समावधीत् ॥ 15 ॥
3.3.m: Meanwhile, the hero, awakened by divine Māyā, / recognized the foes who had committed offences and struck them down, sword in hand.

3.3.s:
hatvā paṃcaśataṃ śūro hayārūḍho mahābalī ..
urvīyāṃ nagarīṃ prāpya jalapāne mano dadhau 16 ..
3.3.d:
हत्वा पंचशतं शूरो हयारूढो महाबली ॥
उर्वीयां नगरीं प्राप्य जलपाने मनो दधौ 16 ॥
3.3.m: Having slain five hundred, the mighty hero mounted his horse, / and arriving in the city of Urvīyā, turned his mind toward drinking water.

3.3.s:
kūpe dṛṣṭvā śubhā nāryo ghaṭapūrtikarīstadā ..
uvāca madhuro vākyaṃ dehi suṃdari me jalam .. 17 ..
3.3.d:
कूपे दृष्ट्वा शुभा नार्यो घटपूर्तिकरीस्तदा ॥
उवाच मधुरो वाक्यं देहि सुंदरि मे जलम् ॥ 17 ॥
3.3.m: Seeing beautiful women at the well then filling their water pots, / he spoke sweet words: “O beautiful one, give me water.”

3.3.s:
dṛṣṭvā tāḥ suṃdaraṃ rūpaṃ mohanāyopacakrire ..
bhittvā tāsāṃ tu vai kumbhānpāyayitvā hayaṃ jalam .. 18 ..
3.3.d:
दृष्ट्वा ताः सुंदरं रूपं मोहनायोपचक्रिरे ॥
भित्त्वा तासां तु वै कुम्भान्पाययित्वा हयं जलम् ॥ 18 ॥
3.3.m: Seeing his handsome form, they set about enchanting him; / but he smashed their jars, watered his horse,

3.3.s:
vanaṃ gatvā ripuṃ jitvā baddhvā tamubhayaṃ balī ..
caṇḍikāpārśvamāgamya tadvadhāya mano dadhe .. 19 ..
3.3.d:
वनं गत्वा रिपुं जित्वा बद्ध्वा तमुभयं बली ॥
चण्डिकापार्श्वमागम्य तद्वधाय मनो दधे ॥ 19 ॥
3.3.m: Went to the forest, defeated the enemy, and, having bound both of them, the mighty one / came to the presence of Caṇḍikā and set his mind on their slaughter.

3.3.s:
śrutvā sa karuṇaṃ vākyaṃ tyaktvā svanagaraṃ yayau ..
nṛpāṃtikamupāgamya varṇayāmāsa kāraṇam .. 3.3.11.20 ..
3.3.d:
श्रुत्वा स करुणं वाक्यं त्यक्त्वा स्वनगरं ययौ ॥
नृपांतिकमुपागम्य वर्णयामास कारणम् ॥ 3.3.11.20 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing their pitiful speech, he released [them] and went to his own city; / and approaching the king, he described the reason.

3.3.s:
śrutvā parimalo rājā dvijātibhyo dadau dhanam ..
samāghrāya sa kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ kṛtakṛtyo'bhavannṛpaḥ .. 21 ..
3.3.d:
श्रुत्वा परिमलो राजा द्विजातिभ्यो ददौ धनम् ॥
समाघ्राय स कृष्णांशं कृतकृत्योऽभवन्नृपः ॥ 21 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing this, King Parimala gave wealth to the twice-born; / and having smelled Kṛṣṇāṃśa's head, the king felt he had achieved his purpose.

3.3.s:
saṃprāptaikādaśadābde tu kṛṣṇāṃśe yuddhadurmade ..
mahīpatirnirutsāhaḥ prayayau dehalīṃ prati .. 22 ..
3.3.d:
संप्राप्तैकादशदाब्दे तु कृष्णांशे युद्धदुर्मदे ॥
महीपतिर्निरुत्साहः प्रययौ देहलीं प्रति ॥ 22 ॥
3.3.m: When Kṛṣṇāṃśa, furious in battle, reached his eleventh year, / the dispirited king set out toward Delhi.

3.3.s:
baliṃ yathocitaṃ dattvā bhaginyai bhayakātaraḥ ..
ruroda vahudhā duḥkhaṃ deśarājātmajaprajam .. 23 ..
3.3.d:
बलिं यथोचितं दत्त्वा भगिन्यै भयकातरः ॥
रुरोद वहुधा दुःखं देशराजात्मजप्रजम् ॥ 23 ॥
3.3.m: Having given a suitable offering to his sister, trembling with fear, / he wept bitterly over the grief caused by the son of Deśarāja.

3.3.s:
agamā bhaginī tasya dṛṣṭvā bhrātaramāturam ..
svapatiṃ varṇayāmāsa śrutvā rājābravīdidam .. 24 ..
3.3.d:
अगमा भगिनी तस्य दृष्ट्वा भ्रातरमातुरम् ॥
स्वपतिं वर्णयामास श्रुत्वा राजाब्रवीदिदम् ॥ 24 ॥
3.3.m: His sister Agamā, seeing her brother in distress, / described it to her husband; and hearing it, the king said this:

3.3.s:
adyāhaṃ svabalaiḥ sārddhaṃ gatvā tatra mahāvatīm ..
haniṣyāmi mahāduṣṭaṃ deśarājasutaṃ ripum .. 25 ..
3.3.d:
अद्याहं स्वबलैः सार्द्धं गत्वा तत्र महावतीम् ॥
हनिष्यामि महादुष्टं देशराजसुतं रिपुम् ॥ 25 ॥
3.3.m: “Today, accompanied by my own forces, I will go there to Mahāvatī / and kill the exceedingly wicked enemy, the son of Deśarāja.”

3.3.s:
ityuktvā dhuṃdhukāraṃ ca samāhūya mahābalam ..
sainyamājñāpayāmāsa saptalakṣaṃ tanutyajam .. 26 ..
3.3.d:
इत्युक्त्वा धुंधुकारं च समाहूय महाबलम् ॥
सैन्यमाज्ञापयामास सप्तलक्षं तनुत्यजम् ॥ 26 ॥
3.3.m: Having spoken thus and summoned the mighty Dhuṃdhukāra, / he gave orders to an army of seven hundred thousand who were ready to abandon their lives.

3.3.s:
kecicchūrā hayārūḍhā uṣṭrārūḍhā mahābalāḥ ..
gajārūḍhā rathārūḍhāḥ saṃyayuśca padātayaḥ .. 27 ..
3.3.d:
केचिच्छूरा हयारूढा उष्ट्रारूढा महाबलाः ॥
गजारूढा रथारूढाः संययुश्च पदातयः ॥ 27 ॥
3.3.m: Some heroes were mounted on horses, others mighty ones mounted on camels; / and mounted on elephants, mounted on chariots, and on foot, they marched forth.

3.3.s:
devasiṃhastu kālajñaḥ śrutvā cāgamanaṃ ripoḥ ..
nṛpapārśvaṃ samāgamya sarvaṃ rājñe nyavedayat .. 28 ..
3.3.d:
देवसिंहस्तु कालज्ञः श्रुत्वा चागमनं रिपोः ॥
नृपपार्श्वं समागम्य सर्वं राज्ञे न्यवेदयत् ॥ 28 ॥
3.3.m: Then Devasiṃha, who knew the times, hearing of the enemy’s approach, / came to the side of the king and reported everything to him.

3.3.s:
śrutvā parimalo rājā vihvalo'bhūdbhayāturaḥ ..
balakhānistamutthāya harṣayukta ivāha ca .. .. 29 ..
3.3.d:
श्रुत्वा परिमलो राजा विह्वलोऽभूद्भयातुरः ॥
बलखानिस्तमुत्थाय हर्षयुक्त इवाह च ॥ ॥ 29 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing this, King Parimala was overwhelmed and afflicted with fear; / but Balakhāni stood up before him and said, as if filled with joy:

3.3.s:
adyāhaṃ ca mahīrājaṃ dhuṃdhukāraṃ sasainyakam ..
jitvā daṃḍyaṃ ca bhavataḥ kariṣyāmi tavājñayā .. 3.3.11.30 ..
3.3.d:
अद्याहं च महीराजं धुंधुकारं ससैन्यकम् ॥
जित्वा दंड्यं च भवतः करिष्यामि तवाज्ञया ॥ 3.3.11.30 ॥
3.3.m: “Today, by your command, I will conquer King Mahīpati / and Dhuṃdhukāra along with his army, and make him pay a penalty to you.”

3.3.s:
ityuktvā taṃ namaskṛtya senāpatirabhūnmune ..
tadā tu nirbhayā vīrā dṛṣṭvā rājānamāturam .. 31 ..
3.3.d:
इत्युक्त्वा तं नमस्कृत्य सेनापतिरभून्मुने ॥
तदा तु निर्भया वीरा दृष्ट्वा राजानमातुरम् ॥ 31 ॥
3.3.m: Having said this and bowed to him, O sage, he became commander of the army; / then those fearless heroes, seeing the king distressed,

3.3.s:
caturlakṣabalaiḥ sārddhaṃ te yuddhāya samāyayuḥ ..
śiṃśapākhyaṃ vanaṃ ghoraṃ chedayitvā ripostadā .. 32 ..
3.3.d:
चतुर्लक्षबलैः सार्द्धं ते युद्धाय समाययुः ॥
शिंशपाख्यं वनं घोरं छेदयित्वा रिपोस्तदा ॥ 32 ॥
3.3.m: Marched out for battle along with four hundred thousand troops; / and having cut down the terrible forest called Śiṃśapā belonging to the enemy,

3.3.s:
ūṣustatra raṇe mattāḥ sarvaśatrubhayaṃkarāḥ ..
etasminnantare tatra dhuṃdhukārādayo balā .. 33 ..
3.3.d:
ऊषुस्तत्र रणे मत्ताः सर्वशत्रुभयंकराः ॥
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे तत्र धुंधुकारादयो बला ॥ 33 ॥
3.3.m: Furious in battle and terrifying to all enemies, they remained there. / Meanwhile, the mighty Dhundhukāra and others,

3.3.s:
kṛtvā kolāhalaṃ śabdaṃ yuddhāya samupāyayuḥ ..
pūrvāhṇe tu bhṛguśreṣṭha sannaddhāste śataghnipāḥ .. 34 ..
3.3.d:
कृत्वा कोलाहलं शब्दं युद्धाय समुपाययुः ॥
पूर्वाह्णे तु भृगुश्रेष्ठ सन्नद्धास्ते शतघ्निपाः ॥ 34 ॥
3.3.m: raising a tumultuous uproar, approached for battle. / In the forenoon, O best of the Bhṛgus, those cannon-bearers were armed and ready;

3.3.s:
śataghnībhistrisāhasraiḥ pañcasāhasrakā yayuḥ ..
dvisahasraśataghnībhiḥ sahitā ścandravaṃśinaḥ .. 35 ..
3.3.d:
शतघ्नीभिस्त्रिसाहस्रैः पञ्चसाहस्रका ययुः ॥
द्विसहस्रशतघ्नीभिः सहिता श्चन्द्रवंशिनः ॥ 35 ॥
3.3.m: five thousand [warriors] marched with three thousand cannons. / Along with two thousand cannons, the descendants of the Lunar dynasty [advanced];

3.3.s:
sainyaṃ ṣaṣṭisahasraṃ ca svagarlokamupāyayau ..
tadarddhaṃ ca tathā sainyaṃ mahīrājasya saṃkṣitam .. 36 ..
3.3.d:
सैन्यं षष्टिसहस्रं च स्वगर्लोकमुपाययौ ॥
तदर्द्धं च तथा सैन्यं महीराजस्य संक्षितम् ॥ 36 ॥
3.3.m: sixty thousand of their army went to the world of heaven, / and half that number of Mahīrāja’s army was destroyed.

3.3.s:
dudruvurbhīrukāḥ śūrā valakhānerdiśo daśa ..
rathā rathai raṇe hanyurgajāścaiva gajaistathā .. 37 ..
3.3.d:
दुद्रुवुर्भीरुकाः शूरा वलखानेर्दिशो दश ॥
रथा रथै रणे हन्युर्गजाश्चैव गजैस्तथा ॥ 37 ॥
3.3.m: The timid ran away in ten directions from the hero Malkhān. / In the battle, chariots slew chariots, and likewise elephants [slew] elephants;

3.3.s:
hayā hayaistathā uṣṭrā uṣṭrapaiśca samāhanan ..
evaṃ sutumule jāte dāruṇe roma harṣaṇe .. 38 ..
3.3.d:
हया हयैस्तथा उष्ट्रा उष्ट्रपैश्च समाहनन् ॥
एवं सुतुमुले जाते दारुणे रोम हर्षणे ॥ 38 ॥
3.3.m: horses struck horses, and camels with camel-riders struck [camels]. / When such a dreadful, hair-raising tumoil had arisen,

3.3.s:
hāhābhūtānsvakīyāṃśca sainyāndṛṣṭvā mahābalān ..
aparāhṇe bhṛguśreṣṭha pañca śūrāḥ samāyayuḥ .. 39 ..
3.3.d:
हाहाभूतान्स्वकीयांश्च सैन्यान्दृष्ट्वा महाबलान् ॥
अपराह्णे भृगुश्रेष्ठ पञ्च शूराः समाययुः ॥ 39 ॥
3.3.m: and seeing their own powerful troops crying out in distress, / in the afternoon, O best of the Bhṛgus, five heroes arrived.

3.3.s:
brahmānaṃdaḥ śaraiḥ śatrūnanayadyamasādanam ..
devasiṃhastathā bhallairāhrādastatra tomaraiḥ .. 3.3.11.40 ..
3.3.d:
ब्रह्मानंदः शरैः शत्रूननयद्यमसादनम् ॥
देवसिंहस्तथा भल्लैराह्रादस्तत्र तोमरैः ॥ 3.3.11.40 ॥
3.3.m: Brahmānanda dispatched the enemies to the abode of Yama with his arrows, / Devasiṃha likewise with javelins, and Āhlāda with iron clubs.

3.3.s:
balakhāniḥ svakhaḍgena kṛṣṇāṃśastu tathaiva ca ..
dvilakṣānkṣatriyāñjaghnuḥ sarvasainyaiḥ samaṃ tataḥ .. 41 ..
3.3.d:
बलखानिः स्वखड्गेन कृष्णांशस्तु तथैव च ॥
द्विलक्षान्क्षत्रियाञ्जघ्नुः सर्वसैन्यैः समं ततः ॥ 41 ॥
3.3.m: Malkhān with his sword and likewise the partial incarnation of Kṛṣṇa / together with all the troops then slew two hundred thousand kṣatriyas.

3.3.s:
dṛṣṭvā parājitaṃ sainyaṃ dhuṃdhukāro mahābalaḥ ..
āhlādaṃ ca svabhallena gajārūḍhaḥ samāvadhīt .. 42 ..
3.3.d:
दृष्ट्वा पराजितं सैन्यं धुंधुकारो महाबलः ॥
आह्लादं च स्वभल्लेन गजारूढः समावधीत् ॥ 42 ॥
3.3.m: Seeing his army defeated, the mighty Dhundhukāra, / mounted on an elephant, struck Āhlāda with his javelin.

3.3.s:
āhlāde mūrcchite tatra devasiṃho mahābalaḥ ..
bhallena bhrātaraṃ tasya daṃśayāmāsa vegataḥ .. 43 ..
3.3.d:
आह्लादे मूर्च्छिते तत्र देवसिंहो महाबलः ॥
भल्लेन भ्रातरं तस्य दंशयामास वेगतः ॥ 43 ॥
3.3.m: When Āhlāda fell unconscious there, the mighty Devasiṃha / swiftly pierced his brother with a javelin.

3.3.s:
sa tīkṣṇavraṇamāsādya gajasthaḥ saṃmumoha vai ..
āgatāḥ śatarājāno nānādeśyā mahābalāḥ .. 44 ..
3.3.d:
स तीक्ष्णव्रणमासाद्य गजस्थः संमुमोह वै ॥
आगताः शतराजानो नानादेश्या महाबलाः ॥ 44 ॥
3.3.m: Receiving a severe wound, he fell unconscious while on his elephant. / A hundred powerful kings had arrived from various countries;

3.3.s:
śastrāṇyastrāṇi teṣāṃ tu chittvā khaṅgena vatsajaḥ ..
svakhaḍgena śirāṃsyeṣāṃ pātayāmāsa bhūtale .. 45 ..
3.3.d:
शस्त्राण्यस्त्राणि तेषां तु छित्त्वा खङ्गेन वत्सजः ॥
स्वखड्गेन शिरांस्येषां पातयामास भूतले ॥ 45 ॥
3.3.m: cutting down their weapons and missiles with his sword, the son of Vatsa / caused their heads to fall to the earth with his sword.

3.3.s:
hate śatrusamūhe tu taccheṣāstu pradudruvuḥ ..
mahīrājastu balavāndṛṣṭvā bhagnaṃ svasainyakam .. 46 ..
3.3.d:
हते शत्रुसमूहे तु तच्छेषास्तु प्रदुद्रुवुः ॥
महीराजस्तु बलवान्दृष्ट्वा भग्नं स्वसैन्यकम् ॥ 46 ॥
3.3.m: When the host of enemies was slain, the remnants fled. / Then the powerful Mahīrāja, seeing his army broken,

3.3.s:
ājagāma gajārūḍhaḥ śivadattavaro balī ..
raudreṇāstreṇa hṛdaye cāvadhīdvatsajaṃ ripum .. 47 ..
3.3.d:
आजगाम गजारूढः शिवदत्तवरो बली ॥
रौद्रेणास्त्रेण हृदये चावधीद्वत्सजं रिपुम् ॥ 47 ॥
3.3.m: came forward riding an elephant, empowered by a boon from Śiva. / With a dreadful missile he struck his enemy, the son of Vatsa, in the heart,

3.3.s:
āhlādaṃ ca tathā vīraṃ devaṃ parimalātmajam ..
mūrcchayitvā mahāvīrāñchatrusainyamupāgamat .. 48 ..
3.3.d:
आह्लादं च तथा वीरं देवं परिमलात्मजम् ॥
मूर्च्छयित्वा महावीराञ्छत्रुसैन्यमुपागमत् ॥ 48 ॥
3.3.m: and likewise the hero Āhlāda, and Deva, the son of Parimala. / Having rendered the great heroes unconscious, he approached the enemy army;

3.3.s:
pūjayitvā śataghnīśca mahāvadhamakārayat ..
ropaṇastvarito gatvā rājñe sarvamavarṇayat .. 49 ..
3.3.d:
पूजयित्वा शतघ्नीश्च महावधमकारयत् ॥
रोपणस्त्वरितो गत्वा राज्ञे सर्वमवर्णयत् ॥ 49 ॥
3.3.m: worshiping the cannons, he caused a great slaughter. / Ropaṇa went swiftly and described everything to the king.

3.3.s:
etasminnaṃtare vīraḥ sukhakhānirmahābalaḥ .
kapotaṃ hayamāruhya nabhomārgeṇa cāgamat .. 3.3.11.50 ..
3.3.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे वीरः सुखखानिर्महाबलः ।
कपोतं हयमारुह्य नभोमार्गेण चागमत् ॥ 3.3.11.50 ॥
3.3.m: In the meantime, the mighty hero Sukhadāsa / mounted his horse Kapota and arrived by the path of the sky.

3.3.s:
mūrcchayitvā mahīrājaṃ svabaṃdhūṃśca savāhanān ..
kṛtvā nṛpāṃtamāgamya baṃdhanāya samudyataḥ .. 51 ..
3.3.d:
मूर्च्छयित्वा महीराजं स्वबंधूंश्च सवाहनान् ॥
कृत्वा नृपांतमागम्य बंधनाय समुद्यतः ॥ 51 ॥
3.3.m: Having knocked Mahīrāja unconscious along with his kinsmen and their mounts, / he approached the king and prepared to bind him.

3.3.s:
tadotthāya mahīrājo mahādevena bodhitaḥ ..
punastānsvaśarai raudrairmūrcchayāmāsa kopavān .. 52 ..
3.3.d:
तदोत्थाय महीराजो महादेवेन बोधितः ॥
पुनस्तान्स्वशरै रौद्रैर्मूर्च्छयामास कोपवान् ॥ 52 ॥
3.3.m: Then Mahīrāja arose, awakened by Mahādeva, / and being enraged, he again knocked them unconscious with his terrible arrows.

3.3.s:
sukhakhānyādikāñchūrānsaṃbadhya nigaḍairdṛḍhaiḥ ..
nṛpaṃ parimalaṃ prāpya punaryuddhamacīkarat .. 53 ..
3.3.d:
सुखखान्यादिकाञ्छूरान्संबध्य निगडैर्दृढैः ॥
नृपं परिमलं प्राप्य पुनर्युद्धमचीकरत् ॥ 53 ॥
3.3.m: Having firmly bound the heroes Sukhakhāni and the others with iron chains, / he advanced against King Parimala and resumed the battle.

3.3.s:
hāhābhūtaṃ svasainyaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā sa udayo hariḥ ..
nabhomārge hayaṃ kṛtvā tāḥ śatadhnīranāśayat .. 54 ..
3.3.d:
हाहाभूतं स्वसैन्यं च दृष्ट्वा स उदयो हरिः ॥
नभोमार्गे हयं कृत्वा ताः शतध्नीरनाशयत् ॥ 54 ॥
3.3.m: Seeing his own army crying out in distress, that Udaya Hari / sent his horse into the sky and destroyed those cannons.

3.3.s:
mahīrājagajaṃ prāpya baddhvā taṃ nigaḍairbalo ..
āhlādapārśvamāgamya bhrātre bhūpaṃ samarpayat .. 55 ..
3.3.d:
महीराजगजं प्राप्य बद्ध्वा तं निगडैर्बलो ॥
आह्लादपार्श्वमागम्य भ्रात्रे भूपं समर्पयत् ॥ 55 ॥
3.3.m: The mighty one reached Mahīrāja's elephant, bound him with chains, / came before Āhlāda, and handed the king over to his brother.

3.3.s:
tadā tu pṛthivīrājo lajjitastena nirjitaḥ ..
pañcakoṭidhanaṃ dattvā svagehaṃ punarāyayau .. 56 ..
3.3.d:
तदा तु पृथिवीराजो लज्जितस्तेन निर्जितः ॥
पञ्चकोटिधनं दत्त्वा स्वगेहं पुनराययौ ॥ 56 ॥
3.3.m: Then Pṛthivīrāja, humiliated at being conquered by him, / gave fifty million in wealth and returned to his own home.

3.3.s:
devasiṃhājñayā śūro balakhānirhi vatsajaḥ ..
tairdravyairnagarīṃ ramyāṃ kārayāmāsa sundarīm .. 57 ..
3.3.d:
देवसिंहाज्ञया शूरो बलखानिर्हि वत्सजः ॥
तैर्द्रव्यैर्नगरीं रम्यां कारयामास सुन्दरीम् ॥ 57 ॥
3.3.m: By order of Devasiṃha, the heroic Malkhān, the son of Vatsa, / caused a pleasant and beautiful city to be built with that wealth.

3.3.s:
śirīṣākhyaṃ puraṃ nāma tena vīreṇa vai kṛtam ..
sarvavarṇasamāyuktaṃ dvikrośāyāmasaṃmitam .. 58 ..
3.3.d:
शिरीषाख्यं पुरं नाम तेन वीरेण वै कृतम् ॥
सर्ववर्णसमायुक्तं द्विक्रोशायामसंमितम् ॥ 58 ॥
3.3.m: The city named Sirisā was founded by that hero, / filled with all classes and measuring two krośas in length.

3.3.s:
tatraiva nyavasadvīro vatsajaḥ svakulaiḥ saha ..
triṃśatkośe kṛtaṃ rāṣṭraṃ tatraiva balakhāninā .. 59 ..
3.3.d:
तत्रैव न्यवसद्वीरो वत्सजः स्वकुलैः सह ॥
त्रिंशत्कोशे कृतं राष्ट्रं तत्रैव बलखानिना ॥ 59 ॥
3.3.m: There the heroic son of Vatsa lived together with his kin; / a realm of thirty kośas was established right there by Malkhān.

3.3.s:
śrutvā parimalo rājā tatrāgatya mudānvitaḥ ..
āghrāya vatsajaṃ śūraṃ deśarājasutaṃ tathā .. 3.3.11.60 ..
3.3.d:
श्रुत्वा परिमलो राजा तत्रागत्य मुदान्वितः ॥
आघ्राय वत्सजं शूरं देशराजसुतं तथा ॥ 3.3.11.60 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing of this, King Parimala arrived there filled with joy; / smelling the head of the heroic son of Vatsa, the son of Deśarāja,

3.3.s: brahmānaṃdena sahitaḥ svagehaṃ punarāyayau .. 61 .. ..
3.3.d: ब्रह्मानंदेन सहितः स्वगेहं पुनराययौ ॥ 61 ॥ ॥
3.3.m: he returned to his own home along with Brahmānanda.

3.3.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
dvādaśābde hi kṛṣṇāṃśe yathājātaṃ tathā śṛṇu ..
iṣaśukladaśamyāṃ ca rājñāṃ jātaḥ samāgamaḥ .. 1 ..
3.3.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
द्वादशाब्दे हि कृष्णांशे यथाजातं तथा शृणु ॥
इषशुक्लदशम्यां च राज्ञां जातः समागमः ॥ 1 ॥
3.3.m: Sūta said: / Hear what happened in the twelfth year of the partial incarnation of Kṛṣṇa. / On the tenth day of the bright fortnight of Āśvina, an assembly of kings took place;

3.3.s:
kānyakubje mahāramye nānābhūpāḥ samāyayuḥ ..
śrutvā parājayaṃ rājño mahīrājasya lakṣaṇaḥ .. 2 ..
3.3.d:
कान्यकुब्जे महारम्ये नानाभूपाः समाययुः ॥
श्रुत्वा पराजयं राज्ञो महीराजस्य लक्षणः ॥ 2 ॥
3.3.m: various kings assembled in delightful Kānyakubja. / Hearing of the defeat of King Mahīrāja, Lakṣaṇa

3.3.s:
kṛṣṇāṃśadarśane vāṃchā tasya cāsīttadā mune ..
pitṛvyaṃ bhūpatiṃ prāha draṣṭuṃ yāsyāmi taṃ śubham .. 3 ..
3.3.d:
कृष्णांशदर्शने वांछा तस्य चासीत्तदा मुने ॥
पितृव्यं भूपतिं प्राह द्रष्टुं यास्यामि तं शुभम् ॥ 3 ॥
3.3.m: then had a desire to see the partial incarnation of Kṛṣṇa, O sage. / He said to his uncle, the king: 'I will go to see that auspicious one,

3.3.s:
jito yena mahīrājaḥ sarvalokaprapūjitaḥ ..
iti śrutvā vacastasya jayacaṃdro mahīpatiḥ ..
bhrātṛjaṃ praṇataṃ prāha śṛṇu śuklayaśaskara ..4..
3.3.d:
जितो येन महीराजः सर्वलोकप्रपूजितः ॥
इति श्रुत्वा वचस्तस्य जयचंद्रो महीपतिः ॥
भ्रातृजं प्रणतं प्राह शृणु शुक्लयशस्कर ॥4॥
3.3.m: by whom Mahīrāja, revered by all people, was defeated.' / Hearing these words of his, King Jayacandra / said to his bowing nephew: 'Listen, O glorifier of the Śukla lineage,

3.3.s:
rājarājapadaṃ te hi kathaṃ saṃhartumicchasi..
ityuktvā jayacaṃdrastu tadājñāṃ naiva dattavān .. 5 ..
3.3.d:
राजराजपदं ते हि कथं संहर्तुमिच्छसि॥
इत्युक्त्वा जयचंद्रस्तु तदाज्ञां नैव दत्तवान् ॥ 5 ॥
3.3.m: why do you wish to destroy your imperial status?' / Having spoken thus, Jayacandra did not give him permission.

3.3.s:
rājānaste ca sahitāḥ svasainyaiḥ parivāritāḥ ..
kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ draṣṭumicchantaḥ saṃyayuśca mahīpatim .. 6 ..
3.3.d:
राजानस्ते च सहिताः स्वसैन्यैः परिवारिताः ॥
कृष्णांशं द्रष्टुमिच्छन्तः संययुश्च महीपतिम् ॥ 6 ॥
3.3.m: Those kings, joined together and surrounded by their own armies, / wishing to see the partial incarnation of Kṛṣṇa, approached the king.

3.3.s:
śirīṣākhyapurasthaṃ ca jñātvā kṛṣṇāṃśamuttamam ..
mahīpatiṃ puraskṛtya samājagmurnṛpāstadā .. 7 ..
3.3.d:
शिरीषाख्यपुरस्थं च ज्ञात्वा कृष्णांशमुत्तमम् ॥
महीपतिं पुरस्कृत्य समाजग्मुर्नृपास्तदा ॥ 7 ॥
3.3.m: Knowing the noble partial incarnation of Kṛṣṇa to be in the city of Sirisā, / the kings then arrived, placing the king at their head.

3.3.s:
dadṛśustaṃ mahātmānaṃ puṃḍarīkanibhānanam ..
prasannavadanāḥ sarve praśaśaṃsuḥ samaṃtataḥ .. 8 ..
3.3.d:
ददृशुस्तं महात्मानं पुंडरीकनिभाननम् ॥
प्रसन्नवदनाः सर्वे प्रशशंसुः समंततः ॥ 8 ॥
3.3.m: They beheld that great-souled one whose face resembled a white lotus; / with pleased countenances, all of them praised him all around.

3.3.s:
tadā mahīpatiḥ kruddho vacanaṃ prāha bhūpatīn ..
yasyeyaṃ ca kṛtā ślāghā yuṣmābhirdūravāsibhiḥ ..
pitarau tasya balinau māhiṣmatyāṃ mṛtiṃ gatau .. 9 ..
3.3.d:
तदा महीपतिः क्रुद्धो वचनं प्राह भूपतीन् ॥
यस्येयं च कृता श्लाघा युष्माभिर्दूरवासिभिः ॥
पितरौ तस्य बलिनौ माहिष्मत्यां मृतिं गतौ ॥ 9 ॥
3.3.m: Then the king angrily addressed the kings: / 'He who has been praised by you who dwell far away— / his two strong parents died at Māhiṣmatī.

3.3.s:
jambuko nāma bhūpālo nārmadīyaiḥ samanvitaḥ ..
baddhvā tau prayayau gehaṃ luṃṭhayitvā dhanaṃ bahu ..
śilāpatre samāropya tayorgātramacūrṇayat ..
śirasī ca tayośchittvā vaṭavṛkṣe samāruhat .. 3.3.12.10 ..
3.3.d:
जम्बुको नाम भूपालो नार्मदीयैः समन्वितः ॥
बद्ध्वा तौ प्रययौ गेहं लुंठयित्वा धनं बहु ॥
शिलापत्रे समारोप्य तयोर्गात्रमचूर्णयत् ॥
शिरसी च तयोश्छित्त्वा वटवृक्षे समारुहत् ॥ 3.3.12.10 ॥
3.3.m: A king named Jambuka, joined by the people from the Narmadā, / bound the two, plundered much wealth, and went home; / placing their limbs on a stone slab, he crushed them, / and cutting off their heads, he hung them on a banyan tree.

3.3.s:
adyāpi tau sthitau vīrau hā putreti prabhāṣiṇau ..
pretadehe ca pitarau yasya prāpto mahābalo ..
tasyodayo vṛthā jñeyo vṛthākīrtiḥ priyaṃkarī .. 11 ..
3.3.d:
अद्यापि तौ स्थितौ वीरौ हा पुत्रेति प्रभाषिणौ ॥
प्रेतदेहे च पितरौ यस्य प्राप्तो महाबलो ॥
तस्योदयो वृथा ज्ञेयो वृथाकीर्तिः प्रियंकरी ॥ 11 ॥
3.3.m: Even today those two heroes remain there, crying out: "Alas, my son!" / For one whose parents have attained the state of preta bodies, / his rise should be deemed useless, and his beloved fame in vain.'

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā sa kṛṣṇāṃśo bhūpatīnprāha namradhīḥ ..
gatau matpitarau sārddhaṃ gurjare yatra vai raṇaḥ .. 12 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा स कृष्णांशो भूपतीन्प्राह नम्रधीः ॥
गतौ मत्पितरौ सार्द्धं गुर्जरे यत्र वै रणः ॥ 12 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing this, that partial incarnation of Kṛṣṇa with a humble mind said to the kings: / 'My parents departed together to Gurjara where the battle was.'

3.3.s:
mlecchairnarāśanaiḥ sārddhaṃ tannṛpeṇa raṇo'bhavat ..
deśarājo vatsarājo yuddhaṃ kṛtvā bhayaṃkaram ..
mlecchaistaiśca hatau tatra śruteyaṃ viśrutā kathā ..13..
3.3.d:
म्लेच्छैर्नराशनैः सार्द्धं तन्नृपेण रणोऽभवत् ॥
देशराजो वत्सराजो युद्धं कृत्वा भयंकरम् ॥
म्लेच्छैस्तैश्च हतौ तत्र श्रुतेयं विश्रुता कथा ॥13॥
3.3.m: A battle took place between its king and the flesh-eating foreigners. / Having fought a terrible fight, Deśarāja and Vatsarāja / were slain there by those foreigners; this is the famous story that is heard.

3.3.s:
mātulenādya kathitaṃ navīnaṃ maraṇaṃ tayoḥ..
cetsatyaṃ vacanaṃ tasya pauruṣaṃ mama paśyata ..14..
3.3.d:
मातुलेनाद्य कथितं नवीनं मरणं तयोः॥
चेत्सत्यं वचनं तस्य पौरुषं मम पश्यत ॥14॥
3.3.m: Today our uncle has reported their death as fresh news. / If his word is true, behold my valor!

3.3.s:
ityuktvā tānsa kṛṣṇāṃśo mātaraṃ prāha satvaram ..
hetuṃ ca varṇayāmāsa bhāṣitaṃ ca mahīpateḥ .. 15 ..
3.3.d:
इत्युक्त्वा तान्स कृष्णांशो मातरं प्राह सत्वरम् ॥
हेतुं च वर्णयामास भाषितं च महीपतेः ॥ 15 ॥
3.3.m: Having spoken thus to them, that portion of Kṛṣṇa went quickly to his mother, / and described the motive and what had been spoken by the king.

3.3.s:
śrutvā vajrasamaṃ vākyaṃ ruroda jananī tadā ..
nottaraṃ pradadau mātā pati duḥkhena duḥkhitā ..16..
3.3.d:
श्रुत्वा वज्रसमं वाक्यं रुरोद जननी तदा ॥
नोत्तरं प्रददौ माता पति दुःखेन दुःखिता ॥16॥
3.3.m: Hearing those words like a thunderbolt, his mother then wept; / afflicted with sorrow for her husband, the mother gave no answer.

3.3.s:
jñātvā pitṛvadhaṃ śrutvā jambukaṃ śivakiṃkaram ..
manasā sa ca kṛṣṇāṃśastuṣṭāva parameśvarīm ..17..
3.3.d:
ज्ञात्वा पितृवधं श्रुत्वा जम्बुकं शिवकिंकरम् ॥
मनसा स च कृष्णांशस्तुष्टाव परमेश्वरीम् ॥17॥
3.3.m: Having learned of the slaughter of his father and heard of Jambuka, the servant of Śiva, / that portion of Kṛṣṇa praised Parameśvarī in his mind:

3.3.s:
jaya jaya jaya jagadamba bhavāni hyakhilalokasurapitṛmunikhāni ..
tvayā tataṃ sacarācarameva viśvaṃ pātamidaṃ hṛtameva .. 18 ..
3.3.d:
जय जय जय जगदम्ब भवानि ह्यखिललोकसुरपितृमुनिखानि ॥
त्वया ततं सचराचरमेव विश्वं पातमिदं हृतमेव ॥ 18 ॥
3.3.m: "Victory, victory, victory, O Mother of the World, O Bhavānī, origin of all the worlds, gods, ancestors, and sages! / By you alone this universe, with the moving and the unmoving, is pervaded, protected, and destroyed!

3.3.s:
iti dhyātvā sa kṛṣṇāṃśaḥ suṣvāpa nijasa dmani ..
tadā bhagavatī tuṣṭā tālanaṃ balavattaram ..
mohayitvāśu tatpārśve preṣayāmāsa sarvagā .. 19 ..
3.3.d:
इति ध्यात्वा स कृष्णांशः सुष्वाप निजस द्मनि ॥
तदा भगवती तुष्टा तालनं बलवत्तरम् ॥
मोहयित्वाशु तत्पार्श्वे प्रेषयामास सर्वगा ॥ 19 ॥
3.3.m: Having thus meditated, that portion of Kṛṣṇa fell asleep in his own dwelling. / Then, being pleased, the omnipresent goddess / quickly enchanted the mighty Tālana and dispatched him to his side.

3.3.s:
caturlakṣabalaiḥ sārddhaṃ tālanaḥ śīghramāgataḥ ..
svasainyaṃ codayāmāsa caikalakṣaṃ mahābalam ..3.3.12.20..
3.3.d:
चतुर्लक्षबलैः सार्द्धं तालनः शीघ्रमागतः ॥
स्वसैन्यं चोदयामास चैकलक्षं महाबलम् ॥3.3.12.20॥
3.3.m: Along with a force of four hundred thousand, Tālana came swiftly. / He mobilized his own powerful army of one hundred thousand.

3.3.s:
balakhānistadā prāptaścaikalakṣabalānvitaḥ ..
anujaṃ tatra saṃsthāpya śirīṣākhye mahābalaḥ ..21..
3.3.d:
बलखानिस्तदा प्राप्तश्चैकलक्षबलान्वितः ॥
अनुजं तत्र संस्थाप्य शिरीषाख्ये महाबलः ॥21॥
3.3.m: Then Balakhāni arrived, accompanied by a force of one hundred thousand, / stationing his younger brother there in the city named Śirīṣa, very mighty.

3.3.s:
sajjībhūtānsamālokya tānudyāne sasainyakān ..
bhītaḥ parimalo rājā kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ prati cāyayau .. 22 ..
3.3.d:
सज्जीभूतान्समालोक्य तानुद्याने ससैन्यकान् ॥
भीतः परिमलो राजा कृष्णांशं प्रति चाययौ ॥ 22 ॥
3.3.m: Seeing them ready in the garden together with their troops, / King Parimala was terrified and went toward the portion of Kṛṣṇa.

3.3.s: vihvalaṃ nṛpamālokya kṛṣṇāṃśo''śvāsayanmudā .. 23 ..
3.3.d: विह्वलं नृपमालोक्य कृष्णांशो'ऽश्वासयन्मुदा ॥ 23 ॥
3.3.m: Seeing the king distressed, the portion of Kṛṣṇa joyfully comforted him.

3.3.s:
lakṣasainyaṃ tadīyaṃ ca gṛhītvā cādhipo'bhavat ..
śataghnyaḥ paṃcasāhasrā nānāvarṇāḥ suvāhanāḥ .. 24 ..
3.3.d:
लक्षसैन्यं तदीयं च गृहीत्वा चाधिपोऽभवत् ॥
शतघ्न्यः पंचसाहस्रा नानावर्णाः सुवाहनाः ॥ 24 ॥
3.3.m: Taking his army of one hundred thousand, he became its commander. / There were five thousand cannons of various colors, mounted on fine vehicles,

3.3.s:
patākāḥ pañcasāhasrāḥ sāhasraṃ kāṣṭhakāriṇaḥ ..
gajā daśasahasrāśca rathāḥ paṃcasahasrakāḥ .. 25 ..
3.3.d:
पताकाः पञ्चसाहस्राः साहस्रं काष्ठकारिणः ॥
गजा दशसहस्राश्च रथाः पंचसहस्रकाः ॥ 25 ॥
3.3.m: five thousand banners, a thousand wood-carpenters, / ten thousand elephants, and five thousand chariots,

3.3.s:
trilakṣāśca hayāḥ sarve uṣṭrā daśasahasrakāḥ ..
śeṣāḥ padātayo jñeyāsta sminsainye bhayānake .. 26 ..
3.3.d:
त्रिलक्षाश्च हयाः सर्वे उष्ट्रा दशसहस्रकाः ॥
शेषाः पदातयो ज्ञेयास्त स्मिन्सैन्ये भयानके ॥ 26 ॥
3.3.m: three hundred thousand horses in all, and ten thousand camels; / the rest in that dreadful army should be known as foot-soldiers.

3.3.s:
tālanaśca samāyātaḥ sarvasenādhipo'bhavat ..
devasiṃho rathānāṃ ca sarveṣāmīśvaro'bhavat .. 27 ..
3.3.d:
तालनश्च समायातः सर्वसेनाधिपोऽभवत् ॥
देवसिंहो रथानां च सर्वेषामीश्वरोऽभवत् ॥ 27 ॥
3.3.m: Having arrived, Tālana became the commander of the entire army; / Devasiṃha became the master of all the chariots;

3.3.s:
balakhānirhayānāṃ ca sarveṣāmadhipo'bhavat ..
āhlādaśca gajānāṃ ca sarveṣāmadhipo'bhavat ..
pattīnāṃ caiva sarveṣāṃ kṛṣṇāṃśaścādhipo'bhavat .. 28 ..
3.3.d:
बलखानिर्हयानां च सर्वेषामधिपोऽभवत् ॥
आह्लादश्च गजानां च सर्वेषामधिपोऽभवत् ॥
पत्तीनां चैव सर्वेषां कृष्णांशश्चाधिपोऽभवत् ॥ 28 ॥
3.3.m: Balakhāni became the master of all the horses; / Āhlāda became the master of all the elephants; / and the portion of Kṛṣṇa became the commander of all the foot-soldiers.

3.3.s:
natvā te malanāṃ bhūpo dattvā dānānyanekaśaḥ ..
samāyayuśca te sarve dakṣiṇāśāṃ balānvitāḥ .. 29 ..
3.3.d:
नत्वा ते मलनां भूपो दत्त्वा दानान्यनेकशः ॥
समाययुश्च ते सर्वे दक्षिणाशां बलान्विताः ॥ 29 ॥
3.3.m: Bowing to Malanā, the king gave gifts in great numbers. / And all of them, endowed with strength, set out toward the southern quarter.

3.3.s:
pakṣamātragataḥ kālo mārge tasminraṇaiṣiṇām ..
chittvā tatra vanaṃ ghoraṃ nānākaṃṭakasaṃyutam ..
senāṃ nivāsayāmāsurnirbhayāste mahābalāḥ .. 3.3.12.30 ..
3.3.d:
पक्षमात्रगतः कालो मार्गे तस्मिन्रणैषिणाम् ॥
छित्त्वा तत्र वनं घोरं नानाकंटकसंयुतम् ॥
सेनां निवासयामासुर्निर्भयास्ते महाबलाः ॥ 3.3.12.30 ॥
3.3.m: The time of just a fortnight elapsed on that march for those seeking battle. / Clearing a terrible forest there, filled with various thorns, / those very mighty men camped their army without fear.

3.3.s:
devasiṃhamatenaiva yoginaste tadābhavan ..
nartakaścaiva kṛṣṇāṃśaścāhlādo ḍamarupriyaḥ .. 31..
3.3.d:
देवसिंहमतेनैव योगिनस्ते तदाभवन् ॥
नर्तकश्चैव कृष्णांशश्चाह्लादो डमरुप्रियः ॥ 31॥
3.3.m: Following the counsel of Devasiṃha, they then became yogins: / the portion of Kṛṣṇa became a dancer, and Āhlāda took delight in the small drum;

3.3.s:
maḍḍudhārī tadā devo vīṇādhārī ca tālanaḥ ..
vatsajaḥ kāṃsyadhārī ca balakhānirmahābalaḥ .. 32 ..
3.3.d:
मड्डुधारी तदा देवो वीणाधारी च तालनः ॥
वत्सजः कांस्यधारी च बलखानिर्महाबलः ॥ 32 ॥
3.3.m: then Deva held the maḍḍu drum, Tālana held the vīṇā, / the son of Vatsa held the cymbals, and Balakhāni was exceedingly powerful.

3.3.s:
māturagre sthitāste vai nanṛtuḥ premavihvalāḥ..
mohitā devakī cāsīnna jñātaṃ tatra kāraṇam .. 33..
3.3.d:
मातुरग्रे स्थितास्ते वै ननृतुः प्रेमविह्वलाः॥
मोहिता देवकी चासीन्न ज्ञातं तत्र कारणम् ॥ 33॥
3.3.m: Standing before the mother, overcome with affection, they danced. / Devakī was enchanted and did not understand the cause.

3.3.s:
mohitāṃ mātaraṃ dṛṣṭvā paraṃ harṣamupāyayuḥ ..
tadā tāṃ kathayāmāsurvayaṃ te tanayā hi bhoḥ .. 34 ..
3.3.d:
मोहितां मातरं दृष्ट्वा परं हर्षमुपाययुः ॥
तदा तां कथयामासुर्वयं ते तनया हि भोः ॥ 34 ॥
3.3.m: Seeing the mother enchanted, they reached supreme joy; / then they said to her, "O Lady, we are indeed your sons!"

3.3.s:
natvā tāṃ prayayuḥ sarve purīṃ māhiṣmatīṃ śubhām ..
nagaraṃ mohayāmāsurvādyagānaviśāradāḥ .. 35 ..
3.3.d:
नत्वा तां प्रययुः सर्वे पुरीं माहिष्मतीं शुभाम् ॥
नगरं मोहयामासुर्वाद्यगानविशारदाः ॥ 35 ॥
3.3.m: Bowing to her, all of them went to the auspicious city of Māhiṣmatī. / Skilled in instrumental music and singing, they enchanted the city.

3.3.s:
dūtyā sārddhaṃ riporgehaṃ yayuste kāryatatparāḥ ..
nṛtyagānasuvādyaiśca rājñaste mohane ratāḥ .. 36 ..
3.3.d:
दूत्या सार्द्धं रिपोर्गेहं ययुस्ते कार्यतत्पराः ॥
नृत्यगानसुवाद्यैश्च राज्ञस्ते मोहने रताः ॥ 36 ॥
3.3.m: Intent on their duty, they went to the enemy's house accompanied by a female messenger; / and with dancing, singing, and fine instruments they engaged in captivating the queen.

3.3.s:
visaṃjñāṃ mahiṣīṃ kṛtvā kṛṣṇāṃśaḥ sarvamohanaḥ ..
prāptavāṃstatra yatrāsau tatsutā vijayaiṣiṇī .. 37 ..
3.3.d:
विसंज्ञां महिषीं कृत्वा कृष्णांशः सर्वमोहनः ॥
प्राप्तवांस्तत्र यत्रासौ तत्सुता विजयैषिणी ॥ 37 ॥
3.3.m: Having rendered the chief queen unconscious, that portion of Kṛṣṇa who enchants all / arrived there where his daughter was, she who desired victory.

3.3.s:
dṛṣṭvā sā suṃdaraṃ rūpaṃ śyāmāṃgaṃ puruṣottamam ..
mumoha vaśamāpannā maithunārthaṃ samudyatā .. 38 ..
3.3.d:
दृष्ट्वा सा सुंदरं रूपं श्यामांगं पुरुषोत्तमम् ॥
मुमोह वशमापन्ना मैथुनार्थं समुद्यता ॥ 38 ॥
3.3.m: Seeing his handsome form, dark-complexioned, the supreme man, / she was enchanted, fell under his power, and became eager for love-making.

3.3.s:
dṛṣṭvā tathā gatāṃ nārīṃ kṛṣṇāṃśaḥ ślakṣṇayā girā ..
śatrorbhedaṃ ca papraccha kāminīṃ madavihvalām ..39..
3.3.d:
दृष्ट्वा तथा गतां नारीं कृष्णांशः श्लक्ष्णया गिरा ॥
शत्रोर्भेदं च पप्रच्छ कामिनीं मदविह्वलाम् ॥39॥
3.3.m: Seeing the woman in such a state, the portion of Kṛṣṇa with gentle words / inquired into the secrets of the enemy from the passionate woman overcome with desire.

3.3.s:
sāha bho devakīputra yadi pāṇiṃ grahīṣyasi..
tarhi te kathayiṣyāmi piturbhedaṃ hi dāruṇam .. 3.3.12.40 ..
3.3.d:
साह भो देवकीपुत्र यदि पाणिं ग्रहीष्यसि॥
तर्हि ते कथयिष्यामि पितुर्भेदं हि दारुणम् ॥ 3.3.12.40 ॥
3.3.m: She said: "O son of Devakī, if you take my hand [in marriage], / then I will reveal to you the formidable secrets of my father!"

3.3.s:
tathetyuktvā sa balavām̐stasyāḥ pāṇiṃ gṛhītavān ..
jñātvā bhedaṃ ripoḥ sarvaṃ tāmāśvāsya yayau mudā ..41..
3.3.d:
तथेत्युक्त्वा स बलवाम्̐स्तस्याः पाणिं गृहीतवान् ॥
ज्ञात्वा भेदं रिपोः सर्वं तामाश्वास्य ययौ मुदा ॥41॥
3.3.m: "So be it," said the mighty one, and took her hand. / Knowing all the enemy's secrets, he consoled her and departed with joy.

3.3.s:
etasminnantare rājñī bādhitā prāha yoginam ..
deśarājapriyāhāraṃ navalakṣasya mūlyakam ..
tubhyaṃ dāsyāmi saṃtuṣṭā nṛtyagānavimohitā .. 42 ..
3.3.d:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे राज्ञी बाधिता प्राह योगिनम् ॥
देशराजप्रियाहारं नवलक्षस्य मूल्यकम् ॥
तुभ्यं दास्यामि संतुष्टा नृत्यगानविमोहिता ॥ 42 ॥
3.3.m: Meanwhile, the queen, having regained her senses, said to the yogin: / "Delighted and enchanted by your dancing and singing, / I will give you the necklace dear to Deśarāja, worth nine hundred thousand."

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā vatsasutastāṃ praśasya gṛhītavān ..
prayayau baṃdhubhiḥ sārddhaṃ jambūko yatra tiṣṭhati .. 43 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा वत्ससुतस्तां प्रशस्य गृहीतवान् ॥
प्रययौ बंधुभिः सार्द्धं जम्बूको यत्र तिष्ठति ॥ 43 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing this, the son of Vatsa praised her and accepted it. / Together with his kinsmen, he went to where Jambūka stayed.

3.3.s:
nanarta tatra kṛṣṇāṃśo balakhāniragāyata ..
āhlādastālano devo dadhmurvādyagatīrmudā .. 44 ..
3.3.d:
ननर्त तत्र कृष्णांशो बलखानिरगायत ॥
आह्लादस्तालनो देवो दध्मुर्वाद्यगतीर्मुदा ॥ 44 ॥
3.3.m: There the portion of Kṛṣṇa danced, Balakhāni sang, / and Āhlāda, Tālana, and Deva joyfully sounded the rhythms of musical instruments.

3.3.s:
mohito'bhūnnṛpastatra kāliyaḥ svajanaiḥ saha ..
kāmaṃ varaya kṛṣṇāṃga yacca te hṛdaye sthitam .. 45 ..
3.3.d:
मोहितोऽभून्नृपस्तत्र कालियः स्वजनैः सह ॥
कामं वरय कृष्णांग यच्च ते हृदये स्थितम् ॥ 45 ॥
3.3.m: King Kāliya was enchanted there along with his people: / "Choose a boon at will, O dark-limbed youth, whatever rests in your heart!"

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā vacaḥ śatrorbalakhānirmahābalaḥ ..
tamāha bho mahīpāla lakṣāvartirvarāṃganā ..
svavidyāṃ darśayenmahyaṃ tadā tṛptiṃ vrajāmyaham .. 46 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा वचः शत्रोर्बलखानिर्महाबलः ॥
तमाह भो महीपाल लक्षावर्तिर्वरांगना ॥
स्वविद्यां दर्शयेन्मह्यं तदा तृप्तिं व्रजाम्यहम् ॥ 46 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing this speech of the enemy, the mighty Balakhāni / said to him: "O King, if the excellent woman Lakṣāvarti / shows me her art, then I shall be satisfied."

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā tathā matvā lakṣāvartiṃ nṛpottamaḥ ..
sabhāyāṃ nartayāmāsa deśarājapriyāṃ tathā .. 47 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा तथा मत्वा लक्षावर्तिं नृपोत्तमः ॥
सभायां नर्तयामास देशराजप्रियां तथा ॥ 47 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing this, and agreeing to it, that best of kings / made Lakṣāvarti, the beloved of Deśarāja, dance in the assembly.

3.3.s:
sā veśyā sutamāhlādaṃ jñātvā yogitvamāgatam ..
ruroda tatra duḥkhārtā netrādaśrūṇi muṃcatī .. 48 ..
3.3.d:
सा वेश्या सुतमाह्लादं ज्ञात्वा योगित्वमागतम् ॥
रुरोद तत्र दुःखार्ता नेत्रादश्रूणि मुंचती ॥ 48 ॥
3.3.m: Recognizing that her son Āhlāda had assumed the state of a yogin, that courtesan / wept there, overcome with grief, shedding tears from her eyes.

3.3.s:
ruditāṃ tāṃ samālokya rudannāhlāda eva saḥ ..
svabhujau tāḍayāmāsa tatpriyārthe mahābalaḥ .. 49 ..
3.3.d:
रुदितां तां समालोक्य रुदन्नाह्लाद एव सः ॥
स्वभुजौ ताडयामास तत्प्रियार्थे महाबलः ॥ 49 ॥
3.3.m: Seeing her weeping, Āhlāda himself wept / and, for the sake of his beloved [mother], that mighty one beat his own arms.

3.3.s:
kṛṣṇāṃśastatra taṃ hāraṃ tasyāḥ kaṃṭhe pradattavān ..
uvāca krodhatāmrākṣastāmāśvāsya punaḥpunaḥ .. 3.3.12.50 ..
3.3.d:
कृष्णांशस्तत्र तं हारं तस्याः कंठे प्रदत्तवान् ॥
उवाच क्रोधताम्राक्षस्तामाश्वास्य पुनःपुनः ॥ 3.3.12.50 ॥
3.3.m: There the portion of Kṛṣṇa placed that necklace upon her neck; / and with eyes red with fury, comforting her again and again, he said:

3.3.s:
ahaṃ codayasiṃho'yaṃ piturvairārthamāgataḥ ..
haniṣyāmi ripuṃ bhūpaṃ sātmajaṃ sabalaṃ tathā .. 51 ..
3.3.d:
अहं चोदयसिंहोऽयं पितुर्वैरार्थमागतः ॥
हनिष्यामि रिपुं भूपं सात्मजं सबलं तथा ॥ 51 ॥
3.3.m: "I, Udayasiṃha, have come for revenge on behalf of my father! / I will kill the enemy king, along with his son and his army!"

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā vacastasya kāliyo balavattaraḥ ..
piturājñāṃ puraskṛtya śatavyūhasamanvitaḥ .. 52 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा वचस्तस्य कालियो बलवत्तरः ॥
पितुराज्ञां पुरस्कृत्य शतव्यूहसमन्वितः ॥ 52 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing these words of his, the very powerful Kāliya, / carrying out his father's command, accompanied by a hundred battle-arrays,

3.3.s:
teṣāṃ ca baṃdhanāyaiva kapāṭaṃ samaruddha saḥ ..
tāñchatrūnsamanujñāya pāśahastānsaśastragān ..53..
3.3.d:
तेषां च बंधनायैव कपाटं समरुद्ध सः ॥
ताञ्छत्रून्समनुज्ञाय पाशहस्तान्सशस्त्रगान् ॥53॥
3.3.m: shut the doors in order to bind them. / Having commanded those enemies armed with weapons and nooses in hand,

3.3.s:
svaṃsvaṃ khaḍgaṃ samākṛṣya kṣatriyāste samāghnata ..
śataśūre hate taiśca kāliyo bhayakātaraḥ .. 54 ..
3.3.d:
स्वंस्वं खड्गं समाकृष्य क्षत्रियास्ते समाघ्नत ॥
शतशूरे हते तैश्च कालियो भयकातरः ॥ 54 ॥
3.3.m: those kṣatriyas drew their respective swords and struck. / And when a hundred warriors were slain by them, Kāliya was agitated with fear.

3.3.s:
tyaktvā tātaṃ pradudrāva te tu gehādbahiryayuḥ ..
svasainyaṃ śīghramāsādya yuddhāya samupasthitaḥ ..
śibirāṇi kṛtānyeva narmadākūlamāsthitaiḥ .. 55 ..
3.3.d:
त्यक्त्वा तातं प्रदुद्राव ते तु गेहाद्बहिर्ययुः ॥
स्वसैन्यं शीघ्रमासाद्य युद्धाय समुपस्थितः ॥
शिबिराणि कृतान्येव नर्मदाकूलमास्थितैः ॥ 55 ॥
3.3.m: Leaving his father, he fled, while they went out of the house. / Having quickly reached his army, he stood ready for battle; / encampments were indeed made by those stationed on the bank of the Narmadā.

3.3.s:
kṛtvā tu narmadāsetuṃ nalvamātraṃ supuṣṭidam ..
svasainyaṃ tārayāmāsa caturaṃgasamanvitam .. 56 ..
3.3.d:
कृत्वा तु नर्मदासेतुं नल्वमात्रं सुपुष्टिदम् ॥
स्वसैन्यं तारयामास चतुरंगसमन्वितम् ॥ 56 ॥
3.3.m: Having constructed a bridge over the Narmadā, one nalva across and very solid, / he made his fourfold army cross over.

3.3.s:
rurodha nagarīṃ sarvāṃ balakhānirbalairyutaḥ ..
śataghnīragrataḥ kṛtvā mahāśabdakarīstadā ..
māhiṣmatyāśca harmyāṇi pātayāmāsa bhūtale .. 57 ..
3.3.d:
रुरोध नगरीं सर्वां बलखानिर्बलैर्युतः ॥
शतघ्नीरग्रतः कृत्वा महाशब्दकरीस्तदा ॥
माहिष्मत्याश्च हर्म्याणि पातयामास भूतले ॥ 57 ॥
3.3.m: Balakhāni, accompanied by his troops, besieged the entire city. / Having placed cannons in front, which made a tremendous noise, / he then brought down the mansions of Māhiṣmatī to the ground.

3.3.s:
narāśca svakulaiḥ sārddhaṃ mukhyadravyasamanvitāḥ ..
viṃdhyādreśca guhāṃ prāpya tatroṣurbhayakātarāḥ .. 58 ..
3.3.d:
नराश्च स्वकुलैः सार्द्धं मुख्यद्रव्यसमन्विताः ॥
विंध्याद्रेश्च गुहां प्राप्य तत्रोषुर्भयकातराः ॥ 58 ॥
3.3.m: And the men, along with their families and taking their most precious belongings, / reached the caves of Mount Vindhya and stayed there, trembling with fear.

3.3.s:
kāliyastu gajānīke paṃcaśabdagaje sthitaḥ ..
hastipā daśasāhasrā yuddhāya samupāyayuḥ .. 59 ..
3.3.d:
कालियस्तु गजानीके पंचशब्दगजे स्थितः ॥
हस्तिपा दशसाहस्रा युद्धाय समुपाययुः ॥ 59 ॥
3.3.m: Kāliya, however, stood amidst his elephant division upon the elephant Pañcaśabda; / ten thousand elephant-drivers advanced for battle.

3.3.s:
tasyānujaḥ sūryavarmā trilakṣaisturagairyutaḥ ..
tuṃdilaśca rathaiḥ sārddhaṃ rathasthaśca sahasrakaiḥ .. 3.3.12.60 ..
3.3.d:
तस्यानुजः सूर्यवर्मा त्रिलक्षैस्तुरगैर्युतः ॥
तुंदिलश्च रथैः सार्द्धं रथस्थश्च सहस्रकैः ॥ 3.3.12.60 ॥
3.3.m: His younger brother Sūryavarman was accompanied by three hundred thousand horses, / and Tuṇḍila, mounted on a chariot, was accompanied by thousands of chariots.

3.3.s:
raṃkaṇo vaṃkaṇaścobhau caturlakṣapadātibhiḥ ..
jagmatustau mahāmlecchau mlecchabhūpasahasrakaiḥ ..
dākṣiṇātyagrāmapāste tau puraskṛtya saṃyayuḥ ..61..
3.3.d:
रंकणो वंकणश्चोभौ चतुर्लक्षपदातिभिः ॥
जग्मतुस्तौ महाम्लेच्छौ म्लेच्छभूपसहस्रकैः ॥
दाक्षिणात्यग्रामपास्ते तौ पुरस्कृत्य संययुः ॥61॥
3.3.m: Both Raṅkaṇa and Vaṅkaṇa, accompanied by four hundred thousand foot-soldiers, / those two great foreigners marched with thousands of foreign kings; / and the southern village heads advanced, placing those two at their head.

3.3.s:
ubhe sene samāsādya yuddhāya samupasthite ..
tayośca tumulayuddhamabhavallomaharṣaṇam ..62..
3.3.d:
उभे सेने समासाद्य युद्धाय समुपस्थिते ॥
तयोश्च तुमुलयुद्धमभवल्लोमहर्षणम् ॥62॥
3.3.m: Both armies, having approached, stood ready for battle, / and between them arose a tumultuous, hair-raising battle.

3.3.s:
triyāme rudhiraisteṣāṃ nadī prāvartata drutam ..
dṛṣṭvāsrajāṃ nadīṃ ghorāṃ māṃsakardamavāhinīm ..
balakhānirameyātmā khaṅgapāṇirnaro yayau .. 63 ..
3.3.d:
त्रियामे रुधिरैस्तेषां नदी प्रावर्तत द्रुतम् ॥
दृष्ट्वास्रजां नदीं घोरां मांसकर्दमवाहिनीम् ॥
बलखानिरमेयात्मा खङ्गपाणिर्नरो ययौ ॥ 63 ॥
3.3.m: Within three hours, a river quickly began to flow with their blood. / Beholding that terrible river of blood carrying mud of flesh, / the man Balakhāni, of boundless spirit, sword in hand, advanced.

3.3.s:
bhallahastastadā devo manorathahaye sthitaḥ ..
biṃdulasthaśca kṛṣṇāṃśaḥ khaṅgenaiva ripūnahan .. 64 ..
3.3.d:
भल्लहस्तस्तदा देवो मनोरथहये स्थितः ॥
बिंदुलस्थश्च कृष्णांशः खङ्गेनैव रिपूनहन् ॥ 64 ॥
3.3.m: Then Deva, holding a spear, mounted on his horse Manoratha, / and the incarnation of Kṛṣṇa, mounted on Bindula, struck down the foes with his sword alone.

3.3.s:
āhlādaśca gadāhastaḥ pothayāmāsa vāhinīm ..
rūpaṇo nāma śūdraśca śaktihastonyahanripūn ..
tālano hastanistriṃśo māhiṣmatyāṃ hananyayau .. 65 ..
3.3.d:
आह्लादश्च गदाहस्तः पोथयामास वाहिनीम् ॥
रूपणो नाम शूद्रश्च शक्तिहस्तोन्यहन्रिपून् ॥
तालनो हस्तनिस्त्रिंशो माहिष्मत्यां हनन्ययौ ॥ 65 ॥
3.3.m: And Āhlāda, mace in hand, crushed the army; / a Śūdra named Rūpaṇa, lance in hand, slew the enemies; / and Tālana, sword in hand, went forth striking them down in Māhiṣmatī.

3.3.s:
evaṃ mahābhaye jāte raṇe tasminmahābale ..
dudruvuḥ sarvato vīrāḥ pāhipāhītyathābruvan .. 66 ..
3.3.d:
एवं महाभये जाते रणे तस्मिन्महाबले ॥
दुद्रुवुः सर्वतो वीराः पाहिपाहीत्यथाब्रुवन् ॥ 66 ॥
3.3.m: When such great terror arose in that mighty battle, / heroes fled in every direction, shouting, 'Save us! Save us!'

3.3.s:
prabhagnaṃ svabalaṃ dṛṣṭvā kāliyo balakhānikam ..
gajasthastāḍayāmāsa svabāṇaistaṃ mahābalaḥ .. 67 ..
3.3.d:
प्रभग्नं स्वबलं दृष्ट्वा कालियो बलखानिकम् ॥
गजस्थस्ताडयामास स्वबाणैस्तं महाबलः ॥ 67 ॥
3.3.m: Seeing his army broken, the mighty Kāliya, mounted on his elephant, / struck Balakhāni with his arrows.

3.3.s:
hariṇī vaḍavā tasya jñātvā svāminamāturam ..
gajopari samāsthāya svapādaistamapātayat .. 68 ..
3.3.d:
हरिणी वडवा तस्य ज्ञात्वा स्वामिनमातुरम् ॥
गजोपरि समास्थाय स्वपादैस्तमपातयत् ॥ 68 ॥
3.3.m: His mare Hariṇī, recognizing that her master was distressed, / sprang upon the elephant and brought him down with her hooves.

3.3.s:
patite kāliye vīre paṃcaśabdo mahāgajaḥ ..
śṛṃkhalaistāḍayāmāsa śūrāṃstānmadamattakān.. .. 69 ..
3.3.d:
पतिते कालिये वीरे पंचशब्दो महागजः ॥
शृंखलैस्ताडयामास शूरांस्तान्मदमत्तकान्॥ ॥ 69 ॥
3.3.m: When the heroic Kāliya fell, the great elephant Pañcaśabda / struck those heroes, frenzied with rut, with his chains.

3.3.s:
mūrcchite paṃcaśūre tu rūpaṇo bhayakātaraḥ ..
devakīṃ varṇayāmāsa yathājātaṃ gajena vai ..3.3.12.70..
3.3.d:
मूर्च्छिते पंचशूरे तु रूपणो भयकातरः ॥
देवकीं वर्णयामास यथाजातं गजेन वै ॥3.3.12.70॥
3.3.m: When the five heroes were rendered unconscious, Rūpaṇa, overcome with fear, / recounted to Devakī what had indeed been done by the elephant.

3.3.s:
tadā tu duḥkhitā devī dolāmāruhya satvarā ..
taṃ gajaṃ ca samāsādya varṇayāmāsa kāraṇam .. 71 ..
3.3.d:
तदा तु दुःखिता देवी दोलामारुह्य सत्वरा ॥
तं गजं च समासाद्य वर्णयामास कारणम् ॥ 71 ॥
3.3.m: Then the distressed queen, quickly mounting a palanquin / and approaching that elephant, explained the matter:

3.3.s:
gajarāja namastubhyaṃ śakradatta mahābala ..
ete putrāstu te vīra pālanīyā yathā pituḥ ..72..
3.3.d:
गजराज नमस्तुभ्यं शक्रदत्त महाबल ॥
एते पुत्रास्तु ते वीर पालनीया यथा पितुः ॥72॥
3.3.m: 'O king of elephants, praise be to you, gifted by Indra, possessed of great strength! / These are your sons, O hero, and are to be protected just as by a father.'

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā divyagajo devamāyāviśāradaḥ ..
devakīṃ śaraṇaṃ prāpya kṣamasvāgaskṛtaṃ mama .. 73 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा दिव्यगजो देवमायाविशारदः ॥
देवकीं शरणं प्राप्य क्षमस्वागस्कृतं मम ॥ 73 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing this, the celestial elephant, skilled in divine illusion, / sought refuge with Devakī, [saying,] 'Forgive my offence!'

3.3.s:
ityukte gajarāje tu kṛṣṇāṃśo balavattaraḥ ..
tyaktvā mūrcchāṃ yayau tatra yatrāhlādaśca mūrcchitaḥ .. 74 ..
3.3.d:
इत्युक्ते गजराजे तु कृष्णांशो बलवत्तरः ॥
त्यक्त्वा मूर्च्छां ययौ तत्र यत्राह्लादश्च मूर्च्छितः ॥ 74 ॥
3.3.m: When this was spoken by the king of elephants, the exceedingly strong incarnation of Kṛṣṇa, / casting off his swoon, went there where Āhlāda lay unconscious.

3.3.s:
tamutthāpya karasparśairbalakhānisamanvitaḥ ..
piturgajaṃ mahāmattamāhlādāya pradattavān ..
karāla mandaṃ smitaṃ rūpaṇāya tadā dadau .. 75 ..
3.3.d:
तमुत्थाप्य करस्पर्शैर्बलखानिसमन्वितः ॥
पितुर्गजं महामत्तमाह्लादाय प्रदत्तवान् ॥
कराल मन्दं स्मितं रूपणाय तदा ददौ ॥ 75 ॥
3.3.m: Rousing him with the touch of his hands, together with Balakhāni, / he gave their father's fiercely rutting elephant to Āhlāda, / and Karāla then gave a faint smile to Rūpaṇa.

3.3.s:
mūrcchitaṃ kāliyaṃ śatruṃ baddhvā sa nigaḍairdṛḍhaiḥ ..
senāntaṃ preṣayāmāsa balakhānirmahābalaḥ .. 76 ..
3.3.d:
मूर्च्छितं कालियं शत्रुं बद्ध्वा स निगडैर्दृढैः ॥
सेनान्तं प्रेषयामास बलखानिर्महाबलः ॥ 76 ॥
3.3.m: Binding the swooned enemy Kāliya with firm iron fetters, / the mighty Balakhāni sent him to the rear of the army.

3.3.s:
sūryavarmā tadā jñātvā baddhaṃ baṃdhuṃ ca kāliyam ..
prayayau śatrusenāntaṃ krodhena sphuritādharaḥ .. 77 ..
3.3.d:
सूर्यवर्मा तदा ज्ञात्वा बद्धं बंधुं च कालियम् ॥
प्रययौ शत्रुसेनान्तं क्रोधेन स्फुरिताधरः ॥ 77 ॥
3.3.m: Then Sūryavarman, learning that his kinsman Kāliya was captured, / advanced toward the front of the enemy army, his lips trembling with rage.

3.3.s:
tamāyāntaṃ samālokya te vīrā yuddhadurmadāḥ ..
rathasthaṃ maṃḍalīkṛtya svasvamastraṃ samākṣipan .. 78 ..
3.3.d:
तमायान्तं समालोक्य ते वीरा युद्धदुर्मदाः ॥
रथस्थं मंडलीकृत्य स्वस्वमस्त्रं समाक्षिपन् ॥ 78 ॥
3.3.m: Seeing him arriving, those heroes fierce in combat, / having encircled him as he stood on his chariot, discharged their weapons.

3.3.s:
kuṃṭhite'stre tadā teṣāṃ vismitāste'bhavanmune ..
cintāṃ ca mahatīṃ prāptāḥ kathaṃ vadhyo bhavedayam .. 79 ..
3.3.d:
कुंठितेऽस्त्रे तदा तेषां विस्मितास्तेऽभवन्मुने ॥
चिन्तां च महतीं प्राप्ताः कथं वध्यो भवेदयम् ॥ 79 ॥
3.3.m: When their weapons were blunted, O sage, they were astonished, / and they fell into great anxiety: 'How can this man be slain?'

3.3.s:
tasyāstraiste mahāvīrā vraṇārtibhayapīḍitāḥ ..
tyaktvā yuddhaṃ punargatvā raṇaṃ cakruḥ punaḥpunaḥ .. 3.3.12.80 ..
3.3.d:
तस्यास्त्रैस्ते महावीरा व्रणार्तिभयपीडिताः ॥
त्यक्त्वा युद्धं पुनर्गत्वा रणं चक्रुः पुनःपुनः ॥ 3.3.12.80 ॥
3.3.m: Afflicted by the pain of wounds and dread from his weapons, those great heroes, / having abandoned the fight, returned again and fought repeatedly.

3.3.s:
evaṃ kati dinānyeva babhūva raṇa uttamaḥ ..
āhlādo vatsajo devastālano bhayasaṃyutaḥ ..
kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ śaraṇaṃ jagmustena vīreṇa mohitāḥ .. 81 ..
3.3.d:
एवं कति दिनान्येव बभूव रण उत्तमः ॥
आह्लादो वत्सजो देवस्तालनो भयसंयुतः ॥
कृष्णांशं शरणं जग्मुस्तेन वीरेण मोहिताः ॥ 81 ॥
3.3.m: Thus for several days a magnificent battle took place. / Āhlāda, Deva born of Vatsa, and Tālana, filled with fear, / bewildered by that hero, sought refuge with the incarnation of Kṛṣṇa.

3.3.s:
kṛṣṇastu taṃ tathā dṛṣṭvā devīṃ viśvavimohinīm ..
tuṣṭāva manasā vīro rātrisūktaṃ paṭhanhṛdi .. 82 ..
3.3.d:
कृष्णस्तु तं तथा दृष्ट्वा देवीं विश्वविमोहिनीम् ॥
तुष्टाव मनसा वीरो रात्रिसूक्तं पठन्हृदि ॥ 82 ॥
3.3.m: And Kṛṣṇa, seeing him thus, the hero praised in his mind / the Goddess who bewilders the universe, reciting the Rātrisūkta in his heart.

3.3.s:
tadā tuṣṭā jagaddhātrī durgā durgārtināśinī ..
mohayitvā tu taṃ vīraṃ tatraivāṃtaradhīyataḥ ..83..
3.3.d:
तदा तुष्टा जगद्धात्री दुर्गा दुर्गार्तिनाशिनी ॥
मोहयित्वा तु तं वीरं तत्रैवांतरधीयतः ॥83॥
3.3.m: Then Durgā, the sustainer of the world, destroyer of distress, pleased, / bewildered that hero and vanished right there.

3.3.s:
nidrayā mohitaṃ dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇāṃśastu mahābalaḥ ..
babaṃdha nigaḍaistaṃ ca devakyante samāgamat .. 84 ..
3.3.d:
निद्रया मोहितं दृष्ट्वा कृष्णांशस्तु महाबलः ॥
बबंध निगडैस्तं च देवक्यन्ते समागमत् ॥ 84 ॥
3.3.m: Seeing him bewildered by sleep, the mighty incarnation of Kṛṣṇa / bound him with iron fetters and went into the presence of Devakī.

3.3.s:
tuṃdilaśca tathā jñātvā bhātṛśokapariplutaḥ ..
ājagāma hayārūḍhaḥ khaṅgahasto mahābalaḥ ..
ripusainyasya madhye tu bahuśūrānatāḍayat .. 85 ..
3.3.d:
तुंदिलश्च तथा ज्ञात्वा भातृशोकपरिप्लुतः ॥
आजगाम हयारूढः खङ्गहस्तो महाबलः ॥
रिपुसैन्यस्य मध्ये तु बहुशूरानताडयत् ॥ 85 ॥
3.3.m: And Tuṇḍila, learning of this, overwhelmed with grief for his brother, / mounted a horse, sword in hand, mighty in strength, and came forth; / he struck down many champions in the midst of the enemy army.

3.3.s:
māhiṣmatyāśca te śūrā raṃkaṇena samanvitāḥ ..
tatsainyaṃ bhañjayāmāsustālanena prapālitam .. 86 ..
3.3.d:
माहिष्मत्याश्च ते शूरा रंकणेन समन्विताः ॥
तत्सैन्यं भञ्जयामासुस्तालनेन प्रपालितम् ॥ 86 ॥
3.3.m: And those champions of Māhiṣmatī, together with Raṅkaṇa, / routed that army protected by Tālana.

3.3.s:
pradrutaṃ svaṃ balaṃ dṛṣṭvā tālanaḥ parighāyudhaḥ ..
śirāṃsi pothayāmāsa mlecchānāṃ ca pṛthakpṛthak .. 87 ..
3.3.d:
प्रद्रुतं स्वं बलं दृष्ट्वा तालनः परिघायुधः ॥
शिरांसि पोथयामास म्लेच्छानां च पृथक्पृथक् ॥ 87 ॥
3.3.m: Seeing his own army fleeing, Tālana, armed with an iron club, / crushed the heads of the foreigners one by one.

3.3.s:
vaṃkaṇaṃ ca tathā hatvā khaḍgenaiva ca raṃkaṇam ..
tuṃdilaṃ ca tathā baddhvā dinānte śibiraṃ yayau ..88..
3.3.d:
वंकणं च तथा हत्वा खड्गेनैव च रंकणम् ॥
तुंदिलं च तथा बद्ध्वा दिनान्ते शिबिरं ययौ ॥88॥
3.3.m: Having slain Vaṅkaṇa and Raṅkaṇa with his sword, / and having bound Tuṇḍila, he went to the camp at the close of the day.

3.3.s:
kāliye ca ripau baddhe subaddhe sūryavarmaṇi ..
tuṃdile ca tathā baddhe raṃkaṇe vaṃkaṇe hate .. 89 ..
3.3.d:
कालिये च रिपौ बद्धे सुबद्धे सूर्यवर्मणि ॥
तुंदिले च तथा बद्धे रंकणे वंकणे हते ॥ 89 ॥
3.3.m: When the enemy Kāliya was bound, Sūryavarman securely bound, / Tuṇḍila likewise bound, and Raṅkaṇa and Vaṅkaṇa slain,

3.3.s:
sahasraṃ mleccharājāno hataśeṣā balānvitāḥ ..
pakṣamātramahorātraṃ yuddhaṃ cakruḥ samaṃtataḥ .. 3.3.12.90 ..
3.3.d:
सहस्रं म्लेच्छराजानो हतशेषा बलान्विताः ॥
पक्षमात्रमहोरात्रं युद्धं चक्रुः समंततः ॥ 3.3.12.90 ॥
3.3.m: the thousand foreign kings, the powerful remnants of the slaughtered, / fought on all sides for a full fortnight, day and night.

3.3.s:
pratyahaṃ tālano vīraḥ senāpatiramarṣaṇaḥ ..
ṣaṣṭiṃ bhūpāñjaghānāśu śatrusainyabhayaṃkaraḥ .. 91 ..
3.3.d:
प्रत्यहं तालनो वीरः सेनापतिरमर्षणः ॥
षष्टिं भूपाञ्जघानाशु शत्रुसैन्यभयंकरः ॥ 91 ॥
3.3.m: Every day the heroic Tālana, the indignant commander of the army, / terrifying to the hostile forces, swiftly slew sixty kings.

3.3.s:
bhayabhītā ripoḥ śūrā hatā bhūpā hataujasaḥ ..
hataśeṣā yayurgehamarddhasainyā bhayāturāḥ .. 92 ..
3.3.d:
भयभीता रिपोः शूरा हता भूपा हतौजसः ॥
हतशेषा ययुर्गेहमर्द्धसैन्या भयातुराः ॥ 92 ॥
3.3.m: Terrified, the enemy champions and kings were slain, their vigour crushed; / the surviving half of the army, tormented by fear, fled home.

3.3.s:
jambukastu tathā śrutvā duḥkhito gehamāyayau ..
vrataṃ hyanaśanaṃ kṛtvā rātrau śocannaśeta saḥ .. 93 ..
3.3.d:
जम्बुकस्तु तथा श्रुत्वा दुःखितो गेहमाययौ ॥
व्रतं ह्यनशनं कृत्वा रात्रौ शोचन्नशेत सः ॥ 93 ॥
3.3.m: And Jambuka, hearing this, came home in sorrow; / observing a fast, he lay down at night, lamenting.

3.3.s:
niśīthe samanuprāpte tatsutā vijayaiṣiṇī ..
pūrṇā tu sā kalā jñeyā rādhāyā vrajavāsinī ..94..
3.3.d:
निशीथे समनुप्राप्ते तत्सुता विजयैषिणी ॥
पूर्णा तु सा कला ज्ञेया राधाया व्रजवासिनी ॥94॥
3.3.m: When midnight arrived, his daughter, who desired victory / — and who should be recognized as a full portion of Rādhā residing in Vraja —

3.3.s:
āśvāsya pitaraṃ taṃ ca yayau māyāviśāradā ..
rakṣakāñchivirāṇāṃ ca mohayitvā samāyayau .. 99 ..
3.3.d:
आश्वास्य पितरं तं च ययौ मायाविशारदा ॥
रक्षकाञ्छिविराणां च मोहयित्वा समाययौ ॥ 99 ॥
3.3.m: having comforted her father, departed, skilled in illusion; / and having bewildered the guards of the camps, she arrived.

3.3.s:
bhrātaro tatra gatvāsau yatra sarvānabodhayat ..
kṛtvā sā rākṣasīṃ māyāṃ paṃcavīrānamohayat .. 96 ..
3.3.d:
भ्रातरो तत्र गत्वासौ यत्र सर्वानबोधयत् ॥
कृत्वा सा राक्षसीं मायां पंचवीरानमोहयत् ॥ 96 ॥
3.3.m: Going there where her brothers were, she awakened none of them; / employing demoniac Māyā, she bewildered the five heroes.

3.3.s:
nirastrakavacānbaṃdhūnpratidolāṃ samāruhat ..
pituraṃtikamāsādya tasmai bhrātṛndadau mudā ..97..
3.3.d:
निरस्त्रकवचान्बंधून्प्रतिदोलां समारुहत् ॥
पितुरंतिकमासाद्य तस्मै भ्रातृन्ददौ मुदा ॥97॥
3.3.m: She mounted a litter alongside her kinsmen, who were stripped of their weapons and armour. / Approaching her father, she joyfully gave the brothers to him.

3.3.s:
prabhāte bodhitāḥ sarve snānadhyānādikāḥ kriyāḥ ..
kṛtvā yayū ripoḥ śālāṃ dṛṣṭavanto na tāṃstadā .. 98..
3.3.d:
प्रभाते बोधिताः सर्वे स्नानध्यानादिकाः क्रियाः ॥
कृत्वा ययू रिपोः शालां दृष्टवन्तो न तांस्तदा ॥ 98॥
3.3.m: In the morning, they were all awakened. Having performed their rites such as bathing and meditation, / they went to the enemy's camp, but then they did not see them.

3.3.s:
babhūburduḥkhitāḥ sarve kimidaṃ kāraṇaṃ katham ..
tānuvāca tadā devaḥ prāptā hyatra ripoḥ sutā .. 99 ..
3.3.d:
बभूबुर्दुःखिताः सर्वे किमिदं कारणं कथम् ॥
तानुवाच तदा देवः प्राप्ता ह्यत्र रिपोः सुता ॥ 99 ॥
3.3.m: They were all grief-stricken: "What is the cause of this? How [could this happen]?" / Then the Lord spoke to them: "Indeed, the enemy's daughter arrived here.

3.3.s:
kṛtvā sā rākṣasīṃ māyāṃ hṛtvā tāngehamāyayau ..
tasmādyūyaṃ mayā sārddhaṃ gatvā yatraiva tadguruḥ .. .. 3.3.12.100 ..
3.3.d:
कृत्वा सा राक्षसीं मायां हृत्वा तान्गेहमाययौ ॥
तस्माद्यूयं मया सार्द्धं गत्वा यत्रैव तद्गुरुः ॥ ॥ 3.3.12.100 ॥
3.3.m: Employing demoniac Māyā and seizing them, she returned to her home. / Therefore, having gone along with me to the very place where her guru [dwells]—

3.3.s:
viṃdhyopari mahāraṇye nānāsattvaniṣevite ..
kuṭīraṃ tasya tatraiva nāmnaivailavilī hi saḥ .. ilavilā
yogasiddhiyutaḥ kāmī rākṣasebhyo hi nirbhayaḥ .. 101 ..
3.3.d:
विंध्योपरि महारण्ये नानासत्त्वनिषेविते ॥
कुटीरं तस्य तत्रैव नाम्नैवैलविली हि सः ॥ इलविला
योगसिद्धियुतः कामी राक्षसेभ्यो हि निर्भयः ॥ 101 ॥
3.3.m: upon the Vindhya [mountain] in the great forest inhabited by various creatures, / his cottage is right there, and he is named Ailavilī; / endowed with yogic perfection, he is lustful and truly fearless of demons.

3.3.s:
jambukasya sutā tatra pratyahaṃ svajanairyutā ..
ekākinī ca sā rātrau svaṃ guruṃ tamarīramat .. 102 ..
3.3.d:
जम्बुकस्य सुता तत्र प्रत्यहं स्वजनैर्युता ॥
एकाकिनी च सा रात्रौ स्वं गुरुं तमरीरमत् ॥ 102 ॥
3.3.m: Jambuka's daughter goes there every day accompanied by her people, / and at night she, alone, sported with that guru of hers.

3.3.s:
kṛteyaṃ cailavilinā māyā manujamohinī ..
kāryasiddhiṃ gamiṣyāmo gatvā taṃ puruṣādhamam ..
iti śrutvā tu catvāro vināhrādaṃ yayurvanam .. 103 ..
3.3.d:
कृतेयं चैलविलिना माया मनुजमोहिनी ॥
कार्यसिद्धिं गमिष्यामो गत्वा तं पुरुषाधमम् ॥
इति श्रुत्वा तु चत्वारो विनाह्रादं ययुर्वनम् ॥ 103 ॥
3.3.m: And this Māyā that bewitched the men was wrought by Ailavilin. / Having gone to that vilest of men, we shall accomplish our purpose." / Hearing this, the four went to the forest without Āhlāda.

3.3.s:
gītanṛtyapravādyaiśca mohayitvā ca ta dine ..
vāsaṃ cakruśca tatraiva dhūrtaṃ māyāviśāradam .. 104 ..
3.3.d:
गीतनृत्यप्रवाद्यैश्च मोहयित्वा च त दिने ॥
वासं चक्रुश्च तत्रैव धूर्तं मायाविशारदम् ॥ 104 ॥
3.3.m: And having captivated on that day with song, dance, and musical instruments / that rogue who was skilled in Māyā, they made their dwelling right there.

3.3.s:
sa tu pūrvabhave daityaścitro nāma mahāsuraḥ ..
bāṇakanyāmuṣāṃ nityamavāñchacchiva pūjakaḥ ..
jāta ailavilī nāma pakṣapūjī sa vegavān ..1 05..
3.3.d:
स तु पूर्वभवे दैत्यश्चित्रो नाम महासुरः ॥
बाणकन्यामुषां नित्यमवाञ्छच्छिव पूजकः ॥
जात ऐलविली नाम पक्षपूजी स वेगवान् ॥1 05॥
3.3.m: In a previous existence, he was a Daitya, a great Asura named Citra; / a worshipper of Śiva, he constantly desired Uṣā, the daughter of Bāṇa. / He was born [now] as the swift-moving Ailavilī, worshipping her faction.

3.3.s:
tayormadhye pramāṇo'yaṃ vivāho me yadā bhavet ..
tadāhaṃ tvāṃ bhajiṣyāmi saṃtyaktvodvāhitaṃ patim .. 106 ..
3.3.d:
तयोर्मध्ये प्रमाणोऽयं विवाहो मे यदा भवेत् ॥
तदाहं त्वां भजिष्यामि संत्यक्त्वोद्वाहितं पतिम् ॥ 106 ॥
3.3.m: "When this marriage of mine becomes authoritative between those two, / then I shall serve you, having abandoned the husband I wed."

3.3.s:
hate tasminmahādhūrte gatvā saṃgrāmamūrddhani ..
jambukasya yayurdurgaṃ dṛṣṭvā te taṃ samāruhan ..
hatvā tatra sthitānvīrāñchataghnyaḥ parikhākṛtāḥ .. 107 ..
3.3.d:
हते तस्मिन्महाधूर्ते गत्वा संग्राममूर्द्धनि ॥
जम्बुकस्य ययुर्दुर्गं दृष्ट्वा ते तं समारुहन् ॥
हत्वा तत्र स्थितान्वीराञ्छतघ्न्यः परिखाकृताः ॥ 107 ॥
3.3.m: When that great rogue was slain, having gone to the forefront of battle, / they went to the stronghold of Jambuka. Seeing it, they scaled it, / having slain the heroes stationed there and the trench-making cannons.

3.3.s:
tadā tu jambuko rājā śivadattavaro balī ..
jitvā pañca mahāvīrānbaddhvā tānnigaḍairdṛḍhaiḥ ..
śaivaṃ yajñaṃ ca kṛtavāṃsteṣāṃ nāmnopabṛṃhitam .. 108 ..
3.3.d:
तदा तु जम्बुको राजा शिवदत्तवरो बली ॥
जित्वा पञ्च महावीरान्बद्ध्वा तान्निगडैर्दृढैः ॥
शैवं यज्ञं च कृतवांस्तेषां नाम्नोपबृंहितम् ॥ 108 ॥
3.3.m: Then the mighty King Jambuka, who had been granted boons by Śiva, / having conquered the five great heroes and bound them with strong iron shackles, / performed a Śaiva sacrifice magnified with their names.

3.3.s:
rūpaṇastu tathā jñātvā devakīṃ pratyavarṇayat ..
tadā tu duḥkhitā devī bhavānīṃ bhayahāriṇīm ..
manasā ca jagāmāśu śaraṇyāṃ śaraṇaṃ satī .. 109 ..
3.3.d:
रूपणस्तु तथा ज्ञात्वा देवकीं प्रत्यवर्णयत् ॥
तदा तु दुःखिता देवी भवानीं भयहारिणीम् ॥
मनसा च जगामाशु शरण्यां शरणं सती ॥ 109 ॥
3.3.m: Rūpaṇa, having learned of this, described it to Devakī. / Then the distressed lady, the virtuous wife, / swiftly went with her mind for refuge to Bhavānī, who dispels fear and is worthy of refuge.

3.3.s:
tadā tuṣṭā jagāddhātrī svapnāṃte tāmavarṇayat ..
aho devaki kalyāṇi putraśokaṃ tyajādhunā .. 3.3.12.110 ..
3.3.d:
तदा तुष्टा जगाद्धात्री स्वप्नांते तामवर्णयत् ॥
अहो देवकि कल्याणि पुत्रशोकं त्यजाधुना ॥ 3.3.12.110 ॥
3.3.m: Then the gratified Mother of the Universe spoke to her at the end of a dream: / "O Devakī, auspicious lady, abandon now your grief for your sons.

3.3.s:
yadā tu jambuko rājā śivadattavaro balī ..
homaṃ kartā sa maṃdātmā teṣāṃ ca balihetave .. 111 ..
3.3.d:
यदा तु जम्बुको राजा शिवदत्तवरो बली ॥
होमं कर्ता स मंदात्मा तेषां च बलिहेतवे ॥ 111 ॥
3.3.m: When that mighty King Jambuka, granted boons by Śiva, / that dull-witted soul, performs the oblation for the sake of their offering,

3.3.s:
mohayitvā tadāhaṃ taṃ mocayitvā ca te sutān ..
vijayaṃ te pradāsyāmi mā ca śoke manaḥ kṛthāḥ .. 112 ..
3.3.d:
मोहयित्वा तदाहं तं मोचयित्वा च ते सुतान् ॥
विजयं ते प्रदास्यामि मा च शोके मनः कृथाः ॥ 112 ॥
3.3.m: having bewitched him then and released your sons, / I shall grant you victory. Do not set your mind on grief."

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā satī devī namaskṛtya maheśvarīm ..
pūjayāmāsa vidhivaddhūpadīpopahārakaiḥ .. 113 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा सती देवी नमस्कृत्य महेश्वरीम् ॥
पूजयामास विधिवद्धूपदीपोपहारकैः ॥ 113 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing this, the virtuous lady, having bowed to Maheśvarī, / worshipped her according to rule with incenses, lamps, and offerings.

3.3.s:
etasminnaṃtare rājā devamāyāvimohitaḥ ..
suṣvāpa tatra homānte te ca jātā hyabaṃdhanāḥ .. 114 ..
3.3.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे राजा देवमायाविमोहितः ॥
सुष्वाप तत्र होमान्ते ते च जाता ह्यबंधनाः ॥ 114 ॥
3.3.m: In the meantime, the king, utterly bewildered by the Māyā of the god, / fell asleep there at the end of the oblation, and they indeed became free from bonds.

3.3.s:
tairbaddho jambuko rājā nigaḍairāyasairdṛḍhaiḥ ..
te taṃ baddhvā yayuḥ śīghraṃ devakīṃ prati nirbhayāḥ .. 115 ..
3.3.d:
तैर्बद्धो जम्बुको राजा निगडैरायसैर्दृढैः ॥
ते तं बद्ध्वा ययुः शीघ्रं देवकीं प्रति निर्भयाः ॥ 115 ॥
3.3.m: King Jambuka was bound by them with strong iron shackles. / Having bound him, they swiftly went towards Devakī, free from fear.

3.3.s:
etasminnaṃtare tatra kāliyādyāstrayaḥ sutāḥ ..
trilakṣaṃ sainyamādāya yuddhāya samupāyayuḥ .. 116 ..
3.3.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे तत्र कालियाद्यास्त्रयः सुताः ॥
त्रिलक्षं सैन्यमादाय युद्धाय समुपाययुः ॥ 116 ॥
3.3.m: In the meantime, three sons led by Kāliya, / taking an army of three hundred thousand, arrived there for battle.

3.3.s:
punaryuddhamabhūdghoraṃ senayorubhayostadā ..
tālanādyāśca catvāro hatvā tāṃ ripuvāhinīm .. 117 ..
3.3.d:
पुनर्युद्धमभूद्घोरं सेनयोरुभयोस्तदा ॥
तालनाद्याश्च चत्वारो हत्वा तां रिपुवाहिनीम् ॥ 117 ॥
3.3.m: Then a terrible battle occurred again between the two armies. / And the four led by Tālana, having destroyed that hostile army,

3.3.s:
trīñchatrūnkoṣṭhakīkṛtya svaśastrairjaghnurūrjitāḥ ..
evaṃ dināni katicittatra jāto mahāraṇaḥ .. 118 ..
3.3.d:
त्रीञ्छत्रून्कोष्ठकीकृत्य स्वशस्त्रैर्जघ्नुरूर्जिताः ॥
एवं दिनानि कतिचित्तत्र जातो महारणः ॥ 118 ॥
3.3.m: and cornering the three enemies, powerfully struck them with their weapons. / In this way, a great battle took place there for some days.

3.3.s:
kāliyo duḥkhito bhūtvā sasmāra manasā haram ..
mohanaṃ maṃtramāsādya mohayāmāsa tānripūn .. 119 ..
3.3.d:
कालियो दुःखितो भूत्वा सस्मार मनसा हरम् ॥
मोहनं मंत्रमासाद्य मोहयामास तान्रिपून् ॥ 119 ॥
3.3.m: Kāliya, becoming distressed, remembered Hara in his mind. / Obtaining a bewitching mantra, he bewitched those enemies.

3.3.s:
etasminnaṃtare devī devakī patidevatā..
pātivratyasya puṇyena sutāṃtikamupāgatā .. 3.3.12.120 ..
3.3.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे देवी देवकी पतिदेवता॥
पातिव्रत्यस्य पुण्येन सुतांतिकमुपागता ॥ 3.3.12.120 ॥
3.3.m: In the meantime, the queen Devakī, to whom her husband was a deity, / approached her sons by the merit of her marital fidelity.

3.3.s:
bodhayitvā tu kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ pañcaśabdagajasthitam ..
punastuṣṭāva jananīṃ sarvaviśvavimohinīm ..
tadā tuṣṭā svayaṃ devī bodhayāmāsa tānmudā .. 121 ..
3.3.d:
बोधयित्वा तु कृष्णांशं पञ्चशब्दगजस्थितम् ॥
पुनस्तुष्टाव जननीं सर्वविश्वविमोहिनीम् ॥
तदा तुष्टा स्वयं देवी बोधयामास तान्मुदा ॥ 121 ॥
3.3.m: Having awakened the portion of Kṛṣṇa, who stood upon an elephant of five sounds, / she praised the Mother, the bewitcher of the entire universe. / Then the goddess herself, pleased, joyfully awakened them.

3.3.s:
āhlādaḥ sūryavarmāṇaṃ kāliyaṃ ca tato'nujaḥ ..
jaghāna balakhānistaṃ tundilaṃ jambukātmajam ..122..
3.3.d:
आह्लादः सूर्यवर्माणं कालियं च ततोऽनुजः ॥
जघान बलखानिस्तं तुन्दिलं जम्बुकात्मजम् ॥122॥
3.3.m: Āhlāda [slew] Sūryavarman, and then his younger brother [slew] Kāliya; / Balakhāni slew Tundila, the son of Jambuka.

3.3.s:
te tu pūrvabhave vipra jarāsaṃdhaḥ sakāliyaḥ ..
dvivido vānaraḥ śūraḥ sūryyavarmeha cābhavat ..123..
3.3.d:
ते तु पूर्वभवे विप्र जरासंधः सकालियः ॥
द्विविदो वानरः शूरः सूर्य्यवर्मेह चाभवत् ॥123॥
3.3.m: In a previous birth, O Brahmin, they were Jarāsandha along with Kāliya, / and the heroic monkey Dvivida became Sūryavarman here.

3.3.s:
triśirāstudilo jātaḥ śṛgālaḥ sa ca jambukaḥ ..
nityavairakarāḥ sarve bhūpāścāsanmahītale ..124 ..
3.3.d:
त्रिशिरास्तुदिलो जातः शृगालः स च जम्बुकः ॥
नित्यवैरकराः सर्वे भूपाश्चासन्महीतले ॥124 ॥
3.3.m: Triśiras became Tundila, and Śṛgāla became that Jambuka. / They were all kings on the earth's surface who constantly bore enmity.

3.3.s:
hateṣu śatruputreṣu devakī jambukaṃ ripum ..
khaṅgena tarjayāmāsa patiśokaparāyaṇā .. 125 ..
3.3.d:
हतेषु शत्रुपुत्रेषु देवकी जम्बुकं रिपुम् ॥
खङ्गेन तर्जयामास पतिशोकपरायणा ॥ 125 ॥
3.3.m: When the enemy's sons were slain, Devakī, devoted to grief for her husband, / threatened the enemy Jambuka with a sword.

3.3.s:
kṛṣṇāṃśaḥ śirasī pitrorgṛhītvā snehakātaraḥ ..
jambukasyaiva hadaye sthāpayāmāsa vihvalaḥ ..126..
3.3.d:
कृष्णांशः शिरसी पित्रोर्गृहीत्वा स्नेहकातरः ॥
जम्बुकस्यैव हदये स्थापयामास विह्वलः ॥126॥
3.3.m: The portion of Kṛṣṇa, distressed with affection and agitated, / took the heads of his two parents and placed them on the chest of Jambuka.

3.3.s:
vihasya tau tadā tatra procaturvacanaṃ priyam ..
ciraṃ jīva hi kṛṣṇāṃśa gayāṃ kuru mahāmate ..
iti vāṇī tayorjātā balino pretadehayoḥ .. 127 ..
3.3.d:
विहस्य तौ तदा तत्र प्रोचतुर्वचनं प्रियम् ॥
चिरं जीव हि कृष्णांश गयां कुरु महामते ॥
इति वाणी तयोर्जाता बलिनो प्रेतदेहयोः ॥ 127 ॥
3.3.m: Laughing then, the two of them spoke affectionate words there: / "Live long, O portion of Kṛṣṇa! Perform [the rites at] Gayā, O noble-minded one!" / Such speech arose from the two powerful ones whose bodies were pretas.

3.3.s:
khaḍgahastā ca sā devī śilāyaṃtre tu taṃ ripum ..
saṃsthāpya codayāmāsa svaputrānharṣasaṃyutā ..128..
3.3.d:
खड्गहस्ता च सा देवी शिलायंत्रे तु तं रिपुम् ॥
संस्थाप्य चोदयामास स्वपुत्रान्हर्षसंयुता ॥128॥
3.3.m: And that queen, with sword in hand, having placed that enemy / in an oil-press, urged her sons, filled with joy:

3.3.s:
he putrāḥ svapituḥ śatruṃ jambukaṃ puruṣādhamam ..
khaṇḍakhaṇḍaṃ ca tilaśaḥ kṛtvānandasamanvitāḥ .. 129 ..
3.3.d:
हे पुत्राः स्वपितुः शत्रुं जम्बुकं पुरुषाधमम् ॥
खण्डखण्डं च तिलशः कृत्वानन्दसमन्विताः ॥ 129 ॥
3.3.m: "O sons, make Jambuka, your father's enemy, the vilest of men, / into pieces and into sesame-sized bits, filled with joy!

3.3.s:
saṃcūrṇayata tadgātraṃ tattailairmadanirmitaiḥ ..
snāsyāmyahaṃ tathetyuktvā ruroda jananī bhṛśam .. 3.3.12.130 ..
3.3.d:
संचूर्णयत तद्गात्रं तत्तैलैर्मदनिर्मितैः ॥
स्नास्याम्यहं तथेत्युक्त्वा रुरोद जननी भृशम् ॥ 3.3.12.130 ॥
3.3.m: Crush his body thoroughly! With his oil prepared by my [will], / I shall bathe!" Having spoken thus, the mother wept profusely.

3.3.s:
tathā kṛtvā tu te putrā mahiṣīṃ sasutāṃ tadā ..
balakhāniyutāstatrāhūya cakruśca tatkriyām .. 131 ..
3.3.d:
तथा कृत्वा तु ते पुत्रा महिषीं ससुतां तदा ॥
बलखानियुतास्तत्राहूय चक्रुश्च तत्क्रियाम् ॥ 131 ॥
3.3.m: Having done so, those sons, accompanied by Balakhāni, / then summoned the chief queen along with her daughter and performed that rite.

3.3.s:
tadā parimalaṃ rājñī dṛṣṭvā svāminamāturam ..
maraṇāyonmukhaṃ vipra paṃcatvamagamanmune .. 132 ..
3.3.d:
तदा परिमलं राज्ञी दृष्ट्वा स्वामिनमातुरम् ॥
मरणायोन्मुखं विप्र पंचत्वमगमन्मुने ॥ 132 ॥
3.3.m: Then, seeing her husband afflicted and about to die, / Queen Parimalā went to the dissolution into five elements, O Brahmin, O sage.

3.3.s:
tatsutā khaḍgamānīya balakhānibhujaṃ prati ..
kṛtitvā mūrchayitvā taṃ tatpakṣānanvadhāvata..133..
3.3.d:
तत्सुता खड्गमानीय बलखानिभुजं प्रति ॥
कृतित्वा मूर्छयित्वा तं तत्पक्षानन्वधावत॥133॥
3.3.m: His daughter, fetching a sword against Balakhāni's arm, / severed it, caused him to faint, and ran after his partisans.

3.3.s:
tālanaṃ devasiṃhaṃ ca rāmāṃśaṃ ca tathāvidham..
kṛttvānyāṃśca tathā śatrūnagacchatkulakātarā..134..
3.3.d:
तालनं देवसिंहं च रामांशं च तथाविधम्॥
कृत्त्वान्यांश्च तथा शत्रूनगच्छत्कुलकातरा॥134॥
3.3.m: Having struck Tālana, Devasiṃha, and likewise the portion of Rāma, / and having similarly cut down other enemies, she went away, fearful for her lineage.

3.3.s:
kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ mohayitvāśu māyayā ca samāharat..
hate tatra śate śūre balakhāniramarṣitaḥ ..
tacchiraśca samāhṛtya citāyāṃ ca samākṣipat .. 135 ..
3.3.d:
कृष्णांशं मोहयित्वाशु मायया च समाहरत्॥
हते तत्र शते शूरे बलखानिरमर्षितः ॥
तच्छिरश्च समाहृत्य चितायां च समाक्षिपत् ॥ 135 ॥
3.3.m: Having quickly bewitched the portion of Kṛṣṇa, she carried him off by Māyā. / When a hundred heroes were slain there, Balakhāni, enraged, / severed her head and threw it onto the funeral pyre.

3.3.s:
tadā vāṇī samutpannā balakhāne śṛṇuṣva bhoḥ ..
avadhyā ca sadā nārī tvayā vadhyā hyadharmiṇaḥ .. 136 ..
3.3.d:
तदा वाणी समुत्पन्ना बलखाने शृणुष्व भोः ॥
अवध्या च सदा नारी त्वया वध्या ह्यधर्मिणः ॥ 136 ॥
3.3.m: Then a voice arose: “Listen, O Balkhān! / A woman must never be killed; you must kill the unrighteous.

3.3.s:
phalamasya vivāhe sve bhoktavyaṃ pāpakarmaṇaḥ ..
iti śrutvā tadā duḥkhī balakhāniryayau puram .. 137 ..
3.3.d:
फलमस्य विवाहे स्वे भोक्तव्यं पापकर्मणः ॥
इति श्रुत्वा तदा दुःखी बलखानिर्ययौ पुरम् ॥ 137 ॥
3.3.m: The fruit of this evil deed must be experienced in his own marriage.” / Hearing this, Balkhān became sorrowful and went to the city.

3.3.s:
tatastu sainikāḥ sarve mahāharṣasamanvitāḥ ..
śatoṣṭrabhāravāhyāni luṃṭhayitvā dhanāni ca .. 138 ..
3.3.d:
ततस्तु सैनिकाः सर्वे महाहर्षसमन्विताः ॥
शतोष्ट्रभारवाह्यानि लुंठयित्वा धनानि च ॥ 138 ॥
3.3.m: Then all the soldiers, filled with great joy, / plundered wealth carried on a hundred camel-loads,

3.3.s:
mahāvatīṃ samājagmuḥ kṛtakṛ tyatvamāgatāḥ ..
hataśeṣaiścārddhasainyaiḥ sahitā gehamāyayuḥ .. 139 .. ..
3.3.d:
महावतीं समाजग्मुः कृतकृ त्यत्वमागताः ॥
हतशेषैश्चार्द्धसैन्यैः सहिता गेहमाययुः ॥ 139 ॥ ॥
3.3.m: and arrived at Mahāvatī, having achieved their purpose. / Together with half the army left from the slain, they returned home.

3.3.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
kasminmāsyabhavadyuddhaṃ tayoḥ katidināni ca ..
tatpaścātsva purīṃ prāya tadā kimabhavanmune .. 1 ..
3.3.d:
॥ ऋषय ऊचुः ॥ ॥
कस्मिन्मास्यभवद्युद्धं तयोः कतिदिनानि च ॥
तत्पश्चात्स्व पुरीं प्राय तदा किमभवन्मुने ॥ 1 ॥
3.3.m: The sages said: / “In which month did the battle between the two take place, and for how many days? / Having reached his city after that, what happened then, O sage?”

3.3.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
pauṣamāsyabhavadyuddhaṃ tayoḥ śatadināni ca ..
jyeṣṭhe māsi gṛhaṃ prāptā dadhmurvādyānyanekaśaḥ.. 2 ..
3.3.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
पौषमास्यभवद्युद्धं तयोः शतदिनानि च ॥
ज्येष्ठे मासि गृहं प्राप्ता दध्मुर्वाद्यान्यनेकशः॥ 2 ॥
3.3.m: Sūta said: / “The battle between the two occurred in the month of Pauṣa, lasting for a hundred days. / Having reached home in the month of Jyeṣṭha, they sounded various musical instruments.

3.3.s:
śrutvā parimalo rājā svasutāñjayino balīn ..
dadau dānāni viprebhyaḥ sukhaṃ jātaṃ gṛhegṛhe .. 3 ..
3.3.d:
श्रुत्वा परिमलो राजा स्वसुताञ्जयिनो बलीन् ॥
ददौ दानानि विप्रेभ्यः सुखं जातं गृहेगृहे ॥ 3 ॥
3.3.m: King Parimala, hearing of his mighty sons' victory, / gave gifts to the brahmins; happiness arose in every house.

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā mahīrājo balakhāniṃ mahābalam ..
tatrāgatya namaskṛtya vacanaṃ prāha namradhīḥ .. 4 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा महीराजो बलखानिं महाबलम् ॥
तत्रागत्य नमस्कृत्य वचनं प्राह नम्रधीः ॥ 4 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing this, Mahīrāja approached the mighty Balkhān, / bowed to him, and said these words with a humble mind:

3.3.s:
arddhakoṭimitaṃ dravyaṃ mattaḥ prāpya sukhī bhava ..
māhiṣmatyāśca rāṣṭraṃ me dehi vīra namostu te .. 5 ..
3.3.d:
अर्द्धकोटिमितं द्रव्यं मत्तः प्राप्य सुखी भव ॥
माहिष्मत्याश्च राष्ट्रं मे देहि वीर नमोस्तु ते ॥ 5 ॥
3.3.m: ‘Take half a crore worth of wealth from me and be happy; / grant me the realm of Māhiṣmatī, O hero, homage to you!

3.3.s:
varṣe varṣe ca taddravyaṃ gṛhāṇa balavanprabho ..
iti śrutvā tathā matvā balakhānirgṛhaṃ yayau ..6..
3.3.d:
वर्षे वर्षे च तद्द्रव्यं गृहाण बलवन्प्रभो ॥
इति श्रुत्वा तथा मत्वा बलखानिर्गृहं ययौ ॥6॥
3.3.m: Accept that wealth year after year, O mighty lord!’ / Hearing this and agreeing, Balkhān went home.

3.3.s:
vayastrayodaśābde ca kṛṣṇāṃśe balavattare ..
yathā jātā harerlīlā bhṛguśreṣṭha tathā śṛṇu .. 7 ..
3.3.d:
वयस्त्रयोदशाब्दे च कृष्णांशे बलवत्तरे ॥
यथा जाता हरेर्लीला भृगुश्रेष्ठ तथा शृणु ॥ 7 ॥
3.3.m: When Kṛṣṇāṃśa was in his thirteenth year of age and grown very strong, / hear, O best of the Bhṛgus, how the sport of Hari occurred.

3.3.s:
bhādre śukle trayodaśyāṃ cāhlādaḥ sānujo yayau ..
gayārthe dhanamādāya hastyaśvarathasaṃkulam .. .. 8 ..
3.3.d:
भाद्रे शुक्ले त्रयोदश्यां चाह्लादः सानुजो ययौ ॥
गयार्थे धनमादाय हस्त्यश्वरथसंकुलम् ॥ ॥ 8 ॥
3.3.m: On the thirteenth day of the bright fortnight of Bhādra, Āhlāda set forth with his younger brother, / taking wealth for the purpose of Gayā, accompanied by elephants, horses, and chariots.

3.3.s:
kṛṣṇāṃśo bindulārūḍho vatsajo hariṇīsthitaḥ ..
devaḥ papīhakārūḍhaḥ sukhakhāniḥ karālake .. 9 ..
3.3.d:
कृष्णांशो बिन्दुलारूढो वत्सजो हरिणीस्थितः ॥
देवः पपीहकारूढः सुखखानिः करालके ॥ 9 ॥
3.3.m: Kṛṣṇāṃśa mounted Bindulā, Vatsaja was mounted on Hariṇī, / Deva mounted Papīhaka, and Sukhakhāni was on Karālaka.

3.3.s:
catvāro dvidinānte ca gayākṣetraṃ samāyayuḥ ..
pūrṇimāṃte puraskṛtya ṣoḍaśaśrāddhakāriṇaḥ .. 3.3.13.10 ..
3.3.d:
चत्वारो द्विदिनान्ते च गयाक्षेत्रं समाययुः ॥
पूर्णिमांते पुरस्कृत्य षोडशश्राद्धकारिणः ॥ 3.3.13.10 ॥
3.3.m: At the end of two days, the four arrived at the sacred ground of Gayā, / intent upon performing the sixteen śrāddhas after the full-moon day.

3.3.s:
śataṃ śataṃ gajāṃścaiva bhūṣitāṃśca rathāstathā ..
dadurhayānsahasraṃ ca hemamālāvibhūṣi tān .. 11 ..
3.3.d:
शतं शतं गजांश्चैव भूषितांश्च रथास्तथा ॥
ददुर्हयान्सहस्रं च हेममालाविभूषि तान् ॥ 11 ॥
