3.3.m: They gave one hundred elephants and adorned chariots as well, / and gave a thousand horses decorated with golden garlands.

3.3.s:
dhenūrhiraṇyaratnāni vāsāṃsi vividhāni ca ..
dattvā te suphalībhūya svagehāya dadhurmanaḥ .. 12 ..
3.3.d:
धेनूर्हिरण्यरत्नानि वासांसि विविधानि च ॥
दत्त्वा ते सुफलीभूय स्वगेहाय दधुर्मनः ॥ 12 ॥
3.3.m: Having given cows, gold, jewels, and various garments, / they achieved their fruit and set their minds on [returning] home.

3.3.s:
lakṣāvartistu yā veśyā yayau badarikāśramam ..
prāṇāṃstatra parityajya sāpsarastvamupāgatā .. 13 ..
3.3.d:
लक्षावर्तिस्तु या वेश्या ययौ बदरिकाश्रमम् ॥
प्राणांस्तत्र परित्यज्य साप्सरस्त्वमुपागता ॥ 13 ॥
3.3.m: Lakṣāvartī, the courtesan, went to Badarikāśrama; / giving up her life-breaths there, she attained the state of an apsaras.

3.3.s:
rākāṃ caṃdre tu saṃprāptaṃ rāhugraste tamomaye ..
kāśyāṃ samāgatā bhūpā nānā deśyāḥ kulaiḥ saha .. 14 ..
3.3.d:
राकां चंद्रे तु संप्राप्तं राहुग्रस्ते तमोमये ॥
काश्यां समागता भूपा नाना देश्याः कुलैः सह ॥ 14 ॥
3.3.m: When the full moon had arrived, seized by Rāhu and enveloped in darkness, / kings from various countries gathered in Kāśī along with their retinues.

3.3.s:
himālayagirau ramye nānādhātuvicitrite ..
tatra śārdūlavaṃśīyo netrasiṃho mahīpatiḥ .. 15 ..
3.3.d:
हिमालयगिरौ रम्ये नानाधातुविचित्रिते ॥
तत्र शार्दूलवंशीयो नेत्रसिंहो महीपतिः ॥ 15 ॥
3.3.m: On the delightful Himālaya mountain, variegated with diverse minerals, / there was a ruler of the earth named Netrasiṃha, born in the tiger-lineage.

3.3.s:
ratnabhāno hate śūre netrasiṃho bhayāturaḥ ..
navatuṃge samāsādya toṣayāmāsa vāsavam .. 16 ..
3.3.d:
रत्नभानो हते शूरे नेत्रसिंहो भयातुरः ॥
नवतुंगे समासाद्य तोषयामास वासवम् ॥ 16 ॥
3.3.m: When the hero Ratnabhānu was slain, Netrasiṃha, afflicted with fear, / went to Navatuṅga and propitiated Vāsava.

3.3.s:
dvādaśābdāntare devo dadau ḍhakkāmṛtaṃ mudā ..
pārvatyā nirmitaṃ yattu vāsavāya svasevine .. 17 ..
3.3.d:
द्वादशाब्दान्तरे देवो ददौ ढक्कामृतं मुदा ॥
पार्वत्या निर्मितं यत्तु वासवाय स्वसेविने ॥ 17 ॥
3.3.m: After twelve years, the god gladly gave him the nectar-drum / fashioned by Pārvatī for Vāsava, who served her.

3.3.s:
dadau ḍhakkāmṛtaṃ rājñe punaḥ prāha śubhaṃ vacaḥ ..
asya śabdena bhūpāla tvaṃ sainyaṃ jīvayiṣyasi .. 18 ..
3.3.d:
ददौ ढक्कामृतं राज्ञे पुनः प्राह शुभं वचः ॥
अस्य शब्देन भूपाल त्वं सैन्यं जीवयिष्यसि ॥ 18 ॥
3.3.m: He gave the nectar-drum to the king and spoke auspicious words: / ‘King, by its sound you will revive your army;

3.3.s:
kṣayaṃ śīghraṃ gamiṣyaṃti śatravaste mahābhaṭāḥ..
prāpte ḍhakkāmṛte tasminnetrasiṃho mahābalaḥ .. 19 ..
3.3.d:
क्षयं शीघ्रं गमिष्यंति शत्रवस्ते महाभटाः॥
प्राप्ते ढक्कामृते तस्मिन्नेत्रसिंहो महाबलः ॥ 19 ॥
3.3.m: your enemies, those great warriors, will quickly perish.’ / Having obtained that nectar-drum, the mighty Netrasiṃha

3.3.s:
nagaraṃ kārayāmāsa tatra sarvajanairyutam ..
yojanāntaṃ caturdvāraṃ durādharṣaṃ paraiḥ sadā .. 3.3.13.20 ..
3.3.d:
नगरं कारयामास तत्र सर्वजनैर्युतम् ॥
योजनान्तं चतुर्द्वारं दुराधर्षं परैः सदा ॥ 3.3.13.20 ॥
3.3.m: caused a city to be built there, filled with all kinds of people, / measuring a yojana, with four gates, forever invincible to enemies.

3.3.s:
netrasiṃhagaḍhaṃ nāmnā vikhyātaṃ bhārate bhuvi ..
kāśmīrānte kṛtaṃ rājye tena śṛṃgasamaṃ tataḥ .. 21 ..
3.3.d:
नेत्रसिंहगढं नाम्ना विख्यातं भारते भुवि ॥
काश्मीरान्ते कृतं राज्ये तेन शृंगसमं ततः ॥ 21 ॥
3.3.m: It was renowned on the earth of Bhārata by the name of Netrasiṃhagaḍha; / it was made by him like a mountain peak in the realm on the border of Kāśmīra.

3.3.s:
pālitaṃ netrasiṃhena tatpuraḥ putravanmune ..
netrapāla iti khyāto grāmo'sau durgamaḥ pareḥ .. 22 ..
3.3.d:
पालितं नेत्रसिंहेन तत्पुरः पुत्रवन्मुने ॥
नेत्रपाल इति ख्यातो ग्रामोऽसौ दुर्गमः परेः ॥ 22 ॥
3.3.m: That city was protected by Netrasiṃha like a son, O sage; / known as Netrapāla, this village was impassable to enemies.

3.3.s:
so'pi rājā samāyāto netrasiṃho mahābalaḥ ..
kanyā svarṇavatī tasya revatyaṃśasamanvitā ..
kāmākṣyā varadānena sarvamāyāviśāradā .. 23 ..
3.3.d:
सोऽपि राजा समायातो नेत्रसिंहो महाबलः ॥
कन्या स्वर्णवती तस्य रेवत्यंशसमन्विता ॥
कामाक्ष्या वरदानेन सर्वमायाविशारदा ॥ 23 ॥
3.3.m: That king Netrasiṃha, who was exceedingly powerful, also arrived. / His daughter was Svarṇavatī, possessing a portion of Revatī, / skilled in all arts of illusion through the boon of Kāmākṣī.

3.3.s:
dṛṣṭvā tāṃ suṃdarīṃ kanyāṃ bālendusadṛśānanām ..
mūrcchitāścābhavanbhūpā rūpayauvanamohitāḥ .. 24 ..
3.3.d:
दृष्ट्वा तां सुंदरीं कन्यां बालेन्दुसदृशाननाम् ॥
मूर्च्छिताश्चाभवन्भूपा रूपयौवनमोहिताः ॥ 24 ॥
3.3.m: Seeing that beautiful maiden, whose face was like the crescent moon, / the kings fainted, infatuated by her beauty and youth.

3.3.s:
dṛṣṭvā tāṃ ca tathāhrādaḥ sarvaratnavibhūṣitām ..
ṣoḍaśābdavayoyuktāṃ kāminīṃ ratirūpiṇīm ..
mūrcchitaścāpatadbhūmau sā taṃ dṛṣṭvā mumoha vai .. 25 ..
3.3.d:
दृष्ट्वा तां च तथाह्रादः सर्वरत्नविभूषिताम् ॥
षोडशाब्दवयोयुक्तां कामिनीं रतिरूपिणीम् ॥
मूर्च्छितश्चापतद्भूमौ सा तं दृष्ट्वा मुमोह वै ॥ 25 ॥
3.3.m: And seeing her adorned with all jewels, / a lovely woman sixteen years of age, the very embodiment of Rati, / Āhlāda too fainted and fell to the ground; and she, seeing him, became deeply infatuated.

3.3.s:
dolāmāruhya tatsakhyau nṛpāntikamupāyayuḥ ..
āhlādastu samutthāya mahāmohatvamāgataḥ .. 26 ..
3.3.d:
दोलामारुह्य तत्सख्यौ नृपान्तिकमुपाययुः ॥
आह्लादस्तु समुत्थाय महामोहत्वमागतः ॥ 26 ॥
3.3.m: Mounting a litter, her two female companions came into the presence of the king; / but Āhlāda arose, having fallen into great infatuation.

3.3.s:
dṛṣṭvā tathāvidhaṃ baṃdhuṃ kṛṣṇāṃśaḥ prāha duḥkhitaḥ ..
kimarthaṃ mohamāyāto bhavām̐statvaviśāradaḥ .. 27 ..
3.3.d:
दृष्ट्वा तथाविधं बंधुं कृष्णांशः प्राह दुःखितः ॥
किमर्थं मोहमायातो भवाम्̐स्तत्वविशारदः ॥ 27 ॥
3.3.m: Seeing his kinsman in such a state, Kṛṣṇāṃśa said sorrowfully: / ‘Why have you succumbed to infatuation, you who are skilled in the truth?

3.3.s:
rajo rāgātmakaṃ viddhi pramādaṃ mohajaṃ tathā ..
jñānāsinā śirastasya chiṃdhi tvamajitaḥ sadā .. 28 ..
3.3.d:
रजो रागात्मकं विद्धि प्रमादं मोहजं तथा ॥
ज्ञानासिना शिरस्तस्य छिंधि त्वमजितः सदा ॥ 28 ॥
3.3.m: Know passion to be of the nature of rajas, and heedlessness to be born of delusion; / with the sword of knowledge, sever its head, you who are ever unvanquished!’

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā vaco bhrātustyaktvā mohaṃ yayau gṛham ..
bhojayitvā dvijaśreṣṭhānsahasraṃ vedatatparān .. 29 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा वचो भ्रातुस्त्यक्त्वा मोहं ययौ गृहम् ॥
भोजयित्वा द्विजश्रेष्ठान्सहस्रं वेदतत्परान् ॥ 29 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing his brother’s words, he cast off delusion and went home; / feeding a thousand excellent brahmins devoted to the Vedas,

3.3.s:
durgāmārādhayāmāsa japtvā madhyacaritrakam ..
māsānte ca tadā devī dattvābhīṣṭaṃ hṛdi sthitam .. 3.3.13.30 ..
3.3.d:
दुर्गामाराधयामास जप्त्वा मध्यचरित्रकम् ॥
मासान्ते च तदा देवी दत्त्वाभीष्टं हृदि स्थितम् ॥ 3.3.13.30 ॥
3.3.m: he worshipped Durgā by chanting the Middle Episode. / At the end of a month, the goddess, having granted the desire dwelling in his heart,

3.3.s:
mohayāmāsa tāṃ kanyāṃ vivāhārthamaninditā ..
svapne dadarśa sā bālā rāmāṃśaṃ devakīsutam .. 31 ..
3.3.d:
मोहयामास तां कन्यां विवाहार्थमनिन्दिता ॥
स्वप्ने ददर्श सा बाला रामांशं देवकीसुतम् ॥ 31 ॥
3.3.m: the blameless one, bewildered that maiden for the purpose of marriage. / In a dream that young girl saw Devakī's son, an incarnation of Rāma.

3.3.s:
prātarbuddhvā tu saṃciṃtya mahāmohamupāyayau ..
tadā dhyātvā ca kāmākṣīṃ sarvābhīṣṭapradāyinīm .. .. 32 ..
3.3.d:
प्रातर्बुद्ध्वा तु संचिंत्य महामोहमुपाययौ ॥
तदा ध्यात्वा च कामाक्षीं सर्वाभीष्टप्रदायिनीम् ॥ ॥ 32 ॥
3.3.m: Waking up in the morning and pondering, she fell into great yearning; / then, having meditated upon Kāmākṣī, the bestower of all desires,

3.3.s:
pauṣamāse tu saṃprāpte śukakaṃṭhe supatrikām ..
baddhvā taṃ preṣayāmāsa śukaṃ patrasthitaṃ priyam .. 33 ..
3.3.d:
पौषमासे तु संप्राप्ते शुककंठे सुपत्रिकाम् ॥
बद्ध्वा तं प्रेषयामास शुकं पत्रस्थितं प्रियम् ॥ 33 ॥
3.3.m: when the month of Pauṣa arrived, having tied an auspicious letter to a parrot's neck, / she sent that beloved parrot carrying the letter.

3.3.s:
sa gatvā puṣpavipinaṃ mahāvatipurīsthitam ..
naraśabdena vacanaṃ kṛṣṇāṃśāya śukobravīta .. 34 ..
3.3.d:
स गत्वा पुष्पविपिनं महावतिपुरीस्थितम् ॥
नरशब्देन वचनं कृष्णांशाय शुकोब्रवीत ॥ 34 ॥
3.3.m: Going to a flower grove situated in the city of Mahāvatī, / the parrot spoke words in a human voice to Kṛṣṇāṃśa:

3.3.s:
vīra te'varajo baṃdhurnāmnāhlādo mahābalaḥ ..
tasmai hi preṣitā patrī svarṇavatyā hitapradā .. 35 ..
3.3.d:
वीर तेऽवरजो बंधुर्नाम्नाह्लादो महाबलः ॥
तस्मै हि प्रेषिता पत्री स्वर्णवत्या हितप्रदा ॥ 35 ॥
3.3.m: ‘O hero, your younger brother and kinsman, named Āhlāda, is of great might; / to him indeed Svarṇavatī has sent a beneficial letter.

3.3.s:
tāṃ jñātvā ca punastasyā uttaraṃ dehi matpriyam ..
atha vā patramālikhya tattvaṃ me kuru kaṃṭhake .. 36 ..
3.3.d:
तां ज्ञात्वा च पुनस्तस्या उत्तरं देहि मत्प्रियम् ॥
अथ वा पत्रमालिख्य तत्त्वं मे कुरु कंठके ॥ 36 ॥
3.3.m: Having learned it, give back to her an answer agreeable to me; / or, having written a letter, place that matter upon my neck.’

3.3.s:
iti śrutvodayo vīro gṛhītvā patramuttamam ..
jñātavāṃstatra vṛttāṃtamāhlādāya punardadau .. 37 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वोदयो वीरो गृहीत्वा पत्रमुत्तमम् ॥
ज्ञातवांस्तत्र वृत्तांतमाह्लादाय पुनर्ददौ ॥ 37 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing this, the heroic Udaya took the excellent letter, / learned the news therein, and gave it back to Āhlāda:

3.3.s:
jambukaśca nṛpo vīro rudradattavaro balī ..
ajeyonyanṛpairvīra tvayā yudhi nipātitaḥ .. 38 ..
3.3.d:
जम्बुकश्च नृपो वीरो रुद्रदत्तवरो बली ॥
अजेयोन्यनृपैर्वीर त्वया युधि निपातितः ॥ 38 ॥
3.3.m: ‘King Jambuka was a hero, mighty by a boon given by Rudra, / invincible to other kings; O hero, you struck him down in battle!’

3.3.s:
tathāvidhaṃ matpitaramiṃdradattavaraṃ ripum ..
tamevaṃ jahi saṃgrāme mama pāṇigrahaṃ kuru .. .. 39 ..
3.3.d:
तथाविधं मत्पितरमिंद्रदत्तवरं रिपुम् ॥
तमेवं जहि संग्रामे मम पाणिग्रहं कुरु ॥ ॥ 39 ॥
3.3.m:
"In the same manner, slay my enemy of a father in battle,
who was granted a boon by Indra, and take my hand in marriage!"

3.3.s:
iti jñātvā sa āhlādastāmāśvāsya hṛdi sthitām ..
śukakaṃṭhe babaṃdhāśu likhitvā patramuttamam .. 3.3.13.40 ..
3.3.d:
इति ज्ञात्वा स आह्लादस्तामाश्वास्य हृदि स्थिताम् ॥
शुककंठे बबंधाशु लिखित्वा पत्रमुत्तमम् ॥ 3.3.13.40 ॥
3.3.m:
Having understood this, Āhlāda comforted her who dwelt in his heart;
having written an excellent letter, he quickly tied it to the neck of the parrot.

3.3.s:
sa śukaḥ pannagaḥ pūrvaṃ puṃḍarīkena śāpitaḥ ..
revatyaṃśasya kāryaṃ ca kṛtvā mokṣatvamāgataḥ .. 41 ..
3.3.d:
स शुकः पन्नगः पूर्वं पुंडरीकेन शापितः ॥
रेवत्यंशस्य कार्यं च कृत्वा मोक्षत्वमागतः ॥ 41 ॥
3.3.m:
That parrot had formerly been a serpent cursed by Puṇḍarīka;
after fulfilling the work of the portion of Revatī, he attained liberation.

3.3.s:
mṛte tasmiñchuke ramye devī svarṇavatī tadā ..
dāhayitvā dadau dānaṃ viprebhyastasya tṛptaye .. 42 ..
3.3.d:
मृते तस्मिञ्छुके रम्ये देवी स्वर्णवती तदा ॥
दाहयित्वा ददौ दानं विप्रेभ्यस्तस्य तृप्तये ॥ 42 ॥
3.3.m:
When that lovely parrot died, Queen Svarṇavatī then
had him cremated and gave gifts to brahmins for his satisfaction.

3.3.s:
māghamāsi ca saṃprāpte paṃcamyāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣake ..
āhlādaḥ saptalakṣaiśca sainyaiḥ sārddhaṃ yayau mudā .. 43 ..
3.3.d:
माघमासि च संप्राप्ते पंचम्यां कृष्णपक्षके ॥
आह्लादः सप्तलक्षैश्च सैन्यैः सार्द्धं ययौ मुदा ॥ 43 ॥
3.3.m:
And when the month of Māgha arrived, on the fifth day of the dark fortnight,
Āhlāda joyfully departed along with an army of seven hundred thousand.

3.3.s:
tālanādyāśca te śūrāḥ svaṃsvaṃ vāhanamāśritāḥ ..
āhlādaṃ rakṣayantaste yayuḥ paṃcadaśāhakam .. 44 ..
3.3.d:
तालनाद्याश्च ते शूराः स्वंस्वं वाहनमाश्रिताः ॥
आह्लादं रक्षयन्तस्ते ययुः पंचदशाहकम् ॥ 44 ॥
3.3.m:
Mounted each on his own mount, those heroes, Tālan and the others,
protecting Āhlāda, marched for fifteen days.

3.3.s:
vaṃgadeśaṃ samullaṃghya śīghraṃ prāptā himālayam ..
rūpaṇaṃ patrakarttāraṃ balakhāniruvāca tam .. 45 ..
3.3.d:
वंगदेशं समुल्लंघ्य शीघ्रं प्राप्ता हिमालयम् ॥
रूपणं पत्रकर्त्तारं बलखानिरुवाच तम् ॥ 45 ॥
3.3.m:
Crossing the land of Vaṅga, they quickly reached the Himālaya.
Balakhāni spoke to Rūpaṇa, the writer of the letter:

3.3.s:
gaccha tvaṃ vīra kavacī karālāśvaṃ samāsthitaḥ ..
paṃcaśastrasamāyukto rājānaṃ śīghramāvaha .. 46 ..
3.3.d:
गच्छ त्वं वीर कवची करालाश्वं समास्थितः ॥
पंचशस्त्रसमायुक्तो राजानं शीघ्रमावह ॥ 46 ॥
3.3.m:
"Go, O hero, clad in armour, mounted on a formidable horse,
equipped with the five weapons, and swiftly challenge the king!

3.3.s:
yuddhacihnaṃ tanau kṛtvā māmāgaccha tvarānvitaḥ ..
tathā matvā śikhaṃḍyaṃśo yayau śīghraṃ sa rūpaṇaḥ ..47..
3.3.d:
युद्धचिह्नं तनौ कृत्वा मामागच्छ त्वरान्वितः ॥
तथा मत्वा शिखंड्यंशो ययौ शीघ्रं स रूपणः ॥47॥
3.3.m:
Put the marks of battle upon your body, and return to me in haste!"
Agreeing to that, Rūpaṇa, an incarnation of Śikhaṇḍin, went swiftly.

3.3.s:
sa dadarśa sabhāṃ rājño bahuśūrasamanvitām..
pārvatīyairnṛpaiḥ sārddhaṃ sahasrairbalavattaraiḥ .. 48 ..
3.3.d:
स ददर्श सभां राज्ञो बहुशूरसमन्विताम्॥
पार्वतीयैर्नृपैः सार्द्धं सहस्रैर्बलवत्तरैः ॥ 48 ॥
3.3.m:
He beheld the assembly of the king, filled with many heroes,
together with thousands of exceedingly powerful mountain kings.

3.3.s:
sa uvāca nṛpaśreṣṭhaṃ netrasiṃhaṃ mahābalam ..
tvatsutāyā vivāhāya balakhānirmahābalaḥ ..
saptalakṣabalairguptaḥ saṃprāptastava rāṣṭrake .. 49 ..
3.3.d:
स उवाच नृपश्रेष्ठं नेत्रसिंहं महाबलम् ॥
त्वत्सुताया विवाहाय बलखानिर्महाबलः ॥
सप्तलक्षबलैर्गुप्तः संप्राप्तस्तव राष्ट्रके ॥ 49 ॥
3.3.m:
He spoke to Netrasiṃha, the best of kings, of great strength:
"For the marriage of your daughter, the mighty Balakhāni,
protected by an army of seven hundred thousand, has arrived in your kingdom.

3.3.s:
tasmāttvaṃ svasutāṃ śīghramāhlādāya samarpaya ..
śulkaṃ me dehi nṛpate yuddharūpaṃ sudāruṇam .. 3.3.13.50 ..
3.3.d:
तस्मात्त्वं स्वसुतां शीघ्रमाह्लादाय समर्पय ॥
शुल्कं मे देहि नृपते युद्धरूपं सुदारुणम् ॥ 3.3.13.50 ॥
3.3.m:
Therefore, swiftly surrender your daughter to Āhlāda!
Or give me the bride-price, O king, in the form of a dreadful battle!"

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā vacastasya sa rājā krodhamūrchitaḥ ..
paṭṭanādhipamājñāya bhūpaṃ pūrṇabalaṃ ruṣā ..
arudhatsa kapāṭaṃ ca tasya baṃdhanahetave .. 51 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा वचस्तस्य स राजा क्रोधमूर्छितः ॥
पट्टनाधिपमाज्ञाय भूपं पूर्णबलं रुषा ॥
अरुधत्स कपाटं च तस्य बंधनहेतवे ॥ 51 ॥
3.3.m:
Hearing his words, the king was overcome with rage.
Knowing the lord of the city, that king of full strength, to be enraged,
he closed the gate in order to bind him.

3.3.s:
pāśahastāñchūraśataṃ paṭṭanādhiparakṣitān ..
dṛṣṭvā sa rūpaṇo vīraḥ khaḍgayuddhamacīkarat .. 52 ..
3.3.d:
पाशहस्ताञ्छूरशतं पट्टनाधिपरक्षितान् ॥
दृष्ट्वा स रूपणो वीरः खड्गयुद्धमचीकरत् ॥ 52 ॥
3.3.m:
Seeing a hundred heroes with nooses in hand guarded by the lord of the city,
the heroic Rūpaṇa waged a sword-fight.

3.3.s:
hatvā tanmukuṭaṃ rājño gṛhītvākāśago balī ..
balakhāniṃ tu saṃprāpya cihnaṃ tasmai nyavedayat .. 53 ..
3.3.d:
हत्वा तन्मुकुटं राज्ञो गृहीत्वाकाशगो बली ॥
बलखानिं तु संप्राप्य चिह्नं तस्मै न्यवेदयत् ॥ 53 ॥
3.3.m:
Having slain them, the mighty hero seized the king’s crown, flew into the sky,
and, reaching Balakhāni, presented that token to him.

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā prasannātmā sapta lakṣadalairyutaḥ ..
arudhannagarīṃ sarvāṃ netrasiṃhena rakṣitām .. 54 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा प्रसन्नात्मा सप्त लक्षदलैर्युतः ॥
अरुधन्नगरीं सर्वां नेत्रसिंहेन रक्षिताम् ॥ 54 ॥
3.3.m:
Hearing this, with a pleased mind and accompanied by seven hundred thousand troops,
he besieged the entire city guarded by Netrasiṃha.

3.3.s:
netrasiṃhastu balavānpārvatīyairnṛpaiḥ saha ..
himatuṃgatalaṃ prāpya yuddhārthī tānsamāhvayat .. 55 ..
3.3.d:
नेत्रसिंहस्तु बलवान्पार्वतीयैर्नृपैः सह ॥
हिमतुंगतलं प्राप्य युद्धार्थी तान्समाह्वयत् ॥ 55 ॥
3.3.m:
The mighty Netrasiṃha, however, together with the mountain kings,
reached the slopes of the snowy peak and, desiring battle, challenged them.

3.3.s:
sahasraṃ ca gajāstasya hayā lakṣaṃ mahābalāḥ ..
sahasraṃ ca nṛpāḥ śūrāścaturlakṣa padātibhiḥ .. 56 ..
3.3.d:
सहस्रं च गजास्तस्य हया लक्षं महाबलाः ॥
सहस्रं च नृपाः शूराश्चतुर्लक्ष पदातिभिः ॥ 56 ॥
3.3.m:
He had a thousand elephants, a hundred thousand mighty horses,
a thousand heroic kings, and four hundred thousand foot soldiers.

3.3.s:
yogasiṃho gajaiḥ sārddhaṃ balakhāniṃ samāhvayat ..
bhogasiṃho hayaiḥ sārddhaṃ kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ ca samāhvayat .. 57 ..
3.3.d:
योगसिंहो गजैः सार्द्धं बलखानिं समाह्वयत् ॥
भोगसिंहो हयैः सार्द्धं कृष्णांशं च समाह्वयत् ॥ 57 ॥
3.3.m:
Yogasiṃha with his elephants challenged Balakhāni;
Bhogasiṃha with his horses challenged the incarnation of Kṛṣṇa;

3.3.s:
vijayo nṛpaputraśca sarvabhūpatibhiḥ saha ..
devasiṃhastathā mlecchai rūpaṇaṃ ca samāhvayat .. 58 ..
3.3.d:
विजयो नृपपुत्रश्च सर्वभूपतिभिः सह ॥
देवसिंहस्तथा म्लेच्छै रूपणं च समाह्वयत् ॥ 58 ॥
3.3.m:
Prince Vijaya, along with all the kings,
and Devasiṃha with the mlecchas challenged Rūpaṇa.

3.3.s:
tayoścāsīnmahadyuddhaṃ senayostatra dāruṇam ..
nirbhayāścaiva te śūrāḥ pārvatīyāḥ samaṃtataḥ ..
jaghnuste śātravīṃ senāṃ dvilakṣāṃ vīrapālitām .. 59 ..
3.3.d:
तयोश्चासीन्महद्युद्धं सेनयोस्तत्र दारुणम् ॥
निर्भयाश्चैव ते शूराः पार्वतीयाः समंततः ॥
जघ्नुस्ते शात्रवीं सेनां द्विलक्षां वीरपालिताम् ॥ 59 ॥
3.3.m:
A great, terrible battle took place there between the two armies.
And those fearless, heroic mountaineers on every side
struck down the enemy army of two hundred thousand, guarded by heroes.

3.3.s:
prabhagnaṃ svabalaṃ dṛṣṭvā catvāro madamattakāḥ ..
divyānaśvānsamāruhya cakruḥ śatrormahāvadham ..
punarujīvitaṃ sarvaṃ ḍhakkāmṛtaravādbalam .. 3.3.13.60 ..
3.3.d:
प्रभग्नं स्वबलं दृष्ट्वा चत्वारो मदमत्तकाः ॥
दिव्यानश्वान्समारुह्य चक्रुः शत्रोर्महावधम् ॥
पुनरुजीवितं सर्वं ढक्कामृतरवाद्बलम् ॥ 3.3.13.60 ॥
3.3.m:
Seeing their own army broken, the four [heroes], intoxicated with fury,
mounted celestial horses and wrought a great slaughter of the enemy.
Yet all the enemy army was revived again by the sound of the nectar-drum (ḍhakkāmṛta).

3.3.s:
yuddhāya saṃmukhaṃ prāpa bhṛguśreṣṭha punaḥ punaḥ ..
ahorātraṃ raṇaścāsītteṣāṃ tatraiva dāruṇaḥ .. 61 ..
3.3.d:
युद्धाय संमुखं प्राप भृगुश्रेष्ठ पुनः पुनः ॥
अहोरात्रं रणश्चासीत्तेषां तत्रैव दारुणः ॥ 61 ॥
3.3.m:
They came face to face for battle again and again, O best of the Bhṛgus;
a dreadful battle of theirs took place right there day and night.

3.3.s:
evaṃ saptāhni saṃjāte yuddhe bhīrubhayaṃkare ..
upāyairbahubhirvīrāścakruścaiva raṇaṃ bahum .. 62 ..
3.3.d:
एवं सप्ताह्नि संजाते युद्धे भीरुभयंकरे ॥
उपायैर्बहुभिर्वीराश्चक्रुश्चैव रणं बहुम् ॥ 62 ॥
3.3.m:
When the battle, terrifying to the timid, had thus gone on for seven days,
the heroes fought extensively by many stratagems.

3.3.s:
punaste jīvamāpannā jaghnustānripusainyapān..
tālanādyāstu te śūrā duḥkhitāstatra cābhavan ..
nirāśāṃ vijaye prāpya kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ .. 63 ..
3.3.d:
पुनस्ते जीवमापन्ना जघ्नुस्तान्रिपुसैन्यपान्॥
तालनाद्यास्तु ते शूरा दुःखितास्तत्र चाभवन् ॥
निराशां विजये प्राप्य कृष्णांशं शरणं ययुः ॥ 63 ॥

3.3.s:
tānāśvāsya sa kṛṣṇāṃśastatra divyahaye sthitaḥ ..
nabhomārgeṇa balavānsvarṇavatyaṃtikaṃ yayau .. 64 ..
3.3.d:
तानाश्वास्य स कृष्णांशस्तत्र दिव्यहये स्थितः ॥
नभोमार्गेण बलवान्स्वर्णवत्यंतिकं ययौ ॥ 64 ॥
3.3.m:
Comforting them, the mighty incarnation of Kṛṣṇa, mounted on a celestial horse,
went through the sky to the vicinity of Svarṇavatī.

3.3.s:
harmyopari sthitāṃ devīṃ sarvaśobhāsamanvitām ..
natvovāca vacaḥ ślakṣṇaṃ kiṃkarohamihodayaḥ ..
śaraṇyāṃ tvāmupāgacchaṃ kāmākṣīmiva bhāmini .. 65 ..
3.3.d:
हर्म्योपरि स्थितां देवीं सर्वशोभासमन्विताम् ॥
नत्वोवाच वचः श्लक्ष्णं किंकरोहमिहोदयः ॥
शरण्यां त्वामुपागच्छं कामाक्षीमिव भामिनि ॥ 65 ॥

3.3.s:
vṛttāntaṃ kathayāmāsa yathāsīcca mahāraṇaḥ ..
śrameṇa karśitā vīrā nirāśāṃ jīvane'gaman .. 66 ..
3.3.d:
वृत्तान्तं कथयामास यथासीच्च महारणः ॥
श्रमेण कर्शिता वीरा निराशां जीवनेऽगमन् ॥ 66 ॥
3.3.m:
He told the story of how the great battle had been,
and how the heroes, exhausted by fatigue, had despaired of their lives.

3.3.s:
sāha codayasiṃha tvaṃ kāmākṣyā maṃdiraṃ vraja ..
ahaṃ ca svālibhiḥ sārdhaṃ navamyāṃ pūjane ratā .. 67 ..
3.3.d:
साह चोदयसिंह त्वं कामाक्ष्या मंदिरं व्रज ॥
अहं च स्वालिभिः सार्धं नवम्यां पूजने रता ॥ 67 ॥
3.3.m:
She said: "O Udayasiṃha, go to the temple of Kāmākṣī;
and I, along with my female companions, am devoted to worship on the navamī.

3.3.s:
ḍhakkāmṛtasya vādyena pūjaye sarvakāmadām ..
iti śrutvā sa balavānsvasainyaṃ prati cāgamat .. 68 ..
3.3.d:
ढक्कामृतस्य वाद्येन पूजये सर्वकामदाम् ॥
इति श्रुत्वा स बलवान्स्वसैन्यं प्रति चागमत् ॥ 68 ॥
3.3.m:
To the sound of the nectar-drum, I shall worship the granter of all desires."
Hearing this, the mighty one returned to his own army.

3.3.s:
ardhaśeṣāṃ raṇātsenāṃ parājāpya ca dudruvuḥ ..
paṭṭanākhyapure prāptāṃ jayaṃ prāpya mahābalāḥ .. 69 ..
3.3.d:
अर्धशेषां रणात्सेनां पराजाप्य च दुद्रुवुः ॥
पट्टनाख्यपुरे प्राप्तां जयं प्राप्य महाबलाः ॥ 69 ॥
3.3.m:
Having defeated the army reduced to half in battle, they fled;
having attained victory, the mighty ones entered the city called Paṭṭana.

3.3.s:
parājite ripau tasminnetrasiṃhasutaiḥ saha ..
gṛhamāgatya balavānviprebhyo godhanaṃ dadau .. 3.3.13.70 ..
3.3.d:
पराजिते रिपौ तस्मिन्नेत्रसिंहसुतैः सह ॥
गृहमागत्य बलवान्विप्रेभ्यो गोधनं ददौ ॥ 3.3.13.70 ॥
3.3.m:
When the enemy had been defeated along with the sons of Netrasiṃha,
the mighty king came home and gave bovine wealth to the brahmins.

3.3.s:
navamyāṃ pitaraṃ prāha devī svarṇavatī tadā ..
kāmākṣīsevanenāśu kuru yāgotsavaṃ mama ..
yatprasādācca vijayī durjayebhyo'bhavadbhavān .. 71 ..
3.3.d:
नवम्यां पितरं प्राह देवी स्वर्णवती तदा ॥
कामाक्षीसेवनेनाशु कुरु यागोत्सवं मम ॥
यत्प्रसादाच्च विजयी दुर्जयेभ्योऽभवद्भवान् ॥ 71 ॥
3.3.m:
On the navamī, Queen Svarṇavatī then spoke to her father:
"Quickly perform my sacrificial festival by worshipping Kāmākṣī,
by whose grace you became victorious over those who are difficult to conquer."

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā pitā prāha svapno dṛṣṭastathā mayā ..
pūjanānmaṃgalaṃ rājñāṃ no cedvighno hi śobhane .. 72 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा पिता प्राह स्वप्नो दृष्टस्तथा मया ॥
पूजनान्मंगलं राज्ञां नो चेद्विघ्नो हि शोभने ॥ 72 ॥
3.3.m:
Hearing this, her father said: "A dream was seen by me in like manner;
from worship comes auspiciousness to kings, otherwise indeed misfortune, O fair one."

3.3.s:
pitroktaivaṃ niśāyāṃ tu sā sutā piturājñayā ..
ḍhakkāmṛtasya vādyena kāmākṣīmadiraṃ yayau .. 73 ..
3.3.d:
पित्रोक्तैवं निशायां तु सा सुता पितुराज्ञया ॥
ढक्कामृतस्य वाद्येन कामाक्षीमदिरं ययौ ॥ 73 ॥
3.3.m:
Addressed thus by her father, at night that daughter, by her father's command,
went to the temple of Kāmākṣī with the playing of the nectar-drum.

3.3.s:
kṛṣṇāṃśo mālyakārasya vadhūrbhūtvā samāgataḥ ..
ḍhakkāmṛtaṃ ca nārībhyo gṛhītvā tvarito yayau .. ..74..
3.3.d:
कृष्णांशो माल्यकारस्य वधूर्भूत्वा समागतः ॥
ढक्कामृतं च नारीभ्यो गृहीत्वा त्वरितो ययौ ॥ ॥74॥
3.3.m:
The incarnation of Kṛṣṇa arrived disguised as the daughter-in-law of a garland-maker;
snatching the nectar-drum from the women, he quickly departed.

3.3.s:
etasminnantare vīrāḥ ṣaṣṭirvāhanasaṃyutāḥ ..
ḍhakkārthaṃ prayayuḥ śīghraṃ sarvaśastraiḥ samudyatāḥ ..75..
3.3.d:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे वीराः षष्टिर्वाहनसंयुताः ॥
ढक्कार्थं प्रययुः शीघ्रं सर्वशस्त्रैः समुद्यताः ॥75॥
3.3.m:
Meanwhile, sixty heroes with mounts
quickly set forth for the drum, equipped with all weapons.

3.3.s:
tānāgatānsa balavāndṛṣṭvā khaḍgaṃ gṛhītavān ..
paṃcapaṃcāśataḥ śūrānanayadyamasādanam .. 76 ..
3.3.d:
तानागतान्स बलवान्दृष्ट्वा खड्गं गृहीतवान् ॥
पंचपंचाशतः शूराननयद्यमसादनम् ॥ 76 ॥
3.3.m:
Seeing them coming, that mighty hero seized his sword
and sent fifty-five heroes to the abode of Yama.

3.3.s:
kṛṣṇāṃśastvarito gatvā rūpaṇo yatra tiṣṭhati ..
ḍhakkāmṛtaṃ ca saṃprāpya hayārūḍho yayau sabhām ..77..
3.3.d:
कृष्णांशस्त्वरितो गत्वा रूपणो यत्र तिष्ठति ॥
ढक्कामृतं च संप्राप्य हयारूढो ययौ सभाम् ॥77॥
3.3.m:
The incarnation of Kṛṣṇa went swiftly to where Rūpaṇa stood;
having secured the nectar-drum, he mounted his horse and went to the assembly.

3.3.s:
hṛte ḍhakkāmṛte divye netrasiṃho bhayāturaḥ ..
aindraṃ yajñaṃ tathā kṛtvā havanāya paro'bhavat .. 78 ..
3.3.d:
हृते ढक्कामृते दिव्ये नेत्रसिंहो भयातुरः ॥
ऐन्द्रं यज्ञं तथा कृत्वा हवनाय परोऽभवत् ॥ 78 ॥
3.3.m:
When the divine nectar-drum had been carried off, Netrasiṃha, afflicted with fear,
performed an Aindra sacrifice and became wholly devoted to offering oblations.

3.3.s:
prabhāte samanuprāpte te vīrāḥ svabalaiḥ saha ..
tarasā prayayuḥ sarve gajoṣṭrahayasaṃsthitāḥ ..
dinānte prāptavaṃtaśca yatrābhūtsamahāraṇaḥ .. 79 ..
3.3.d:
प्रभाते समनुप्राप्ते ते वीराः स्वबलैः सह ॥
तरसा प्रययुः सर्वे गजोष्ट्रहयसंस्थिताः ॥
दिनान्ते प्राप्तवंतश्च यत्राभूत्समहारणः ॥ 79 ॥
3.3.m: When morning arrived, those heroes, mounted on elephants, camels, and horses, / swiftly advanced together with their forces. / And at the close of day they arrived where the great battle had taken place.

3.3.s:
kṛṣṇāṃśaḥ pūjayitvā taṃ dadhmau ḍhakkāmṛtaṃ balī ..
tacchabdena mṛtā vīrāḥ punarujīvitāstadā .. 3.3.13.80 ..
3.3.d:
कृष्णांशः पूजयित्वा तं दध्मौ ढक्कामृतं बली ॥
तच्छब्देन मृता वीराः पुनरुजीवितास्तदा ॥ 3.3.13.80 ॥
3.3.m: The mighty Kṛṣṇāṃśa worshipped that [drum] and blew the nectar-drum; / at its sound, the dead heroes were then brought back to life.

3.3.s:
saptalakṣabalaṃ tasya punaḥ prāptaṃ madāturam ..
rurodha nagarīṃ sarvāṃ dadhmau vādyānyanekaśaḥ .. 81 ..
3.3.d:
सप्तलक्षबलं तस्य पुनः प्राप्तं मदातुरम् ॥
रुरोध नगरीं सर्वां दध्मौ वाद्यान्यनेकशः ॥ 81 ॥
3.3.m: His army of seven hundred thousand was restored, frenzied with passion; / it laid siege to the entire city and blew many musical instruments.

3.3.s:
ruddhe tu nagare tasminnetrasiṃho bhayāturaḥ ..
svātmānamarpayāmāsa vahnau śakrāya dhīmate .. 82 ..
3.3.d:
रुद्धे तु नगरे तस्मिन्नेत्रसिंहो भयातुरः ॥
स्वात्मानमर्पयामास वह्नौ शक्राय धीमते ॥ 82 ॥
3.3.m: When that city was besieged, Netrasiṃha, terrified, / offered himself in the fire to the wise Śakra.

3.3.s:
tadā prasanno bhagavānuvāca nṛpatiṃ prati ..
rāmāṃśoyaṃ ca kṛṣṇāṃśo bhuvi jātau kalaikayā .. 83 ..
3.3.d:
तदा प्रसन्नो भगवानुवाच नृपतिं प्रति ॥
रामांशोयं च कृष्णांशो भुवि जातौ कलैकया ॥ 83 ॥
3.3.m: Then the pleased lord said to the king: / “This part of Rāma and part of Kṛṣṇa were born on earth as a single portion.

3.3.s:
tasmai yogyāya sā kanyā rāmāṃśāya yaśasvine ..
yoginīyaṃ svarṇavatī revatyaṃśāvatāriṇī ..84..
3.3.d:
तस्मै योग्याय सा कन्या रामांशाय यशस्विने ॥
योगिनीयं स्वर्णवती रेवत्यंशावतारिणी ॥84॥
3.3.m: That maiden belongs to that worthy, renowned part of Rāma; / this Svarṇavatī is a yoginī, an incarnation of a portion of Revatī.”

3.3.s:
ityuktvā ca svayaṃ devo ḍhakkāmṛtamumāpriyam ..
hṛtvā vahnau samākṣipya durgāyai saṃnyavedayat .. 85 ..
3.3.d:
इत्युक्त्वा च स्वयं देवो ढक्कामृतमुमाप्रियम् ॥
हृत्वा वह्नौ समाक्षिप्य दुर्गायै संन्यवेदयत् ॥ 85 ॥
3.3.m: Having said this, the god himself seized the nectar-drum dear to Umā, / cast it into the fire, and offered it to Durgā.

3.3.s:
gate tasminsurapato sa rājā brāhmaṇaiḥ saha ..
mahīpatiṃ prati yayau melanārthaṃ samudyataḥ .. 86 ..
3.3.d:
गते तस्मिन्सुरपतो स राजा ब्राह्मणैः सह ॥
महीपतिं प्रति ययौ मेलनार्थं समुद्यतः ॥ 86 ॥
3.3.m: When the lord of the gods was gone, that king, together with brāhmaṇas, / set out to meet the lord of the earth.

3.3.s:
tathāgataṃ nṛpaṃ dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇāṃśaśca mahīpatiḥ ..
āhlādamātulaḥ prāha mānyaḥ sarvabalaiḥ sadā ..87..
3.3.d:
तथागतं नृपं दृष्ट्वा कृष्णांशश्च महीपतिः ॥
आह्लादमातुलः प्राह मान्यः सर्वबलैः सदा ॥87॥
3.3.m: Seeing the king arrive, Kṛṣṇāṃśa, the lord of the earth, / and Āhlāda's maternal uncle, who was always respected by all the forces, spoke:

3.3.s:
rājannayaṃ sa balavānāhrādaḥ sānujaiḥ saha ..
matpaṃktau na sthito vīraḥ kule hīnatvamāgataḥ .. 88 ..
3.3.d:
राजन्नयं स बलवानाह्रादः सानुजैः सह ॥
मत्पंक्तौ न स्थितो वीरः कुले हीनत्वमागतः ॥ 88 ॥
3.3.m: “O King, this strong Āhlāda along with his younger brothers / is a hero who does not sit in my rank, having fallen into baseness of family.

3.3.s:
āryābhīrī smṛtā teṣāṃ kiṃ tvayā viditaṃ na hi ..
yadi deyā tvayā kanyā tarhi tvaṃ hīnatāṃ vraja .. 89 ..
3.3.d:
आर्याभीरी स्मृता तेषां किं त्वया विदितं न हि ॥
यदि देया त्वया कन्या तर्हि त्वं हीनतां व्रज ॥ 89 ॥
3.3.m: Their [mother] is remembered as an Ārya-Abhīrī; is this not known to you? / If you give your maiden [to him], then you will sink into degradation.

3.3.s:
atastvaṃ vacanaṃ cedaṃ kulayogyaṃ śṛṇuṣva bhoḥ ..
caturo bālakānnīcāṃstālanena samanvitān .. 3.3.13.90 ..
3.3.d:
अतस्त्वं वचनं चेदं कुलयोग्यं शृणुष्व भोः ॥
चतुरो बालकान्नीचांस्तालनेन समन्वितान् ॥ 3.3.13.90 ॥
3.3.m: Therefore, listen to this advice of mine that is fitting for your family: / Having deceived the four base young men together with Tālana

3.3.s:
vañcayitvā vivāhārthe śirāṃsyeṣāṃ samāhara ..
maṃḍapati makhaṃ kṛtvā cāmuṇḍāyai samarpaya .. 91 ..
3.3.d:
वञ्चयित्वा विवाहार्थे शिरांस्येषां समाहर ॥
मंडपति मखं कृत्वा चामुण्डायै समर्पय ॥ 91 ॥
3.3.m: under the pretext of a marriage, take their heads; / perform a sacrifice in the pavilion and offer them to Cāmuṇḍā.

3.3.s:
tvatkanyayā samāhūtā vīrā vai revatī hi sā ..
paścātkanyāṃ svayaṃ hatvā kulakalyāṇamāvaha.. 92 ..
3.3.d:
त्वत्कन्यया समाहूता वीरा वै रेवती हि सा ॥
पश्चात्कन्यां स्वयं हत्वा कुलकल्याणमावह॥ 92 ॥
3.3.m: The heroes have been summoned by your maiden, for she is indeed Revatī; / afterwards, having killed the maiden yourself, bring welfare to your family.

3.3.s:
no cedbhavānkṣayaṃ yāyātsakulo jaṃbuko yathā ..
ityuktvā sa yayau sārddhaṃ yatrāhrādasya bāṃdhavaḥ .. 93 ..
3.3.d:
नो चेद्भवान्क्षयं यायात्सकुलो जंबुको यथा ॥
इत्युक्त्वा स ययौ सार्द्धं यत्राह्रादस्य बांधवः ॥ 93 ॥
3.3.m: Otherwise, you will perish along with your family, like a jackal.” / Having spoken thus, he went along with [them] to where Āhlāda's kinsman was.

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā sa śalyāṃśaḥ suyodhanamukheritam ..
tathetyuktvotsavaṃ kṛtvā maṃḍapāṃte vidhānataḥ ..
āhlādasya samīpaṃ sa gatvaitadvaṃcanāya hi ..
tamāha daṃḍavatpādau gṛhītvā nṛpatissvayam .. 94 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा स शल्यांशः सुयोधनमुखेरितम् ॥
तथेत्युक्त्वोत्सवं कृत्वा मंडपांते विधानतः ॥
आह्लादस्य समीपं स गत्वैतद्वंचनाय हि ॥
तमाह दंडवत्पादौ गृहीत्वा नृपतिस्स्वयम् ॥ 94 ॥
3.3.m: Having heard this, spoken from the mouth of Suyodhana, that part of Śalya, / saying “So be it,” held a festival at the end of the pavilion according to the rites; / and going near Āhlāda to deceive him, / the king himself held his feet prostrate like a staff and said to him:

3.3.s:
bhavantoṃśāvatārāśca mayā jñātāḥ surottamāt ..
nirastrānpañca yuṣmāṃśca pūjayitvā yathāvidhi ..
rāmāṃśāya svakanyāṃ ca dāsyāmi kularītitaḥ .. 95 ..
3.3.d:
भवन्तोंशावताराश्च मया ज्ञाताः सुरोत्तमात् ॥
निरस्त्रान्पञ्च युष्मांश्च पूजयित्वा यथाविधि ॥
रामांशाय स्वकन्यां च दास्यामि कुलरीतितः ॥ 95 ॥
3.3.m: “I have learned from the highest of gods that you are incarnations of [divine] portions. / Having worshipped the five of you without weapons according to the rules, / I shall give my maiden to the part of Rāma according to the custom of the family.”

3.3.s:
ityāhrādaṃ samādiśya sa nṛpaśchalamāśritaḥ ..
durgotsave yayau gehaṃ tadvadhāya samudyataḥ .. 96 ..
3.3.d:
इत्याह्रादं समादिश्य स नृपश्छलमाश्रितः ॥
दुर्गोत्सवे ययौ गेहं तद्वधाय समुद्यतः ॥ 96 ॥
3.3.m: Having thus instructed Āhlāda, that king resorted to deceit; / on the festival of Durgā, he went to his house, resolved to slaughter him.

3.3.s:
sahasraṃ maṃḍape bhūpānsaṃsthāpya svabalaiḥ saha ..
tālanādyāṃśca ṣaṭ śūrānmaṃḍapāṃte samāhvayat .. 97 ..
3.3.d:
सहस्रं मंडपे भूपान्संस्थाप्य स्वबलैः सह ॥
तालनाद्यांश्च षट् शूरान्मंडपांते समाह्वयत् ॥ 97 ॥
3.3.m: Stationing a thousand kings along with his own forces in the pavilion, / he summoned the six heroes, beginning with Tālana, to the pavilion.

3.3.s:
vivāhaprathamāvarte yogasiṃho'simuttamam ..
varamāhatya śirasi jagarja balavānruṣā .. 98 ..
3.3.d:
विवाहप्रथमावर्ते योगसिंहोऽसिमुत्तमम् ॥
वरमाहत्य शिरसि जगर्ज बलवान्रुषा ॥ 98 ॥
3.3.m: At the first circumambulation of the marriage, the mighty Yogasiṃha, / striking the bridegroom on the head with his excellent sword, roared in fury.

3.3.s:
tamāha tālano dhīmānna yogyaṃ bhavatā kṛtam ..
śrutvāha netrasiṃhastaṃ kularītiriyaṃ balin ..
nirāyudhaiḥ paraiḥ sārddhaṃ śastriṇāṃ saṃgaro hi naḥ .. 99 ..
3.3.d:
तमाह तालनो धीमान्न योग्यं भवता कृतम् ॥
श्रुत्वाह नेत्रसिंहस्तं कुलरीतिरियं बलिन् ॥
निरायुधैः परैः सार्द्धं शस्त्रिणां संगरो हि नः ॥ 99 ॥
3.3.m: The wise Tālana said to him: “What you have done is not fitting.” / Hearing this, Netrasiṃha said to him: “O strong one, this is the custom of our family; / our battle, as armed men, is indeed with unarmed foes.”

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā yogasiṃhaṃ kṛṣṇāṃśastaṃ samārudhat ..
bhogasiṃhaṃ tathā kṛṣya balakhānirgṛhītavān .. 3.3.13.100 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा योगसिंहं कृष्णांशस्तं समारुधत् ॥
भोगसिंहं तथा कृष्य बलखानिर्गृहीतवान् ॥ 3.3.13.100 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing this, Kṛṣṇāṃśa held back Yogasiṃha; / and dragging Bhogasiṃha, Balakhāni seized him.

3.3.s:
vijayaṃ tṛtīyāvarte sukhakhānirnyaruṃddha vai ..
caturthāvartake śatruṃ nṛpaṃ pūrṇabalaṃ śaṭham ..
rūpaṇastaṃ gṛhītvāśu yuyudhe tadbalaiḥ saha .. 101 ..
3.3.d:
विजयं तृतीयावर्ते सुखखानिर्न्यरुंद्ध वै ॥
चतुर्थावर्तके शत्रुं नृपं पूर्णबलं शठम् ॥
रूपणस्तं गृहीत्वाशु युयुधे तद्बलैः सह ॥ 101 ॥
3.3.m: At the third circumambulation, Sukhakhāni obstructed Vijaya; / and at the fourth circumambulation, seizing the enemy, the deceitful King Pūrṇabala, / Rūpaṇa quickly fought with his forces.

3.3.s:
paṃcame bahurājānaṃ tālanaśca samārudhat ..
ṣaṣṭhāvartte netrasiṃhaṃ tathāhlādo gṛhītavān .. 102 ..
3.3.d:
पंचमे बहुराजानं तालनश्च समारुधत् ॥
षष्ठावर्त्ते नेत्रसिंहं तथाह्लादो गृहीतवान् ॥ 102 ॥
3.3.m: At the fifth, Tālana held back Bahurāja; / and at the sixth circumambulation, Āhlāda seized Netrasiṃha.

3.3.s:
saṃprāpte tumale yuddhe bahuśūrāḥ kṣayaṃ gatāḥ ..
nirāyudhāḥ ṣaḍ balinaḥ saṃkṣamya vraṇamuttamam ..
nirāyudhānripūnsvānsvāṃścakruḥ śaktiprapūjakāḥ ..1 03..
3.3.d:
संप्राप्ते तुमले युद्धे बहुशूराः क्षयं गताः ॥
निरायुधाः षड् बलिनः संक्षम्य व्रणमुत्तमम् ॥
निरायुधान्रिपून्स्वान्स्वांश्चक्रुः शक्तिप्रपूजकाः ॥1 03॥
3.3.m: When a fierce battle took place, many heroes met their destruction. / The six mighty men, unarmed, enduring severe wounds, / worshippers of Śakti, rendered their respective enemies weaponless.

3.3.s:
etasminnantare devaḥ kāladarśī samāgataḥ ..
nabhomārgeṇa tānaśvāṃstebhya āgatya saṃdadau .. 104 ..
3.3.d:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे देवः कालदर्शी समागतः ॥
नभोमार्गेण तानश्वांस्तेभ्य आगत्य संददौ ॥ 104 ॥
3.3.m: In the meantime, the god who sees the time of death arrived; / coming by the path of the sky, he gave those horses to them:

3.3.s:
bindulaṃ caiva kṛṣṇāṃśo devastatra manoratham ..
rūpaṇaśca karālāśvaṃ cāhlādastu papīhakam .. 105 ..
3.3.d:
बिन्दुलं चैव कृष्णांशो देवस्तत्र मनोरथम् ॥
रूपणश्च करालाश्वं चाह्लादस्तु पपीहकम् ॥ 105 ॥
3.3.m: to Kṛṣṇāṃśa, Bindula; and the god there [gave] Manoratha; / to Rūpaṇa, the horse Karāla; and to Āhlāda, Papīhaka;

3.3.s:
hariṇīṃ balakhāniśca tadbhrātā harināgaram ..
siṃhinīṃ tālanaḥ śūraḥ samāruhya raṇodyataḥ .. 106 ..
3.3.d:
हरिणीं बलखानिश्च तद्भ्राता हरिनागरम् ॥
सिंहिनीं तालनः शूरः समारुह्य रणोद्यतः ॥ 106 ॥
3.3.m: to Balakhāni, Hariṇī; and his brother [received] Harināgara; / the hero Tālana mounted Siṃhinī and prepared for battle.

3.3.s:
rātrau tannṛpateḥ senāṃ hatvā baddhvā ca tatpatim ..
dolāṃ gehācca niṣkāśya saptabhramarakāritām .. 107 ..
3.3.d:
रात्रौ तन्नृपतेः सेनां हत्वा बद्ध्वा च तत्पतिम् ॥
दोलां गेहाच्च निष्काश्य सप्तभ्रमरकारिताम् ॥ 107 ॥
3.3.m: Having slain the army of that king by night and bound its lord, / and having brought out from the house the palanquin constructed with seven turns,

3.3.s:
svasainyaṃ te samājagmurnirbhayā balavattarāḥ ..
tānsarvānnetrasiṃhādīndṛṣṭvā pāhīti jalpitaḥ .. 108 ..
3.3.d:
स्वसैन्यं ते समाजग्मुर्निर्भया बलवत्तराः ॥
तान्सर्वान्नेत्रसिंहादीन्दृष्ट्वा पाहीति जल्पितः ॥ 108 ॥
3.3.m: those most mighty men, fearless, returned to their own army. / Seeing them all, Netrasiṃha and the others cried out, “Protect us!”

3.3.s:
nigaḍairekataḥ kṛtvā pañca bhūpānhi vaṃcakān ..
kārāgāre mahāghore tatra tānsaṃnyavāsayan .. .. 109 ..
3.3.d:
निगडैरेकतः कृत्वा पञ्च भूपान्हि वंचकान् ॥
कारागारे महाघोरे तत्र तान्संन्यवासयन् ॥ ॥ 109 ॥
3.3.m: Fettering together with chains those five deceitful kings, / they threw them there into a terrible dungeon.

3.3.s:
netrasiṃho varo bhrātā sundarāraṇyabhūmipaḥ ..
hetuṃ jñātvāyayau śīghraṃ māyāvī lakṣasainyakaḥ .. 3.3.13.110 ..
3.3.d:
नेत्रसिंहो वरो भ्राता सुन्दरारण्यभूमिपः ॥
हेतुं ज्ञात्वाययौ शीघ्रं मायावी लक्षसैन्यकः ॥ 3.3.13.110 ॥
3.3.m: Netrasiṃha's excellent brother, the king of Sundarāraṇya, / knowing the cause, arrived quickly, a master of illusion with an army of one hundred thousand.

3.3.s:
tatrāgatya harānando nāmnā tānayudhadbalī . .
netrasiṃhasya sainyaṃ ca caturlakṣaṃ tadāgamat . . 111 . .
3.3.d:
तत्रागत्य हरानन्दो नाम्ना तानयुधद्बली ॥
नेत्रसिंहस्य सैन्यं च चतुर्लक्षं तदागमत् ॥ 111 ॥
3.3.m: Arriving there, the mighty one named Harānanda fought them; / and an army of Netrasiṃha consisting of four hundred thousand arrived then.

3.3.s:
pañcalakṣai raṇo ghoraḥ saptalakṣayutairabhūt ..
pañcāhorātramātraṃ ca tayoścāsītsa saṃkulaḥ ..
arddhasainyaṃ ripostatra hataśeṣamadudruvat .. 112 . .
3.3.d:
पञ्चलक्षै रणो घोरः सप्तलक्षयुतैरभूत् ॥
पञ्चाहोरात्रमात्रं च तयोश्चासीत्स संकुलः ॥
अर्द्धसैन्यं रिपोस्तत्र हतशेषमदुद्रुवत् ॥ 112 ॥
3.3.m: A terrible battle of five hundred thousand against seven hundred thousand ensued; / and for five days and nights their clash continued. / Half of the enemy's army was slain there; the remainder fled.

3.3.s:
vismitaḥ sa harānando rudramāyāviśāradaḥ ..
balādhikyayutāñjñātvā śivadhyānaparo'bhavat . . . . 113 . .
3.3.d:
विस्मितः स हरानन्दो रुद्रमायाविशारदः ॥
बलाधिक्ययुताञ्ज्ञात्वा शिवध्यानपरोऽभवत् ॥ ॥ 113 ॥
3.3.m: Astonished, that Harānanda, skilled in the magical illusion of Rudra, / knowing them to possess superior strength, became absorbed in meditation on Śiva.

3.3.s:
racitvā śāṃbarīṃ māyāṃ nānārūpavidhāriṇīm . .
pāṣāṇabhūtānsakalānkṛtvā bhūpānsamāyayau . . 114 . .
3.3.d:
रचित्वा शांबरीं मायां नानारूपविधारिणीम् ॥
पाषाणभूतान्सकलान्कृत्वा भूपान्समाययौ ॥ 114 ॥
3.3.m: Conjuring an illusion of Śambara assuming manifold forms, / he turned all the kings into stone and came forward.

3.3.s:
sasutaṃ bhrātaraṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ nṛpaṃ pūrṇabalaṃ tataḥ ..
mocayitvā yayau gehaṃ kṛtakṛtyo mahābalī .. 115 ..
āhlādaṃ nigaḍairbaddhvā māyayā jaḍatāṃ gatam ..
netrasiṃhaḥ sa balavānyayau svaṃ durgamudyataḥ ..
taṃ praśaṃsyānujaṃ vīro viprebhyaśca dadau dhanam .. 11 6. .
tadā svarṇavatī dīnā baddhaṃ jñātvā patiṃ nijam ..
kṛṣṇāṃśādyānmohitāṃśca śaṃbhumāyāvaśānugān . . .. 11 7..
3.3.d:
ससुतं भ्रातरं ज्येष्ठं नृपं पूर्णबलं ततः ॥
मोचयित्वा ययौ गेहं कृतकृत्यो महाबली ॥ 115 ॥
आह्लादं निगडैर्बद्ध्वा मायया जडतां गतम् ॥
नेत्रसिंहः स बलवान्ययौ स्वं दुर्गमुद्यतः ॥
तं प्रशंस्यानुजं वीरो विप्रेभ्यश्च ददौ धनम् ॥ 11 6॥
तदा स्वर्णवती दीना बद्धं ज्ञात्वा पतिं निजम् ॥
कृष्णांशाद्यान्मोहितांश्च शंभुमायावशानुगान् ॥ ॥ 11 7॥
3.3.m:
Having released his eldest brother together with his son, King Pūrṇabala, / that very mighty one, his purpose accomplished, went home.
Having bound with chains Āhlāda, who had been reduced to insensibility by magic, / the mighty Netrasiṃha set out for his own fortress; / praising his younger brother, the hero gave wealth to the brāhmaṇas.
Then the wretched Svarṇavatī, knowing her husband to be bound / and Kṛṣṇāṃśa and the others to be bewitched, subdued by the illusion of Śambhu—

3.3.s:
rurodoccaistadā devīṃ dhyāyaṃtī kāmarūpiṇīm . .
tadā tuṣṭā jagaddhātrī mūrcchitāṃstānabodhayat . . 118 . .
te sarve cetanāṃ prāptāḥ prāhuḥ svarṇavatīṃ mudā ..
kvāsthito vaṃdhurāhlādo devi tvaṃ kāraṇaṃ vada. . 11 9.
yathā baddhaḥ svayaṃ svāmī kathayāmāsa sā tathā ..
ahaṃ śukī bhavāmyadya bhavānbiṃdulasaṃsthitaḥ . .. 3.3.13.12 0 ..
3.3.d:
रुरोदोच्चैस्तदा देवीं ध्यायंती कामरूपिणीम् ॥
तदा तुष्टा जगद्धात्री मूर्च्छितांस्तानबोधयत् ॥ 118 ॥
ते सर्वे चेतनां प्राप्ताः प्राहुः स्वर्णवतीं मुदा ॥
क्वास्थितो वंधुराह्लादो देवि त्वं कारणं वद॥ 11 9.
यथा बद्धः स्वयं स्वामी कथयामास सा तथा ॥
अहं शुकी भवाम्यद्य भवान्बिंदुलसंस्थितः ॥। 3.3.13.12 0 ॥
3.3.m:
Then she wept aloud, meditating upon the goddess who assumes forms at will. / Then the sustainer of the world, being pleased, awakened those who had fainted.
Having regained consciousness, they all joyfully said to Svarṇavatī: / "Where is our brother Āhlāda? O lady, tell us the cause!" / She told them just how her husband had been bound: / "Today I will become a female parrot, while you remain at Biṃdula."

3.3.s:
ityuktvā sā śukī bhūtvā kṛṣṇāṃśena samanvitā ..
yatrāste tatpatirbaddhastatra sā kāminī yayau .. 121 ..
3.3.d:
इत्युक्त्वा सा शुकी भूत्वा कृष्णांशेन समन्विता ॥
यत्रास्ते तत्पतिर्बद्धस्तत्र सा कामिनी ययौ ॥ 121 ॥
3.3.m: Having said this and become a female parrot, accompanied by Kṛṣṇāṃśa, / that loving woman went to where her bound husband was.

3.3.s:
kṛṣṇāṃśo'pi hayārūḍho nabhomārgeṇa cāptavān ..
abhīrīṃ mūrtimāsādya svāminaṃ prati sā yayau .. 1 22..
3.3.d:
कृष्णांशोऽपि हयारूढो नभोमार्गेण चाप्तवान् ॥
अभीरीं मूर्तिमासाद्य स्वामिनं प्रति सा ययौ ॥ 1 22॥
3.3.m: Kṛṣṇāṃśa too, mounted on a horse, arrived through the path of the sky. / Assuming the form of an Ābhīra woman, she approached her husband.

3.3.s:
āśvāsya taṃ yathāyogyaṃ kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ pratyavarṇayat ..
kṛṣṇāṃśastatra balavānhatvā durga nivāsinaḥ .. 123 ..
3.3.d:
आश्वास्य तं यथायोग्यं कृष्णांशं प्रत्यवर्णयत् ॥
कृष्णांशस्तत्र बलवान्हत्वा दुर्ग निवासिनः ॥ 123 ॥
3.3.m: Having consoled him fittingly, she reported to Kṛṣṇāṃśa. / There the mighty Kṛṣṇāṃśa, having slain the fortress-dwellers,

3.3.s:
rakṣakāñchatasāhasrānhatvā bhrātaramāyayau . .
paurṇimāṃ madhuyuktāṃ ca jñātvā sarve tvarānvitāḥ .. 124 ..
3.3.d:
रक्षकाञ्छतसाहस्रान्हत्वा भ्रातरमाययौ ॥
पौर्णिमां मधुयुक्तां च ज्ञात्वा सर्वे त्वरान्विताः ॥ 124 ॥
3.3.m: and having slain hundreds of thousands of guards, came to his brother. / Knowing it was the full moon day endowed with spring, all of them hastened.

3.3.s:
ayodhyāṃ śīghramāgamya snātvā vai sarayūṃ nadīm . .
holikādāhasamaye śīghraṃ veṇyāṃ samāgatāḥ .. 1 25. .
3.3.d:
अयोध्यां शीघ्रमागम्य स्नात्वा वै सरयूं नदीम् ॥
होलिकादाहसमये शीघ्रं वेण्यां समागताः ॥ 1 25॥
3.3.m: Quickly coming to Ayodhyā and bathing in the Sarayū river, / at the time of the burning of Holikā they quickly arrived at the confluence.

3.3.s:
snānadhyānādikā niṣṭhāḥ kṛtvā gehamupāyayuḥ ..
sāgarasya taṭaṃ prāpya kṛtvā te ca mahotsavam . .
caitrasya kṛṣṇapañcamyāṃ svagehaṃ punarāyayuḥ .. 126 ..
3.3.d:
स्नानध्यानादिका निष्ठाः कृत्वा गेहमुपाययुः ॥
सागरस्य तटं प्राप्य कृत्वा ते च महोत्सवम् ॥
चैत्रस्य कृष्णपञ्चम्यां स्वगेहं पुनराययुः ॥ 126 ॥
3.3.m: Having performed their vows of bathing, meditation, and the rest, they went home. / Reaching the shore of the ocean and holding a great festival, / they returned to their own home on the fifth day of the dark fortnight of Caitra.

3.3.s:
dūtā uṣṭrasamārūḍhāstatkṣemakaraṇotsukāḥ . .
vaiśākhe śuklapaṃcamyāṃ svagehaṃ punarāyayuḥ .. 127 . .
3.3.d:
दूता उष्ट्रसमारूढास्तत्क्षेमकरणोत्सुकाः ॥
वैशाखे शुक्लपंचम्यां स्वगेहं पुनराययुः ॥ 127 ॥
3.3.m: Messengers mounted on camels, eager to ensure their well-being, / returned to their own home on the fifth day of the bright fortnight of Vaiśākha.

3.3.s:
malanā bhūpatiścaiva gehegehe mahotsavam ..
kārayitvā vidhānena brāhmaṇebhyo dadau dhanam . . 128 ..
3.3.d:
मलना भूपतिश्चैव गेहेगेहे महोत्सवम् ॥
कारयित्वा विधानेन ब्राह्मणेभ्यो ददौ धनम् ॥ 128 ॥
3.3.m: And King Malanā, having caused a great festival to be celebrated in every house / according to the rules, gave wealth to the brāhmaṇas.

3.3.s:
. . sūta uvāca .. ..
caturdaśābde kṛṣṇāṃśe yathā jātaṃ tathā śṛṇu ..
jayantaḥ śakraputraśca jānakīśāpamohitaḥ ..
kalau janmatvamāpannaḥ svarṇavatyudare'vasat .. 1 . .
3.3.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
चतुर्दशाब्दे कृष्णांशे यथा जातं तथा शृणु ॥
जयन्तः शक्रपुत्रश्च जानकीशापमोहितः ॥
कलौ जन्मत्वमापन्नः स्वर्णवत्युदरेऽवसत् ॥ 1 ॥
3.3.m: Sūta said: / Hear how it happened when Kṛṣṇāṃśa was in his fourteenth year. / Jayanta, Indra's son, bewitched by the curse of Jānakī, / took birth in the Kali age and dwelt in the womb of Svarṇavatī.

3.3.s:
caitraśukla navamyāṃ ca madhyāhne guruvāsare ..
sa jātaścandravadano rājalakṣaṇalakṣitaḥ .. 2 . .
3.3.d:
चैत्रशुक्ल नवम्यां च मध्याह्ने गुरुवासरे ॥
स जातश्चन्द्रवदनो राजलक्षणलक्षितः ॥ 2 ॥
3.3.m: On the navamī of the bright fortnight of Caitra, at midday on a Thursday, / he was born, moon-faced, marked with the marks of royalty.

3.3.s:
jāte tasminsutaśreṣṭhe devāḥ sarṣigaṇāstadā ..
induloyaṃ mahīṃ jāto jayanto vāsavātmajaḥ ..
ityūcurvacanaṃ tasmādindulo nāma cābhavat . . 3 ..
3.3.d:
जाते तस्मिन्सुतश्रेष्ठे देवाः सर्षिगणास्तदा ॥
इन्दुलोयं महीं जातो जयन्तो वासवात्मजः ॥
इत्यूचुर्वचनं तस्मादिन्दुलो नाम चाभवत् ॥ 3 ॥
3.3.m: When that excellent son was born, the gods along with the hosts of sages / then spoke these words: "This Indula, Jayanta the son of Vāsava, is born upon the earth." / Therefore his name became Indula.

3.3.s:
āhlādo jātakarmādīnkārayitvā śiśormudā ..
brāhmaṇebhyo dadau svarṇadhenuvṛndaṃ hayāngajān .. 4 ..
3.3.d:
आह्लादो जातकर्मादीन्कारयित्वा शिशोर्मुदा ॥
ब्राह्मणेभ्यो ददौ स्वर्णधेनुवृन्दं हयान्गजान् ॥ 4 ॥
3.3.m: Āhlāda, having joyfully performed the birth rite and other ceremonies for the child, / gave to the brāhmaṇas herds of golden cows, horses, and elephants.

3.3.s:
indule tanaye jāte dvimāsāṃte mahītale ..
yogasiṃhastadāgatya svarṇavatyai dadau dhanam ..
netrasiṃha sutaṃ dṛṣṭvā malanāsnehasaṃyutā ..
papraccha kuśalapraśnaṃ bhojayitvā vidhānataḥ .. 6 ..
3.3.d:
इन्दुले तनये जाते द्विमासांते महीतले ॥
योगसिंहस्तदागत्य स्वर्णवत्यै ददौ धनम् ॥
नेत्रसिंह सुतं दृष्ट्वा मलनास्नेहसंयुता ॥
पप्रच्छ कुशलप्रश्नं भोजयित्वा विधानतः ॥ 6 ॥
3.3.m: When the son Indula was two months old upon the surface of the earth, / Yogasiṃha then came and gave wealth to Svarṇavatī. / Seeing the son of Netrasiṃha, Malanā, filled with affection, / inquired after his welfare, having fed him according to rule.

3.3.s:
śatavṛndāśca nartakyo nānārāgeṇa saṃyutāḥ ..
tatrāgatyeva nanṛturyatra bhūpasutaḥ sthitaḥ .. 7 ..
3.3.d:
शतवृन्दाश्च नर्तक्यो नानारागेण संयुताः ॥
तत्रागत्येव ननृतुर्यत्र भूपसुतः स्थितः ॥ 7 ॥
3.3.m: Hundreds of dancing girls, endowed with various musical melodies, / came right there and danced where the king's son was.

3.3.s:
saptarātramuṣitvā sa yogasiṃho yayau gṛham ..
ṣaṇmāse ca sute jāte devendraḥ snehakātaraḥ .. 8 ..
3.3.d:
सप्तरात्रमुषित्वा स योगसिंहो ययौ गृहम् ॥
षण्मासे च सुते जाते देवेन्द्रः स्नेहकातरः ॥ 8 ॥
3.3.m: Having stayed for seven nights, Yogasiṃha went home. / And when the son reached six months, the lord of the gods, overcome by affection,

3.3.s:
putrasnehena taṃ putraṃ sa jahāra svamāyayā ..
saṃhṛtya bālakaṃ śreṣṭhamindrāṇyai ca samarpayat .. 9 ..
3.3.d:
पुत्रस्नेहेन तं पुत्रं स जहार स्वमायया ॥
संहृत्य बालकं श्रेष्ठमिन्द्राण्यै च समर्पयत् ॥ 9 ॥
3.3.m: carried off that son by his own Māyā out of affection for his son. / Taking the excellent boy away, he handed him over to Indrāṇī.

3.3.s:
snehaplutā śacī devī svastanau tamapāyayat ..
devyā dugdhaṃ sa vai pītvā ṣoḍaśābdasamobhavat .. 3.3.14.10 ..
3.3.d:
स्नेहप्लुता शची देवी स्वस्तनौ तमपाययत् ॥
देव्या दुग्धं स वै पीत्वा षोडशाब्दसमोभवत् ॥ 3.3.14.10 ॥
3.3.m: Flooded with affection, the goddess Śacī suckled him at her own breasts. / Having drunk the milk of the goddess, he became like a sixteen-year-old.

3.3.s:
induṃ pīyūṣabhavanaṃ gṛhṇāti vapuṣā svayam ..
ataḥ sa indulo nāma jayantaśca prakīrtitaḥ ..
sa bālaḥ svapiturvidyāṃ paṭhitvā śreṣṭhatāmagāt .. 11 ..
3.3.d:
इन्दुं पीयूषभवनं गृह्णाति वपुषा स्वयम् ॥
अतः स इन्दुलो नाम जयन्तश्च प्रकीर्तितः ॥
स बालः स्वपितुर्विद्यां पठित्वा श्रेष्ठतामगात् ॥ 11 ॥
3.3.m: He himself received in his body the moon, the abode of nectar; / hence he is celebrated by the name Indula, and also as Jayanta. / That boy, having studied the learning of his father, attained excellence.

3.3.s:
vinaṣṭe bālake tasmindevī svarṇavatī tadā ..
rurodoccaistadā dīnā hā putra kva gato'si bhoḥ .. 12 ..
3.3.d:
विनष्टे बालके तस्मिन्देवी स्वर्णवती तदा ॥
रुरोदोच्चैस्तदा दीना हा पुत्र क्व गतोऽसि भोः ॥ 12 ॥
3.3.m: When that boy was lost, the noble lady Svarṇavatī / then wept aloud in distress: "Alas, my son, where have you gone?"

3.3.s:
jñātvāhlādaṃ tathā bhūtaṃ daśagrāme tathāvidhe ..
raudraḥ kolāhalo jāto rudatāṃ ca nṛṇāṃ mune .. 13 ..
3.3.d:
ज्ञात्वाह्लादं तथा भूतं दशग्रामे तथाविधे ॥
रौद्रः कोलाहलो जातो रुदतां च नृणां मुने ॥ 13 ॥
3.3.m: When it was known that Āhlāda was in such a state, O sage, in Daśagrāma / a dreadful uproar of weeping men arose in like manner.

3.3.s:
āhlādaḥ svakulaiḥ sārddhaṃ nirāhāro yateṃdriyaḥ ..
śāradāṃ śaraṇaṃ prāptastrirātraṃ tatra cāvasat .. 14..
3.3.d:
आह्लादः स्वकुलैः सार्द्धं निराहारो यतेंद्रियः ॥
शारदां शरणं प्राप्तस्त्रिरात्रं तत्र चावसत् ॥ 14॥
3.3.m: Āhlāda, together with his family, fasting and with senses restrained, / sought refuge with Śāradā and dwelt there for three nights.

3.3.s:
tadā tuṣṭā svayaṃ devī vāguvācāśarīriṇī ..
he putra svakulaiḥ sārddhaṃ mā śucastvaṃ sutaṃ prati .. .. 15 ..
3.3.d:
तदा तुष्टा स्वयं देवी वागुवाचाशरीरिणी ॥
हे पुत्र स्वकुलैः सार्द्धं मा शुचस्त्वं सुतं प्रति ॥ ॥ 15 ॥
3.3.m: Then, being pleased, the goddess herself spoke as a bodiless voice: / "O son, together with your family do not grieve over your child!

3.3.s:
indraputro jayantaśca svargalokamupāgataḥ ..
divyavidyāṃ paṭhitvā sa trivarṣāṃte gamiṣyati .. 16 ..
3.3.d:
इन्द्रपुत्रो जयन्तश्च स्वर्गलोकमुपागतः ॥
दिव्यविद्यां पठित्वा स त्रिवर्षांते गमिष्यति ॥ 16 ॥
3.3.m: Jayanta, the son of Indra, has gone to the world of heaven. / Having studied divine knowledge, he will return at the end of three years.

3.3.s:
yāvattvaṃ bhūtale'vātsīstāvatsa bhūtale vaset ..
tatpaścātsvargatiṃ prāpya jayanto hi bhaviṣyati .. 17 ..
3.3.d:
यावत्त्वं भूतलेऽवात्सीस्तावत्स भूतले वसेत् ॥
तत्पश्चात्स्वर्गतिं प्राप्य जयन्तो हि भविष्यति ॥ 17 ॥
3.3.m: As long as you dwell on the earth, so long shall he dwell on the earth. / After that, having attained heaven, he will indeed be Jayanta."

3.3.s:
ityukte vacane devyā niśśokāste tadābhavan ..
daśagrāmapuraṃ prāpya samūṣurjñāna tatparāḥ .. 18 ..
3.3.d:
इत्युक्ते वचने देव्या निश्शोकास्ते तदाभवन् ॥
दशग्रामपुरं प्राप्य समूषुर्ज्ञान तत्पराः ॥ 18 ॥
3.3.m: When this word was spoken by the goddess, they became free from sorrow. / Reaching the town of Daśagrāma, they dwelt intent on wisdom.

3.3.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
indule svargasaṃprāpte te vīrāḥ śokakātarāḥ ..
śāradāṃ pūjayāmāsuḥ sarvalokanivāsinīm .. 1 ..
3.3.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
इन्दुले स्वर्गसंप्राप्ते ते वीराः शोककातराः ॥
शारदां पूजयामासुः सर्वलोकनिवासिनीम् ॥ 1 ॥
3.3.m: Sūta said: / When Indula had reached heaven, those heroes, overcome with grief, / worshipped Śāradā, who dwells in all worlds.

3.3.s:
japtvā saptaśatī stotraṃ trisandhyaṃ premabhaktitaḥ ..
dhyānenānandamāpannāstadā saptaśatehani .. 2 ..
3.3.d:
जप्त्वा सप्तशती स्तोत्रं त्रिसन्ध्यं प्रेमभक्तितः ॥
ध्यानेनानन्दमापन्नास्तदा सप्तशतेहनि ॥ 2 ॥
3.3.m: Having recited the Saptaśatī hymn at the three junctures of the day with loving devotion, / they attained bliss through meditation. Then on the seven-hundredth day,

3.3.s:
sāmantadvijaputraśca cāmuṇḍo nāma viśrutaḥ ..
so'ṣṭavarṣavayā bhūtvā pūjayāmāsa caṇḍikām .. 3 ..
3.3.d:
सामन्तद्विजपुत्रश्च चामुण्डो नाम विश्रुतः ॥
सोऽष्टवर्षवया भूत्वा पूजयामास चण्डिकाम् ॥ 3 ॥
3.3.m: the son of the feudatory brāhmaṇa, renowned by the name Cāmuṇḍa, / having reached eight years of age, worshipped Caṇḍikā.

3.3.s:
dvādaśābde tato jāte tricaritrasya pāṭhataḥ ..
parīkṣārthaṃ tu bhaktānāṃ sākṣānmūrtitvamāgatā .. 4 ..
3.3.d:
द्वादशाब्दे ततो जाते त्रिचरित्रस्य पाठतः ॥
परीक्षार्थं तु भक्तानां साक्षान्मूर्तित्वमागता ॥ 4 ॥
3.3.m: Then, after twelve years passed, by the recitation of the three episodes, / she manifested in visible bodily form to test her devotees:

3.3.s:
kuṃḍikeyaṃ ca bho bhaktāḥ pūrayāmi ca tāmaham ..
yūyaṃ tu manasopāyaiḥ kurudhvaṃ pūraṇe matim .. 5 ..
3.3.d:
कुंडिकेयं च भो भक्ताः पूरयामि च तामहम् ॥
यूयं तु मनसोपायैः कुरुध्वं पूरणे मतिम् ॥ 5 ॥
3.3.m: "O devotees, here is a small vessel, and I am filling it. / But set your minds on filling it through mental means."

3.3.s:
sukhakhānistu balavānmadhupuṣpaistathā phalaiḥ ..
kuṇḍikāṃ pūrayā māsa na pūrṇatvamupāgatā ..
balakhānistathā māṃsairmūlaśarmā tu raktakaiḥ .. 6 ..
3.3.d:
सुखखानिस्तु बलवान्मधुपुष्पैस्तथा फलैः ॥
कुण्डिकां पूरया मास न पूर्णत्वमुपागता ॥
बलखानिस्तथा मांसैर्मूलशर्मा तु रक्तकैः ॥ 6 ॥
3.3.m: The mighty Sukhakhāni filled the vessel with honey-flowers and fruits, / but it did not reach fullness; / likewise Balakhāni with meats, and Mūlaśarmā with red garments.

3.3.s:
devakī ca tadā havyaiścandanādibhirarcanaiḥ ..
kuṇḍikāṃ pūrayāmāsa na pūrṇatvamupāgatā .. 7 ..
3.3.d:
देवकी च तदा हव्यैश्चन्दनादिभिरर्चनैः ॥
कुण्डिकां पूरयामास न पूर्णत्वमुपागता ॥ 7 ॥
3.3.m: And Devakī then filled the vessel with sacrificial offerings and worship with sandalwood and other articles, / yet it did not reach fullness.

3.3.s:
āhrādaścaiva sarvāṃgairudayaḥ śirasā svayam ..
kuṇḍikāṃ pūrayāmāsa tadā pūrṇatvamāgatā .. 8 ..
3.3.d:
आह्रादश्चैव सर्वांगैरुदयः शिरसा स्वयम् ॥
कुण्डिकां पूरयामास तदा पूर्णत्वमागता ॥ 8 ॥
3.3.m: Then Āhlāda with all his limbs and Udaya with his own head / filled the small vessel; then it attained fullness.

3.3.s:
uvāca vacanaṃ devī svabhaktānbhaktavatsalā ..
sukhākhāne bhavānvīro bhaviṣyati surapriyaḥ .. 9 ..
3.3.d:
उवाच वचनं देवी स्वभक्तान्भक्तवत्सला ॥
सुखाखाने भवान्वीरो भविष्यति सुरप्रियः ॥ 9 ॥
3.3.m: The goddess, affectionate to her devotees, spoke these words to her devotees: / "O Sukhakhāni, you shall be a hero dear to the gods.

3.3.s:
balakhānirmahāvīro dīrghe kāle sa mṛtyubhāk ..
mūlaśarmā tu balavānraktabījo bhaviṣyati .. 3.3.15.10 ..
3.3.d:
बलखानिर्महावीरो दीर्घे काले स मृत्युभाक् ॥
मूलशर्मा तु बलवान्रक्तबीजो भविष्यति ॥ 3.3.15.10 ॥
3.3.m: Balakhāni shall be a mighty hero meeting death after a long time. / And the mighty Mūlaśarmā shall become a Raktabīja."

3.3.s:
devakī ca bhaveddevī cirakālaṃ svalokagā ..
āhlādaścaiva kṛṣṇāṃśastayormadhye dvayaṃ varam ..
ekastu devavatprokto balādhikyo dvitīyakaḥ .. 11 ..
3.3.d:
देवकी च भवेद्देवी चिरकालं स्वलोकगा ॥
आह्लादश्चैव कृष्णांशस्तयोर्मध्ये द्वयं वरम् ॥
एकस्तु देववत्प्रोक्तो बलाधिक्यो द्वितीयकः ॥ 11 ॥
3.3.m: And Devakī shall become a goddess, dwelling in her own realm for a long time. / And Āhlāda is a portion of Kṛṣṇa; between the two, each has an excellent boon: / one is declared to be like a god, while the second possesses superior strength.

3.3.s:
niṣkāmo'yaṃ devasiṃho mṛto mokṣatvamāpnuyāt ..
ityuktvāntardadhe mātā te sarve tṛptimāgatāḥ .. 12 ..
3.3.d:
निष्कामोऽयं देवसिंहो मृतो मोक्षत्वमाप्नुयात् ॥
इत्युक्त्वान्तर्दधे माता ते सर्वे तृप्तिमागताः ॥ 12 ॥
3.3.m: This Devasiṃha, free from desire, upon dying shall attain liberation.” / Having spoken thus, the Mother vanished, and they all attained satisfaction.

3.3.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
prāpte saptadaśābde ca kṛṣṇāṃśe tatra cābhavat ..
śṛṇu tvaṃ muniśārdūla dṛṣṭaṃ yadyogadarśanāt .. 1 ..
3.3.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
प्राप्ते सप्तदशाब्दे च कृष्णांशे तत्र चाभवत् ॥
शृणु त्वं मुनिशार्दूल दृष्टं यद्योगदर्शनात् ॥ 1 ॥
3.3.m: Sūta said: / When the seventeenth year arrived, and a portion of Kṛṣṇa was present there, / listen, O tiger among sages, to what was seen through yogic vision.

3.3.s:
ratnabhānau mṛte rājñi marudhanvamahīpatiḥ ..
gajasenastadā vipra pṛthvīrājabhayāturaḥ .. 2 ..
3.3.d:
रत्नभानौ मृते राज्ञि मरुधन्वमहीपतिः ॥
गजसेनस्तदा विप्र पृथ्वीराजभयातुरः ॥ 2 ॥
3.3.m: When King Ratnabhānu had died, the ruler of Marudhanvan, / Gajasena, O twice-born one, was afflicted with fear of Pṛthvīrāja.

3.3.s:
ārādhya pāvakaṃ devaṃ yajñadhyānavratārcanaiḥ ..
dvādaśābdaṃ sadācāraḥ premabhaktyā hyatoṣayat .. 3..
3.3.d:
आराध्य पावकं देवं यज्ञध्यानव्रतार्चनैः ॥
द्वादशाब्दं सदाचारः प्रेमभक्त्या ह्यतोषयत् ॥ 3॥
3.3.m: Having propitiated the god Pāvaka with sacrifices, meditations, vows, and worship, / living virtuously for twelve years, he pleased him with loving devotion.

3.3.s:
tadā prasanno bhagavānpāvakīyaṃ hayaṃ śubham ..
dadau tasmai sutau cobhau kanyāṃ ca gajamuktikām .. 4 ..
3.3.d:
तदा प्रसन्नो भगवान्पावकीयं हयं शुभम् ॥
ददौ तस्मै सुतौ चोभौ कन्यां च गजमुक्तिकाम् ॥ 4 ॥
3.3.m: Then, being pleased, the Lord gave him an auspicious horse belonging to Pāvaka, / and two sons, and a daughter named Gajamuktikā.

3.3.s:
pāvakāste hi catvāraḥ samudbhūtā mahītale ..
agnivarṇā mahāvīrāḥ sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitāḥ .. 5 ..
3.3.d:
पावकास्ते हि चत्वारः समुद्भूता महीतले ॥
अग्निवर्णा महावीराः सर्वलक्षणलक्षिताः ॥ 5 ॥
3.3.m: Indeed, those four arose from fire upon the earth, / fiery-hued, mighty heroes, endowed with all auspicious marks.

3.3.s:
aṣṭādaśavayobhūtāḥ sarve te munipuṃgava ..
jātamātrā devasamāḥ sarvavidyāviśāradāḥ .. 6 ..
3.3.d:
अष्टादशवयोभूताः सर्वे ते मुनिपुंगव ॥
जातमात्रा देवसमाः सर्वविद्याविशारदाः ॥ 6 ॥
3.3.m: They had all attained eighteen years of age, O best of sages; / as soon as they were born, they were equal to gods, proficient in all branches of learning.

3.3.s:
aṣṭādaśābdavayasā sā kanyā varavarṇinī ..
durgāyāśca varaṃ prāptā dharmāṃśastvāṃ variṣyati .. 7 ..
3.3.d:
अष्टादशाब्दवयसा सा कन्या वरवर्णिनी ॥
दुर्गायाश्च वरं प्राप्ता धर्मांशस्त्वां वरिष्यति ॥ 7 ॥
3.3.m: At eighteen years of age, that fair-complexioned maiden / received a boon from Durgā: “A portion of Dharma shall choose you.”

3.3.s:
śārdūlavaṃśī sa nṛpaḥ kṛtavānvai svayaṃvaram ..
nānādeśyā nṛpāḥ prāptāḥ sutāyā rūpamohitāḥ .. 8 ..
3.3.d:
शार्दूलवंशी स नृपः कृतवान्वै स्वयंवरम् ॥
नानादेश्या नृपाः प्राप्ताः सुताया रूपमोहिताः ॥ 8 ॥
3.3.m: That king of the tiger-dynasty held a svayaṃvara; / kings from various countries arrived, infatuated by the beauty of his daughter.

3.3.s:
mārgaśīrṣe site pakṣe cāṣṭamyāṃ caṃdravāsare ..
tasyāḥ svayaṃvaraścāsītsā nṛpānprati cāyayau .. 9 ..
3.3.d:
मार्गशीर्षे सिते पक्षे चाष्टम्यां चंद्रवासरे ॥
तस्याः स्वयंवरश्चासीत्सा नृपान्प्रति चाययौ ॥ 9 ॥
3.3.m: In the bright fortnight of Mārgaśīrṣa, on the aṣṭamī, on a Monday, / her svayaṃvara took place, and she approached the kings.

3.3.s:
vidyudvarṇaṃ mukhaṃ tasyāścaṃcalāyāstathāgatam ..
dṛṣṭvā mumoha dharmāṃśo balakhānirmahīpatiḥ .. 3.3.16.10 ..
3.3.d:
विद्युद्वर्णं मुखं तस्याश्चंचलायास्तथागतम् ॥
दृष्ट्वा मुमोह धर्मांशो बलखानिर्महीपतिः ॥ 3.3.16.10 ॥
3.3.m: Seeing her lightning-hued face as she approached like a streak of lightning, / the portion of Dharma, King Balakhāni, was enraptured.

3.3.s:
sāpi dṛṣṭvā ca taṃ vīraṃ mumoha gajamuktikā ..
buddhvā tasmai dadau mālāṃ vaijayaṃtī śubhānanā .. 11 ..
3.3.d:
सापि दृष्ट्वा च तं वीरं मुमोह गजमुक्तिका ॥
बुद्ध्वा तस्मै ददौ मालां वैजयंती शुभानना ॥ 11 ॥
3.3.m: Seeing that hero, Gajamuktikā too was enraptured; / recognizing him, the fair-faced maiden placed the garland of victory upon him.

3.3.s:
tārakādyāśca bhūpālāḥ sarvaśastrāstrasaṃyutāḥ ..
rurudhuḥ sarvato vīraṃ te balātkanyakārthinaḥ .. 12 ..
3.3.d:
तारकाद्याश्च भूपालाः सर्वशस्त्रास्त्रसंयुताः ॥
रुरुधुः सर्वतो वीरं ते बलात्कन्यकार्थिनः ॥ 12 ॥
3.3.m: Then the kings led by Tāraka, equipped with all weapons and missiles, / surrounded the hero on all sides, seeking by force to seize the maiden.

3.3.s:
tathāvidhānnṛpāndṛṣṭvā bhūpānpaṃcaśatānbalī ..
sa śīghraṃ khaṅgamutsṛjya śatabhūpaśirāṃsyahan .. .. 13 ..
3.3.d:
तथाविधान्नृपान्दृष्ट्वा भूपान्पंचशतान्बली ॥
स शीघ्रं खङ्गमुत्सृज्य शतभूपशिरांस्यहन् ॥ ॥ 13 ॥
3.3.m: Seeing five hundred kings of that sort, the mighty one / swiftly drew his sword and struck off the heads of a hundred kings.

3.3.s:
sarvato vadhyamānaṃ taṃ balakhāniṃ sa tārakaḥ ..
tadbhujābhyāṃ dadau khaḍgaṃ sa tadaṃge dvidhābhavat .. 14 ..
3.3.d:
सर्वतो वध्यमानं तं बलखानिं स तारकः ॥
तद्भुजाभ्यां ददौ खड्गं स तदंगे द्विधाभवत् ॥ 14 ॥
3.3.m: As Balakhāni was being attacked on all sides, Tāraka / struck with his sword with both arms, but it broke in two upon his body.

3.3.s:
mahīrājasuto jyeṣṭho dṛṣṭvā khaḍgaṃ tathā gatam ..
apovāha raṇācchūrastatpaścātte nṛpā yayuḥ .. 15 ..
3.3.d:
महीराजसुतो ज्येष्ठो दृष्ट्वा खड्गं तथा गतम् ॥
अपोवाह रणाच्छूरस्तत्पश्चात्ते नृपा ययुः ॥ 15 ॥
3.3.m: Seeing the sword broken in that way, the eldest son of Mahīrāja, / the warrior, fled from the battle, and those kings followed after him.

3.3.s:
parājite nṛpabale balakhānirmahābalaḥ ..
tāṃ kanyāṃ śibikārūḍhāṃ svagehaṃ so'nayadbalī .. 16 ..
3.3.d:
पराजिते नृपबले बलखानिर्महाबलः ॥
तां कन्यां शिबिकारूढां स्वगेहं सोऽनयद्बली ॥ 16 ॥
3.3.m: When the army of kings was defeated, the mighty Balakhāni, / full of strength, led that maiden, seated in a palanquin, to his own home.

3.3.s:
tāṃ gacchaṃtīṃ sutāṃ dṛṣṭvā gajaseno mahīpatiḥ ..
mahīpatyājñayā prāpto jñātvā taṃ kṣatriyādhamam .. 17 ..
3.3.d:
तां गच्छंतीं सुतां दृष्ट्वा गजसेनो महीपतिः ॥
महीपत्याज्ञया प्राप्तो ज्ञात्वा तं क्षत्रियाधमम् ॥ 17 ॥
3.3.m: Seeing his daughter departing, King Gajasena / arrived at the ruler’s command, considering him the lowest of kṣatriyas.

3.3.s:
jaṃbukaghnaṃ mahāvīraṃ māyayā tamamohayat ..
jāte nidrāture vīre durgāyāḥ śāpamohite .. 18 ..
3.3.d:
जंबुकघ्नं महावीरं मायया तममोहयत् ॥
जाते निद्रातुरे वीरे दुर्गायाः शापमोहिते ॥ 18 ॥
3.3.m: By magical illusion, he bewildered that mighty hero, the slayer of Jambuka; / when the hero became overcome with sleep, deluded by Durgā's curse,

3.3.s:
nigaḍaistaṃ babaṃdhāśu dṛḍhairlohamayai ruṣā ..
lohadurgaṃ ca saṃprāpya grāmarūpaṃ mahīpatiḥ .. 19 ..
3.3.d:
निगडैस्तं बबंधाशु दृढैर्लोहमयै रुषा ॥
लोहदुर्गं च संप्राप्य ग्रामरूपं महीपतिः ॥ 19 ॥
3.3.m: he quickly bound him in anger with firm iron fetters; / and having reached Lohadurga, in the form of a village, the king

3.3.s:
cāṃḍālāṃśca samāhūya kaṭhināṃstatravāsinaḥ ..
vadhāyājñāpayāmāsa tasya daṃḍairanekaśaḥ .. 3.3.16.20 ..
3.3.d:
चांडालांश्च समाहूय कठिनांस्तत्रवासिनः ॥
वधायाज्ञापयामास तस्य दंडैरनेकशः ॥ 3.3.16.20 ॥
3.3.m: summoned the harsh cāṇḍālas dwelling there / and ordered them to put him to death with manifold beatings with sticks.

3.3.s:
te raudrāstaṃ samābadhya tāḍayāmāsurūjjitāḥ ..
tattāḍanāttadā nidrā tatraiva vilayaṃ gatā .. 21 ..
3.3.d:
ते रौद्रास्तं समाबध्य ताडयामासुरूज्जिताः ॥
तत्ताडनात्तदा निद्रा तत्रैव विलयं गता ॥ 21 ॥
3.3.m: Those terrible men bound him firmly and beat him with great force; / from that beating, his sleep was dissolved right there.

3.3.s:
dṛṣṭvā tatastu caṃḍālānbalakhāniratāḍayat ..
talamuṣṭiprahāreṇa cāṃḍālā maraṇaṃ gatāḥ .. 22 ..
3.3.d:
दृष्ट्वा ततस्तु चंडालान्बलखानिरताडयत् ॥
तलमुष्टिप्रहारेण चांडाला मरणं गताः ॥ 22 ॥
3.3.m: Seeing the cāṇḍālas thereupon, Balakhāni struck back; / with blows of his palms and fists, the cāṇḍālas met their death.

3.3.s:
mṛte paṃcaśate raudre taccheṣā dudruvurbhayāt ..
kapāṭaṃ sudṛḍhaṃ kṛtvā nṛpāṃtikamupāyayuḥ .. 23 ..
3.3.d:
मृते पंचशते रौद्रे तच्छेषा दुद्रुवुर्भयात् ॥
कपाटं सुदृढं कृत्वा नृपांतिकमुपाययुः ॥ 23 ॥
3.3.m: When five hundred of those terrible men were slain, the survivors fled in terror; / having barred the door firmly, they approached the king.

3.3.s:
sa nṛpaḥ kāraṇaṃ jñātvā hastabaddho mahābalī ..
uvāca tatra gatvāsau vacanaṃ kāryatatparaḥ ..24..
3.3.d:
स नृपः कारणं ज्ञात्वा हस्तबद्धो महाबली ॥
उवाच तत्र गत्वासौ वचनं कार्यतत्परः ॥24॥
3.3.m: Learning the cause, that king, having his hands bound in supplication, mighty though he was, / went there and spoke these words, intent upon his purpose:

3.3.s:
bhavānmahābalo vīra cāṃḍālairbaṃdhanaṃ gataḥ ..
dasyubhirluṃṭhitastatra nidrāvaśyo vanaṃ gataḥ..25..
3.3.d:
भवान्महाबलो वीर चांडालैर्बंधनं गतः ॥
दस्युभिर्लुंठितस्तत्र निद्रावश्यो वनं गतः॥25॥
3.3.m: “You are a hero of great strength; you were bound by cāṇḍālas, / plundered there by bandits, and overcome by sleep, you went to the forest.

3.3.s:
matsutā bhavane prāptā diṣṭyā tvaṃ jīvitaṃ gataḥ ..
udvāhya matsutāṃ śīghraṃ svagehaṃ yātumarhasi ..
iti śrutvā priyaṃ vākyaṃ taṃ praśasya tathākarot..26..
3.3.d:
मत्सुता भवने प्राप्ता दिष्ट्या त्वं जीवितं गतः ॥
उद्वाह्य मत्सुतां शीघ्रं स्वगेहं यातुमर्हसि ॥
इति श्रुत्वा प्रियं वाक्यं तं प्रशस्य तथाकरोत्॥26॥
3.3.m: My daughter has arrived at the palace; fortunately, you have remained alive. / Having married my daughter, you should quickly go to your own home.” / Hearing these pleasant words, praising him, he acted accordingly.

3.3.s:
maṃḍape vedakarmāṇi vivāhārthaṃ cakāra saḥ ..
jātāyāṃ maṃḍapārcāyāṃ patramāhlādahetave .. 27 ..
3.3.d:
मंडपे वेदकर्माणि विवाहार्थं चकार सः ॥
जातायां मंडपार्चायां पत्रमाह्लादहेतवे ॥ 27 ॥
3.3.m: He performed the Vedic rites in the pavilion for the sake of the marriage; / when the worship of the pavilion was completed, for the purpose of [bringing] Āhlāda,

3.3.s:
tadājñayā likhitvāsau gajaseno'gnisevakaḥ ..
uṣṭrārūḍhaṃ samāhūya śīghraṃ patramacodayat .. 28 ..
3.3.d:
तदाज्ञया लिखित्वासौ गजसेनोऽग्निसेवकः ॥
उष्ट्रारूढं समाहूय शीघ्रं पत्रमचोदयत् ॥ 28 ॥
3.3.m: having written a letter at his command, Gajasena, the worshipper of fire, / summoned an emissary mounted on a camel and dispatched the letter quickly:

3.3.s:
balakhānervivāho'tra bhavānsainyasamanvitaḥ ..
saṃprāpya yogyadravyāṇi bhuktvā tvaṃ tṛptimāvaha .. 29 ..
3.3.d:
बलखानेर्विवाहोऽत्र भवान्सैन्यसमन्वितः ॥
संप्राप्य योग्यद्रव्याणि भुक्त्वा त्वं तृप्तिमावह ॥ 29 ॥
3.3.m: “Here is Balakhāni's marriage; accompanied by your army, / having arrived and received suitable gifts and enjoyed food, find satisfaction.”

3.3.s:
ityukte niśi jātāyāṃ balakhānirmahābalaḥ ..
bhojanaṃ kṛtavāṃstatra viṣajuṣṭaṃ nṛpārpitam .. 3.3.16.30 ..
3.3.d:
इत्युक्ते निशि जातायां बलखानिर्महाबलः ॥
भोजनं कृतवांस्तत्र विषजुष्टं नृपार्पितम् ॥ 3.3.16.30 ॥
3.3.m: Having said this, when night fell, the mighty Balakhāni / ate food there that was tainted with poison, offered by the king.

3.3.s:
garalaṃ tena saṃbhuktaṃ na mamāra varācchubhāt ..
tataḥ kāle ca saṃprāpte dṛṣṭvā mohatvamāgatam ..
punarbabaṃdha nigaḍaistāḍayāmāsa vetasaiḥ .. 31 ..
3.3.d:
गरलं तेन संभुक्तं न ममार वराच्छुभात् ॥
ततः काले च संप्राप्ते दृष्ट्वा मोहत्वमागतम् ॥
पुनर्बबंध निगडैस्ताडयामास वेतसैः ॥ 31 ॥
3.3.m: Though the poison was consumed by him, he did not die, on account of an auspicious boon; / then, when the time came, seeing that he had fallen into a stupor, / he bound him again with fetters and beat him with canes.

3.3.s:
viṣadoṣamasṛkdvārānnissṛtaṃ sarvadehataḥ ..
tadā bubodha balavānbhūpatiṃ prāha namradhīḥ .. 32 ..
3.3.d:
विषदोषमसृक्द्वारान्निस्सृतं सर्वदेहतः ॥
तदा बुबोध बलवान्भूपतिं प्राह नम्रधीः ॥ 32 ॥
3.3.m: The effect of the poison flowed out with blood from his whole body; / then the strong man awakened, and with a humble mind said to the king:

3.3.s:
rājankimīdṛśaṃ jātaṃ tvatsainyaṃ tāḍane ratam ..
sa āha bho mahāvīra matkule rītirīdṛśī ..
yātanāṃ prathamaṃ prāpya tadanūdvāhito bhavet .. 33 ..
3.3.d:
राजन्किमीदृशं जातं त्वत्सैन्यं ताडने रतम् ॥
स आह भो महावीर मत्कुले रीतिरीदृशी ॥
यातनां प्रथमं प्राप्य तदनूद्वाहितो भवेत् ॥ 33 ॥
3.3.m: “O King, what sort of thing has happened, that your army is intent upon beating me?” / He replied: “O mighty hero, such is the custom in my family; / having first endured suffering, one should then be married.”

3.3.s:
ityukte sati bhūpāle gajamuktā samāgatā ..
pitaraṃ prāha vacanaṃ ko'yaṃ tattāḍane gataḥ .. 34 ..
3.3.d:
इत्युक्ते सति भूपाले गजमुक्ता समागता ॥
पितरं प्राह वचनं कोऽयं तत्ताडने गतः ॥ 34 ॥
3.3.m: While the king was speaking thus, Gajamuktā arrived; / she addressed these words to her father: “Who is this person who has undergone such beating?”

3.3.s:
nṛpaḥ prāha sute śīghraṃ yāhi tvaṃ nijamaṃdire ..
kṛṣikaroyamāyāto dravyārthaṃ tāḍane gataḥ .. 35 ..
3.3.d:
नृपः प्राह सुते शीघ्रं याहि त्वं निजमंदिरे ॥
कृषिकरोयमायातो द्रव्यार्थं ताडने गतः ॥ 35 ॥
3.3.m: The king said: “Daughter, go quickly to your own palace; / this is a farmer who came for wealth and has undergone beating.”

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā vaco ghoraṃ balakhānirmahābalaḥ ..
chittvā tadbaṃdhanaṃ ghoraṃ khaḍgahastaḥ samāyayau .. 36 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा वचो घोरं बलखानिर्महाबलः ॥
छित्त्वा तद्बंधनं घोरं खड्गहस्तः समाययौ ॥ 36 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing these dreadful words, the mighty Balakhāni / cut through those terrible bonds and advanced, sword in hand.

3.3.s:
śūrānpaṃcaśataṃ taṃ ca ruddhvā śastraiḥ samaṃtataḥ ..
prajaghnatastu tānsarvānbalakhānirvyanāśayat .. 37 ..
3.3.d:
शूरान्पंचशतं तं च रुद्ध्वा शस्त्रैः समंततः ॥
प्रजघ्नतस्तु तान्सर्वान्बलखानिर्व्यनाशयत् ॥ 37 ॥
3.3.m: Five hundred warriors surrounded him on all sides with weapons; / but as they attacked him, Balakhāni destroyed them all.

3.3.s:
gajasena suto jyeṣṭhaḥ sūryadyutirupāgataḥ ..
baddhvā punastaṃ balinaṃ gartamadhye samākṣipat .. 38 ..
3.3.d:
गजसेन सुतो ज्येष्ठः सूर्यद्युतिरुपागतः ॥
बद्ध्वा पुनस्तं बलिनं गर्तमध्ये समाक्षिपत् ॥ 38 ॥
3.3.m: The eldest son of Gajasena, Sūryadyuti, approached; / having bound the strong one again, he threw him into a pit.

3.3.s:
tathā gataṃ patiṃ dṛṣṭvā gajamuktā suduḥkhitā ..
niśi tatra gatā devī dattvā dravyaṃ tu rakṣakān .. 39..
3.3.d:
तथा गतं पतिं दृष्ट्वा गजमुक्ता सुदुःखिता ॥
निशि तत्र गता देवी दत्त्वा द्रव्यं तु रक्षकान् ॥ 39॥
3.3.m: Seeing her husband in such a state, Gajamuktā was deeply grieved; / at night, the lady went there, having bribed the guards with wealth.

3.3.s:
patiṃ niṣkāsya rudatī vyajanaṃ pataye dadau ..
rātraurātrau tathā prāptā vyatītaṃ pakṣamātrakam .. 3.3.16.40 ..
3.3.d:
पतिं निष्कास्य रुदती व्यजनं पतये ददौ ॥
रात्रौरात्रौ तथा प्राप्ता व्यतीतं पक्षमात्रकम् ॥ 3.3.16.40 ॥
3.3.m: Taking her husband out and weeping, she fanned her husband. / Reaching there night after night, a mere fortnight passed by.

3.3.s:
etasminnaṃtare vīraścāhlādaḥ saptalakṣakaiḥ ..
sainyaiḥ sahāyayau śīghraṃ śrutvā tatraiva kāraṇam .. 41 ..
3.3.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे वीरश्चाह्लादः सप्तलक्षकैः ॥
सैन्यैः सहाययौ शीघ्रं श्रुत्वा तत्रैव कारणम् ॥ 41 ॥
3.3.m: Meanwhile, the hero Āhlāda, with seven hundred thousand / soldiers, arrived swiftly as soon as he heard of the cause.

3.3.s:
balakhānirgato garte rurodha nagarīṃ tadā ..
gajaiḥ ṣoḍaśasāhasrairgajaseno raṇaṃ yayau .. 42 ..
3.3.d:
बलखानिर्गतो गर्ते रुरोध नगरीं तदा ॥
गजैः षोडशसाहस्रैर्गजसेनो रणं ययौ ॥ 42 ॥
3.3.m: Balakhāni emerged from the pit and then besieged the city. / With sixteen thousand elephants, Gajasena marched to battle.

3.3.s:
trilakṣaiśca hayaiḥ sārddhaṃ sūryadyutirupāyayau ..
kāṃtāmalastadā prāptastrilakṣaiśca padātibhiḥ .. 43 ..
3.3.d:
त्रिलक्षैश्च हयैः सार्द्धं सूर्यद्युतिरुपाययौ ॥
कांतामलस्तदा प्राप्तस्त्रिलक्षैश्च पदातिभिः ॥ 43 ॥
3.3.m: And with three hundred thousand horses, Sūryadyuti approached; / Kāntāmala then arrived with three hundred thousand foot soldiers.

3.3.s:
tayoścāsīnmahadyuddhamahorātraṃ hi sainyayoḥ ..
rakṣite tālanādye ca gajasenādyake tadā .. 44 ..
3.3.d:
तयोश्चासीन्महद्युद्धमहोरात्रं हि सैन्ययोः ॥
रक्षिते तालनाद्ये च गजसेनाद्यके तदा ॥ 44 ॥
3.3.m: And a great battle took place between the two armies for a day and night, / while the forces led by Tālana and Gajasena were held in check.

3.3.s:
dvitīye'hni samāyāte gajaseno mahābalaḥ ..
prabhagnaṃ svabalaṃ dṛṣṭvā pāvakī'yaṃ samāruhat ..
dāhayāmāsa tatsainyaṃ tālanādyaiśca pālitam .. 45 ..
3.3.d:
द्वितीयेऽह्नि समायाते गजसेनो महाबलः ॥
प्रभग्नं स्वबलं दृष्ट्वा पावकीऽयं समारुहत् ॥
दाहयामास तत्सैन्यं तालनाद्यैश्च पालितम् ॥ 45 ॥
3.3.m: When the second day arrived, the mighty Gajasena, / seeing his own army shattered, mounted a fiery chariot [and] / burned that army led and protected by Tālana and the others.

3.3.s:
bhasmībhūtaṃ balaṃ dṛṣṭvā tālanaḥ śatrusammukhe ..
gatvā bhallena bhūpālaṃ tāḍayāmāsa vegataḥ .. 46 ..
3.3.d:
भस्मीभूतं बलं दृष्ट्वा तालनः शत्रुसम्मुखे ॥
गत्वा भल्लेन भूपालं ताडयामास वेगतः ॥ 46 ॥
3.3.m: Seeing his army turned to ashes, Tālana, advancing before the enemy, / quickly struck the king with a spear.

3.3.s:
mūrchitaṃ nṛpamājñāya sūryadyutirupāyayau ..
pāvakīyaṃ samāruhya dāhayāmāsa tālanam .. 47 ..
3.3.d:
मूर्छितं नृपमाज्ञाय सूर्यद्युतिरुपाययौ ॥
पावकीयं समारुह्य दाहयामास तालनम् ॥ 47 ॥
3.3.m: Knowing the king had fainted, Sūryadyuti approached, / [and] mounting a fiery chariot, burned Tālana.

3.3.s:
etasminnaṃtare śūrau devau cāhlādakṛṣṇakau ..
babandhatū ruṣāviṣṭau sūryadyutimariṃdamam .. 48 ..
3.3.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे शूरौ देवौ चाह्लादकृष्णकौ ॥
बबन्धतू रुषाविष्टौ सूर्यद्युतिमरिंदमम् ॥ 48 ॥
3.3.m: Meanwhile, the two heroic lords, Āhlāda and Kṛṣṇaka, / seized with fury, bound Sūryadyuti, the subduer of foes.

3.3.s:
subaddhaṃ bhrātaraṃ jñātvā hayaṃ kāṃtāmalo'ruhat ..
devasiṃhaṃ ca saṃmohya kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ prati so'gamat ..
gṛhītvā taṃ sa kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ tasya tejaḥ samāharat .. 49 ..
3.3.d:
सुबद्धं भ्रातरं ज्ञात्वा हयं कांतामलोऽरुहत् ॥
देवसिंहं च संमोह्य कृष्णांशं प्रति सोऽगमत् ॥
गृहीत्वा तं स कृष्णांशं तस्य तेजः समाहरत् ॥ 49 ॥
3.3.m: Knowing his brother firmly bound, Kāntāmala mounted a horse, / and bewitching Devasiṃha, went against Kṛṣṇāṃśa; / seizing Kṛṣṇāṃśa, he took away his splendour.

3.3.s:
saptalakṣabalaṃ sarvaṃ vahnibhūtamabhūttadā ..
amaratvātsa āhlādastadā tu samajīvayat .. 3.3.16.50 ..
3.3.d:
सप्तलक्षबलं सर्वं वह्निभूतमभूत्तदा ॥
अमरत्वात्स आह्लादस्तदा तु समजीवयत् ॥ 3.3.16.50 ॥
3.3.m: Then the entire army of seven hundred thousand turned to fire; / but because of his immortality, Āhlāda brought it back to life.

3.3.s:
gajasenasyārddhasainyaṃ taiśca sarvairvināśitam ..
vijayaṃ nṛpatiḥ prāpya harṣito gehamāyayau . 51 ..
3.3.d:
गजसेनस्यार्द्धसैन्यं तैश्च सर्वैर्विनाशितम् ॥
विजयं नृपतिः प्राप्य हर्षितो गेहमाययौ । 51 ॥
3.3.m: Half of Gajasena's army was destroyed by all of them; / having gained victory, the king returned home delighted.

3.3.s:
vahnibhūtaṃ ca kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ dṛṣṭvāhlādaḥ suduḥkhitaḥ ..
durgāṃ devīṃ sa tuṣṭāva manasā raṇamūrddhani .. 52 ..
3.3.d:
वह्निभूतं च कृष्णांशं दृष्ट्वाह्लादः सुदुःखितः ॥
दुर्गां देवीं स तुष्टाव मनसा रणमूर्द्धनि ॥ 52 ॥
3.3.m: And seeing Kṛṣṇāṃśa turned to fire, Āhlāda, overwhelmed with sorrow, / praised the goddess Durgā in his mind on the battlefield.

3.3.s:
tadā devī vacaḥ prāha vatsa te putra eva ca ..
svargādāgatya sarvāṇi punarujjīvayiṣyati .. 53 ..
3.3.d:
तदा देवी वचः प्राह वत्स ते पुत्र एव च ॥
स्वर्गादागत्य सर्वाणि पुनरुज्जीवयिष्यति ॥ 53 ॥
3.3.m: Then the goddess spoke these words: 'Child, your son indeed, / coming from heaven, will bring all back to life.'

3.3.s:
ityukte vacane devyā indulo vāsavājñayā ..
dvādaśābdasamaṃ rūpaṃ dhṛtvā vidyāviśāradaḥ ..
vaḍavāmṛtamāruhya hayaṃ tatra samāgataḥ .. 54 ..
3.3.d:
इत्युक्ते वचने देव्या इन्दुलो वासवाज्ञया ॥
द्वादशाब्दसमं रूपं धृत्वा विद्याविशारदः ॥
वडवामृतमारुह्य हयं तत्र समागतः ॥ 54 ॥
3.3.m: When these words were spoken by the goddess, Indula, by command of Indra, / taking the form of a twelve-year-old, skilled in knowledge, / arrived there, mounted upon the horse Vaḍavāmṛta.

3.3.s:
tadaṅgāduddhṛtā vāhā meghā iva samantataḥ ..
pāvakaṃ śamayāmāsustrayaste devatopamāḥ .. 55 ..
3.3.d:
तदङ्गादुद्धृता वाहा मेघा इव समन्ततः ॥
पावकं शमयामासुस्त्रयस्ते देवतोपमाः ॥ 55 ॥
3.3.m: Horses brought forth from his body, like clouds on every side, / extinguished the fire, as did those three who were like gods.

3.3.s:
śamībhūte tadā vahnau svamukhātsahayo mudā ..
lālāmudvāhayāmāsa tayā te jīvitāstataḥ .. 56 ..
3.3.d:
शमीभूते तदा वह्नौ स्वमुखात्सहयो मुदा ॥
लालामुद्वाहयामास तया ते जीवितास्ततः ॥ 56 ॥
3.3.m: When the fire had subsided, the horse gladly discharged saliva / from its mouth; through that they were brought to life.

3.3.s:
jīvite saptalakṣe tu śamībhūte hi pāvake ..
gajasenaḥ sutābhyāṃ ca prayātaḥ sarvatodiśam .. 57 ..
3.3.d:
जीविते सप्तलक्षे तु शमीभूते हि पावके ॥
गजसेनः सुताभ्यां च प्रयातः सर्वतोदिशम् ॥ 57 ॥
3.3.m: When the seven hundred thousand were revived and the fire was extinguished, / Gajasena along with his two sons fled in all directions.

3.3.s:
lakṣaṃ sainyaṃ tu ye śiṣṭāste sarve'pi bhayāturāḥ ..
dudruvurbhārgavaśreṣṭha divyarūpatvadhāriṇaḥ .. 58 ..
3.3.d:
लक्षं सैन्यं तु ये शिष्टास्ते सर्वेऽपि भयातुराः ॥
दुद्रुवुर्भार्गवश्रेष्ठ दिव्यरूपत्वधारिणः ॥ 58 ॥
3.3.m: The hundred thousand soldiers who were left, all tormented by fear, / ran away, O best of Bhārgavas, taking divine forms.

3.3.s:
kecitsaṃnyāsino bhūtvā kecidvai brahmacāriṇaḥ ..
jīvatvaṃ prāptavantaste tathānye saṃkṣayaṃ gatāḥ .. 59 ..
3.3.d:
केचित्संन्यासिनो भूत्वा केचिद्वै ब्रह्मचारिणः ॥
जीवत्वं प्राप्तवन्तस्ते तथान्ये संक्षयं गताः ॥ 59 ॥
3.3.m: Some becoming ascetics, and some indeed brahmacārins, / they attained life, while others went to destruction.

3.3.s:
baddhvā tāngajasenādīṃstrīñchūrānsa ca tālanaḥ ..
kṛṣṇāṃśena samāyukta iṃdradurgaṃ samāyayau .. 3.3.16.60 ..
3.3.d:
बद्ध्वा तान्गजसेनादींस्त्रीञ्छूरान्स च तालनः ॥
कृष्णांशेन समायुक्त इंद्रदुर्गं समाययौ ॥ 3.3.16.60 ॥
3.3.m: Tālana, having bound those three heroes, Gajasena and the others, / accompanied by Kṛṣṇāṃśa, arrived at Indradurga.

3.3.s:
balakhāniṃ ca niṣkāsya tālanastadanaṃtaram ..
pṛṣṭavān kāraṇaṃ sarvaṃ śrutvā tanmukhato vacaḥ ..
tānvīrāṃstāḍayāmāsa vetasaiḥ staṃbhabaṃdhanaiḥ .. 61 ..
3.3.d:
बलखानिं च निष्कास्य तालनस्तदनंतरम् ॥
पृष्टवान् कारणं सर्वं श्रुत्वा तन्मुखतो वचः ॥
तान्वीरांस्ताडयामास वेतसैः स्तंभबंधनैः ॥ 61 ॥
3.3.m: And having brought out Balakhāni, Tālana thereupon / asked about the entire matter; hearing the words from his mouth, / he beat those heroes with cane reeds while tied to posts.

3.3.s:
gajamuktājñayā vipra senāpatarirudāradhīḥ ..
tālanastānsamutsṛjya vivāhārthaṃ samāyayau ..
balakhānirhayārūḍho gajamuktā ca maṃḍape .. 62 ..
3.3.d:
गजमुक्ताज्ञया विप्र सेनापतरिरुदारधीः ॥
तालनस्तान्समुत्सृज्य विवाहार्थं समाययौ ॥
बलखानिर्हयारूढो गजमुक्ता च मंडपे ॥ 62 ॥
3.3.m: At the command of Gajamuktā, O brāhmaṇa, the noble-minded general / Tālana released them and arrived for the wedding; / Balakhāni was mounted on a horse, and Gajamuktā was in the pavilion.

3.3.s:
gajasenastadā divyairbhojanaistānabhojayat ..
nivāsya lohadurge tānkapāṭaḥ sudṛḍhīkṛtaḥ ..
lakṣaśūrānsa saṃsthāpya svayaṃ rudrapuraṃ yayau ..63..
3.3.d:
गजसेनस्तदा दिव्यैर्भोजनैस्तानभोजयत् ॥
निवास्य लोहदुर्गे तान्कपाटः सुदृढीकृतः ॥
लक्षशूरान्स संस्थाप्य स्वयं रुद्रपुरं ययौ ॥63॥
3.3.m: Then Gajasena fed them with divine feasts; / having housed them in the iron fortress, the gate was made very secure; / stationing a hundred thousand heroes, he himself went to Rudrapura.

3.3.s:
te rātrau lohadurgeṣu hyuṣitvā yatnato balāt ..
prabhāte ca kapāṭe na dvāraṃ dṛṣṭvā tadābravīt ..
dvāramudghāṭayāśu tvaṃ no cetprāṇāṃstyajiṣyasi .. 64 ..
3.3.d:
ते रात्रौ लोहदुर्गेषु ह्युषित्वा यत्नतो बलात् ॥
प्रभाते च कपाटे न द्वारं दृष्ट्वा तदाब्रवीत् ॥
द्वारमुद्घाटयाशु त्वं नो चेत्प्राणांस्त्यजिष्यसि ॥ 64 ॥
3.3.m: Having stayed the night in the iron fortress with effort and force, / seeing at dawn no doorway in the gate, [one of them] then said: / 'Open the door quickly, or else you will lose your lives!'

3.3.s:
iti senāpatiḥ śrutvā lakṣaśūrānsamādiśat ..
nānāyatnaiśca haṃtavyāḥ śatravo bhayakāriṇaḥ .. 65 ..
3.3.d:
इति सेनापतिः श्रुत्वा लक्षशूरान्समादिशत् ॥
नानायत्नैश्च हंतव्याः शत्रवो भयकारिणः ॥ 65 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing this, the general commanded the hundred thousand heroes: / 'These terrifying enemies must be slain by various efforts.'

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā tu te śūrāḥ śataghnyastaiḥ suropitāḥ ..
ekaikaṃ kramaśo jaghnurvṛṃdaṃ te vairatatparāḥ .. 66 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा तु ते शूराः शतघ्न्यस्तैः सुरोपिताः ॥
एकैकं क्रमशो जघ्नुर्वृंदं ते वैरतत्पराः ॥ 66 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing this, those heroes, having set up cannons, / intent on hostility, gradually slew troop after troop, one by one.

3.3.s:
hate daśasahasre tu kṛṣṇāṃśo biṃdulaṃ hayam ..
samāruhya jaghānāśu svakhaḍgena mahadbalam .. 67 ..
3.3.d:
हते दशसहस्रे तु कृष्णांशो बिंदुलं हयम् ॥
समारुह्य जघानाशु स्वखड्गेन महद्बलम् ॥ 67 ॥
3.3.m: When ten thousand were slain, Kṛṣṇāṃśa, having mounted / the horse Bindula, quickly slew the great army with his sword.

3.3.s:
hataśeṣā bhayārtāśca sahayāśītisammitāḥ ..
iṃdradurgaṃ prati prāhuryathā jāto balakṣayaḥ .. 68 ..
3.3.d:
हतशेषा भयार्ताश्च सहयाशीतिसम्मिताः ॥
इंद्रदुर्गं प्रति प्राहुर्यथा जातो बलक्षयः ॥ 68 ॥
3.3.m: The survivors, afflicted with fear, numbering about eighty on horses, / told [the king] toward Indradurga how the destruction of the army had happened.

3.3.s:
śrutvā bhayāturo rājā svasutābhyāṃ samanvitaḥ ..
gajamuktāṃ puraskṛtya vahudravyasamanvitām ..
svapāpaṃ kṣālayāmāsa dattvā kanyāṃ vidhānataḥ .. 69 ..
3.3.d:
श्रुत्वा भयातुरो राजा स्वसुताभ्यां समन्वितः ॥
गजमुक्तां पुरस्कृत्य वहुद्रव्यसमन्विताम् ॥
स्वपापं क्षालयामास दत्त्वा कन्यां विधानतः ॥ 69 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing [this], the king, seized with fear, accompanied by his two sons, / placing Gajamuktā at the head, accompanied by much wealth, / washed away his sin by giving his daughter according to rule.

3.3.s:
ṣoḍaśoṣṭrāṇi svarṇāni gṛhītvāhlāda eva saḥ ..
