yayau svagehaṃ sahitaḥ putrabhrātṛsamanvitaḥ .. 3.3.16.70 ..
3.3.d:
षोडशोष्ट्राणि स्वर्णानि गृहीत्वाह्लाद एव सः ॥
ययौ स्वगेहं सहितः पुत्रभ्रातृसमन्वितः ॥ 3.3.16.70 ॥
3.3.m: Having taken sixteen camels [laden with] gold, Āhlāda indeed / went to his home, accompanied by his son and brother.

3.3.s:
saṃprāpte gehamāhlāde devī svarṇavatī svayam ..
indulaṃ svāṃkamāropya lalāpa karuṇaṃ bahu .. 71 ..
3.3.d:
संप्राप्ते गेहमाह्लादे देवी स्वर्णवती स्वयम् ॥
इन्दुलं स्वांकमारोप्य ललाप करुणं बहु ॥ 71 ॥
3.3.m: When Āhlāda reached home, Queen Svarṇavatī herself, / placing Indula on her lap, wept very piteously:

3.3.s:
mṛtāhaṃ ca tvayā putra punarujjīvitā khalu ..
dhanyāhaṃ kṛtakṛtyāsmi jayanta tava darśanāt ..72..
3.3.d:
मृताहं च त्वया पुत्र पुनरुज्जीविता खलु ॥
धन्याहं कृतकृत्यास्मि जयन्त तव दर्शनात् ॥72॥
3.3.m: ‘Dead as I was, I have indeed been brought back to life by you, my son! / Blessed am I, my purpose accomplished, O Jayanta, by the sight of you!’

3.3.s:
iti śrutvendulo vīro natvāha jananīṃ mudā..
anṛṇaṃ nādhigacchāmi tvatto mātaḥ kadācana..73..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वेन्दुलो वीरो नत्वाह जननीं मुदा॥
अनृणं नाधिगच्छामि त्वत्तो मातः कदाचन॥73॥
3.3.m: Hearing this, the heroic Indula, bowing, gladly said to his mother: / ‘I can never be free from debt to you, mother!’

3.3.s:
saṃprāpte gehamāhlāde rājā parimalaḥ sudhīḥ ..
vādyāni vādayāmāsa viprebhyaśca dadau dhanam.. 74..
3.3.d:
संप्राप्ते गेहमाह्लादे राजा परिमलः सुधीः ॥
वाद्यानि वादयामास विप्रेभ्यश्च ददौ धनम्॥ 74॥
3.3.m: When Āhlāda reached home, the wise King Parimala / caused musical instruments to be played and gave wealth to the brāhmaṇas.

3.3.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
kṛṣṇāṃśe'ṣṭādaśābde tu yathājātaṃ tathā śṛṇu ..
mṛte kṛṣṇakumāre tu bhūpatau ratnabhānunā .. 1 ..
3.3.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
कृष्णांशेऽष्टादशाब्दे तु यथाजातं तथा शृणु ॥
मृते कृष्णकुमारे तु भूपतौ रत्नभानुना ॥ 1 ॥
3.3.m: Sūta said: / Hear what happened in the eighteenth year of Kṛṣṇāṃśa: / when King Kṛṣṇakumāra had died by Ratnabhānu,

3.3.s:
mahīrājaḥ suduḥkhārto lakṣacaṃḍīmakārayat ..
homānte tu tadā devī vāguvāca nṛpaṃ prati .. 2 ..
3.3.d:
महीराजः सुदुःखार्तो लक्षचंडीमकारयत् ॥
होमान्ते तु तदा देवी वागुवाच नृपं प्रति ॥ 2 ॥
3.3.m: Mahīrāja, overwhelmed with sorrow, had the Lakṣacaṇḍī performed; / and at the end of the oblation, a divine voice spoke to the king:

3.3.s:
varṣevarṣe tu te sapta bhaviṣyaṃtyaṃgasambhavāḥ ..
kumārāḥ kauravāṃśāśca draupadyaṃśā sutā nṛpa .. 3 ..
3.3.d:
वर्षेवर्षे तु ते सप्त भविष्यंत्यंगसम्भवाः ॥
कुमाराः कौरवांशाश्च द्रौपद्यंशा सुता नृप ॥ 3 ॥
3.3.m: ‘Year after year, seven sons born from your body / shall be [born as] portions of the Kauravas, and a daughter as a portion of Draupadī, O king.’

3.3.s:
ityukte vacane tasminrājñī garbhamatho dadhau ..
karṇāṃśaśca suto jātastārako balavattaraḥ .. 4 ..
3.3.d:
इत्युक्ते वचने तस्मिन्राज्ञी गर्भमथो दधौ ॥
कर्णांशश्च सुतो जातस्तारको बलवत्तरः ॥ 4 ॥
3.3.m: When these words were spoken, the queen then conceived; / and a son was born, a portion of Karṇa, named Tāraka, who was exceedingly strong.

3.3.s:
dvitīyābde tathā jāte duśśāsanaśubhāṃśataḥ ..
nṛhaririti vikhyātastṛtīyābde tu cābhavat .. 5 ..
3.3.d:
द्वितीयाब्दे तथा जाते दुश्शासनशुभांशतः ॥
नृहरिरिति विख्यातस्तृतीयाब्दे तु चाभवत् ॥ 5 ॥
3.3.m: Likewise, in the second year, from the auspicious portion of Duḥśāsana, / he was born who was renowned as Nṛhari; and in the third year there was [another son]:

3.3.s:
uddharṣāṃśaḥ saradano durmukhāṃśastu mardanaḥ ..
vikarṇāṃśaḥ sūryyakarmā bhīmaścāṃśo viviṃśateḥ .. 6 ..
3.3.d:
उद्धर्षांशः सरदनो दुर्मुखांशस्तु मर्दनः ॥
विकर्णांशः सूर्य्यकर्मा भीमश्चांशो विविंशतेः ॥ 6 ॥
3.3.m: Saradana, a portion of Uddharṣa; Mardana, a portion of Durmukha; / Sūryakarmā, a portion of Vikarṇa; Bhīma, a portion of Viviṃśati;

3.3.s:
varddhanaścitrabāṇāṃśo velā tadanu cābhavat ..
yathā kṛṣṇā tathā saiva rūpaceṣṭāguṇairmune .. 7 ..
3.3.d:
वर्द्धनश्चित्रबाणांशो वेला तदनु चाभवत् ॥
यथा कृष्णा तथा सैव रूपचेष्टागुणैर्मुने ॥ 7 ॥
3.3.m: Vardhana, a portion of Citrabāṇa; and after that was born Velā. / Just as Draupadī was, so was she, in beauty, deeds, and virtues, O sage.

3.3.s:
bhuvi tasyāṃ ca jātāyāṃ bhūkampo dāruṇo'bhavat ..
aṭṭāṭṭahāsamaśivaṃ cāmuṃḍā khe cakāra ha ..
raktavṛṣṭiḥ pure cāsīdasthiśarkarayā yutā .. 8 ..
3.3.d:
भुवि तस्यां च जातायां भूकम्पो दारुणोऽभवत् ॥
अट्टाट्टहासमशिवं चामुंडा खे चकार ह ॥
रक्तवृष्टिः पुरे चासीदस्थिशर्करया युता ॥ 8 ॥
3.3.m: And when she was born on earth, a terrible earthquake occurred; / Cāmuṇḍā uttered an inauspicious loud burst of laughter in the sky, / and a rain of blood accompanied by bone fragments fell upon the city.

3.3.s:
brāhmaṇāśca samāgatya jātakarmādikāṃ kriyām ..
kṛtvā nāma tathā cakre śṛṇu bhūmipa sākṣaram .. 9 ..9..
3.3.d:
ब्राह्मणाश्च समागत्य जातकर्मादिकां क्रियाम् ॥
कृत्वा नाम तथा चक्रे शृणु भूमिप साक्षरम् ॥ 9 ॥9॥
3.3.m: And the brahmins arrived, performed the natal rites and others, / and gave her a name; listen to the syllables, O king:

3.3.s:
ilā ca śaśino mātā vikalpenā'bhavadbhuvi ..
tasmādveleti vikhyātā kanyeyaṃ rūpaśālinī .. 3.3.17.10 ..
3.3.d:
इला च शशिनो माता विकल्पेनाऽभवद्भुवि ॥
तस्माद्वेलेति विख्याता कन्येयं रूपशालिनी ॥ 3.3.17.10 ॥
3.3.m: “Ilā, the mother of the Moon, was [born] on earth by alternative course (vikalpena); / therefore this daughter, possessed of beauty, is renowned as Velā.”

3.3.s:
jātāyāṃ ca sutāyāṃ sa pitā viprebhya uttamam ..
dadau dānaṃ mudā yukto vāsāṃsi vividhāni ca .. 11 ..
3.3.d:
जातायां च सुतायां स पिता विप्रेभ्य उत्तमम् ॥
ददौ दानं मुदा युक्तो वासांसि विविधानि च ॥ 11 ॥
3.3.m: And when that daughter was born, her father, filled with joy, / gave excellent gifts and various garments to the brahmins.

3.3.s:
dvādaśābdavayaḥ prāpte sā sutā varavarṇinī ..
uvāca pitaraṃ namrā śṛṇu tvaṃ pṛthivīpate .. 12 ..
3.3.d:
द्वादशाब्दवयः प्राप्ते सा सुता वरवर्णिनी ॥
उवाच पितरं नम्रा शृणु त्वं पृथिवीपते ॥ 12 ॥
3.3.m: When she reached twelve years of age, that daughter of excellent complexion, / humble, spoke to her father: “Listen, O ruler of the earth!

3.3.s:
maṃḍape raktadhārābhiryo māṃ saṃsnāpayiṣyati ..
draupadyā bhūṣaṇaṃ dātā sa me bhartā bhaviṣyati ..13..
3.3.d:
मंडपे रक्तधाराभिर्यो मां संस्नापयिष्यति ॥
द्रौपद्या भूषणं दाता स मे भर्ता भविष्यति ॥13॥
3.3.m: He who will bathe me in the pavilion with streams of blood / and who will give me the ornament of Draupadī shall be my husband.”

3.3.s:
svarṇapatre tadā rājā padyaṃ velāmukhodbhavam ..
likhitvā tārakaṃ prāha tvamanveṣaya tatpatim .. 14 ..
3.3.d:
स्वर्णपत्रे तदा राजा पद्यं वेलामुखोद्भवम् ॥
लिखित्वा तारकं प्राह त्वमन्वेषय तत्पतिम् ॥ 14 ॥
3.3.m: Then the king inscribed on a golden leaf the verse uttered from the mouth of Velā / and said to Tāraka: “Search for her husband.”

3.3.s:
sārddhaṃ lakṣatrayaṃ dravyaṃ gṛhītvā lakṣasainyakaḥ ..
nṛpāntaraṃ yayau śīghraṃ tārakaḥ piturājñayā .. 15..
3.3.d:
सार्द्धं लक्षत्रयं द्रव्यं गृहीत्वा लक्षसैन्यकः ॥
नृपान्तरं ययौ शीघ्रं तारकः पितुराज्ञया ॥ 15॥
3.3.m: Taking three and a half lakhs of wealth, accompanied by an army of one lakh, / Tāraka swiftly went to other kings at his father's command.

3.3.s:
siṃdhusthāne cāryadeśe bhūpaṃ bhūpaṃ yayau balī ..
na gṛhītaṃ nṛpaiḥ keścittadvākyaṃ ghoramulbaṇam ..
mahīpatiṃ sa saṃprāpya mātulaṃ tadvaco'bravīt .. 16 ..
3.3.d:
सिंधुस्थाने चार्यदेशे भूपं भूपं ययौ बली ॥
न गृहीतं नृपैः केश्चित्तद्वाक्यं घोरमुल्बणम् ॥
महीपतिं स संप्राप्य मातुलं तद्वचोऽब्रवीत् ॥ 16 ॥
3.3.m: The mighty one went from king to king in Sindh and in the Āryan lands; / but none of the kings accepted that terrible and fierce decree. / Reaching the monarch, his maternal uncle, he spoke those words.

3.3.s:
śrutvā sa āha bho vīra brahmānando mahābalaḥ ..
sa ca vākyaṃ pragṛhṇīyādāhlādādyaiḥ surakṣitaḥ .. 17 ..
3.3.d:
श्रुत्वा स आह भो वीर ब्रह्मानन्दो महाबलः ॥
स च वाक्यं प्रगृह्णीयादाह्लादाद्यैः सुरक्षितः ॥ 17 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing this, he said: “O hero, the mighty Brahmānanda, / well-guarded by Āhlāda and others, may accept this decree.

3.3.s:
kiṃ tvayā viditaṃ naiva caritaṃ tasya viśrutam ..
bhavānṣaḍbaṃdhusahitaḥ kṛṣṇāṃśādyairvivāhitaḥ .. 18 ..
3.3.d:
किं त्वया विदितं नैव चरितं तस्य विश्रुतम् ॥
भवान्षड्बंधुसहितः कृष्णांशाद्यैर्विवाहितः ॥ 18 ॥
3.3.m: Is his renowned deed not known to you? / He, along with his six brothers, was given in marriage by Kṛṣṇāṃśa and the rest.

3.3.s:
te sarve vaśagāstasya brahmānaṃdasya dhīmataḥ ..
nāsti bhūmaṃḍale kaścittadbalena samo nṛpaḥ .. 19 ..
3.3.d:
ते सर्वे वशगास्तस्य ब्रह्मानंदस्य धीमतः ॥
नास्ति भूमंडले कश्चित्तद्बलेन समो नृपः ॥ 19 ॥
3.3.m: They are all subject to that wise Brahmānanda; / there is no king on the circle of the earth equal to his power.”

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā yayau tūrṇaṃ tārakaḥ svabalaiḥ saha ..
tatpadyaṃ kathayitvāgre hastabaddhastadābhavat .. 3.3.17.20 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा ययौ तूर्णं तारकः स्वबलैः सह ॥
तत्पद्यं कथयित्वाग्रे हस्तबद्धस्तदाभवत् ॥ 3.3.17.20 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing this, Tāraka quickly went with his own troops; / reciting that verse before him, he then stood with joined hands.

3.3.s:
kṛṣṇāṃśastu gṛhītvāśu padyaṃ vākyamuvāca ha ..
ahaṃ vivāhayiṣyāmi brahmānaṃdaṃ nṛpottamam .. 21 ..
3.3.d:
कृष्णांशस्तु गृहीत्वाशु पद्यं वाक्यमुवाच ह ॥
अहं विवाहयिष्यामि ब्रह्मानंदं नृपोत्तमम् ॥ 21 ॥
3.3.m: Kṛṣṇāṃśa, swiftly taking the verse, said these words: / “I shall wed the best of kings, Brahmānanda [to her].”

3.3.s:
tūṣṇīṃ bhūtāstadā sarve tārakaḥ sa dvijaiḥ saha ..
abhiṣekaṃ tadā kṛtvā svagehaṃ punarāyayau .. 22 ..
3.3.d:
तूष्णीं भूतास्तदा सर्वे तारकः स द्विजैः सह ॥
अभिषेकं तदा कृत्वा स्वगेहं पुनराययौ ॥ 22 ॥
3.3.m: Then, all falling silent, Tāraka along with the twice-born / performed the consecration and returned to his home.

3.3.s:
māghamāse site pakṣe trayodaśyāṃ suvāsare ..
vivāhalagnaṃ śubhadaṃ varakanyārthayostadā .. 23 ..
3.3.d:
माघमासे सिते पक्षे त्रयोदश्यां सुवासरे ॥
विवाहलग्नं शुभदं वरकन्यार्थयोस्तदा ॥ 23 ॥
3.3.m: In the month of Māgha, during the bright fortnight, on an auspicious thirteenth lunar day, / the auspicious time for marriage was set for the groom and the bride.

3.3.s:
saptalakṣabalaiḥ sārddhaṃ lakṣaṇaśca satālanaḥ ..
mahāvatīṃ purīṃ prāpto balī parimalādibhiḥ .. 24 ..
3.3.d:
सप्तलक्षबलैः सार्द्धं लक्षणश्च सतालनः ॥
महावतीं पुरीं प्राप्तो बली परिमलादिभिः ॥ 24 ॥
3.3.m: Accompanied by an army of seven lakhs, Lakṣaṇa along with Tālana, / mighty with Parimala and the others, reached the city of Mahāvatī.

3.3.s:
āhlādo lakṣasainyāḍhyaḥ kṛṣṇāṃśena samanvitaḥ ..
balakhānirlakṣasainyaḥ saṃyutaḥ sukhakhāninā .. 25 ..
3.3.d:
आह्लादो लक्षसैन्याढ्यः कृष्णांशेन समन्वितः ॥
बलखानिर्लक्षसैन्यः संयुतः सुखखानिना ॥ 25 ॥
3.3.m: Āhlāda was equipped with an army of a lakh, accompanied by Kṛṣṇāṃśa; / Balakhāni had an army of a lakh, joined with Sukhakhāni;

3.3.s:
netrasiṃho lakṣasainyo yogabhogasamanvitaḥ ..
raṇajicca balī bālo dvilakṣabalasaṃyutaḥ .. 26 ..
3.3.d:
नेत्रसिंहो लक्षसैन्यो योगभोगसमन्वितः ॥
रणजिच्च बली बालो द्विलक्षबलसंयुतः ॥ 26 ॥
3.3.m: Netrasiṃha had an army of a lakh, accompanied by Yoga and Bhoga; / and the mighty youth Raṇajit was accompanied by a force of two lakhs.

3.3.s:
evaṃ dvādaśalakṣāṇāṃ sainyānāmadhipo balī ..
tālanaḥ siṃhinīsaṃstho vaḍavāṃ prayayau saha .. 27 ..
3.3.d:
एवं द्वादशलक्षाणां सैन्यानामधिपो बली ॥
तालनः सिंहिनीसंस्थो वडवां प्रययौ सह ॥ 27 ॥
3.3.m: Thus the mighty Tālana, commander of twelve lakhs of troops, / mounted upon a lioness, proceeded together towards Vaḍavā.

3.3.s:
sainyairdvādaśalakṣaiśca sahitastālano balī ..
āyayau dehalīgrāme mahīrājānupālite .. 28 ..
3.3.d:
सैन्यैर्द्वादशलक्षैश्च सहितस्तालनो बली ॥
आययौ देहलीग्रामे महीराजानुपालिते ॥ 28 ॥
3.3.m: Accompanied by the twelve lakhs of troops, the mighty Tālana / arrived at the village of Dehalī, protected by King Mahīrāja.

3.3.s:
devo manorathārūḍho viṃdulasthaḥ sa kṛṣṇakaḥ ..
vaḍavāmṛtamāsādya svarṇavatyāḥ suto gataḥ .. .. 29 ..
3.3.d:
देवो मनोरथारूढो विंदुलस्थः स कृष्णकः ॥
वडवामृतमासाद्य स्वर्णवत्याः सुतो गतः ॥ ॥ 29 ॥
3.3.m: Deva, mounted upon Manoratha, and Kṛṣṇaka, mounted upon Vindula, / having obtained nectar at Vaḍavā, went as the son of Svarṇavatī.

3.3.s:
rūpaṇaśca karālastha āhlādaśca papīhake ..
balakhāniḥ kapotastho hariṇastho'nujastataḥ .. 3.3.17.30 ..
3.3.d:
रूपणश्च करालस्थ आह्लादश्च पपीहके ॥
बलखानिः कपोतस्थो हरिणस्थोऽनुजस्ततः ॥ 3.3.17.30 ॥
3.3.m: Rūpaṇa was mounted on Karāla, Āhlāda on Papīhaka, / Balakhāni on Kapota, and next his younger brother mounted on a deer;

3.3.s:
raṇajinmalanāputraḥ saṃsthito harināgare ..
pañcaśabdagajārūḍho mahāvatyadhipo gataḥ .. 31 ..
3.3.d:
रणजिन्मलनापुत्रः संस्थितो हरिनागरे ॥
पञ्चशब्दगजारूढो महावत्यधिपो गतः ॥ 31 ॥
3.3.m: Raṇajit, the son of Malanā, was mounted on Harināgara; / and the lord of Mahāvatī, mounted upon an elephant of five sounds, proceeded.

3.3.s:
vimānavaramāruhya dhīvaraiḥ śatavāhikaiḥ ..
maṇimuktāsvarṇamayaṃ sahasrairvādyakairyutam .. 32 ..
3.3.d:
विमानवरमारुह्य धीवरैः शतवाहिकैः ॥
मणिमुक्तास्वर्णमयं सहस्रैर्वाद्यकैर्युतम् ॥ 32 ॥
3.3.m: Mounting an excellent celestial chariot borne by a hundred fishermen, / fashioned of gems, pearls, and gold, accompanied by thousands of musical instruments,

3.3.s:
ayutaiśca patākaiśca vetrapāṇisahakrakaiḥ ..
sahasraiḥ śibikābhiśca pañcasāhasrakai rathaiḥ .. 33 ..
3.3.d:
अयुतैश्च पताकैश्च वेत्रपाणिसहक्रकैः ॥
सहस्रैः शिबिकाभिश्च पञ्चसाहस्रकै रथैः ॥ 33 ॥
3.3.m: with tens of thousands of banners and thousands of cane-bearing guards, / with thousands of palanquins and five thousand chariots,

3.3.s:
śakaṭairmahiṣoḍhaistu tathā pañcasahasrakaiḥ ..
sarvatopaskṛtaṃ ramyaṃ brahmānaṃdaṃ samāgataḥ .. 34 ..
3.3.d:
शकटैर्महिषोढैस्तु तथा पञ्चसहस्रकैः ॥
सर्वतोपस्कृतं रम्यं ब्रह्मानंदं समागतः ॥ 34 ॥
3.3.m: and likewise with five thousand carts drawn by buffaloes, / fully adorned on all sides, the delightful Brahmānanda arrived.

3.3.s:
śrutvā kolāhalaṃ teṣāṃ mahīrājo nṛpottamaḥ ..
vismitaḥ sa babhūvātra śibirāṇi mudā dadau .. 35 ..
3.3.d:
श्रुत्वा कोलाहलं तेषां महीराजो नृपोत्तमः ॥
विस्मितः स बभूवात्र शिबिराणि मुदा ददौ ॥ 35 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing their tumult, Mahīrāja, the best of kings, / was filled with wonder and joyfully assigned camps there.

3.3.s:
durgadvāri kriyāṃ ramyāṃ kṛtvā vidhividhānataḥ ..
draupadyā bhūṣaṇaṃ dehi velāyai sa tamabravīt .. 36 ..
3.3.d:
दुर्गद्वारि क्रियां रम्यां कृत्वा विधिविधानतः ॥
द्रौपद्या भूषणं देहि वेलायै स तमब्रवीत् ॥ 36 ॥
3.3.m: Having performed the charming rites at the fort gate in accordance with the rules, / he said to him: “Give the ornament of Draupadī to Velā.”

3.3.s:
indulastu yayau svargaṃ vāsavaṃ prati cābravīt ..
draupadyā bhūṣaṇaṃ sarvaṃ dehi mahyaṃ surottama .. 37 ..
3.3.d:
इन्दुलस्तु ययौ स्वर्गं वासवं प्रति चाब्रवीत् ॥
द्रौपद्या भूषणं सर्वं देहि मह्यं सुरोत्तम ॥ 37 ॥
3.3.m: Indula went to heaven and said to Indra: / “Give all the ornaments of Draupadī to me, O best of gods.”

3.3.s:
kuberātsa samānīya divyamābhūṣaṇaṃ dadau ..
indulaḥ praharānte ca prāptaḥ pitre nyavedayat .. 38 ..
3.3.d:
कुबेरात्स समानीय दिव्यमाभूषणं ददौ ॥
इन्दुलः प्रहरान्ते च प्राप्तः पित्रे न्यवेदयत् ॥ 38 ॥
3.3.m: Bringing them from Kubera, he gave the divine ornaments; / and Indula, having returned at the end of a watch, offered them to his father.

3.3.s:
āhlādastu svayaṃ gatvā velāye bhūṣaṇaṃ dadau ..
prāpte brāhme muhūrte tu vivāhastatra cābhavat .. 39 ..
3.3.d:
आह्लादस्तु स्वयं गत्वा वेलाये भूषणं ददौ ॥
प्राप्ते ब्राह्मे मुहूर्ते तु विवाहस्तत्र चाभवत् ॥ 39 ॥
3.3.m: Āhlāda himself went and gave the ornament to Velā; / and when the auspicious hour of Brahmā arrived, the wedding took place there.

3.3.s:
saṃprāpte prathamāvarte tārakaḥ khaḍgamādadau ..
āhlādastaṃ samāsādya yuyudhe bahulīlayā .. 3.3.17.40 ..
3.3.d:
संप्राप्ते प्रथमावर्ते तारकः खड्गमाददौ ॥
आह्लादस्तं समासाद्य युयुधे बहुलीलया ॥ 3.3.17.40 ॥
3.3.m: When the first circumambulation arrived, Tāraka took up his sword; / Āhlāda, confronting him, fought with abundant skill.

3.3.s:
nṛharistu dvitīye ca kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ prati cārudhat ..
tathā saradanaṃ vīraṃ balakhānirupāyayau .. 41 ..
3.3.d:
नृहरिस्तु द्वितीये च कृष्णांशं प्रति चारुधत् ॥
तथा सरदनं वीरं बलखानिरुपाययौ ॥ 41 ॥
3.3.m: At the second, Nṛhari blocked Kṛṣṇāṃśa; / likewise Balakhāni approached the heroic Saradana.

3.3.s:
mardanaṃ sukhakhānistu caturthāvartake'rudhat ..
raṇajitsūryavarmāṇaṃ sa bhīmaṃ rūpaṇo balī ..
devastu vardhanaṃ vīraṃ saptāvarte kramādyayau .. 42 ..
3.3.d:
मर्दनं सुखखानिस्तु चतुर्थावर्तकेऽरुधत् ॥
रणजित्सूर्यवर्माणं स भीमं रूपणो बली ॥
देवस्तु वर्धनं वीरं सप्तावर्ते क्रमाद्ययौ ॥ 42 ॥
3.3.m: At the fourth circumambulation, Sukhakhāni checked Mardana; / Raṇajit [confronted] Sūryavarmā, the mighty Rūpaṇa [checked] Bhīma, / and Deva successively went against the heroic Vardhana at the seventh circumambulation.

3.3.s:
śatabhūpānkhaḍgadharāngajasenādikāṃstadā ..
lakṣaṇādyāḥ samājagmurmaṃḍape bahuvistate .. 43 ..
3.3.d:
शतभूपान्खड्गधरान्गजसेनादिकांस्तदा ॥
लक्षणाद्याः समाजग्मुर्मंडपे बहुविस्तते ॥ 43 ॥
3.3.m: Then Lakṣaṇa and the others came upon a hundred sword-bearing kings, / elephant forces, and the rest in the wide pavilion.

3.3.s:
bhagnabhūtaṃ nṛpabalaṃ dṛṣṭvā rājā ruṣānvitaḥ ..
mahīrājo yayau rūḍho gajaṃ cāribhayaṃkaram .. 44 ..
3.3.d:
भग्नभूतं नृपबलं दृष्ट्वा राजा रुषान्वितः ॥
महीराजो ययौ रूढो गजं चारिभयंकरम् ॥ 44 ॥
3.3.m: Seeing his royal army broken, the king, overcome with fury— / Mahīrāja, mounted upon an elephant that terrified enemies—proceeded.

3.3.s:
jitvā tānnetrasiṃhādīñchabdavedhī nṛpottamaḥ ..
lakṣaṇaṃ prayayau śīghraṃ bauddhinīṃ hastinīṃ sthitam .. 45 ..
3.3.d:
जित्वा तान्नेत्रसिंहादीञ्छब्दवेधी नृपोत्तमः ॥
लक्षणं प्रययौ शीघ्रं बौद्धिनीं हस्तिनीं स्थितम् ॥ 45 ॥
3.3.m: Having defeated Netrasiṃha and the others, that best of kings, who shot by sound, / swiftly went towards Lakṣaṇa, who was mounted upon the elephant Bauddhinī.

3.3.s:
śivaṃ manasi saṃsthāpya jitvā baddhvā ruṣānvitaḥ ..
agamattamupagṛhya darśayāmāsa taṃ nṛpam .. 46 ..
3.3.d:
शिवं मनसि संस्थाप्य जित्वा बद्ध्वा रुषान्वितः ॥
अगमत्तमुपगृह्य दर्शयामास तं नृपम् ॥ 46 ॥
3.3.m: Fixing Śiva in his mind, having defeated and bound him in fury, / he seized him, took him away, and displayed that king.

3.3.s:
śrutvā parimalo rājā kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ bhīruko yayau ..
vṛttāntaṃ kathayāmāsa cāhrādādiparājayam.. 47 ..
3.3.d:
श्रुत्वा परिमलो राजा कृष्णांशं भीरुको ययौ ॥
वृत्तान्तं कथयामास चाह्रादादिपराजयम्॥ 47 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing of this, King Parimala, terrified, went to Kṛṣṇāṃśa / and narrated the account of the defeat of Āhlāda and the others.

3.3.s:
ajitaḥ sa ca kṛṣṇāṃśo nabhomārgeṇa maṃdiram ..
gatvā jagarja balavānyoginyānaṃdadāyakaḥ .. 48 ..
3.3.d:
अजितः स च कृष्णांशो नभोमार्गेण मंदिरम् ॥
गत्वा जगर्ज बलवान्योगिन्यानंददायकः ॥ 48 ॥
3.3.m: And that invincible Kṛṣṇāṃśa, powerful and giving joy to the yoginīs, / went through the sky to the palace and roared.

3.3.s:
tadā sa lakṣaṇo vīrastyaktvā baṃdhanamuttamam ..
viṣṇuṃ manasi saṃsthāpya mahīrājaṃ samāyayau .. 49 ..
3.3.d:
तदा स लक्षणो वीरस्त्यक्त्वा बंधनमुत्तमम् ॥
विष्णुं मनसि संस्थाप्य महीराजं समाययौ ॥ 49 ॥
3.3.m: Then that hero Lakṣaṇa, leaving aside that excellent binding / and placing Viṣṇu in his mind, came to King Mahī.

3.3.s: gṛhītvā cāgamāṃ dolāṃ svayaṃ śibiramāptavān .. 3.3.17.50 ..
3.3.d: गृहीत्वा चागमां दोलां स्वयं शिबिरमाप्तवान् ॥ 3.3.17.50 ॥
3.3.m: And taking the inaccessible litter, he himself reached the camp.

3.3.s:
etasminnaṃtare sarve tyaktvā mūrcchāṃ samaṃtataḥ ..
khaḍgayuddhena tāñjitvā baddhvā tānnigaḍairdṛḍhaiḥ .. 51 ..
3.3.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे सर्वे त्यक्त्वा मूर्च्छां समंततः ॥
खड्गयुद्धेन ताञ्जित्वा बद्ध्वा तान्निगडैर्दृढैः ॥ 51 ॥
3.3.m: In the meantime, they all completely cast off their swoon; / having conquered them in a duel with swords and bound them with strong iron chains,

3.3.s:
sānvayāñchatabhūpāṃśca hatvā tadrudhirāvahaiḥ ..
draupadīṃ snāpayāmāsurvelārūpāṃ kalottamām .. 52 ..
3.3.d:
सान्वयाञ्छतभूपांश्च हत्वा तद्रुधिरावहैः ॥
द्रौपदीं स्नापयामासुर्वेलारूपां कलोत्तमाम् ॥ 52 ॥
3.3.m: and having slain one hundred kings along with their lineages, with the streams of their blood / they bathed Draupadī, who was in the form of Velā, that supreme portion [of divinity].

3.3.s:
vivāhānte ca te sarve śibirāṇi samāyayuḥ ..
samutsṛjya sutānsapta subhojyaiste hyabhojayan .. 53 ..
3.3.d:
विवाहान्ते च ते सर्वे शिबिराणि समाययुः ॥
समुत्सृज्य सुतान्सप्त सुभोज्यैस्ते ह्यभोजयन् ॥ 53 ॥
3.3.m: And at the end of the wedding, they all returned to their camps; / releasing the seven sons, they fed them with sumptuous food.

3.3.s:
bhuktavatsu suvīreṣu sāhasrāstaiḥ sutaiḥ saha ..
rurudhuḥ sarvato jaghnurastraśastraiḥ samaṃtataḥ .. 54 ..
3.3.d:
भुक्तवत्सु सुवीरेषु साहस्रास्तैः सुतैः सह ॥
रुरुधुः सर्वतो जघ्नुरस्त्रशस्त्रैः समंततः ॥ 54 ॥
3.3.m: When those fine heroes had eaten, [the enemies] together with those sons in their thousands / besieged them on every side and struck all around with missile weapons and hand-weapons.

3.3.s:
sahasraśūrāṃstānhatvā punarbaddhvā mahābalān ..
śibirāṇi samājagmusteṣāṃ hāsyaviśāradāḥ .. 55 ..
3.3.d:
सहस्रशूरांस्तान्हत्वा पुनर्बद्ध्वा महाबलान् ॥
शिबिराणि समाजग्मुस्तेषां हास्यविशारदाः ॥ 55 ॥
3.3.m: Having slain those thousand warriors and bound those mighty ones once again, / skilled in mocking them, they returned to their camps.

3.3.s:
daśalakṣasuvarṇāni gṛhītvā nṛpatirbalī ..
velāṃ navoḍhāmādāya gatvā natvā tamabravīt .. 56 ..
3.3.d:
दशलक्षसुवर्णानि गृहीत्वा नृपतिर्बली ॥
वेलां नवोढामादाय गत्वा नत्वा तमब्रवीत् ॥ 56 ॥
3.3.m: Taking ten hundred thousand gold coins, the strong king, / taking the newlywed Velā, went, bowed, and said to him:

3.3.s:
pradyotasuta he rājam̐llakṣaṇo'sau mahābalaḥ ..
mama patnīṃ samādāya dāsīṃ kartuṃ samicchati .. 57 ..
3.3.d:
प्रद्योतसुत हे राजम्̐ल्लक्षणोऽसौ महाबलः ॥
मम पत्नीं समादाय दासीं कर्तुं समिच्छति ॥ 57 ॥
3.3.m: “O King, son of Pradyota! That mighty Lakṣaṇa, / taking my wife, wishes to make her a slave-girl.”

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā parimalaḥ sarva bhūpasamanvitaḥ ..
bahudhā bodhitaścaiva na bubodha tadā nṛpaḥ .. 58 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा परिमलः सर्व भूपसमन्वितः ॥
बहुधा बोधितश्चैव न बुबोध तदा नृपः ॥ 58 ॥
3.3.m: Having heard this, Parimala, accompanied by all the kings, / although instructed in many ways, did not listen then, O King.

3.3.s:
tadā mahāsatī velā vilalāpa bhṛśaṃ muhuḥ ..
tacchutvā sa ca kṛṣṇāṃśaḥ sahito balakhāninā ..
tāmāśvāsya tadā velāṃ nabhomārgeṇa cāyayau ..59..
3.3.d:
तदा महासती वेला विललाप भृशं मुहुः ॥
तच्छुत्वा स च कृष्णांशः सहितो बलखानिना ॥
तामाश्वास्य तदा वेलां नभोमार्गेण चाययौ ॥59॥
3.3.m: Then the great, faithful wife Velā lamented bitterly again and again. / Hearing that, Kṛṣṇāṃśa, accompanied by Balakhānin, / having consoled Velā then, came through the sky.

3.3.s:
lakṣaṇaṃ tarjayitvāsau gṛhītvā cāgamanmudā..
nabhomārgeṇa gehe taṃ kṛṣṇāṃśaḥ samapeṣayat .. 3.3.17.60 ..
3.3.d:
लक्षणं तर्जयित्वासौ गृहीत्वा चागमन्मुदा॥
नभोमार्गेण गेहे तं कृष्णांशः समपेषयत् ॥ 3.3.17.60 ॥
3.3.m: Having threatened Lakṣaṇa and seized him, they came with joy; / Kṛṣṇāṃśa sent him to his home through the sky.

3.3.s:
punastyaktvā sapta sutānsahitānnṛpatestu te ..
śapathaṃ kārayāmāsurdaṃbhaṃ prati mahābalāḥ ..
uṣitvā daśarātrāṃte dadhyurgaṃtumano mune ..61..
3.3.d:
पुनस्त्यक्त्वा सप्त सुतान्सहितान्नृपतेस्तु ते ॥
शपथं कारयामासुर्दंभं प्रति महाबलाः ॥
उषित्वा दशरात्रांते दध्युर्गंतुमनो मुने ॥61॥
3.3.m: Releasing the seven sons once again along with the king, / those mighty ones made them swear an oath against deceit; / having stayed for ten nights, they set their minds on departing, O sage.

3.3.s:
mahīrājastu balavāngṛhītvā bhūpateḥ padau ..
sa uvācāśrupūrṇākṣastadā parimalaṃ nṛpam .. 62 ..
3.3.d:
महीराजस्तु बलवान्गृहीत्वा भूपतेः पदौ ॥
स उवाचाश्रुपूर्णाक्षस्तदा परिमलं नृपम् ॥ 62 ॥
3.3.m: Then mighty King Mahī, grasping the feet of the monarch, / with eyes filled with tears, said to King Parimala:

3.3.s:
mahārāja vadhūste ca veleyaṃ dvādaśābdikā ..
pitṛmātṛviyogaṃ ca na kṣamaṃtī tu bālikā .. 63 ..
3.3.d:
महाराज वधूस्ते च वेलेयं द्वादशाब्दिका ॥
पितृमातृवियोगं च न क्षमंती तु बालिका ॥ 63 ॥
3.3.m: “O Great King, this Velā, your daughter-in-law, is twelve years old; / being a young girl, she cannot bear separation from her mother and father.

3.3.s:
tasmāttāṃ tvaṃ parityajya gaccha gehaṃ sukhī bhava ..
patiyogyā yadā bhūyāttadā tvāṃ punareṣyati..64..
3.3.d:
तस्मात्तां त्वं परित्यज्य गच्छ गेहं सुखी भव ॥
पतियोग्या यदा भूयात्तदा त्वां पुनरेष्यति॥64॥
3.3.m: Therefore, leave her, go home, and be happy. / When she becomes fit for a husband, she will come to you again.”

3.3.s:
ityuktvā ca vaco rājā sa snehādaṃkamaspṛśat..
cūrṇībhūte parimale cāhlādastatra duḥkhitaḥ..
mahīrājaṃ sa pasparśa sa rājā cūrṇatāṃ gataḥ.. 65..
3.3.d:
इत्युक्त्वा च वचो राजा स स्नेहादंकमस्पृशत्॥
चूर्णीभूते परिमले चाह्लादस्तत्र दुःखितः॥
महीराजं स पस्पर्श स राजा चूर्णतां गतः॥ 65॥
3.3.m: Having spoken these words, the king touched his lap out of affection. / When Parimala was crushed [in embrace], Cāhlāda, distressed there, / touched King Mahī, and that king became crushed.

3.3.s:
bhagnāsthī bhūpatī cobhau pāvakīyaiścikitsakaiḥ..
sukhavaṃtau gṛhaṃ prāpya kṛtakṛtyatvamāgatau..66..
3.3.d:
भग्नास्थी भूपती चोभौ पावकीयैश्चिकित्सकैः॥
सुखवंतौ गृहं प्राप्य कृतकृत्यत्वमागतौ॥66॥
3.3.m: Both monarchs, with their bones broken, by means of fire-physicians / became comfortable, reached home, and attained fulfillment.

3.3.s:
malanā svasutaṃ dṛṣṭvā prāptamudvāhitaṃ gṛhe ..
kṛtvotsavaṃ bahuvidhaṃ viprebhyaśca dadau dhanam ..
homaṃ vai kārayāmāsa caṃḍikāyāḥ prasādataḥ .. 67 ..
3.3.d:
मलना स्वसुतं दृष्ट्वा प्राप्तमुद्वाहितं गृहे ॥
कृत्वोत्सवं बहुविधं विप्रेभ्यश्च ददौ धनम् ॥
होमं वै कारयामास चंडिकायाः प्रसादतः ॥ 67 ॥
3.3.m: Malanā, seeing her son arrive home married, / held various festivities, gave wealth to the brahmins, / and caused a fire offering to be performed through the favor of Caṇḍikā.

3.3.s:
sabhāyāṃ lakṣaṇo vīro yātrākāle tamabravīt ..
agamā jayacandrāya matvā jitvā hṛtāṃ tu tām ..
nabhomārgeṇa saṃprāptau yoginau ca śivājñayā..68..
3.3.d:
सभायां लक्षणो वीरो यात्राकाले तमब्रवीत् ॥
अगमा जयचन्द्राय मत्वा जित्वा हृतां तु ताम् ॥
नभोमार्गेण संप्राप्तौ योगिनौ च शिवाज्ञया॥68॥
3.3.m: In the assembly, at the time of departure, the heroic Lakṣaṇa said to him: / “Thinking her inaccessible to Jayacandra, she was seized after conquering [him]; / but two yogins arrived through the sky by the command of Śiva.

3.3.s:
jahatustau ca māṃ jitvā tattīkṣṇabhaya mohitam ..
adyāhaṃ dhāma gacchāmi ciraṃ jīva nṛpottama ..
ityuktavaṃtaṃ taṃ natvā yayurbhūpāḥ svamālayam .. 69 ..
3.3.d:
जहतुस्तौ च मां जित्वा तत्तीक्ष्णभय मोहितम् ॥
अद्याहं धाम गच्छामि चिरं जीव नृपोत्तम ॥
इत्युक्तवंतं तं नत्वा ययुर्भूपाः स्वमालयम् ॥ 69 ॥
3.3.m: Having conquered me, bewildered by intense terror, those two left me. / Today I go to my abode; live long, O best of kings!” / Having bowed to him who had spoken thus, the kings went to their own dwellings.

3.3.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
viṃśābde caiva kṛṣṇāṃśe yathā jātaṃ tathā śṛṇu ..
sāgarākhyasarastīre kadācidiṃdulo balī ..
japtvā saptaśatīstotraṃ tatra dhyānānvito'bhavat ..1..
3.3.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
विंशाब्दे चैव कृष्णांशे यथा जातं तथा शृणु ॥
सागराख्यसरस्तीरे कदाचिदिंदुलो बली ॥
जप्त्वा सप्तशतीस्तोत्रं तत्र ध्यानान्वितोऽभवत् ॥1॥
3.3.m: Sūta said: / Hear what happened in the twentieth year of Kṛṣṇāṃśa: / Once, on the shore of the lake named Sāgara, mighty Indula, / having recited the Saptaśatī hymn, became absorbed in meditation there.

3.3.s:
etasminnaṃtare haṃsā ākāśādbhū mimāgatāḥ ..
teṣāṃ ca rutaśabdaiśca sa dhyānādutthito'bhavat .. 2 ..
3.3.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे हंसा आकाशाद्भू मिमागताः ॥
तेषां च रुतशब्दैश्च स ध्यानादुत्थितोऽभवत् ॥ 2 ॥
3.3.m: In the meantime, wild geese came down from the sky to the earth, / and at the sounds of their calls, he arose from meditation.

3.3.s:
vakṣyamāṇaṃ vacaḥ prāhurdhanyo'yaṃ divyavigrahaḥ ..
parvatānāṃ himagirirvanaṃ vṛṃdāvanaṃ tathā .. 3 ..
3.3.d:
वक्ष्यमाणं वचः प्राहुर्धन्योऽयं दिव्यविग्रहः ॥
पर्वतानां हिमगिरिर्वनं वृंदावनं तथा ॥ 3 ॥
3.3.m: They spoke the word about to be related: “Blessed is this divine form! / Among mountains the Himālaya, and among forests Vṛndāvana;

3.3.s:
mahāvatī purīṇāṃ ca sāgaraḥ sarasāmapi ..
nārīṇāṃ padminī nārī nṛṇāṃ śreṣṭhastvamiṃdulaḥ .. 4 ..
3.3.d:
महावती पुरीणां च सागरः सरसामपि ॥
नारीणां पद्मिनी नारी नृणां श्रेष्ठस्त्वमिंदुलः ॥ 4 ॥
3.3.m: and Mahāvatī among cities, and the ocean among lakes; / among women the padminī woman, and among men you, Indula, are the foremost.

3.3.s:
bho indula mahāprājña mānase sarasi sthitāḥ ..
vayaṃ śrutvā śriyo vākyaṃ nalinī sāgaraṃ gatāḥ .. 5 ..
3.3.d:
भो इन्दुल महाप्राज्ञ मानसे सरसि स्थिताः ॥
वयं श्रुत्वा श्रियो वाक्यं नलिनी सागरं गताः ॥ 5 ॥
3.3.m: O wise Indula, residing in Lake Mānasa, / we, having heard the words of Śrī, went to the Nalinīsāgara.

3.3.s:
dṛṣṭvā tatra śubhāṃ nārīṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitām ..
saptālibhiryutāṃ ramyāṃ gītanāṭya viśāradām .. 6 ..
3.3.d:
दृष्ट्वा तत्र शुभां नारीं सर्वाभरणभूषिताम् ॥
सप्तालिभिर्युतां रम्यां गीतनाट्य विशारदाम् ॥ 6 ॥
3.3.m: Seeing there an auspicious woman adorned with all ornaments, / accompanied by seven female companions, lovely, skilled in song and dance,

3.3.s:
dṛṣṭvā mohatvamāpannā vayaṃ deśāntaraṃ gatāḥ ..
vilokitā narāḥ sarve'trāsmābhirjagatītale ..
tvatsamo na hi ko'pyatra padminī sadṛśo varaḥ .. 7 ..
3.3.d:
दृष्ट्वा मोहत्वमापन्ना वयं देशान्तरं गताः ॥
विलोकिता नराः सर्वेऽत्रास्माभिर्जगतीतले ॥
त्वत्समो न हि कोऽप्यत्र पद्मिनी सदृशो वरः ॥ 7 ॥
3.3.m: falling into bewilderment upon seeing her, we went to other lands. / All men here upon the surface of the earth were observed by us; / indeed, there is no bridegroom here equal to you, matching the padminī.

3.3.s:
tasmāttvaṃ naḥ samāruhya tāṃ devīṃ draṣṭumarhasi ..
tathetyuktvā śakrasuto haṃsarājaṃ samāruhat .. 8 ..
3.3.d:
तस्मात्त्वं नः समारुह्य तां देवीं द्रष्टुमर्हसि ॥
तथेत्युक्त्वा शक्रसुतो हंसराजं समारुहत् ॥ 8 ॥
3.3.m: Therefore, mounting upon us, you ought to see that lady.” / Saying “So be it,” the son of Śakra mounted the king of wild geese.

3.3.s:
siṃhaladvīpake ramye hyāryasiṃho nṛpaḥ sthitaḥ ..
tatsutā padminī nāmnā rūpayauvanaśālinī ..
rāgiṇyaḥ sapta vikhyātāstatsakhyaḥ pramadottamāḥ .. 9 ..
3.3.d:
सिंहलद्वीपके रम्ये ह्यार्यसिंहो नृपः स्थितः ॥
तत्सुता पद्मिनी नाम्ना रूपयौवनशालिनी ॥
रागिण्यः सप्त विख्यातास्तत्सख्यः प्रमदोत्तमाः ॥ 9 ॥
3.3.m: In the lovely island of Siṃhala, King Āryasiṃha resides; / his daughter, named Padminī, is endowed with beauty and youth. / Seven well-known rāgiṇīs, the best of young women, are her female companions.

3.3.s:
nalinīsāgare ramye girijāmaṃdiraṃ śubham ..
tatra sthitāṃ ca tāṃ devīmindulaḥ sa dadarśa ha .. 3.3.18.10 ..
3.3.d:
नलिनीसागरे रम्ये गिरिजामंदिरं शुभम् ॥
तत्र स्थितां च तां देवीमिन्दुलः स ददर्श ह ॥ 3.3.18.10 ॥
3.3.m: At the lovely Nalinīsāgara, there is an auspicious temple of Girijā; / and Indula indeed saw that lady staying there.

3.3.s:
sāpi taṃ sundaraṃ dṛṣṭvā haṃsadehe samāsthitam ..
saṃmohyāhūya taṃ devaṃ tena sārddhamarīramat ..11..
3.3.d:
सापि तं सुन्दरं दृष्ट्वा हंसदेहे समास्थितम् ॥
संमोह्याहूय तं देवं तेन सार्द्धमरीरमत् ॥11॥
3.3.m: Seeing that handsome one mounted upon the body of a wild goose, / she, being enraptured and having summoned that godlike man, took delight with him.

3.3.s:
varṣamekaṃ yayau tatra nānālīlāsu mohitaḥ ..
naktaṃ divaṃ na bubudhe ramamāṇastayā saha .. 12..
3.3.d:
वर्षमेकं ययौ तत्र नानालीलासु मोहितः ॥
नक्तं दिवं न बुबुधे रममाणस्तया सह ॥ 12॥
3.3.m: A year passed there while he was fascinated by various amorous sports; / sporting with her, he did not notice night or day.

3.3.s:
bhaktigarvatvamāpanne cāhlāde jagadaṃbikā ..
dṛṣṭvā cāntardadhe devī garvācaraṇakuṃṭhitā .. 13 ..
3.3.d:
भक्तिगर्वत्वमापन्ने चाह्लादे जगदंबिका ॥
दृष्ट्वा चान्तर्दधे देवी गर्वाचरणकुंठिता ॥ 13 ॥
3.3.m: When Āhlāda fell into the pride of devotion, the Mother of the World, / seeing it, disappeared, the goddess offended by his arrogant conduct.

3.3.s:
tasya prāptaṃ mahadduḥkhamāhlādasya jayaiṣiṇaḥ ..
sa kaiścitpuruṣairvīraḥ kathito'bhūtsva maṃdire .. 14 ..
3.3.d:
तस्य प्राप्तं महद्दुःखमाह्लादस्य जयैषिणः ॥
स कैश्चित्पुरुषैर्वीरः कथितोऽभूत्स्व मंदिरे ॥ 14 ॥
3.3.m: Great sorrow befell that Āhlāda, who was desirous of victory. / That hero was reported by certain men in his palace:

3.3.s:
indulaṃ rūpasampannaṃ laṃkāpuranivāsinaḥ ..
rākṣasāstaṃ samāhṛtya svagehaṃ śīghramāyayuḥ .. 15 ..
3.3.d:
इन्दुलं रूपसम्पन्नं लंकापुरनिवासिनः ॥
राक्षसास्तं समाहृत्य स्वगेहं शीघ्रमाययुः ॥ 15 ॥
3.3.m: “Rākṣasas residing in the city of Laṅkā, / having seized Indula who is endowed with beauty, quickly went to their own abode.”

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā vaco ghoraṃ sakulo vilalāpa ha ..
hāhāśabdo mahāṃścāsītteṣāṃ tu rudatāṃ mune .. 16 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा वचो घोरं सकुलो विललाप ह ॥
हाहाशब्दो महांश्चासीत्तेषां तु रुदतां मुने ॥ 16 ॥
3.3.m: Having heard this terrible news, he lamented with his family; / and a great cry of distress arose among those who were weeping, O sage.

3.3.s:
kṛṣṇāṃśo ruditaṃ prāhāhlādaṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ śṛṇuṣva bhoḥ ..
jitvāhaṃ rākṣasānsarvāṃstālanādyaiḥ samanvitaḥ ..
iṃdulaṃ tvāṃ sameṣyāmi bhavāndhairyaparo bhavet ..17..
3.3.d:
कृष्णांशो रुदितं प्राहाह्लादं ज्येष्ठं शृणुष्व भोः ॥
जित्वाहं राक्षसान्सर्वांस्तालनाद्यैः समन्वितः ॥
इंदुलं त्वां समेष्यामि भवान्धैर्यपरो भवेत् ॥17॥
3.3.m: Kṛṣṇāṃśa said to the weeping elder brother Āhlāda: “Listen, sir! / Having conquered all the rākṣasas together with Tālana and the others, / I shall bring Indula back to you; may you be resolute!”

3.3.s:
balakhāniśca kṛṣṇāṃśo devasiṃhaśca tālanaḥ ..
saptalakṣabalaiḥ sārddhaṃ lakāṃ prati yayurmudā .. 18 ..
3.3.d:
बलखानिश्च कृष्णांशो देवसिंहश्च तालनः ॥
सप्तलक्षबलैः सार्द्धं लकां प्रति ययुर्मुदा ॥ 18 ॥
3.3.m: And Balakhāni, Kṛṣṇāṃśa, Devasiṃha, and Tālana, / together with an army of seven hundred thousand, set out with joy towards Laṅkā.

3.3.s:
mārgaprāptāśca ye bhūpā grāmapā rāṣṭrapāstathā ..
yathāyogya baliṃ ramyaṃ prāpya tasmai nyavedayan ..19..
3.3.d:
मार्गप्राप्ताश्च ये भूपा ग्रामपा राष्ट्रपास्तथा ॥
यथायोग्य बलिं रम्यं प्राप्य तस्मै न्यवेदयन् ॥19॥
3.3.m: And whichever kings, village chiefs, and district governors were encountered on the way, / having brought suitable, pleasant tribute, presented it to him.

3.3.s:
ye bhūpā madamattāśca jitvā tāṃstālano balī ..
baddhvā taiśca samāgacchatsetubaṃdhaṃ śivasthalam ..3.3.18.20..
3.3.d:
ये भूपा मदमत्ताश्च जित्वा तांस्तालनो बली ॥
बद्ध्वा तैश्च समागच्छत्सेतुबंधं शिवस्थलम् ॥3.3.18.20॥
3.3.m: And the mighty Tālana, having conquered those kings who were intoxicated with pride / and having bound them, arrived with them at Setubandha, the sacred place of Śiva.

3.3.s:
pūjayitvā ca rāmeśaṃ rāmeṇa sthāpitaṃ śivam ..
siṃhaladvīpamaganṣaṇmāsābhyaṃtare tadā ..21..
3.3.d:
पूजयित्वा च रामेशं रामेण स्थापितं शिवम् ॥
सिंहलद्वीपमगन्षण्मासाभ्यंतरे तदा ॥21॥
3.3.m: And having worshipped Rāmeśa, the Śiva established by Rāma, / they then went to the island of Siṃhala within six months.

3.3.s:
nalinīsāgaraṃ prāpya tatra vāsamakārayan ..
patraṃ saṃpreṣayāmāsa balakhānirnṛpāya ca ..22..
3.3.d:
नलिनीसागरं प्राप्य तत्र वासमकारयन् ॥
पत्रं संप्रेषयामास बलखानिर्नृपाय च ॥22॥
3.3.m: Reaching the Nalinī Ocean, they encamped there, / and Balakhāni dispatched a letter to the king:

3.3.s:
āryyasiṃha mahābhāga svapotāndehi tīrṇakān ..
bhavām̐śca svabalaiḥ sārddhaṃ laṃkāṃ prati vrajādhunā ..
no cettvāṃ sabalaṃ jitvā rāṣṭrabhaṃgaṃ karomyaham ..23..
3.3.d:
आर्य्यसिंह महाभाग स्वपोतान्देहि तीर्णकान् ॥
भवाम्̐श्च स्वबलैः सार्द्धं लंकां प्रति व्रजाधुना ॥
नो चेत्त्वां सबलं जित्वा राष्ट्रभंगं करोम्यहम् ॥23॥
3.3.m: "O noble Āryasiṃha, give up your sea-crossing ships, / and now march towards Laṅkā along with your own forces; / otherwise, having conquered you together with your army, I will destroy your kingdom."

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā patravaco bhūpatirbalavattaraḥ ..
rakṣitaḥ śakraputreṇa yuddhāya samupāyayau ..24..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा पत्रवचो भूपतिर्बलवत्तरः ॥
रक्षितः शक्रपुत्रेण युद्धाय समुपाययौ ॥24॥
3.3.m: Hearing these words of the letter, the exceedingly powerful king, / protected by the son of Śakra, came forth for battle.

3.3.s:
indulaḥ staṃbhanaṃ maṃtraṃ saṃsthāpya śara uttame ..
staṃbhayāmāsa tatsainyaṃ tālanādyaiḥ surakṣitam .. ..25..
3.3.d:
इन्दुलः स्तंभनं मंत्रं संस्थाप्य शर उत्तमे ॥
स्तंभयामास तत्सैन्यं तालनाद्यैः सुरक्षितम् ॥ ॥25॥
3.3.m: Indula, having placed an immobilising mantra upon an excellent arrow, / immobilised that army well-protected by Tālana and the others.

3.3.s:
divase sukhaśarmā ca trilakṣaiḥ svadalaiḥ saha ..
āryyasiṃhasya tanayo mahadyuddhamacīkarat .. 26 ..
3.3.d:
दिवसे सुखशर्मा च त्रिलक्षैः स्वदलैः सह ॥
आर्य्यसिंहस्य तनयो महद्युद्धमचीकरत् ॥ 26 ॥
3.3.m: By day, Sukhaśarman, the son of Āryasiṃha, / waged a great battle with his own divisions of three hundred thousand.

3.3.s:
niśāmukhe ca saṃprāpte śakraputro mahābalaḥ.
śataputraiḥ kṣatriyāṇāṃ sārddhaṃ yuddhāya cāyayau ..27..
3.3.d:
निशामुखे च संप्राप्ते शक्रपुत्रो महाबलः।
शतपुत्रैः क्षत्रियाणां सार्द्धं युद्धाय चाययौ ॥27॥
3.3.m: And when nightfall arrived, the mighty son of Śakra / came forth to battle along with a hundred sons of kṣatriyas.

3.3.s:
teṣāṃ hayā haridvarṇā yogiveṣadharā balāt ..
mahatīṃ te sahasraṃ ca ripoḥ senāṃ vyanāśayat ..
tatpaścādgehamāsādya tadā taiḥ sukhito'vasat .. 28 ..
3.3.d:
तेषां हया हरिद्वर्णा योगिवेषधरा बलात् ॥
महतीं ते सहस्रं च रिपोः सेनां व्यनाशयत् ॥
तत्पश्चाद्गेहमासाद्य तदा तैः सुखितोऽवसत् ॥ 28 ॥
3.3.m: Their green-coloured horses forcibly bearing the guises of yogins, / they destroyed a great army of thousands belonging to the enemy; / thereafter, having reached his house, he then dwelt happily with them.

3.3.s:
evaṃ jātāśca ṣaṇmāsāstayoryuddhaṃ hi senayoḥ ..
krameṇa saṃkṣayaṃ prāptaṃ balakhānermahadbalam .. 29 ..
3.3.d:
एवं जाताश्च षण्मासास्तयोर्युद्धं हि सेनयोः ॥
क्रमेण संक्षयं प्राप्तं बलखानेर्महद्बलम् ॥ 29 ॥
3.3.m: In this way six months passed in the battle of those two armies; / gradually, the great force of Balakhāni suffered destruction.

3.3.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
dṛṣṭvā sainyanipātaṃ ca balakhānirmahābalaḥ ..
saṃprāpya mānasīṃ pīḍāṃ yuddhārthaṃ vimukho'bhavat ..1..
3.3.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
दृष्ट्वा सैन्यनिपातं च बलखानिर्महाबलः ॥
संप्राप्य मानसीं पीडां युद्धार्थं विमुखोऽभवत् ॥1॥
3.3.m: Sūta said: / Seeing the slaughter of his army, the mighty Balakhāni, / suffering mental distress, became averse to battle.

3.3.s:
devasiṃhaṃ samāhūya trikālajñaṃ mahāmatim ..
taṃ maṃtraṃ maṃtrayāmāsa kāryasiddhiryathā bhavet ..
śrutvovāca mahāyogī devasiṃho mahābalaḥ ..2..
3.3.d:
देवसिंहं समाहूय त्रिकालज्ञं महामतिम् ॥
तं मंत्रं मंत्रयामास कार्यसिद्धिर्यथा भवेत् ॥
श्रुत्वोवाच महायोगी देवसिंहो महाबलः ॥2॥
3.3.m: Having summoned the highly intelligent Devasiṃha, who knew the three times, / he held counsel with him so that success in his enterprise might come about. / Hearing him, the great yogin Devasiṃha, of great might, said:

3.3.s:
maheṃdratanayaḥ kaścitsarvaśastrāstrakovidaḥ ..
tvatsainyaṃ rodhayitvā vai divyāstreṇa divāmukhe ..
rātrau svayaṃ samāgamya karoti balasaṃkṣayam ..3..
3.3.d:
महेंद्रतनयः कश्चित्सर्वशस्त्रास्त्रकोविदः ॥
त्वत्सैन्यं रोधयित्वा वै दिव्यास्त्रेण दिवामुखे ॥
रात्रौ स्वयं समागम्य करोति बलसंक्षयम् ॥3॥
3.3.m: "A certain son of Mahendra, skilled in all weapons and divine missiles, / having checked your army with a divine missile at daybreak, / comes himself at night and causes the destruction of your forces.

3.3.s:
atastvaṃ matsahāyena tālanena samanvitaḥ ..
kṛṣṇāṃśena samāgamya śakra putraṃ śubhānanam ..
vijayī bhava śīghraṃ hi no cedyāyāṃ yamakṣayam ..4..
3.3.d:
अतस्त्वं मत्सहायेन तालनेन समन्वितः ॥
कृष्णांशेन समागम्य शक्र पुत्रं शुभाननम् ॥
विजयी भव शीघ्रं हि नो चेद्यायां यमक्षयम् ॥4॥
3.3.m: Therefore, with my assistance and accompanied by Tālana, / uniting with Kṛṣṇāṃśa, quickly become victorious / over the fair-faced son of Śakra; otherwise I shall go to the abode of Yama."

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā vacastasya devasiṃhasya bhāṣitam ..
yatnaṃ cakāra balavānbhrātṛmitrasamanvitaḥ ....
ekaviṃśābdakṛṣṇāṃśe saṃprāpte yuddhakovide ..
senāṃ niveśayāmāsa poteṣu hayavāhanaḥ ..6..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा वचस्तस्य देवसिंहस्य भाषितम् ॥
यत्नं चकार बलवान्भ्रातृमित्रसमन्वितः ॥॥
एकविंशाब्दकृष्णांशे संप्राप्ते युद्धकोविदे ॥
सेनां निवेशयामास पोतेषु हयवाहनः ॥6॥
3.3.m: Hearing these spoken words of Devasiṃha, / the mighty one made an effort together with his brother and friends. / When Kṛṣṇāṃśa, skilled in battle, reached his twenty-first year, / he, having horses as mounts, embarked his army onto ships.

3.3.s:
arddhaṃ sainyaṃ ca tatraiva sthāpayitvā mahābalaḥ ..
arddhasainyena kṛṣṇāṃśo dakṣiṇāṃ diśamāgamat .. 7 ..
3.3.d:
अर्द्धं सैन्यं च तत्रैव स्थापयित्वा महाबलः ॥
अर्द्धसैन्येन कृष्णांशो दक्षिणां दिशमागमत् ॥ 7 ॥
3.3.m: Having stationed half of the army right there, the mighty / Kṛṣṇāṃśa went toward the southern direction with half of the army.

3.3.s:
hayārūḍhāśca te śūrāḥ sarve yuddhasamanvitāḥ ..
kapāṭaṃ dṛḍhamudghāṭya nagarāntamupāyayuḥ ..8..
3.3.d:
हयारूढाश्च ते शूराः सर्वे युद्धसमन्विताः ॥
कपाटं दृढमुद्घाट्य नगरान्तमुपाययुः ॥8॥
3.3.m: And those heroes mounted on horses, all prepared for battle, / having forced open the firm city-gate, reached the interior of the city.

3.3.s:
hatvā te rakṣiṇaḥ sarvām̐lluṃṭhayitvā puraṃ śubham ..
ripordurgaṃ samāsādya cakruḥ śatrormahākṣayam .. 9 ..
3.3.d:
हत्वा ते रक्षिणः सर्वाम्̐ल्लुंठयित्वा पुरं शुभम् ॥
रिपोर्दुर्गं समासाद्य चक्रुः शत्रोर्महाक्षयम् ॥ 9 ॥
3.3.m: Having slain all the guards and plundered the fair city, / they reached the enemy's citadel and brought about the great destruction of the foe.

3.3.s:
rājño'ntaḥ puramāgatya kṛṣṇāṃśo balavattaraḥ ..
dadarśa sundarīṃ bālāṃ padminīṃ padmalocanām ..
saptālibhirvṛtāṃ ramyāṃ gītanṛtyaviśāradām .. 3.3.19.10 ..
3.3.d:
राज्ञोऽन्तः पुरमागत्य कृष्णांशो बलवत्तरः ॥
ददर्श सुन्दरीं बालां पद्मिनीं पद्मलोचनाम् ॥
सप्तालिभिर्वृतां रम्यां गीतनृत्यविशारदाम् ॥ 3.3.19.10 ॥
3.3.m: Entering the king's inner apartments, the exceedingly powerful Kṛṣṇāṃśa / beheld a beautiful young maiden, a lotus-eyed padminī, / surrounded by seven female companions, lovely and skilled in singing and dancing.

3.3.s:
balāddolāṃ samāropya luṃṭhayitvā riporgṛham..
jagāma śivire tasminyatra jāto mahāraṇaḥ .. 11 ..
3.3.d:
बलाद्दोलां समारोप्य लुंठयित्वा रिपोर्गृहम्॥
जगाम शिविरे तस्मिन्यत्र जातो महारणः ॥ 11 ॥
3.3.m: Having forcibly placed her into a palanquin and plundered the enemy's palace, / he went to that camp where the great battle was taking place.

3.3.s:
balakhānistu balavāndevatālanasaṃyutaḥ ..
jaghāna śātravīṃ senāmindulāstreṇa pālitām .. 12 ..
3.3.d:
बलखानिस्तु बलवान्देवतालनसंयुतः ॥
जघान शात्रवीं सेनामिन्दुलास्त्रेण पालिताम् ॥ 12 ॥
3.3.m: Meanwhile, the mighty Balakhāni, accompanied by Deva[siṃha] and Tālana, / struck down the enemy army protected by Indula's missile.

3.3.s:
sukhavarmāṇamāgatya senādhyakṣaṃ ripoḥ sutam ..
sarvatastaṃ svakīyāstrairjaghnuste madavihvalāḥ .. 13 ..
3.3.d:
सुखवर्माणमागत्य सेनाध्यक्षं रिपोः सुतम् ॥
सर्वतस्तं स्वकीयास्त्रैर्जघ्नुस्ते मदविह्वलाः ॥ 13 ॥
3.3.m: Approaching Sukhavarman, the enemy's son who was commander of the army, / they, frantic with fury, struck him from all sides with their own weapons.

3.3.s:
hate tasminmahāvīrye jayantaḥ krodhamūrcchitaḥ ..
senāmujjīvayāṃcakre śakraputraḥ pratāpavān .. 14 ..
3.3.d:
हते तस्मिन्महावीर्ये जयन्तः क्रोधमूर्च्छितः ॥
सेनामुज्जीवयांचक्रे शक्रपुत्रः प्रतापवान् ॥ 14 ॥
3.3.m: When that hero of great valour was slain, the glorious Jayanta, / the son of Śakra, overcome with rage, revived the army.

3.3.s:
śyālaṃ ca sukhavarmāṇaṃ saṃjīvya svagṛhaṃ yayau ..
tatra dṛṣṭvā janānsarvānbahurodanatatparān .. 15 ..
3.3.d:
श्यालं च सुखवर्माणं संजीव्य स्वगृहं ययौ ॥
तत्र दृष्ट्वा जनान्सर्वान्बहुरोदनतत्परान् ॥ 15 ॥
3.3.m: And having revived his brother-in-law Sukhavarman, he went to his own house; / there he saw all the people engaged in much weeping.

3.3.s:
vismitaḥ sa yayau gehaṃ yathā pūrvaṃ tathāvidhaḥ ..
na dadarśa priyāṃ tatra sakhībhiḥ sahitāṃ mune .. 16 ..
3.3.d:
विस्मितः स ययौ गेहं यथा पूर्वं तथाविधः ॥
न ददर्श प्रियां तत्र सखीभिः सहितां मुने ॥ 16 ॥
3.3.m: Astonished, he entered the house just as it was before; / he did not see his beloved there accompanied by her friends, O sage.

3.3.s:
āryyasiṃhagṛhaṃ gatvā pṛṣṭavānsarvakāraṇam ..
jñātvā saṃluṭhitaṃ gehaṃ śatrubhiḥ śastrakovidaiḥ .. 17 ..
3.3.d:
आर्य्यसिंहगृहं गत्वा पृष्टवान्सर्वकारणम् ॥
ज्ञात्वा संलुठितं गेहं शत्रुभिः शस्त्रकोविदैः ॥ 17 ॥
3.3.m: Going to Āryasiṃha's house, he asked the cause of it all; / he learned that the house had been plundered by the enemies skilled in weapons.

3.3.s:
ruroda subhṛśaṃ vīro hā priye madavihvale ..
darśayādya mukhaṃ ramyaṃ tvatpatistvāṃ samutsukaḥ ..18..
3.3.d:
रुरोद सुभृशं वीरो हा प्रिये मदविह्वले ॥
दर्शयाद्य मुखं रम्यं त्वत्पतिस्त्वां समुत्सुकः ॥18॥
3.3.m: The hero wept exceedingly: "Alas, my beloved, overcome with passion! / Show your lovely face today; your husband is longing for you!"

3.3.s:
ityevaṃ rodanaṃ kṛtvā vaḍavopari saṃsthitaḥ ..
dhanustūṇīramādāya khaḍgaṃ śatruvimohanam ..
ekākī sa yayau kruddho niśi yatra sthito ripuḥ .. 19 ..
3.3.d:
इत्येवं रोदनं कृत्वा वडवोपरि संस्थितः ॥
धनुस्तूणीरमादाय खड्गं शत्रुविमोहनम् ॥
एकाकी स ययौ क्रुद्धो निशि यत्र स्थितो रिपुः ॥ 19 ॥
3.3.m: Having wept in this manner, seated upon his mare, / taking his bow, quivers, and a sword that confounds the enemy, / he went alone, enraged, at night to where the enemy was stationed.

3.3.s:
etasminsamaye vīro balakhānirmahābalaḥ ..
dṛṣṭvā tāṃ sundarīṃ bālāṃ vilalāpa bhṛśaṃ muhuḥ .. 3.3.19.20 ..
3.3.d:
एतस्मिन्समये वीरो बलखानिर्महाबलः ॥
दृष्ट्वा तां सुन्दरीं बालां विललाप भृशं मुहुः ॥ 3.3.19.20 ॥
3.3.m: At that very time, the hero, the mighty Balakhāni, / seeing that beautiful young girl, lamented greatly again and again:

3.3.s:
hā indula mahāvīra hā madbaṃdho priyaṃkara ..
tvadyogyeyaṃ śubhā nārī rūpayauvanaśālinī..21..
3.3.d:
हा इन्दुल महावीर हा मद्बंधो प्रियंकर ॥
त्वद्योग्येयं शुभा नारी रूपयौवनशालिनी॥21॥
3.3.m: "Alas, Indula, great hero! Alas, my kinsman who does what is dear! / This auspicious woman, endowed with beauty and youth, is worthy of you!

3.3.s:
darśanaṃ dehi me śīghraṃ gṛhāṇādya śubhānanām ..
ityuktvā mūrcchito bhūtvā mānase pūjayañchivām ..22.. .
3.3.d:
दर्शनं देहि मे शीघ्रं गृहाणाद्य शुभाननाम् ॥
इत्युक्त्वा मूर्च्छितो भूत्वा मानसे पूजयञ्छिवाम् ॥22॥ ।
3.3.m: Grant me your presence quickly; take this fair-faced woman today!" / Having spoken thus, he fainted, worshipping Śivā in his mind.

3.3.s:
tasminkāle ca saṃprāptaḥ śakraputro mahābalaḥ..
jaghāna śātravīṃ senāṃ kṛṣṇāṃśenaiva pālitām .. 23 ..
3.3.d:
तस्मिन्काले च संप्राप्तः शक्रपुत्रो महाबलः॥
जघान शात्रवीं सेनां कृष्णांशेनैव पालिताम् ॥ 23 ॥
3.3.m: And at that time the mighty son of Śakra arrived / and struck down the enemy army protected by Kṛṣṇāṃśa.

3.3.s:
dṛṣṭvā sainyanipātaṃ ca tālano vāhinīpatiḥ.. .
siṃhanādaṃ nanādoccaiḥ siṃhinyupari saṃsthitaḥ .. 24 ..
3.3.d:
दृष्ट्वा सैन्यनिपातं च तालनो वाहिनीपतिः॥ ।
सिंहनादं ननादोच्चैः सिंहिन्युपरि संस्थितः ॥ 24 ॥
3.3.m: Seeing the destruction of the army, Tālana, the commander of the forces, / roared a lion's roar loudly, mounted upon a lioness:

3.3.s:
na jayaḥ sainyanāśena tava vīra bhaviṣyati ..
māṃ hatvā jahi matsainyaṃ yoginbālasvarūpaka .. ...25..
3.3.d:
न जयः सैन्यनाशेन तव वीर भविष्यति ॥
मां हत्वा जहि मत्सैन्यं योगिन्बालस्वरूपक ॥ ॥.25॥
3.3.m: "Victory will not be yours by the destruction of the army, O hero! / Slay me and then destroy my army, O yogin who have the form of a boy!"

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā vacastasya śakraputro bhayaṃkaraḥ ..
jaghāna hṛdaye bāṇānsa tu khaḍgena cācchinat ..
svabhallena punarvīro daṃśayāmāsa vakṣasi ..26..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा वचस्तस्य शक्रपुत्रो भयंकरः ॥
जघान हृदये बाणान्स तु खड्गेन चाच्छिनत् ॥
स्वभल्लेन पुनर्वीरो दंशयामास वक्षसि ॥26॥
3.3.m: Hearing these words of his, the terrible son of Śakra / struck arrows into his heart, but he cut them down with his sword; / then the hero pierced him in the chest with his own spear.

3.3.s:
iṃdule mūrchite tasminvaḍavā divyarūpiṇī ..
ākāśopari saṃprāpya jayantaṃ samabodhayat ..27..
3.3.d:
इंदुले मूर्छिते तस्मिन्वडवा दिव्यरूपिणी ॥
आकाशोपरि संप्राप्य जयन्तं समबोधयत् ॥27॥
3.3.m: When that Indula fainted, the mare possessing a divine form, / ascending into the sky, revived Jayanta.

3.3.s:
tadā sa bālastvaritaḥ kālāstraṃ cāpa ādadhe..
tena jāto mahāñchabdastālanaḥ sa mamāra ha .. 28 ..
3.3.d:
तदा स बालस्त्वरितः कालास्त्रं चाप आदधे॥
तेन जातो महाञ्छब्दस्तालनः स ममार ह ॥ 28 ॥
3.3.m: Then that boy quickly fitted the weapon of Death to his bow; / by it a great sound arose, and Tālana died.

3.3.s:
mṛte senāpatau tasminkṛṣṇāṃśo madavihvalaḥ ..
nabhomārgeṇa saṃprāpya jagarjja ca muhurmuhuḥ .. 29 ..
3.3.d:
मृते सेनापतौ तस्मिन्कृष्णांशो मदविह्वलः ॥
नभोमार्गेण संप्राप्य जगर्ज्ज च मुहुर्मुहुः ॥ 29 ॥
3.3.m: When that general died, the portion of Kṛṣṇa, overwhelmed with fury, / arrived by the path of the sky and roared again and again.

3.3.s:
indulaḥ krodhatāmrākṣastvāgneyaṃ śaramādade ..
vahnibhūtaṃ nabhastatra svayogena mahābalaḥ ..
kṛtvā śīghraṃ yayau śatruṃ sa tu vāyavyamādadhe .. 3.3.19.30 ..
3.3.d:
इन्दुलः क्रोधताम्राक्षस्त्वाग्नेयं शरमाददे ॥
वह्निभूतं नभस्तत्र स्वयोगेन महाबलः ॥
कृत्वा शीघ्रं ययौ शत्रुं स तु वायव्यमादधे ॥ 3.3.19.30 ॥
3.3.m: Indula, his eyes red with anger, took up a fire-arrow; / having turned the sky into fire with his yoga, that very mighty one / swiftly approached his enemy, but he [the other] fitted the wind-weapon.

3.3.s:
svayogenaiva kṛṣṇāṃśaḥ pītvā vāyavyamuttamam ..
punarjagāma tatpārśvaṃ kalaikaḥ sa hareḥ svayam ..31..
3.3.d:
स्वयोगेनैव कृष्णांशः पीत्वा वायव्यमुत्तमम् ॥
पुनर्जगाम तत्पार्श्वं कलैकः स हरेः स्वयम् ॥31॥
3.3.m: Drinking up the excellent wind-weapon by his yoga alone, / the portion of Kṛṣṇa, himself a single part of Hari, approached his side once more.

3.3.s:
tathāvidhaṃ ripuṃ dṛṣṭvā śakraputro mahābalaḥ ..
gaṃdharvāstraṃ samādāya mohanāyopacakrame .. 32 ..
3.3.d:
तथाविधं रिपुं दृष्ट्वा शक्रपुत्रो महाबलः ॥
गंधर्वास्त्रं समादाय मोहनायोपचक्रमे ॥ 32 ॥
3.3.m: Seeing the enemy in such a state, the very mighty son of Śakra / took up the gandharva-weapon and set out to bewilder him.

3.3.s:
punaryogabalenaiva tadastraṃ saṃkṣayaṃ gatam ..
vāruṇaṃ śaramādāya tasyopari samākṣipat .. 33 ..
3.3.d:
पुनर्योगबलेनैव तदस्त्रं संक्षयं गतम् ॥
वारुणं शरमादाय तस्योपरि समाक्षिपत् ॥ 33 ॥
3.3.m: By the power of his yoga alone, that weapon was completely destroyed; / taking up a water-arrow, he hurled it down upon him.

3.3.s:
svayogenaiva kṛṣṇāṃśo jalaṃ sarvaṃ mukhe'karot ..
evaṃ sarvāṇi cāstrāṇi pītvā pītvā punaḥpunuḥ ..34..
3.3.d:
स्वयोगेनैव कृष्णांशो जलं सर्वं मुखेऽकरोत् ॥
एवं सर्वाणि चास्त्राणि पीत्वा पीत्वा पुनःपुनुः ॥34॥
3.3.m: By his yoga alone, the portion of Kṛṣṇa drew all the water into his mouth; / thus drinking up all the divine weapons again and again,

3.3.s:
yayau śīghraṃ prasannātmā bāhuśālī yatendriyaḥ ..
iṃdulastu tadā kruddho'śvinīṃ tyaktvā bhuvi sthitaḥ ..
carma khaḍgaṃ gṛhītvāśu khaḍgayuddhamacīkarat ..35..
3.3.d:
ययौ शीघ्रं प्रसन्नात्मा बाहुशाली यतेन्द्रियः ॥
इंदुलस्तु तदा क्रुद्धोऽश्विनीं त्यक्त्वा भुवि स्थितः ॥
चर्म खड्गं गृहीत्वाशु खड्गयुद्धमचीकरत् ॥35॥
3.3.m: that strong-armed one of restrained senses, cheerful in spirit, advanced swiftly. / Then Indula, enraged, dismounted from the mare and stood upon the ground; / taking shield and sword, he immediately engaged in sword combat.

3.3.s:
etasminnaṃtare prāptā devādyāḥ sarvabhūmipāḥ ..
dadṛśustanmahadyuddhaṃ sarvavismayakāraṇam .. 36 ..
3.3.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे प्राप्ता देवाद्याः सर्वभूमिपाः ॥
ददृशुस्तन्महद्युद्धं सर्वविस्मयकारणम् ॥ 36 ॥
3.3.m: In the meantime, the gods and all the kings of the earth arrived; / they watched that great battle which was a cause of wonder to all.

3.3.s:
prātaḥkāle ca saṃprāpte balakhānirmahābalaḥ ..
dadarśa vālakaṃ ramyaṃ jaṭājinasamanvitam .. 37 ..
3.3.d:
प्रातःकाले च संप्राप्ते बलखानिर्महाबलः ॥
ददर्श वालकं रम्यं जटाजिनसमन्वितम् ॥ 37 ॥
3.3.m: And when morning came, the very mighty Balakhāni / beheld the handsome boy, adorned with matted hair and an antelope skin.

3.3.s:
śrameṇa karśito vīraḥ śakraputraḥ pratāpavān ..
balakhāneḥ piturbandhoḥ śapathaṃ kṛtavānsvayam .. 38 ..
3.3.d:
श्रमेण कर्शितो वीरः शक्रपुत्रः प्रतापवान् ॥
बलखानेः पितुर्बन्धोः शपथं कृतवान्स्वयम् ॥ 38 ॥
3.3.m: Exhausted by fatigue, that heroic and glorious son of Śakra / himself swore an oath by Balakhāni, his father’s brother:

3.3.s:
svakhaḍgenaiva kṛṣṇāṃśa śirastava harāmyaham ..
no cenme dūṣitā mātā nāmnā svarṇavatī satī ..
ityuktvā khaḍgamādāya yayau śīghraṃ ruṣānvitaḥ .. 39 ..
3.3.d:
स्वखड्गेनैव कृष्णांश शिरस्तव हराम्यहम् ॥
नो चेन्मे दूषिता माता नाम्ना स्वर्णवती सती ॥
इत्युक्त्वा खड्गमादाय ययौ शीघ्रं रुषान्वितः ॥ 39 ॥
3.3.m: “O portion of Kṛṣṇa, with my own sword I shall take off your head; / if not, my mother, the virtuous woman named Svarṇavatī, is defiled!” / Having said this and taken up his sword, he advanced swiftly, filled with wrath.

3.3.s:
balakhānistu taṃ jñātvā tyaktvāstraṃ premakātaraḥ ..
putrāṃtikamupāgamya vacanaṃ cedamabravīt .. 3.3.19.40 ..
3.3.d:
बलखानिस्तु तं ज्ञात्वा त्यक्त्वास्त्रं प्रेमकातरः ॥
पुत्रांतिकमुपागम्य वचनं चेदमब्रवीत् ॥ 3.3.19.40 ॥
3.3.m: Recognising him, Balakhāni cast aside his weapon, overcome with affection; / having approached near his son, he spoke this word:

3.3.s:
he indula mahābhāga pitṛmātṛyaśaskara ..
āhlādaprāṇasadṛśa svarṇavatyaṃgamānasa .. 41 ..
3.3.d:
हे इन्दुल महाभाग पितृमातृयशस्कर ॥
आह्लादप्राणसदृश स्वर्णवत्यंगमानस ॥ 41 ॥
3.3.m: “O noble Indula, bringer of glory to your father and mother, / you who are like the very life of Āhlāda, mind and limb of Svarṇavatī!

3.3.s:
pūrvaṃ hatvā ca māṃ vīra svapitṛvyaṃ tataḥ punaḥ ..
tathaivodayasiṃhaṃ ca devasiṃhaṃ tathā kulam ..
sukhī bhava mahāvīra gehe vai sukhavarmaṇaḥ .. 42 ..
3.3.d:
पूर्वं हत्वा च मां वीर स्वपितृव्यं ततः पुनः ॥
तथैवोदयसिंहं च देवसिंहं तथा कुलम् ॥
सुखी भव महावीर गेहे वै सुखवर्मणः ॥ 42 ॥
3.3.m: O hero, having first slain me, your own paternal uncle, and then again / likewise Udayasiṃha, Devasiṃha, and your family, / be happy, O great hero, in the house of Sukhavarman!”

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā vacastasya jñātvā ca svakulaṃ śiśuḥ ..
tyaktvā khaḍgaṃ patitvā ca svapitṛvyasya pādayoḥ ..
kṛtavānrodanaṃ gāḍhamaparādhanivṛttaye .. 43 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा वचस्तस्य ज्ञात्वा च स्वकुलं शिशुः ॥
त्यक्त्वा खड्गं पतित्वा च स्वपितृव्यस्य पादयोः ॥
कृतवान्रोदनं गाढमपराधनिवृत्तये ॥ 43 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing his words and recognising his own family, the child / cast aside his sword, fell at the feet of his paternal uncle, / and wept bitterly in order to avert his offense.

3.3.s:
uvāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ śṛṇu tāta mama priya ..
nārīyaṃ dūṣitā vedairnṛṇāṃ mohapradāyinī .. 44 ..
3.3.d:
उवाच मधुरं वाक्यं शृणु तात मम प्रिय ॥
नारीयं दूषिता वेदैर्नृणां मोहप्रदायिनी ॥ 44 ॥
3.3.m: He spoke sweet words: “Listen, O father, my dear one! / This woman is reviled by the Vedas, bestowing delusion upon men.

3.3.s:
devo vā mānuṣo vāpi pannago vāpi dānavaḥ ..
āryya nārīmayairjālairbandhanāya samudyataḥ ..45..
3.3.d:
देवो वा मानुषो वापि पन्नगो वापि दानवः ॥
आर्य्य नारीमयैर्जालैर्बन्धनाय समुद्यतः ॥45॥
3.3.m: Be he a god, a mortal, a serpent, or a dānava, / O noble one, he is bound by the snares made of women.

3.3.s:
sohamājanmaśuddhasya piturāhlādakasya ca ..
gehe jāto jayantaśca śakraputraḥ svayaṃ vibho .. 46 ..
3.3.d:
सोहमाजन्मशुद्धस्य पितुराह्लादकस्य च ॥
गेहे जातो जयन्तश्च शक्रपुत्रः स्वयं विभो ॥ 46 ॥
3.3.m: Such as I am, born in the house of my father Āhlādaka, who was pure from birth, / I am Jayanta himself, the son of Śakra, O lord!

3.3.s:
padminyā janitaṃ mohaṃ gṛhītvā jñātavānna hi ..
kṣamasva mama mandasya śeṣamajñānajaṃ pituḥ .. 47 ..
3.3.d:
पद्मिन्या जनितं मोहं गृहीत्वा ज्ञातवान्न हि ॥
क्षमस्व मम मन्दस्य शेषमज्ञानजं पितुः ॥ 47 ॥
3.3.m: Seized by the delusion produced by Padminī, I did not know! / Forgive the remnant of my, a foolish one's, [offense] born of ignorance towards a father!”

3.3.s:
ityuktvā sa punarbālo ruroda snehakātaraḥ ..
senāmujjīvayāmāsa tālanaṃ ca mahābalam ..48..
3.3.d:
इत्युक्त्वा स पुनर्बालो रुरोद स्नेहकातरः ॥
सेनामुज्जीवयामास तालनं च महाबलम् ॥48॥
3.3.m: Having said this, that boy wept again, overcome with affection; / and he revived the army and the very mighty Tālana.

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā vacastasya kṛṣṇāṃśo vacanaṃ śiśoḥ ..
paramānandamāgamya hṛdaye tamaropayat..
utsavaṃ kārayāmāsa tatra deśe janejane ..49..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा वचस्तस्य कृष्णांशो वचनं शिशोः ॥
परमानन्दमागम्य हृदये तमरोपयत्॥
उत्सवं कारयामास तत्र देशे जनेजने ॥49॥
3.3.m: Hearing the words of that child, the portion of Kṛṣṇa / attained supreme bliss and clasped him to his heart; / he caused a festival to be celebrated among all the people in that region.

3.3.s:
āryyasiṃhastu tacchrutvā nānādravyasamanvitaḥ ..
dadau kanyāṃ vidhānena padminīmiṃdulāya vai ..3.3.19.50..
3.3.d:
आर्य्यसिंहस्तु तच्छ्रुत्वा नानाद्रव्यसमन्वितः ॥
ददौ कन्यां विधानेन पद्मिनीमिंदुलाय वै ॥3.3.19.50॥
3.3.m: Hearing of that, Āryasiṃha, possessing diverse treasures, / gave the maiden Padminī in marriage to Indula according to the prescribed rites.

3.3.s:
śataṃ hayāṃstathā nāgānmuktāmaṇi vibhūṣitān ..
kanyārthe tāndadau rājā jāmātre bahubhūṣaṇam ..51..
3.3.d:
शतं हयांस्तथा नागान्मुक्तामणि विभूषितान् ॥
कन्यार्थे तान्ददौ राजा जामात्रे बहुभूषणम् ॥51॥
3.3.m: A hundred horses and elephants adorned with pearls and gems— / these the king gave for the maiden’s sake, and many ornaments to his son-in-law.

3.3.s:
prasthānamakarotteṣāṃ sa premṇā vākyagadgadaḥ ..
te tu sarve mudā yuktāḥ svagehaṃ śīghra māyayuḥ .. 52 ..
3.3.d:
प्रस्थानमकरोत्तेषां स प्रेम्णा वाक्यगद्गदः ॥
ते तु सर्वे मुदा युक्ताः स्वगेहं शीघ्र माययुः ॥ 52 ॥
3.3.m: With voice choked with love, he made their departure; / and they, all filled with joy, quickly returned to their own home.

3.3.s:
uṣitvā māsamekaṃ tu tasminmārge bhayānake ..
kīrtisāgaramāsādya cakruste bahudhotsavam..53..
3.3.d:
उषित्वा मासमेकं तु तस्मिन्मार्गे भयानके ॥
कीर्तिसागरमासाद्य चक्रुस्ते बहुधोत्सवम्॥53॥
3.3.m: Having tarried for one month on that perilous journey, / they reached Kīrtisāgara and held a great festival in many ways.

3.3.s:
āhlādastu prasannātmā sutaṃ patnīsamanvitam ..
dṛṣṭvā viprānsamāhūya dadau dānānyanekaśaḥ ..54 ..
3.3.d:
आह्लादस्तु प्रसन्नात्मा सुतं पत्नीसमन्वितम् ॥
दृष्ट्वा विप्रान्समाहूय ददौ दानान्यनेकशः ॥54 ॥
3.3.m: Cheerful in spirit, Āhlāda, seeing his son accompanied by his wife, / summoned the brāhmaṇas and gave diverse gifts.

3.3.s:
daśahārākhyanagaraṃ saṃprāptaḥ svakulaissaha ..
kṛṣṇāṃśasya mahākīrtirjātā loke jane jane ..59..
3.3.d:
दशहाराख्यनगरं संप्राप्तः स्वकुलैस्सह ॥
कृष्णांशस्य महाकीर्तिर्जाता लोके जने जने ॥59॥
3.3.m: Together with his family, he reached the city named Daśahāra; / great renown arose for the portion of Kṛṣṇa among all the people in the world.

3.3.s:
pṛthvīrājastu tacchrutvā vismayaṃ paramaṃ yayau ..
sā tu vai padminī nārī durvāsaḥśāpamohitā .. 56 ..
3.3.d:
पृथ्वीराजस्तु तच्छ्रुत्वा विस्मयं परमं ययौ ॥
सा तु वै पद्मिनी नारी दुर्वासःशापमोहिता ॥ 56 ॥
3.3.m: Pṛthvīrāja, hearing that, fell into supreme astonishment. / But that woman Padminī, deluded by the curse of Durvāsas,

3.3.s:
apsasarastvaṃ svayaṃ tyaktvā bhūmau nārītvamāgatā ..
dvādaśābdapramāṇena soṣitvā jagatītale ..57..
3.3.d:
अप्ससरस्त्वं स्वयं त्यक्त्वा भूमौ नारीत्वमागता ॥
द्वादशाब्दप्रमाणेन सोषित्वा जगतीतले ॥57॥
3.3.m: having abandoned her nature as an apsaras, had assumed womanhood on earth; / having dwelt upon the surface of the earth for the measure of twelve years,

3.3.s:
yakṣmaṇā maraṇaṃ prāpya svargalokamupāyayau ..
nava māsānkṛto vāsastayā cāhlā damaṃdire ..58..
3.3.d:
यक्ष्मणा मरणं प्राप्य स्वर्गलोकमुपाययौ ॥
नव मासान्कृतो वासस्तया चाह्ला दमंदिरे ॥58॥
3.3.m: she met death from consumption and departed for the world of heaven; / a dwelling of nine months was made by her in the house of Āhlāda.

3.3.s:
.. .. sūta uvāca .. ..
mune pāṃcāladeśe tu rājāsīdbalavarddhanaḥ ..
tasya patnī viśālākṣī jaladevīti viśrutā .. 1 ..
3.3.d:
॥ ॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
मुने पांचालदेशे तु राजासीद्बलवर्द्धनः ॥
तस्य पत्नी विशालाक्षी जलदेवीति विश्रुता ॥ 1 ॥
3.3.m: Sūta said: / “O sage, in the Pañcāla country there was a king named Balavardhana; / his large-eyed wife was renowned as Jaladevī.

3.3.s:
bisenavaṃśabhūpālo vedatattvaviśāradaḥ ..
sastrīkaḥ pūjayāmāsa varuṇaṃ yādasāṃ patim ..2 ..
3.3.d:
बिसेनवंशभूपालो वेदतत्त्वविशारदः ॥
सस्त्रीकः पूजयामास वरुणं यादसां पतिम् ॥2 ॥
3.3.m: The king of the Bisena lineage, skilled in the true meaning of the Vedas, / together with his wife worshipped Varuṇa, the lord of aquatic creatures.

3.3.s:
tasya putrāvubhau jātau kṣatradharmaparāyaṇau ..
laharo jyeṣṭhatanayo mayūradhvaja eva hi .. 3 ..
3.3.d:
तस्य पुत्रावुभौ जातौ क्षत्रधर्मपरायणौ ॥
लहरो ज्येष्ठतनयो मयूरध्वज एव हि ॥ 3 ॥
3.3.m: To him were born two sons devoted to the duties of kṣatriyas: / Lahara was his eldest son, and Mayūradhvaja indeed [was the other].

3.3.s:
dvādaśābdavayā bhūtvā mayūradhvaja eva saḥ ..
ājñayā jyeṣṭhabaṃdhośca skaṃdadevamatoṣayat .. 4 ..
3.3.d:
द्वादशाब्दवया भूत्वा मयूरध्वज एव सः ॥
आज्ञया ज्येष्ठबंधोश्च स्कंददेवमतोषयत् ॥ 4 ॥
3.3.m: Reaching twelve years of age, that very Mayūradhvaja, / by the order of his elder brother, propitiated the god Skanda.

3.3.s:
yateṃdriyastathā maunī vānaprastha parāyaṇaḥ ..
paṃcābdaṃ tadvratī bhūtvā japadhyānaparobhavat .. 5 ..
3.3.d:
यतेंद्रियस्तथा मौनी वानप्रस्थ परायणः ॥
पंचाब्दं तद्व्रती भूत्वा जपध्यानपरोभवत् ॥ 5 ॥
3.3.m: Subduing his senses, observing silence, devoted to the life of a forest-dweller, / observing that vow for five years, he became absorbed in recitation and meditation.

3.3.s:
tadā prasanno bhagavānsenānīragnibhūḥ svayam ..
svarūpaṃ darśayāmāsa sarvāścaryasamanvi tam.. 6 ..
3.3.d:
तदा प्रसन्नो भगवान्सेनानीरग्निभूः स्वयम् ॥
स्वरूपं दर्शयामास सर्वाश्चर्यसमन्वि तम्॥ 6 ॥
3.3.m: Then the blessed general, fire-born himself, was pleased; / he revealed his own form, which was endowed with all wonders.

3.3.s:
mayūradhvaja evāpi dṛṣṭvā sarvamayaṃ śiśum ..
devasenāsahāyaṃ ca tuṣṭāva ślakṣṇayā girā .. 7 ..
3.3.d:
मयूरध्वज एवापि दृष्ट्वा सर्वमयं शिशुम् ॥
देवसेनासहायं च तुष्टाव श्लक्ष्णया गिरा ॥ 7 ॥
3.3.m: And Mayūradhvaja, beholding that child composed of all things, / the helper of Devasenā, praised him with gentle words.

3.3.s:
mayūradhvaja uvāca ..
jayati te vapurdivyavigrahaṃ nayati sarvadā devatāgaṇān ..
pibati mātriyaṃ dugdhamuttamaṃ vadhati sarvadā daityadānavān .. 8 ..
3.3.d:
मयूरध्वज उवाच ॥
जयति ते वपुर्दिव्यविग्रहं नयति सर्वदा देवतागणान् ॥
पिबति मात्रियं दुग्धमुत्तमं वधति सर्वदा दैत्यदानवान् ॥ 8 ॥
3.3.m: Mayūradhvaja said: / “Victorious is your body of divine form, which ever leads the hosts of gods, / which drinks the excellent milk of the Mothers, and ever slays the daityas and dānavas!

3.3.s:
namaste devaseneśa mahiṣāsuramardana ..
ṣaḍānana mahābāho tārakaprāṇanāśaka .. 9 ..
3.3.d:
नमस्ते देवसेनेश महिषासुरमर्दन ॥
षडानन महाबाहो तारकप्राणनाशक ॥ 9 ॥
3.3.m: Homage to you, O lord of Devasenā, crusher of Mahiṣāsura, / six-faced, mighty-armed one, destroyer of the life of Tāraka!”

3.3.s:
prasanno bhava sarvātmanguhaśaktidharāvyaya ..
kiṃkaraṃ pāhi māṃ nityaṃ śaraṇāgatavatsala .. 3.3.20.10 ..
3.3.d:
प्रसन्नो भव सर्वात्मन्गुहशक्तिधराव्यय ॥
किंकरं पाहि मां नित्यं शरणागतवत्सल ॥ 3.3.20.10 ॥
3.3.m: Be gracious, O Soul of All, Guha, wielder of the spear, imperishable one! / Protect me, your servant, constantly, O you who are affectionate to those seeking refuge!

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā stutiṃ tasya senānīstamuvāca vai ..
kiṃ te'bhīṣṭaṃ nṛpaśreṣṭha mattaḥ sarvamavāpsyasi .. 11 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा स्तुतिं तस्य सेनानीस्तमुवाच वै ॥
किं तेऽभीष्टं नृपश्रेष्ठ मत्तः सर्वमवाप्स्यसि ॥ 11 ॥
3.3.m: Having heard this hymn of praise, the army-commander said to him: / "What is your desire, best of kings? You shall obtain everything from me."

3.3.s:
ityuktastena devena bhūpatiḥ prāha namradhīḥ ..
balaṃ me dehi bhagavansahāyaṃ kuru sarvadā .. 12 ..
3.3.d:
इत्युक्तस्तेन देवेन भूपतिः प्राह नम्रधीः ॥
बलं मे देहि भगवन्सहायं कुरु सर्वदा ॥ 12 ॥
3.3.m: Thus addressed by that god, the king, bowing his intellect, said: / "Grant me strength, O Lord, and always provide me aid!"

3.3.s:
tathetyuktvā tu taṃ skaṃdastatraivāntardadhe punaḥ ..
sa nṛpastu prasannātmā kārayāmāsa vai puram .. 13 ..
3.3.d:
तथेत्युक्त्वा तु तं स्कंदस्तत्रैवान्तर्दधे पुनः ॥
स नृपस्तु प्रसन्नात्मा कारयामास वै पुरम् ॥ 13 ॥
3.3.m: Saying "So be it" to him, Skanda vanished right there again. / That king, his soul pleased, had a city built,

3.3.s:
nāmnā mayūranagaraṃ naravṛṃdasamanvitam ..
dviyojanāyāmayutaṃ skaṃdadevena rakṣitam .. 14 ..
3.3.d:
नाम्ना मयूरनगरं नरवृंदसमन्वितम् ॥
द्वियोजनायामयुतं स्कंददेवेन रक्षितम् ॥ 14 ॥
3.3.m: Named Mayūranagara, filled with hosts of men, / Two yojanas in extent, protected by the god Skanda.

3.3.s:
laharo nāmā tadbaṃdhurdvidaśābdaprayatnataḥ ..
varuṇaṃ pūjayāmāsa nadīnadasamanvitam .. 15 ..
3.3.d:
लहरो नामा तद्बंधुर्द्विदशाब्दप्रयत्नतः ॥
वरुणं पूजयामास नदीनदसमन्वितम् ॥ 15 ॥
3.3.m: His brother, named Lahara, by means of an effort lasting twenty years, / Worshipped Varuṇa, who is accompanied by rivers and streams.

3.3.s:
tadā prasanno bhagavānvaruṇo yādasāṃ patiḥ ..
varaṃ brūhīti vacanaṃ premṇovāca mahīpatim .. 16 ..
3.3.d:
तदा प्रसन्नो भगवान्वरुणो यादसां पतिः ॥
वरं ब्रूहीति वचनं प्रेम्णोवाच महीपतिम् ॥ 16 ॥
3.3.m: Then the blessed lord Varuṇa, master of aquatic creatures, was pleased, / And with affection addressed these words to the king: "Choose a boon!"

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā'mṛtamayaṃ vacanaṃ laharo nṛpaḥ ..
tuṣṭāva ślakṣṇayā vācā pāśinaṃ payasāṃ patim .. 17 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वाऽमृतमयं वचनं लहरो नृपः ॥
तुष्टाव श्लक्ष्णया वाचा पाशिनं पयसां पतिम् ॥ 17 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing this nectar-like utterance, King Lahara / Praised the noose-bearer, the lord of waters, with smooth speech:

3.3.s:
.. lahara uvāca .. ..
yasya cittaṃ mahajjñeyaṃ tapo balasamanvitam ..
ataḥ pracetāste nāma namastubhyaṃ pracetase .. 18 ..
3.3.d:
॥ लहर उवाच ॥ ॥
यस्य चित्तं महज्ज्ञेयं तपो बलसमन्वितम् ॥
अतः प्रचेतास्ते नाम नमस्तुभ्यं प्रचेतसे ॥ 18 ॥
3.3.m: Lahara said: / "He whose mind is known as great, endowed with ascetic power and strength, / Therefore your name is Pracetas; homage to you, Pracetas!

3.3.s:
ruṇaddhi payasāṃ vegaṃ na kenāpyavarodhitaḥ ..
atastvaṃ varuṇo nāma namaste varuṇāya vai .. 19 ..
3.3.d:
रुणद्धि पयसां वेगं न केनाप्यवरोधितः ॥
अतस्त्वं वरुणो नाम नमस्ते वरुणाय वै ॥ 19 ॥
3.3.m: You hold back the speed of the waters, unrestrained by anyone; / Therefore your name is Varuṇa; homage indeed to Varuṇa!

3.3.s:
daityānāṃ baṃdhanārthāya devānāṃ jayahetave ..
divyaḥ pāśastvayānītaḥ pāśine te namonamaḥ .. 3.3.20.20 ..
3.3.d:
दैत्यानां बंधनार्थाय देवानां जयहेतवे ॥
दिव्यः पाशस्त्वयानीतः पाशिने ते नमोनमः ॥ 3.3.20.20 ॥
3.3.m: For binding the Daityas and for the victory of the gods, / A celestial noose was brought by you; homage, homage to you, the noose-wielder!"

3.3.s:
iti stutastadā devo rājñā tenaiva dhīmatā ..
nagarīṃ kārayāmāsa lāharīmatha cottamām ..21..
3.3.d:
इति स्तुतस्तदा देवो राज्ञा तेनैव धीमता ॥
नगरीं कारयामास लाहरीमथ चोत्तमाम् ॥21॥
3.3.m: Thus praised then by that wise king, the god / Caused an excellent city, Lāharī, to be built,

3.3.s:
triyojanāyāmayutāṃ caturvarṇasamanvitām ..
svayaṃ ca grāmarakṣārthe tatrovāsa jalā dhipaḥ.. 22 ..
3.3.d:
त्रियोजनायामयुतां चतुर्वर्णसमन्विताम् ॥
स्वयं च ग्रामरक्षार्थे तत्रोवास जला धिपः॥ 22 ॥
3.3.m: Three yojanas in extent, populated by the four classes; / And the lord of waters dwelt there himself to protect the settlement.

3.3.s:
bhūpastu tatprasādena prāpa rājñīṃ śubhānanām ..
rāvī nāma mahāśreṣṭhā jñeyā devāṃganopamā .. 23 ..
3.3.d:
भूपस्तु तत्प्रसादेन प्राप राज्ञीं शुभाननाम् ॥
रावी नाम महाश्रेष्ठा ज्ञेया देवांगनोपमा ॥ 23 ॥
3.3.m: By his favor, the king obtained an auspicious-faced queen / Named Rāvī, highly distinguished, who should be known as like a divine maiden.

3.3.s: tasyāṃ sa janayāmāsa sutānṣo ḍaśasaṃmitān .. dhārtarāṣṭrāṃśajānmukhyāngajatulyabalānvitān ..24..
3.3.d: तस्यां स जनयामास सुतान्षो डशसंमितान् ॥ धार्तराष्ट्रांशजान्मुख्यान्गजतुल्यबलान्वितान् ॥24॥
3.3.m: Upon her he fathered sixteen sons, / Leading men born of portions of the Dhārtarāṣṭras, endowed with strength equal to elephants.

3.3.s:
tatpaścātkanyakā jātā nāmnā madanamaṃjarī ..
dvādaśābdavayaḥprāpte sutāyāḥ sa tu bhūpatiḥ .. 25 ..
3.3.d:
तत्पश्चात्कन्यका जाता नाम्ना मदनमंजरी ॥
द्वादशाब्दवयःप्राप्ते सुतायाः स तु भूपतिः ॥ 25 ॥
3.3.m: After that, a daughter was born, named Madanamañjarī. / When his daughter reached twelve years of age, that king,

3.3.s:
devasiṃhaṃ varaṃ matvā caṃdravaṃśinamuttamam ..
prāhūya jyeṣṭhatanayaṃ preṣayāmāsa bhūpatiḥ..26 ..
3.3.d:
देवसिंहं वरं मत्वा चंद्रवंशिनमुत्तमम् ॥
प्राहूय ज्येष्ठतनयं प्रेषयामास भूपतिः॥26 ॥
3.3.m: Considering Devasiṃha, an excellent descendant of the Lunar dynasty, to be a suitable bridegroom, / Called his eldest son and sent him forth.

3.3.s:
raṇadhīrastu tanayo lakṣamudrānvito balī ..
sahasraśabarasahitaḥ prāptavānsa mahāvatīm .. 27 ..
3.3.d:
रणधीरस्तु तनयो लक्षमुद्रान्वितो बली ॥
सहस्रशबरसहितः प्राप्तवान्स महावतीम् ॥ 27 ॥
3.3.m: His son Raṇadhīra, mighty, accompanied by one hundred thousand coins / And accompanied by a thousand Śabaras, arrived at Mahāvatī.

3.3.s:
natvā parimalaṃ bhūpaṃ tadīyātkulaśālinaḥ ..
svahetuṃ varṇayāmāsa vivāhārthe svasuḥ svayam ..28..
3.3.d:
नत्वा परिमलं भूपं तदीयात्कुलशालिनः ॥
स्वहेतुं वर्णयामास विवाहार्थे स्वसुः स्वयम् ॥28॥
3.3.m: Having bowed to King Parimala, from among those distinguished by their noble family, / He personally described his purpose regarding the marriage of his sister.

3.3.s:
śrutvā parimalo bhūpo devasiṃhaṃ mahāmatim ..
āhūya vacanaṃ prāha vivāhārthe manaḥ kuru .. 39 ..
3.3.d:
श्रुत्वा परिमलो भूपो देवसिंहं महामतिम् ॥
आहूय वचनं प्राह विवाहार्थे मनः कुरु ॥ 39 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing this, King Parimala summoned the wise Devasiṃha / And addressed these words: "Set your mind on marriage!"

3.3.s:
devasiṃhastu balavānpitṛvyaṃ prāha namradhīḥ ..
vivāhaṃ na kariṣyāmi brahmacaryaṃ vrataṃ mama .. 3.3.20.30 ..
3.3.d:
देवसिंहस्तु बलवान्पितृव्यं प्राह नम्रधीः ॥
विवाहं न करिष्यामि ब्रह्मचर्यं व्रतं मम ॥ 3.3.20.30 ॥
3.3.m: The mighty Devasiṃha, his mind bowed, said to his paternal uncle: / "I shall not contract a marriage; lifelong celibacy is my vow."

3.3.s:
bahudhā prārthitassarvairdvijavṛṃdasamanvitaiḥ ..
na tatyāja vrataṃ śreṣṭhaṃ devasiṃho mahāmatiḥ .. .. 31 ..
3.3.d:
बहुधा प्रार्थितस्सर्वैर्द्विजवृंदसमन्वितैः ॥
न तत्याज व्रतं श्रेष्ठं देवसिंहो महामतिः ॥ ॥ 31 ॥
3.3.m: Though repeatedly requested by everyone, together with hosts of twice-born men, / The wise Devasiṃha did not abandon his excellent vow.

3.3.s:
tadā parimalo bhūpo raṇadhīraṃ vaco'bravīt ..
sukhakhānirayaṃ bālo vivāhārthe vadāmyaham.. 32 ..
3.3.d:
तदा परिमलो भूपो रणधीरं वचोऽब्रवीत् ॥
सुखखानिरयं बालो विवाहार्थे वदाम्यहम्॥ 32 ॥
3.3.m: Then King Parimala said these words to Raṇadhīra: / "Here is the boy Sukhakhāni; I speak of him for the marriage."

3.3.s:
tatheti matvā sa nṛpo raṇadhīro gṛhaṃ yayau ..
pitaraṃ kathayāmāsa sukhakhānirmahāvrataḥ .. 33 ..
3.3.d:
तथेति मत्वा स नृपो रणधीरो गृहं ययौ ॥
पितरं कथयामास सुखखानिर्महाव्रतः ॥ 33 ॥
3.3.m: Deeming it acceptable, that King Raṇadhīra went home, / And told his father: "Sukhakhāni has undertaken a great vow."

3.3.s:
etasminnantare dhūrto mahīpatiruvāca tam ..
ayogyo'yaṃ vivāho'tra pāvakīye kulottame .. 34 ..
3.3.d:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे धूर्तो महीपतिरुवाच तम् ॥
अयोग्योऽयं विवाहोऽत्र पावकीये कुलोत्तमे ॥ 34 ॥
3.3.m: In the meantime, a knavish king said to him: / "This marriage is improper here in the noble family belonging to Fire!

3.3.s:
śūdrīyo'tra varo rājanvarṇasaṃkarakārakaḥ ..
tasmāttvaṃ sainyasahito jetuṃ tāngaṃtumarhasi .. 35 ..
3.3.d:
शूद्रीयोऽत्र वरो राजन्वर्णसंकरकारकः ॥
तस्मात्त्वं सैन्यसहितो जेतुं तान्गंतुमर्हसि ॥ 35 ॥
3.3.m: The groom here is of Śūdra origin, O King, a causer of class mixture; / Therefore, you should go with your army to conquer them!

3.3.s:
kārāgāre lohamaye baṃdhanaṃ kuru bhūpateḥ ..
matkīrtiḥ svargagā nityaṃ jagatyaṃte bhaviṣyati .. 36 ..
3.3.d:
कारागारे लोहमये बंधनं कुरु भूपतेः ॥
मत्कीर्तिः स्वर्गगा नित्यं जगत्यंते भविष्यति ॥ 36 ॥
3.3.m: Put that king in an iron prison! / In the end, my fame will constantly reach heaven in the world!"

3.3.s:
jitastairjambuko rājā netrasiṃhastu yo nṛpaḥ ..
tathā gajapatirbhūpaḥ pṛthvīrājo mahābalaḥ .. 37 ..
3.3.d:
जितस्तैर्जम्बुको राजा नेत्रसिंहस्तु यो नृपः ॥
तथा गजपतिर्भूपः पृथ्वीराजो महाबलः ॥ 37 ॥
3.3.m: [The knave said:] "By them was King Jambuka conquered, as well as King Netrasiṃha, / Likewise King Gajapati, and the mighty Pṛthvīrāja;

3.3.s:
āryasiṃhastathānye ca jitāste balavattarāḥ ..
iti śrutvā vaco ramyaṃ laharo nṛpasattamaḥ .. 38 ..
3.3.d:
आर्यसिंहस्तथान्ये च जितास्ते बलवत्तराः ॥
इति श्रुत्वा वचो रम्यं लहरो नृपसत्तमः ॥ 38 ॥
3.3.m: Āryasiṃha and others, even stronger, were conquered!" / Hearing this charming speech, Lahara, best of kings,

3.3.s:
senāṃ saṃsthāpayāmāsa caturaṃgabalānvitām ..
caturlakṣamitāṃ śreṣṭhāṃ pālitāṃ ṣoḍaśātmajaiḥ .. 39 ..
3.3.d:
सेनां संस्थापयामास चतुरंगबलान्विताम् ॥
चतुर्लक्षमितां श्रेष्ठां पालितां षोडशात्मजैः ॥ 39 ॥
3.3.m: Arrayed an army endowed with fourfold strength, / Measuring four hundred thousand, excellent, led by his sixteen sons.

3.3.s:
māghaśukladaśamyāṃ ca balakhāniṃ mahābalaḥ ..
saṃprāptaḥ svakulaissārddhaṃ caturlakṣabalānvitam ..3.3.20.40..
3.3.d:
माघशुक्लदशम्यां च बलखानिं महाबलः ॥
संप्राप्तः स्वकुलैस्सार्द्धं चतुर्लक्षबलान्वितम् ॥3.3.20.40॥
3.3.m: On the tenth day of the bright fortnight of Māgha, the mighty one reached Balakhāni / Along with his kinsmen, endowed with a force of four hundred thousand.

3.3.s:
deśe pāṃcālake ramye laharīnagare sthitaḥ ..
dvādaśābde ca kṛṣṇāṃśe tatra vāsamakārayat .. 41 ..
3.3.d:
देशे पांचालके रम्ये लहरीनगरे स्थितः ॥
द्वादशाब्दे च कृष्णांशे तत्र वासमकारयत् ॥ 41 ॥
3.3.m: Situated in the lovely Pañcāla country, in the city of Laharī, / In his twelfth year, the partial incarnation of Kṛṣṇa took up residence there.

3.3.s:
nṛpaterājñayā śūrā yuddhāya samupāyayuḥ ..
balakhānistu dharmātmā dṛṣṭvā śūrāṃstathāgatān..
vīrānājñāpayāmāsa svakīyānsaṃgare punaḥ .. 42 ..
3.3.d:
नृपतेराज्ञया शूरा युद्धाय समुपाययुः ॥
बलखानिस्तु धर्मात्मा दृष्ट्वा शूरांस्तथागतान्॥
वीरानाज्ञापयामास स्वकीयान्संगरे पुनः ॥ 42 ॥
3.3.m: By command of the king, the warriors approached for battle. / But the righteous Balakhāni, seeing the warriors thus arrived, / Commanded his own heroes again for battle.

3.3.s:
tayoryuddhamabhūdghoraṃ senayorlomaharṣaṇam ..
paṃcame'hni divā prāpte balakhānirmahābalaḥ ..
kṛṣṇāṃśenaiva sahito riporvadhamakārayat.. 43 ..
3.3.d:
तयोर्युद्धमभूद्घोरं सेनयोर्लोमहर्षणम् ॥
पंचमेऽह्नि दिवा प्राप्ते बलखानिर्महाबलः ॥
कृष्णांशेनैव सहितो रिपोर्वधमकारयत्॥ 43 ॥
3.3.m: A terrible battle arose between those two armies, causing hair to stand on end. / When day arrived on the fifth day, the mighty Balakhāni, / Together with the partial incarnation of Kṛṣṇa, caused the slaughter of the enemy.

3.3.s:
parājitāśca te śūrā hataśeṣā bhayāturāḥ ..
tāndṛṣṭvā ṣoḍaśasutā rathaṃ svaṃsvaṃ samāsthitāḥ ..
yuddhāyābhimukhaṃ jagmurdhanurbāṇaviśāradāḥ .. 44 ..
3.3.d:
पराजिताश्च ते शूरा हतशेषा भयातुराः ॥
तान्दृष्ट्वा षोडशसुता रथं स्वंस्वं समास्थिताः ॥
युद्धायाभिमुखं जग्मुर्धनुर्बाणविशारदाः ॥ 44 ॥
3.3.m: And those warriors were defeated; the survivors of the slaughter were overcome with fear. / Seeing them, the sixteen sons mounted their respective chariots, / Skilled in bow and arrow, and marched forward to battle.

3.3.s:
kṛṣṇāṃśastāṃstathā dṛṣṭvā śaravarṣasamanvitān ..
ekākī prayayau śīghraṃ khaḍgacarmadharo balī .. 45 ..
3.3.d:
कृष्णांशस्तांस्तथा दृष्ट्वा शरवर्षसमन्वितान् ॥
एकाकी प्रययौ शीघ्रं खड्गचर्मधरो बली ॥ 45 ॥
3.3.m: Seeing them accompanied by a shower of arrows, the partial incarnation of Kṛṣṇa / Quickly went out alone, mighty, bearing sword and shield.

3.3.s:
teṣāṃ dhanūṃṣi saṃchidya baddhvā tānyuddhadurmadān..
āhlādāya dadau vīraḥ kṛṣṇāṃśo raṇakovidaḥ .. 46 ..
3.3.d:
तेषां धनूंषि संछिद्य बद्ध्वा तान्युद्धदुर्मदान्॥
आह्लादाय ददौ वीरः कृष्णांशो रणकोविदः ॥ 46 ॥
3.3.m: Severing their bows and binding those who were mad with battle, / The heroic partial incarnation of Kṛṣṇa, skilled in war, handed them over to Āhlāda.

3.3.s:
putrāṇāṃ bandhanaṃ śrutvā laharo nṛpasattamaḥ ..
plāvayāmāsa tatsainyaṃ balakhānermahātmanaḥ .. 47 ..
3.3.d:
पुत्राणां बन्धनं श्रुत्वा लहरो नृपसत्तमः ॥
प्लावयामास तत्सैन्यं बलखानेर्महात्मनः ॥ 47 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing of the capture of his sons, Lahara, best of kings, / Flooded that army of the high-souled Balakhāni.

3.3.s:
jalībhūte tathā sainye jayanto balavattaraḥ ..
vāyavyāstreṇa samare śuśoṣa sakalaṃ jalam ..
laharasya tataḥ senāmuvāha bahuyojanam .. 48 ..
3.3.d:
जलीभूते तथा सैन्ये जयन्तो बलवत्तरः ॥
वायव्यास्त्रेण समरे शुशोष सकलं जलम् ॥
लहरस्य ततः सेनामुवाह बहुयोजनम् ॥ 48 ॥
3.3.m: When the army was turned to water, the very mighty Jayanta / Dried up all the water in battle by means of the wind-weapon; / Then he carried the army of Lahara many yojanas away.

3.3.s:
tadā tu bhagavāndevo varuṇo yādasāṃ patiḥ ..
sutāmudvāhayāmāsa laharasya mahīpateḥ .. 49 ..
3.3.d:
तदा तु भगवान्देवो वरुणो यादसां पतिः ॥
सुतामुद्वाहयामास लहरस्य महीपतेः ॥ 49 ॥
3.3.m: Then the blessed lord Varuṇa, master of aquatic creatures, / Had the daughter of King Lahara married.

3.3.s:
laharo'pi prasannātmā jñātvāṃśaṃ jagatītale ..
bhaktiṃ cakāra śuddhānāmaṃśānāṃ parayā mudā .. 3.3.20.50 ..
3.3.d:
लहरोऽपि प्रसन्नात्मा ज्ञात्वांशं जगतीतले ॥
भक्तिं चकार शुद्धानामंशानां परया मुदा ॥ 3.3.20.50 ॥
3.3.m: Lahara too, delighted in mind, having recognized the partial incarnation on the surface of the earth, / With supreme joy showed devotion to those pure partial incarnations.

3.3.s:
dattvā ca bahudhā dravyaṃ parikramya punaḥpunaḥ ..
svānte niveśayāmāsa māsamātraṃ prasannadhīḥ .. 51 ..
3.3.d:
दत्त्वा च बहुधा द्रव्यं परिक्रम्य पुनःपुनः ॥
स्वान्ते निवेशयामास मासमात्रं प्रसन्नधीः ॥ 51 ॥
3.3.m: Giving various kinds of wealth and circumambulating them again and again, / With a pleased mind he lodged them in his private quarters for one month.

3.3.s:
aṃśāste'pi mahāpūjāṃ gṛhītvā laharapradām ..
dolāmāropya tāṃ devīṃ svagehāya yayurmudā .. 52 ..
3.3.d:
अंशास्तेऽपि महापूजां गृहीत्वा लहरप्रदाम् ॥
दोलामारोप्य तां देवीं स्वगेहाय ययुर्मुदा ॥ 52 ॥
3.3.m: Those partial incarnations too, having received the grand worship offered by Lahara, / Placed that lady on a litter and joyfully went to their own home.

3.3.s:
iti te kathitaṃ vipra kṛṣṇāṃśacaritaṃ śubham ..
sukhakhānervivāhaṃ ca śrutvānaṃdamavāpnuyāt ..53..
3.3.d:
इति ते कथितं विप्र कृष्णांशचरितं शुभम् ॥
सुखखानेर्विवाहं च श्रुत्वानंदमवाप्नुयात् ॥53॥
3.3.m: Thus has been told to you, O brāhmaṇa, the auspicious life of Kṛṣṇāṃśa / and the marriage of Sukhakhāni; hearing it, one attains bliss.

3.3.s:
.. ṛṣiruvāca .. ..
gṛhaṃ gatvā ca te vīrāḥ kiṃ cakruścaritaṃ śubham ..
tattvaṃ kathaya viprendra sarvajño'si mato hi naḥ .. 1 ..
3.3.d:
॥ ऋषिरुवाच ॥ ॥
गृहं गत्वा च ते वीराः किं चक्रुश्चरितं शुभम् ॥
तत्त्वं कथय विप्रेन्द्र सर्वज्ञोऽसि मतो हि नः ॥ 1 ॥
3.3.m: The sage said: / Having returned home, what auspicious deed did those heroes perform? / Tell the truth, O chief of brāhmaṇas; indeed, you are considered omniscient by us.

3.3.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
gṛhamāgatya te sarve parito bhūpateḥ sabhām ..
gatvā vārtāṃ tathā cakruryathā jāto mahāraṇaḥ .. 2 ..
3.3.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
गृहमागत्य ते सर्वे परितो भूपतेः सभाम् ॥
गत्वा वार्तां तथा चक्रुर्यथा जातो महारणः ॥ 2 ॥
3.3.m: Sūta said: / Having all come home, they went around to the assembly of the king / and reported the news of how the great battle had taken place.

3.3.s:
śrutvā parimalo bhūpo vājivṛṃdaṃ kṣayaṃ gatam ..
āhūya sa ca kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ vacanaṃ prāha namradhīḥ .. 3 ..
3.3.d:
श्रुत्वा परिमलो भूपो वाजिवृंदं क्षयं गतम् ॥
आहूय स च कृष्णांशं वचनं प्राह नम्रधीः ॥ 3 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing that the host of horses had been destroyed, King Parimala / summoned Kṛṣṇāṃśa and, with humble mind, spoke these words:

3.3.s:
siṃdhudeśe ca gaṃtavyaṃ tvayā ca balaśālinā ..
pañcalakṣānhayānkṛtvā punarāgaccha vai gṛham ..4..
3.3.d:
सिंधुदेशे च गंतव्यं त्वया च बलशालिना ॥
पञ्चलक्षान्हयान्कृत्वा पुनरागच्छ वै गृहम् ॥4॥
3.3.m: “You, being full of strength, must go to the country of Sindhu; / acquiring five hundred thousand horses, come home again.”

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā tu kṛṣṇāṃśo devasiṃhena saṃyutaḥ ..
svarṇabhārasahasroṣṭrāngṛhītvā tarasā yayau .. 5 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा तु कृष्णांशो देवसिंहेन संयुतः ॥
स्वर्णभारसहस्रोष्ट्रान्गृहीत्वा तरसा ययौ ॥ 5 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing this, Kṛṣṇāṃśa, accompanied by Devasiṃha, / quickly set out, taking camels laden with a thousand measures of gold.

3.3.s:
śūraiśca daśasāhasraissārddhaṃ tatra samāgataḥ ..
mayūranagarī yatra caturvarṇasamanvitā .. 6 ..
3.3.d:
शूरैश्च दशसाहस्रैस्सार्द्धं तत्र समागतः ॥
मयूरनगरी यत्र चतुर्वर्णसमन्विता ॥ 6 ॥
