3.3.m: Together with ten thousand heroes, he arrived there, / where the city of Mayūranagarī was, populated by the four classes.

3.3.s:
prātaḥkāle tu saṃprāpte mālākārasya vai sutā..
puṣpānāma samāsannā cāraṃbhe kusumārthinī .. 7 ..
3.3.d:
प्रातःकाले तु संप्राप्ते मालाकारस्य वै सुता॥
पुष्पानाम समासन्ना चारंभे कुसुमार्थिनी ॥ 7 ॥
3.3.m: When morning arrived, the daughter of a florist, / indeed named Puṣpā, drew near at the beginning [of the day], seeking flowers.

3.3.s:
kṛṣṇāṃśastu tadā pūjāṃ kṛtvā devamayo mudā ..
jagāma vipinaṃ ramyaṃ vasaṃte puṣpanālike .. 8 ..
3.3.d:
कृष्णांशस्तु तदा पूजां कृत्वा देवमयो मुदा ॥
जगाम विपिनं रम्यं वसंते पुष्पनालिके ॥ 8 ॥
3.3.m: Then Kṛṣṇāṃśa, full of divine nature, having performed worship with joy, / went into the delightful forest, in spring, when the flowers were blooming on their stalks.

3.3.s:
bahvāścaryayutaṃ puṣpa mattabhramaranāditam ..
dṛṣṭvā mumoha kṛṣṇāṃśastadarthe svayamudyataḥ .. 9 ..
3.3.d:
बह्वाश्चर्ययुतं पुष्प मत्तभ्रमरनादितम् ॥
दृष्ट्वा मुमोह कृष्णांशस्तदर्थे स्वयमुद्यतः ॥ 9 ॥
3.3.m: Seeing a flower endowed with much wonder, made resonant by intoxicated black bees, / Kṛṣṇāṃśa was enchanted and set about obtaining it himself.

3.3.s:
etasminnaṃtare puṣpā puṣpārthaṃ samupāgatā ..
dadarśa devasadṛśaṃ ṣoḍaśābdamayaṃ naram ..
prasannavadanaṃ śāntamiṃdranīlamaṇidyutim ..3.3.21.10..
3.3.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे पुष्पा पुष्पार्थं समुपागता ॥
ददर्श देवसदृशं षोडशाब्दमयं नरम् ॥
प्रसन्नवदनं शान्तमिंद्रनीलमणिद्युतिम् ॥3.3.21.10॥
3.3.m: In the meantime, Puṣpā arrived for the sake of flowers. / She beheld a man who resembled a god, sixteen years of age, / with a smiling face, calm, having the brilliance of a sapphire gem.

3.3.s:
kṛṣṇāṃśastu śubhāṃ nārīṃ dṛṣṭvāścaryamupāgataḥ ..
papraccha vacasā tāṃ vai kasyeyaṃ surasuṃdarī ..
svargalokādihāyātā yadi vā pannagī svayam .. 11 ..
3.3.d:
कृष्णांशस्तु शुभां नारीं दृष्ट्वाश्चर्यमुपागतः ॥
पप्रच्छ वचसा तां वै कस्येयं सुरसुंदरी ॥
स्वर्गलोकादिहायाता यदि वा पन्नगी स्वयम् ॥ 11 ॥
3.3.m: Kṛṣṇāṃśa, seeing the auspicious woman, was filled with wonder. / He indeed asked her with his voice: “Whose heavenly beauty is this? / Has she come here from the celestial world, or is she an innate serpent-maiden?”

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā ca sā prāha mālākārasya vai sutā ..
ahaṃ śūdrī mahābāho puṣpārthaṃ samupāgatā .. 12 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा च सा प्राह मालाकारस्य वै सुता ॥
अहं शूद्री महाबाहो पुष्पार्थं समुपागता ॥ 12 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing this, she, the florist's daughter, said: / “I am a Śūdra woman, O mighty-armed one, who have come for flowers.

3.3.s:
puṣpeṇānena bhūpāla tulitā bhūpateḥ sutā ..
nāmnā puṣpavatī devī rādheva saguṇāvalī .. 13 ..
3.3.d:
पुष्पेणानेन भूपाल तुलिता भूपतेः सुता ॥
नाम्ना पुष्पवती देवी राधेव सगुणावली ॥ 13 ॥
3.3.m: By this flower, O protector of the earth, is weighed the daughter of the king, / named the lady Puṣpavatī, who possesses a multitude of virtues like Rādhā.

3.3.s:
devaiśca prārthitā bālā rūpayauvanaśālinī ..
makaraṃdabhayāddevāstasyā yogyā na vai balāt .. 14 ..
3.3.d:
देवैश्च प्रार्थिता बाला रूपयौवनशालिनी ॥
मकरंदभयाद्देवास्तस्या योग्या न वै बलात् ॥ 14 ॥
3.3.m: The maiden, endowed with beauty and youth, has been sought by the gods; / but through fear of Makaranda, the gods cannot match her by force.

3.3.s:
śṛṇu tatkāraṇaṃ bhūpa makaraṃdo yathā bhavet ..
mayūradhvajabhūpena saṃprāpto guhato varaḥ .. 15 ..
3.3.d:
शृणु तत्कारणं भूप मकरंदो यथा भवेत् ॥
मयूरध्वजभूपेन संप्राप्तो गुहतो वरः ॥ 15 ॥
3.3.m: Hear the reason for that, O king, of how Makaranda came to be. / A boon was obtained from Guha by King Mayūradhvaja:

3.3.s:
ajeyo'nyaiśca kṛṣṇāṃśādṛte tvaṃ jagatītale ..
tanmitraṃ pṛthivīrājo rājarājaḥ śivapriyaḥ .. 16 ..
3.3.d:
अजेयोऽन्यैश्च कृष्णांशादृते त्वं जगतीतले ॥
तन्मित्रं पृथिवीराजो राजराजः शिवप्रियः ॥ 16 ॥
3.3.m: ‘You are invincible on the face of the earth by others, except Kṛṣṇāṃśa.’ / His friend was Pṛthivīrāja, a king of kings, beloved of Śiva.

3.3.s:
sa rājyaṃ kārayāmāsa dharmameghaṃ haripriyam ..
tadā prasanno bhagavānyajñeśo yajñamūrtimān..17..
3.3.d:
स राज्यं कारयामास धर्ममेघं हरिप्रियम् ॥
तदा प्रसन्नो भगवान्यज्ञेशो यज्ञमूर्तिमान्॥17॥
3.3.m: He ruled a kingdom that was a cloud of dharma, beloved of Hari. / Then the blessed Lord of Sacrifice, the embodiment of sacrifice, was pleased,

3.3.s:
mithunaṃ janayāmāsa pāvakātsuṃdarānanam ..
makaraṃdaḥ suto jñeyaḥ kanyā puṣpavatī matā .. 18 ..
3.3.d:
मिथुनं जनयामास पावकात्सुंदराननम् ॥
मकरंदः सुतो ज्ञेयः कन्या पुष्पवती मता ॥ 18 ॥
3.3.m: and brought forth from the fire a pair of beautiful faces: / the son should be known as Makaranda, and the maiden is considered Puṣpavatī.

3.3.s:
pañcamābdavayā bhūtvā makaraṃdo mahābalaḥ ..
tuṣṭāva tapasā dharmaṃ vedadharmaparāyaṇaḥ .. 19 ..
3.3.d:
पञ्चमाब्दवया भूत्वा मकरंदो महाबलः ॥
तुष्टाव तपसा धर्मं वेदधर्मपरायणः ॥ 19 ॥
3.3.m: Having reached the age of five years, the mighty Makaranda, / devoted to the Vedic dharma, praised Dharma through asceticism.

3.3.s:
dvādaśābdavayaḥ prāpte makaraṃde nṛpapriye ..
prasanno bhagavāndharmo dadau tasmai mahāhayam .. 3.3.21.20 ..
3.3.d:
द्वादशाब्दवयः प्राप्ते मकरंदे नृपप्रिये ॥
प्रसन्नो भगवान्धर्मो ददौ तस्मै महाहयम् ॥ 3.3.21.20 ॥
3.3.m: When Makaranda, dear to the king, reached twelve years of age, / the blessed Dharma was pleased and gave him a great horse,

3.3.s:
śilāmayaṃ mahāvegaṃ śatrusenākṣayaṃkaram ..
tamaśvaṃ svayamāruhya sarvapūjyo hyabhūtsukhī ..21..
3.3.d:
शिलामयं महावेगं शत्रुसेनाक्षयंकरम् ॥
तमश्वं स्वयमारुह्य सर्वपूज्यो ह्यभूत्सुखी ॥21॥
3.3.m: made of stone, possessing great speed, causing the destruction of enemy armies. / Having mounted that horse himself, he became worshipped by all and happy.

3.3.s:
tasyedaṃ suṃdaraṃ divyaṃ vipinaṃ surapūjitam ..
bhavānarhati vai śreṣṭhaḥ puṣpavatyāḥ kalevaram .. 22 ..
3.3.d:
तस्येदं सुंदरं दिव्यं विपिनं सुरपूजितम् ॥
भवानर्हति वै श्रेष्ठः पुष्पवत्याः कलेवरम् ॥ 22 ॥
3.3.m: His is this beautiful, divine forest, worshipped by the gods. / You, the most excellent one, indeed deserve the person of Puṣpavatī.”

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā tu vacanaṃ kṛṣṇāṃśaḥ smarapīḍitaḥ ..
dadau bahudhanaṃ tasyai mālinyā gehamāgataḥ .. 23 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा तु वचनं कृष्णांशः स्मरपीडितः ॥
ददौ बहुधनं तस्यै मालिन्या गेहमागतः ॥ 23 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing her words, Kṛṣṇāṃśa, tormented by love, / gave her much wealth and went to the house of the florist woman.

3.3.s:
devasiṃhastu kālajño jñātvā mohatvamāgatam ..
kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ bodhayāmāsa padyaiḥ sāṃkhyasamudbhavaiḥ ..24 ..
3.3.d:
देवसिंहस्तु कालज्ञो ज्ञात्वा मोहत्वमागतम् ॥
कृष्णांशं बोधयामास पद्यैः सांख्यसमुद्भवैः ॥24 ॥
3.3.m: Devasiṃha, who knew the right time, recognizing that delusion had come upon him, / enlightened Kṛṣṇāṃśa with verses originating from Sāṃkhya.

3.3.s:
kṛṣṇāṃśastu tatassārddhaṃ devasiṃhena tanmayaḥ ..
siṃdhudeśaṃ samāgatya krītvā sarvahayāṃstadā .. 25 ..
3.3.d:
कृष्णांशस्तु ततस्सार्द्धं देवसिंहेन तन्मयः ॥
सिंधुदेशं समागत्य क्रीत्वा सर्वहयांस्तदा ॥ 25 ॥
3.3.m: Then Kṛṣṇāṃśa, absorbed in her, together with Devasiṃha, / came to the country of Sindhu and then bought all the horses.

3.3.s:
māsānte gṛhamāgatya rājñe sarvānnyavedayat ..
puṣpavatyāḥ śubhaṃ rūpaṃ dhyātvā puṣperitaṃ balī ..
kṛṣṇāṃśo mohamāgatya tuṣṭāva jagadaṃbikām ..26..
3.3.d:
मासान्ते गृहमागत्य राज्ञे सर्वान्न्यवेदयत् ॥
पुष्पवत्याः शुभं रूपं ध्यात्वा पुष्पेरितं बली ॥
कृष्णांशो मोहमागत्य तुष्टाव जगदंबिकाम् ॥26॥
3.3.m: Having returned home at the end of the month, he presented them all to the king. / Meditating upon the auspicious form of Puṣpavatī described by Puṣpā, the mighty / Kṛṣṇāṃśa fell into delusion and praised the Mother of the World:

3.3.s:
kṛṣṇāṃśa uvāca ..
devamāye mahāmāye nityaśuddhasvarūpiṇi ..
pāhi māṃ kāmadevārtaṃ puṣpavatyai prabodhaya ..27..
3.3.d:
कृष्णांश उवाच ॥
देवमाये महामाये नित्यशुद्धस्वरूपिणि ॥
पाहि मां कामदेवार्तं पुष्पवत्यै प्रबोधय ॥27॥
3.3.m: Kṛṣṇāṃśa said: / “O Devamāyā, O Mahāmāyā, whose essential form is eternally pure, / protect me, afflicted by the god of love, [and] awaken [affection in] Puṣpavatī!

3.3.s:
madhukaiṭabhasaṃmohe mahiṣāsuraghātini ..
pāhi māṃ kāmadevārtaṃ puṣpavatya prabodhaya .. 28 ..
3.3.d:
मधुकैटभसंमोहे महिषासुरघातिनि ॥
पाहि मां कामदेवार्तं पुष्पवत्य प्रबोधय ॥ 28 ॥
3.3.m: O bewitcher of Madhu and Kaiṭabha, O slayer of Mahiṣāsura, / protect me, afflicted by the god of love, [and] awaken [affection in] Puṣpavatī!

3.3.s:
dhūmralocanasaṃdāhe caṃḍamuṃḍavināśini ..
pāhi māṃ kāmadevārttaṃ puṣpavatyai prabodhaya .. 29 ..
3.3.d:
धूम्रलोचनसंदाहे चंडमुंडविनाशिनि ॥
पाहि मां कामदेवार्त्तं पुष्पवत्यै प्रबोधय ॥ 29 ॥
3.3.m: O burner of Dhūmralocana, O destroyer of Caṇḍa and Muṇḍa, / protect me, afflicted by the god of love, [and] awaken [affection in] Puṣpavatī!

3.3.s:
raktabījāsṛkkapīte sarvadaityabhayaṃkare ..
pāhi māṃ kāmadevārttaṃ puṣpavatyai prabodhaya .. 3.3.21.30 .. .
3.3.d:
रक्तबीजासृक्कपीते सर्वदैत्यभयंकरे ॥
पाहि मां कामदेवार्त्तं पुष्पवत्यै प्रबोधय ॥ 3.3.21.30 ॥ ।
3.3.m: O drinker of the blood of Raktabīja, O terrifier of all demons, / protect me, afflicted by the god of love, [and] awaken [affection in] Puṣpavatī!

3.3.s:
niśuṃbhadaityasaṃhāre śuṃbhadaityavināśini ..
pāhi māṃ kāmadevārttaṃ puṣpavatyai prabodhaya .. 31 ..
3.3.d:
निशुंभदैत्यसंहारे शुंभदैत्यविनाशिनि ॥
पाहि मां कामदेवार्त्तं पुष्पवत्यै प्रबोधय ॥ 31 ॥
3.3.m: O destroyer of the demon Niśumbha, O slayer of the demon Śumbha, / protect me, afflicted by the god of love, [and] awaken [affection in] Puṣpavatī!”

3.3.s:
iti stutvā ca suṣvāpa sa vīraḥ paramāsane ..
tadā tu śāradā devī tasyāḥ svapnapradarśanam ..
cakāra pratyahaṃ devī varadābhayakāriṇī .. 32 ..
3.3.d:
इति स्तुत्वा च सुष्वाप स वीरः परमासने ॥
तदा तु शारदा देवी तस्याः स्वप्नप्रदर्शनम् ॥
चकार प्रत्यहं देवी वरदाभयकारिणी ॥ 32 ॥
3.3.m: Having thus praised her, that hero fell asleep on an excellent couch. / Then the goddess Śāradā, bestowing boons and granting fearlessness, / showed visions in dreams to her every day.

3.3.s:
evaṃ gate caturmāse jalavṛṣṭikare mune ..
triviṃśābdavayaścāsītkṛṣṇāṃśasya yaśaskaram .. 33 ..
3.3.d:
एवं गते चतुर्मासे जलवृष्टिकरे मुने ॥
त्रिविंशाब्दवयश्चासीत्कृष्णांशस्य यशस्करम् ॥ 33 ॥
3.3.m: When four months had thus passed bringing downpours of rain, O sage, / the renowned age of Kṛṣṇāṃśa became twenty-three years.

3.3.s:
kārtike kṛṣṇapakṣe tu gato'sau devasaṃyutaḥ ..
mayūranagare ramye makaraṃdena rakṣite .. 34 ..
3.3.d:
कार्तिके कृष्णपक्षे तु गतोऽसौ देवसंयुतः ॥
मयूरनगरे रम्ये मकरंदेन रक्षिते ॥ 34 ॥
3.3.m: In the month of Kārtika, during the dark fortnight, accompanied by Devasiṃha, / he went to the delightful city of Mayūranagara, protected by Makaranda.

3.3.s: puṣpāgṛhamupāgamya tatra vāsamacīkarat .. 35 ..
3.3.d: पुष्पागृहमुपागम्य तत्र वासमचीकरत् ॥ 35 ॥
3.3.m: Approaching Puṣpā’s house, he took up residence there.

3.3.s:
ekadā suṃdaraṃ hāra kṛṣṇāṃśenaiva guṃṭhitam ..
maṇimuktāyutaṃ ramyaṃ nānāpuṣpasamanvitam ..
gṛhītvā prayayau puṣpā puṣpavatyāśca maṃdire .. 36 ..
3.3.d:
एकदा सुंदरं हार कृष्णांशेनैव गुंठितम् ॥
मणिमुक्तायुतं रम्यं नानापुष्पसमन्वितम् ॥
गृहीत्वा प्रययौ पुष्पा पुष्पवत्याश्च मंदिरे ॥ 36 ॥
3.3.m: One day, taking a beautiful garland woven by Kṛṣṇāṃśa himself, / delightful, endowed with jewels and pearls, and furnished with various flowers, / Puṣpā went to the palace of Puṣpavatī.

3.3.s:
sā tu graiveyakaṃ dṛṣṭvā tvaṣṭreva racitaṃ priyam ..
hṛdi kṛtvā mumohāśu kāminī ratirūpiṇi .. 37 ..
3.3.d:
सा तु ग्रैवेयकं दृष्ट्वा त्वष्ट्रेव रचितं प्रियम् ॥
हृदि कृत्वा मुमोहाशु कामिनी रतिरूपिणि ॥ 37 ॥
3.3.m: Seeing that lovely necklace as if fashioned by Tvaṣṭṛ, / placing it on her chest, that passionate woman, possessing the form of Rati, was at once enchanted.

3.3.s:
aye sakhi mahāmāye satyaṃ kathaya me'grataḥ ..
graiveyakamidaṃ ramyaṃ kutaḥ prāptaṃ mama priyam .. 38 ..
3.3.d:
अये सखि महामाये सत्यं कथय मेऽग्रतः ॥
ग्रैवेयकमिदं रम्यं कुतः प्राप्तं मम प्रियम् ॥ 38 ॥
3.3.m: “Ah, friend, O Mahāmāyā, tell me the truth before me: / from where was this delightful necklace obtained, which is so dear to me?”

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā vacastasyā makaraṃdabhayāturā ..
puṣpā puṣpāṃjaliṃ kṛtvā vacanaṃ prāha tāṃ prati .. 39 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा वचस्तस्या मकरंदभयातुरा ॥
पुष्पा पुष्पांजलिं कृत्वा वचनं प्राह तां प्रति ॥ 39 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing her words, distressed by fear of Makaranda, / Puṣpā folded her hands in a hollow with flowers and addressed these words to her:

3.3.s:
jīvadānaṃ ca me dehi tarhi te kathayāmyaham ..
tathetyuktavatīṃ kanyāṃ sāha me bhaginī śubhe .. 3.3.21.40 ..
3.3.d:
जीवदानं च मे देहि तर्हि ते कथयाम्यहम् ॥
तथेत्युक्तवतीं कन्यां साह मे भगिनी शुभे ॥ 3.3.21.40 ॥
3.3.m: “Grant me the gift of my life, then I will tell you.” / To the maiden who said ‘So be it,’ she said, ‘O auspicious sister:

3.3.s:
kṛṣṇā nāma mahāramyā sarvalokavimohinī ..
mahāvatyāṃ gṛhaṃ tasyā madgṛhe sā samāgatā ..
tayā viracitaṃ subhūrgraiveyakamanuttamam .. 41 ..
3.3.d:
कृष्णा नाम महारम्या सर्वलोकविमोहिनी ॥
महावत्यां गृहं तस्या मद्गृहे सा समागता ॥
तया विरचितं सुभूर्ग्रैवेयकमनुत्तमम् ॥ 41 ॥
3.3.m: Named Kṛṣṇā, she is exceedingly beautiful, enchanting the whole world. / Her home is in Mahāvatī; she has arrived at my house. / O fair-browed one, that supreme necklace was fashioned by her.

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā tu vacanaṃ devī puṣpavatī svayam ..
uvāca mālinīṃ vākyaṃ rātriṃ darśaya tāṃ mama .. 42 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा तु वचनं देवी पुष्पवती स्वयम् ॥
उवाच मालिनीं वाक्यं रात्रिं दर्शय तां मम ॥ 42 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing these words, the princess Puṣpavatī herself / said to the florist woman: "Show her to me tonight."

3.3.s:
makaraṃdabhayāddevāstathānye puruṣā bhuvi ..
matsamīpe gatirnāsti teṣāṃ satyaṃ bravīmyaham .. 43 ..
3.3.d:
मकरंदभयाद्देवास्तथान्ये पुरुषा भुवि ॥
मत्समीपे गतिर्नास्ति तेषां सत्यं ब्रवीम्यहम् ॥ 43 ॥
3.3.m: "Out of fear of Makaranda, gods and other men on earth / have no access to my presence; I speak the truth to you."

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā vaco ghoraṃ puṣpā tu bhayakātarā ..
novāca vacanaṃ kiñcitpṛcchyamānā punaḥ punaḥ .. 44 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा वचो घोरं पुष्पा तु भयकातरा ॥
नोवाच वचनं किञ्चित्पृच्छ्यमाना पुनः पुनः ॥ 44 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing these terrible words, Puṣpā, trembling with fear, / said nothing at all, though questioned again and again.

3.3.s:
tadā puṣpavatī prāha kiṃ te bhayamupāgatam ..
sāha me bhaginī ramyā yadi tvadgehamāgatā .. 45 ..
3.3.d:
तदा पुष्पवती प्राह किं ते भयमुपागतम् ॥
साह मे भगिनी रम्या यदि त्वद्गेहमागता ॥ 45 ॥
3.3.m: Then Puṣpavatī said: "What fear has come upon you? / She is my delightful sister, if she has come to your house.

3.3.s:
mohitaḥ puruṣaḥ kaścidbalāttāṃ hi bhajiṣyati ..
tarhi me maraṇaṃ jñeyaṃ kuladharmaparāyaṇe .. 46 ..
3.3.d:
मोहितः पुरुषः कश्चिद्बलात्तां हि भजिष्यति ॥
तर्हि मे मरणं ज्ञेयं कुलधर्मपरायणे ॥ 46 ॥
3.3.m: If some bewitched man should forcibly possess her, / then know that it means my death, O woman devoted to the virtue of your family."

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā puṣpavatī punaḥ provāca dharmiṇī ..
mayūradhvaja evāpi matpitā nītitatparaḥ ..
ayogyaṃ ye kariṣyaṃti te yāsyaṃti yamālayam .. 47 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा पुष्पवती पुनः प्रोवाच धर्मिणी ॥
मयूरध्वज एवापि मत्पिता नीतितत्परः ॥
अयोग्यं ये करिष्यंति ते यास्यंति यमालयम् ॥ 47 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing this, the righteous Puṣpavatī spoke again: / "My father is Mayūradhvaja himself, devoted to statecraft. / Those who do what is improper will go to the abode of Yama.

3.3.s:
atastvaṃ śīghramādāya taddolāṃ ca madaṃtike ..
darśayitvā ca tāṃ ramyāṃ punargaccha gṛhaṃ svakam .. 48 ..
3.3.d:
अतस्त्वं शीघ्रमादाय तद्दोलां च मदंतिके ॥
दर्शयित्वा च तां रम्यां पुनर्गच्छ गृहं स्वकम् ॥ 48 ॥
3.3.m: Therefore, quickly bringing her litter into my presence / and showing me that lovely woman, go back to your own home."

3.3.s:
tatheti matvā sā śūdrī gṛhamāgatya bhāminī ..
kṛṣṇāśaṃ varṇayāmāsa yathā proktaṃ tayā mune .. 49 ..
3.3.d:
तथेति मत्वा सा शूद्री गृहमागत्य भामिनी ॥
कृष्णाशं वर्णयामास यथा प्रोक्तं तया मुने ॥ 49 ॥
3.3.m: Consenting with "So be it," that lovely Śūdra woman returned home / and described everything to Kṛṣṇāṃśa just as she had spoken, O sage.

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā vaco ramyaṃ kṛṣṇāṃśo balavattaraḥ ..
nāsāvedhaṃ svayaṃ kṛtvā punarnārīmayaṃ vapuḥ ..
jagāma puṣpayā sārddhaṃ dolāmāruhya vīryavān .. 3.3.21.50 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा वचो रम्यं कृष्णांशो बलवत्तरः ॥
नासावेधं स्वयं कृत्वा पुनर्नारीमयं वपुः ॥
जगाम पुष्पया सार्द्धं दोलामारुह्य वीर्यवान् ॥ 3.3.21.50 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing these delightful words, the mighty Kṛṣṇāṃśa, / having pierced his own nose, assumed once more the form of a woman, / and that valiant hero, mounting the litter, set out together with Puṣpā.

3.3.s:
tadā puṣpavatī devī dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇāṃ manoramām ..
uvāca vacanaṃ puṣpāṃ śṛṇu me vacanaṃ sakhi .. 51 ..
3.3.d:
तदा पुष्पवती देवी दृष्ट्वा कृष्णां मनोरमाम् ॥
उवाच वचनं पुष्पां शृणु मे वचनं सखि ॥ 51 ॥
3.3.m: Then the princess Puṣpavatī, seeing the charming Kṛṣṇā, / addressed words to Puṣpā: "Listen to my words, friend.

3.3.s:
yādṛśīyaṃ śubhā nārī tādṛśaḥ puruṣo mayā ..
svapnāṃte pratyahaṃ dṛṣṭo ramamāṇo mayā saha .. 52 ..
3.3.d:
यादृशीयं शुभा नारी तादृशः पुरुषो मया ॥
स्वप्नांते प्रत्यहं दृष्टो रममाणो मया सह ॥ 52 ॥
3.3.m: Just as this auspicious woman is, exactly such a man / I have seen every day at the end of my dreams, making love with me."

3.3.s:
kṛṣṇāṃśaśca sa tāmāha deśarājasuto varaḥ ..
udayo nāma vikhyātastasyāhaṃ lalitā sakhī .. 53 ..
3.3.d:
कृष्णांशश्च स तामाह देशराजसुतो वरः ॥
उदयो नाम विख्यातस्तस्याहं ललिता सखी ॥ 53 ॥
3.3.m: And Kṛṣṇāṃśa said to her: "There is an excellent son of Deśarāja, / renowned by the name of Udaya; I am his playful female friend.

3.3.s:
pratyahaṃ racitaṃ hāramatha pūjanahetave ..
sa vīrastu gṛhītvā taṃ devīṃ pūjya nyavedayat .. 54 ..
3.3.d:
प्रत्यहं रचितं हारमथ पूजनहेतवे ॥
स वीरस्तु गृहीत्वा तं देवीं पूज्य न्यवेदयत् ॥ 54 ॥
3.3.m: Every day a garland is fashioned for the purpose of worship; / taking it, that hero would worship the goddess and offer it.

3.3.s:
ekadā prasthitaṃ vīraṃ puṣpamadhye śanaiḥśanaiḥ ..
udāsīnaṃ ca taṃ dṛṣṭvā provācāhaṃ samāgatā .. 55 ..
3.3.d:
एकदा प्रस्थितं वीरं पुष्पमध्ये शनैःशनैः ॥
उदासीनं च तं दृष्ट्वा प्रोवाचाहं समागता ॥ 55 ॥
3.3.m: Once, as that hero was slowly strolling amidst the flowers, / seeing him dejected, I approached and said:

3.3.s:
moho'yaṃ te kutaḥ prāptaḥ sa tvaṃ kathaya mā ciram ..
ityuktaḥ sa tu māmāha svapnāṃte pratyahaṃ sakhi .. 56 ..
3.3.d:
मोहोऽयं ते कुतः प्राप्तः स त्वं कथय मा चिरम् ॥
इत्युक्तः स तु मामाह स्वप्नांते प्रत्यहं सखि ॥ 56 ॥
3.3.m: 'Whence has this lovesickness come upon you? Tell me without delay.' / Thus addressed, he said to me: 'Every day at the end of my dreams, O friend,

3.3.s:
mayā dṛṣṭā śubhā nārī rūpayauvanaśālinī ..
tadviyogena duḥkhārtaṃ mukhaṃ mlānatvamāgatam .. 57 ..
3.3.d:
मया दृष्टा शुभा नारी रूपयौवनशालिनी ॥
तद्वियोगेन दुःखार्तं मुखं म्लानत्वमागतम् ॥ 57 ॥
3.3.m: I have seen an auspicious woman endowed with beauty and youth. / Afflicted with grief by separation from her, my face has become withered.'"

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā puṣpavatī tāmāha rucirānanām ..
vivāho me yadā tena sārddhaṃ ramyo bhaviṣyati .. .. 58 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा पुष्पवती तामाह रुचिराननाम् ॥
विवाहो मे यदा तेन सार्द्धं रम्यो भविष्यति ॥ ॥ 58 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing this, Puṣpavatī said to her of the lovely face: / "When my delightful marriage with him takes place,

3.3.s:
tadā tvāṃ tarpayiṣyāmi bahudravyaiḥ śubhānane ..
atastvaṃ gaccha tatpārśvaṃ śīghraṃ tasmai nivedaya .. 59 ..
3.3.d:
तदा त्वां तर्पयिष्यामि बहुद्रव्यैः शुभानने ॥
अतस्त्वं गच्छ तत्पार्श्वं शीघ्रं तस्मै निवेदय ॥ 59 ॥
3.3.m: then I will gratify you with many riches, O fair-faced woman! / Therefore, go to his side and quickly report this to him."

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā tu tadvācaṃ puṣpā premasamanvitā ..
dolāmāropya tāṃ kṛṣṇāṃ svagehaṃ gaṃtumuyatā .. 3.3.21.60 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा तु तद्वाचं पुष्पा प्रेमसमन्विता ॥
दोलामारोप्य तां कृष्णां स्वगेहं गंतुमुयता ॥ 3.3.21.60 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing her words, Puṣpā, filled with affection, / placed Kṛṣṇā in the litter and prepared to return to her own home.

3.3.s:
durgadvāre tu prāptāyāṃ taddolāyāṃ ca bhārgava ..
makaraṃdo mahāvīryyo dvādaśābdavayā balī .. 61 ..
3.3.d:
दुर्गद्वारे तु प्राप्तायां तद्दोलायां च भार्गव ॥
मकरंदो महावीर्य्यो द्वादशाब्दवया बली ॥ 61 ॥
3.3.m: When that litter reached the gate of the fortress, O descendant of Bhṛgu, / the mighty and heroic Makaranda, twelve years of age,

3.3.s:
dolāsamīpamāgatya dadarśa rucirānanām ..
kṛṣṇāmindīvaraśyāmāṃ cārunetrāṃ manoharām .. 62 ..
3.3.d:
दोलासमीपमागत्य ददर्श रुचिराननाम् ॥
कृष्णामिन्दीवरश्यामां चारुनेत्रां मनोहराम् ॥ 62 ॥
3.3.m: approached the litter and saw her of the lovely face, / Kṛṣṇā, dark as a blue lotus, with beautiful eyes and enchanting form.

3.3.s:
mumoha balavānvīro govarddhana kalāṃśakaḥ .. govardhana
premṇovāca sa cārvaṃgi śṛṇu me vacanaṃ priye .. 63 ..
3.3.d:
मुमोह बलवान्वीरो गोवर्द्धन कलांशकः ॥ गोवर्धन
प्रेम्णोवाच स चार्वंगि शृणु मे वचनं प्रिये ॥ 63 ॥
3.3.m: That powerful hero, a partial incarnation of Govardhana, was infatuated. / He spoke with love: "O fair-limbed woman, hear my words, my dear!

3.3.s:
madgṛhaṃ śīghramāgaccha patnī mama bhavādhunā ..
iti śrutvā tu sā kṛṣṇā vihasyo vāca bhūpatim .. 64 ..
3.3.d:
मद्गृहं शीघ्रमागच्छ पत्नी मम भवाधुना ॥
इति श्रुत्वा तु सा कृष्णा विहस्यो वाच भूपतिम् ॥ 64 ॥
3.3.m: Come quickly to my palace; become my wife now." / Hearing this, Kṛṣṇā laughed and said to the king's son:

3.3.s:
kulīnastvaṃ mahāvīra vahnikuṇḍātsamudbhavaḥ ..
ṣoḍaśābdavayāstūṇī śanibhallasamanvitaḥ .. 65 ..
3.3.d:
कुलीनस्त्वं महावीर वह्निकुण्डात्समुद्भवः ॥
षोडशाब्दवयास्तूणी शनिभल्लसमन्वितः ॥ 65 ॥
3.3.m: "You are of noble birth, a great hero, born from the sacrificial fire-pit, / sixteen years of age, carrying a quiver and equipped with a Saturn-lance.

3.3.s:
tvadyogyā bhūpateḥ kanyā caṃdrasūryyānvayasya vai ..
ahaṃ śūdrī hīnatamā kathaṃ yogyā taveha vai .. 66 ..
3.3.d:
त्वद्योग्या भूपतेः कन्या चंद्रसूर्य्यान्वयस्य वै ॥
अहं शूद्री हीनतमा कथं योग्या तवेह वै ॥ 66 ॥
3.3.m: A king's daughter of the Lunar or Solar dynasty is truly worthy of you. / I am a low-born Śūdra woman; how am I fit for you here?

3.3.s:
kanyāhaṃ śūdrajāteśca bahmacaryyavrate sthitā ..
iti śrutvā tu vacanaṃ makarando nṛpātmajaḥ .. 67 ..
3.3.d:
कन्याहं शूद्रजातेश्च बह्मचर्य्यव्रते स्थिता ॥
इति श्रुत्वा तु वचनं मकरन्दो नृपात्मजः ॥ 67 ॥
3.3.m: I am a maiden of the Śūdra caste, established in the vow of celibacy." / Hearing these words, Makaranda, the king's son,

3.3.s:
balādgṛhītvā tāṃ nārīṃ pasparśa hṛdaye svayam ..
kṛṣṇāṃśastu tadā tasmai dattvā hṛdayavedanām ..
mohayitvā nṛpasutaṃ sa devaḥ svagṛhaṃ yayau .. 68 ..
3.3.d:
बलाद्गृहीत्वा तां नारीं पस्पर्श हृदये स्वयम् ॥
कृष्णांशस्तु तदा तस्मै दत्त्वा हृदयवेदनाम् ॥
मोहयित्वा नृपसुतं स देवः स्वगृहं ययौ ॥ 68 ॥
3.3.m: seized that woman by force and touched her heart himself. / Kṛṣṇāṃśa then, inflicting pain in his chest / and bewitching the king's son, that god departed to his own home.

3.3.s:
makarandastu saṃbuddho madanāgniprapīḍitaḥ ..
gehamāgatya puṣpāyāḥ sarvaṃ tasyai nyavedayat .. 69 ..
3.3.d:
मकरन्दस्तु संबुद्धो मदनाग्निप्रपीडितः ॥
गेहमागत्य पुष्पायाः सर्वं तस्यै न्यवेदयत् ॥ 69 ॥
3.3.m: When Makaranda regained consciousness, tormented by the fire of love, / he came to Puṣpā's house and related everything to her.

3.3.s:
tatsnehakātaraṃ bhūpaṃ makaraṃdaṃ mahābalam..
puṣpāha ślakṣṇayā vācā śṛṇu pārthivasattama .. 3.3.21.70 ..
3.3.d:
तत्स्नेहकातरं भूपं मकरंदं महाबलम्॥
पुष्पाह श्लक्ष्णया वाचा शृणु पार्थिवसत्तम ॥ 3.3.21.70 ॥
3.3.m: To that king, the mighty Makaranda, who was agitated with love for her, / Puṣpā said in gentle words: "Listen, O best of kings!

3.3.s:
mahāvatī purī ramyā tatra kṛṣṇāgṛhaṃ śubham ..
tvadbhayācca gatā gehaṃ kṛṣṇāṃśasya ca sā sakhī .. 71 ..
3.3.d:
महावती पुरी रम्या तत्र कृष्णागृहं शुभम् ॥
त्वद्भयाच्च गता गेहं कृष्णांशस्य च सा सखी ॥ 71 ॥
3.3.m: Mahāvatī is a delightful city; Kṛṣṇā's auspicious home is there. / Out of fear of you, that friend has gone to the home of Kṛṣṇāṃśa,

3.3.s: rodanaṃ kurvatī gāḍhaṃ tava nindanatatparā .. 72 ..
3.3.d: रोदनं कुर्वती गाढं तव निन्दनतत्परा ॥ 72 ॥
3.3.m: weeping bitterly and intent on denouncing you.

3.3.s:
āgamiṣyati vai vīro balaissārddhaṃ mahābala ..
atastvaṃ sarvasainyāni sajjībhūtāni vai kuru .. 73 ..
3.3.d:
आगमिष्यति वै वीरो बलैस्सार्द्धं महाबल ॥
अतस्त्वं सर्वसैन्यानि सज्जीभूतानि वै कुरु ॥ 73 ॥
3.3.m: That hero will surely arrive with his forces, O mighty one; / therefore, prepare all your armies.

3.3.s:
jito yena mahāvīraḥ pitṛvyo laharastava ..
vivāhaṃ kārayāmāsa tadbandhoḥ sutayā saha .. 74 ..
3.3.d:
जितो येन महावीरः पितृव्यो लहरस्तव ॥
विवाहं कारयामास तद्बन्धोः सुतया सह ॥ 74 ॥
3.3.m: He defeated your uncle, the great hero Lahara, / and brought about a marriage with the daughter of his relative."

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā vaco ghoraṃ makarando mahīpatiḥ ..
śataghnīḥ sthāpayāmāsa durgakūṭeṣu dāruṇāḥ .. 75 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा वचो घोरं मकरन्दो महीपतिः ॥
शतघ्नीः स्थापयामास दुर्गकूटेषु दारुणाः ॥ 75 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing these dreadful words, King Makaranda / stationed frightful cannon upon the summits of the fortress.

3.3.s:
svasainyaṃ ca samāhūya trilakṣaṃ khaḍgasaṃyutam ..
tatraiva sthāpayāmāsa rāṣṭrarakṣārthamudyataḥ .. 76 ..
3.3.d:
स्वसैन्यं च समाहूय त्रिलक्षं खड्गसंयुतम् ॥
तत्रैव स्थापयामास राष्ट्ररक्षार्थमुद्यतः ॥ 76 ॥
3.3.m: Summoning his own army of three hundred thousand equipped with swords, / he stationed it right there, resolved to protect his realm.

3.3.s:
kṛṣṇāṃśastu gṛhaṃ prāpya balakhānimuvāca tat ..
śrutvā sa ca mahāvīro bhrātṛmitrasamanvitaḥ ..
pañcalakṣabalaissārddhaṃ mayūranagaraṃ yayau .. 77 ..
3.3.d:
कृष्णांशस्तु गृहं प्राप्य बलखानिमुवाच तत् ॥
श्रुत्वा स च महावीरो भ्रातृमित्रसमन्वितः ॥
पञ्चलक्षबलैस्सार्द्धं मयूरनगरं ययौ ॥ 77 ॥
3.3.m: Kṛṣṇāṃśa, having reached home, told that to Balakhāni. / Hearing it, that great hero, accompanied by his brothers and allies, / set out for Mayūranagara along with a force of five hundred thousand:

3.3.s:
śataghnyaḥ pañcasāhasrā gajā daśa sahasrakāḥ ..
ekalakṣaṃ hayāḥ sarve śeṣā jñeyāḥ padātayaḥ ..
uṣitvā pakṣamātraṃ tu mārge pāṃcālake tadā .. 78 ..
3.3.d:
शतघ्न्यः पञ्चसाहस्रा गजा दश सहस्रकाः ॥
एकलक्षं हयाः सर्वे शेषा ज्ञेयाः पदातयः ॥
उषित्वा पक्षमात्रं तु मार्गे पांचालके तदा ॥ 78 ॥
3.3.m: Five thousand cannon, ten thousand elephants, / one hundred thousand horses in all, and the rest were known as infantry. / Then, having encamped for just a fortnight on the road in the Pāñcāla country,

3.3.s:
makaraṃdastu tacchrutvā śanibhallakaraḥ sthitaḥ ..
senāmājñāpayāmāsa jahi śatrūnmahābalān .. 79 ..
3.3.d:
मकरंदस्तु तच्छ्रुत्वा शनिभल्लकरः स्थितः ॥
सेनामाज्ञापयामास जहि शत्रून्महाबलान् ॥ 79 ॥
3.3.m: Makaranda, hearing of this, stood with the Saturn-lance in his hand / and commanded his army: "Slay the mighty enemies!"

3.3.s:
śrutvā padātayo lakṣaṃ śataghnīvahnimādadan ..
te tu vai saptasāhasrāścakruḥ śatrubalakṣayam .. 3.3.21.80 ..
3.3.d:
श्रुत्वा पदातयो लक्षं शतघ्नीवह्निमाददन् ॥
ते तु वै सप्तसाहस्राश्चक्रुः शत्रुबलक्षयम् ॥ 3.3.21.80 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing this, one hundred thousand infantry set fire to the cannon; / those seven thousand indeed wrought the destruction of the enemy host.

3.3.s:
grāmasya dakṣiṇadvāre hayārūḍhāstadā yayuḥ ..
bhuśuṃḍīkṣepaṇīśaktikhaḍgayuddhaviśāradāḥ .. 81 ..
3.3.d:
ग्रामस्य दक्षिणद्वारे हयारूढास्तदा ययुः ॥
भुशुंडीक्षेपणीशक्तिखड्गयुद्धविशारदाः ॥ 81 ॥
3.3.m: Then, skilled in combat with muskets, slings, spears, and swords, / mounted on horses, they advanced to the southern gate of the town.

3.3.s:
ekalakṣaṃ hayāssarve makaraṃdasya bhūpateḥ ..
tayoścāsīnmahadyuddhaṃ tumulaṃ hayasenayoḥ .. 82 ..
3.3.d:
एकलक्षं हयास्सर्वे मकरंदस्य भूपतेः ॥
तयोश्चासीन्महद्युद्धं तुमुलं हयसेनयोः ॥ 82 ॥
3.3.m: All one hundred thousand horses belonged to King Makaranda; / and between those two cavalry forces there was a great and tumultuous battle.

3.3.s:
tadā tu paścimadvāre gajā viṃśatsahasrakāḥ ..
tathā daśasahasraiśca śatrubhiḥ saha saṃyayuḥ .. 83 ..
3.3.d:
तदा तु पश्चिमद्वारे गजा विंशत्सहस्रकाः ॥
तथा दशसहस्रैश्च शत्रुभिः सह संययुः ॥ 83 ॥
3.3.m: Then, at the western gate, twenty thousand elephants / marched out along with ten thousand enemies.

3.3.s:
uṣṭra rakṣā mahāvīrāścatvāriṃśatsahasrakāḥ ..
balakhānyādibhiḥ sārddhaṃ yuyudhurdiśi cottare .. 84 ..
3.3.d:
उष्ट्र रक्षा महावीराश्चत्वारिंशत्सहस्रकाः ॥
बलखान्यादिभिः सार्द्धं युयुधुर्दिशि चोत्तरे ॥ 84 ॥
3.3.m: Forty thousand great heroic camel-protectors / fought with Balakhāni and the others in the northern quarter.

3.3.s:
ahorātramabhūdyuddhaṃ tumulaṃ lomaharṣaṇam ..
tataḥ parājitāssarve balakhānermahābalāḥ .. 85 ..
3.3.d:
अहोरात्रमभूद्युद्धं तुमुलं लोमहर्षणम् ॥
ततः पराजितास्सर्वे बलखानेर्महाबलाः ॥ 85 ॥
3.3.m: There was a tumultuous battle lasting day and night, making the hair stand on end. / Then all the mighty warriors of Balakhāni were defeated.

3.3.s:
tyaktvā yuddhaṃ tu te sarve dudruvuśca diśo daśa ..
kṛṣṇāṃśo biṃdulārūḍho balakhāniḥ kapotagaḥ .. 86 ..
3.3.d:
त्यक्त्वा युद्धं तु ते सर्वे दुद्रुवुश्च दिशो दश ॥
कृष्णांशो बिंदुलारूढो बलखानिः कपोतगः ॥ 86 ॥
3.3.m: Abandoning the battle, they all fled in the ten directions. / Kṛṣṇāṃśa was mounted on Biṃdula, Balakhāni on a pigeon,

3.3.s:
manorathasthito devaścāhlādastu gajasthitaḥ..
pūrvādikramato dvāri gatāste raṇadurmadāḥ .. 87 ..
3.3.d:
मनोरथस्थितो देवश्चाह्लादस्तु गजस्थितः॥
पूर्वादिक्रमतो द्वारि गतास्ते रणदुर्मदाः ॥ 87 ॥
3.3.m: Deva was stationed in Manoratha, and Āhlāda on an elephant. / Frantic in battle, they went to the gates in order, beginning with the east.

3.3.s:
satsaruṃ khaḍgamutsṛjya cakruḥ śatrumahāvadham ..
parājitāśca te śūrā makaraṃdamupāyayuḥ .. 88 ..
3.3.d:
सत्सरुं खड्गमुत्सृज्य चक्रुः शत्रुमहावधम् ॥
पराजिताश्च ते शूरा मकरंदमुपाययुः ॥ 88 ॥
3.3.m: Drawing their hilted swords, they wrought great slaughter of the enemy. / Defeated, those heroes approached Makaraṃda.

3.3.s:
vahniputrastu balavānvājinaṃ ca śilāmayam..
śanibhallakaragrāhī tamāruhya raṇaṃ yayau .. 89 ..
3.3.d:
वह्निपुत्रस्तु बलवान्वाजिनं च शिलामयम्॥
शनिभल्लकरग्राही तमारुह्य रणं ययौ ॥ 89 ॥
3.3.m: The mighty son of fire, holding a spear of Śani in his hand, / mounted a stone horse and went into battle.

3.3.s:
kṛṣṇāṃśādyāśca te śūrā rurudhussarvatodiśam ..
taṃ ca kaṃṭhe dadau khaḍgaṃ balakhānirmahābalaḥ .. 3.3.21.90 ..
3.3.d:
कृष्णांशाद्याश्च ते शूरा रुरुधुस्सर्वतोदिशम् ॥
तं च कंठे ददौ खड्गं बलखानिर्महाबलः ॥ 3.3.21.90 ॥
3.3.m: Kṛṣṇāṃśa and those [other] heroes blocked him from every side. / And mighty Balakhāni struck him on the neck with a sword.

3.3.s:
svabhallaṃ devasiṃhaśca tamaṃke ca samāhanat ..
āhlādo vakṣasi śaraṃ kṛṣṇāṃśaḥ khaḍgamuttamam .. 91 ..
3.3.d:
स्वभल्लं देवसिंहश्च तमंके च समाहनत् ॥
आह्लादो वक्षसि शरं कृष्णांशः खड्गमुत्तमम् ॥ 91 ॥
3.3.m: Devasiṃha struck him on his lap with his spear; / Āhlāda [struck] an arrow into his chest, and Kṛṣṇāṃśa an excellent sword.

3.3.s:
śilāvājiprabhāveṇa kaśmalaṃ na jagāma ha ..
sa dṛṣṭvā niṣphalānvīrāñjagarja bhairavaṃ dhvanim .. 92 ..
3.3.d:
शिलावाजिप्रभावेण कश्मलं न जगाम ह ॥
स दृष्ट्वा निष्फलान्वीराञ्जगर्ज भैरवं ध्वनिम् ॥ 92 ॥
3.3.m: By the power of the stone horse, he did not faint. / Seeing the heroes' [efforts] in vain, he roared with a terrifying sound.

3.3.s:
śanibhallena te sarve babhūvurmūrchitā raṇe ..
te'śvāḥ śilāśvavegena mūrchitāścābhavankṣaṇāt .. 93 ..
3.3.d:
शनिभल्लेन ते सर्वे बभूवुर्मूर्छिता रणे ॥
तेऽश्वाः शिलाश्ववेगेन मूर्छिताश्चाभवन्क्षणात् ॥ 93 ॥
3.3.m: By means of the spear of Śani, they all fell senseless in battle. / Their horses, by the swiftness of the stone horse, became senseless in an instant.

3.3.s:
makaraṃdastu balavānbaddhvā tānyuddhadurmadān ..
prasannātmā yayau gehaṃ svapitre tānnyavedayat .. 94 ..
3.3.d:
मकरंदस्तु बलवान्बद्ध्वा तान्युद्धदुर्मदान् ॥
प्रसन्नात्मा ययौ गेहं स्वपित्रे तान्न्यवेदयत् ॥ 94 ॥
3.3.m: Mighty Makaraṃda, having bound those [warriors] furious in battle, / went home with a pleased mind and presented them to his father.

3.3.s:
dṛṣṭvā parājitānvīrānrūpaṇo bhayakātaraḥ ..
mahāvatīṃ purīṃ prāpya bhūpatiṃ samavarṇayat .. 95 ..
3.3.d:
दृष्ट्वा पराजितान्वीरान्रूपणो भयकातरः ॥
महावतीं पुरीं प्राप्य भूपतिं समवर्णयत् ॥ 95 ॥
3.3.m: Seeing the heroes defeated, Rūpaṇa, distressed with fear, / reached the city of Mahāvatī and recounted [it] to the king.

3.3.s:
brahmānaṃdastu tacchrutvā lakṣasainyasamanvitaḥ ..
iṃdulena sahāyena mayūranagaraṃ yayau .. 96 ..
3.3.d:
ब्रह्मानंदस्तु तच्छ्रुत्वा लक्षसैन्यसमन्वितः ॥
इंदुलेन सहायेन मयूरनगरं ययौ ॥ 96 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing that, Brahmānaṃda, accompanied by an army of one hundred thousand, / went with Iṃdula as his ally to Mayūranagara.

3.3.s:
likhitvā nirmalaṃ patraṃ tadrājñe tvarito dadau ..
bhūmirājasutākāṃta viddhi māṃ manujarṣabha .. 97 ..
3.3.d:
लिखित्वा निर्मलं पत्रं तद्राज्ञे त्वरितो ददौ ॥
भूमिराजसुताकांत विद्धि मां मनुजर्षभ ॥ 97 ॥
3.3.m: Writing a clear letter, he promptly gave it to that king: / 'O bull among men, know me as the lover of King Bhūmi's daughter!

3.3.s:
kṛṣṇāṃśāya sutāṃ dehi nāmnā puṣpavatīṃ śubhām ..
no cenmatkaṭhinairbāṇaiḥ kṣayaṃ yāsyaṃti sainikāḥ .. 98 ..
3.3.d:
कृष्णांशाय सुतां देहि नाम्ना पुष्पवतीं शुभाम् ॥
नो चेन्मत्कठिनैर्बाणैः क्षयं यास्यंति सैनिकाः ॥ 98 ॥
3.3.m: Give your auspicious daughter named Puṣpavatī to Kṛṣṇāṃśa; / otherwise, your soldiers will meet destruction by my fierce arrows!'

3.3.s:
niśamyeti nṛpaśreṣṭho mayūradhvaja eva saḥ ..
makaraṃdena sahito dvilakṣabalasaṃyutaḥ ..
ahorātraṃ kṛtaṃ yuddhaṃ tena sārddhaṃ bhayapradam .. 99 ..
3.3.d:
निशम्येति नृपश्रेष्ठो मयूरध्वज एव सः ॥
मकरंदेन सहितो द्विलक्षबलसंयुतः ॥
अहोरात्रं कृतं युद्धं तेन सार्द्धं भयप्रदम् ॥ 99 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing this, that best of kings, Mayūradhvaja himself, / joined with Makaraṃda and accompanied by a force of two hundred thousand, / waged a terrifying battle with him day and night.

3.3.s:
brahmānaṃdastu balavānbāṇayuddhamacīkarat ..
makaraṃdasya bhallena mūrchitaḥ so'patadbhuvi .. 3.3.21.100 ..
3.3.d:
ब्रह्मानंदस्तु बलवान्बाणयुद्धमचीकरत् ॥
मकरंदस्य भल्लेन मूर्छितः सोऽपतद्भुवि ॥ 3.3.21.100 ॥
3.3.m: Mighty Brahmānaṃda carried on a battle of arrows. / Pierced by Makaraṃda's spear, he fell senseless to the ground.

3.3.s:
tadā svarṇavatīputro jayantaḥ śakrasaṃbhavaḥ ..
svavidyāṃ darśayāmāsa makaraṃdāya dhīmate .. 101 ..
vaiṣṇavāstraprabhāvena śilāśvo bhasma cābhavat ..
brahmāstreṇa bhṛguśreṣṭha śanibhallo'patadbhuvi ..1 02..
nāgapāśena taṃ baddhvā makaraṃdaṃ mahābalam ..
vivāhaṃ kārayāmāsa kṛṣṇāṃśasya mahātmanaḥ ..1 03..
senāmujjīvayāmāsa svakīyāmiṃdulo balī ..
maṃgalaṃ kārayāmāsa makaraṃdo gṛhegṛhe ..
dadau kanyāṃ vidhānena bahudravyasamanvitām ..1 04..
mayūradhvajabhūpālo mahāsnehamacīkarat..
nṛpājñāṃ te puraskṛtya yayuḥ sārddhaṃ mahāvatīm .. ..1 05..
3.3.d:
तदा स्वर्णवतीपुत्रो जयन्तः शक्रसंभवः ॥
स्वविद्यां दर्शयामास मकरंदाय धीमते ॥ 101 ॥
वैष्णवास्त्रप्रभावेन शिलाश्वो भस्म चाभवत् ॥
ब्रह्मास्त्रेण भृगुश्रेष्ठ शनिभल्लोऽपतद्भुवि ॥1 02॥
नागपाशेन तं बद्ध्वा मकरंदं महाबलम् ॥
विवाहं कारयामास कृष्णांशस्य महात्मनः ॥1 03॥
सेनामुज्जीवयामास स्वकीयामिंदुलो बली ॥
मंगलं कारयामास मकरंदो गृहेगृहे ॥
ददौ कन्यां विधानेन बहुद्रव्यसमन्विताम् ॥1 04॥
मयूरध्वजभूपालो महास्नेहमचीकरत्॥
नृपाज्ञां ते पुरस्कृत्य ययुः सार्द्धं महावतीम् ॥ ॥1 05॥
3.3.m:
Then Jayanta, born of Śakra, son of Svarṇavatī, / displayed his magical knowledge to the wise Makaraṃda.
By the power of the Vaiṣṇava missile, the stone horse turned to ashes; / and by the missile of Brahmā, O best of the Bhṛgus, the spear of Śani fell to the ground.
Having bound mighty Makaraṃda with the serpent-noose, / he brought about the marriage of the great-souled Kṛṣṇāṃśa.
Mighty Iṃdula revived his own army. / Makaraṃda caused auspicious ceremonies to be performed in every house, / and duly gave away the maiden along with much wealth.
King Mayūradhvaja showed great affection. / Honoring the king's command, they set out together for Mahāvatī.

3.3.s:
sūta uvāca ..
mahāvatyāṃ tu saṃprāpte kṛṣṇāṃśe balavattare ..
maṃgalaṃ kṛtavānrājā tadā parimalo balī .. 1 ..
3.3.d:
सूत उवाच ॥
महावत्यां तु संप्राप्ते कृष्णांशे बलवत्तरे ॥
मंगलं कृतवान्राजा तदा परिमलो बली ॥ 1 ॥
3.3.m: Sūta said: / When the exceedingly strong Kṛṣṇāṃśa had arrived in Mahāvatī, / the mighty King Parimala then performed auspicious rites.

3.3.s:
puṣpavatyā tayā sārddhaṃ gītanṛtyaviśāradaḥ ..
kṛṣṇāṃśaḥ pratyahaṃ gehe mumoha sakhibhiḥ saha .. 2 ..
3.3.d:
पुष्पवत्या तया सार्द्धं गीतनृत्यविशारदः ॥
कृष्णांशः प्रत्यहं गेहे मुमोह सखिभिः सह ॥ 2 ॥
3.3.m: Skilled in song and dance, Kṛṣṇāṃśa along with Puṣpavatī / rejoiced day after day in the house together with his companions.

3.3.s:
hemaṃtaśiśire vīro rahaḥ krīḍāṃ karoti vai ..
yathā śakro'psarobhiśca tathaiva hyudayo balī .. 3 ..
3.3.d:
हेमंतशिशिरे वीरो रहः क्रीडां करोति वै ॥
यथा शक्रोऽप्सरोभिश्च तथैव ह्युदयो बली ॥ 3 ॥
3.3.m: In autumn and winter, the hero engaged in secret sport; / just as Śakra with the Apsarases, exactly so did mighty Udaya.

3.3.s:
grāmyadharmaṃ na kṛtavānsarvasparśaviśāradaḥ ..
ekadā nṛtyakrīḍāyāṃ devī puṣpavatī svayam .. 4 ..
3.3.d:
ग्राम्यधर्मं न कृतवान्सर्वस्पर्शविशारदः ॥
एकदा नृत्यक्रीडायां देवी पुष्पवती स्वयम् ॥ 4 ॥
3.3.m: Though skilled in every kind of touch, he did not engage in sexual intercourse. / Once, during a dance-sport, Queen Puṣpavatī herself

3.3.s:
kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ vacanaṃ prāha pūrvajanmani ko bhavān ..
iti śrutvodayo vīro vihasyovāca vai vacaḥ .. 5 ..
3.3.d:
कृष्णांशं वचनं प्राह पूर्वजन्मनि को भवान् ॥
इति श्रुत्वोदयो वीरो विहस्योवाच वै वचः ॥ 5 ॥
3.3.m: spoke words to Kṛṣṇāṃśa: 'Who were you in a previous birth?' / Hearing this, heroic Udaya laughed and said:

3.3.s:
nṛpohaṃ caṃdradāsaśca pūrvajanmani he priye ..
bālyātprabhṛti me duḥkhaṃ prāptaṃ daivavinirmitam..6..
3.3.d:
नृपोहं चंद्रदासश्च पूर्वजन्मनि हे प्रिये ॥
बाल्यात्प्रभृति मे दुःखं प्राप्तं दैवविनिर्मितम्॥6॥
3.3.m: 'In my previous birth, O beloved, I was King Candradāsa. / From my childhood onward, I encountered suffering wrought by destiny.

3.3.s:
śālagrāmaśilāpūjā pratyahaṃ vai mayā kṛtā ..
tena puṇyaprabhāvena sārvabhaumo babhūva ha ..7..
3.3.d:
शालग्रामशिलापूजा प्रत्यहं वै मया कृता ॥
तेन पुण्यप्रभावेन सार्वभौमो बभूव ह ॥7॥
3.3.m: Every day indeed I performed worship of the Śālagrāma stone; / by the power of that merit, I became a universal emperor.

3.3.s:
mṛte'hani tu saṃprāpte śālagrāme mano dadhau ..
sāyujyaṃ me hareścāsītsvayaṃ brahmaprasādataḥ..8..
3.3.d:
मृतेऽहनि तु संप्राप्ते शालग्रामे मनो दधौ ॥
सायुज्यं मे हरेश्चासीत्स्वयं ब्रह्मप्रसादतः॥8॥
3.3.m: When the day of death arrived, I fixed my mind upon the Śālagrāma; / and union with Hari was mine by the grace of Brahmā himself.

3.3.s:
kalinā prārthito viṣṇuḥ kālātmā parameśvaraḥ ..
svadehānmāṃ tu niṣkāsya bhūmau janimacīkarat ..9..
3.3.d:
कलिना प्रार्थितो विष्णुः कालात्मा परमेश्वरः ॥
स्वदेहान्मां तु निष्कास्य भूमौ जनिमचीकरत् ॥9॥
3.3.m: Beseeched by Kali, Viṣṇu, the Supreme Lord whose self is time, / took me out of his own body and made me be born on earth.

3.3.s:
yadā yadā hi dharmasya glānirbhavati vai priye..
yugadharmasya maryādāsthāpanāya bhavāmyaham..3.3.22.1 0..
3.3.d:
यदा यदा हि धर्मस्य ग्लानिर्भवति वै प्रिये॥
युगधर्मस्य मर्यादास्थापनाय भवाम्यहम्॥3.3.22.1 0॥
3.3.m: Whenever there is a decline of dharma, O beloved, / I appear to establish the limits of the duty of the age.

3.3.s:
satye tu mānasī pūjā devānāṃ tṛptihetave ..
tretāyāṃ vahnipūjā ca yajñadānādikā kriyā ..11..
3.3.d:
सत्ये तु मानसी पूजा देवानां तृप्तिहेतवे ॥
त्रेतायां वह्निपूजा च यज्ञदानादिका क्रिया ॥11॥
3.3.m: In the Kṛta age, there was mental worship for the satisfaction of the gods; / in the Tretā age, worship of fire and rites of sacrifice, giving, and the like.

3.3.s:
dvāpare mūrtipūjā ca devānāṃ vai priyaṃkarī ..
kalau tu dāruṇe prāpte brahmapūjanamuttamam..12..
3.3.d:
द्वापरे मूर्तिपूजा च देवानां वै प्रियंकरी ॥
कलौ तु दारुणे प्राप्ते ब्रह्मपूजनमुत्तमम्॥12॥
3.3.m: In the Dvāpara age, worship of images is pleasing to the gods; / but when the terrible Kali age arrives, worship of Brahman is supreme.

3.3.s:
ahaṃ haṃsaḥ satyayuge tretāyāṃ yajñapūruṣaḥ ..
hiraṇyagarbhaśca priye dvāpare'haṃ sukhapradaḥ ..
śālagrāmaḥ kalau prāpte devānāṃ tṛptaye hyaham .. 13 ..
3.3.d:
अहं हंसः सत्ययुगे त्रेतायां यज्ञपूरुषः ॥
हिरण्यगर्भश्च प्रिये द्वापरेऽहं सुखप्रदः ॥
शालग्रामः कलौ प्राप्ते देवानां तृप्तये ह्यहम् ॥ 13 ॥
3.3.m: I was Haṃsa in the Kṛta age, the Sacrificial Man in the Tretā, / and Hiraṇyagarbha who grants happiness in the Dvāpara, O beloved; / when the Kali age arrives, I am the Śālagrāma for the satisfaction of the gods.

3.3.s:
munayo devatāssarvāstathā pitṛgaṇāḥ priye ..
sarve te tṛptimāyāṃti śālagrāmasya pūjanāt .. 14 ..
3.3.d:
मुनयो देवतास्सर्वास्तथा पितृगणाः प्रिये ॥
सर्वे ते तृप्तिमायांति शालग्रामस्य पूजनात् ॥ 14 ॥
3.3.m: Sages, all the deities, and the ancestral spirits, O beloved— / all of them attain satisfaction from the worship of the Śālagrāma.

3.3.s:
dvijātibhistrivarṇaiśca pūjanaṃ caṃdanādikaiḥ ..
śūdraiśca snānamātreṇa bhakti bhāvena pūjanam ..15..
3.3.d:
द्विजातिभिस्त्रिवर्णैश्च पूजनं चंदनादिकैः ॥
शूद्रैश्च स्नानमात्रेण भक्ति भावेन पूजनम् ॥15॥
3.3.m: Worship is done by the twice-born of the three social classes with sandalwood paste and the like; / and by Śūdras, worship is done with a devotion of feeling through mere bathing [of it].

3.3.s:
mlecchaiśca darśanaṃ puṇyaṃ vinayādbhaktibhāvataḥ ..
śālagrāmaḥ svayaṃ brahma saccidānaṃdavigrahaḥ ..
tasya darśanamātreṇa kṣayaṃ yāsyaṃti vai malāḥ ..16..
3.3.d:
म्लेच्छैश्च दर्शनं पुण्यं विनयाद्भक्तिभावतः ॥
शालग्रामः स्वयं ब्रह्म सच्चिदानंदविग्रहः ॥
तस्य दर्शनमात्रेण क्षयं यास्यंति वै मलाः ॥16॥
3.3.m: Even by Mlecchas, seeing it with humility and devotion is meritorious. / The Śālagrāma is Brahman itself, whose form is being, consciousness, and bliss; / by merely seeing it, impurities will indeed be destroyed.

3.3.s:
iti te kathitaṃ devi yugamaryādamuttamam ..
purā tvaṃ kasya tanayā satyaṃ kathaya me'ciram..17..
3.3.d:
इति ते कथितं देवि युगमर्यादमुत्तमम् ॥
पुरा त्वं कस्य तनया सत्यं कथय मेऽचिरम्॥17॥
3.3.m: Thus has the excellent standard of the ages been related to you, O lady. / Whose daughter were you formerly? Tell me the truth without delay.'

3.3.s:
puṣpavatyuvāca..
pūrvajanmani veśyāhaṃ caṃdrakāṃtiriti śrutā ..
gānanṛtyādikaṃ vādyaṃ devasyāgre mayā kṛtam .. 18 ..
3.3.d:
पुष्पवत्युवाच॥
पूर्वजन्मनि वेश्याहं चंद्रकांतिरिति श्रुता ॥
गाननृत्यादिकं वाद्यं देवस्याग्रे मया कृतम् ॥ 18 ॥
3.3.m: Puṣpavatī said: / 'In my previous birth, I was a courtesan known as Candrakānti. / Singing, dancing, instrumental music, and such were performed by me before the deity.'

3.3.s:
tena puṇyaprabhāveṇa svargalokamupāgatā ..
devaiśca prārthitā tatra rūpa yauvanaśālinī .. 19 ..
3.3.d:
तेन पुण्यप्रभावेण स्वर्गलोकमुपागता ॥
देवैश्च प्रार्थिता तत्र रूप यौवनशालिनी ॥ 19 ॥
3.3.m: By the power of that merit, I went to the heavenly world; / and endowed with beauty and youth, I was wooed there by the gods.

3.3.s:
brahmacaryaṃ na tatyāja svargaloke'pi vai hyaham ..
tena puṇyaprabhāveṇa coṣā bāṇasutā'bhavam ..
aniruddhaḥ svayaṃ brahma mama pāṇiṃ gṛhītavān .. 3.3.22.20 ..
3.3.d:
ब्रह्मचर्यं न तत्याज स्वर्गलोकेऽपि वै ह्यहम् ॥
तेन पुण्यप्रभावेण चोषा बाणसुताऽभवम् ॥
अनिरुद्धः स्वयं ब्रह्म मम पाणिं गृहीतवान् ॥ 3.3.22.20 ॥
3.3.m: Even in the heavenly world, indeed, I did not abandon celibacy; / by the power of that merit, I became Uṣā, the daughter of Bāṇa. / Aniruddha, Brahman himself, took my hand in marriage.

3.3.s:
kalinā prārthito devo mama svāmī svahetave ..
arcāvatāramāsādya mārkaṃḍeyasthalaṃ gataḥ .. 21 ..
3.3.d:
कलिना प्रार्थितो देवो मम स्वामी स्वहेतवे ॥
अर्चावतारमासाद्य मार्कंडेयस्थलं गतः ॥ 21 ॥
3.3.m: Beseeched by Kali for his own purpose, the god, my lord, / assumed an icon-incarnation and went to the place of Mārkaṇḍeya.

3.3.s:
svaprasādasya mahimā darśitastena tatra vai ..
atraiva sthitimaryādo dārurūpasya me pateḥ .. 22 ..
3.3.d:
स्वप्रसादस्य महिमा दर्शितस्तेन तत्र वै ॥
अत्रैव स्थितिमर्यादो दारुरूपस्य मे पतेः ॥ 22 ॥
3.3.m: There he indeed displayed the greatness of his grace; / the boundary-dwelling of my husband in wooden form is right here.

3.3.s:
ahaṃ tasyājñayā svāmiñjambukasya sutābhavam ..
divyarūpasamāyuktā nāmnāhaṃ vijayaiṣiṇī .. 23 ..
3.3.d:
अहं तस्याज्ञया स्वामिञ्जम्बुकस्य सुताभवम् ॥
दिव्यरूपसमायुक्ता नाम्नाहं विजयैषिणी ॥ 23 ॥
3.3.m: By his command, my lord, I became the daughter of Jambuka, / endowed with divine beauty, named Vijayaiṣiṇī.

3.3.s:
kṛtaṃ mamaiva maraṇaṃ tvadbhrātrā balakhāninā ..
makaraṃdasya bhaginī bhūtvā tvāṃ patimāgatā ..24..
3.3.d:
कृतं ममैव मरणं त्वद्भ्रात्रा बलखानिना ॥
मकरंदस्य भगिनी भूत्वा त्वां पतिमागता ॥24॥
3.3.m: My death indeed was brought about by your brother Balakhānin; / having become the sister of Makaranda, I have come to you as my husband.

3.3.s:
tena doṣeṇa tvadbhrātā yātanāṃ tīvramāgataḥ ..
rājña innagaṭhasyaiva gehe gajapateḥ svayam ..
ityuktvā maunamāsthāya reme patyā samaṃ mudā .. 25 ..
3.3.d:
तेन दोषेण त्वद्भ्राता यातनां तीव्रमागतः ॥
राज्ञ इन्नगठस्यैव गेहे गजपतेः स्वयम् ॥
इत्युक्त्वा मौनमास्थाय रेमे पत्या समं मुदा ॥ 25 ॥
3.3.m: Because of that sin, your brother has undergone severe torment / in the very house of King Innagaṭha, the lord of elephants, in person. / Having spoken thus, she took to silence and took delight joyfully with her husband.

3.3.s:
holikāsamaye prāpte malanā snehaduḥkhitā ..
sutāṃ caṃdrāvalīṃ ramyāṃ svapnāṃte sā dadarśa ha ..
ruroda niśi duḥkhena svasutāsnehakātarā .. 26 ..
3.3.d:
होलिकासमये प्राप्ते मलना स्नेहदुःखिता ॥
सुतां चंद्रावलीं रम्यां स्वप्नांते सा ददर्श ह ॥
रुरोद निशि दुःखेन स्वसुतास्नेहकातरा ॥ 26 ॥
3.3.m: When the time of Holikā arrived, Malanā, distressed by affection, / saw her lovely daughter Candrāvalī in a dream; / distressed by affection for her own daughter, she wept at night in sorrow.

3.3.s:
tadodayo mahāvīro jñātvā rodana kāraṇam ..
śūraiśca daśasāhasraissārddhaṃ bahudhanairyutaḥ ..
ekākī prayayau vīro yatra caṃdrāvalīgṛham .. 27 ..
3.3.d:
तदोदयो महावीरो ज्ञात्वा रोदन कारणम् ॥
शूरैश्च दशसाहस्रैस्सार्द्धं बहुधनैर्युतः ॥
एकाकी प्रययौ वीरो यत्र चंद्रावलीगृहम् ॥ 27 ॥
3.3.m: Then the great hero Udaya, having learned the cause of her weeping, / set out alone, accompanied by ten thousand warriors and endowed with much wealth, / to the place where Candrāvalī's house stood.

3.3.s:
mahīpatistu tacchatrurjñātvā kāraṇamuttamam ..
paścājjagāma kāryārthī sa tu duryodhanāṃśakaḥ ..
balīṭhāṭhamiti khyātaṃ grāmaṃ yādavapālitam .. 28 ..
3.3.d:
महीपतिस्तु तच्छत्रुर्ज्ञात्वा कारणमुत्तमम् ॥
पश्चाज्जगाम कार्यार्थी स तु दुर्योधनांशकः ॥
बलीठाठमिति ख्यातं ग्रामं यादवपालितम् ॥ 28 ॥
3.3.m: The king, however, his enemy, having learned of that excellent opportunity, / followed behind, seeking his own ends, as a portion of Duryodhana, / to the village celebrated as Balīṭhāṭha, ruled by the Yādavas.

3.3.s:
vīraseno nṛpastatra trilakṣabalasaṃyutaḥ ..
aṣṭau sutāśca tasyāsanrūpayauvanaśālinaḥ .. 29 ..
3.3.d:
वीरसेनो नृपस्तत्र त्रिलक्षबलसंयुतः ॥
अष्टौ सुताश्च तस्यासन्रूपयौवनशालिनः ॥ 29 ॥
3.3.m: King Vīrasena was there, endowed with an army of three hundred thousand; / and he had eight sons, endowed with beauty and youth:

3.3.s:
kāmasenaḥ prasenaśca mahāsenastathaiva ca ..
sukhaseno rūpaseno viṣvakseno madhuvrataḥ ..
madhupaśca kramājjātā yādavāṃśāśca yādavāḥ .. 3.3.22.30 ..
3.3.d:
कामसेनः प्रसेनश्च महासेनस्तथैव च ॥
सुखसेनो रूपसेनो विष्वक्सेनो मधुव्रतः ॥
मधुपश्च क्रमाज्जाता यादवांशाश्च यादवाः ॥ 3.3.22.30 ॥
3.3.m: Kāmasena, Prasena, and likewise Mahāsena, / Sukhasena, Rūpasena, Viṣvaksena, Madhuvrata, / and Madhupa were born in order, portions of Yādavas, and themselves Yādavas.

3.3.s:
tatra gatvā ca kṛṣṇāṃśassabhāyāṃ narakesarī ..
daṃḍavatpraṇato bhūtvā vīrasenaṃ mahīpatim .. 31 ..
3.3.d:
तत्र गत्वा च कृष्णांशस्सभायां नरकेसरी ॥
दंडवत्प्रणतो भूत्वा वीरसेनं महीपतिम् ॥ 31 ॥
3.3.m: Having gone there into the assembly, the portion of Kṛṣṇa, a man-lion, / prostrated himself like a staff before King Vīrasena.

3.3.s:
malanālikhitaṃ patraṃ dattvā rājñe mahāmanāḥ ..
daśabhāraṃ suvarṇasya punarvāsamacīkarat .. 32 ..
3.3.d:
मलनालिखितं पत्रं दत्त्वा राज्ञे महामनाः ॥
दशभारं सुवर्णस्य पुनर्वासमचीकरत् ॥ 32 ॥
3.3.m: Giving the king the letter written by Malanā, the high-minded one / offered ten bhāras of gold and took up residence again.

3.3.s:
vyaṃjanāni vicitrāṇi bhuktvā yādavasaṃyutaḥ ..
caṃdrāvalīṃ samāgatya kuśalaṃ ca nyavedayat .. 33 ..
3.3.d:
व्यंजनानि विचित्राणि भुक्त्वा यादवसंयुतः ॥
चंद्रावलीं समागत्य कुशलं च न्यवेदयत् ॥ 33 ॥
3.3.m: Having eaten diverse dishes together with the Yādavas, / he approached Candrāvalī and inquired after her welfare.

3.3.s:
premotsukā ca bhaginī kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ prāha duḥkhitā..
bhavāndvyabdavayā vīra tadāhaṃ ca vivāhitā ..34..
3.3.d:
प्रेमोत्सुका च भगिनी कृष्णांशं प्राह दुःखिता॥
भवान्द्व्यब्दवया वीर तदाहं च विवाहिता ॥34॥
3.3.m: Longing with affection and sorrowful, the sister said to the portion of Kṛṣṇa: / "You were two years of age, O hero, when I was given in marriage.

3.3.s:
viṃśadabdastato jāto vismṛtā pitṛmātṛbhiḥ ..
samarthena tvayā vīra saṃsmṛtā bhaginī svayam .. 35 ..
3.3.d:
विंशदब्दस्ततो जातो विस्मृता पितृमातृभिः ॥
समर्थेन त्वया वीर संस्मृता भगिनी स्वयम् ॥ 35 ॥
3.3.m: Twenty years have passed since then, forgotten by our parents; / but by you, a capable hero, your sister has been remembered in person.

3.3.s:
adya me saphalaṃ janma jīvitaṃ saphalaṃ ca me ..
baṃdhudarśanamātreṇa sarvaṃ ca saphalaṃ mama .. 36 ..
3.3.d:
अद्य मे सफलं जन्म जीवितं सफलं च मे ॥
बंधुदर्शनमात्रेण सर्वं च सफलं मम ॥ 36 ॥
3.3.m: Today my birth is fruitful, and my life is fruitful; / by the mere sight of my kin, everything of mine is fruitful."

3.3.s:
prasannātmodayastatra bhaginīṃ prāha namradhīḥ ..
jambukena gṛhaṃ sarvaṃ luṇṭhitaṃ balaśālinā .. 37 .. .
3.3.d:
प्रसन्नात्मोदयस्तत्र भगिनीं प्राह नम्रधीः ॥
जम्बुकेन गृहं सर्वं लुण्ठितं बलशालिना ॥ 37 ॥ ।
3.3.m: There, his mind humble, Udaya, pleased at heart, said to his sister: / "The entire household was plundered by the mighty Jambuka.

3.3.s:
tasya duḥkhena bhūpālo bhayabhīto dinedine ..
mahākaṣṭena vijayo jambukāccābhayo'bhavat .. 38 ..
3.3.d:
तस्य दुःखेन भूपालो भयभीतो दिनेदिने ॥
महाकष्टेन विजयो जम्बुकाच्चाभयोऽभवत् ॥ 38 ॥
3.3.m: From the distress caused by that, the king was terrified day by day; / with great difficulty, Vijaya was made free from fear of Jambuka.

3.3.s:
mahīrājastu balavānrurodha nagarīṃ mama ..
mayā vivāhito bhrātā brahmā tatsutayā saha .. 39 ..
3.3.d:
महीराजस्तु बलवान्रुरोध नगरीं मम ॥
मया विवाहितो भ्राता ब्रह्मा तत्सुतया सह ॥ 39 ॥
3.3.m: The powerful Mahīrāja besieged my city; / our brother Brahmā was married by me to his daughter.

3.3.s:
punaśca siṃhaladvīpe jayaṃtārthe vayaṃ gatāḥ ..
evaṃvidhāni duḥkhāni bahūni hyabhavanpituḥ .. 3.3.22.40 ..
3.3.d:
पुनश्च सिंहलद्वीपे जयंतार्थे वयं गताः ॥
एवंविधानि दुःखानि बहूनि ह्यभवन्पितुः ॥ 3.3.22.40 ॥
3.3.m: And again we went to the island of Siṃhala for the sake of Jayanta; / such were the many sorrows that befell our father.

3.3.s:
atastvāṃ prati suprītā vayaṃ bhaginikiṃkarāḥ ..
mṛduvākyamiti śrutvā tadā caṃdrāvalī mudā .. 41 ..
3.3.d:
अतस्त्वां प्रति सुप्रीता वयं भगिनिकिंकराः ॥
मृदुवाक्यमिति श्रुत्वा तदा चंद्रावली मुदा ॥ 41 ॥
3.3.m: Therefore, we are well disposed toward you, being servants to our sister." / Having heard this gentle speech, Candrāvalī then with joy,

3.3.s:
gehaṃ nivāsayāmāsa svakīyaṃ premavihvalā ..
etasminnantare dhūrto mahīpatirupāyayau .. 42 ..
3.3.d:
गेहं निवासयामास स्वकीयं प्रेमविह्वला ॥
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे धूर्तो महीपतिरुपाययौ ॥ 42 ॥
3.3.m: overcome with affection, accommodated him in her own home. / In the meantime, the rogue Mahīpati arrived.

3.3.s:
sabhāyāṃ vīrasenasya rājñā tenaiva satkṛtaḥ ..
vārtāṃtaraṃ samāsādya tamuvāca mahīpatiḥ .. 43 ..
3.3.d:
सभायां वीरसेनस्य राज्ञा तेनैव सत्कृतः ॥
वार्तांतरं समासाद्य तमुवाच महीपतिः ॥ 43 ॥
3.3.m: Honored in the assembly of Vīrasena by that very king, / finding an opportunity in conversation, Mahīpati said to him:

3.3.s:
niṣkāsitāśca te sarve rājñāhlādādayaḥ khalāḥ .
caurito nṛpateḥ kośo hīnajātyairmahābalaiḥ ..44..
3.3.d:
निष्कासिताश्च ते सर्वे राज्ञाह्लादादयः खलाः ।
चौरितो नृपतेः कोशो हीनजात्यैर्महाबलैः ॥44॥
3.3.m: "Those villains Ahlāda and the others have all been expelled by the king; / the treasury of the king was stolen by those low-born men of great strength.

3.3.s:
tadā tu kuṃṭhitāḥ sarve śirīṣākhyapure'vasan ..
chidradarśī tu kṛṣṇāṃśo gehaṃ tava samāgataḥ .. 45 ..
3.3.d:
तदा तु कुंठिताः सर्वे शिरीषाख्यपुरेऽवसन् ॥
छिद्रदर्शी तु कृष्णांशो गेहं तव समागतः ॥ 45 ॥
3.3.m: Then, having been thwarted, they all lived in the town called Śirīṣa; / but the fault-seeking portion of Kṛṣṇa has now come to your home.

3.3.s:
caṃdrāvalyāśca vai dolāṃ gṛhītvā sa gamiṣyati ..
satyaṃ bravīmi bhūpāla nānyathā vacanaṃ mama .. .. 46 ..
3.3.d:
चंद्रावल्याश्च वै दोलां गृहीत्वा स गमिष्यति ॥
सत्यं ब्रवीमि भूपाल नान्यथा वचनं मम ॥ ॥ 46 ॥
3.3.m: He will depart after taking the palanquin of Candrāvalī; / I speak the truth, O king, my word is not otherwise."

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā vīraseno jñātvā tatsatyakāraṇam ..
kāmasenaṃ samāhūya caṃdrāvalyāḥ patiṃ sutam ..47..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा वीरसेनो ज्ञात्वा तत्सत्यकारणम् ॥
कामसेनं समाहूय चंद्रावल्याः पतिं सुतम् ॥47॥
3.3.m: Hearing this and taking it to be the true state of affairs, Vīrasena / summoned his son Kāmasena, Candrāvalī's husband,

3.3.s:
vacanaṃ prāha bhoḥ putra baṃdhanaṃ kuru tasya vai ..
iti śrutvā kāmaseno viṣamādāya dāruṇam .. 48 ..
3.3.d:
वचनं प्राह भोः पुत्र बंधनं कुरु तस्य वै ॥
इति श्रुत्वा कामसेनो विषमादाय दारुणम् ॥ 48 ॥
3.3.m: and spoke these words: "O son, bind him fast!" / Hearing this, Kāmasena took dreadful poison

3.3.s:
bhojanāya dadau tasyai jñātvā candrāvalī tadā ..
bhrāturaṃtikamāsādya pātramādāya sā yayau .. 49 ..
3.3.d:
भोजनाय ददौ तस्यै ज्ञात्वा चन्द्रावली तदा ॥
भ्रातुरंतिकमासाद्य पात्रमादाय सा ययौ ॥ 49 ॥
3.3.m: and gave it to her to eat. Learning of it then, Candrāvalī / took the vessel and went into the presence of her brother.

3.3.s:
kāmasenaśca kupito gṛhītvā daṃḍavetasam ..
svapriyāṃ tāḍayāmāsa sa dṛṣṭvā taṃ tadākupat .. 3.3.22.50 ..
3.3.d:
कामसेनश्च कुपितो गृहीत्वा दंडवेतसम् ॥
स्वप्रियां ताडयामास स दृष्ट्वा तं तदाकुपत् ॥ 3.3.22.50 ॥
3.3.m: Kāmasena, enraged, took a cane staff / and struck his beloved wife; seeing that, he then became furious.

3.3.s:
gṛhītvā bhujayostaṃ vai baṃdhanāya samudyataḥ ..
baṃdhanatvaṃ gate putre vīraseno mahābalaḥ .. 51 ..
3.3.d:
गृहीत्वा भुजयोस्तं वै बंधनाय समुद्यतः ॥
बंधनत्वं गते पुत्रे वीरसेनो महाबलः ॥ 51 ॥
3.3.m: Seizing him by the arms, he set about binding him; / when his son was bound, the mighty Vīrasena

3.3.s:
putrānājñāpayāmāsa tasya baṃdhanahetave ..
etasminnaṃtare vīro dolāmādāya satvaram .. .. 52 ..
3.3.d:
पुत्रानाज्ञापयामास तस्य बंधनहेतवे ॥
एतस्मिन्नंतरे वीरो दोलामादाय सत्वरम् ॥ ॥ 52 ॥
3.3.m: ordered his sons to bind him. / In the meantime, the hero quickly took the palanquin,

3.3.s:
senāmadhye samāgamya mahadyudamacīkarat ..
ekato daśasāhasrāstrilakṣāstu tathaikataḥ ..
ahorātramabhūdyuddhaṃ dāruṇaṃ romaharṣaṇam ..53 ..
3.3.d:
सेनामध्ये समागम्य महद्युदमचीकरत् ॥
एकतो दशसाहस्रास्त्रिलक्षास्तु तथैकतः ॥
अहोरात्रमभूद्युद्धं दारुणं रोमहर्षणम् ॥53 ॥
3.3.m: advanced into the midst of the army, and fought a great battle: / ten thousand on one side, and three hundred thousand on the other; / day and night there was a fierce battle that made the hair stand on end.

3.3.s:
hatā lakṣaṃ mahāśūrā udayena mahābalāḥ ..
śeṣāḥ pradudruvussarve yādavā bhayakātarāḥ .. 54 ..
3.3.d:
हता लक्षं महाशूरा उदयेन महाबलाः ॥
शेषाः प्रदुद्रुवुस्सर्वे यादवा भयकातराः ॥ 54 ॥
3.3.m: A hundred thousand mighty warriors were slain by Udaya; / the remaining Yādavas all fled, distressed by fear.

3.3.s:
dṛṣṭvā parājitaṃ sainyaṃ sapta putrā mahābalāḥ ..
svāngajāṃśca samāruhya kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ rurudhū ruṣā .. 55 ..
3.3.d:
दृष्ट्वा पराजितं सैन्यं सप्त पुत्रा महाबलाः ॥
स्वान्गजांश्च समारुह्य कृष्णांशं रुरुधू रुषा ॥ 55 ॥
3.3.m: Seeing their army defeated, the seven mighty sons / mounted their elephants and blocked the portion of Kṛṣṇa in fury.

3.3.s:
sa vīro biṃdulārūḍho bhūmau kṛtvā gajāsanān ..
teṣāmastrāṇi saṃcchidya badhnāti baladarpitaḥ..56..
3.3.d:
स वीरो बिंदुलारूढो भूमौ कृत्वा गजासनान् ॥
तेषामस्त्राणि संच्छिद्य बध्नाति बलदर्पितः॥56॥
3.3.m: Mounted on Bindulā, that hero brought to the ground those seated on elephants; / cutting down their weapons, proud of his strength, he bound them.

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā vīrasenaḥ sūryabhaktiparāyaṇaḥ ..
sauramastraṃ samādāya tasya sainyamadāhayat ..
tenāstreṇaiva kṛṣṇāṃśaḥ sahayo mūrcchito bhuvi .. 57 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा वीरसेनः सूर्यभक्तिपरायणः ॥
सौरमस्त्रं समादाय तस्य सैन्यमदाहयत् ॥
तेनास्त्रेणैव कृष्णांशः सहयो मूर्च्छितो भुवि ॥ 57 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing of this, Vīrasena, devoted to the worship of the Sun, / took up the solar missile and burned his army; / by that very weapon, the portion of Kṛṣṇa fell fainting to the ground along with his horse.

3.3.s:
vīrasenastu taṃ baddhvā mocayitvā sutānvadhūm ..
svagehamāgatastṛrṇaṃ nānāvādyānyavādayat .. 58 ..
3.3.d:
वीरसेनस्तु तं बद्ध्वा मोचयित्वा सुतान्वधूम् ॥
स्वगेहमागतस्तृर्णं नानावाद्यान्यवादयत् ॥ 58 ॥
3.3.m: Having bound him and freed his sons and daughter-in-law, / Vīrasena quickly returned to his own home and had various musical instruments played.

3.3.s:
hataroṣāstadā vīrāḥ kṛṣṇāṃśasya yayurdiśaḥ ..
hetuṃ parimalasyāgre sarvamūcustadāditaḥ .. 59 ..
3.3.d:
हतरोषास्तदा वीराः कृष्णांशस्य ययुर्दिशः ॥
हेतुं परिमलस्याग्रे सर्वमूचुस्तदादितः ॥ 59 ॥
3.3.m: Then, their fury subdued, the warriors of the portion of Kṛṣṇa dispersed in all directions; / in the presence of Parimala, they told the whole cause from the beginning.

3.3.s:
mahīpatiṃ mahādhūrtaṃ matvā rājābravīdidam ..
gaccha tvaṃ malanāputra lakṣasainyasamanvitaḥ .. 3.3.22.60 ..
3.3.d:
महीपतिं महाधूर्तं मत्वा राजाब्रवीदिदम् ॥
गच्छ त्वं मलनापुत्र लक्षसैन्यसमन्वितः ॥ 3.3.22.60 ॥
3.3.m:
Considering that king to be a great rogue, the king said this:
“Go, son of Malanā, accompanied by an army of one hundred thousand.

3.3.s:
baddhvā svabhaginīkāṃtaṃ svabaṃdhuṃ mocayāśu vai ..
iti śrutvā ca sa suto lakṣasenāsamanvitaḥ ..61..
3.3.d:
बद्ध्वा स्वभगिनीकांतं स्वबंधुं मोचयाशु वै ॥
इति श्रुत्वा च स सुतो लक्षसेनासमन्वितः ॥61॥
3.3.m:
Bind the beloved of your own sister and release your kinsman at once!”
Having heard this, that son, accompanied by an army of one hundred thousand,

3.3.s:
śīghraṃ gatvā ca nagarīṃ rurodha balavānruṣā ..
yuddhī bhūte bale tasminvīraseno nṛpottamaḥ ..
sauramastramupādāya dāhanārthaṃ samudyataḥ .. 62 ..
3.3.d:
शीघ्रं गत्वा च नगरीं रुरोध बलवान्रुषा ॥
युद्धी भूते बले तस्मिन्वीरसेनो नृपोत्तमः ॥
सौरमस्त्रमुपादाय दाहनार्थं समुद्यतः ॥ 62 ॥
3.3.m:
went swiftly and, being mighty, besieged the city in anger.
When that army engaged in battle, Vīrasena, the best of kings,
took up a solar weapon and prepared to burn [them].

3.3.s:
sajjībhūte tadastre tu brahmānaṃdo mahābalaḥ ..
brahmāstreṇaiva sa śaraṃ vārayāmāsa vai ruṣā .. 63 ..
3.3.d:
सज्जीभूते तदस्त्रे तु ब्रह्मानंदो महाबलः ॥
ब्रह्मास्त्रेणैव स शरं वारयामास वै रुषा ॥ 63 ॥
3.3.m:
When that weapon was readied, the mighty Brahmānanda,
with a Brahmā-weapon itself, warded off that arrow in fury.

3.3.s:
dṛṣṭvā bhayānvito bhūpastameva śaraṇaṃ yayau ..
brahmānaṃdastu taṃ bhūpaṃ vacanaṃ prāha nirbhayaḥ .. 64 ..
3.3.d:
दृष्ट्वा भयान्वितो भूपस्तमेव शरणं ययौ ॥
ब्रह्मानंदस्तु तं भूपं वचनं प्राह निर्भयः ॥ 64 ॥
3.3.m:
Seeing [this], the king, filled with fear, went to him alone for refuge.
Brahmānanda, however, fearlessly addressed words to that king:

3.3.s:
dhūrtavākyena he bhūpa madbaṃdhurbādhitastvayā ..
avadhyā ca sadā nārī tvatsutastāmatāḍayat ..
atastvaṃ bhaginīyuktaṃ svasutaṃ dehi me nṛpa .. 65..
3.3.d:
धूर्तवाक्येन हे भूप मद्बंधुर्बाधितस्त्वया ॥
अवध्या च सदा नारी त्वत्सुतस्तामताडयत् ॥
अतस्त्वं भगिनीयुक्तं स्वसुतं देहि मे नृप ॥ 65॥
3.3.m:
“O king, on the word of a rogue my kinsman was troubled by you.
And a woman is ever unslayable, [yet] your son struck her.
Therefore, O king, give me your son along with your sister!”

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā ca nṛpatirvacanaṃ prāha namradhīḥ ..
matsutā ca gṛhe nāsti kāmasenaṃ gṛhāṇa bhoḥ .. 66 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा च नृपतिर्वचनं प्राह नम्रधीः ॥
मत्सुता च गृहे नास्ति कामसेनं गृहाण भोः ॥ 66 ॥
3.3.m:
Having heard this, the king, humble in mind, spoke these words:
“My daughter is not at home; take Kāmasena, sir!”

3.3.s:
ityuktvā vīrasenaśca sutaṃ caṃdrāvalīṃ tathā ..
dattvā tasmai prasannātmā tatprasthānamakārayat .. 67 ..
3.3.d:
इत्युक्त्वा वीरसेनश्च सुतं चंद्रावलीं तथा ॥
दत्त्वा तस्मै प्रसन्नात्मा तत्प्रस्थानमकारयत् ॥ 67 ॥
3.3.m:
Having said this, Vīrasena, with a pleased mind,
gave him his son and also Candrāvalī, and caused their departure.

3.3.s:
brahmānando'pi balavānkṛṣṇāṃśena samanvitaḥ ..
senayāśītisāhasryā yayau sārddhaṃ mahāvatīm .. 68 ..
3.3.d:
ब्रह्मानन्दोऽपि बलवान्कृष्णांशेन समन्वितः ॥
सेनयाशीतिसाहस्र्या ययौ सार्द्धं महावतीम् ॥ 68 ॥
3.3.m:
The mighty Brahmānanda too, accompanied by Kṛṣṇāṃśa,
went with an army of eighty thousand to Mahāvatī.

3.3.s:
malanā svasutaṃ dṛṣṭvā premavihvalakaṃpitā ..
snāpayitvāśrudhārābhirdvijātibhyo dadau dhanam .. 69 ..
3.3.d:
मलना स्वसुतं दृष्ट्वा प्रेमविह्वलकंपिता ॥
स्नापयित्वाश्रुधाराभिर्द्विजातिभ्यो ददौ धनम् ॥ 69 ॥
3.3.m:
Seeing her son, Malanā, trembling and overwhelmed with love,
bathed [him] with streams of tears and gave wealth to the twice-born.

3.3.s:
iti te kathitaṃ vipra kṛṣṇāṃśacaritaṃ śubham ..
śṛṇvatāṃ kalipāpaghnaṃ kathayiṣyāmi vai punaḥ .. 3.3.22.70 ..
3.3.d:
इति ते कथितं विप्र कृष्णांशचरितं शुभम् ॥
शृण्वतां कलिपापघ्नं कथयिष्यामि वै पुनः ॥ 3.3.22.70 ॥
3.3.m:
Thus has been narrated to you, O brāhmaṇa, the auspicious deeds of Kṛṣṇāṃśa,
which destroy the sins of the Kali age for those who hear it; indeed, I shall tell it again.

3.3.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
caturviśābdakaṃ prāpte kṛṣṇāṃśe balaśālini ..
iṣaśukladaśamyāṃ ca kṛto rājñā mahotsavaḥ .. 1 ..
3.3.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
चतुर्विशाब्दकं प्राप्ते कृष्णांशे बलशालिनि ॥
इषशुक्लदशम्यां च कृतो राज्ञा महोत्सवः ॥ 1 ॥
3.3.m:
Sūta said:
When the mighty Kṛṣṇāṃśa reached his twenty-fourth year,
the king held a great festival on the tenth day of the bright fortnight of Iṣa.

3.3.s:
bhojayitvā dvijaśreṣṭhāndattvā tebhyo hi dakṣiṇāḥ ..
svabhṛtyebhyastathā vittaṃ yathāyogyaṃ kramāddadau .. 2 ..
3.3.d:
भोजयित्वा द्विजश्रेष्ठान्दत्त्वा तेभ्यो हि दक्षिणाः ॥
स्वभृत्येभ्यस्तथा वित्तं यथायोग्यं क्रमाद्ददौ ॥ 2 ॥
3.3.m:
Having fed the best of the twice-born and given them sacrificial gifts,
he duly bestowed wealth upon his servants in proper order.

3.3.s:
kārtikyāṃ śubhayuktāyāṃ kṛṣṇāṃśo balasaṃyutaḥ ..
indulena ca saṃyukto devasiṃhena saṃyutaḥ .. 3 ..
3.3.d:
कार्तिक्यां शुभयुक्तायां कृष्णांशो बलसंयुतः ॥
इन्दुलेन च संयुक्तो देवसिंहेन संयुतः ॥ 3 ॥
3.3.m:
On the auspicious full-moon day of Kārtika, Kṛṣṇāṃśa, endowed with might,
together with Indula and accompanied by Devasiṃha,

3.3.s:
ayutaiḥ svarṇadravyaiśca śūrairdaśasahasrakaiḥ ..
yayau barhiṣmatīsthāne nānābhūpasamanvite .. 4 ..
3.3.d:
अयुतैः स्वर्णद्रव्यैश्च शूरैर्दशसहस्रकैः ॥
ययौ बर्हिष्मतीस्थाने नानाभूपसमन्विते ॥ 4 ॥
3.3.m:
along with ten thousand measures of gold and ten thousand warriors,
went to the place of Barhiṣmatī, which was filled with various kings.

3.3.s:
etasminnaṃtare tatra citrarekhā samāgatā ..
vṛtā saptālibhirdevī citraguptaprapūjinī .. 5 ..
3.3.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे तत्र चित्ररेखा समागता ॥
वृता सप्तालिभिर्देवी चित्रगुप्तप्रपूजिनी ॥ 5 ॥
3.3.m:
In the meantime, Citrarekhā arrived there,
the goddess surrounded by seven female companions, a devout worshipper of Citragupta.

3.3.s:
gaṃgāmadhye mahāramyaṃ yānaṃ māyāmayaṃ tayā ..
kṛtaṃ kautūhalayutaṃ bahusaṃpatsamanvitam .. 6 ..
3.3.d:
गंगामध्ये महारम्यं यानं मायामयं तया ॥
कृतं कौतूहलयुतं बहुसंपत्समन्वितम् ॥ 6 ॥
3.3.m:
In the midst of the Gaṅgā, she created an exceedingly delightful vehicle made of illusion,
full of wonders and endowed with abundant treasures.

3.3.s:
āgatāstatra rājāno nānā taddarśanotsukāḥ ..
tadodayo devayuto jayaṃtena samanvitaḥ ..
śataśūraiśca sahito darśanārthamupāyayau .. 7 ..
3.3.d:
आगतास्तत्र राजानो नाना तद्दर्शनोत्सुकाः ॥
तदोदयो देवयुतो जयंतेन समन्वितः ॥
शतशूरैश्च सहितो दर्शनार्थमुपाययौ ॥ 7 ॥
3.3.m:
Various kings arrived there, eager to see it.
Then Udaya, accompanied by Deva and accompanied by Jayanta,
went to see it together with a hundred warriors.

3.3.s:
citrarekhā mahāramyā vāhīkanṛpateḥ sutā ..
dadarśa sudaraṃ kāntamiṃdulaṃ śaśivanmukham ..
yena svapnāṃtare ramyaṃ sārddhaṃ bhuktaṃ tayā sukham .. 8 ..
3.3.d:
चित्ररेखा महारम्या वाहीकनृपतेः सुता ॥
ददर्श सुदरं कान्तमिंदुलं शशिवन्मुखम् ॥
येन स्वप्नांतरे रम्यं सार्द्धं भुक्तं तया सुखम् ॥ 8 ॥
3.3.m:
The exceedingly lovely Citrarekhā, daughter of the king of the Vāhīkas,
saw the handsome and beloved Indula, whose face was like the moon,
with whom she had enjoyed delightful pleasure within a dream.

3.3.s:
tamāhlādasutaṃ jñātvā sābhinaṃdanadehajā ..
kṛtvā mohamayaṃ jālaṃ śukabhūtaṃ tadeṃdulam .. 9 ..
3.3.d:
तमाह्लादसुतं ज्ञात्वा साभिनंदनदेहजा ॥
कृत्वा मोहमयं जालं शुकभूतं तदेंदुलम् ॥ 9 ॥
3.3.m:
Recognising him as the son of Āhlāda, that daughter born of the body of Abhinandana,
having cast a net of illusion, turned Indula into a parrot,

3.3.s:
hṛtvā svayaṃvare ramye paramānandamāyayau ..
punarāhṛtya tāṃ māyāṃ svagehāya yayau mudā .. 3.3.23.10 ..
3.3.d:
हृत्वा स्वयंवरे रम्ये परमानन्दमाययौ ॥
पुनराहृत्य तां मायां स्वगेहाय ययौ मुदा ॥ 3.3.23.10 ॥
3.3.m:
abducted him at the delightful svayaṃvara, and reached supreme bliss.
Withdrawing that illusion again, she joyfully went to her own abode.

3.3.s:
kṛṣṇāṃśastu tadā buddhvā na dadarśa svakaṃ śiśum ..
devasiṃhaṃ bodhayitvā papraccha kva gataḥ śiśuḥ .. 11 ..
3.3.d:
कृष्णांशस्तु तदा बुद्ध्वा न ददर्श स्वकं शिशुम् ॥
देवसिंहं बोधयित्वा पप्रच्छ क्व गतः शिशुः ॥ 11 ॥
3.3.m:
Kṛṣṇāṃśa, however, waking up then, did not see his child.
Waking Devasiṃha, he asked: “Where has the child gone?”

3.3.s:
kālajño devasiṃho'pi mohitaścitramāyayā ..
na jñātastena vai bālaḥ kva gataḥ kena vā hṛtaḥ .. 12 ..
3.3.d:
कालज्ञो देवसिंहोऽपि मोहितश्चित्रमायया ॥
न ज्ञातस्तेन वै बालः क्व गतः केन वा हृतः ॥ 12 ॥
3.3.m:
Even Devasiṃha, who knew the proper time, was deluded by the wondrous illusion;
he did not know where the boy had gone, or by whom he had been taken.

3.3.s:
vismitaṃ devasiṃhaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇāṃśako balī ..
rurodoccaistadā gāḍhaṃ citramāyāvimohitaḥ .. 13 ..
3.3.d:
विस्मितं देवसिंहं च दृष्ट्वा कृष्णांशको बली ॥
रुरोदोच्चैस्तदा गाढं चित्रमायाविमोहितः ॥ 13 ॥
3.3.m:
Seeing Devasiṃha bewildered, the mighty Kṛṣṇāṃśa
wept bitterly and aloud, deluded by the wondrous illusion.

3.3.s:
śrutvā tu rodanaṃ tasya khalastatra mahīpatiḥ ..
yayau śīghraṃ prasannātmā yatrāhlādaḥ svayaṃ sthitaḥ ..
ruditvā tatra vai gāḍhaṃ vacanaṃ prāha namradhīḥ .. 14 ..
3.3.d:
श्रुत्वा तु रोदनं तस्य खलस्तत्र महीपतिः ॥
ययौ शीघ्रं प्रसन्नात्मा यत्राह्लादः स्वयं स्थितः ॥
रुदित्वा तत्र वै गाढं वचनं प्राह नम्रधीः ॥ 14 ॥

3.3.s:
udayo nāma te bhrātā mohayitvā madena tau ..
devamindulamevāsau hatvā dhārāsvaropayat .. 15 ..
3.3.d:
उदयो नाम ते भ्राता मोहयित्वा मदेन तौ ॥
देवमिन्दुलमेवासौ हत्वा धारास्वरोपयत् ॥ 15 ॥
3.3.m:
“Your brother named Udaya, having intoxicated those two with pride,
slew Deva and Indula, and threw them into the river's current!

3.3.s:
pratyakṣaṃ ca mayā dṛṣṭaṃ tena vīreṇa vai kṛtam ..
śataṃ svarṇaṃ ca me dattvā vinayenāvarodhitaḥ .. 16 ..
3.3.d:
प्रत्यक्षं च मया दृष्टं तेन वीरेण वै कृतम् ॥
शतं स्वर्णं च मे दत्त्वा विनयेनावरोधितः ॥ 16 ॥
3.3.m:
And with my own eyes I saw what was done by that warrior.
Giving me a hundred [pieces of] gold, he courteously constrained me.

3.3.s:
devasiṃhastato buddhyā na jñātaṃ tena yatkṛtam ..
iti śrutvā tu vacanaṃ niścayaṃ nādhigacchati .. 17 ..
3.3.d:
देवसिंहस्ततो बुद्ध्या न ज्ञातं तेन यत्कृतम् ॥
इति श्रुत्वा तु वचनं निश्चयं नाधिगच्छति ॥ 17 ॥
3.3.m:
Therefore, Devasiṃha, through his wit, did not realise what was done by him.”
Hearing these words, however, he could not reach a certain conclusion.

3.3.s:
etasminnaṃtare prāptau tau vīrau rodane ratau ..
tadviyogena kṛṣṇāṃśaḥ svadehaṃ tyaktumudyataḥ .. 18 ..
3.3.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे प्राप्तौ तौ वीरौ रोदने रतौ ॥
तद्वियोगेन कृष्णांशः स्वदेहं त्यक्तुमुद्यतः ॥ 18 ॥
3.3.m:
Meanwhile, those two warriors arrived, engaged in weeping;
from separation from him, Kṛṣṇāṃśa prepared to abandon his own body.

3.3.s:
āhlādo niścayaṃ jñātvā bhāṣitaṃ ca mahīpateḥ ..
kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ tāḍayāmāsa vaitasaiścarmakartanaiḥ..19..
3.3.d:
आह्लादो निश्चयं ज्ञात्वा भाषितं च महीपतेः ॥
कृष्णांशं ताडयामास वैतसैश्चर्मकर्तनैः॥19॥
3.3.m:
Āhlāda, believing the king's words to be a certainty,
beat Kṛṣṇāṃśa with cane whips and leather thongs.

3.3.s:
tasya mātā tathā patnī bhaginī premaduḥkhitāḥ ..
āhlādaṃ bodhayāmāsurdhūrtamāyāvimohitam ..
na bodhitastadā vīraścitramāyāvimohitaḥ .. 3.3.23.20 ..
3.3.d:
तस्य माता तथा पत्नी भगिनी प्रेमदुःखिताः ॥
आह्लादं बोधयामासुर्धूर्तमायाविमोहितम् ॥
न बोधितस्तदा वीरश्चित्रमायाविमोहितः ॥ 3.3.23.20 ॥

3.3.s:
tadā puṣpavatī devī svapatiṃ bhrātṛpīḍitam ..
dṛṣṭvā tatra gatā śīghraṃ patiduḥkhena duḥkhitā ..21..
3.3.d:
तदा पुष्पवती देवी स्वपतिं भ्रातृपीडितम् ॥
दृष्ट्वा तत्र गता शीघ्रं पतिदुःखेन दुःखिता ॥21॥
3.3.m:
Then Queen Puṣpavatī, seeing her husband afflicted by his brother,
went there swiftly, sorrowful over her husband's distress.

3.3.s:
vināparādhaṃ kṛṣṇāṃśo mahāniṃdāmavāptavān ..
tadā vedavido viprā āhlādaṃ prāhurūrjitam .. 22 ..
3.3.d:
विनापराधं कृष्णांशो महानिंदामवाप्तवान् ॥
तदा वेदविदो विप्रा आह्लादं प्राहुरूर्जितम् ॥ 22 ॥
3.3.m:
Without any fault, Kṛṣṇāṃśa met with great reproach.
Then the brāhmaṇas who knew the Vedas spoke forcefully to Āhlāda:

3.3.s:
vadhastyāgaḥ samo jñeyo yogyaṃ buddhyā vicāraya ..
ityuktaḥ sa turīyātmā putraśokena duḥkhitaḥ .. ..23 ..
3.3.d:
वधस्त्यागः समो ज्ञेयो योग्यं बुद्ध्या विचारय ॥
इत्युक्तः स तुरीयात्मा पुत्रशोकेन दुःखितः ॥ ॥23 ॥
3.3.m:
“Banishment is to be known as equal to execution; consider what is fitting with your intellect!”
Thus addressed, that high-minded man, grief-stricken over the sorrow for his son,

3.3.s:
cāṃḍālāṃśca samāhūya baddhvā taṃ putraghātinam ..
dattvā tebhyaḥ sapatnīkaṃ vadhaṃ kuruta mā ciram .. 24 ..
3.3.d:
चांडालांश्च समाहूय बद्ध्वा तं पुत्रघातिनम् ॥
दत्त्वा तेभ्यः सपत्नीकं वधं कुरुत मा चिरम् ॥ 24 ॥
3.3.m:
summoned the Cāṇḍālas, bound that slayer of his son,
handed him over to them together with his wife, [and said:] “Put [him] to death without delay!

3.3.s:
asya netre samutpāṭya māṃ darśayata saṃyutāḥ ..
iti śrutvā gatāste vai gahanaṃ vyāghrasevitam .. 25 ..
3.3.d:
अस्य नेत्रे समुत्पाट्य मां दर्शयत संयुताः ॥
इति श्रुत्वा गतास्ते वै गहनं व्याघ्रसेवितम् ॥ 25 ॥
3.3.m:
Gouge out his two eyes and, together, show them to me!”
Hearing this, they went to a dense forest frequented by tigers.

3.3.s:
devasiṃhastato gatvā dattvā tebhyo mahaddhanam ..
saṃprāpya daṃpatī vīraścāṃḍālebhyo vanaṃ yayau .. 26 ..
3.3.d:
देवसिंहस्ततो गत्वा दत्त्वा तेभ्यो महद्धनम् ॥
संप्राप्य दंपती वीरश्चांडालेभ्यो वनं ययौ ॥ 26 ॥
3.3.m:
Then Devasiṃha went, gave them great wealth,
and having received the couple from the Cāṇḍālas, the warrior went into the forest.

3.3.s:
balakhānestu yā patnī gajamuktā pativratā ..
daṃpatī pālayāmāsa guhyagehe mudā yutā .. 27 ..
3.3.d:
बलखानेस्तु या पत्नी गजमुक्ता पतिव्रता ॥
दंपती पालयामास गुह्यगेहे मुदा युता ॥ 27 ॥
3.3.m:
The devoted wife of Balakhāni, Gajamuktā,
joyfully protected the couple in a secret dwelling.

3.3.s:
cāṃḍālāste tu saṃgatya mṛganetre ca taṃ daduḥ ..
devasiṃhastadāgatya krodhātmā ca tamabravīt ..
dhiktvāṃ pāpaṃ durācāraṃ tvayā me hiṃsitaḥ sakhā .. 28 ..
3.3.d:
चांडालास्ते तु संगत्य मृगनेत्रे च तं ददुः ॥
देवसिंहस्तदागत्य क्रोधात्मा च तमब्रवीत् ॥
धिक्त्वां पापं दुराचारं त्वया मे हिंसितः सखा ॥ 28 ॥
3.3.m:
Those Cāṇḍālas, having assembled, gave him the eyes of a deer.
Devasiṃha then came, filled with anger, and said to him:
“Fie on you, wicked and evil-doer! By you my friend was harmed!”

3.3.s:
jīvitastvatsuto bhūmau tadanveṣaṇahetave ..
yāsyāmi vividhānrāṣṭrānsatyaṃsatyaṃ bravīmyaham ..
ityuktvā prayayau vīraḥ śirīṣākhyapuraṃ śubham .. 29 ..
3.3.d:
जीवितस्त्वत्सुतो भूमौ तदन्वेषणहेतवे ॥
यास्यामि विविधान्राष्ट्रान्सत्यंसत्यं ब्रवीम्यहम् ॥
इत्युक्त्वा प्रययौ वीरः शिरीषाख्यपुरं शुभम् ॥ 29 ॥
3.3.m: “Your son is alive on earth; to search for him / I will go to various lands; truly, truly I say [this].” / Having spoken thus, the hero set forth to the auspicious city named Śirīṣa.

3.3.s:
gajamuktāmanujñāpya daṃpatī prāpya nirbhayaḥ ..
mayūranagaraṃ ramyaṃ niśi ghoraṃ samāyayau .. 3.3.23.30 ..
3.3.d:
गजमुक्तामनुज्ञाप्य दंपती प्राप्य निर्भयः ॥
मयूरनगरं रम्यं निशि घोरं समाययौ ॥ 3.3.23.30 ॥
3.3.m: Taking leave of Gajamuktā, having reached the couple, fearless, / he arrived at the delightful Mayūranagara in the terrifying night.

3.3.s:
makaraṃdastu balavānjñātvā tatsarvakāraṇam ..
svasuḥ patiṃ ca bhaginīṃ svāṃte premṇā nyavāsayat .. 31 ..
3.3.d:
मकरंदस्तु बलवान्ज्ञात्वा तत्सर्वकारणम् ॥
स्वसुः पतिं च भगिनीं स्वांते प्रेम्णा न्यवासयत् ॥ 31 ॥
3.3.m: The mighty Makaranda, however, having learned the whole matter, / lovingly settled his sister's husband and his sister in his own residence.

3.3.s:
dharmamārādhayāmāsa yajñairnānāvidhaiḥ stavaiḥ ..
prasanno dharmarājaśca makarandamuvāca ha .. 32 ..
3.3.d:
धर्ममाराधयामास यज्ञैर्नानाविधैः स्तवैः ॥
प्रसन्नो धर्मराजश्च मकरन्दमुवाच ह ॥ 32 ॥
3.3.m: He worshiped Dharma with sacrifices of various kinds and with hymns of praise. / Pleased, the lord of Dharma spoke to Makaranda:

3.3.s:
abhinaṃdanabhūpasya sutā citraprapūjinī ..
nāṭyātmajā kesariṇī tatsakhī daṃbhakovidā .. 33 ..
3.3.d:
अभिनंदनभूपस्य सुता चित्रप्रपूजिनी ॥
नाट्यात्मजा केसरिणी तत्सखी दंभकोविदा ॥ 33 ॥
3.3.m: “King Abhinandana has a daughter who worships images, / born of dramatic art, Kesariṇī, her friend, who is skilled in deceit.

3.3.s:
kesariṇyā gururjñeyaḥ kutuko yogurūpadhṛk ..
tena prasāritā māyā śatayojanamantarā .. 34 ..
3.3.d:
केसरिण्या गुरुर्ज्ञेयः कुतुको योगुरूपधृक् ॥
तेन प्रसारिता माया शतयोजनमन्तरा ॥ 34 ॥
3.3.m: The teacher of Kesariṇī should be known as Kutuka, who wears the guise of a yogi; / by him a magical illusion has been spread across a distance of a hundred yojanas.

3.3.s:
śatrubhirdurgamā bhūmiḥ śatrupāṣāṇakāriṇī ..
citraguptaprabhāveṇa nirbhayo bhūpatiḥ svayam .. 35 ..
3.3.d:
शत्रुभिर्दुर्गमा भूमिः शत्रुपाषाणकारिणी ॥
चित्रगुप्तप्रभावेण निर्भयो भूपतिः स्वयम् ॥ 35 ॥
3.3.m: The ground is impassable to enemies, turning enemies to stone; / through the power of Citragupta, the king himself is fearless.

3.3.s:
citrarekhābhūpasutā jayaṃtastu tayā hṛtaḥ ..
nararūpadharo rātrau śukarūpadharo dine ..
indulaśca sthito duḥkhī citramāyāvimohitaḥ .. 36 ..
3.3.d:
चित्ररेखाभूपसुता जयंतस्तु तया हृतः ॥
नररूपधरो रात्रौ शुकरूपधरो दिने ॥
इन्दुलश्च स्थितो दुःखी चित्रमायाविमोहितः ॥ 36 ॥
3.3.m: Citrarekhā is the king's daughter; and Jayanta was carried off by her; / he takes human form by night, and takes the form of a parrot by day; / and Indula remains there sorrowful, bewildered by the wonderful magical illusion.

3.3.s:
kṛṣṇāṃśaśca bhavāndevaḥ sahitaḥ sūryavarmaṇā ..
mayā dattāni yaṃtrāṇi gṛhītvā te mudā yutāḥ ..
citrarekhāṃ samāgatya nṛtyādīṃstaiḥ samaṃ kuru .. 37 ..
3.3.d:
कृष्णांशश्च भवान्देवः सहितः सूर्यवर्मणा ॥
मया दत्तानि यंत्राणि गृहीत्वा ते मुदा युताः ॥
चित्ररेखां समागत्य नृत्यादींस्तैः समं कुरु ॥ 37 ॥
3.3.m: And you, noble lord, being a portion of Kṛṣṇa, accompanied by Sūryavarman, / taking the magical diagrams given by me, filled with joy, / approach Citrarekhā and perform dances and the like together with them.

3.3.s:
mohayitvā ca tāṃ devīṃ paṭhitvā tanmataṃ śubham ..
punarāgaccha vai śīghraṃ sainyayogaṃ punaḥ kuru .. .. 38 ..
3.3.d:
मोहयित्वा च तां देवीं पठित्वा तन्मतं शुभम् ॥
पुनरागच्छ वै शीघ्रं सैन्ययोगं पुनः कुरु ॥ ॥ 38 ॥
3.3.m: Enchanting that queen, and reciting her auspicious teaching, / come back swiftly indeed, and assemble your army again.”

3.3.s:
ityuktvāntardadhe devassa rājā vismayānvitaḥ ..
kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ varṇayāmāsa yathā dharmeṇa bhāṣitam .. 39 ..
3.3.d:
इत्युक्त्वान्तर्दधे देवस्स राजा विस्मयान्वितः ॥
कृष्णांशं वर्णयामास यथा धर्मेण भाषितम् ॥ 39 ॥
3.3.m: Having spoken thus, the god disappeared. Filled with amazement, the king / described [it all] to the portion of Kṛṣṇa, exactly as told by Dharma.

3.3.s:
phālgune māsi saṃprāpte trayaste yogirūpiṇaḥ ..
yayurinnagaṭaṃ ramyaṃ nṛtyagītaviśāradāḥ .. 3.3.23.40 ..
3.3.d:
फाल्गुने मासि संप्राप्ते त्रयस्ते योगिरूपिणः ॥
ययुरिन्नगटं रम्यं नृत्यगीतविशारदाः ॥ 3.3.23.40 ॥
3.3.m: When the month of Phālguna arrived, the three of them, disguised as yogis, / skilled in dance and song, went to the charming Innagaṭa.

3.3.s:
mṛdaṃgāṃkastadā devo makaraṃdo vipaṃcimān..
nṛtyagānakaro vīraḥ kṛṣṇāṃśaḥ sarva mohanaḥ .. 41 ..
3.3.d:
मृदंगांकस्तदा देवो मकरंदो विपंचिमान्॥
नृत्यगानकरो वीरः कृष्णांशः सर्व मोहनः ॥ 41 ॥
3.3.m: Then Lord [Devasiṃha] played the mṛdaṅga drum, Makaranda had the vīṇā, / and the hero who is a portion of Kṛṣṇa, enchanting everyone, sang and danced.

3.3.s:
mohayitvā ca nagaraṃ tathā gajapatiṃ nṛpam ..
sakulaṃ ca sasainyaṃ ca tuṣṭo rājābravīdididam .. 42 ..
3.3.d:
मोहयित्वा च नगरं तथा गजपतिं नृपम् ॥
सकुलं च ससैन्यं च तुष्टो राजाब्रवीदिदिदम् ॥ 42 ॥
3.3.m: Having enchanted the city, and likewise King Gajapati, / along with his family and army, the delighted king spoke this:

3.3.s:
vāṃchitaṃ brūhi me yoginsa śrutvā prāha namradhīḥ ..
dehi me sūryavarmāṇaṃ svasutaṃ kāryahetave ..43..
3.3.d:
वांछितं ब्रूहि मे योगिन्स श्रुत्वा प्राह नम्रधीः ॥
देहि मे सूर्यवर्माणं स्वसुतं कार्यहेतवे ॥43॥
3.3.m: “Tell me your desire, O yogi!” Having heard that, with humble mind he said: / “Give me Sūryavarman, your own son, for the sake of our mission.

3.3.s:
kṛtvā kāryamahaṃ śīghraṃ punardāsyami te sutam..
vidhinā nirmito dharmo rājabhirviśvarakṣaṇam ..44..
3.3.d:
कृत्वा कार्यमहं शीघ्रं पुनर्दास्यमि ते सुतम्॥
विधिना निर्मितो धर्मो राजभिर्विश्वरक्षणम् ॥44॥
3.3.m: Having quickly accomplished the mission, I will give your son back to you; / the duty ordained by Fate for kings is the protection of the universe.”

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā gajapatirdattvā tebhyaḥ svakaṃ sutam ..
svarājñīmāyayau rājā gatāste kāryatatparāḥ ..45..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा गजपतिर्दत्त्वा तेभ्यः स्वकं सुतम् ॥
स्वराज्ञीमाययौ राजा गतास्ते कार्यतत्पराः ॥45॥
3.3.m: Hearing this, Gajapati gave them his own son; / the king went to his queen, and they departed intent upon their task.

3.3.s:
pakṣamātreṇa bāhlīkaṃ nagaraṃ prayayurmudā ..
dharmadattāni yaṃtrāṇi gṛhītvā śatrumaṃdiram .. 46 ..
3.3.d:
पक्षमात्रेण बाह्लीकं नगरं प्रययुर्मुदा ॥
धर्मदत्तानि यंत्राणि गृहीत्वा शत्रुमंदिरम् ॥ 46 ॥
3.3.m: Within just a fortnight, they gladly went to the city of Bāhlīka, / taking the magical diagrams given by Dharma to the dwelling of the enemy.

3.3.s:
āyayurlāsyatattvajñā nṛpamohanatatparāḥ ..
sarve ca nāgarāḥ prāptāstatra kṣatragaṇā mudā ..47..
3.3.d:
आययुर्लास्यतत्त्वज्ञा नृपमोहनतत्पराः ॥
सर्वे च नागराः प्राप्तास्तत्र क्षत्रगणा मुदा ॥47॥
3.3.m: Knowing the principles of dance, intent on enchanting the king, they arrived; / and all the citizens and the hosts of kṣatriyas gathered there joyfully.

3.3.s:
mohitāstaiśca te sarve gītanṛtyaviśāradaiḥ ..
mahaddhanaṃ dadau tebhyastomarānvayasaṃbhavāḥ ..48..
3.3.d:
मोहितास्तैश्च ते सर्वे गीतनृत्यविशारदैः ॥
महद्धनं ददौ तेभ्यस्तोमरान्वयसंभवाः ॥48॥
3.3.m: They were all enchanted by those skilled in song and dance; / those born of the Tomara lineage gave them immense wealth.

3.3.s:
tānādāya punarbhūpaḥ svagehamabhinaṃdanaḥ ..
āyayau gehanṛtyārthī kārayāmāsa vai punaḥ ..49..
3.3.d:
तानादाय पुनर्भूपः स्वगेहमभिनंदनः ॥
आययौ गेहनृत्यार्थी कारयामास वै पुनः ॥49॥
3.3.m: Taking them, King Abhinandana again went to his own palace; / desiring a dance in his house, he had it performed once more.

3.3.s:
makaraṃdastadā vīṇāṃ mṛdaṃgaṃ bhīṣmajo balī..
maṃjīraṃ sūryavarmā ca kṛṣṇāṃśo gānanṛtyakam ..3.3.23.50..
3.3.d:
मकरंदस्तदा वीणां मृदंगं भीष्मजो बली॥
मंजीरं सूर्यवर्मा च कृष्णांशो गाननृत्यकम् ॥3.3.23.50॥
3.3.m: Then Makaranda [played] the vīṇā, the mighty son of Bhīṣma the mṛdaṅga drum, / Sūryavarman the cymbals, and the portion of Kṛṣṇa performed singing and dancing.

3.3.s:
gṛhītvā modayāmāsurnārīvṛndā mahottamam ..
citrarekhā svayaṃ dṛṣṭvā teṣāṃ mohanahetave .. 51 ..
3.3.d:
गृहीत्वा मोदयामासुर्नारीवृन्दा महोत्तमम् ॥
चित्ररेखा स्वयं दृष्ट्वा तेषां मोहनहेतवे ॥ 51 ॥
3.3.m: Holding these, they delighted the multitude of women exceedingly; / Citrarekhā herself, having seen them, for the sake of enchanting them,

3.3.s:
māyāṃ nirvāpayāmāsa niṣphalā sā'bhavatkṣaṇāt ..
mohitā taiśca sā devī tānuvāca mudānvitā .. 52 ..
3.3.d:
मायां निर्वापयामास निष्फला साऽभवत्क्षणात् ॥
मोहिता तैश्च सा देवी तानुवाच मुदान्विता ॥ 52 ॥
3.3.m: discharged a magical illusion; but in an instant it became fruitless. / Enchanted by them, that queen, filled with joy, spoke to them:

3.3.s:
vāṃchitaṃ brūhi me vīra kṛṣṇāṃśaścāha tāṃ vadhūm..
śukaṃ dehi ca me dehi no cecchāpaṃ dadāmya'ham .. 53 ..
3.3.d:
वांछितं ब्रूहि मे वीर कृष्णांशश्चाह तां वधूम्॥
