शुकं देहि च मे देहि नो चेच्छापं ददाम्यऽहम् ॥ 53 ॥
3.3.m: “O hero, tell me your desire!” And the portion of Kṛṣṇa said to the young woman: / “Give me the parrot, give it to me, or else I shall pronounce a curse!”

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā citrarekhā śokavyākulacetanā ..
kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ yoginaṃ prāha satyaṃ kathaya ko bhavān .. 54 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा चित्ररेखा शोकव्याकुलचेतना ॥
कृष्णांशं योगिनं प्राह सत्यं कथय को भवान् ॥ 54 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing this, Citrarekhā, her mind agitated with grief, / said to the yogi, the portion of Kṛṣṇa: “Tell the truth, who are you?

3.3.s:
iṃdrādyā devatāssarve mayā nirmitayā yayā ..
mohitāḥ kṣaṇamātreṇa na bhavānmohito mayā ..55..
3.3.d:
इंद्राद्या देवतास्सर्वे मया निर्मितया यया ॥
मोहिताः क्षणमात्रेण न भवान्मोहितो मया ॥55॥
3.3.m: All the deities headed by Indra were enchanted in an instant / by me through the [illusion] that I produced; yet you were not enchanted by me.

3.3.s:
devo nārāyaṇo vāpi dharmo vāpi śivaḥ svayam ..
ityuktassa tu kṛṣṇāṃśo vacanaṃ prāha nirbhayaḥ ..56..
3.3.d:
देवो नारायणो वापि धर्मो वापि शिवः स्वयम् ॥
इत्युक्तस्स तु कृष्णांशो वचनं प्राह निर्भयः ॥56॥
3.3.m: Are you Lord Nārāyaṇa, or Dharma, or Śiva himself?” / Addressed thus, that portion of Kṛṣṇa spoke fearless words:

3.3.s:
udayo nāma me rājñi devasiṃho'yamuttamaḥ ..
macchyālo makaraṃdo'yaṃ sūryavarmā tathāvidhaḥ .. 57 ..
3.3.d:
उदयो नाम मे राज्ञि देवसिंहोऽयमुत्तमः ॥
मच्छ्यालो मकरंदोऽयं सूर्यवर्मा तथाविधः ॥ 57 ॥
3.3.m: “O queen, my name is Udaya; this excellent one is Devasiṃha; / this is my brother-in-law Makaranda; and Sūryavarman is such a one.

3.3.s:
indulasya viyogena vayaṃ yogitvamāgatāḥ ..
madguruśca tathonmādī saṃkulastadviyogataḥ .. 58 ..
3.3.d:
इन्दुलस्य वियोगेन वयं योगित्वमागताः ॥
मद्गुरुश्च तथोन्मादी संकुलस्तद्वियोगतः ॥ 58 ॥
3.3.m: Because of separation from Indula, we have assumed the state of yogis; / and my teacher, distressed by separation from him, has likewise become mad.

3.3.s:
śukaṃ dehi mahāmāye iṃdulaṃ dehi vā yadi ..
ityuktvāśu rurodoccairhā indula mahābala .. 59 ..
3.3.d:
शुकं देहि महामाये इंदुलं देहि वा यदि ॥
इत्युक्त्वाशु रुरोदोच्चैर्हा इन्दुल महाबल ॥ 59 ॥
3.3.m: Give the parrot, O Mahāmāyā, or else give Indula!” / Having spoken thus, he wept aloud: “Alas, Indula of mighty strength!

3.3.s:
darśanaṃ dehi me śīghraṃ no cetprāṇāṃstyajāmyaham ..
ityevaṃvādinaṃ vīraṃ citrarekhā mahottamā .. 3.3.23.60 ..
3.3.d:
दर्शनं देहि मे शीघ्रं नो चेत्प्राणांस्त्यजाम्यहम् ॥
इत्येवंवादिनं वीरं चित्ररेखा महोत्तमा ॥ 3.3.23.60 ॥
3.3.m: Show yourself to me quickly, or else I shall abandon my life!” / As the hero was speaking in this way, the most excellent Citrarekhā,

3.3.s:
kṛtvā lajjāṃ punaḥ prāha māṃ ca putraṃ gṛhāṇa bhoḥ ..
kṛtvā naramayaṃ rūpaṃ svakāntaṃ sarvasuṃdaram .. 61 ..
3.3.d:
कृत्वा लज्जां पुनः प्राह मां च पुत्रं गृहाण भोः ॥
कृत्वा नरमयं रूपं स्वकान्तं सर्वसुंदरम् ॥ 61 ॥
3.3.m: feeling shame, said again: “Take both me and my son, sir!” / Making her beloved, who was handsome in every limb, assume human form,

3.3.s:
patitvā taccaraṇayo rurodoccaiśca daṃpatī ..
tathāvidhau ca tau dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇāṃśo harṣasaṃyutaḥ .. 62 ..
3.3.d:
पतित्वा तच्चरणयो रुरोदोच्चैश्च दंपती ॥
तथाविधौ च तौ दृष्ट्वा कृष्णांशो हर्षसंयुतः ॥ 62 ॥
3.3.m: the couple fell at his feet and wept aloud. / Seeing the two of them in such a state, the portion of Kṛṣṇa was filled with joy.

3.3.s:
iṃdulenaiva likhitaṃ gṛhītvā patramuttamam..
dharmayaṃtraprabhāveṇa mayūranagaraṃ yayau .. 63 ..
3.3.d:
इंदुलेनैव लिखितं गृहीत्वा पत्रमुत्तमम्॥
धर्मयंत्रप्रभावेण मयूरनगरं ययौ ॥ 63 ॥
3.3.m: Taking the excellent letter written by Indula himself, / through the power of Dharma's magical diagram, he went to Mayūranagara.

3.3.s:
sūryavarmā gato gehaṃ makaraṃdena mānitaḥ ..
devasiṃhastu balavāngṛhītvā patramuttamam ..64..
3.3.d:
सूर्यवर्मा गतो गेहं मकरंदेन मानितः ॥
देवसिंहस्तु बलवान्गृहीत्वा पत्रमुत्तमम् ॥64॥
3.3.m: Honored by Makaranda, Sūryavarman went home. / But the mighty Devasiṃha, taking the excellent letter,

3.3.s:
yayau manorathārūḍho yatrāhlādaḥ śucānvitaḥ ..
ko bhavāniti taṃ prāha mahonmādīva dṛśyate .. 65 ..
3.3.d:
ययौ मनोरथारूढो यत्राह्लादः शुचान्वितः ॥
को भवानिति तं प्राह महोन्मादीव दृश्यते ॥ 65 ॥
3.3.m: mounted upon a chariot of his desire, went to where Āhlāda was, overcome with sorrow. / [Āhlāda], who looked like a great madman, said to him: “Who are you?”

3.3.s:
devasiṃhaṃ ca māṃ viddhi tava putrānveṣaṇe ratam ..
patraṃ gṛhāṇa bho vīra likhitaṃ tatsutena vai .. 66 ..
3.3.d:
देवसिंहं च मां विद्धि तव पुत्रान्वेषणे रतम् ॥
पत्रं गृहाण भो वीर लिखितं तत्सुतेन वै ॥ 66 ॥
3.3.m: “Know me to be Devasiṃha, devoted to the search for your son; / take the letter, O hero, written indeed by your son!”

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā sa āhlādaścā hlādaṃ paramāptavān ..
jñātvā tatkāraṇaṃ sarvaṃ yathāvidhi suto hṛtaḥ ..67..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा स आह्लादश्चा ह्लादं परमाप्तवान् ॥
ज्ञात्वा तत्कारणं सर्वं यथाविधि सुतो हृतः ॥67॥
3.3.m: Hearing this, Āhlāda attained supreme delight; / he understood the whole reason why his son had been carried off in that manner.

3.3.s:
mahīpatiṃ samāhūya vacanaṃ prāha namradhīḥ..
satyaṃ kathaya me bhūpa kṛṣṇāṃśena hatassutaḥ .. 68 ..
3.3.d:
महीपतिं समाहूय वचनं प्राह नम्रधीः॥
सत्यं कथय मे भूप कृष्णांशेन हतस्सुतः ॥ 68 ॥
3.3.m: Summoning the king, with humble mind he said: / “Tell me the truth, O king! Was my son slain by the portion of Kṛṣṇa?”

3.3.s:
sa hovāca śrutaṃ vīra kṛṣṇāṃśena yathā hataḥ ..
ityuktvā tu vihasyāśu kāryasiddhimupāgataḥ .. 69 ..
3.3.d:
स होवाच श्रुतं वीर कृष्णांशेन यथा हतः ॥
इत्युक्त्वा तु विहस्याशु कार्यसिद्धिमुपागतः ॥ 69 ॥
3.3.m: He replied: “It was heard, O hero, that he was slain by the portion of Kṛṣṇa.” / Having spoken thus, laughing quickly, he attained the accomplishment of his purpose.

3.3.s:
ahlādaḥ krodhatāmrākṣaḥ keśānā kṛṣya taṃ mudā ..
vetasaistāḍayāmāsa svahastena punaḥ punaḥ .. 3.3.23.70 ..
3.3.d:
अह्लादः क्रोधताम्राक्षः केशाना कृष्य तं मुदा ॥
वेतसैस्ताडयामास स्वहस्तेन पुनः पुनः ॥ 3.3.23.70 ॥
3.3.m: Āhlāda, his eyes red with rage, pulling him joyfully by the hair, / struck him again and again with his own hand using cane rods.

3.3.s:
śrutvā parimalo rājā sapatnīkassamāgataḥ ..
bahudhā modayāmāsa rāmāṃśaṃ bahurūpiṇam .. 71 ..
3.3.d:
श्रुत्वा परिमलो राजा सपत्नीकस्समागतः ॥
बहुधा मोदयामास रामांशं बहुरूपिणम् ॥ 71 ॥
3.3.m: Having heard of it, King Parimala came along with his wife; / he cheered the multiform portion of Rāma in many ways.

3.3.s:
are dhūrta mahāpāpinmadbaṃdhurghātitastvayā ..
gato yatra mama prāṇassakulaṃ tvāṃ nayāmyaham .. 72 ..
3.3.d:
अरे धूर्त महापापिन्मद्बंधुर्घातितस्त्वया ॥
गतो यत्र मम प्राणस्सकुलं त्वां नयाम्यहम् ॥ 72 ॥
3.3.m: "Ah, rogue, great sinner! You have had my brother killed! / Where my life has gone, there shall I take you along with your kin!"

3.3.s:
tadā mahīpatirduḥkhī niḥśvāso maunamāsthitaḥ ..
tadaghaṃ hṛdi saṃsthāpya mahāpīḍāmavāptavān .. 73 ..
3.3.d:
तदा महीपतिर्दुःखी निःश्वासो मौनमास्थितः ॥
तदघं हृदि संस्थाप्य महापीडामवाप्तवान् ॥ 73 ॥
3.3.m: Then the king, sorrowful, sighing, took to silence; / holding that sin in his heart, he suffered great affliction.

3.3.s:
etasminnaṃtare vīro balakhāniḥ samāgataḥ ..
vimucya mātulaṃ dhūrtaṃ jyeṣṭhabandhumasāntvayat .. 74 ..
3.3.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे वीरो बलखानिः समागतः ॥
विमुच्य मातुलं धूर्तं ज्येष्ठबन्धुमसान्त्वयत् ॥ 74 ॥
3.3.m: In the meantime, the heroic Balakhāni arrived; / releasing the roguish maternal uncle, he consoled his elder brother.

3.3.s:
sa cakāra vivāhārthamudyogaṃ bhrātṛjasya vai ..
netrasiṃho nṛpaḥ prāpto lakṣasainyasamanvitaḥ .. 75 ..
3.3.d:
स चकार विवाहार्थमुद्योगं भ्रातृजस्य वै ॥
नेत्रसिंहो नृपः प्राप्तो लक्षसैन्यसमन्वितः ॥ 75 ॥
3.3.m: He made preparations for the marriage of his nephew. / King Netrasiṃha arrived, accompanied by an army of one hundred thousand.

3.3.s:
tārakaśca tamāyātassārddhaṃ śūrasahasrakaiḥ ..
vīrasenaḥ svayaṃ prāptaḥ śūraiḥ sārddhaṃ navā'yutaiḥ .. 76 ..
3.3.d:
तारकश्च तमायातस्सार्द्धं शूरसहस्रकैः ॥
वीरसेनः स्वयं प्राप्तः शूरैः सार्द्धं नवाऽयुतैः ॥ 76 ॥
3.3.m: And Tāraka came to him together with thousands of heroes; / Vīrasena himself arrived with ninety thousand heroes.

3.3.s:
tālanaśca tataḥ prāpto lakṣasainyasama nvitaḥ ..
sūryavarmā tathā prāpto lakṣasainyasamanvitaḥ .. 77 ..
3.3.d:
तालनश्च ततः प्राप्तो लक्षसैन्यसम न्वितः ॥
सूर्यवर्मा तथा प्राप्तो लक्षसैन्यसमन्वितः ॥ 77 ॥
3.3.m: Then Tālana arrived, accompanied by an army of one hundred thousand; / likewise Sūryavarmā arrived, accompanied by an army of one hundred thousand.

3.3.s:
brahmānaṃdaḥ svayaṃ prāptastrilakṣabalasaṃyutaḥ ..
āhlādaśca śucāviṣṭo lakṣasainya samanvitaḥ .. 78 ..
3.3.d:
ब्रह्मानंदः स्वयं प्राप्तस्त्रिलक्षबलसंयुतः ॥
आह्लादश्च शुचाविष्टो लक्षसैन्य समन्वितः ॥ 78 ॥
3.3.m: Brahmānanda himself arrived, joined by a force of three hundred thousand; / and Āhlāda, overcome with grief, [came] accompanied by an army of one hundred thousand.

3.3.s:
hā baṃdho kva gatastvaṃ vai māṃ tyaktvā puruṣādhamam ..
ityuktvā prayayau vīraḥ śokavyākulacetanaḥ .. 79 ..
3.3.d:
हा बंधो क्व गतस्त्वं वै मां त्यक्त्वा पुरुषाधमम् ॥
इत्युक्त्वा प्रययौ वीरः शोकव्याकुलचेतनः ॥ 79 ॥
3.3.m: "Alas, brother, where have you gone, having abandoned me, the lowest of men?" / Having spoken thus, the hero departed, his mind agitated by sorrow.

3.3.s:
balakhānistu balavām̐llakṣasainyasamanvitaḥ ..
devasiṃhena sahito bāhlīkaṃ prati sogamat .. 3.3.23.80 ..
3.3.d:
बलखानिस्तु बलवाम्̐ल्लक्षसैन्यसमन्वितः ॥
देवसिंहेन सहितो बाह्लीकं प्रति सोगमत् ॥ 3.3.23.80 ॥
3.3.m: Mighty Balakhāni, however, accompanied by an army of one hundred thousand, / went towards Bāhlīka together with Devasiṃha.

3.3.s:
ahorātrapramāṇena māsaikaḥ pathi vai gataḥ ..
jyeṣṭhakṛṣṇasya paṃcamyāṃ vāhlīkagrāmamāptavān ..
vyūhaḥ svakīyasainyānāṃ racito balakhāninā .. 81 ..
3.3.d:
अहोरात्रप्रमाणेन मासैकः पथि वै गतः ॥
ज्येष्ठकृष्णस्य पंचम्यां वाह्लीकग्राममाप्तवान् ॥
व्यूहः स्वकीयसैन्यानां रचितो बलखानिना ॥ 81 ॥
3.3.m: By the measure of day and night, one month passed on the road; / on the fifth [tithi] of the dark fortnight of Jyeṣṭha, he reached the village of Vāhlīka. / A battle array of his own troops was arranged by Balakhāni:

3.3.s:
eko rathaḥ sthito yuddhe tatpaścātsaṃsthitā gajāḥ ..
pañcāśacca kramātteṣāṃ vājinaśca śataṃśatam .. 82 ..
3.3.d:
एको रथः स्थितो युद्धे तत्पश्चात्संस्थिता गजाः ॥
पञ्चाशच्च क्रमात्तेषां वाजिनश्च शतंशतम् ॥ 82 ॥
3.3.m: One chariot stood in the battle, and behind it stood elephants; / fifty in order of them, and horses one hundred by one hundred.

3.3.s:
teṣāṃ paścātkramājjñeyā pattayo daśa saṃsthitāḥ ..
ekā senā ca sā jñeyā tatpramāṇaṃ bravīmyaham .. 83 ..
3.3.d:
तेषां पश्चात्क्रमाज्ज्ञेया पत्तयो दश संस्थिताः ॥
एका सेना च सा ज्ञेया तत्प्रमाणं ब्रवीम्यहम् ॥ 83 ॥
3.3.m: Behind them, ten foot-soldiers are to be known standing in order. / That is to be known as one division, and I shall tell its measure:

3.3.s:
eko ratho gajāssarve śatārddhaṃ tu hayāstu ye ..
senāyāṃ pañcasāhasrāḥ śataghnyastu tathā smṛtāḥ.. 84 ..
3.3.d:
एको रथो गजास्सर्वे शतार्द्धं तु हयास्तु ये ॥
सेनायां पञ्चसाहस्राः शतघ्न्यस्तु तथा स्मृताः॥ 84 ॥
3.3.m: One chariot, all the elephants, half a hundred, and whatever horses there are— / five thousand in a division, and likewise śataghnīs are traditionally taught.

3.3.s:
pañcāyutāni senāyāṃ sarve padacarāḥ smṛtāḥ ..
evaṃvidhāśca tāḥ senā balakhāneśca ṣoḍaśa .. 85 ..
3.3.d:
पञ्चायुतानि सेनायां सर्वे पदचराः स्मृताः ॥
एवंविधाश्च ताः सेना बलखानेश्च षोडश ॥ 85 ॥
3.3.m: Fifty thousand in a division are traditionally taught to be all foot-soldiers. / And of such kind were the sixteen divisions of Balakhāni.

3.3.s:
gajāstu daśasāhasrā madamattāḥ pṛthagyayuḥ ..
yuddhe 'smingaṇitaṃ hyevaṃ śūrāḥ śatruprahāriṇaḥ .. 86 ..
3.3.d:
गजास्तु दशसाहस्रा मदमत्ताः पृथग्ययुः ॥
युद्धे ऽस्मिन्गणितं ह्येवं शूराः शत्रुप्रहारिणः ॥ 86 ॥
3.3.m: Ten thousand elephants, intoxicated with rut, marched separately. / Thus was the calculation in this battle of heroes striking the enemy.

3.3.s:
abhinandanabhūpasya mlecchāḥ paiśācadharmiṇaḥ ..
trilakṣāśca hayārūḍhā ekalakṣāḥ śatapripāḥ? .. .. 87 ..
3.3.d:
अभिनन्दनभूपस्य म्लेच्छाः पैशाचधर्मिणः ॥
त्रिलक्षाश्च हयारूढा एकलक्षाः शतप्रिपाः? ॥ ॥ 87 ॥
3.3.m: Of King Abhinandana there were mlecchas of piśāca-like nature: / three hundred thousand mounted on horses, [and] one hundred thousand […];

3.3.s:
ekalakṣaḥ padacarā bhuśuṇḍīparighāyudhāḥ ..
tomarānvayasaṃyuktāḥ kṣatriyāḥ prayutāni vai ..
gajasthāstatra saṃprāptā yatrāhlādamahā camūḥ .. 88 ..
3.3.d:
एकलक्षः पदचरा भुशुण्डीपरिघायुधाः ॥
तोमरान्वयसंयुक्ताः क्षत्रियाः प्रयुतानि वै ॥
गजस्थास्तत्र संप्राप्ता यत्राह्लादमहा चमूः ॥ 88 ॥
3.3.m: One hundred thousand foot-soldiers armed with bhuśuṇḍīs and iron clubs; / and kṣatriyas belonging to the Tomara lineage, indeed millions / mounted on elephants, arrived there where Āhlāda's great army was.

3.3.s:
tayoścāsīnmahadyuddhaṃ tumulaṃ romaharṣaṇam ..
madamattāśca te sarve nirbhayā raṇamāyayuḥ .. 89 ..
3.3.d:
तयोश्चासीन्महद्युद्धं तुमुलं रोमहर्षणम् ॥
मदमत्ताश्च ते सर्वे निर्भया रणमाययुः ॥ 89 ॥
3.3.m: And between the two there was a great battle, tumultuous and hair-raising; / and all of them, intoxicated with pride, entered the battle fearlessly.

3.3.s:
saptāhorātramabhavadyuddhaṃ samaraśāli nām ..
bāhlīkasyārddhasenā ca kṣayaṃ nītā ca tairnṛpaiḥ .. 3.3.23.90 ..
3.3.d:
सप्ताहोरात्रमभवद्युद्धं समरशालि नाम् ॥
बाह्लीकस्यार्द्धसेना च क्षयं नीता च तैर्नृपैः ॥ 3.3.23.90 ॥
3.3.m: A battle of those adorned with valor took place for seven days and nights; / and half the army of the Bāhlīka [king] was brought to destruction by those kings.

3.3.s:
ekalakṣaṃ hatāḥ sarve balakhāneśca sainyapaiḥ ..
hāhābhūte śatrusainye bhayabhīte diśo gate ..
harṣitā balakhānyādyā jaya durge vaco'bruvan..91..
3.3.d:
एकलक्षं हताः सर्वे बलखानेश्च सैन्यपैः ॥
हाहाभूते शत्रुसैन्ये भयभीते दिशो गते ॥
हर्षिता बलखान्याद्या जय दुर्गे वचोऽब्रुवन्॥91॥
3.3.m: One hundred thousand were all slain by Balakhāni's commanders. / When the enemy army cried out "Alas, alas!", terrified and fleeing in all directions, / Balakhāni and the others, delighted, spoke the words: "Victory to Durgā!"

3.3.s:
dṛṣṭvā sainyavināśaṃ ca rājñaḥ saptakumārakāḥ ..
kauravāṃśāśca te jagmuryatra jāto mahārathāḥ..92..
3.3.d:
दृष्ट्वा सैन्यविनाशं च राज्ञः सप्तकुमारकाः ॥
कौरवांशाश्च ते जग्मुर्यत्र जातो महारथाः॥92॥
3.3.m: Seeing the destruction of the army, the seven sons of the king, / who were portions of the Kauravas, great chariot-warriors, went to where it had happened:

3.3.s:
mahānandaśca nandaśca parānandopanandakau ..
sunandaśca surānandaḥ pranandaḥ kramatobhavāḥ .. 93 ..
3.3.d:
महानन्दश्च नन्दश्च परानन्दोपनन्दकौ ॥
सुनन्दश्च सुरानन्दः प्रनन्दः क्रमतोभवाः ॥ 93 ॥
3.3.m: Mahānanda and Nanda, Parānanda and Upanandaka, / Sunanda, Surānanda, and Prananda, born in succession.

3.3.s:
gajasthāste mahāvīrāstomarānvayasaṃbhavāḥ ..
senāṃ jaghnuḥ śaraistīkṣṇairbalakhānermahātmanaḥ .. 94 ..
3.3.d:
गजस्थास्ते महावीरास्तोमरान्वयसंभवाः ॥
सेनां जघ्नुः शरैस्तीक्ष्णैर्बलखानेर्महात्मनः ॥ 94 ॥
3.3.m: Mounted on elephants, those great heroes born of the Tomara lineage / struck with sharp arrows the army of the great-souled Balakhāni.

3.3.s:
bhayabhītāśca te sarve balakhānimupāyayu ..
dṛṣṭvā sainyaṃ parābhūtaṃ balakhānistadā ruṣā .. 95 ..
3.3.d:
भयभीताश्च ते सर्वे बलखानिमुपाययु ॥
दृष्ट्वा सैन्यं पराभूतं बलखानिस्तदा रुषा ॥ 95 ॥
3.3.m: Terrified by fear, they all approached Balakhāni. / Seeing his army defeated, Balakhāni then, in wrath,

3.3.s:
abhyadhāvata vegena kapotastho mahābalaḥ ..
naṃdaṃ prati tathā devaḥ parānaṃdaṃ ca tālanaḥ .. 96 ..
3.3.d:
अभ्यधावत वेगेन कपोतस्थो महाबलः ॥
नंदं प्रति तथा देवः परानंदं च तालनः ॥ 96 ॥
3.3.m: rushed forward with speed, the mighty one mounted on Kapota; / Deva likewise against Nanda, and Tālana against Parānanda;

3.3.s:
upanandaṃ sūryavarmā sunandaṃ prati tārakaḥ ..
netrasiṃhaḥ surānandaṃ pranandaṃ prati yādavaḥ .. 97 ..
3.3.d:
उपनन्दं सूर्यवर्मा सुनन्दं प्रति तारकः ॥
नेत्रसिंहः सुरानन्दं प्रनन्दं प्रति यादवः ॥ 97 ॥
3.3.m: Sūryavarmā against Upananda; Tāraka against Sunanda; / Netrasiṃha against Surānanda; and the Yādava against Prananda.

3.3.s:
yudhyamānāstu te sarve parasparaṃ vadhaiṣiṇaḥ ..
dinārddhamabhavadyuddhaṃ bahuvīrapraṇāśanam .. 98 ..
3.3.d:
युध्यमानास्तु ते सर्वे परस्परं वधैषिणः ॥
दिनार्द्धमभवद्युद्धं बहुवीरप्रणाशनम् ॥ 98 ॥
3.3.m: All of them fighting, desiring to slay one another; / for half a day there was a battle that destroyed many heroes.

3.3.s:
parājitāstu te putrā bāhlīkasya mahābalāḥ ..
tyaktvā yuddhaṃ yayurgehaṃ bhīrukā balakhāninā .. 99 ..
3.3.d:
पराजितास्तु ते पुत्रा बाह्लीकस्य महाबलाः ॥
त्यक्त्वा युद्धं ययुर्गेहं भीरुका बलखानिना ॥ 99 ॥
3.3.m: Those mighty sons of Bāhlīka were defeated; / abandoning the battle, cowardly, they went home, [overcome] by Balakhāni.

3.3.s:
dṛṣṭvā teṣāṃ balaṃ ghoramabhinandanabhūmipaḥ ..
kutukaṃ ca samāhūya nāṭyāṃ kesīraṇīṃ tathā ..
kathitaṃ kāraṇaṃ rājñā yathā jātaḥ parājayaḥ .. 3.3.23.100 ..
3.3.d:
दृष्ट्वा तेषां बलं घोरमभिनन्दनभूमिपः ॥
कुतुकं च समाहूय नाट्यां केसीरणीं तथा ॥
कथितं कारणं राज्ञा यथा जातः पराजयः ॥ 3.3.23.100 ॥
3.3.m: Seeing their terrible army, King Abhinandana / summoned Kutuka and the dancer Kesīraṇī; / the cause was recounted by the king, how the defeat occurred.

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā tu kutukastamāśvāsya mahīpatim ..
sa dhyātvā śāṃbarīṃ māyāṃ mahādevena nirmitām ..
tatsainyaṃ mohayāmāsa śilābhūtamacetanam .. 101 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा तु कुतुकस्तमाश्वास्य महीपतिम् ॥
स ध्यात्वा शांबरीं मायां महादेवेन निर्मिताम् ॥
तत्सैन्यं मोहयामास शिलाभूतमचेतनम् ॥ 101 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing this, Kutuka, having comforted the king, / contemplated the illusory magic of Śambara fashioned by Mahādeva, / and bewitched that army, making it turn to stone and senseless.

3.3.s:
tadā kesariṇī nāṭyā aṣṭau baddhvā mahābalān..
rājñaḥ pārśvamupāgamya dattvā tāngehamāyayau ..102..
3.3.d:
तदा केसरिणी नाट्या अष्टौ बद्ध्वा महाबलान्॥
राज्ञः पार्श्वमुपागम्य दत्त्वा तान्गेहमाययौ ॥102॥
3.3.m: Then the dancer Kesariṇī, having bound the eight mighty ones, / approached the presence of the king, handed them over, and went home.

3.3.s:
bāhlīkaśca prasannātmā baddhvā tānnigaḍairdṛḍhaiḥ ..
luṃṭhitvā draviṇaṃ teṣāṃ kośamadhye samākṣipat .. 103 ..
3.3.d:
बाह्लीकश्च प्रसन्नात्मा बद्ध्वा तान्निगडैर्दृढैः ॥
लुंठित्वा द्रविणं तेषां कोशमध्ये समाक्षिपत् ॥ 103 ॥
3.3.m: And the Bāhlīka [king], with delighted mind, having bound them with strong fetters, / plundered their wealth and threw it into his treasury.

3.3.s:
devyāśca varadānena devasiṃho bhayāturaḥ ..
mahāvatīṃ samāgamya svarṇavatyai nyavedayat .. 104 ..
3.3.d:
देव्याश्च वरदानेन देवसिंहो भयातुरः ॥
महावतीं समागम्य स्वर्णवत्यै न्यवेदयत् ॥ 104 ॥
3.3.m: And by the granting of a boon from the goddess, Devasiṃha, afflicted with fear, / arrived at Mahāvatī and informed Svarṇavatī.

3.3.s:
jñātvā svarṇavatī devī sarvavidyāviśāradā ..
śyenīṃ mūrtiṃ samāsthāya yayau puṣpavatīṃ prati .. 105 ..
3.3.d:
ज्ञात्वा स्वर्णवती देवी सर्वविद्याविशारदा ॥
श्येनीं मूर्तिं समास्थाय ययौ पुष्पवतीं प्रति ॥ 105 ॥
3.3.m: Having learned [this], queen Svarṇavatī, skilled in all sciences, / assumed the form of a female falcon and went towards Puṣpavatī.

3.3.s:
dṛṣṭvā tu daṃpatī tatra makaraṃdaṃ gṛhe sthitau ..
ruditvā kathayāmāsa yathā prāptaḥ parājayaḥ .. .. 106 ..
3.3.d:
दृष्ट्वा तु दंपती तत्र मकरंदं गृहे स्थितौ ॥
रुदित्वा कथयामास यथा प्राप्तः पराजयः ॥ ॥ 106 ॥
3.3.m: Seeing the married couple staying there at home with Makaranda, / she wept and recounted how the defeat had occurred.

3.3.s:
kṛṣṇāṃśastu tadā duḥkhī makarandaṃ vaco'bravīt ..
gaccha vīra mayā sārddhaṃ madgururbaṃdhanaṃ gataḥ .. 107 ..
3.3.d:
कृष्णांशस्तु तदा दुःखी मकरन्दं वचोऽब्रवीत् ॥
गच्छ वीर मया सार्द्धं मद्गुरुर्बंधनं गतः ॥ 107 ॥
3.3.m: Then the portion of Kṛṣṇa, sorrowful, addressed words to Makaranda: / "Go, hero, along with me; my guru has fallen into captivity.

3.3.s:
kulakṣaye mahatpāpaṃ suproktaṃ pūrva sūribhiḥ ..
nimagnānduḥkhajaladhau samuddhara mama priya .. 108 ..
3.3.d:
कुलक्षये महत्पापं सुप्रोक्तं पूर्व सूरिभिः ॥
निमग्नान्दुःखजलधौ समुद्धर मम प्रिय ॥ 108 ॥
3.3.m: Great sin in the destruction of one's family has been well spoken of by ancient sages; / deliver those submerged in the ocean of sorrow, my dear friend!"

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā tu tacchayālaḥ śūrāyutasamanvitaḥ ..
saṃnyastaveṣamāsthāya khaḍgacarmasamanvitaḥ ..
kṛṣṇāṃśena hayārūḍho bāhlīkaṃ tvarito yayau .. 109 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा तु तच्छयालः शूरायुतसमन्वितः ॥
संन्यस्तवेषमास्थाय खड्गचर्मसमन्वितः ॥
कृष्णांशेन हयारूढो बाह्लीकं त्वरितो ययौ ॥ 109 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing this, his brother-in-law, accompanied by ten thousand heroes, / assuming the dress of an ascetic, equipped with sword and shield, / mounted on a horse along with the portion of Kṛṣṇa, went swiftly to Bāhlīka.

3.3.s:
tadā svarṇavatī devī puṣpavatyā samanvitā ..
śyenīrūpamupāsthāya yayau yatra mahāraṇaḥ .. 3.3.23.110 ..
3.3.d:
तदा स्वर्णवती देवी पुष्पवत्या समन्विता ॥
श्येनीरूपमुपास्थाय ययौ यत्र महारणः ॥ 3.3.23.110 ॥
3.3.m: Then queen Svarṇavatī, accompanied by Puṣpavatī, / assuming the form of female falcons, went to where the great battle was.

3.3.s:
sa chittvā śāṃbarīṃ māyāṃ bodhayitvā svasainikān ..
rurodha nagarīṃ tasya bāhlīkasya mahātmanaḥ .. 111 ..
3.3.d:
स छित्त्वा शांबरीं मायां बोधयित्वा स्वसैनिकान् ॥
रुरोध नगरीं तस्य बाह्लीकस्य महात्मनः ॥ 111 ॥
3.3.m: Having severed the illusory magic of Śambara and awakened her soldiers, / she besieged the city of that great-souled Bāhlīka [king].

3.3.s:
dṛṣṭvā tāñchatrusaṃyuktānkutukastu tayā saha ..
punaśca śāṃbarīṃ māyāṃ preṣayāmāsa tānprati .. 112 ..
3.3.d:
दृष्ट्वा ताञ्छत्रुसंयुक्तान्कुतुकस्तु तया सह ॥
पुनश्च शांबरीं मायां प्रेषयामास तान्प्रति ॥ 112 ॥
3.3.m: Seeing them joined with the enemies, Kutuka together with her / once again sent forth the illusory magic of Śambara against them.

3.3.s:
chittvā sā sakalāṃ māyāṃ baddhvā tau daityasannibhau ..
nagaraṃ dāhayāmāsa tasya bhūpasya māyayā .. 113 ..
3.3.d:
छित्त्वा सा सकलां मायां बद्ध्वा तौ दैत्यसन्निभौ ॥
नगरं दाहयामास तस्य भूपस्य मायया ॥ 113 ॥
3.3.m: Having dispelled all illusion and bound those two who resembled Daityas, / she burned the king's city by her illusion.

3.3.s:
na dāho dāhamāpanno na bhasmī bhasmavānkhalu ..
svarṇavatyā kṛtaṃ citraṃ svayaṃ devyā ca māyayā .. .. 114 ..
3.3.d:
न दाहो दाहमापन्नो न भस्मी भस्मवान्खलु ॥
स्वर्णवत्या कृतं चित्रं स्वयं देव्या च मायया ॥ ॥ 114 ॥
3.3.m: There was no burning that underwent destruction, nor ash that truly remained as ash; / a wonder was wrought by Svarṇavatī herself, the goddess, through her illusion.

3.3.s:
tadā puṣpavatī devī hatvā kesariṇī ruṣā ..
tanmāṃsaistarpayāmāsa gṛdhragomāyuvāyasān .. 115 ..
3.3.d:
तदा पुष्पवती देवी हत्वा केसरिणी रुषा ॥
तन्मांसैस्तर्पयामास गृध्रगोमायुवायसान् ॥ 115 ॥
3.3.m: Then the goddess Puṣpavatī, having angrily slain Kesariṇī, / sated the vultures, jackals, and crows with her flesh.

3.3.s:
kutukaṃ ca tathābhūtaṃ hatvā svarṇavatī svayam ..
kārāgāre lohamaye sthitānvīrānamocayat .. 116 ..
3.3.d:
कुतुकं च तथाभूतं हत्वा स्वर्णवती स्वयम् ॥
कारागारे लोहमये स्थितान्वीरानमोचयत् ॥ 116 ॥
3.3.m: And having herself slain Kutuka, who had become likewise, / Svarṇavatī released the heroes who were held in the iron prison.

3.3.s:
punarāgamya sā devī tayā sārddhaṃ śubhānanā ..
makarandaḥ sthito yatra kṛṣṇāṃśena samanvitaḥ .. 117 ..
3.3.d:
पुनरागम्य सा देवी तया सार्द्धं शुभानना ॥
मकरन्दः स्थितो यत्र कृष्णांशेन समन्वितः ॥ 117 ॥
3.3.m: Returning again along with her, that fair-faced goddess / went to where Makaranda stayed, accompanied by Kṛṣṇāṃśa.

3.3.s:
te sarve vismitāścāsañjñātvā devyā vimohitāḥ ..
krodhavanto mahāvīrā yuddhāya samupāyayuḥ .. 118 ..
3.3.d:
ते सर्वे विस्मिताश्चासञ्ज्ञात्वा देव्या विमोहिताः ॥
क्रोधवन्तो महावीरा युद्धाय समुपाययुः ॥ 118 ॥
3.3.m: They were all astonished, and realizing they had been deluded by the goddess, / those mighty heroes, full of wrath, advanced to battle.

3.3.s:
punaścāsīttayoryuddhaṃ senayorubhayormṛdhe ..
balakhāniṃ mahānando nandaścāhlādamāyayau .. 119 ..
3.3.d:
पुनश्चासीत्तयोर्युद्धं सेनयोरुभयोर्मृधे ॥
बलखानिं महानन्दो नन्दश्चाह्लादमाययौ ॥ 119 ॥
3.3.m: Again the fight took place between those two armies in combat; / Mahānanda went against Balkhān, and Nanda against Āhlāda.

3.3.s:
parānaṃdastathā devaṃ tārakaṃ copanaṃdanaḥ ..
sunando netra siṃhaṃ ca surānaṃdaśca tālanam .. 3.3.23.120 ..
3.3.d:
परानंदस्तथा देवं तारकं चोपनंदनः ॥
सुनन्दो नेत्र सिंहं च सुरानंदश्च तालनम् ॥ 3.3.23.120 ॥
3.3.m: Parānanda went against Deva, Upanandana against Tāraka, / Sunanda against Netrasiṃha, and Surānanda against Tālana.

3.3.s:
pranando vīrasenaṃ ca brahmānandaṃ sa bhūpatiḥ ..
gajasthitāśca te sarve dhanuryuddhaparāyaṇāḥ ..
ahorātramabhūdyuddhaṃ teṣāṃ ca tumulaṃ kramāt .. 121 ..
3.3.d:
प्रनन्दो वीरसेनं च ब्रह्मानन्दं स भूपतिः ॥
गजस्थिताश्च ते सर्वे धनुर्युद्धपरायणाः ॥
अहोरात्रमभूद्युद्धं तेषां च तुमुलं क्रमात् ॥ 121 ॥
3.3.m: Prananda went against Vīrasena, and that king against Brahmānanda. / All of them, mounted on elephants and devoted to archery combat, / fought continuously day and night, their clash gradually turning into a tumult.

3.3.s:
etasminnantare rātrau citrarekhā samāgatā ..
svakīyānvyākulībhūtāṃstādṛśāṃśca vilokya vai .. 122 ..
3.3.d:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे रात्रौ चित्ररेखा समागता ॥
स्वकीयान्व्याकुलीभूतांस्तादृशांश्च विलोक्य वै ॥ 122 ॥
3.3.m: Meanwhile, Citrarekhā arrived at night, / and seeing her own people in such a distressed state,

3.3.s:
citraguptaṃ tadā dhyātvā citramāyāmacīkarat ..
tadā tadbāṃdhavāścāsanbahudhā cābhinaṃdanāḥ .. 123 ..
3.3.d:
चित्रगुप्तं तदा ध्यात्वा चित्रमायामचीकरत् ॥
तदा तद्बांधवाश्चासन्बहुधा चाभिनंदनाः ॥ 123 ॥
3.3.m: she meditated upon Citragupta and manifested a wondrous illusion; / then her relatives rejoiced in many ways.

3.3.s:
tān dṛṣṭvā vismitāḥ sarve bhayabhītāśca dudruvuḥ ..
tyaktvā yuddhamayīṃ bhūmiṃ śokavyākulacetanā .. 124 ..
3.3.d:
तान् दृष्ट्वा विस्मिताः सर्वे भयभीताश्च दुद्रुवुः ॥
त्यक्त्वा युद्धमयीं भूमिं शोकव्याकुलचेतना ॥ 124 ॥
3.3.m: Seeing them, all were astonished, and stricken with fear, they fled, / abandoning the battlefield, their minds bewildered by grief.

3.3.s:
paṃcayojanamāgatya tato vāsamakārayan ..
saṃdhyākāle tamobhūte nirutsāhā mahābalāḥ .. 125..
3.3.d:
पंचयोजनमागत्य ततो वासमकारयन् ॥
संध्याकाले तमोभूते निरुत्साहा महाबलाः ॥ 125॥
3.3.m: Having traveled five yojanas, they made camp there / at twilight as darkness fell, those mighty warriors bereft of zeal.

3.3.s:
hā kṛṣṇāṃśa mahābāho śaraṇāgatavatsala ..
indulaste kumāro'yaṃ saṃhṛtaścitrarekhayā .. 126 ..
3.3.d:
हा कृष्णांश महाबाहो शरणागतवत्सल ॥
इन्दुलस्ते कुमारोऽयं संहृतश्चित्ररेखया ॥ 126 ॥
3.3.m: "Alas, Kṛṣṇāṃśa, mighty-armed one, affectionate to those seeking refuge! / This youth, your Indula, has been seized by Citrarekhā!

3.3.s:
tayā vimohitā vīrā vayaṃ te śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ ..
ityuktvā rodanaṃ cakruḥ kva gato'si mahāmate ..127..
3.3.d:
तया विमोहिता वीरा वयं ते शरणं गताः ॥
इत्युक्त्वा रोदनं चक्रुः क्व गतोऽसि महामते ॥127॥
3.3.m: Deluded by her, we heroes have taken refuge with you!" / Saying this, they wept: "Where have you gone, O wise one?"

3.3.s:
tadā kolāhalaścāsīdrudatāṃ balaśālinām ..
āhlādaṃ garhayitvā te mūrchitā bhuvi vihvalāḥ .. 128 ..
3.3.d:
तदा कोलाहलश्चासीद्रुदतां बलशालिनाम् ॥
आह्लादं गर्हयित्वा ते मूर्छिता भुवि विह्वलाः ॥ 128 ॥
3.3.m: Then there was an uproar among those strong men who wept; / reproaching Āhlāda, they fell faint and distressed upon the ground.

3.3.s:
āhlādastu'tathā śrutvā vajrapātāhataḥ svayam ..
unmādivattadā bhūtvā tāḍayāmāsa vakṣasi .. 129 ..
3.3.d:
आह्लादस्तुऽतथा श्रुत्वा वज्रपाताहतः स्वयम् ॥
उन्मादिवत्तदा भूत्वा ताडयामास वक्षसि ॥ 129 ॥
3.3.m: Āhlāda, hearing that, felt struck as if by a thunderbolt; / becoming like a madman, he beat his chest.

3.3.s:
etasminnaṃtare yogī kṛṣṇāṃśo bhagavatkalā ..
caṃdrodaye svayaṃ prāptaścāṣṭamyāṃ bhṛguvāsare .. 3.3.23.130 ..
3.3.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे योगी कृष्णांशो भगवत्कला ॥
चंद्रोदये स्वयं प्राप्तश्चाष्टम्यां भृगुवासरे ॥ 3.3.23.130 ॥
3.3.m: Meanwhile, the yogin Kṛṣṇāṃśa, a portion of the Lord, / arrived in person at moonrise, on the aṣṭamī, on a Friday.

3.3.s:
śūraśca daśasāhasrairmakaraṃdena saṃyutaḥ ..
tatsenāṃ bodhayāmāsa pālitāṃ balakhā ninā .. 131 ..
3.3.d:
शूरश्च दशसाहस्रैर्मकरंदेन संयुतः ॥
तत्सेनां बोधयामास पालितां बलखा निना ॥ 131 ॥
3.3.m: The heroic warrior, accompanied by ten thousand and joined with Makaranda, / rallied that army protected by Balkhān.

3.3.s:
jitvā tānsarvabhūpālāngṛhītvā vipulaṃ dhanam ..
pañcaśabdasthitaṃ baṃdhuṃ pratyāgatya jagarja vai .. 132 ..
3.3.d:
जित्वा तान्सर्वभूपालान्गृहीत्वा विपुलं धनम् ॥
पञ्चशब्दस्थितं बंधुं प्रत्यागत्य जगर्ज वै ॥ 132 ॥
3.3.m: Having defeated all those kings and seized immense wealth, / he returned to his kinsman, who stood with five musical instruments, and roared aloud.

3.3.s:
tasya śabdena śeṣāṃśo bodhito balaśālinā ..
śakunaṃ śubhamālokya bhujāvutthāpya vīryavān ..
svāṃke niveśayāmāsa kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ yogirūpiṇam .. 133 ..
3.3.d:
तस्य शब्देन शेषांशो बोधितो बलशालिना ॥
शकुनं शुभमालोक्य भुजावुत्थाप्य वीर्यवान् ॥
स्वांके निवेशयामास कृष्णांशं योगिरूपिणम् ॥ 133 ॥
3.3.m: Awakened by his roar, that mighty hero, the portion of Śeṣa, / beholding an auspicious omen and raising his arms, the valiant one / took Kṛṣṇāṃśa, who had the form of a yogin, onto his lap.

3.3.s:
snāpayitvā śrudhārābhiḥ kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ premavihvalaḥ ..
dattvā dvijātimukhyebhyo varṇayāmāsa kāraṇam .. 134 ..
3.3.d:
स्नापयित्वा श्रुधाराभिः कृष्णांशं प्रेमविह्वलः ॥
दत्त्वा द्विजातिमुख्येभ्यो वर्णयामास कारणम् ॥ 134 ॥
3.3.m: Bathing Kṛṣṇāṃśa with streams of tears, overwhelmed with love, / he made gifts to the foremost of the twice-born and narrated the circumstance.

3.3.s:
kṛṣṇāṃśo'pi prasannātmā svakīyāṃ sakalāṃ kathām..
varṇayitvā yathābhūtāṃ punarbāhlīkamāyayau ..135..
3.3.d:
कृष्णांशोऽपि प्रसन्नात्मा स्वकीयां सकलां कथाम्॥
वर्णयित्वा यथाभूतां पुनर्बाह्लीकमाययौ ॥135॥
3.3.m: Kṛṣṇāṃśa too, with a delighted heart, having related his entire story / just as it had occurred, went again to Bāhlīka.

3.3.s:
citravidyāṃ svayaṃ kṛtvā pāṭhitāṃ citrarekhayā ..
baddhvābhinaṃdanaṃ bhūpaṃ sasutaṃ ca samaṃtriṇam ..
vivāhaṃ kārayāmāsa jayaṃtasya tayā saha .. 136 ..
3.3.d:
चित्रविद्यां स्वयं कृत्वा पाठितां चित्ररेखया ॥
बद्ध्वाभिनंदनं भूपं ससुतं च समंत्रिणम् ॥
विवाहं कारयामास जयंतस्य तया सह ॥ 136 ॥
3.3.m: Having himself performed the wondrous magic taught by Citrarekhā, / and having bound King Abhinandana along with his son and minister, / he arranged the marriage of Jayanta with her.

3.3.s:
bāhlīkastu prasannātmā dattvā ca vipulaṃ dhanam ..
svasutāṃ citrarekhāṃ ca jayantāya mudā dadau ..137..
3.3.d:
बाह्लीकस्तु प्रसन्नात्मा दत्त्वा च विपुलं धनम् ॥
स्वसुतां चित्ररेखां च जयन्ताय मुदा ददौ ॥137॥
3.3.m: Bāhlīka, with a pleased mind, having given immense wealth, / joyfully bestowed his daughter Citrarekhā upon Jayanta.

3.3.s:
śataṃ gajānhayāṃstatra sahasrāṇi dhanairyutān ..
śataṃ dāsāṃstathā dāsīrjayaṃtāya svaya dadau .. 138 ..
3.3.d:
शतं गजान्हयांस्तत्र सहस्राणि धनैर्युतान् ॥
शतं दासांस्तथा दासीर्जयंताय स्वय ददौ ॥ 138 ॥
3.3.m: A hundred elephants, thousands of horses accompanied with riches, / and a hundred male and female slaves he gave personally to Jayanta.

3.3.s:
prasthānaṃ kārayāmāsa balakhānermahātmanaḥ ..
śrāvaṇe māsi saṃprāptāste sarve ca mahāvatīm .. 139 ..
3.3.d:
प्रस्थानं कारयामास बलखानेर्महात्मनः ॥
श्रावणे मासि संप्राप्तास्ते सर्वे च महावतीम् ॥ 139 ॥
3.3.m: He caused the departure of the high-souled Balkhān; / and in the month of Śrāvaṇa they all reached Mahāvatī.

3.3.s:
svaṃsvaṃ gehaṃ yayussarve bhūpāścāhlādamānitāḥ ..
iti te kathitaṃ vipra caritraṃ kalināśa nam..
śṛṇvatāṃ sarvapāpaghnaṃ kathayiṣyāmi vai punaḥ .. 3.3.23.140 ..
3.3.d:
स्वंस्वं गेहं ययुस्सर्वे भूपाश्चाह्लादमानिताः ॥
इति ते कथितं विप्र चरित्रं कलिनाश नम्॥
शृण्वतां सर्वपापघ्नं कथयिष्यामि वै पुनः ॥ 3.3.23.140 ॥
3.3.m: All the kings, honored by Āhlāda, went to their respective homes. / Thus has been recounted to you, O brāhmaṇa, the narrative that destroys the Kali age, / which destroys all sins for those who hear it; I shall narrate further.

3.3.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
kṛṣṇāṃśe ca gṛhaṃ prāpte cendule ca vivāhite ..
mahīpatissadā duḥkhī dehalīṃ prati cāgamat.. 1 ..
3.3.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
कृष्णांशे च गृहं प्राप्ते चेन्दुले च विवाहिते ॥
महीपतिस्सदा दुःखी देहलीं प्रति चागमत्॥ 1 ॥
3.3.m: Sūta said: / When Kṛṣṇāṃśa had reached home and Indula was married, / Mahīpati, ever sorrowful, went toward Delhi.

3.3.s:
vṛttāṃtaṃ ca nṛpasyāgre kathayitvā sa tārakaḥ ..
paraṃ vismayamāpannaḥ kṛṣṇāṃśacaritaṃ prati .. 2 ..
3.3.d:
वृत्तांतं च नृपस्याग्रे कथयित्वा स तारकः ॥
परं विस्मयमापन्नः कृष्णांशचरितं प्रति ॥ 2 ॥
3.3.m: Having narrated the account before the king, that Tāraka / was filled with supreme astonishment regarding the deeds of Kṛṣṇāṃśa.

3.3.s:
etasminnaṃtare maṃtrī caṃdrabhaṭṭa udāradhīḥ ..
bhūmirājaṃ vacaḥ prāha śṛṇu pārthivasattama..3..
3.3.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे मंत्री चंद्रभट्ट उदारधीः ॥
भूमिराजं वचः प्राह शृणु पार्थिवसत्तम॥3॥
3.3.m: Meanwhile, the minister Candra Bhaṭṭa, of noble intellect, / addressed words to the king Bhūmirāja: "Hear, O best of earthly rulers!

3.3.s:
mayā cārādhitā devī vaiṣṇavī viśvakāriṇī ..
trivarṣāṃte ca tuṣṭābhūdvaradā bhayahāriṇī..4..
3.3.d:
मया चाराधिता देवी वैष्णवी विश्वकारिणी ॥
त्रिवर्षांते च तुष्टाभूद्वरदा भयहारिणी॥4॥
3.3.m: I propitiated the Vaiṣṇava goddess, the creator of the universe; / at the end of three years she was pleased, bestowing boons and removing fear.

3.3.s:
tayā dattaṃ śubhaṃ jñānaṃ kumatidhvaṃsakārakam..
tato'haṃ jñānavānbhūtvā kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ prati bhṛpate ..
caritraṃ varṇayāmāsa tasya kalmaṣanāśanam .. 5 ..
3.3.d:
तया दत्तं शुभं ज्ञानं कुमतिध्वंसकारकम्॥
ततोऽहं ज्ञानवान्भूत्वा कृष्णांशं प्रति भृपते ॥
चरित्रं वर्णयामास तस्य कल्मषनाशनम् ॥ 5 ॥
3.3.m: By her was given auspicious knowledge, which destroys wicked thoughts. / Thereupon, endowed with knowledge regarding Kṛṣṇāṃśa, O king, / I narrated his deeds which destroy sins."

3.3.s:
ityuktvā sa ca śuddhātmā graṃthaṃ bhāṣāmayaṃ śubham ..
māhātmyaṃ devibhaktānāṃ śrāvayāmāsa vai sabhām ..6..
3.3.d:
इत्युक्त्वा स च शुद्धात्मा ग्रंथं भाषामयं शुभम् ॥
माहात्म्यं देविभक्तानां श्रावयामास वै सभाम् ॥6॥
3.3.m: Having spoken thus, that pure-souled one recited to the assembly / an auspicious work composed in the vernacular, the majesty of the goddess's devotees.

3.3.s:
tacchrutvā bhūmirājastu vismitaścābhavatkṣa ṇāt ..
mahīpatistadā prāha divyāśvabaladarpitaḥ. ..
udayo nāma balavānyasyaivaṃ varṇitā kathā ..7..
3.3.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा भूमिराजस्तु विस्मितश्चाभवत्क्ष णात् ॥
महीपतिस्तदा प्राह दिव्याश्वबलदर्पितः॥।
उदयो नाम बलवान्यस्यैवं वर्णिता कथा ॥7॥
3.3.m: Hearing that, Bhūmirāja was astonished in an instant. / Then Mahīpati, arrogant with the might of divine horses, said: / "There is a mighty man named Udaya, whose story has thus been narrated.

3.3.s:
catvāro vājino divyā jalasthalakhagāśca te ..
śīghraṃ tāṃśca samāhṛtya svayaṃ bhūpa balī bhava .. 8 ..
3.3.d:
चत्वारो वाजिनो दिव्या जलस्थलखगाश्च ते ॥
शीघ्रं तांश्च समाहृत्य स्वयं भूप बली भव ॥ 8 ॥
3.3.m: Four are his divine horses, moving on water, land, and through the sky. / Quickly fetch them, O king, and become mighty yourself."

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā sa nṛpatiḥ śrutavākyaviśāradam ..
āhūya kuṃdanamalaṃ preṣayāmāsa satvaram .. 9 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा स नृपतिः श्रुतवाक्यविशारदम् ॥
आहूय कुंदनमलं प्रेषयामास सत्वरम् ॥ 9 ॥
3.3.m: Having heard this, that monarch summoned Kundanamala, / who was skilled in hearing and speaking, and dispatched him swiftly.

3.3.s:
mahāvatīṃ samāgatya sa dūto bhūpatiṃ prati ..
uvāca vacanaṃ premṇā mahīrājasya bhūpateḥ .. 3.3.24.10 ..
3.3.d:
महावतीं समागत्य स दूतो भूपतिं प्रति ॥
उवाच वचनं प्रेम्णा महीराजस्य भूपतेः ॥ 3.3.24.10 ॥
3.3.m: Having arrived at Mahāvatī, that messenger lovingly spoke / the words of the king, Bhūpati Mahīrāja, to the ruler:

3.3.s:
vājinaste hi catvāro divyarūpāḥ śubha prabhāḥ ..
darśanātheṃ tava vadhūrvelā nāma mamātmajā .. 11 ..
3.3.d:
वाजिनस्ते हि चत्वारो दिव्यरूपाः शुभ प्रभाः ॥
दर्शनाथें तव वधूर्वेला नाम ममात्मजा ॥ 11 ॥
3.3.m: "Your four horses are of divine form and auspicious splendor. / For the purpose of seeing them, your daughter-in-law Velā, who is my daughter,

3.3.s:
tayāhūtānhayānbhūpa dehi me vismayaṃ tyaja ..
no cedvelāgninā sarve kṣayaṃ yāsyaṃti sainyapāḥ .. 12 ..
3.3.d:
तयाहूतान्हयान्भूप देहि मे विस्मयं त्यज ॥
नो चेद्वेलाग्निना सर्वे क्षयं यास्यंति सैन्यपाः ॥ 12 ॥
3.3.m: has summoned the horses; give them to me, O king, and cast off amazement! / Otherwise, through Velā's fire, all your army commanders will meet destruction!"

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā vaco ghoraṃ sa bhūpo bhayakātaraḥ ..
āhlādādīnsamāhūya vacanaṃ prāha namradhīḥ ..
hayānsvānsvānmudā dehi madīyaṃ vacanaṃ kuru .. ..13..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा वचो घोरं स भूपो भयकातरः ॥
आह्लादादीन्समाहूय वचनं प्राह नम्रधीः ॥
हयान्स्वान्स्वान्मुदा देहि मदीयं वचनं कुरु ॥ ॥13॥
3.3.m:
Hearing these dreadful words, the king, distressed with fear,
called Āhlāda and the others and spoke with humble mind:
“Give up your horses with joy; carry out my word.”

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā sa āhlādo dhyātvā sarvamayīṃ śivām ..
uvāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ śṛṇu bhūpa śivapriya ..14..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा स आह्लादो ध्यात्वा सर्वमयीं शिवाम् ॥
उवाच मधुरं वाक्यं शृणु भूप शिवप्रिय ॥14॥
3.3.m:
Hearing this, Āhlāda, having meditated upon all-pervading Śivā,
spoke sweet words: “Listen, O king, dear to Śiva!

3.3.s:
yatra naḥ saṃsthitāḥ prāṇāstatra te vā jinaḥ sthitāḥ ..
na dāsyāmo vayaṃ rājansatyaṃsatyaṃ na cānyathā .. 15 ..
3.3.d:
यत्र नः संस्थिताः प्राणास्तत्र ते वा जिनः स्थिताः ॥
न दास्यामो वयं राजन्सत्यंसत्यं न चान्यथा ॥ 15 ॥
3.3.m:
Where our vital breaths reside, there those horses remain.
We will not give them, O king, in truth, in truth, and not otherwise.”

3.3.s: iti śrutvā vacastasya rājā parimalo balī ..16..
3.3.d: इति श्रुत्वा वचस्तस्य राजा परिमलो बली ॥16॥
3.3.m: Hearing his words, the powerful King Parimala,

3.3.s:
śapathaṃ kṛtavānghoraṃ śṛṇvatāṃ balaśālinām ..
bhojanaṃ brahmamāṃsasya pānīyaṃ go'sṛjopamam..17..
3.3.d:
शपथं कृतवान्घोरं शृण्वतां बलशालिनाम् ॥
भोजनं ब्रह्ममांसस्य पानीयं गोऽसृजोपमम्॥17॥
3.3.m:
made a dreadful oath within the hearing of those mighty ones:
“Eating the flesh of a brahmin, drinking like cow's blood,

3.3.s:
śayyā svamātṛsadṛśī brahmahatyopamā sabhā ..
mama rāṣṭre ca yuṣmābhirvāsaḥ pāpamayo mahān ..18..
3.3.d:
शय्या स्वमातृसदृशी ब्रह्महत्योपमा सभा ॥
मम राष्ट्रे च युष्माभिर्वासः पापमयो महान् ॥18॥
3.3.m:
a bed resembling one's own mother, an assembly like the murder of a brahmin—
[such] dwelling in my kingdom would be for you, full of great sin.”

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā tu śapathaṃ devakī śokatatparā ..
cakāra rodanaṃ gāḍhaṃ sagehajanavigrahā..19..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा तु शपथं देवकी शोकतत्परा ॥
चकार रोदनं गाढं सगेहजनविग्रहा॥19॥
3.3.m:
Hearing this oath, Devakī, overcome with grief,
wept bitterly together with her household members.

3.3.s:
paṃcaviṃśābdake prāpte kṛṣṇāṃśe yogatatpare ..
bhādraśuklacaturdaśyāṃ tadgehāddharmatatparāḥ .. 3.3.24.20 ..
3.3.d:
पंचविंशाब्दके प्राप्ते कृष्णांशे योगतत्परे ॥
भाद्रशुक्लचतुर्दश्यां तद्गेहाद्धर्मतत्पराः ॥ 3.3.24.20 ॥
3.3.m:
When the twenty-fifth year was reached by Kṛṣṇāṃśa, who was intent on yoga,
on the fourteenth lunar day of the bright fortnight of Bhādrapada, they, devoted to righteousness, from that house

3.3.s:
niryayuḥ kānyakubjaṃ te jayacaṃdreṇa pālitam ..
svarṇavatyā puṣpavatyā sahitāścitrarekhayā ..21..
3.3.d:
निर्ययुः कान्यकुब्जं ते जयचंद्रेण पालितम् ॥
स्वर्णवत्या पुष्पवत्या सहिताश्चित्ररेखया ॥21॥
3.3.m:
departed for Kānyakubja, which was protected by Jayacandra,
accompanied by Svarṇavatī, Puṣpavatī, and Citrarekhā.

3.3.s:
indulaḥ prayayau śīghramayutāśvabalaissaha ..
karālaṃ hayamāruhya paṃcaśabdaṃ ca tatpitā ..
kṛṣṇāṃśo biṃdulārūḍho devakīmanusaṃyayau ..22..
3.3.d:
इन्दुलः प्रययौ शीघ्रमयुताश्वबलैस्सह ॥
करालं हयमारुह्य पंचशब्दं च तत्पिता ॥
कृष्णांशो बिंदुलारूढो देवकीमनुसंययौ ॥22॥
3.3.m:
Indula set out swiftly together with a force of ten thousand horses.
Mounted upon the horse Karāla and with the five sounds [of royalty], his father,
and Kṛṣṇāṃśa, mounted on Bindulā, followed Devakī.

3.3.s:
tyaktvā te bhūpatergrāmaṃ sarvasaṃpatsamanvitam ..
pathi tryahamuṣitvā te jayacaṃdramupāyayuḥ ..23..
3.3.d:
त्यक्त्वा ते भूपतेर्ग्रामं सर्वसंपत्समन्वितम् ॥
पथि त्र्यहमुषित्वा ते जयचंद्रमुपाययुः ॥23॥
3.3.m:
Leaving that king's village endowed with all wealth,
having stayed three days on the road, they approached Jayacandra.

3.3.s:
natvā taṃ bhūpatiṃ premṇā gaditvā sarvakāraṇam ..
uṣitvā śītalāsthāne pūjayāmāsurambikām..24..
3.3.d:
नत्वा तं भूपतिं प्रेम्णा गदित्वा सर्वकारणम् ॥
उषित्वा शीतलास्थाने पूजयामासुरम्बिकाम्॥24॥
3.3.m:
Bowing to that king with love and explaining the whole matter,
having stayed in the temple of Śītalā, they worshipped Ambikā.

3.3.s:
jayacaṃdrastu bhūpālo devasiṃhena varṇitaḥ..
tebhyaśca na dadau vṛttiṃ bhūmā parimalājñayā..25..
3.3.d:
जयचंद्रस्तु भूपालो देवसिंहेन वर्णितः॥
तेभ्यश्च न ददौ वृत्तिं भूमा परिमलाज्ञया॥25॥
3.3.m:
King Jayacandra, however, informed by Devasiṃha,
did not grant them a livelihood or land, by the order of Parimala.

3.3.s:
kuṃṭhito devasiṃhastu gatvā kṛṣṇāṃśamuttamam ..
uditvā kāraṇaṃ sarvaṃ sa śrutvā roṣamādadhau .. 26..
3.3.d:
कुंठितो देवसिंहस्तु गत्वा कृष्णांशमुत्तमम् ॥
उदित्वा कारणं सर्वं स श्रुत्वा रोषमादधौ ॥ 26॥
3.3.m:
Dejected, Devasiṃha approached the noble Kṛṣṇāṃśa
and reported the whole matter. Hearing it, he became enraged.

3.3.s:
tvaritaṃ biṃdulārūḍho hayapaṃcaśatāvṛtaḥ ..
luṃṭhayāmāsa nagaraṃ pālitaṃ lakṣaṇena tat .. 27 ..
3.3.d:
त्वरितं बिंदुलारूढो हयपंचशतावृतः ॥
लुंठयामास नगरं पालितं लक्षणेन तत् ॥ 27 ॥
3.3.m:
Quickly mounted on Bindulā, surrounded by five hundred horses,
he plundered that city, which was protected by Lakṣaṇa.

3.3.s:
dṛṣṭvā taṃ lakṣaṇo vīro hastinaḥ pṛṣṭhamāsthitaḥ ..
śareṇa tāḍayāmāsa kṛṣṇāṃśahṛdayaṃ dṛḍham ..28..
3.3.d:
दृष्ट्वा तं लक्षणो वीरो हस्तिनः पृष्ठमास्थितः ॥
शरेण ताडयामास कृष्णांशहृदयं दृढम् ॥28॥
3.3.m:
Seeing him, the heroic Lakṣaṇa, stationed on the back of an elephant,
struck Kṛṣṇāṃśa's chest forcefully with an arrow.

3.3.s:
niṣphalatvaṃ gato bāṇo viṣṇumaṃtreṇa preritaḥ ..
vismitaḥ sa tu bhūpālo vāhanādbhūmimāgataḥ .. 29 ..
3.3.d:
निष्फलत्वं गतो बाणो विष्णुमंत्रेण प्रेरितः ॥
विस्मितः स तु भूपालो वाहनाद्भूमिमागतः ॥ 29 ॥
3.3.m:
The arrow, countered by the Viṣṇu mantra, became ineffective.
Astonished, that king descended from his mount to the ground.

3.3.s:
natvā taccaraṇau divyau kuliśādibhiranvitau ..
tuṣṭāva daṃḍavadbhūtvā lakṣaṇo gadgadaṃ girā .. 3.3.24.30 ..
3.3.d:
नत्वा तच्चरणौ दिव्यौ कुलिशादिभिरन्वितौ ॥
तुष्टाव दंडवद्भूत्वा लक्षणो गद्गदं गिरा ॥ 3.3.24.30 ॥
3.3.m:
Bowing to his divine feet marked with the thunderbolt and other signs,
falling like a staff, Lakṣaṇa praised him with a voice choked with emotion:

3.3.s:
.. lakṣaṇa uvāca .. ..
vaiṣṇavaṃ viddhi māṃ svāminviṣṇupūjanatatparam ..
jāne'haṃ tvāṃ mahābāho kṛṣṇaśaktyavatārakam ..31..
3.3.d:
॥ लक्षण उवाच ॥ ॥
वैष्णवं विद्धि मां स्वामिन्विष्णुपूजनतत्परम् ॥
जानेऽहं त्वां महाबाहो कृष्णशक्त्यवतारकम् ॥31॥
3.3.m:
Lakṣaṇa said:
“Know me, O master, to be a Vaiṣṇava, devoted to the worship of Viṣṇu.
I recognize you, O mighty-armed one, as an avatar of the power of Kṛṣṇa.

3.3.s:
tvadṛte ko hi me bāṇaṃ niṣphalaṃ kurute bhuvi ..
kṣamasva mama daurātmyaṃ nātha te māyayā kṛtam ..32..
3.3.d:
त्वदृते को हि मे बाणं निष्फलं कुरुते भुवि ॥
क्षमस्व मम दौरात्म्यं नाथ ते मायया कृतम् ॥32॥
3.3.m:
Apart from you, who on earth could render my arrow fruitless?
Forgive my wickedness, O Lord, which was brought about by your Māyā.”

3.3.s:
ityuktvā tena sahito jayacandraṃ mahīpatim..
gatvā taṃ kathayāmāsa yathā prāptaḥ parājayam..33..
3.3.d:
इत्युक्त्वा तेन सहितो जयचन्द्रं महीपतिम्॥
गत्वा तं कथयामास यथा प्राप्तः पराजयम्॥33॥
3.3.m:
Having spoken thus, together with him he went to King Jayacandra
and told him how he had suffered defeat.

3.3.s:
nṛpastayoḥ parīkṣārthaṃ yau tu chāyāvimohitau..
gajau kuvalayāpīḍau tyaktavācchītalāsthale..34..
3.3.d:
नृपस्तयोः परीक्षार्थं यौ तु छायाविमोहितौ॥
गजौ कुवलयापीडौ त्यक्तवाच्छीतलास्थले॥34॥
3.3.m:
To test the two of them, the king released two elephants, Kuvalayāpīḍas,
who were bewildered by their own shadows, into the courtyard of Śītalā.

3.3.s:
tadāhlādodayau vīrau gṛhītvā tau svalīlayā ..
cakṛṣaturbalātpucche krośamātraṃ punaḥpunaḥ .. 35 ..
3.3.d:
तदाह्लादोदयौ वीरौ गृहीत्वा तौ स्वलीलया ॥
चकृषतुर्बलात्पुच्छे क्रोशमात्रं पुनःपुनः ॥ 35 ॥
3.3.m:
Then those two heroes, Āhlāda and Udaya, seizing them effortlessly,
dragged them repeatedly by the tail by force for a whole krośa.

3.3.s:
mṛtau kuvalayāpīḍau dṛṣṭvā rājā bhayāturaḥ ..
dadau rājagṛhaṃ grāmaṃ tayorarthe prasannadhīḥ .. 36 ..
3.3.d:
मृतौ कुवलयापीडौ दृष्ट्वा राजा भयातुरः ॥
ददौ राजगृहं ग्रामं तयोरर्थे प्रसन्नधीः ॥ 36 ॥
3.3.m:
Seeing the two Kuvalayāpīḍas dead, the king, stricken with fear,
with a pleased mind granted the village of Rājagṛha for the sake of the two.

3.3.s:
iṣaśuddhe tu saṃprāpte lakṣaṇo nāma vai balī ..
nṛpājñayā yayau śīghraṃ taiśca digvijayaṃ prati .. 37 ..
3.3.d:
इषशुद्धे तु संप्राप्ते लक्षणो नाम वै बली ॥
नृपाज्ञया ययौ शीघ्रं तैश्च दिग्विजयं प्रति ॥ 37 ॥
3.3.m:
When the bright fortnight of Āśvina arrived, the mighty Lakṣaṇa,
by order of the king, set out quickly with them on a world conquest.

3.3.s:
saptalakṣabalaissārddhaṃ tālanādyaiśca saṃyutaḥ ..
vārāṇasīṃ purīṃ prāpya rurodha nagarīṃ tadā .. 38 ..
3.3.d:
सप्तलक्षबलैस्सार्द्धं तालनाद्यैश्च संयुतः ॥
वाराणसीं पुरीं प्राप्य रुरोध नगरीं तदा ॥ 38 ॥
3.3.m:
Accompanied by a force of seven hundred thousand, equipped with cymbals, pipes, and other [instruments],
reaching the city of Vārāṇasī, he besieged the city at that time.

3.3.s:
rudravarmā ca bhūpālo gauḍavaṃśayaśaskaraḥ ..
paṃcāyutaiḥ svasainyaiśca sārddhaṃ yuddhārthamāptavān .. 39 ..
3.3.d:
रुद्रवर्मा च भूपालो गौडवंशयशस्करः ॥
पंचायुतैः स्वसैन्यैश्च सार्द्धं युद्धार्थमाप्तवान् ॥ 39 ॥
3.3.m:
King Rudravarmā, who brought glory to the Gauḍa dynasty,
approached for battle along with his own fifty thousand troops.

3.3.s:
yāmamātreṇa taṃ jitvā ṣoḍaśābdasya vai karam ..
koṭimudrāmayaṃ prāpya jayacaṃdrāya cārpayat ..3.3.24.40 ..
3.3.d:
याममात्रेण तं जित्वा षोडशाब्दस्य वै करम् ॥
कोटिमुद्रामयं प्राप्य जयचंद्राय चार्पयत् ॥3.3.24.40 ॥
3.3.m:
Conquering him in just a single watch, obtaining the tribute of sixteen years
consisting of ten million coins, he offered it to Jayacandra.

3.3.s:
māgadheśaṃ punarjitvā nāmnā vijayakāriṇam ..
viṃśatyabdakaraṃ prāpya svabhūpāya samarpayat .. 41 ..
3.3.d:
मागधेशं पुनर्जित्वा नाम्ना विजयकारिणम् ॥
विंशत्यब्दकरं प्राप्य स्वभूपाय समर्पयत् ॥ 41 ॥
3.3.m:
Then, having conquered the lord of Magadha, named Vijayakārin,
obtaining the tribute of twenty years, he surrendered it to his king,

3.3.s:
paṃcakoṭīśca vai mudrā rājatasya punaryayau ..
aṃga vaṃgadeśapatiṃ vīro lakṣaṇo vai yutaśca taiḥ..
lakṣasainyayutaṃ bhūpaṃ kālīvarmāṇamuttamam..
ahorātreṇa taṃ jitvā mahāyuddhena lakṣaṇaḥ.. 44.
3.3.d:
पंचकोटीश्च वै मुद्रा राजतस्य पुनर्ययौ ॥
अंग वंगदेशपतिं वीरो लक्षणो वै युतश्च तैः॥
लक्षसैन्ययुतं भूपं कालीवर्माणमुत्तमम्॥
अहोरात्रेण तं जित्वा महायुद्धेन लक्षणः॥ 44.
3.3.m:
and fifty million silver coins. Next the heroic Lakṣaṇa, joined by them,
went against the lord of the Aṅga and Vaṅga countries,
the excellent King Kālīvarmā, who was accompanied by a hundred thousand troops;
conquering him in a day and a night in a great battle, Lakṣaṇa,

3.3.s:
viṃśatyabda karaṃ prāpya koṭiṃ svarṇamayaṃ tadā..
preṣayāmāsa bhūpāya jayacaṃdrāya vai mudā..45..
3.3.d:
विंशत्यब्द करं प्राप्य कोटिं स्वर्णमयं तदा॥
प्रेषयामास भूपाय जयचंद्राय वै मुदा॥45॥
3.3.m:
having received twenty years of tribute amounting to ten million gold [coins],
then sent it with joy to King Jayacandra.

3.3.s:
uṣṭradeśaṃ yayau vīraḥ pālitaṃ tairmahābalaiḥ..
dhoyīkavistatranṛpo lakṣasainyasamanvitaḥ.46..
3.3.d:
उष्ट्रदेशं ययौ वीरः पालितं तैर्महाबलैः॥
धोयीकविस्तत्रनृपो लक्षसैन्यसमन्वितः.46॥
3.3.m:
The hero went to the country of Uṣṭra, which was protected by those of great might.
King Dhoyīkavi was there, accompanied by a hundred thousand troops.

3.3.s:
jagannāthājñayā prāptastaiśca sārddhaṃ raṇonmukhe..
tayoścāsīnmahadyuddhaṃ tumulaṃ romaharṣaṇam..
ahorātrapramāṇena kṛṣṇāṃśena jito nṛpaḥ..47..
3.3.d:
जगन्नाथाज्ञया प्राप्तस्तैश्च सार्द्धं रणोन्मुखे॥
तयोश्चासीन्महद्युद्धं तुमुलं रोमहर्षणम्॥
अहोरात्रप्रमाणेन कृष्णांशेन जितो नृपः॥47॥

3.3.s:
viṃśatyabdakaraṃ sarvaṃ koṭisvarṇasamanvitam ..
saṃprāpya preṣayāmāsa kānyakubjādhipāya vai .. 48 ..
3.3.d:
विंशत्यब्दकरं सर्वं कोटिस्वर्णसमन्वितम् ॥
संप्राप्य प्रेषयामास कान्यकुब्जाधिपाय वै ॥ 48 ॥
3.3.m:
Having obtained the entire twenty years' tribute along with ten million gold [coins],
he sent it to the sovereign of Kānyakubja.

3.3.s:
puṃḍradeśaṃ yayau vīro lakṣaṇo balavattaraḥ ..
nṛpaṃ nāgapatiṃ nāma paṃcāyutabalairyutam ..
dinamātreṇa taṃ jitvā koṭimudrā gṛhītavān .. 49 ..
3.3.d:
पुंड्रदेशं ययौ वीरो लक्षणो बलवत्तरः ॥
नृपं नागपतिं नाम पंचायुतबलैर्युतम् ॥
दिनमात्रेण तं जित्वा कोटिमुद्रा गृहीतवान् ॥ 49 ॥
3.3.m:
The heroic Lakṣaṇa, exceedingly powerful, went to the Puṇḍra country.
Conquering the king named Nāgapati, who was accompanied by fifty thousand troops,
in merely a single day, he took ten million coins.

3.3.s:
maheṃdragirimāgatya natvā taṃ bhārgavaṃ munim ..
nato nivṛtya te sarve netrapālapuraṃ yayuḥ .. 3.3.24.50 ..
3.3.d:
महेंद्रगिरिमागत्य नत्वा तं भार्गवं मुनिम् ॥
नतो निवृत्य ते सर्वे नेत्रपालपुरं ययुः ॥ 3.3.24.50 ॥
3.3.m:
Coming to Mount Mahendra and bowing to that sage, the descendant of Bhṛgu,
having bowed and turned back, they all went to the city of Netrapāla.

3.3.s:
yogasiṃhastadāgatya kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ prati bhārgava ..
koṭimudrā dadau tasmai saptarātrama vāsayat .. 51 ..
3.3.d:
योगसिंहस्तदागत्य कृष्णांशं प्रति भार्गव ॥
कोटिमुद्रा ददौ तस्मै सप्तरात्रम वासयत् ॥ 51 ॥
3.3.m:
Then Yogasiṃha, having come to Kṛṣṇāṃśa, O descendant of Bhṛgu,
gave him ten million coins and hosted him for seven nights.

3.3.s:
vīrasiṃhapuraṃ jagmuste vīrā madavattarāḥ ..
rurudhurnagarīṃ sarvāṃ himatuṃgopari sthitām ..
pālitāṃ gorakhākhyena yoginā bhaktakāra ṇāt .. 52 ..
3.3.d:
वीरसिंहपुरं जग्मुस्ते वीरा मदवत्तराः ॥
रुरुधुर्नगरीं सर्वां हिमतुंगोपरि स्थिताम् ॥
पालितां गोरखाख्येन योगिना भक्तकार णात् ॥ 52 ॥

3.3.s:
bhūpānujaḥ pravīraśca sainyāyutasamanvitaḥ ..
kṛtavāndāruṇaṃ yuddhaṃ lakṣaṇasyaiva senayā .. 53 ..
3.3.d:
भूपानुजः प्रवीरश्च सैन्यायुतसमन्वितः ॥
कृतवान्दारुणं युद्धं लक्षणस्यैव सेनया ॥ 53 ॥
3.3.m:
The king's younger brother, Pravīra, accompanied by ten thousand troops,
waged a terrible battle with the army of Lakṣaṇa.

3.3.s:
pratyahaṃ balavāñchūro hatvā śūrasahasra kam ..
sāyaṃkāle gṛhaṃ prāpya yoginaṃ tamapūjayat .. 54 ..
3.3.d:
प्रत्यहं बलवाञ्छूरो हत्वा शूरसहस्र कम् ॥
सायंकाले गृहं प्राप्य योगिनं तमपूजयत् ॥ 54 ॥
3.3.m:
Every day that mighty warrior, slaying a thousand heroes,
returned to his house at eventide and worshipped that yogin.

3.3.s:
pūjanātsa prasannātmā sainyamujjīvya bhūpateḥ ..
dattvā gajabalaṃ tebhyaḥ punaryogaṃ karoti vai .. 55 ..
3.3.d:
पूजनात्स प्रसन्नात्मा सैन्यमुज्जीव्य भूपतेः ॥
दत्त्वा गजबलं तेभ्यः पुनर्योगं करोति वै ॥ 55 ॥
3.3.m:
Pleasured by the worship, reviving the king's army
and giving them the strength of elephants, he engaged again in yoga.

3.3.s:
sārddhamāso gatastatra yuddhyatāṃ balaśālinām ..
tadā te tu nirutsāhā devasiṃhaṃ tamabruvavan .. 56 ..
3.3.d:
सार्द्धमासो गतस्तत्र युद्ध्यतां बलशालिनाम् ॥
तदा ते तु निरुत्साहा देवसिंहं तमब्रुववन् ॥ 56 ॥
3.3.m:
A month and a half passed there as those powerful ones fought.
Then, dispirited, they spoke to Devasiṃha:

3.3.s:
vijayo naḥ kathaṃ bhūpa brūhi nastattvamagrataḥ..
iti śrutvā sa hovāca śṛṇu kṛṣṇāṃśa me vacaḥ ..57..
3.3.d:
विजयो नः कथं भूप ब्रूहि नस्तत्त्वमग्रतः॥
इति श्रुत्वा स होवाच शृणु कृष्णांश मे वचः ॥57॥
3.3.m:
"How shall we gain victory, O king? Tell us the truth beforehand."
Having heard this, he said: "Listen to my words, O Kṛṣṇāṃśa:

3.3.s:
yogināṃ gorakhaṃ nāma parājitya svanṛtyataḥ ..
punaryuddhaṃ kuru tvaṃ vai tato jaya mavāpsyasi .. 58 ..
3.3.d:
योगिनां गोरखं नाम पराजित्य स्वनृत्यतः ॥
पुनर्युद्धं कुरु त्वं वै ततो जय मवाप्स्यसि ॥ 58 ॥
3.3.m:
Having defeated Gorakha, chief among yogins, by your own dancing,
fight the battle again indeed; from that you will obtain victory."

3.3.s:
ityuktāste hi kṛṣṇādyāḥ kṛtvā yogamayaṃ vapuḥ ..
sthāpayitvā raṇe senāṃ pālitāṃ lakṣaṇena vai .. 59 ..
3.3.d:
इत्युक्तास्ते हि कृष्णाद्याः कृत्वा योगमयं वपुः ॥
स्थापयित्वा रणे सेनां पालितां लक्षणेन वै ॥ 59 ॥
3.3.m:
Addressed thus, Kṛṣṇa and the others, having assumed forms endowed with yoga,
and having stationed their army in battle protected indeed by Lakṣaṇa,

3.3.s:
prātaḥ kāle yayuste vai maṃdiraṃ tasya yoginaḥ ..
kṛṣṇāṃśo nartakaścāsīdveṇuvādyaviśāradaḥ .. 3.3.24.60 ..
3.3.d:
प्रातः काले ययुस्ते वै मंदिरं तस्य योगिनः ॥
कृष्णांशो नर्तकश्चासीद्वेणुवाद्यविशारदः ॥ 3.3.24.60 ॥
3.3.m:
went in the morning to the dwelling of that yogin.
Kṛṣṇāṃśa was the dancer, skilled in playing the flute;

3.3.s:
devasiṃho mṛdaṃgāḍhyo vīṇādhārī ca tālanaḥ ..
kāṃsyadhārī tadāhlādo jagau gītāṃ sanātanīm .. 61 ..
3.3.d:
देवसिंहो मृदंगाढ्यो वीणाधारी च तालनः ॥
कांस्यधारी तदाह्लादो जगौ गीतां सनातनीम् ॥ 61 ॥
3.3.m:
Devasiṃha was endowed with a mṛdaṅga drum, and Tālana held a vīṇā;
holding cymbals, Āhlāda then sang eternal songs.

3.3.s:
tadarthaṃ hṛdaye kṛtvā gorakhassarvayogavān ..
varaṃ vṛṇuta tānāha te tacchrutvā'bruvanvacaḥ .. 62 ..
3.3.d:
तदर्थं हृदये कृत्वा गोरखस्सर्वयोगवान् ॥
वरं वृणुत तानाह ते तच्छ्रुत्वाऽब्रुवन्वचः ॥ 62 ॥
3.3.m:
Taking the meaning to heart, Gorakha, master of all yoga,
said to them: "Choose a boon." Having heard that, they spoke these words:

3.3.s:
namasyāmo vayaṃ tubhyaṃ yadi deyo varastvayā ..
dehi saṃjīvinī vidyāmāhlādāya mahātmane ..63..
3.3.d:
नमस्यामो वयं तुभ्यं यदि देयो वरस्त्वया ॥
देहि संजीविनी विद्यामाह्लादाय महात्मने ॥63॥
3.3.m:
"We bow to you. If a boon is to be given by you,
give the Saṃjīvinī vidyā to the high-souled Āhlāda."

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā hṛdi dhyātvā tānuvāca prasannadhīḥ ..
vidyā saṃjīvinī tubhyaṃ varṣamātraṃ bhaviṣyati ..
tatpaścānniṣkalībhūyāgamiṣyati madaṃtikam ..64..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा हृदि ध्यात्वा तानुवाच प्रसन्नधीः ॥
विद्या संजीविनी तुभ्यं वर्षमात्रं भविष्यति ॥
तत्पश्चान्निष्कलीभूयागमिष्यति मदंतिकम् ॥64॥
3.3.m:
Having heard this, contemplating it in his heart, his mind pleased, he said to them:
"The Saṃjīvinī vidyā will belong to you for just one year.
After that, becoming inactive, it will return to my presence.

3.3.s:
adyaprabhṛti bho vīra mayā tyaktamidaṃ jagat ..
yatra bhartṛhariḥ śiṣyastatra gatvā śaye hyaham.. 65 ..
3.3.d:
अद्यप्रभृति भो वीर मया त्यक्तमिदं जगत् ॥
यत्र भर्तृहरिः शिष्यस्तत्र गत्वा शये ह्यहम्॥ 65 ॥
3.3.m:
From today onward, O hero, this world has been abandoned by me.
Going to where my disciple Bhartṛhari is, I shall indeed rest."

3.3.s:
ityuktvāntarhito yogī jagmuste raṇamūrddhani ..
jitvā pravīrasiṃhaṃ ca vīrasiṃhaṃ tathaiva ca .. 66 ..
3.3.d:
इत्युक्त्वान्तर्हितो योगी जग्मुस्ते रणमूर्द्धनि ॥
जित्वा प्रवीरसिंहं च वीरसिंहं तथैव च ॥ 66 ॥
3.3.m:
Having spoken thus, the yogin vanished, and they went to the forefront of the battle.
Having conquered Pravīrasiṃha and likewise Vīrasiṃha,

3.3.s:
hatvā tasyāyutaṃ sainyaṃ luṇṭhayitvā ca tadgṛham ..
kṛtvā dāsamayaṃ bhūpaṃ lakṣaṇaḥ prayayau mudā .. 67 ..
3.3.d:
हत्वा तस्यायुतं सैन्यं लुण्ठयित्वा च तद्गृहम् ॥
कृत्वा दासमयं भूपं लक्षणः प्रययौ मुदा ॥ 67 ॥
3.3.m:
having slain ten thousand of his troops and looted his house,
and having turned the king into a servant, Lakṣaṇa departed with joy.

3.3.s:
kośalaṃ deśamāgatya jitvā tasya mahīpatim ..
sainyāyutaṃ sūryadharaṃ karayogyamacīkarat .. 68 ..
3.3.d:
कोशलं देशमागत्य जित्वा तस्य महीपतिम् ॥
सैन्यायुतं सूर्यधरं करयोग्यमचीकरत् ॥ 68 ॥
3.3.m:
Having reached the country of Kośala and defeated its ruler,
he made Sūryadhara, who had ten thousand troops, subject to tribute.

3.3.s:
ṣoḍaśābdakaraṃ prāpya mudrākoṭyayutaṃ mudā ..
naimiṣāraṇyamāgamya tatroṣuḥ snānatatparāḥ .. 69 ..
3.3.d:
षोडशाब्दकरं प्राप्य मुद्राकोट्ययुतं मुदा ॥
नैमिषारण्यमागम्य तत्रोषुः स्नानतत्पराः ॥ 69 ॥
3.3.m:
Having obtained sixteen years of tribute, ten million coins, with joy,
and having come to the Naimiṣa forest, they stayed there, intent on ritual bathing.

3.3.s:
holikāyā dine ramye lakṣaṇo balavattaraḥ ..
dattvā dānāni viprebhyo mahotsavamakārayat .. 3.3.24.70 ..
3.3.d:
होलिकाया दिने रम्ये लक्षणो बलवत्तरः ॥
दत्त्वा दानानि विप्रेभ्यो महोत्सवमकारयत् ॥ 3.3.24.70 ॥
3.3.m:
On the delightful day of Holikā, Lakṣaṇa, of exceedingly great strength,
having given gifts to the brahmins, held a great festival.

3.3.s:
tadā vayaṃ ca munayaḥ samādhisthāśca bhūpatiḥ ..
yadā sa lakṣaṇaḥ prāpto naimiṣāraṇyamuttamam .. 71 ..
3.3.d:
तदा वयं च मुनयः समाधिस्थाश्च भूपतिः ॥
यदा स लक्षणः प्राप्तो नैमिषारण्यमुत्तमम् ॥ 71 ॥
3.3.m:
Then we, the sages, and the king were absorbed in meditation,
when that Lakṣaṇa arrived at the excellent Naimiṣa forest.

3.3.s:
snātvā sarvāṇi tīrthāni saṃtarpya dvijadevatāḥ ..
kānyakubjapuraṃ jagmuścaitrakṛṣṇāṣṭamīdine .. 72 ..
3.3.d:
स्नात्वा सर्वाणि तीर्थानि संतर्प्य द्विजदेवताः ॥
कान्यकुब्जपुरं जग्मुश्चैत्रकृष्णाष्टमीदिने ॥ 72 ॥
3.3.m:
Having bathed at all the sacred bathing places and gratified the twice-born and the gods,
they went to the city of Kānyakubja on the eighth lunar day of the dark fortnight of Caitra.

3.3.s:
iti te kathitaṃ vipra yathādigvijayobhavat ..
śṛṇu vipra kathāṃ ramyāṃ balakhāniryathā mṛtaḥ .. 73 ..
3.3.d:
इति ते कथितं विप्र यथादिग्विजयोभवत् ॥
शृणु विप्र कथां रम्यां बलखानिर्यथा मृतः ॥ 73 ॥
3.3.m:
Thus it has been related to you, O brahmin, how the conquest of the quarters took place.
Listen, O brahmin, to the delightful story of how Balakhāni died.

3.3.s:
mārgakṛṣṇasya saptamyāṃ bhūmirājo mahābalaḥ ..
mahīpateśca vākyena sāmaṃtaṃ prāha nirbhayaḥ .. 74 ..
3.3.d:
मार्गकृष्णस्य सप्तम्यां भूमिराजो महाबलः ॥
महीपतेश्च वाक्येन सामंतं प्राह निर्भयः ॥ 74 ॥
3.3.m:
On the seventh lunar day of the dark fortnight of Mārgaśīrṣa, the mighty Bhūmirāja,
at the word of the monarch, spoke fearlessly to the feudatory lord:

3.3.s:
mayā śrutaste tanayaḥ śāradāvaradarpitaḥ ..
raktabījatvamāpannastaṃ me dehi kṛpāṃ kuru .. 75 ..
3.3.d:
मया श्रुतस्ते तनयः शारदावरदर्पितः ॥
रक्तबीजत्वमापन्नस्तं मे देहि कृपां कुरु ॥ 75 ॥
3.3.m:
"I have heard that your son is proud through the boon of Śāradā,
having attained the nature of Raktabīja; give him to me, show favor!"

3.3.s:
ityuktassa tu sāmantastena rājñeva satkṛtaḥ .
cāmuṃḍaṃ nāma tanayaṃ samāhūyābravīdidam .. 76 ..
3.3.d:
इत्युक्तस्स तु सामन्तस्तेन राज्ञेव सत्कृतः ।
चामुंडं नाम तनयं समाहूयाब्रवीदिदम् ॥ 76 ॥
3.3.m:
Addressed thus, that feudatory lord, honoured by that king,
summoned his son named Cāmuṇḍa and spoke this:

3.3.s:
putra tvaṃ nṛpateḥ kāryaṃ sadā kuru raṇapriya ..
iti śrutvā piturvākyaṃ sa vai rājānamabravīt .. 77 ..
3.3.d:
पुत्र त्वं नृपतेः कार्यं सदा कुरु रणप्रिय ॥
इति श्रुत्वा पितुर्वाक्यं स वै राजानमब्रवीत् ॥ 77 ॥
3.3.m:
"O son, you who love battle, always perform the business of the king."
Having heard the words of his father, he indeed said to the king:

3.3.s:
dehyājñāṃ bhūpate mahyaṃ śīghraṃ jayamavāpsyasi ..
iti śrutvā sa hovāca balakhānirmahābalaḥ .. 78 ..
3.3.d:
देह्याज्ञां भूपते मह्यं शीघ्रं जयमवाप्स्यसि ॥
इति श्रुत्वा स होवाच बलखानिर्महाबलः ॥ 78 ॥
3.3.m:
"Give me the command, O king; you will quickly attain victory."
Having heard this, the mighty Balakhāni spoke:

3.3.s:
macchirīṣavanaṃ chitvā gṛhīttvā rāṣṭramuttamam ..
susthito nirbhayo gehe bāhuśālī yateṃdriyaḥ ..79..
3.3.d:
मच्छिरीषवनं छित्वा गृहीत्त्वा राष्ट्रमुत्तमम् ॥
सुस्थितो निर्भयो गेहे बाहुशाली यतेंद्रियः ॥79॥
3.3.m:
"Having cut down my Śirīṣa forest and seized my excellent kingdom,
he stays comfortably and fearlessly in his house, mighty-armed and self-controlled.

3.3.s:
yadi tvaṃ balakhāniṃ ca jitvā me hyarpayiṣyasi..
hatvā vā tasya sakalaṃ rāṣṭraṃ tvayi bhaviṣyati .. 3.3.24.80 ..
3.3.d:
यदि त्वं बलखानिं च जित्वा मे ह्यर्पयिष्यसि॥
हत्वा वा तस्य सकलं राष्ट्रं त्वयि भविष्यति ॥ 3.3.24.80 ॥
3.3.m:
If you conquer Balakhāni and deliver him to me,
or kill him, his entire kingdom will belong to you."

3.3.s:
ityuktvā raktabījaṃ taṃ samāhūya svakaṃ balam ..
saptalakṣaṃ dadau tasmai sa tatprāpya mudā yayau .. .. 81 ..
3.3.d:
इत्युक्त्वा रक्तबीजं तं समाहूय स्वकं बलम् ॥
सप्तलक्षं ददौ तस्मै स तत्प्राप्य मुदा ययौ ॥ ॥ 81 ॥
3.3.m:
Having spoken thus and summoned his own force, he gave seven hundred thousand [troops]
to that Raktabīja; having received that, he set out with joy.

3.3.s:
uṣitvā tridinaṃ mārge śirīṣākhyamupāgataḥ ..
rurodha nagarīṃ sarvāṃ balakhānermahātmanaḥ.. 82 ..
3.3.d:
उषित्वा त्रिदिनं मार्गे शिरीषाख्यमुपागतः ॥
रुरोध नगरीं सर्वां बलखानेर्महात्मनः॥ 82 ॥
3.3.m:
Having stayed for three days on the road, he arrived at the city called Śirīṣa,
and besieged the entire city of the noble Balakhāni.

3.3.s:
cāmuṃḍāgamanaṃ śrutvā balakhānirmahābalaḥ..
pūjayitvā mahamāyāṃ dattvā dānānyanekaśaḥ ..
lakṣasainyena sahitaḥ prayayau nagarādbahiḥ .. 83 ..
3.3.d:
चामुंडागमनं श्रुत्वा बलखानिर्महाबलः॥
पूजयित्वा महमायां दत्त्वा दानान्यनेकशः ॥
लक्षसैन्येन सहितः प्रययौ नगराद्बहिः ॥ 83 ॥
3.3.m:
Hearing of the arrival of Cāmuṇḍa, the mighty Balakhāni,
having worshipped Mahāmāyā and given many gifts,
set out from the city accompanied by an army of one hundred thousand.

3.3.s:
tasyānujo mahāvīrassukhakhānirbalaiḥ saha ..
hariṇīṃ tāṃ samāruhya śatrusainyamacikṣapat .. 84 ..
3.3.d:
तस्यानुजो महावीरस्सुखखानिर्बलैः सह ॥
हरिणीं तां समारुह्य शत्रुसैन्यमचिक्षपत् ॥ 84 ॥
3.3.m:
His younger brother, the great hero Sukhakhāni, accompanied by forces,
having mounted that mare, drove back the enemy army.

3.3.s:
balakhāniḥ kapotastho nāśayitvā riporbalam ..
lakṣasainyaṃ mudā yuktaścāmuṃḍaṃ prati cāgamat .. .. 85 ..
3.3.d:
बलखानिः कपोतस्थो नाशयित्वा रिपोर्बलम् ॥
लक्षसैन्यं मुदा युक्तश्चामुंडं प्रति चागमत् ॥ ॥ 85 ॥
3.3.m:
Balakhāni, riding his pigeon, having destroyed the force of the enemy,
advanced toward Cāmuṇḍa with an army of one hundred thousand, filled with joy.

3.3.s:
tayoścāsīnmahadyuddhaṃ svasvasainyakṣayaṃkaram ..
ahorātrapramāṇena nihatāḥ kṣatriyā raṇe .. 86 ..
3.3.d:
तयोश्चासीन्महद्युद्धं स्वस्वसैन्यक्षयंकरम् ॥
अहोरात्रप्रमाणेन निहताः क्षत्रिया रणे ॥ 86 ॥
3.3.m:
A great battle took place between the two, causing the destruction of their respective armies;
for the duration of a day and night, kṣatriyas were slain in battle.

3.3.s:
prātaḥkāle tu saṃprāpte kṛtvā snānādikāḥ kriyāḥ ..
jagmatustau raṇe vīrau dhanurbāṇaviśāradau .. 87 ..
3.3.d:
प्रातःकाले तु संप्राप्ते कृत्वा स्नानादिकाः क्रियाः ॥
जग्मतुस्तौ रणे वीरौ धनुर्बाणविशारदौ ॥ 87 ॥
3.3.m:
When morning arrived, having performed their ablutions and other rites,
those two heroes, skilled with bow and arrow, entered the battle.

3.3.s:
rathastho balakhāniśca cāmuṇḍo gajapṛṣṭhagaḥ ..
cakratustumulaṃ ghoraṃ naravismayakārakam .. 88 ..
3.3.d:
रथस्थो बलखानिश्च चामुण्डो गजपृष्ठगः ॥
चक्रतुस्तुमुलं घोरं नरविस्मयकारकम् ॥ 88 ॥
3.3.m:
Balakhāni mounted on a chariot and Cāmuṇḍa on the back of an elephant
fought a tumultuous, terrible combat that caused wonder among men.

3.3.s:
bāṇairbāṇāṃśca saṃchidya devībhaktau ca tau mudā ..
anyonyaṃ vāhane hatvā bhūtalatvamupāgatau ..
khaḍgacarmadharau vīrau yuyudhāte parasparam..89..
3.3.d:
बाणैर्बाणांश्च संछिद्य देवीभक्तौ च तौ मुदा ॥
अन्योन्यं वाहने हत्वा भूतलत्वमुपागतौ ॥
खड्गचर्मधरौ वीरौ युयुधाते परस्परम्॥89॥

3.3.s:
yāvanto raktabījāṃgātsaṃjātā raktabiṃdavaḥ ..
tāvantaḥ puruṣā jātā raktabījaparākramāḥ .. 3.3.24.90 ..
3.3.d:
यावन्तो रक्तबीजांगात्संजाता रक्तबिंदवः ॥
तावन्तः पुरुषा जाता रक्तबीजपराक्रमाः ॥ 3.3.24.90 ॥
3.3.m:
As many drops of blood as sprang from the body of Raktabīja,
so many men were born possessing the prowess of Raktabīja.

3.3.s:
taiśca vīrairmadonmattairbalakhānissamaṃtataḥ ..
saṃruddho'bhūd bhṛguśreṣṭha śāradāṃ śaraṇaṃ yayau..91..
3.3.d:
तैश्च वीरैर्मदोन्मत्तैर्बलखानिस्समंततः ॥
संरुद्धोऽभूद् भृगुश्रेष्ठ शारदां शरणं ययौ॥91॥
3.3.m:
By those heroes maddened with battle, Balakhāni was besieged on all sides,
O best of the Bhṛgus; he went to Śāradā for refuge.

3.3.s:
etasminnaṃtare vīraḥ sukhakhānistato'nujaḥ..
āgneyaṃ śaramādāya raktabījānadāhayat..92..
3.3.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे वीरः सुखखानिस्ततोऽनुजः॥
आग्नेयं शरमादाय रक्तबीजानदाहयत्॥92॥
3.3.m:
In the meantime, his younger brother, the heroic Sukhakhāni,
took an arrow of fire and burned the Raktabījas.

3.3.s:
purā tu sukhakhā niśca havyairdevaṃ ca pāvakam ..
paṃcābdānpūjayāmāsa tadā tuṣṭassvayaṃ prabhuḥ .. 93 ..
3.3.d:
पुरा तु सुखखा निश्च हव्यैर्देवं च पावकम् ॥
पंचाब्दान्पूजयामास तदा तुष्टस्स्वयं प्रभुः ॥ 93 ॥
3.3.m:
Formerly, indeed, Sukhakhāni had worshipped the divine fire with oblations
for five years; then the Lord himself was pleased.

3.3.s:
pāvakīyaṃ śaraṃ ramyaṃ śatrusaṃhārakārakam ..
dadau tasmai prasannātmā tenāsāvabhavajjayī .. 94 ..
3.3.d:
पावकीयं शरं रम्यं शत्रुसंहारकारकम् ॥
ददौ तस्मै प्रसन्नात्मा तेनासावभवज्जयी ॥ 94 ॥
3.3.m:
With a pleased mind, he gave him a beautiful arrow of fire that slays enemies;
by means of that, he became victorious.

3.3.s:
balakhānistu balavāndṛṣṭvā śatruvināśanam ..
parājitaṃ ca cāmuṃḍaṃ baddhvā gehamupāgatam .. 95..
3.3.d:
बलखानिस्तु बलवान्दृष्ट्वा शत्रुविनाशनम् ॥
पराजितं च चामुंडं बद्ध्वा गेहमुपागतम् ॥ 95॥
3.3.m:
The mighty Balakhāni, having seen the destruction of the enemy,
and bound the defeated Cāmuṇḍa, returned home.

3.3.s:
kṛtvā nārīmayaṃ veṣaṃ sa bhīto brahmahatyayā ..
dolāmāropya balavānpreṣayāmāsa śatrave .. 96 ..
3.3.d:
कृत्वा नारीमयं वेषं स भीतो ब्रह्महत्यया ॥
दोलामारोप्य बलवान्प्रेषयामास शत्रवे ॥ 96 ॥
3.3.m:
Having dressed him in woman's attire, the strong one, afraid of the sin of slaying a brahmin,
placed him in a palanquin and sent him back to the enemy.

3.3.s:
hataśeṣaṃ paṃcalakṣaṃ sainyaṃ gatvā ca dehalīm ..
vṛttāntaṃ kathayāmāsa yathā jāto mahāraṇaḥ .. 97 ..
3.3.d:
हतशेषं पंचलक्षं सैन्यं गत्वा च देहलीम् ॥
वृत्तान्तं कथयामास यथा जातो महारणः ॥ 97 ॥
3.3.m:
The remainder of the army, five hundred thousand who were not slain, having gone to Delhi,
related the account of how the great battle took place.

3.3.s:
nārīveṣaṃ ca cāmuṃḍaṃ sa dṛṣṭvā pṛthivīpatiḥ ..
krodhāviṣṭaśca balavānmahīpatimuvāca ha .. 98 ..
3.3.d:
नारीवेषं च चामुंडं स दृष्ट्वा पृथिवीपतिः ॥
क्रोधाविष्टश्च बलवान्महीपतिमुवाच ह ॥ 98 ॥
3.3.m:
Having seen Cāmuṇḍa in woman's attire, the ruler of the earth,
seized with fury, the mighty one spoke to Mahīpati:

3.3.s:
kathaṃ jayo me bhavitā sukhakhānau ca jīvite ..
śrutvā mahīpatiḥ prāha cchadmanā kāryamākuru .. 99 ..
3.3.d:
कथं जयो मे भविता सुखखानौ च जीविते ॥
श्रुत्वा महीपतिः प्राह च्छद्मना कार्यमाकुरु ॥ 99 ॥
3.3.m:
"How will there be victory for me while Sukhakhāni lives?"
Having heard him, Mahīpati said: "Accomplish the deed by deceit."

3.3.s:
brāhmī mātā tayorjñeyā śuddhā saiva pativratā ..
dūtībhiḥ kāraṇaṃ jñātvā punaryuddhaṃ kuruṣva bhoḥ .. 3.3.24.100 ..
3.3.d:
ब्राह्मी माता तयोर्ज्ञेया शुद्धा सैव पतिव्रता ॥
दूतीभिः कारणं ज्ञात्वा पुनर्युद्धं कुरुष्व भोः ॥ 3.3.24.100 ॥
3.3.m: "Their mother, Brāhmī, should be known as pure and devoted to her husband alone. / Having discovered the cause through female messengers, O sir, wage war once more!"

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā mahīrājo dūtīstāśchalakovidāḥ ..
āhūya preṣayāmāsa balakhānigṛhaṃ prati ..1 01..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा महीराजो दूतीस्ताश्छलकोविदाः ॥
आहूय प्रेषयामास बलखानिगृहं प्रति ॥1 01॥
3.3.m: Having heard this, Mahīrāja summoned those female messengers skilled in deceit / and sent them to the dwelling of Balakhāni.

3.3.s:
brāhmaṇyastāstadā bhūtvā balakhānigṛhaṃ yayuḥ ..
sasutāṃ tāṃ praśasyāśu papracchurvinayānvitāḥ .. 102 ..
3.3.d:
ब्राह्मण्यस्तास्तदा भूत्वा बलखानिगृहं ययुः ॥
ससुतां तां प्रशस्याशु पप्रच्छुर्विनयान्विताः ॥ 102 ॥
3.3.m: Having then become Brahmin women, they went to the dwelling of Balakhāni. / Promptly praising that woman along with her sons, filled with modesty, they inquired:

3.3.s:
tava putrau mahāvīrau diṣṭyā śatrukṣayaṃkarau ..
tayormṛtyuḥ kathaṃ bhūyājjīvatāṃ śaradāṃ śatam .. 103 ..
3.3.d:
तव पुत्रौ महावीरौ दिष्ट्या शत्रुक्षयंकरौ ॥
तयोर्मृत्युः कथं भूयाज्जीवतां शरदां शतम् ॥ 103 ॥
3.3.m: "By good fortune, your two sons are great heroes who bring about the destruction of enemies. / How could death ever come to them? May they live for a hundred autumns!"

3.3.s:
tadā brāhmī vacaḥ prāha pāvakīyaḥ śaraḥ śubhaḥ ..
sukhakhānerjīvakaro balakhāneḥ padāhvakaḥ .. 104 ..
3.3.d:
तदा ब्राह्मी वचः प्राह पावकीयः शरः शुभः ॥
सुखखानेर्जीवकरो बलखानेः पदाह्वकः ॥ 104 ॥
3.3.m: Then Brāhmī spoke these words: "An auspicious arrow belonging to Pāvaka [Agni] / brings life to Sukhakhāni, and an arrow bearing the name of 'foot' [destroys] Balakhāni."

3.3.s:
iti jñātvā tu tā dūtyaḥ prayayurdehalīṃ prati ..
kathayitvā nṛpasyāgre dhanaṃ prāpyaṃ gṛhaṃ yayuḥ ..105..
3.3.d:
इति ज्ञात्वा तु ता दूत्यः प्रययुर्देहलीं प्रति ॥
कथयित्वा नृपस्याग्रे धनं प्राप्यं गृहं ययुः ॥105॥
3.3.m: Having learned this, those female messengers set out toward Dehalī. / Having related it before the king and received wealth, they went home.

3.3.s:
mahīrājastu tacchrutvā mahādevamumāpatim ..
pārthivaiḥ pūjanaṃ cakre sahasradivasānmudā ..106..
3.3.d:
महीराजस्तु तच्छ्रुत्वा महादेवमुमापतिम् ॥
पार्थिवैः पूजनं चक्रे सहस्रदिवसान्मुदा ॥106॥
3.3.m: Having heard that, Mahīrāja joyfully performed worship of Mahādeva, the lord of Umā, / with earthen liṅgas for a thousand days.

3.3.s:
sūta uvāca ..
ṣaḍviṃśābde ca kṛṣṇāṃśe yathā jātaṃ tathā śṛṇu ..
mune biṃdusaro nāma dakṣiṇasyāṃ diśi sthitam ..1..
3.3.d:
सूत उवाच ॥
षड्विंशाब्दे च कृष्णांशे यथा जातं तथा शृणु ॥
मुने बिंदुसरो नाम दक्षिणस्यां दिशि स्थितम् ॥1॥
3.3.m: Sūta said: / Hear, O sage, what happened in the twenty-sixth year in the portion of Kṛṣṇa: / There is [a lake] named Bindusaras situated in the southern direction.

3.3.s:
tasya tīre'vasadgrāmo yojanāyāmasaṃyutaḥ ..
nāmnā biṃdugaḍho durgo varṇadharmapravartakaḥ .. 2 ..
3.3.d:
तस्य तीरेऽवसद्ग्रामो योजनायामसंयुतः ॥
नाम्ना बिंदुगढो दुर्गो वर्णधर्मप्रवर्तकः ॥ 2 ॥
3.3.m: On its bank stood a village extending for a yojana, / a fortress named Bindugaḍha that maintained the duties of the social classes.

3.3.s:
tasmingrāme'vasadbhūpo viṣvaksenānvayodbhavaḥ ..
śāradānandano nāma brahmadhyānaparāyaṇaḥ..3..
3.3.d:
तस्मिन्ग्रामेऽवसद्भूपो विष्वक्सेनान्वयोद्भवः ॥
शारदानन्दनो नाम ब्रह्मध्यानपरायणः॥3॥
3.3.m: In that village lived a king born in the lineage of Viṣvaksena, / named Śāradānandana, devoted to meditation on Brahman.

3.3.s:
brahmacaryaprabhāveṇa tadvīryaṃ śirasi sthitam ..
atassa kāmapālākhyaḥ prathito'bhūnmahītale..4..
3.3.d:
ब्रह्मचर्यप्रभावेण तद्वीर्यं शिरसि स्थितम् ॥
अतस्स कामपालाख्यः प्रथितोऽभून्महीतले॥4॥
3.3.m: Through the power of his celibacy, his semen remained in his head; / therefore he became renowned on the surface of the earth by the name Kāmapāla.

3.3.s:
yajñaiḥ saṃpūjayāmāsa surajyeṣṭhaṃ prajāpatim..
yajñāṃśabhuktamātreṇa rājñī garbhamupādadhau..5..
3.3.d:
यज्ञैः संपूजयामास सुरज्येष्ठं प्रजापतिम्॥
यज्ञांशभुक्तमात्रेण राज्ञी गर्भमुपादधौ॥5॥
3.3.m: He worshipped Prajāpati, the eldest of the gods, with sacrifices; / merely by consuming the sacrificial share, the queen conceived.

3.3.s:
daśamāsāntare jātā kanyā sarvaguṇālayā ..
padminī nāma vikhyātā sarvaśobhāsamanvitā.. 6 ..
3.3.d:
दशमासान्तरे जाता कन्या सर्वगुणालया ॥
पद्मिनी नाम विख्याता सर्वशोभासमन्विता॥ 6 ॥
3.3.m: At the end of ten months, a daughter was born, an abode of all virtues, / renowned by the name Padminī, endowed with all beauty.

3.3.s:
dvādaśābdavayaḥ prāptau babhūva varavarṇinī ..
padmākaro bhūpasuto mahīrājapadānugaḥ ..7..
3.3.d:
द्वादशाब्दवयः प्राप्तौ बभूव वरवर्णिनी ॥
पद्माकरो भूपसुतो महीराजपदानुगः ॥7॥
3.3.m: When she reached twelve years of age, she became a fair-complexioned maiden. / Padmākara, the king’s son, was a follower of Mahīrāja.

3.3.s:
piturājñānusāreṇa bhūpānāhūya satvaram ..
svayaṃ varaṃ bhaginyāśca kārayāmāsa vai mudā .. 8 ..
3.3.d:
पितुराज्ञानुसारेण भूपानाहूय सत्वरम् ॥
स्वयं वरं भगिन्याश्च कारयामास वै मुदा ॥ 8 ॥
3.3.m: In accordance with his father's command, swiftly summoning the kings, / he joyfully arranged a svayaṃvara for his sister.

3.3.s:
nānādeśyā yayurbhūpā mukhyaśūrasamanvitāḥ ..
sahāhlādaiścatuvīrairlakṣaṇaḥ piturājñayā .. 9 ..
3.3.d:
नानादेश्या ययुर्भूपा मुख्यशूरसमन्विताः ॥
सहाह्लादैश्चतुवीरैर्लक्षणः पितुराज्ञया ॥ 9 ॥
3.3.m: Kings from various lands went, accompanied by their foremost heroes. / Together with the four heroes led by Āhlāda, Lakṣaṇa, by his father's command,

3.3.s:
yayau biṃdugaḍhaṃ grāmaṃ sthito yatra mahotsavaḥ ..
mahīrājastu balavāndṛṣṭvā lakṣaṇamāgatam .. 3.3.25.10 ..
3.3.d:
ययौ बिंदुगढं ग्रामं स्थितो यत्र महोत्सवः ॥
महीराजस्तु बलवान्दृष्ट्वा लक्षणमागतम् ॥ 3.3.25.10 ॥
3.3.m: went to the village of Bindugaḍha, where a great festival was underway. / But mighty Mahīrāja, seeing that Lakṣaṇa had arrived,

3.3.s:
svasenāṃ sthāpayāmāsa rakṣārthe sarvabhūbhujām ..
etasminnaṃtare devī sakhībhiḥ saha padminī .. 11 ..
3.3.d:
स्वसेनां स्थापयामास रक्षार्थे सर्वभूभुजाम् ॥
एतस्मिन्नंतरे देवी सखीभिः सह पद्मिनी ॥ 11 ॥
3.3.m: stationed his own army for the protection of all the kings. / In the meantime, the lady Padminī, together with her female companions,

3.3.s:
sarvabhūpānvilokyāśu lakṣaṇāṃtamupāyayau ..
śyāmāṃgaṃ ca yuvānaṃ ca sarvalakṣaṇa lakṣitam .. 12 ..
3.3.d:
सर्वभूपान्विलोक्याशु लक्षणांतमुपाययौ ॥
श्यामांगं च युवानं च सर्वलक्षण लक्षितम् ॥ 12 ॥
3.3.m: quickly looking upon all the kings, approached the side of Lakṣaṇa— / dark-limbed and youthful, marked by every auspicious sign,

3.3.s:
catvāriṃśattathā paṃcāśanmānābdavayovṛtam ..
vyūḍhoraskaṃ dṛḍhaskaṃdhaṃ nirjaraṃ rogavarjitam .. 13 ..
3.3.d:
चत्वारिंशत्तथा पंचाशन्मानाब्दवयोवृतम् ॥
व्यूढोरस्कं दृढस्कंधं निर्जरं रोगवर्जितम् ॥ 13 ॥
3.3.m: surpassing men of forty and fifty years of age in stature, / broad-chested, firm-shouldered, ageless, and free from disease.

3.3.s:
dṛṣṭvā tamātmasadṛśamāhlādādyaiśca rakṣitam ..
jayamālāṃ dadau tasmai padminī lakṣaṇāya ca .. 14 ..
3.3.d:
दृष्ट्वा तमात्मसदृशमाह्लादाद्यैश्च रक्षितम् ॥
जयमालां ददौ तस्मै पद्मिनी लक्षणाय च ॥ 14 ॥
3.3.m: Seeing him as suitable for herself and guarded by Āhlāda and the others, / Padminī placed the garland of victory upon that Lakṣaṇa.

3.3.s:
tadā sa lakṣaṇo vīro gṛhītvā pāṇimuttamam ..
svarathaṃ ca samāruhya rājñāṃ madhye yayau mudā .. 15 ..
3.3.d:
तदा स लक्षणो वीरो गृहीत्वा पाणिमुत्तमम् ॥
स्वरथं च समारुह्य राज्ञां मध्ये ययौ मुदा ॥ 15 ॥
3.3.m: Then that heroic Lakṣaṇa, taking her excellent hand, / mounted his own chariot and joyfully departed amidst the kings.

3.3.s:
pṛdhvīrājastathā sarve bhūmipā balasaṃyutāḥ ..
rurudhuḥ sarvato vīraṃ lakṣaṇaṃ balavattaram .. 16 ..
3.3.d:
पृध्वीराजस्तथा सर्वे भूमिपा बलसंयुताः ॥
रुरुधुः सर्वतो वीरं लक्षणं बलवत्तरम् ॥ 16 ॥
3.3.m: Pṛthvīrāja and all the kings, endowed with strength, / blockaded the immensely powerful hero Lakṣaṇa on all sides.

3.3.s:
tālanaḥ siṃhinīsaṃstho gṛhītvā parighaṃ mudā ..
sainyāni yodhayāmāsa bhīmasenāṃśasaṃbhavaḥ .. 17 ..
3.3.d:
तालनः सिंहिनीसंस्थो गृहीत्वा परिघं मुदा ॥
सैन्यानि योधयामास भीमसेनांशसंभवः ॥ 17 ॥
3.3.m: Tālana, mounted on a lioness and joyfully seizing an iron club, / fought the armies, born as an incarnation of a portion of Bhīmasena.

3.3.s:
paṃcaśabdagajārūḍhaścāhlādastomarāyudhaḥ ..
ripūnvidārayāmāsa balabhadrāṃśasaṃbhavaḥ .. 18 ..
3.3.d:
पंचशब्दगजारूढश्चाह्लादस्तोमरायुधः ॥
रिपून्विदारयामास बलभद्रांशसंभवः ॥ 18 ॥
3.3.m: Mounted on the elephant Pañcaśabda and armed with a javelin, Āhlāda, / born as an incarnation of a portion of Balabhadra, tore apart the enemies.

3.3.s:
kṛṣṇāṃśo bindulārūḍho gṛhītvā khaḍgamuttamam ..
bhūpatīnbahudhā chittvā mahāvadhamakārayat .. 19 ..
3.3.d:
कृष्णांशो बिन्दुलारूढो गृहीत्वा खड्गमुत्तमम् ॥
भूपतीन्बहुधा छित्त्वा महावधमकारयत् ॥ 19 ॥
3.3.m: The incarnation of a portion of Kṛṣṇa, mounted on Bindula and taking an excellent sword, / repeatedly struck down the kings and wrought a great slaughter.

3.3.s:
devo manorathārūḍho bhairavaṃ bhallamādadhau ..
hatvā ca bahudhā sainyaṃ nanarda ca punaḥpunaḥ .. 3.3.25.20 ..
3.3.d:
देवो मनोरथारूढो भैरवं भल्लमादधौ ॥
हत्वा च बहुधा सैन्यं ननर्द च पुनःपुनः ॥ 3.3.25.20 ॥
3.3.m: Deva, mounted on Manoratha, held a terrifying spear; / having slain the army in many ways, he roared again and again.

3.3.s:
lakṣaṇo dhanurādāya vaiṣṇavāstrāṇi vai punaḥ ..
saṃdhāya ca jaghānāśu mahīrājasya sainyapān .. 21 ..
3.3.d:
लक्षणो धनुरादाय वैष्णवास्त्राणि वै पुनः ॥
संधाय च जघानाशु महीराजस्य सैन्यपान् ॥ 21 ॥
3.3.m: Lakṣaṇa, taking up his bow and fitting Vaiṣṇava missiles, / swiftly struck down the army commanders of Mahīrāja.

3.3.s:
yāmamātramabhūyuddhaṃ teṣāṃ taiśca samanvitam ..
tyaktvā yuddhaṃ mahīrājaḥ sarvabhūpasamanvitaḥ .. 22 ..
3.3.d:
याममात्रमभूयुद्धं तेषां तैश्च समन्वितम् ॥
त्यक्त्वा युद्धं महीराजः सर्वभूपसमन्वितः ॥ 22 ॥
3.3.m: The battle between them lasted only for a single watch of the day. / Abandoning the fight, Mahīrāja, accompanied by all the kings,

3.3.s:
yayau sa dehalīgrāme śāradānaṃdanastadā ..
saṃsthāpya maṇḍapaśubhaṃ kṛtvā vaivāhikīḥ kriyāḥ ..
dadau kanyāṃ vidhānena dhanadhānyādisaṃvṛtām .. 23 ..
3.3.d:
ययौ स देहलीग्रामे शारदानंदनस्तदा ॥
संस्थाप्य मण्डपशुभं कृत्वा वैवाहिकीः क्रियाः ॥
ददौ कन्यां विधानेन धनधान्यादिसंवृताम् ॥ 23 ॥
3.3.m: went to the village of Dehalī. Then Śāradānandana, / having erected an auspicious pavilion and performed the marriage rites, / gave away his daughter according to rule, endowed with wealth, grain, and other gifts.

3.3.s:
etasminnantare prāpto mahīpatiruvāca tam ..
padmākaraṃ bhūpasutaṃ lakṣasainyasamanvitam .. 24 ..
3.3.d:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे प्राप्तो महीपतिरुवाच तम् ॥
पद्माकरं भूपसुतं लक्षसैन्यसमन्वितम् ॥ 24 ॥
3.3.m: In the meantime, the king [Mahīrāja] arrived and spoke to that / prince Padmākara, who was accompanied by an army of one hundred thousand:

3.3.s:
aho mitra mahāvīra kīdṛśī te matiḥ sthitā ..
viṣvaksenānvaye tvaṃ vai saṃjātaḥ kṣatriyottamaḥ .. 25 ..
3.3.d:
अहो मित्र महावीर कीदृशी ते मतिः स्थिता ॥
विष्वक्सेनान्वये त्वं वै संजातः क्षत्रियोत्तमः ॥ 25 ॥
3.3.m: "O friend, great hero! What sort of intellect has settled in you? / You were indeed born in the lineage of Viṣvaksena, a foremost kṣatriya.

3.3.s:
lakṣaṇo dharmarahito varṇasaṃkarasaṃyutaḥ ..
āhlādādyāśca te śūrā ābhīramātṛsaṃbhavāḥ ..
tairyutaśca nivāso vai saṃtyājyo dharmakovidaiḥ .. 26 ..
3.3.d:
लक्षणो धर्मरहितो वर्णसंकरसंयुतः ॥
आह्लादाद्याश्च ते शूरा आभीरमातृसंभवाः ॥
तैर्युतश्च निवासो वै संत्याज्यो धर्मकोविदैः ॥ 26 ॥
3.3.m: Lakṣaṇa is devoid of dharma and sprung from a mixture of castes, / and those heroes led by Āhlāda are born of an Ābhīra mother; / cohabitation with them is certainly to be shunned by those skilled in dharma."

3.3.s:
iti padmākaraḥ śrutvā sarvamāyāviśāradaḥ ..
sa kṛtvā śāmbarīṃ māyāṃ baddhvā tāneva durjayān ..
svagehe sthāpayāmāsa kārāgāre śilāmaye .. 27 ..
3.3.d:
इति पद्माकरः श्रुत्वा सर्वमायाविशारदः ॥
स कृत्वा शाम्बरीं मायां बद्ध्वा तानेव दुर्जयान् ॥
स्वगेहे स्थापयामास कारागारे शिलामये ॥ 27 ॥
3.3.m: Having heard this, Padmākara, an expert in all magical arts, / employing Śāmbarī magic and binding those very men who were hard to conquer, / kept them in his own residence in a prison made of stone.

3.3.s:
devyāśca varadānena devasiṃhastadā niśi ..
tyaktvā māyāmohamayī kānyakubjamupāyayau .. 28 ..
3.3.d:
देव्याश्च वरदानेन देवसिंहस्तदा निशि ॥
त्यक्त्वा मायामोहमयी कान्यकुब्जमुपाययौ ॥ 28 ॥
3.3.m: By the boons of the goddess, Devasiṃha on that night, / breaking free from the delusion created by magic, went to Kānyakubja.

3.3.s:
iṃdulāgre ca tatsarve gaditvā tena saṃyutaḥ ..
prāpto biṃdugaḍhaṃ śīghraṃ divyamāyāviśāradaḥ .. 29 ..
3.3.d:
इंदुलाग्रे च तत्सर्वे गदित्वा तेन संयुतः ॥
प्राप्तो बिंदुगढं शीघ्रं दिव्यमायाविशारदः ॥ 29 ॥
3.3.m: Having related all of that before Indula, he, accompanied by him / who was skilled in divine magic, quickly reached Bindugaḍha.

3.3.s:
padmākarastu tacchutvā kṛtvā māyāṃ ca śāmbarīm ..
mohanāyodyatastatra yathā megho raviṃ divi .. 3.3.25.30 ..
3.3.d:
पद्माकरस्तु तच्छुत्वा कृत्वा मायां च शाम्बरीम् ॥
मोहनायोद्यतस्तत्र यथा मेघो रविं दिवि ॥ 3.3.25.30 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing that, Padmākara, having produced his Śāmbarī magic, / stepped forward to delude them there, just as a cloud [obscures] the sun in the sky.

3.3.s:
iṃdulaśca tadā cāpe saṃdhāya śaramuttamam ..
kāmāstreṇa tu tanmāyā bhasmībhūtābhavatkṣaṇāt .. 31 ..
3.3.d:
इंदुलश्च तदा चापे संधाय शरमुत्तमम् ॥
कामास्त्रेण तु तन्माया भस्मीभूताभवत्क्षणात् ॥ 31 ॥
3.3.m: Then Indula, fitting an excellent arrow to his bow, / reduced that magic to ashes in an instant with a love-missile.

3.3.s:
tadā te bodhitāḥ sarve kāmāstreṇa mahābalāḥ ..
bhittvā lohamayaṃ jālaṃ kapāṭaṃ ca tathā dṛḍham .. 32 ..
3.3.d:
तदा ते बोधिताः सर्वे कामास्त्रेण महाबलाः ॥
भित्त्वा लोहमयं जालं कपाटं च तथा दृढम् ॥ 32 ॥
