3.3.m: Then, awakened by the love-missile, all those mighty heroes, / breaking through the iron grating and the sturdy door,

3.3.s:
bahirbhūtāḥ samājagmuḥ śatrusainyānyanāśayan ..
kṣatriyāḥ paṃcasāhasrā mṛtā yamapuraṃ yayuḥ .. 33 ..
3.3.d:
बहिर्भूताः समाजग्मुः शत्रुसैन्यान्यनाशयन् ॥
क्षत्रियाः पंचसाहस्रा मृता यमपुरं ययुः ॥ 33 ॥
3.3.m: came outside, destroying the enemy armies; / five thousand kṣatriyas died and went to the realm of Yama.

3.3.s:
śāradānaṃdano bhūpastatrāgatya vinamya tān ..
svasutāṃ ca dadau tasmai lakṣaṇāya mahātmane ..34..
3.3.d:
शारदानंदनो भूपस्तत्रागत्य विनम्य तान् ॥
स्वसुतां च ददौ तस्मै लक्षणाय महात्मने ॥34॥
3.3.m: King Śāradānandana, arriving there and bowing to them, / gave his daughter to that great-souled Lakṣaṇa.

3.3.s:
nānāvidhāni bhojyāni praśasyābharaṇāni ca ..
sarvebhyaśca dadau rājā sahasrebhyastadā mudā .. 35 ..
3.3.d:
नानाविधानि भोज्यानि प्रशस्याभरणानि च ॥
सर्वेभ्यश्च ददौ राजा सहस्रेभ्यस्तदा मुदा ॥ 35 ॥
3.3.m: The king then joyfully gave various kinds of food / and praiseworthy ornaments to all the thousands [of people].

3.3.s:
kumārikāṃ svakīyāṃ ca bahurodanatatparām..
sa matvā kāmapālo vai svagehāttaṃ nyavāsayat ..
āgato lakṣaṇo gehaṃ māghakṛṣṇāṣṭamīdine .. 36 ..
3.3.d:
कुमारिकां स्वकीयां च बहुरोदनतत्पराम्॥
स मत्वा कामपालो वै स्वगेहात्तं न्यवासयत् ॥
आगतो लक्षणो गेहं माघकृष्णाष्टमीदिने ॥ 36 ॥
3.3.m: And considering his maiden daughter, intent on much weeping, / Kāmapāla lodged him away from his house. / Lakṣaṇa came home on the eighth lunar day of the dark fortnight of Māgha.

3.3.s:
jayacaṃdrastu taṃ dṛṣṭvā lakṣaṇaṃ premavihvalaḥ ..
śatagrāmāndadau tebhyastālanādibhya eva ca..37..
3.3.d:
जयचंद्रस्तु तं दृष्ट्वा लक्षणं प्रेमविह्वलः ॥
शतग्रामान्ददौ तेभ्यस्तालनादिभ्य एव च॥37॥
3.3.m: Seeing him, Jayacandra was overwhelmed with affection; / he gave a hundred villages to them, Tālanā and the others.

3.3.s:
dattvā tato'nyadānāni govastrābharaṇāni ca ..
pradadau brāhmaṇebhyaśca sa cakāra mahotsavam ..38.. ..
3.3.d:
दत्त्वा ततोऽन्यदानानि गोवस्त्राभरणानि च ॥
प्रददौ ब्राह्मणेभ्यश्च स चकार महोत्सवम् ॥38॥ ॥
3.3.m: Having given then other gifts, cattle, garments, and ornaments, / he gave them to the Brahmins and held a great festival.

3.3.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
mahīrājo varaṃ prāptaḥ śaṃkarātpārthivārcanāt ..
saṃyojya phālgune māsi senāṃ śatrubhayaṃkarām .. 39 ..
3.3.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
महीराजो वरं प्राप्तः शंकरात्पार्थिवार्चनात् ॥
संयोज्य फाल्गुने मासि सेनां शत्रुभयंकराम् ॥ 39 ॥
3.3.m: Sūta said: / Mahīrāja obtained a boon from Śaṅkara by worshipping an earthen liṅga. / Marshaling an army in the month of Phālguna that struck fear into his enemies,

3.3.s:
saptalakṣaiśca sahitaḥ śirīṣākhyapuraṃ yayau ..
nṛpājñayā ca cāṃmuḍo rurodha nagaraṃ punaḥ .. 3.3.25.40 ..
3.3.d:
सप्तलक्षैश्च सहितः शिरीषाख्यपुरं ययौ ॥
नृपाज्ञया च चांमुडो रुरोध नगरं पुनः ॥ 3.3.25.40 ॥
3.3.m: accompanied by seven hundred thousand, he went to the city named Śirīṣa. / And at the king's command, Cāmuṇḍa again besieged the city.

3.3.s:
sukhakhānistadā kruddho lakṣasainyasamanvitaḥ ..
nagarādbahirāgatya mahāvadhamakārayat .. 41 ..
3.3.d:
सुखखानिस्तदा क्रुद्धो लक्षसैन्यसमन्वितः ॥
नगराद्बहिरागत्य महावधमकारयत् ॥ 41 ॥
3.3.m: Then Sukhakhāni, enraged, accompanied by an army of a hundred thousand, / came out of the city and caused a great slaughter.

3.3.s:
pāvakāstreṇa balavānhatvā daśasahasrakam ..
mahīrājamupāgamya vacanaṃ prāha nirbhayaḥ .. 42 ..
3.3.d:
पावकास्त्रेण बलवान्हत्वा दशसहस्रकम् ॥
महीराजमुपागम्य वचनं प्राह निर्भयः ॥ 42 ॥
3.3.m: The mighty one, having killed ten thousand with a fire-weapon, / approached Mahīrāja and spoke fearless words:

3.3.s:
adya tvāṃ ca haniṣyāmi tvaṃ vā hantā raṇe mama ..
svavidyāṃ kuru bhūpa tvaṃ no cedyāsyasi vaiśasam .. 43 ..
3.3.d:
अद्य त्वां च हनिष्यामि त्वं वा हन्ता रणे मम ॥
स्वविद्यां कुरु भूप त्वं नो चेद्यास्यसि वैशसम् ॥ 43 ॥
3.3.m: "Today I shall kill you, or you will be my slayer in battle. / Display your skill, O king, otherwise you will meet your destruction."

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā mahīrājo raudrāstraṃ cāpa ādadhe ..
tadastrācca mahāvahniḥ prādurbhūto bhayaṃkaraḥ .. 44 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा महीराजो रौद्रास्त्रं चाप आदधे ॥
तदस्त्राच्च महावह्निः प्रादुर्भूतो भयंकरः ॥ 44 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing this, Mahīrāja set a Raudra weapon upon his bow. / From that weapon a terrible, great fire burst forth.

3.3.s:
sukhakhānistadāgneyaṃ saṃdadhau tasya śāṃtaye ..
raudrāgninā ca saśaraḥ sukhakhānirlayaṃ gataḥ .. 45 ..
3.3.d:
सुखखानिस्तदाग्नेयं संदधौ तस्य शांतये ॥
रौद्राग्निना च सशरः सुखखानिर्लयं गतः ॥ 45 ॥
3.3.m: Then Sukhakhāni discharged a fire-missile to pacify it. / But by the Raudra fire, Sukhakhāni perished along with his arrows.

3.3.s:
tadastraṃ śivatūṇīre gataṃ kāryaṃ vidhāya tat ..
balakhānistu tacchrutvā bhayabhītaḥ samāgataḥ .. 46 ..
3.3.d:
तदस्त्रं शिवतूणीरे गतं कार्यं विधाय तत् ॥
बलखानिस्तु तच्छ्रुत्वा भयभीतः समागतः ॥ 46 ॥
3.3.m: Having accomplished its task, that weapon returned to Śiva's quiver. / Hearing of that, Balakhāni came up, terrified with fear.

3.3.s:
bhrāturvairamupādāya jaghāna ca riporbalam ..
dhyātvā ca śāradāṃ devīṃ bhūmirājamupāgamat .. 47 ..
3.3.d:
भ्रातुर्वैरमुपादाय जघान च रिपोर्बलम् ॥
ध्यात्वा च शारदां देवीं भूमिराजमुपागमत् ॥ 47 ॥
3.3.m: Taking up his brother's enmity, he struck down the enemy's host. / Meditating upon goddess Śāradā, he approached the earth's ruler [Mahīrāja].

3.3.s:
bhūmirājastu taṃ dṛṣṭvā tadbalādhikyamohitaḥ ..
uvāca vacanaṃ premṇā balakhāne śṛṇuṣva bhoḥ .. 48 ..
3.3.d:
भूमिराजस्तु तं दृष्ट्वा तद्बलाधिक्यमोहितः ॥
उवाच वचनं प्रेम्णा बलखाने शृणुष्व भोः ॥ 48 ॥
3.3.m: Seeing him, the earth's ruler [Mahīrāja], astonished by the superiority of his power, / spoke words with affection: "Listen, O Balakhāni!

3.3.s:
krośamātrāntare gartā dvādaśaiva mayā kṛtāḥ ..
rakṣitā dvādaśaśataiḥ śūrairyuddhaviśāradaiḥ .. 49 ..
3.3.d:
क्रोशमात्रान्तरे गर्ता द्वादशैव मया कृताः ॥
रक्षिता द्वादशशतैः शूरैर्युद्धविशारदैः ॥ 49 ॥
3.3.m: At an interval of just one krośa, twelve pits have been made by me, / guarded by twelve hundred heroes skilled in battle.

3.3.s:
śūrāñjitvā samullaṃghya gartāndvādaśasammitān ..
mamārddhaṃ sakalaṃ rāṣṭraṃ gṛhāṇa balisattama .. 3.3.25.50 ..
3.3.d:
शूराञ्जित्वा समुल्लंघ्य गर्तान्द्वादशसम्मितान् ॥
ममार्द्धं सकलं राष्ट्रं गृहाण बलिसत्तम ॥ 3.3.25.50 ॥
3.3.m: Having conquered the heroes and leaped over those twelve pits, / take the whole half of my kingdom, O best among the strong!"

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā priyaṃ vākyaṃ tadrājñā satyabhāṣitam ..
kapotaṃ hayamāruhya khaḍgahasto vanaṃ yayau .. 51 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा प्रियं वाक्यं तद्राज्ञा सत्यभाषितम् ॥
कपोतं हयमारुह्य खड्गहस्तो वनं ययौ ॥ 51 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing these pleasing words spoken truly by that king, / he mounted his horse Kapota and went into the forest, sword in hand.

3.3.s:
dṛṣṭvā gartānmahāvīro hatvā śūrāñchatañchatam..
yayau sa dvādaśāngarttānbāhuśālī jiteṃdriyaḥ .. 52 ..
3.3.d:
दृष्ट्वा गर्तान्महावीरो हत्वा शूराञ्छतञ्छतम्॥
ययौ स द्वादशान्गर्त्तान्बाहुशाली जितेंद्रियः ॥ 52 ॥
3.3.m: Seeing the pits, that great hero, slaying heroes by hundreds, / that long-armed master of his senses passed those twelve pits.

3.3.s:
cāmuṃḍastu tadāgatya śarāyutasamanvitaḥ ...
rurodha sarvato vīraṃ chadmakārī dvijādhamaḥ .. 53 ..
3.3.d:
चामुंडस्तु तदागत्य शरायुतसमन्वितः ॥।
रुरोध सर्वतो वीरं छद्मकारी द्विजाधमः ॥ 53 ॥
3.3.m: Then Cāmuṇḍa arrived, equipped with ten thousand arrows; / that vile Brahmin, a worker of deceit, surrounded the hero on every side.

3.3.s:
balakhāniśca mahatīṃ senāṃ tasya jaghāna ha ..
cāmuṃḍaṃ tamupāgamya nanarda ca punaḥpunaḥ .. 54 ..
3.3.d:
बलखानिश्च महतीं सेनां तस्य जघान ह ॥
चामुंडं तमुपागम्य ननर्द च पुनःपुनः ॥ 54 ॥
3.3.m: Balakhāni slaughtered his great army, / and approaching that Cāmuṇḍa, roared again and again.

3.3.s:
trayodaśaṃ guptagartaṃ tṛṇairācchāditaṃ mṛdā ..
viṣadhautairmahābhallaissaṃruddhaṃ vivaraprabham .. 55 ..
3.3.d:
त्रयोदशं गुप्तगर्तं तृणैराच्छादितं मृदा ॥
विषधौतैर्महाभल्लैस्संरुद्धं विवरप्रभम् ॥ 55 ॥
3.3.m: A thirteenth hidden pit, covered with grass and soil, / was bristling with large lances cleansed with poison, resembling a chasm.

3.3.s:
patitaḥ sakapotaśca sa vīro daivamohitaḥ ..
aṃdhakāre mahāghoraṃ gaṃbhīraṃ krośamātrakam .. 56 ..
3.3.d:
पतितः सकपोतश्च स वीरो दैवमोहितः ॥
अंधकारे महाघोरं गंभीरं क्रोशमात्रकम् ॥ 56 ॥
3.3.m: Bewildered by fate, that hero fell into it along with Kapota; / in the darkness it was exceedingly dreadful, deep, measuring a krośa.

3.3.s:
vidīrṇastatra caraṇassa padmo vatsajasya vai ..
mahākaṣṭena tadvājī gartādāgatya vai bahiḥ ..
svapadaistāḍayāmāsa mahīrājasya tadbalam .. 57 ..
3.3.d:
विदीर्णस्तत्र चरणस्स पद्मो वत्सजस्य वै ॥
महाकष्टेन तद्वाजी गर्तादागत्य वै बहिः ॥
स्वपदैस्ताडयामास महीराजस्य तद्बलम् ॥ 57 ॥
3.3.m: There the foot, indeed the hoof of the foal was torn open. / With great difficulty that steed came out from the pit / and struck down Mahīrāja's host with its hooves.

3.3.s:
cāmuṃḍastu tadāgatya balakhāneśca vai śiraḥ ..
chittvā jaghāna tatsainyaṃ hāhābhūtaṃ vineśvaram .. 58 ..
3.3.d:
चामुंडस्तु तदागत्य बलखानेश्च वै शिरः ॥
छित्त्वा जघान तत्सैन्यं हाहाभूतं विनेश्वरम् ॥ 58 ॥
3.3.m: Then Cāmuṇḍa, coming forward, cut off Balakhāni's head / and slaughtered his army, which was crying 'Alas!' and left without a master.

3.3.s:
gajamuktā ca tacchutvā citāmāropya vai patim ..
dāhayāmāsa cāṃgāni sā patyā saha vai satī .. 59 ..
3.3.d:
गजमुक्ता च तच्छुत्वा चितामारोप्य वै पतिम् ॥
दाहयामास चांगानि सा पत्या सह वै सती ॥ 59 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing of that, Gajamuktā placed her husband on the funeral pyre; / that faithful wife burned her limbs together with her husband.

3.3.s:
tadā brahmā svavadhvā ca sārddhamāgatya tatra vai ..
sukhakhāniṃ ca saṃhūya dadāha tatkalevaram .. 3.3.25.60 ..
3.3.d:
तदा ब्रह्मा स्ववध्वा च सार्द्धमागत्य तत्र वै ॥
सुखखानिं च संहूय ददाह तत्कलेवरम् ॥ 3.3.25.60 ॥
3.3.m: Then Brahmā, having arrived there together with his daughter-in-law, / called forth Sukhakhāni and burned his body.

3.3.s:
śūnyabhūtaṃ ca nagaraṃ bhasma kṛtvā sa vai nṛpaḥ ..
jagāma dehalī śīghraṃ mahotsāhasamanvitaḥ .. 61 ..
3.3.d:
शून्यभूतं च नगरं भस्म कृत्वा स वै नृपः ॥
जगाम देहली शीघ्रं महोत्साहसमन्वितः ॥ 61 ॥
3.3.m: Having reduced that deserted city to ashes, that king / went swiftly to Dehalī, filled with great enthusiasm.

3.3.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
śrāvaṇe māsi saṃprāpte dehalīṃ ca mahīpatiḥ ..
nāgotsavāya prayayau sadaiva kalahapriyaḥ .. 1 ..
3.3.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
श्रावणे मासि संप्राप्ते देहलीं च महीपतिः ॥
नागोत्सवाय प्रययौ सदैव कलहप्रियः ॥ 1 ॥
3.3.m: Sūta said: / When the month of Śrāvaṇa arrived, the earth-ruler, / who was always fond of strife, went to Dehalī for the serpent festival.

3.3.s:
dṛṣṭvā nāgotsavaṃ tatra gītanṛtyasamanvitam ..
mahīrājaṃ namaskṛtya vacanaṃ prāha namradhīḥ .. 2 ..
3.3.d:
दृष्ट्वा नागोत्सवं तत्र गीतनृत्यसमन्वितम् ॥
महीराजं नमस्कृत्य वचनं प्राह नम्रधीः ॥ 2 ॥
3.3.m: Seeing the serpent festival there, accompanied by singing and dancing, / he bowed to Mahīrāja and, humble in mind, spoke these words:

3.3.s:
rājanmahāvatīgrāme kīrtisāgaramadhyage ..
vāmanotsavamatyaṃ taṃ yavavrīhisamanvitaḥ ..
paśya tvaṃ tatra gatvā ca mamaiva vacanaṃ kuru .. 3 ..
3.3.d:
राजन्महावतीग्रामे कीर्तिसागरमध्यगे ॥
वामनोत्सवमत्यं तं यवव्रीहिसमन्वितः ॥
पश्य त्वं तत्र गत्वा च ममैव वचनं कुरु ॥ 3 ॥
3.3.m: "O king, in the village of Mahāvatī, located in the middle of Kīrtisāgara, / is the great festival of Vāmana, furnished with barley and rice. / Go there, see it, and do what I say."

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā mahīrājo dhuṃdhukāreṇa saṃyutaḥ ..
saptalakṣabalairyuktaścāmuṇḍena samanvitaḥ ..
prāptaḥ śirīṣavipine tatra vāsamakārayat .. 4 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा महीराजो धुंधुकारेण संयुतः ॥
सप्तलक्षबलैर्युक्तश्चामुण्डेन समन्वितः ॥
प्राप्तः शिरीषविपिने तत्र वासमकारयत् ॥ 4 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing this, Mahīrāja, accompanied by Dhundhukāra, / endowed with a force of seven hundred thousand, and accompanied by Cāmuṇḍa, / reached the forest of Śirīṣa and took up residence there.

3.3.s:
mahīpatistu nṛpatiṃ natvā vai candravaṃśinam ..
uvāca vacanaṃ duḥkhī dhūrto māyāviśāradaḥ .. 5 ..
3.3.d:
महीपतिस्तु नृपतिं नत्वा वै चन्द्रवंशिनम् ॥
उवाच वचनं दुःखी धूर्तो मायाविशारदः ॥ 5 ॥
3.3.m: Then the earth-ruler [Mahīpati], bowing to the king of the lunar dynasty, / spoke these words sorrowfully, a rogue skilled in deception:

3.3.s:
rājanprāpto mahīrājo yuddhārthī tvāmupasthitaḥ ..
candrāvalīṃ ca tanayāṃ brahmānaṃdaṃ tavātmajam ..
divyaliṃgaṃ sa saṃpūjya balātkārādgrahīṣyati .. 6 ..
3.3.d:
राजन्प्राप्तो महीराजो युद्धार्थी त्वामुपस्थितः ॥
चन्द्रावलीं च तनयां ब्रह्मानंदं तवात्मजम् ॥
दिव्यलिंगं स संपूज्य बलात्काराद्ग्रहीष्यति ॥ 6 ॥
3.3.m: "O king, Mahīrāja has arrived, desiring war, and approaches you. / Having worshipped the divine liṅga, he will violently seize / your daughter Candrāvalī and your son Brahmānanda.

3.3.s:
tasmāttvaṃ svabalaiḥ sārddhaṃ mayā saha mahāmate ..
chadmanā taṃ parājitya nagare'sminsukhī bhava .. 7 ..
3.3.d:
तस्मात्त्वं स्वबलैः सार्द्धं मया सह महामते ॥
छद्मना तं पराजित्य नगरेऽस्मिन्सुखी भव ॥ 7 ॥
3.3.m: Therefore, along with your forces and together with me, O great-minded one, / conquer him by deceit and live happily in this city."

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā daiva vaśo rājā parimalo balī ..
caturlakṣabalaissārddhaṃ niśīthe ca samāgataḥ .. 8 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा दैव वशो राजा परिमलो बली ॥
चतुर्लक्षबलैस्सार्द्धं निशीथे च समागतः ॥ 8 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing this, the mighty King Parimala, subject to destiny, / came at midnight along with a force of four hundred thousand.

3.3.s:
śayitānkṣatriyāñchūrānhatvā paṃcasahasrakān ..
śataghnīṃ roṣaṇīṃ cakre bahuśūravināśinīm .. 9 ..
3.3.d:
शयितान्क्षत्रियाञ्छूरान्हत्वा पंचसहस्रकान् ॥
शतघ्नीं रोषणीं चक्रे बहुशूरविनाशिनीम् ॥ 9 ॥
3.3.m: Having slain five thousand sleeping kṣatriya heroes, / he made the cannon furious, destroying many heroes.

3.3.s:
tadotthāya mahīrājaḥ kaṭimābadhya saṃbhramāt ..
vairiṇaṃ paramaṃ matvā mahadyuddhamacīkarat .. 3.3.26.10 ..
3.3.d:
तदोत्थाय महीराजः कटिमाबध्य संभ्रमात् ॥
वैरिणं परमं मत्वा महद्युद्धमचीकरत् ॥ 3.3.26.10 ॥
3.3.m: Then Mahīrāja arose, quickly girded his loins, / and considering his enemy supreme, waged a great battle.

3.3.s:
yuddhyaṃtyoḥ senayo statra malanā putragṛddhinī ..
śāradāmādarādgatvā pūjayāmāsa bhaktitaḥ .. 11 ..
3.3.d:
युद्ध्यंत्योः सेनयो स्तत्र मलना पुत्रगृद्धिनी ॥
शारदामादराद्गत्वा पूजयामास भक्तितः ॥ 11 ॥
3.3.m: While the two armies were fighting there, Malanā, longing for her son, / went respectfully to Śāradā and worshipped her with devotion:

3.3.s:
devidevi mahādevi sarvaduḥkhavināśini ..
hara me sakalāṃ bādhāṃ kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ bodhayāśu ca .. 12 ..
3.3.d:
देविदेवि महादेवि सर्वदुःखविनाशिनि ॥
हर मे सकलां बाधां कृष्णांशं बोधयाशु च ॥ 12 ॥
3.3.m: "O Goddess, O Goddess, O Great Goddess, destroyer of all sorrow! / Remove all my distress and quickly awaken the portion of Kṛṣṇa!"

3.3.s:
japtvāyutamimaṃ maṃtraṃ hutvā tarpaṇamārjane ..
kṛtvā suṣvāpa tadveśmastadā tuṣṭā svayaṃ śivā .. 13 ..
3.3.d:
जप्त्वायुतमिमं मंत्रं हुत्वा तर्पणमार्जने ॥
कृत्वा सुष्वाप तद्वेश्मस्तदा तुष्टा स्वयं शिवा ॥ 13 ॥
3.3.m: Having chanted this mantra ten thousand times, offering oblations, libation, and sprinkling, / she slept in that temple; then Śivā herself was pleased:

3.3.s: malane mahatī bādhā kṣayaṃ yāsyati mā śucaḥ .. 14 ..
3.3.d: मलने महती बाधा क्षयं यास्यति मा शुचः ॥ 14 ॥
3.3.m: "O Malanā, your great distress will go to ruin; do not grieve!"

3.3.s:
ityuktvā śāradā devī kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ prati cāgamat ..
putra te jananī bhūmirmahīrājena pīḍitā..
kṣayaṃ yāsyati śīghraṃ ca tasmāttvaṃ tāṃ samuddhara .. 15 ..
3.3.d:
इत्युक्त्वा शारदा देवी कृष्णांशं प्रति चागमत् ॥
पुत्र ते जननी भूमिर्महीराजेन पीडिता॥
क्षयं यास्यति शीघ्रं च तस्मात्त्वं तां समुद्धर ॥ 15 ॥
3.3.m: Having spoken thus, the goddess Śāradā came before the portion of Kṛṣṇa [and said]: / "Son, your mother, the land, is tormented by Mahīrāja; / she will soon meet with destruction, therefore do you rescue her."

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā vaco devyāssa vīro vismayānvitaḥ ..
devakīṃ prati saṃprāptaḥ kathayāmāsa kāraṇam .. 16 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा वचो देव्यास्स वीरो विस्मयान्वितः ॥
देवकीं प्रति संप्राप्तः कथयामास कारणम् ॥ 16 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing these words of the goddess, that hero, filled with wonder, / went to Devakī and related the cause.

3.3.s:
sā tu śrutvā vaco ghoraṃ svarṇavatyā samanvitā ..
ruroda bhṛśamudvignā vilapya bahudhā satī .. 17 ..
3.3.d:
सा तु श्रुत्वा वचो घोरं स्वर्णवत्या समन्विता ॥
रुरोद भृशमुद्विग्ना विलप्य बहुधा सती ॥ 17 ॥
3.3.m: Having heard those terrible words, she, accompanied by Svarṇavatī, / wept, intensely distressed, and wailed in many ways, chaste woman [that she was].

3.3.s:
kṛṣṇāṃśastu tadā duḥkhī devasiṃhamuvāca ha ..
kiṃ kartavyaṃ mayā vīra dehyājñāṃ dāruṇe bhaye .. 18 ..
3.3.d:
कृष्णांशस्तु तदा दुःखी देवसिंहमुवाच ह ॥
किं कर्तव्यं मया वीर देह्याज्ञां दारुणे भये ॥ 18 ॥
3.3.m: Then the portion of Kṛṣṇa, sorrowful, spoke to Devasiṃha: / "What should I do, O hero? Give an order in [this] terrible peril."

3.3.s:
tacchrutvā tena sahito lakṣaṇena samanvitaḥ ..
yayau digvijayārthena vyājena ca mahāvatīm .. .. 19 ..
3.3.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा तेन सहितो लक्षणेन समन्वितः ॥
ययौ दिग्विजयार्थेन व्याजेन च महावतीम् ॥ ॥ 19 ॥
3.3.m: Having heard that, accompanied by him and joined by Lakṣaṇa, / he set out for Mahāvatī under the pretext of a world conquest.

3.3.s:
tālano bhīmasenāṃśaḥ senāpatirudāradhīḥ ..
saptalakṣabalaissārddhaṃ vināhlādena saṃyayau .. 3.3.26.20 ..
3.3.d:
तालनो भीमसेनांशः सेनापतिरुदारधीः ॥
सप्तलक्षबलैस्सार्द्धं विनाह्लादेन संययौ ॥ 3.3.26.20 ॥
3.3.m: Tālana, the noble-minded portion of Bhīmasena and commander of the army, / set out together with a force of seven hundred thousand, without Āhlāda.

3.3.s:
kalpakṣretramupāgamya yoginaste tadābhavan ..
senāṃ niveśayāmāsa vipine tatra dāruṇe .. 21 ..
3.3.d:
कल्पक्ष्रेत्रमुपागम्य योगिनस्ते तदाभवन् ॥
सेनां निवेशयामास विपिने तत्र दारुणे ॥ 21 ॥
3.3.m: Approaching Kalpakṣetra, they then disguised themselves as yogins; / he quartered the army there in that dreadful forest.

3.3.s:
kṛṣṇāṃśastālano devo lakṣaṇo balavattaraḥ ..
gṛhītvā lāsyavastūni yuddhabhūmimupāgaman ..22..
3.3.d:
कृष्णांशस्तालनो देवो लक्षणो बलवत्तरः ॥
गृहीत्वा लास्यवस्तूनि युद्धभूमिमुपागमन् ॥22॥
3.3.m: The portion of Kṛṣṇa, Tālana, Deva, and the very powerful Lakṣaṇa, / taking the instruments of dance, approached the battlefield.

3.3.s:
saptāhaṃ ca tayoryuddhaṃ jātaṃ mṛtyuvivarddhanam ..
saptame'hani te vīrāssaṃprāptā raṇamūrddhani ..23..
3.3.d:
सप्ताहं च तयोर्युद्धं जातं मृत्युविवर्द्धनम् ॥
सप्तमेऽहनि ते वीरास्संप्राप्ता रणमूर्द्धनि ॥23॥
3.3.m: And for seven days a battle took place between the two, swelling the ranks of death; / on the seventh day those heroes arrived at the forefront of battle.

3.3.s: tasmindine mahābhāga mahadyuddhamavartata .. 24 ..
3.3.d: तस्मिन्दिने महाभाग महद्युद्धमवर्तत ॥ 24 ॥
3.3.m: On that day, O highly fortunate one, a great battle took place.

3.3.s:
dṛṣṭvā parājitaṃ sainyaṃ rājā parimalo balī ..
rathasthaścāpamādāya mahīrājamupāyayau .. 25 ..
3.3.d:
दृष्ट्वा पराजितं सैन्यं राजा परिमलो बली ॥
रथस्थश्चापमादाय महीराजमुपाययौ ॥ 25 ॥
3.3.m: Seeing the army defeated, the powerful king Parimala, / mounted on a chariot and taking his bow, advanced against Mahīrāja.

3.3.s:
yādavaśca gajārūḍhastadā caṃdrāvalīpatiḥ ..
dhundhukāraṃ samāhūya dhanuryuddhamacīkarat .. 26 ..
3.3.d:
यादवश्च गजारूढस्तदा चंद्रावलीपतिः ॥
धुन्धुकारं समाहूय धनुर्युद्धमचीकरत् ॥ 26 ॥
3.3.m: And the Yādava, mounted on an elephant, the husband of Candrāvalī, / challenged Dhundhukāra and waged an archery battle.

3.3.s:
harināgaramāruhya brahmānaṃdo mahābala. ..
tārakaṃ śatrumāhūya dhanuryuddhaṃ cakāra ha .. 27 ..
3.3.d:
हरिनागरमारुह्य ब्रह्मानंदो महाबल॥।
तारकं शत्रुमाहूय धनुर्युद्धं चकार ह ॥ 27 ॥
3.3.m: Mounting Harināgara, the mighty Brahmānanda / challenged the enemy Tāraka and waged an archery battle.

3.3.s:
mardanaṃ rājaputraṃ ca raṇajidga jasaṃsthitaḥ ..
svaśaraistāḍayāmāsa tatsutaṃ ca jaghāna ha .. 28 ..
3.3.d:
मर्दनं राजपुत्रं च रणजिद्ग जसंस्थितः ॥
स्वशरैस्ताडयामास तत्सुतं च जघान ह ॥ 28 ॥
3.3.m: And Raṇajit, mounted on an elephant, struck the prince Mardana / with his arrows, and slew his son.

3.3.s:
rūpaṇo vai saradanaṃ hayārūḍho jagāma ha ..
ābhīrītanayo jāto madano nāma vai balī ..
nṛharaṃ rājaputraṃ ca śaṃkhāṃśaśca jagāma ha .. 29 ..
3.3.d:
रूपणो वै सरदनं हयारूढो जगाम ह ॥
आभीरीतनयो जातो मदनो नाम वै बली ॥
नृहरं राजपुत्रं च शंखांशश्च जगाम ह ॥ 29 ॥
3.3.m: Rūpaṇa, mounted on a horse, went against Saradana; / and the mighty son born of the cowherd woman, named Madana, / and the portion of Śaṅkha, went against the prince Nṛhara.

3.3.s:
teṣu saṃgrāmameteṣu cāmuṇḍo'yutasainyapaḥ ..
mahīpateśca vacanaṃ matvā nagaramāyayau .. 3.3.26.30 ..
3.3.d:
तेषु संग्राममेतेषु चामुण्डोऽयुतसैन्यपः ॥
महीपतेश्च वचनं मत्वा नगरमाययौ ॥ 3.3.26.30 ॥
3.3.m: While they were engaged in these battles, Cāmuṇḍa, commander of ten thousand troops, / heeding the word of the king, went to the city.

3.3.s:
dadarśa nagarīṃ ramyāṃ caturvarṇasamanvitām ..
dhanadhānyayutāṃ vīro devībhaktiparāyaṇaḥ .. 31 ..
3.3.d:
ददर्श नगरीं रम्यां चतुर्वर्णसमन्विताम् ॥
धनधान्ययुतां वीरो देवीभक्तिपरायणः ॥ 31 ॥
3.3.m: The hero, devoted to the worship of the goddess, / saw the charming city endowed with the four classes and filled with wealth and grain.

3.3.s:
mahīpatistu vai dhūrto durgadvāri samāgataḥ ..
cāmuṃḍena yutaḥ pāpī rājagehamupāyayau ..32..
3.3.d:
महीपतिस्तु वै धूर्तो दुर्गद्वारि समागतः ॥
चामुंडेन युतः पापी राजगेहमुपाययौ ॥32॥
3.3.m: The rogue Mahīpati arrived at the fortress gate; / accompanied by Cāmuṇḍa, the wicked one went to the royal palace.

3.3.s:
malanā bhrātaraṃ dṛṣṭvā vacanaṃ prāha duḥkhitā ..
bhādrakṛṣṇāṣṭamī cādya yavavrīhi gṛhe sthitam ..33..
3.3.d:
मलना भ्रातरं दृष्ट्वा वचनं प्राह दुःखिता ॥
भाद्रकृष्णाष्टमी चाद्य यवव्रीहि गृहे स्थितम् ॥33॥
3.3.m: Seeing her brother, Malanā, sorrowful, spoke these words: / "Today is Bhādrapada dark aṣṭamī, and barley and rice remain in the house;

3.3.s:
na prāptaṃ jala saṃsthāne supuṇye kīrtisāgare ..
mahīrājo mahāpāpī vāmanotsavamāgataḥ ..34..
3.3.d:
न प्राप्तं जल संस्थाने सुपुण्ये कीर्तिसागरे ॥
महीराजो महापापी वामनोत्सवमागतः ॥34॥
3.3.m: they have not been taken to the water-place, the most meritorious Kīrtisāgara; / the wicked Mahīrāja has come for the Vāmana festival.

3.3.s:
vināhlādaṃ ca kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ mahadduḥkhamupāgatam ..
ityuktasya vihasyāha brāhmaṇo'yaṃ mahābalī ..
kānyakubjātsamāyātaḥ kṛṣṇāṃśena prayojitaḥ ..35..
3.3.d:
विनाह्लादं च कृष्णांशं महद्दुःखमुपागतम् ॥
इत्युक्तस्य विहस्याह ब्राह्मणोऽयं महाबली ॥
कान्यकुब्जात्समायातः कृष्णांशेन प्रयोजितः ॥35॥
3.3.m: Deprived of Āhlāda and the portion of Kṛṣṇa, great sorrow has arrived." / To her who spoke thus, he laughed and said: "This very powerful brāhmaṇa, / sent by the portion of Kṛṣṇa, has come from Kānyakubja;

3.3.s:
devīdattaśca nāmnā'yaṃ sa te kāryaṃ kariṣyati ..
śrutvā caṃdrāvalī devī sarvabhūṣaṇasaṃyutā ..36..
3.3.d:
देवीदत्तश्च नाम्नाऽयं स ते कार्यं करिष्यति ॥
श्रुत्वा चंद्रावली देवी सर्वभूषणसंयुता ॥36॥
3.3.m: and this one named Devīdatta will accomplish your task." / Hearing [this], the queen Candrāvalī, adorned with all ornaments,

3.3.s:
kāmāgnipīḍitaṃ vipraṃ cāmuṃḍaṃ ca dadarśa ha..
mātaraṃ prati cāgamya vacanaṃ prāha nirbharam..37..
3.3.d:
कामाग्निपीडितं विप्रं चामुंडं च ददर्श ह॥
मातरं प्रति चागम्य वचनं प्राह निर्भरम्॥37॥
3.3.m: saw the brāhmaṇa tormented by the fire of desire, as well as Cāmuṇḍa; / and approaching her mother, she spoke these words with deep anxiety:

3.3.s:
dhūrto'yaṃ brāhmaṇo mātarniścayaṃ māṃ hariṣyati ..
ko'yaṃ vīro na jānāmi kathaṃ yāmi pativratā ..38..
3.3.d:
धूर्तोऽयं ब्राह्मणो मातर्निश्चयं मां हरिष्यति ॥
कोऽयं वीरो न जानामि कथं यामि पतिव्रता ॥38॥
3.3.m: "This brāhmaṇa is a rogue, O mother; he will surely carry me off; / I do not know who this warrior is; how can I, devoted to my husband, go?"

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā vacastasyā lajjitassa mahīpatiḥ..
cāmuṃḍena yutaḥ prāpto yatrābhūtsa mahāraṇaḥ..39..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा वचस्तस्या लज्जितस्स महीपतिः॥
चामुंडेन युतः प्राप्तो यत्राभूत्स महारणः॥39॥
3.3.m: Hearing her words, that Mahīpati was ashamed; / accompanied by Cāmuṇḍa, he went where that great battle was [taking place].

3.3.s:
etasminnaṃtare te vai brahmādyāstaiḥ parājitāḥ..
tyaktvā yuddhaṃ gṛhaṃ prāptāstrilakṣabalasaṃyutāḥ ..3.3.26.40..
3.3.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे ते वै ब्रह्माद्यास्तैः पराजिताः॥
त्यक्त्वा युद्धं गृहं प्राप्तास्त्रिलक्षबलसंयुताः ॥3.3.26.40॥
3.3.m: Meanwhile, those [warriors] led by Brahmā, defeated by them, / abandoning the battle, returned home with a force of three hundred thousand.

3.3.s:
kapāṭaṃ sudṛḍhaṃ kṛtvā mahāciṃtāmupāyayuḥ .
mahīrājastu balavānmahīpatyanumoditaḥ..41..
3.3.d:
कपाटं सुदृढं कृत्वा महाचिंतामुपाययुः ।
महीराजस्तु बलवान्महीपत्यनुमोदितः॥41॥
3.3.m: Barring the door firmly, they fell into great anxiety; / but the mighty Mahīrāja, approved by Mahīpati,

3.3.s:
pramadāvanamāgatya ṣaṣṭilakṣabalānvitaḥ..
jugopa tatra balavānmānanotsavahetave ..
tālanādyāśca catvāraḥ śirīṣākhyapuraṃ yayuḥ..
sthalībhūtaṃ ca taṃ grāmaṃ dṛṣṭvā te vismayānvitāḥ..
prayayuste sukhabhraṣṭā dadṛśurhimadaṃ munim..43..
3.3.d:
प्रमदावनमागत्य षष्टिलक्षबलान्वितः॥
जुगोप तत्र बलवान्माननोत्सवहेतवे ॥
तालनाद्याश्च चत्वारः शिरीषाख्यपुरं ययुः॥
स्थलीभूतं च तं ग्रामं दृष्ट्वा ते विस्मयान्विताः॥
प्रययुस्ते सुखभ्रष्टा ददृशुर्हिमदं मुनिम्॥43॥
3.3.m: came to the pleasure grove accompanied by a force of six million; / the powerful one guarded [it] there for the sake of the celebration; / and the four [heroes] led by Tālana went to the city named Śirīṣa; / seeing that town turned into a desolate field, they were filled with wonder; / stripped of their happiness, they went on and saw the sage Himada.

3.3.s:
praṇamyocuḥ śucāviṣṭā balakhā nirmune balī ..
kva gataḥ samaraślāghī sa ca kunāgarairyutaḥ ..44..
3.3.d:
प्रणम्योचुः शुचाविष्टा बलखा निर्मुने बली ॥
क्व गतः समरश्लाघी स च कुनागरैर्युतः ॥44॥
3.3.m: Bowing, filled with grief, they said: "O sage, where has the mighty Balakhāni gone, / he who took pride in battle and was accompanied by Kunāgaras?"

3.3.s:
śrutvāha himado yogī mahīrājena nāśitaḥ ..
chadmanā balakhāniśca tasyeyaṃ sundarī citā ..45..
3.3.d:
श्रुत्वाह हिमदो योगी महीराजेन नाशितः ॥
छद्मना बलखानिश्च तस्येयं सुन्दरी चिता ॥45॥
3.3.m: Hearing this, the yogin Himada said: "Balakhāni was destroyed / through deceit by Mahīrāja, and this is his beautiful funeral pyre."

3.3.s: iti śrutvā vaco ghoraṃ kṛṣṇāṃśaḥ śokatatparaḥ ..46..
3.3.d: इति श्रुत्वा वचो घोरं कृष्णांशः शोकतत्परः ॥46॥
3.3.m: Hearing these dreadful words, the portion of Kṛṣṇa was consumed by grief.

3.3.s:
vilalāpa bhṛśaṃ tatra hā bandho dharmajāṃśaka ..
tvadṛte bhūtale vāso mamātīva bhayaṃkaraḥ .. 47 ..
3.3.d:
विललाप भृशं तत्र हा बन्धो धर्मजांशक ॥
त्वदृते भूतले वासो ममातीव भयंकरः ॥ 47 ॥
3.3.m: He wailed intensely there: "Alas, brother, portion of the son of Dharma! / Without you, dwelling on the earth is utterly terrifying to me.

3.3.s: darśanaṃ dehi me kṣipraṃ no cetprāṇāṃstyajāmyaham .. 48 ..
3.3.d: दर्शनं देहि मे क्षिप्रं नो चेत्प्राणांस्त्यजाम्यहम् ॥ 48 ॥
3.3.m: Show yourself to me quickly; otherwise I shall abandon my life-breaths!"

3.3.s:
ityuktaḥ sa tu tadbhrātā balakhāniḥ piśācagaḥ ..
sapatnīkassamāyāto rodanaṃ kṛtavānbahu ..
kathitvā sarvavṛttāntaṃ yathājātaṃ svavaiśasam .. 49 ..
3.3.d:
इत्युक्तः स तु तद्भ्राता बलखानिः पिशाचगः ॥
सपत्नीकस्समायातो रोदनं कृतवान्बहु ॥
कथित्वा सर्ववृत्तान्तं यथाजातं स्ववैशसम् ॥ 49 ॥
3.3.m: Addressed thus, his brother Balakhāni, having joined the piśācas, / arrived together with his wife and wept abundantly; / and having related the entire account of how his ruin occurred,

3.3.s:
divyaṃ vimānamāruhya gato nākaṃ manoramam ..
yudhiṣṭhire tasya kalā balakhānerlayaṃ gatā .. 3.3.26.50 ..
3.3.d:
दिव्यं विमानमारुह्य गतो नाकं मनोरमम् ॥
युधिष्ठिरे तस्य कला बलखानेर्लयं गता ॥ 3.3.26.50 ॥
3.3.m: he mounted a celestial chariot and went to charming heaven; / that portion of his, Balakhāni's, merged into Yudhiṣṭhira.

3.3.s:
tadā duḥkhī sa kṛṣṇāṃśaḥ kṛtvā bhrātustilāṃjalim ..
mahāvatīṃ samāgatya rājagehamupāyayau .. 51 ..
3.3.d:
तदा दुःखी स कृष्णांशः कृत्वा भ्रातुस्तिलांजलिम् ॥
महावतीं समागत्य राजगेहमुपाययौ ॥ 51 ॥
3.3.m: Then, sorrowful, that portion of Kṛṣṇa, having offered a handful of sesamum water for his brother, / arrived at Mahāvatī and went to the royal palace.

3.3.s:
veṇuśabdena kṛṣṇāṃśo nanarta janamohanaḥ ..
vīṇāpravādyaṃ ca jagau tālano yogirūpadhṛka .. 52 ..
3.3.d:
वेणुशब्देन कृष्णांशो ननर्त जनमोहनः ॥
वीणाप्रवाद्यं च जगौ तालनो योगिरूपधृक ॥ 52 ॥
3.3.m: With the sound of the flute, the portion of Kṛṣṇa, enchanter of people, danced; / and Tālana, bearing the form of a yogin, played the vīṇā and sang.

3.3.s:
mṛdaṃgadhvaninā devo lakṣaṇaḥ kāṃsyavādyakaḥ ..
susvaraṃ ca jagau tatra śrutvā rājā vimohitaḥ .. 53 ..
3.3.d:
मृदंगध्वनिना देवो लक्षणः कांस्यवाद्यकः ॥
सुस्वरं च जगौ तत्र श्रुत्वा राजा विमोहितः ॥ 53 ॥
3.3.m: To the sound of the mṛdaṅga, Deva [danced, and] Lakṣaṇa played the bronze bell; / and he sang sweetly there; hearing it, the king was completely enchanted.

3.3.s:
tadā tu malanā rājñī dṛṣṭvā tadvāmanotsavam ..
ruditvā vacanaṃ prāha kva gato me priyaṃkaraḥ .. 54 ..
3.3.d:
तदा तु मलना राज्ञी दृष्ट्वा तद्वामनोत्सवम् ॥
रुदित्वा वचनं प्राह क्व गतो मे प्रियंकरः ॥ 54 ॥
3.3.m: Then queen Malanā, seeing that Vāmana festival, / wept and spoke these words: "Where has my beloved gone,

3.3.s:
kṛṣṇāṃśo bandhusahitastyaktvā māṃ mandabhāginīm ..
tvayā virahito deśo mahīrājena luṃṭhitaḥ .. 55 ..
3.3.d:
कृष्णांशो बन्धुसहितस्त्यक्त्वा मां मन्दभागिनीम् ॥
त्वया विरहितो देशो महीराजेन लुंठितः ॥ 55 ॥
3.3.m: the portion of Kṛṣṇa, together with his kinsman, abandoning me, ill-fated [as I am]? / Bereft of you, the realm has been plundered by Mahīrāja!"

3.3.s:
ityuktāṃ malanāṃ dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇāṃśaḥ sneha kātaraḥ ..
vacanaṃ prāha namrātmā devi tvaṃ vacanaṃ kuru .. 56 ..
3.3.d:
इत्युक्तां मलनां दृष्ट्वा कृष्णांशः स्नेह कातरः ॥
वचनं प्राह नम्रात्मा देवि त्वं वचनं कुरु ॥ 56 ॥
3.3.m: Seeing Malanā who spoke thus, the portion of Kṛṣṇa, agitated with affection, / humbled in spirit, spoke these words: "O queen, keep my word.

3.3.s:
yoginaśca vayaṃ rājñi sarvayuddhaviśāradāḥ ..
tavedaṃ sakalaṃ kāryaṃ kṛtvā yāmo hi naimiṣam .. 57 ..
3.3.d:
योगिनश्च वयं राज्ञि सर्वयुद्धविशारदाः ॥
तवेदं सकलं कार्यं कृत्वा यामो हि नैमिषम् ॥ 57 ॥
3.3.m: We are yogins, O queen, skilled in all forms of warfare; / having accomplished all this work of yours, we shall indeed go to Naimiṣa.

3.3.s:
ye yavavrīhayaścaiva tava sadmani saṃsthitāḥ ..
gṛhītvā yoṣitassarvā gacchantu sāgarāntikam ..
vayaṃ tu yogasainyena tava rakṣāṃ ca kurmahe .. 58 ..
3.3.d:
ये यवव्रीहयश्चैव तव सद्मनि संस्थिताः ॥
गृहीत्वा योषितस्सर्वा गच्छन्तु सागरान्तिकम् ॥
वयं तु योगसैन्येन तव रक्षां च कुर्महे ॥ 58 ॥
3.3.m: Whatever barley and rice remain in your house, / let all the women take it and go to the edge of the lake; / we, for our part, shall protect you with our yogic army."

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā vacastasya tatsutā ca pativratā ..
mātaraṃ vacanaṃ prāha kṛṣṇāṃśo'yaṃ na nartakaḥ .. 59 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा वचस्तस्य तत्सुता च पतिव्रता ॥
मातरं वचनं प्राह कृष्णांशोऽयं न नर्तकः ॥ 59 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing his words, her devoted daughter / said to her mother: “This is an incarnation of Kṛṣṇa, not a dancer.

3.3.s:
puṇḍarīkanibhe netre śyāmāṃgaṃ tasya sundaram ..
kṛṣṇāṃśena vinā mātaḥ ko rakṣārthaṃ kṣamo bhuvi ..
durjayaśca mahīrājaḥ kṛṣṇāṃśena vinirjitaḥ .. 3.3.26.60 ..
3.3.d:
पुण्डरीकनिभे नेत्रे श्यामांगं तस्य सुन्दरम् ॥
कृष्णांशेन विना मातः को रक्षार्थं क्षमो भुवि ॥
दुर्जयश्च महीराजः कृष्णांशेन विनिर्जितः ॥ 3.3.26.60 ॥
3.3.m: His eyes resemble white lotuses, and his dark body is beautiful. / Who on earth, Mother, is capable of protecting [us] without an incarnation of Kṛṣṇa? / And King Mahī, difficult to conquer, was completely defeated by this incarnation of Kṛṣṇa.”

3.3.s:
iti tadvacanaṃ śrutvā malanā premavihvalā ..
yavavīhayo niṣkāsya yoṣitāṃ sthāpitāḥ kare .. 61 ..
3.3.d:
इति तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा मलना प्रेमविह्वला ॥
यववीहयो निष्कास्य योषितां स्थापिताः करे ॥ 61 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing her words, Malanā, overwhelmed with love, / brought out barley and rice and placed them in the hands of the women.

3.3.s:
jagustā yoṣitassarvāḥ kṛṣṇāṃśacaritaṃ śubham ..
lakṣaṇaḥ śīghramāgamya yogiveṣānsvasainikān ..
sajjīkṛtya sthitastatra tālanādyaiḥ surakṣitaḥ .. 62 ..
3.3.d:
जगुस्ता योषितस्सर्वाः कृष्णांशचरितं शुभम् ॥
लक्षणः शीघ्रमागम्य योगिवेषान्स्वसैनिकान् ॥
सज्जीकृत्य स्थितस्तत्र तालनाद्यैः सुरक्षितः ॥ 62 ॥
3.3.m: All those women sang the auspicious deeds of Kṛṣṇa’s incarnation. / Lakṣaṇa, arriving quickly, drew up his soldiers / disguised as yogins and stood there, well guarded by Tālana and the others.

3.3.s:
kīrtisāgaramāgamya te vīrā bala darpitāḥ ..
rurudhuḥ sarvato nārīrdolāyutamitasthitāḥ .. 63 ..
3.3.d:
कीर्तिसागरमागम्य ते वीरा बल दर्पिताः ॥
रुरुधुः सर्वतो नारीर्दोलायुतमितस्थिताः ॥ 63 ॥
3.3.m: Reaching Kīrtisāgara, those heroes, arrogant in their strength, / surrounded on all sides the women who were seated in their palanquins.

3.3.s:
mahīpatistu kulahā jñātvā kṛṣṇāṃśamāgatam ..
caṃdravaṃśinamāgamya saputraśca ruroda ha .. 64 ..
3.3.d:
महीपतिस्तु कुलहा ज्ञात्वा कृष्णांशमागतम् ॥
चंद्रवंशिनमागम्य सपुत्रश्च रुरोद ह ॥ 64 ॥
3.3.m: The king, destroyer of his family, knowing that Kṛṣṇa’s incarnation had come, / approached the scion of the lunar dynasty and wept along with his son:

3.3.s:
yogibhistairmahārāja luṃṭhitāḥ sarvayoṣitaḥ ..
malanā saṃhṛtā tatra tathā caṃdrāvalī sutā .. 65 ..
3.3.d:
योगिभिस्तैर्महाराज लुंठिताः सर्वयोषितः ॥
मलना संहृता तत्र तथा चंद्रावली सुता ॥ 65 ॥
3.3.m: “O Great King, all the women were plundered by those yogins! / Malanā was carried off there, as was her daughter Candrāvalī.

3.3.s:
mahīrājasya te sainyā yogiveṣāssamāgatāḥ ..
tārakāya sutāṃ prādānmahīrājāya matsvasām .. 66 ..
3.3.d:
महीराजस्य ते सैन्या योगिवेषास्समागताः ॥
तारकाय सुतां प्रादान्महीराजाय मत्स्वसाम् ॥ 66 ॥
3.3.m: Those troops of King Mahī arrived in the disguise of yogins; / he gave his daughter to Tāraka, and my sister to King Mahī.”

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā vaco ghoraṃ brahmānando mahābalaḥ ..
lakṣasainyānvitastatra yayau roṣasamanvitaḥ .. 67 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा वचो घोरं ब्रह्मानन्दो महाबलः ॥
लक्षसैन्यान्वितस्तत्र ययौ रोषसमन्वितः ॥ 67 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing these dreadful words, the mighty Brahmānanda, / accompanied by an army of one hundred thousand, went there filled with wrath.

3.3.s:
mahīrājastu kalahī sainyāyutamahātmajaḥ ..
rakṣitaḥ kāmasenena tathā raṇajitā yayau .. 68 ..
3.3.d:
महीराजस्तु कलही सैन्यायुतमहात्मजः ॥
रक्षितः कामसेनेन तथा रणजिता ययौ ॥ 68 ॥
3.3.m: King Mahī, fond of strife, having ten thousand troops and his son, / protected by Kāmasena and by Raṇajit, marched forth.

3.3.s:
tayoścāsīnmahayuddhaṃ senayorubhayorbhuvi ..
tālano yogiveṣaśca brahmānaṃdamupāyayau .. 69 ..
3.3.d:
तयोश्चासीन्महयुद्धं सेनयोरुभयोर्भुवि ॥
तालनो योगिवेषश्च ब्रह्मानंदमुपाययौ ॥ 69 ॥
3.3.m: A great battle took place on earth between the two armies. / Tālana, disguised as a yogin, approached Brahmānanda.

3.3.s:
lakṣaṇaścābhayaṃ śūraṃ devasiṃho mahīpatim ..
jitvā baddhvā ca muditau kāmasenassamāgataḥ .. 3.3.26.70 ..
3.3.d:
लक्षणश्चाभयं शूरं देवसिंहो महीपतिम् ॥
जित्वा बद्ध्वा च मुदितौ कामसेनस्समागतः ॥ 3.3.26.70 ॥
3.3.m: Lakṣaṇa [approached] the heroic Abhaya, and Devasiṃha [approached] the king. / When, having conquered and bound them, the two were rejoicing, Kāmasena arrived.

3.3.s:
lakṣaṇaḥ kāmasenaṃ ca devo raṇajitaṃ tadā ..
baddhvā tatra sthitau vīrau śatrūsainyakṣayaṃkarau .. 71 .
3.3.d:
लक्षणः कामसेनं च देवो रणजितं तदा ॥
बद्ध्वा तत्र स्थितौ वीरौ शत्रूसैन्यक्षयंकरौ ॥ 71 ।
3.3.m: Then Lakṣaṇa [bound] Kāmasena, and Deva bound Raṇajit; / the two heroes stood there, causing the destruction of the enemy’s army.

3.3.s:
etasminnaṃtare brahmā baddhvā vai tālanaṃ balī ..
lakṣaṇāntamupāgamya dhanuryuddhamacīkarat .. 72 ..
3.3.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे ब्रह्मा बद्ध्वा वै तालनं बली ॥
लक्षणान्तमुपागम्य धनुर्युद्धमचीकरत् ॥ 72 ॥
3.3.m: Meanwhile, the mighty Brahmā, having bound Tālana, / went near Lakṣaṇa and engaged in a duel of bows.

3.3.s:
lakṣaṇaṃ chinnadhanvānaṃ punarbaddhvā mahābalaḥ ..
devasiṃhamupāgamya mūrchitaṃ taṃ cakāra ha .. 73 ..
3.3.d:
लक्षणं छिन्नधन्वानं पुनर्बद्ध्वा महाबलः ॥
देवसिंहमुपागम्य मूर्छितं तं चकार ह ॥ 73 ॥
3.3.m: Having broken Lakṣaṇa’s bow and bound him again, the mighty one / approached Devasiṃha and made him lose consciousness.

3.3.s:
hāhābhūte yogisainye pradrute sarvato diśam ..
kṛṣṇāṃśo yoṣitassarvā vacanaṃ prāha namradhīḥ .. 74 ..
3.3.d:
हाहाभूते योगिसैन्ये प्रद्रुते सर्वतो दिशम् ॥
कृष्णांशो योषितस्सर्वा वचनं प्राह नम्रधीः ॥ 74 ॥
3.3.m: When the army of yogins raised a cry of despair and fled in all directions, / the incarnation of Kṛṣṇa spoke these words with humble mind to all the women:

3.3.s:
brahmānando'yamāyāto mama sainya kṣayaṃkaraḥ ..
tasmādyūyaṃ mayā sārddhaṃ gacchāśu ca taṃ prati .. 75 ..
3.3.d:
ब्रह्मानन्दोऽयमायातो मम सैन्य क्षयंकरः ॥
तस्माद्यूयं मया सार्द्धं गच्छाशु च तं प्रति ॥ 75 ॥
3.3.m: “This Brahmānanda has arrived, destroying my army; / therefore, quickly go with me against him!”

3.3.s:
ityuktvā tāssamādāya brahmānandamupāyayau ..
tayoścāsīnmahadyuddhaṃ naranārāyaṇāṃ śayoḥ .. 76 ..
3.3.d:
इत्युक्त्वा तास्समादाय ब्रह्मानन्दमुपाययौ ॥
तयोश्चासीन्महद्युद्धं नरनारायणां शयोः ॥ 76 ॥
3.3.m: Having said this and taken them, he went near Brahmānanda; / and a great battle ensued between the two, who were portions of Nara and Nārāyaṇa.

3.3.s:
kṛṣṇāṃśastatra balavānnabhomārgeṇa taṃ prati ..
rathasthaṃ ca samāgamya mohayāmāsa so'sinā .. 77 ..
3.3.d:
कृष्णांशस्तत्र बलवान्नभोमार्गेण तं प्रति ॥
रथस्थं च समागम्य मोहयामास सोऽसिना ॥ 77 ॥
3.3.m: There the mighty incarnation of Kṛṣṇa, moving through the sky towards him / who stood in a chariot, arrived and stunned him with his sword.

3.3.s:
tadā tu mūrchite tasminmocayitvā ca tā mudā ..
yogī sainyānvito yuddhātpalāyanaparo'bhavat .. 78 ..
3.3.d:
तदा तु मूर्छिते तस्मिन्मोचयित्वा च ता मुदा ॥
योगी सैन्यान्वितो युद्धात्पलायनपरोऽभवत् ॥ 78 ॥
3.3.m: Then, while he was unconscious, joyfully freeing them, / the yogin with his troops set about fleeing from the battle.

3.3.s:
parājite yogisainye brahmānaṃdo mahābalaḥ ..
yoṣitastāḥ samādāya svagehāya dadhau manaḥ .. 79 ..
3.3.d:
पराजिते योगिसैन्ये ब्रह्मानंदो महाबलः ॥
योषितस्ताः समादाय स्वगेहाय दधौ मनः ॥ 79 ॥
3.3.m: When the army of yogins was defeated, the mighty Brahmānanda, / taking those women, set his mind on [returning to] his own home.

3.3.s:
mahīrājastu saṃprāpto mahīpatyanumoditaḥ ..
rurodha sarvato nārīḥ śivadattavaro balī .. 3.3.26.80 ..
3.3.d:
महीराजस्तु संप्राप्तो महीपत्यनुमोदितः ॥
रुरोध सर्वतो नारीः शिवदत्तवरो बली ॥ 3.3.26.80 ॥
3.3.m: King Mahī, having arrived and been praised by the king, / the strong one who had received a boon from Śiva, blocked the women on all sides.

3.3.s:
nṛharaścābhayaṃ śūraṃ mardanaścaiva rūpaṇam ..
madanaṃ vai saradano brahmānaṃdaṃ ca tārakaḥ .. 81 ..
3.3.d:
नृहरश्चाभयं शूरं मर्दनश्चैव रूपणम् ॥
मदनं वै सरदनो ब्रह्मानंदं च तारकः ॥ 81 ॥
3.3.m: Nṛhara [attacked] the heroic Abhaya, Mardana [attacked] Rūpaṇa, / Saradana [attacked] Madana, and Tāraka [attacked] Brahmānanda.

3.3.s:
cāmuṇḍaḥ kāmasenaṃ ca dhanuryuddhamacīkarat ..
tadābhayo mahāvīro dhunvaṃtaṃ nṛharaṃ ripum .. 82 ..
3.3.d:
चामुण्डः कामसेनं च धनुर्युद्धमचीकरत् ॥
तदाभयो महावीरो धुन्वंतं नृहरं रिपुम् ॥ 82 ॥
3.3.m: Cāmuṇḍa waged archery combat against Kāmasena. / Then the great hero Abhaya, against his enemy Nṛhara who was brandishing [his bow],

3.3.s:
chittvā dhanustamāgatya khaḍgayuddhamacīkarat ..
nṛharaḥ khaḍgarahito'bhavadyuddhaparāṅmukhaḥ ..
tamāha vacanaṃ kruddho'bhayo yuddhārthamudyataḥ .. .. 83 ..
3.3.d:
छित्त्वा धनुस्तमागत्य खड्गयुद्धमचीकरत् ॥
नृहरः खड्गरहितोऽभवद्युद्धपराङ्मुखः ॥
तमाह वचनं क्रुद्धोऽभयो युद्धार्थमुद्यतः ॥ ॥ 83 ॥
3.3.m: severed his bow, approached him, and fought with swords. / Nṛhara, bereft of his sword, turned away from the fight. / Enraged, Abhaya, intent on fighting, said to him:

3.3.s: bhavānvai mātṛṣvasrīyo mahīrājasya cātmajaḥ .. 84 ..
3.3.d: भवान्वै मातृष्वस्रीयो महीराजस्य चात्मजः ॥ 84 ॥
3.3.m: “You are indeed a maternal aunt’s son, and the son of King Mahī.

3.3.s:
kṣatriyāṇāṃ paraṃ dharmaṃ kathaṃ saṃhartumicchati ..
iti śrutvā tu nṛharo gṛhītvā parighaṃ ruṣā .. 85 ..
3.3.d:
क्षत्रियाणां परं धर्मं कथं संहर्तुमिच्छति ॥
इति श्रुत्वा तु नृहरो गृहीत्वा परिघं रुषा ॥ 85 ॥
3.3.m: Why do you wish to abandon the supreme duty of kṣatriyas?” / Hearing this, Nṛhara, seizing an iron mace in rage,

3.3.s:
jaghāna taṃ ca śirasi sa hataḥ svargamāyayau ..
sa ca vai kṛtavarmāṃśo vilīnaḥ kṛtavarmaṇi .. 86 ..
3.3.d:
जघान तं च शिरसि स हतः स्वर्गमाययौ ॥
स च वै कृतवर्मांशो विलीनः कृतवर्मणि ॥ 86 ॥
3.3.m: struck him on the head, and, slain, he went to heaven. / A portion of Kṛtavarman, he merged into Kṛtavarman.

3.3.s:
madanaṃ gopajātaṃ ca hatvā saradano balī ..
jayaśabdaṃ cakāroccairpunarhatvā riporbalam ..
uttarāṃśaśca sa jñeyo madanaścottare layaḥ .. 87 ..
3.3.d:
मदनं गोपजातं च हत्वा सरदनो बली ॥
जयशब्दं चकारोच्चैर्पुनर्हत्वा रिपोर्बलम् ॥
उत्तरांशश्च स ज्ञेयो मदनश्चोत्तरे लयः ॥ 87 ॥
3.3.m: Having slain Madana, who was born of a cowherd, the mighty Saradana / shouted aloud a cry of victory, having further destroyed the enemy’s force. / Madana is to be known as a portion of Uttara, and he dissolved into Uttara.

3.3.s:
rūpaṇaśca samāgatya mūrchayitvā ca mardanam ..
punassaradanaṃ prāpya khaḍgayuddhaṃ cakāra ha .. 88 ..
3.3.d:
रूपणश्च समागत्य मूर्छयित्वा च मर्दनम् ॥
पुनस्सरदनं प्राप्य खड्गयुद्धं चकार ह ॥ 88 ॥
3.3.m: Rūpaṇa, having arrived and rendered Mardana unconscious, / then reached Saradana and fought a sword duel [with him].

3.3.s:
brahmānaṃdaśca balavānsa baddhvā tārakaṃ ruṣā ..
mahīrājāntamāgamya dhanuryuddhaṃ cakāra ha .. 89 ..
3.3.d:
ब्रह्मानंदश्च बलवान्स बद्ध्वा तारकं रुषा ॥
महीराजान्तमागम्य धनुर्युद्धं चकार ह ॥ 89 ॥
3.3.m: And the mighty Brahmānanda, having bound Tāraka in anger, / approached King Mahī and fought an archery duel.

3.3.s:
nṛharaṃ raṇajitprāpya svabhallena tadā ruṣā ..
jaghāna samaraślāghī mahīrājasutaṃ śubham ..3.3.26.90..
3.3.d:
नृहरं रणजित्प्राप्य स्वभल्लेन तदा रुषा ॥
जघान समरश्लाघी महीराजसुतं शुभम् ॥3.3.26.90॥
3.3.m: Reaching Nṛhara, Raṇajit, praised in battle, then in anger / struck the noble son of King Mahī with his spear.

3.3.s: sa vai duśśāsanāṃśaśca mṛtastasminsamāgataḥ .. 91 ..
3.3.d: स वै दुश्शासनांशश्च मृतस्तस्मिन्समागतः ॥ 91 ॥
3.3.m: He was indeed a portion of Duḥśāsana, and upon dying he entered him.

3.3.s:
nihate nṛhare baṃdhau mardanaḥ krodhatatparaḥ ..
svaśaraistāḍayāmāsa sātyakeraṃśamuttamam .. 92 ..
3.3.d:
निहते नृहरे बंधौ मर्दनः क्रोधतत्परः ॥
स्वशरैस्ताडयामास सात्यकेरंशमुत्तमम् ॥ 92 ॥
3.3.m: When his kinsman Nṛhara was killed, Mardana, intent on wrath, / struck that excellent portion of Sātyaki with his arrows.

3.3.s:
chittvā tānraṇajicchūrassa vai parimalodbhavaḥ ..
svabhallena śiraḥ kāyānmardanasya sa cāharat .. 93 ..
3.3.d:
छित्त्वा तान्रणजिच्छूरस्स वै परिमलोद्भवः ॥
स्वभल्लेन शिरः कायान्मर्दनस्य स चाहरत् ॥ 93 ॥
3.3.m: The heroic Raṇajit, born of Parimala, cutting down those [arrows], / severed Mardana’s head from his body with his spear.

3.3.s:
mṛte'sminmardane vīre tadā saradano balī ..
tāḍayāmāsa taṃ vīraṃ svabhallenaiva vakṣasi .. 94 ..
3.3.d:
मृतेऽस्मिन्मर्दने वीरे तदा सरदनो बली ॥
ताडयामास तं वीरं स्वभल्लेनैव वक्षसि ॥ 94 ॥
3.3.m: When the hero Mardana died, the mighty Saradana / struck that hero right in the chest with his spear.

3.3.s:
mahatkaṣṭamupāgamya raṇajinmalanodbhavaḥ ..
svakhaṅgena śiraḥ kāyādapāharata vairiṇaḥ .. 95 ..
3.3.d:
महत्कष्टमुपागम्य रणजिन्मलनोद्भवः ॥
स्वखङ्गेन शिरः कायादपाहरत वैरिणः ॥ 95 ॥
3.3.m: Suffering great distress, Raṇajit, born of Malanā, / severed the enemy’s head from his body with his sword.

3.3.s:
tribaṃdhau nihate yuddhe tārakaḥ krodhamūrchitaḥ ..
rathasthaśca rathasthaṃ ca tāḍayāmāsa vai śaraiḥ .. 96 ..
3.3.d:
त्रिबंधौ निहते युद्धे तारकः क्रोधमूर्छितः ॥
रथस्थश्च रथस्थं च ताडयामास वै शरैः ॥ 96 ॥
3.3.m: When the three kinsmen were slain in battle, Tāraka, overcome with wrath, / standing in his chariot, struck [Raṇajit] standing in his chariot with arrows.

3.3.s:
chittvā bāṇaṃ ca raṇajittathaiva ca riporddhanuḥ ..
triśaraistāḍayāmāsa karṇāṃśaṃ tārakaṃ hṛdi .. 97 ..
3.3.d:
छित्त्वा बाणं च रणजित्तथैव च रिपोर्द्धनुः ॥
त्रिशरैस्ताडयामास कर्णांशं तारकं हृदि ॥ 97 ॥
3.3.m: Having cut down the arrow and also the enemy’s bow, Raṇajit / struck Tāraka, who was a portion of Karṇa, in the heart with three arrows.

3.3.s:
amarṣavaśamāpanno yathā daṃḍairbhujaṃgamaḥ ..
dhyātvā ca śaṃkaraṃ devaṃ viṣadhautaṃ śaraṃ punaḥ .. 98 ..
3.3.d:
अमर्षवशमापन्नो यथा दंडैर्भुजंगमः ॥
ध्यात्वा च शंकरं देवं विषधौतं शरं पुनः ॥ 98 ॥
3.3.m: Falling under the sway of fury like a serpent [struck] with sticks, / and meditating on the god Śaṅkara, [Tāraka] again took an arrow washed in poison,

3.3.s:
saṃdhāya tarjayitvā ca śatrukaṃṭhamatāḍayat ..
tena bāṇena raṇajittyaktvā dehaṃ divaṃ gataḥ .. 99 ..
3.3.d:
संधाय तर्जयित्वा च शत्रुकंठमताडयत् ॥
तेन बाणेन रणजित्त्यक्त्वा देहं दिवं गतः ॥ 99 ॥
3.3.m: fitted it to the bow, shouted defiance, and struck his enemy’s throat. / By that arrow, Raṇajit, abandoning his body, went to heaven.

3.3.s:
hate tasminmahāvīrye brahmānaṃdaśca duḥkhitaḥ ..
mahīrājabhayādbrahmā puraskṛsya ca yoṣitaḥ ..
saṃdhyākāle tu saṃprāpte bhādrakṛṣṇāṣṭamīdine .. 3.3.26.100 ..
3.3.d:
हते तस्मिन्महावीर्ये ब्रह्मानंदश्च दुःखितः ॥
महीराजभयाद्ब्रह्मा पुरस्कृस्य च योषितः ॥
संध्याकाले तु संप्राप्ते भाद्रकृष्णाष्टमीदिने ॥ 3.3.26.100 ॥
3.3.m: When that hero of great valour was slain, Brahmānanda was sorrowful. / Out of fear of King Mahī, Brahmā, placing the women before him, / when evening time arrived on the eighth lunar day of the dark fortnight of Bhādra,

3.3.s:
kapāṭaṃ sudṛḍhaṃ kṛtvā sainyaiḥ ṣaṣṭisahasrakaiḥ ..
sārddhaṃ gehamupāgamya śāradāṃ śaraṇaṃ yayau .. 101 ..
3.3.d:
कपाटं सुदृढं कृत्वा सैन्यैः षष्टिसहस्रकैः ॥
सार्द्धं गेहमुपागम्य शारदां शरणं ययौ ॥ 101 ॥
3.3.m: fastening the door firmly, went to his house / together with sixty thousand troops and sought refuge with Śāradā.

3.3.s:
mahīrājastu balavānputraśokena duḥkhitaḥ ..
saṃkalpaṃ kṛtavānghoraṃ śṛṇvatāṃ sarvabhūbhṛtām .. 102 ..
3.3.d:
महीराजस्तु बलवान्पुत्रशोकेन दुःखितः ॥
संकल्पं कृतवान्घोरं शृण्वतां सर्वभूभृताम् ॥ 102 ॥
3.3.m: The powerful Mahīrāja, however, grieved by sorrow for his son, / made a dreadful vow within the hearing of all the kings:

3.3.s:
śirīṣākhyapuraṃ ramyaṃ yathā śūnyaṃ mayā kṛtam ..
tathā mahāvatī sarvā brahmānaṃdādibhissaha ..
kṣayaṃ yāsyaṃti madbāṇaiḥ sarve te caṃdravaṃśinaḥ .. 103 ..
3.3.d:
शिरीषाख्यपुरं रम्यं यथा शून्यं मया कृतम् ॥
तथा महावती सर्वा ब्रह्मानंदादिभिस्सह ॥
क्षयं यास्यंति मद्बाणैः सर्वे ते चंद्रवंशिनः ॥ 103 ॥
3.3.m: "Just as the lovely city called Śirīṣa was desolated by me, / so shall the entire Mahāvatī, along with Brahmānanda and the rest, / perish by my arrows—all those born of the Lunar lineage!"

3.3.s:
ityuktvā dhuṃdhukāraṃ vai cāhvayāmāsa bhūpatiḥ ..
paṃcalakṣabalaissārddhaṃ śīghramāgamyatāṃ priya .. 104 ..
3.3.d:
इत्युक्त्वा धुंधुकारं वै चाह्वयामास भूपतिः ॥
पंचलक्षबलैस्सार्द्धं शीघ्रमागम्यतां प्रिय ॥ 104 ॥
3.3.m: Having said this, the king indeed summoned Dhundhukāra: / "Come quickly, my dear friend, along with a force of five hundred thousand!"

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā dhuṃdhukāro gatvā śīghraṃ ca dehalīm ..
uṣitvā sapta divasānyuddhabhūmimupāgamat .. 105 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा धुंधुकारो गत्वा शीघ्रं च देहलीम् ॥
उषित्वा सप्त दिवसान्युद्धभूमिमुपागमत् ॥ 105 ॥
3.3.m: Having heard this, Dhundhukāra went swiftly to Dehalī, / and after staying there for seven days, he came to the battleground.

3.3.s:
tadāṣṭalakṣasahito mahīrājo mahābalaḥ ..
tārakeṇa ca saṃyukto yuddhāya samupāyayau .. 106 ..
3.3.d:
तदाष्टलक्षसहितो महीराजो महाबलः ॥
तारकेण च संयुक्तो युद्धाय समुपाययौ ॥ 106 ॥
3.3.m: Then the mighty Mahīrāja, accompanied by eight hundred thousand [troops], / and joined with Tāraka, marched out for battle.

3.3.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
saptaviṃśābdake prāpte kṛṣṇāṃśe sarvamaṃgale ..
bhādrakṛṣṇadaśamyāṃ ca malanā śokakātarā ..
jananāyakamāhūya vacanaṃ prāha duḥkhitā .. 1 ..
3.3.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
सप्तविंशाब्दके प्राप्ते कृष्णांशे सर्वमंगले ॥
भाद्रकृष्णदशम्यां च मलना शोककातरा ॥
जननायकमाहूय वचनं प्राह दुःखिता ॥ 1 ॥
3.3.m: Sūta said: / When the twenty-seventh year arrived, the all-auspicious portion of Kṛṣṇa, / on the tenth day of the dark fortnight of Bhādrapada, Malanā, distraught with grief, / summoned Jananāyaka and, sorrowful, spoke these words:

3.3.s:
aye kacchapadeśīya gotamānvayasaṃbhava ..
harināgaramāruhya kānyakubjaṃ vrajādhunā .. 2 ..
3.3.d:
अये कच्छपदेशीय गोतमान्वयसंभव ॥
हरिनागरमारुह्य कान्यकुब्जं व्रजाधुना ॥ 2 ॥
3.3.m: "O native of the Kacchapa country, born in the lineage of Gautama, / mount Harināgara and go at once to Kānyakubja!

3.3.s:
putramāhlādamāhūya sānujaṃ matpriyaṃkaram ..
iti śrutvā tu vacanaṃ hṛdi saṃciṃtya trai punaḥ .. 3 ..
3.3.d:
पुत्रमाह्लादमाहूय सानुजं मत्प्रियंकरम् ॥
इति श्रुत्वा तु वचनं हृदि संचिंत्य त्रै पुनः ॥ 3 ॥
3.3.m: Summon my son Āhlāda, together with his younger brother, who brings joy to me!" / Having heard these words and reflected upon them in his heart, Trai once again

3.3.s:
malanāṃ duḥkhitāṃ prāha na tvāyāsyati sa prabhuḥ ..
rājñaḥ parimalasyaiva vākyaṃ matvā suduḥkhadam .. 4 ..
3.3.d:
मलनां दुःखितां प्राह न त्वायास्यति स प्रभुः ॥
राज्ञः परिमलस्यैव वाक्यं मत्वा सुदुःखदम् ॥ 4 ॥
3.3.m: spoke to the grieving Malanā: "That lord will not come, / regarding the command of King Parimala as exceedingly painful."

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā tu vacanaṃ ruroda malanā satī ..
punarmūrcchāṃ gatā bhūmau jīvanaṃ tyaktumudyatā .. 5 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा तु वचनं रुरोद मलना सती ॥
पुनर्मूर्च्छां गता भूमौ जीवनं त्यक्तुमुद्यता ॥ 5 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing this speech, the virtuous Malanā wept, / fainted again upon the ground, and was ready to surrender her life:

3.3.s:
hā rāmāṃśa mahābāho vatsa kṛṣṇāṃśa sundara ..
kva gatau saha devakyā tyaktvā māṃ maṃdabhāginīm ..6..
3.3.d:
हा रामांश महाबाहो वत्स कृष्णांश सुन्दर ॥
क्व गतौ सह देवक्या त्यक्त्वा मां मंदभागिनीम् ॥6॥
3.3.m: "Alas, mighty-armed portion of Rāma! O handsome child, portion of Kṛṣṇa! / Where have you both gone with Devakī, abandoning me, ill-fated woman?"

3.3.s:
tadā parimalāputro dṛṣṭvā rājñīṃ tathā gatām ..
bahudhāśvāsya balavānkānyakubjapuraṃ yayau .. 7 ..
3.3.d:
तदा परिमलापुत्रो दृष्ट्वा राज्ञीं तथा गताम् ॥
बहुधाश्वास्य बलवान्कान्यकुब्जपुरं ययौ ॥ 7 ॥
3.3.m: Then the son of Parimalā, seeing the queen reduced to that state, / consoled her in many ways and, mighty as he was, departed for the city of Kānyakubja.

3.3.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
tvayā parimalāputrassaṃprokto jananāyakaḥ ..
romaharṣaṇa no brūhi so'yaṃ kastena kiṃ kṛtam .. 8 ..
3.3.d:
॥ ऋषय ऊचुः ॥ ॥
त्वया परिमलापुत्रस्संप्रोक्तो जननायकः ॥
रोमहर्षण नो ब्रूहि सोऽयं कस्तेन किं कृतम् ॥ 8 ॥
3.3.m: The sages said: / "You have spoken of Jananāyaka as the son of Parimalā. / O Romaharṣaṇa, tell us who he was and what he did!"

3.3.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
iṃdraprasthapurevātsītpradyotaḥ kathito mayā ..
pitā parimalasyaivāmātyo'naṃgamahīpateḥ .. 9 ..
3.3.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
इंद्रप्रस्थपुरेवात्सीत्प्रद्योतः कथितो मया ॥
पिता परिमलस्यैवामात्योऽनंगमहीपतेः ॥ 9 ॥
3.3.m: Sūta said: / In the city of Indraprastha lived Pradyota, of whom I have spoken, / the father of Parimala and minister to King Anaṅga.

3.3.s:
tasya kanyā samājātā nāmnā parimalā mune ..
duḥśalāṃśasamudbhūtā raṃbheva sukumārikā .. 3.3.27.10 ..
3.3.d:
तस्य कन्या समाजाता नाम्ना परिमला मुने ॥
दुःशलांशसमुद्भूता रंभेव सुकुमारिका ॥ 3.3.27.10 ॥
3.3.m: A daughter was born to him named Parimalā, O sage, / originating from a portion of Duḥśalā, delicate as Rambhā.

3.3.s:
tadvivāhārthamudyogaḥ kṛtaḥ pitrā svayaṃvaraḥ ..
putraḥ kacchapabhūpasya sa nāmnā kamalāpatiḥ ..
tāmudvāhma vidhānena svagehāya yayau mudā.. 11 ..
3.3.d:
तद्विवाहार्थमुद्योगः कृतः पित्रा स्वयंवरः ॥
पुत्रः कच्छपभूपस्य स नाम्ना कमलापतिः ॥
तामुद्वाह्म विधानेन स्वगेहाय ययौ मुदा॥ 11 ॥
3.3.m: Her father made preparations for her marriage through a svayaṃvara. / The son of the Kacchapa king, named Kamalāpati, / married her according to the prescribed rites and returned home with joy.

3.3.s:
tayossamāgamo jātaḥ putro'yaṃ jananāyakaḥ ..
śatruvidyāparaḥ śūraḥ khaḍgayuddhaviśāradaḥ ..12..
3.3.d:
तयोस्समागमो जातः पुत्रोऽयं जननायकः ॥
शत्रुविद्यापरः शूरः खड्गयुद्धविशारदः ॥12॥
3.3.m: From their union this son, Jananāyaka, was born, / devoted to the military science of enemies, heroic, and skilled in sword combat.

3.3.s:
jitvā bhūpānbalādvīraḥ siṃdhutīralanivāsinaḥ ..
ṣaḍaṃśakaramādāya pitṛrājyamupasthitaḥ ..13..
3.3.d:
जित्वा भूपान्बलाद्वीरः सिंधुतीरलनिवासिनः ॥
षडंशकरमादाय पितृराज्यमुपस्थितः ॥13॥
3.3.m: Conquering by force the kings dwelling on the banks of the Sindhu / and taking a sixth-part tribute, the hero arrived at his ancestral realm.

3.3.s:
ekadā tu mahīrājaḥ svasainyaparivāritaḥ ..
kacchadeśamupāgamya karārthaṃ samupasthitaḥ ..14..
3.3.d:
एकदा तु महीराजः स्वसैन्यपरिवारितः ॥
कच्छदेशमुपागम्य करार्थं समुपस्थितः ॥14॥
3.3.m: Once, however, Mahīrāja, surrounded by his army, / came to the Kaccha country and arrived to demand tribute.

3.3.s:
tayoścāsīnmahadyuddhaṃ jananāyakabhūpayoḥ..
māsānte sūryavaṃśīyo mahīrājena nirjitaḥ .. 15 ..
3.3.d:
तयोश्चासीन्महद्युद्धं जननायकभूपयोः॥
मासान्ते सूर्यवंशीयो महीराजेन निर्जितः ॥ 15 ॥
3.3.m: A great battle took place between the two kings, [Mahīrāja] and Jananāyaka. / At the end of a month, the Solar descendant was defeated by Mahīrāja.

3.3.s:
tyaktvā rāṣṭraṃ ca sakulaḥ saṃprāptaśca mahāvatīm ..
parimalastu tadā rājā tasmai grāmaṃ śubhaṃ dadau .. 16 ..
3.3.d:
त्यक्त्वा राष्ट्रं च सकुलः संप्राप्तश्च महावतीम् ॥
परिमलस्तु तदा राजा तस्मै ग्रामं शुभं ददौ ॥ 16 ॥
3.3.m: Abandoning his kingdom along with his clan, he arrived at Mahāvatī. / King Parimala then granted him an auspicious village.

3.3.s:
nivāsaṃ kṛtavāṃstatra svanāmnā prathitaṃ bhuvi ..
sa vai kacchapadeśīyo yayau parimalājñayā.. 17 ..
3.3.d:
निवासं कृतवांस्तत्र स्वनाम्ना प्रथितं भुवि ॥
स वै कच्छपदेशीयो ययौ परिमलाज्ञया॥ 17 ॥
3.3.m: He took up residence there, renown on earth by his own name. / Then, at the command of Parimala, that native of the Kacchapa country set forth.

3.3.s:
tadāsau ca mahīrājo mahīpatyanumoditaḥ ..
cāmuṃḍaṃ śīghramāhūya lakṣasainyasamanvitam ..
ādeśaṃ kṛtavānrājā tasya baṃdhanahetave .. 18 ..
3.3.d:
तदासौ च महीराजो महीपत्यनुमोदितः ॥
चामुंडं शीघ्रमाहूय लक्षसैन्यसमन्वितम् ॥
आदेशं कृतवान्राजा तस्य बंधनहेतवे ॥ 18 ॥
3.3.m: Thereupon that Mahīrāja, encouraged by the sovereign, / swiftly summoned Cāmuṇḍa along with an army of a hundred thousand, / and the king gave orders to capture him.

3.3.s:
sa ca netravatīkūle saṃprāpte lakṣa sainyapaḥ ..
rurodha sūryavaṃśīyaṃ jananāyakamuttamam ..19..
3.3.d:
स च नेत्रवतीकूले संप्राप्ते लक्ष सैन्यपः ॥
रुरोध सूर्यवंशीयं जननायकमुत्तमम् ॥19॥
3.3.m: Arriving at the banks of the Netravatī, the commander of a hundred-thousand strong / blocked the noble Jananāyaka of the Solar lineage.

3.3.s:
sa tadā khaḍgamādāya bāhuśālī yateṃdriyaḥ ..
tatra śūraśataṃ hatvā nabhomārgamupāyayau ..3.3.27.20..
3.3.d:
स तदा खड्गमादाय बाहुशाली यतेंद्रियः ॥
तत्र शूरशतं हत्वा नभोमार्गमुपाययौ ॥3.3.27.20॥
3.3.m: Then, drawing his sword, the strong-armed and self-controlled hero / killed a hundred warriors there and leaped up into the path of the sky.

3.3.s:
senāpateśca mukuṭaṃ gajasthasya gṛhītavān ..
lajjitaḥ sa tu cāmuṃḍo vacanaṃ prāha namradhīḥ ..21..
3.3.d:
सेनापतेश्च मुकुटं गजस्थस्य गृहीतवान् ॥
लज्जितः स तु चामुंडो वचनं प्राह नम्रधीः ॥21॥
3.3.m: He seized the diadem of the general who was mounted on an elephant. / Ashamed, Cāmuṇḍa spoke these words with a humble mind:

3.3.s:
bhavānvṛttikaro mahyaṃ kṣatriyo brāhmaṇasya vai ..
dehi me mukuṭaṃ vīra ciraṃ jīva sukhī bhava..22..
3.3.d:
भवान्वृत्तिकरो मह्यं क्षत्रियो ब्राह्मणस्य वै ॥
देहि मे मुकुटं वीर चिरं जीव सुखी भव॥22॥
3.3.m: "You are a source of livelihood to me, a kṣatriya to a brāhmaṇa! / Return my diadem, O hero; live long and be happy!"

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā sa vinayaṃ dattvā tasmai śubhaṃ vasu ..
kuṭhāranagare prāpto vāmanena surakṣitaḥ ..23..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा स विनयं दत्त्वा तस्मै शुभं वसु ॥
कुठारनगरे प्राप्तो वामनेन सुरक्षितः ॥23॥
3.3.m: Hearing this courteous plea, he gave him auspicious wealth, / and, protected by Vāmana, arrived in the town of Kuṭhāra.

3.3.s:
dṛṣṭvā tatra vaṭacchāyāṃ śrameṇātīva karṣitaḥ..
suṣvāpa nirbhayo vīrastatra sthāne sukhaprade .. 24 ..
3.3.d:
दृष्ट्वा तत्र वटच्छायां श्रमेणातीव कर्षितः॥
सुष्वाप निर्भयो वीरस्तत्र स्थाने सुखप्रदे ॥ 24 ॥
3.3.m: Seeing the shade of a banyan tree there, utterly exhausted by toil, / the fearless hero fell asleep in that place which provided comfort.

3.3.s:
tadā tu vāmano jñātvā svadūtaistatra kāraṇam ..
vastrāṇyācchādya cāgamya cāharaddharināgaram .. 25 ..
3.3.d:
तदा तु वामनो ज्ञात्वा स्वदूतैस्तत्र कारणम् ॥
वस्त्राण्याच्छाद्य चागम्य चाहरद्धरिनागरम् ॥ 25 ॥
3.3.m: Then Vāmana, learning through his spies the situation there, / disguised himself in garments, arrived, and stole Harināgara.

3.3.s:
hṛte tasmiṃśca divyāśve prabuddho jananāyakaḥ ..
ciṃtāmavāpya mahatīṃ rodanaṃ kṛtavānbahu .. 26 ..
3.3.d:
हृते तस्मिंश्च दिव्याश्वे प्रबुद्धो जननायकः ॥
चिंतामवाप्य महतीं रोदनं कृतवान्बहु ॥ 26 ॥
3.3.m: When that celestial horse had been stolen, Jananāyaka woke up; / overcome by great distress, he wept copiously.

3.3.s:
aśvāṃghricihnamālokya vāmanaṃ prāpya nirbhayaḥ ..
vacanaṃ prāha namrātmā nṛpaṃ gaurānvayodbhavam .. 27 ..
3.3.d:
अश्वांघ्रिचिह्नमालोक्य वामनं प्राप्य निर्भयः ॥
वचनं प्राह नम्रात्मा नृपं गौरान्वयोद्भवम् ॥ 27 ॥
3.3.m: Tracing the hoof-prints of the horse, he fearlessly approached Vāmana; / with humble disposition, he addressed the king born in the Gaura lineage:

3.3.s:
kṣatriyāṇāṃ hi saṃhāsyo bhayado bhuvi sarvadā ..
sa bhavānrājanītijño dehi me'śvaṃ sukhī bhava ..28..
3.3.d:
क्षत्रियाणां हि संहास्यो भयदो भुवि सर्वदा ॥
स भवान्राजनीतिज्ञो देहि मेऽश्वं सुखी भव ॥28॥
3.3.m: "A matter for ridicule among kṣatriyas is always terrifying on earth. / As one who knows statecraft, give me back my horse, and be happy,

3.3.s:
no cettvāṃ vai sanagaraṃ kṛṣṇāṃśaḥ kṣapayiṣyati ..
iti śrutvā tu vacanaṃ vāmano gauravaṃśajaḥ..29..
3.3.d:
नो चेत्त्वां वै सनगरं कृष्णांशः क्षपयिष्यति ॥
इति श्रुत्वा तु वचनं वामनो गौरवंशजः॥29॥
3.3.m: lest the portion of Kṛṣṇa destroy you along with your city!" / Hearing these words, Vāmana, born of the Gaura lineage,

3.3.s: bhayabhīto viniścitya pradadau harināgaram .. 3.3.27.30 ..
3.3.d: भयभीतो विनिश्चित्य प्रददौ हरिनागरम् ॥ 3.3.27.30 ॥
3.3.m: terrified, resolved [to do so] and returned Harināgara.

3.3.s:
pratodaṃ svarṇaracitaṃ nānāratnasamanvitam ..
lobhācca na dadau rājā mṛṣā śapathakārakaḥ ..31 ..
3.3.d:
प्रतोदं स्वर्णरचितं नानारत्नसमन्वितम् ॥
लोभाच्च न ददौ राजा मृषा शपथकारकः ॥31 ॥
3.3.m: The whip, fashioned of gold and adorned with diverse jewels, / out of greed the king did not return, swearing a false oath.

3.3.s:
tadā parimalāputraḥ kuṃṭhitaḥ prāha bhūpatim ..
pratodalobhātte rājankṣayaṃ durgo gamiṣyati .. 32 ..
3.3.d:
तदा परिमलापुत्रः कुंठितः प्राह भूपतिम् ॥
प्रतोदलोभात्ते राजन्क्षयं दुर्गो गमिष्यति ॥ 32 ॥
3.3.m: Then the son of Parimalā, frustrated, said to the king: / "Out of greed for the whip, O king, your fortress will go to destruction!"

3.3.s:
ityuktvā prayayau vīraḥ kānyakubjaṃ mahottamam..
lakṣaṇo hastinīsaṃstho vacanaṃ prāha garvitaḥ ..
kastvaṃ prāpto hayārūḍho nirbhayaḥ kṣatriyottamaḥ .. 33 ..
3.3.d:
इत्युक्त्वा प्रययौ वीरः कान्यकुब्जं महोत्तमम्॥
लक्षणो हस्तिनीसंस्थो वचनं प्राह गर्वितः ॥
कस्त्वं प्राप्तो हयारूढो निर्भयः क्षत्रियोत्तमः ॥ 33 ॥
3.3.m: Having said this, the hero departed for the great and pre-eminent Kānyakubja. / Lakṣaṇa, seated upon a female elephant, proudly spoke:

3.3.s:
sa hovāca mahārāja preṣitaścaṃdravaṃśinā ..
tavāntikaṃ samāyātaḥ śaraṇāgatavatsala .. 34 ..
3.3.d:
स होवाच महाराज प्रेषितश्चंद्रवंशिना ॥
तवान्तिकं समायातः शरणागतवत्सल ॥ 34 ॥
3.3.m: "Who are you, an excellent kṣatriya, who have arrived fearless upon a horse?" / He replied: "O great king, sent by one of the Lunar dynasty,

3.3.s:
mahīrājaśca balavānsakulaṃ caṃdravaṃśinam ..
haniṣyati ca raudrāstrairmahīpatyanumoditaḥ .. 35 .. .
3.3.d:
महीराजश्च बलवान्सकुलं चंद्रवंशिनम् ॥
हनिष्यति च रौद्रास्त्रैर्महीपत्यनुमोदितः ॥ 35 ॥ ।
3.3.m: I have come to your presence, O you who are kind to those seeking refuge! / The mighty Mahīrāja, encouraged by the sovereign,

3.3.s:
atastvaṃ svabalaissārddhaṃ sahāhlādādibhiryutaḥ ..
gacchagaccha mahārāja mṛtānujīvayādhunā .. 36 ..
3.3.d:
अतस्त्वं स्वबलैस्सार्द्धं सहाह्लादादिभिर्युतः ॥
गच्छगच्छ महाराज मृतानुजीवयाधुना ॥ 36 ॥
3.3.m: will slaughter the Lunar dynasty along with their families using dreadful weapons. / Therefore, march forth, march forth with your forces, O great king, together with Āhlāda and the rest, / and revive the fallen at once!"

3.3.s:
ityukto lakṣaṇastena jayacaṃdraṃ praṇamya saḥ ..
sarvaṃ vai kathayāmāsa mahīrājo yathāgataḥ .. 37..
3.3.d:
इत्युक्तो लक्षणस्तेन जयचंद्रं प्रणम्य सः ॥
सर्वं वै कथयामास महीराजो यथागतः ॥ 37॥
3.3.m: Addressed thus by him, Lakṣaṇa bowed to Jayacandra / and told him everything regarding how Mahīrāja had arrived.

3.3.s:
jayacaṃdrastu tacchrutvā cāhūya jananāyakam ..
vacanaṃ prāha kruddhātmā śṛṇu gautamavaṃśaja .. 38 ..
3.3.d:
जयचंद्रस्तु तच्छ्रुत्वा चाहूय जननायकम् ॥
वचनं प्राह क्रुद्धात्मा शृणु गौतमवंशज ॥ 38 ॥
3.3.m: Having heard that, Jayacandra summoned the leader of men / and, enraged in his soul, spoke these words: 'Listen, O scion of the Gautama race!

3.3.s:
rājā parimalaḥ krūrastyaktvā māṃ nijabhūpatim ..
prītiṃ ca kṛtavāṃstena macchatrordehalīpateḥ .. 39 ..
3.3.d:
राजा परिमलः क्रूरस्त्यक्त्वा मां निजभूपतिम् ॥
प्रीतिं च कृतवांस्तेन मच्छत्रोर्देहलीपतेः ॥ 39 ॥
3.3.m: Cruel King Parimala abandoned me, his own king, / and made friendship with that enemy of mine, the lord of Dehalī.

3.3.s:
priyaṃ saṃbadhinaṃ matvā saṃtyaktāstena rakṣakāḥ ..
yathā kṛtaṃ phalaṃ tena bhoktavyaṃ ca tathā bhuvi .. 3.3.27.40 ..
3.3.d:
प्रियं संबधिनं मत्वा संत्यक्तास्तेन रक्षकाः ॥
यथा कृतं फलं तेन भोक्तव्यं च तथा भुवि ॥ 3.3.27.40 ॥
3.3.m: Considering him a beloved relation by marriage, he discarded his protectors; / he must reap on earth the fruit according as he has acted.'

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā tu vacanaṃ kṛṣṇāṃśaḥ prāha namradhīḥ ..
rājañchuddhaḥ parimalo mahīpatyanuvācakaḥ ..
ato vai tvāṃ samutsṛjya bhūmirājavaśaṃ gataḥ ..41..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा तु वचनं कृष्णांशः प्राह नम्रधीः ॥
राजञ्छुद्धः परिमलो महीपत्यनुवाचकः ॥
अतो वै त्वां समुत्सृज्य भूमिराजवशं गतः ॥41॥
3.3.m: Hearing these words, the part of Kṛṣṇa, of humble mind, said: / 'O King, Parimala was blameless, acting upon the word of the king of the earth; / therefore indeed, abandoning you, he fell under the sway of Bhūmirāja.

3.3.s:
bhavānvai sarvadharmajñastatkṣamasvāparādhakam ..
ājñāṃ dehi mahārāja nivatsyāmastadaṃtikam.. 42 ..
3.3.d:
भवान्वै सर्वधर्मज्ञस्तत्क्षमस्वापराधकम् ॥
आज्ञां देहि महाराज निवत्स्यामस्तदंतिकम्॥ 42 ॥
3.3.m: You know all dharma; therefore forgive his offence. / Give your command, O great king: we shall dwell near him.'

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā tu vacanaṃ jayacaṃdro mahīpatiḥ ..
kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ prāha bho vīra dehi me bhuktimūlyakam ..
śīghraṃ vraja tvaṃ sakulo no cenno gaṃtumarhasi .. 43 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा तु वचनं जयचंद्रो महीपतिः ॥
कृष्णांशं प्राह भो वीर देहि मे भुक्तिमूल्यकम् ॥
शीघ्रं व्रज त्वं सकुलो नो चेन्नो गंतुमर्हसि ॥ 43 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing these words, King Jayacandra / said to the part of Kṛṣṇa: 'O hero, pay me the tribute of usufruct; / go quickly with your family; otherwise you ought not to go.'

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā vihasyāha kṛṣṇāṃśassarvamohanaḥ ..
mayā digvijayaḥ sarvaḥ kṛto bhīrubhayaṃkaraḥ ..
taddeyaṃ dehi me rājangṛhāṇa bhuktimūlyakam..44..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा विहस्याह कृष्णांशस्सर्वमोहनः ॥
मया दिग्विजयः सर्वः कृतो भीरुभयंकरः ॥
तद्देयं देहि मे राजन्गृहाण भुक्तिमूल्यकम्॥44॥
3.3.m: Hearing this, laughing, the part of Kṛṣṇa, who enchants everyone, said: / 'I carried out the conquest of all quarters, terrifying to cowards; / give me that which is to be given, O King, and take your tribute of usufruct!'

3.3.s:
ityuktassa tu bhūpālaḥ kṛṣṇāṃśena vilajjitaḥ ..
sainyamājñāpayāmāsa saptalakṣaṃ mahābalam .. 45 ..
3.3.d:
इत्युक्तस्स तु भूपालः कृष्णांशेन विलज्जितः ॥
सैन्यमाज्ञापयामास सप्तलक्षं महाबलम् ॥ 45 ॥
3.3.m: Spoken to thus by the part of Kṛṣṇa, that king felt ashamed; / he commanded an army of seven hundred thousand of great might.

3.3.s:
tadā vai sakulo vīraścāhlādo lakṣaṇānvitaḥ ..
nṛpasyāgre samāsthāya namaskṛtya yayau mudā .. 46 ..
3.3.d:
तदा वै सकुलो वीरश्चाह्लादो लक्षणान्वितः ॥
नृपस्याग्रे समास्थाय नमस्कृत्य ययौ मुदा ॥ 46 ॥
3.3.m: Then indeed, the hero Āhlāda, accompanied by his family and Lakṣaṇa, / stood before the king, paid homage, and departed with joy.

3.3.s:
kuṭhāranagaraṃ prāpya nṛpadurgaṃ rurodha ha ..
jñātvā sa vāmano bhūpaḥ pratodaṃ ca dadau mudā .. 47 ..
3.3.d:
कुठारनगरं प्राप्य नृपदुर्गं रुरोध ह ॥
ज्ञात्वा स वामनो भूपः प्रतोदं च ददौ मुदा ॥ 47 ॥
3.3.m: Having reached the city of Kuṭhāra, he besieged the king's fortress. / Understanding this, King Vāmana joyfully gave him an iron-tipped goad.

3.3.s:
sainyāyuta yutaṃ bhūpaṃ vāmanaṃ lakṣaṇo balī ..
paścātkṛtya yayau śīghraṃ yamunātaṭamuttamam .. 48 ..
3.3.d:
सैन्यायुत युतं भूपं वामनं लक्षणो बली ॥
पश्चात्कृत्य ययौ शीघ्रं यमुनातटमुत्तमम् ॥ 48 ॥
3.3.m: Placing King Vāmana, endowed with ten thousand troops, behind him, / mighty Lakṣaṇa quickly went to the excellent bank of the Yamunā.

3.3.s:
yamunājalamuttīrya kalpakṣetramavāptavān..
gaṃgāsiṃhaṃ ca nṛpatiṃ ṣaṣṭisāhasrasaṃyutam ..
puraskṛtya yayau vīro lakṣaṇo balavattaraḥ .. 49 ..
3.3.d:
यमुनाजलमुत्तीर्य कल्पक्षेत्रमवाप्तवान्॥
गंगासिंहं च नृपतिं षष्टिसाहस्रसंयुतम् ॥
पुरस्कृत्य ययौ वीरो लक्षणो बलवत्तरः ॥ 49 ॥
3.3.m: Crossing the waters of the Yamunā, he reached the field of Kalpa; / placing King Gaṅgāsiṃha, accompanied by sixty thousand [soldiers], at the front, / the more powerful hero Lakṣaṇa went forward.

3.3.s:
nadīṃ vetravatīṃ ramyāṃ samāgamya balaissaha ..
tatroṣuḥ kṣatriyāḥ śūrāssarva śastrāstrasaṃyutāḥ .. 3.3.27.50 ..
3.3.d:
नदीं वेत्रवतीं रम्यां समागम्य बलैस्सह ॥
तत्रोषुः क्षत्रियाः शूरास्सर्व शस्त्रास्त्रसंयुताः ॥ 3.3.27.50 ॥
3.3.m: Having approached the charming river Vetravatī along with their forces, / the valiant kṣatriyas, equipped with all weapons and missiles, encamped there.

3.3.s:
etasminnaṃtare vīraścāmuṃḍo lakṣasainyapaḥ ..
śataghnīḥ sthāpayāmāsa bhairavīḥ śatrunāśinīḥ .. 51 ..
3.3.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे वीरश्चामुंडो लक्षसैन्यपः ॥
शतघ्नीः स्थापयामास भैरवीः शत्रुनाशिनीः ॥ 51 ॥
3.3.m: Meanwhile, the hero Cāmuṇḍa, commander of a hundred thousand troops, / set up the Bhairavī śataghnī cannons that destroy enemies.

3.3.s:
tayoścāsīnmahadyuddhaṃ śataghrīraṇasaṃsthayoḥ ..
praharānte ca tatsainyaṃ dṛṣṭvā śūraḥ parājitam .. 52 ..
3.3.d:
तयोश्चासीन्महद्युद्धं शतघ्रीरणसंस्थयोः ॥
प्रहरान्ते च तत्सैन्यं दृष्ट्वा शूरः पराजितम् ॥ 52 ॥
3.3.m: A great battle arose between the two who stood in the battle of cannons. / And at the end of a watch, seeing his army routed, the hero

3.3.s:
raktabījaḥ samāgamya gajasthastvarito balī..
svabāṇaistāḍayāmāsa sainyaṃ tālanapālitam .. 53 ..
3.3.d:
रक्तबीजः समागम्य गजस्थस्त्वरितो बली॥
स्वबाणैस्ताडयामास सैन्यं तालनपालितम् ॥ 53 ॥
3.3.m: Raktabīja, mounted on an elephant, advanced quickly, being mighty; / with his arrows he struck down the army protected by Tālana.

3.3.s:
kecicchūrā hatā yuddhe kecittatra parājitāḥ ..
dudruvurbhayabhītāśca cāmuṃḍena ca pīḍitāḥ .. 54 ..
3.3.d:
केचिच्छूरा हता युद्धे केचित्तत्र पराजिताः ॥
दुद्रुवुर्भयभीताश्च चामुंडेन च पीडिताः ॥ 54 ॥
3.3.m: Some warriors were killed in battle, some were routed there; / terrified, they fled, afflicted by Cāmuṇḍa.

3.3.s:
prabhagnaṃ svabalaṃ dṛṣṭvā tālanaḥ parighāyudhaḥ ..
jaghāna tena sa gajaṃ cāmuṃḍo bhūmimāgataḥ 55 ..
3.3.d:
प्रभग्नं स्वबलं दृष्ट्वा तालनः परिघायुधः ॥
जघान तेन स गजं चामुंडो भूमिमागतः 55 ॥
3.3.m: Seeing his army broken, Tālana, armed with an iron club, / struck his elephant with it; Cāmuṇḍa fell to the ground.

3.3.s:
khaḍgayuddhaparo vīrastālanaṃ pīraghāyudham..
parājitya yayau paścācchatru sainyakṣayaṃkaraḥ ..56..
3.3.d:
खड्गयुद्धपरो वीरस्तालनं पीरघायुधम्॥
पराजित्य ययौ पश्चाच्छत्रु सैन्यक्षयंकरः ॥56॥
3.3.m: Devoted to sword-fighting, the hero defeated Tālana, whose weapon was an iron club; / bringing destruction upon the enemy army, he then withdrew.

3.3.s:
lakṣaṇastvarito gatvā svabhallena ca taṃ ripum ..
bhujayostāḍayāmāsa tadā te bahudhā'bhavan.. 57 ..
3.3.d:
लक्षणस्त्वरितो गत्वा स्वभल्लेन च तं रिपुम् ॥
भुजयोस्ताडयामास तदा ते बहुधाऽभवन्॥ 57 ॥
3.3.m: Going swiftly, Lakṣaṇa struck that enemy / on both arms with his spear; then they multiplied into many.

3.3.s:
sahasraṃ raktabījāśca khaḍga śaktyṛṣṭipāṇayaḥ ..
tiṣṭhatiṣṭheti bhāṣantaḥ kṣatriyānyuddhadurmadān .. 58 ..
3.3.d:
सहस्रं रक्तबीजाश्च खड्ग शक्त्यृष्टिपाणयः ॥
तिष्ठतिष्ठेति भाषन्तः क्षत्रियान्युद्धदुर्मदान् ॥ 58 ॥
3.3.m: A thousand Raktabījas, holding swords, spears, and lances in hand, / saying 'Halt, halt!' [attacked] the kṣatriyas who were reckless in battle.

3.3.s:
āhlādādyāśca te śūrā raktabījabhayāturāḥ ..
tyaktvā yuddhaṃ yayussarve brahmānaṃdaṃ mahābalam .. 59 ..
3.3.d:
आह्लादाद्याश्च ते शूरा रक्तबीजभयातुराः ॥
त्यक्त्वा युद्धं ययुस्सर्वे ब्रह्मानंदं महाबलम् ॥ 59 ॥
3.3.m: And Āhlāda and those other warriors, frantic with fear of Raktabīja, / abandoned the fight and all went to the mighty Brahmānanda.

3.3.s:
brahmānaṃdastu tāndṛṣṭvā gatvā svapitaraṃ prati ..
vṛttāṃtaṃ kathayāmāsa lakṣaṇāgamanaṃ mune .. 3.3.27.60 ..
3.3.d:
ब्रह्मानंदस्तु तान्दृष्ट्वा गत्वा स्वपितरं प्रति ॥
वृत्तांतं कथयामास लक्षणागमनं मुने ॥ 3.3.27.60 ॥
3.3.m: Seeing them, Brahmānanda went to his father / and reported the matter, O sage, [including] the arrival of Lakṣaṇa.

3.3.s:
śrutvā parimalo rājā premavihvalagadgadaḥ ..
āhlādapārśvamāgamya ruroda bhṛśamāturaḥ .. 61 ..
3.3.d:
श्रुत्वा परिमलो राजा प्रेमविह्वलगद्गदः ॥
आह्लादपार्श्वमागम्य रुरोद भृशमातुरः ॥ 61 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing this, King Parimala, choking, overcome with love, / came to Āhlāda's side and wept bitterly, greatly distressed.

3.3.s:
tadā tu devakī devī nṛpatiṃ prematatparam ..
uvāca sumukhī dīnā vayaṃ te bhakti tatparāḥ .. 62 ..
3.3.d:
तदा तु देवकी देवी नृपतिं प्रेमतत्परम् ॥
उवाच सुमुखी दीना वयं ते भक्ति तत्पराः ॥ 62 ॥
3.3.m: Then fair-faced Queen Devakī, looking miserable, / spoke to the king who was devoted to affection: 'We were devoted in devotion to you.

3.3.s:
bhavatā saṃparityaktā vicarāmo'nyabhūpatim ..
kṣamasva mama daurātmyaṃ pūrvajanmavipākajam.. 63 ..
3.3.d:
भवता संपरित्यक्ता विचरामोऽन्यभूपतिम् ॥
क्षमस्व मम दौरात्म्यं पूर्वजन्मविपाकजम्॥ 63 ॥
3.3.m: Abandoned by you, we approached another king. / Forgive my wickedness born of the ripening of deeds in a previous birth.'

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā ca nṛpatiḥ paramā naṃdanirbharaḥ ..
maṃtriṇaścādhikāraṃ ca rāmāṃśāya dadau mudā ..
svakīyaṃ lakṣasainyaṃ ca tatpatiścodayaḥ kṛtaḥ .. 64 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा च नृपतिः परमा नंदनिर्भरः ॥
मंत्रिणश्चाधिकारं च रामांशाय ददौ मुदा ॥
स्वकीयं लक्षसैन्यं च तत्पतिश्चोदयः कृतः ॥ 64 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing this, the king was filled with supreme joy; / he joyfully granted the office of minister to the part of Rāma, / and as for his own army of a hundred thousand, Udaya was made its commander.

3.3.s:
tataḥ paṃcadinānte tu mahīrājassamāgataḥ ..
rurodha nagarīṃ sarvāṃ cāmuṃḍabaladarpitaḥ ..
tayoścāsīnmahayuddhaṃ māsamātraṃ bhayānakam ..65..
3.3.d:
ततः पंचदिनान्ते तु महीराजस्समागतः ॥
रुरोध नगरीं सर्वां चामुंडबलदर्पितः ॥
तयोश्चासीन्महयुद्धं मासमात्रं भयानकम् ॥65॥
3.3.m: Then, at the end of five days, Mahīrāja arrived; / haughty with the strength of Cāmuṇḍa, he besieged the whole city. / And between the two there was a dreadful battle lasting for an entire month.

3.3.s:
prabhāte vimale jāte kṛṣṇāṃśo lakṣasainyapaḥ..
cāmuḍāntamupāgamya sahasraṃ svāṃgasaṃbhavam ..
ciccheda ca śirasteṣāṃ cāmuṃḍānāṃ pṛthakpṛthak .. 66 ..
3.3.d:
प्रभाते विमले जाते कृष्णांशो लक्षसैन्यपः॥
चामुडान्तमुपागम्य सहस्रं स्वांगसंभवम् ॥
चिच्छेद च शिरस्तेषां चामुंडानां पृथक्पृथक् ॥ 66 ॥
3.3.m: When pure dawn appeared, the part of Kṛṣṇa, leader of a hundred thousand soldiers, / approached Cāmuṇḍa; the thousand born from his body— / he severed the heads of each and every one of those Cāmuṇḍas.

3.3.s:
chinne śirasi te sarve lakṣavīrā babhūvire ..
tadā tadvyākulaṃ sainyaṃ cāmuṇḍaistaiḥ prapīḍitam ..67..
3.3.d:
छिन्ने शिरसि ते सर्वे लक्षवीरा बभूविरे ॥
तदा तद्व्याकुलं सैन्यं चामुण्डैस्तैः प्रपीडितम् ॥67॥
3.3.m: When the heads were severed, they all became a hundred thousand warriors. / Then that army became distressed, tormented by those Cāmuṇḍas.

3.3.s:
vismitaścaiva kṛṣṇāṃśo bhayabhītastadā mune ..
tuṣṭāva śāradāṃ devīṃ sarvamaṃgalakāriṇīm .. 68 ..
3.3.d:
विस्मितश्चैव कृष्णांशो भयभीतस्तदा मुने ॥
तुष्टाव शारदां देवीं सर्वमंगलकारिणीम् ॥ 68 ॥
3.3.m: Both astonished and terrified then, O sage, the part of Kṛṣṇa / praised goddess Śāradā, the bringer of all auspiciousness.

3.3.s:
kṛṣṇāṃśa uvāca..
namaste śārade mātarbrahmalokanivāsini..
tvayā tatamidaṃ viśvaṃ śabdamātraniraṃtaram..69..
3.3.d:
कृष्णांश उवाच॥
नमस्ते शारदे मातर्ब्रह्मलोकनिवासिनि॥
त्वया ततमिदं विश्वं शब्दमात्रनिरंतरम्॥69॥
3.3.m: The part of Kṛṣṇa said: / 'Homage to you, Mother Śāradā, dweller in the world of Brahmā! / By you this entire universe is pervaded perpetually by mere sound.

3.3.s:
raktabījavināśāya cāmuṃḍārūpadhāriṇi..
namaste divyacāmuṇḍe pāhi māṃ śaraṇāgatam..3.3.27.70..
3.3.d:
रक्तबीजविनाशाय चामुंडारूपधारिणि॥
नमस्ते दिव्यचामुण्डे पाहि मां शरणागतम्॥3.3.27.70॥
3.3.m: O you who assume the form of Cāmuṇḍā for the destruction of Raktabīja, / homage to you, divine Cāmuṇḍā; protect me who have come for refuge!'

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā stavaṃ devī varadā sarvakāriṇī..
tasya khaḍgamupāgamya raktabījaṃ dadāha vai.. 71..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा स्तवं देवी वरदा सर्वकारिणी॥
तस्य खड्गमुपागम्य रक्तबीजं ददाह वै॥ 71॥
3.3.m: Hearing this hymn of praise, the goddess, giver of boons and maker of all, / entered his sword and indeed burnt Raktabīja to ashes.

3.3.s:
bhasmībhūte lakṣaripau cāmuṇḍo bhūmimāgataḥ..
babaṃdha taṃ sa kṛṣṇāṃśo brahmānaṃdāṃtikaṃ yayau..
bhūmirājastu tacchrutvā bhayabhītaḥ samāgataḥ..
tadā parimalaṃ bhūpaṃ dayāluṃ premavihvalam ..
uvāca vacanaṃ rājā kṣamasva mama duṣkṛtam .. 73 ..
3.3.d:
भस्मीभूते लक्षरिपौ चामुण्डो भूमिमागतः॥
बबंध तं स कृष्णांशो ब्रह्मानंदांतिकं ययौ॥
भूमिराजस्तु तच्छ्रुत्वा भयभीतः समागतः॥
तदा परिमलं भूपं दयालुं प्रेमविह्वलम् ॥
उवाच वचनं राजा क्षमस्व मम दुष्कृतम् ॥ 73 ॥
3.3.m: When the hundred thousand enemies were reduced to ashes, Cāmuṇḍa fell to the ground; / that part of Kṛṣṇa bound him and went near Brahmānanda. / Hearing of that, Bhūmirāja, terrified, came there; / then to King Parimala, who was compassionate and overcome with love, / the king spoke these words: 'Forgive my misdeed!

3.3.s:
mahīpateśca vacanānmahadbhayamupāgatam ..
adyaprabhṛti bho vīra saṃtyaktaḥ kalahaḥ priyaḥ ..
bhavāṃśca mama saṃbandhī vayaṃ vai tava kiṃkarāḥ ..74 ..
3.3.d:
महीपतेश्च वचनान्महद्भयमुपागतम् ॥
अद्यप्रभृति भो वीर संत्यक्तः कलहः प्रियः ॥
भवांश्च मम संबन्धी वयं वै तव किंकराः ॥74 ॥
3.3.m: Great fear has overtaken me due to the command of the king of the earth. / From this day forth, O hero, sweet strife is abandoned; / you are my relative, and we are indeed your servants.'

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā parimalo rājānamidamabravīt ..
ratnabhānośca tanayaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ nāma viśrutam ..
śaraṇyaṃ śaraṇaṃ yāhi viṣṇubhaktaṃ dayāparam .. 75 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा परिमलो राजानमिदमब्रवीत् ॥
रत्नभानोश्च तनयं लक्षणं नाम विश्रुतम् ॥
शरण्यं शरणं याहि विष्णुभक्तं दयापरम् ॥ 75 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing this, Parimala said this to the king: / 'Go for refuge to the shelter-giver, the famous son of Ratnabhānu / named Lakṣaṇa, devoted to Viṣṇu, supremely compassionate.'

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā bhūmirājo dvijarūpadharo balī..
sāṣṭāṃgaṃ daṃḍavadbhūmau lakṣaṇasya cakāra ha .. 76 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा भूमिराजो द्विजरूपधरो बली॥
साष्टांगं दंडवद्भूमौ लक्षणस्य चकार ह ॥ 76 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing this, mighty Bhūmirāja, disguised in the form of a twice-born, / made a full prostration like a staff on the earth before Lakṣaṇa.

3.3.s:
tadā tu lakṣaṇo vīraḥ kṛtvā snehaṃ nṛpopari ..
saptalakṣabalaiḥ sārddhaṃ kānyakujjamupāyayau .. 77 ..
3.3.d:
तदा तु लक्षणो वीरः कृत्वा स्नेहं नृपोपरि ॥
सप्तलक्षबलैः सार्द्धं कान्यकुज्जमुपाययौ ॥ 77 ॥
3.3.m: Then the hero Lakṣaṇa, showing affection towards the king, / set out for Kānyakubja together with an army of seven hundred thousand.

3.3.s: phālgune māsi saṃprāpte sarve svaṃsvaṃ gṛhaṃ yayuḥ .. 78 ..
3.3.d: फाल्गुने मासि संप्राप्ते सर्वे स्वंस्वं गृहं ययुः ॥ 78 ॥
3.3.m: When the month of Phālguna arrived, all went to their respective homes.

3.3.s:
balakhānergayāśrāddhamacīkaradaviplutaḥ ..
caitramāsi site pakṣe saṃprāpya nijamaṃdire ..
brāhmaṇānbhojayāmāsa sahasraṃ vedatatparān .. 79 ..
3.3.d:
बलखानेर्गयाश्राद्धमचीकरदविप्लुतः ॥
चैत्रमासि सिते पक्षे संप्राप्य निजमंदिरे ॥
ब्राह्मणान्भोजयामास सहस्रं वेदतत्परान् ॥ 79 ॥
3.3.m: Without wavering, he caused the Gayā-śrāddha to be performed for Balkhān; / and having reached his own abode in the bright fortnight of the month of Caitra, / he fed a thousand brāhmaṇas devoted to the Vedas.

3.3.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
aṣṭāviṃśābdake prāpte kṛṣṇāṃśe balavattare ..
kārtikyāmiṃduvāre ca kṛttikāvyatipātabhe..1..
3.3.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
अष्टाविंशाब्दके प्राप्ते कृष्णांशे बलवत्तरे ॥
कार्तिक्यामिंदुवारे च कृत्तिकाव्यतिपातभे॥1॥
3.3.m: Sūta said: / When the very powerful Kṛṣṇāṃśa reached his twenty-eighth year, / on the full moon of Kārttika, a Monday, under the asterism Kṛttikā at the Vyatīpāta conjunction,

3.3.s:
kṛṣṇāṃśo'yutasenāḍhyaḥ svarṇavatyā samanvitaḥ..
vivāhamukuṭasyaiva saṃtyāgāya yayau mudā..2..
3.3.d:
कृष्णांशोऽयुतसेनाढ्यः स्वर्णवत्या समन्वितः॥
विवाहमुकुटस्यैव संत्यागाय ययौ मुदा॥2॥
3.3.m: Kṛṣṇāṃśa, accompanied by an army of ten thousand and joined by Svarṇavatī, / went with joy to remove his wedding diadem.

3.3.s:
pavitramutpalāraṇyaṃ vālmīkimunisevitam..
gaṃgākūle brahmamayaṃ lohakīlakamuttamam..3..
3.3.d:
पवित्रमुत्पलारण्यं वाल्मीकिमुनिसेवितम्॥
गंगाकूले ब्रह्ममयं लोहकीलकमुत्तमम्॥3॥
3.3.m: To the sacred Utpalāraṇya, frequented by the sage Vālmīki, / on the bank of the Gaṅgā, full of the absolute, [at] the excellent iron stake (Lohakīlaka);

3.3.s:
tatra gatvā sa śuddhātmā puṣpavatyā samanvitaḥ..
gosahasraṃ ca viprebhyo dadau snāne prasannadhīḥ.. .. 4 ..
3.3.d:
तत्र गत्वा स शुद्धात्मा पुष्पवत्या समन्वितः॥
गोसहस्रं च विप्रेभ्यो ददौ स्नाने प्रसन्नधीः॥ ॥ 4 ॥
3.3.m: Having gone there, that pure-souled one, accompanied by Puṣpavatī, / glad in mind at the bath, gave a thousand cows to the vipras.

3.3.s:
etasminnaṃtare prāptā mlecchajātisamudbhavā ..
śobhā nāma mahāramyā veśyā paramasundarī.. 5 ..
3.3.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे प्राप्ता म्लेच्छजातिसमुद्भवा ॥
शोभा नाम महारम्या वेश्या परमसुन्दरी॥ 5 ॥
3.3.m: In the meantime, there arrived one born of the Mleccha race, / a most enchanting, exceedingly beautiful courtesan named Śobhā.

3.3.s:
sā dadarśa paraṃ ramyaṃ kṛṣṇāśaṃ puruṣottamam..
taddṛṣṭimohamāpannā vyākulā cābhavatkṣaṇāt .. 6 ..
3.3.d:
सा ददर्श परं रम्यं कृष्णाशं पुरुषोत्तमम्॥
तद्दृष्टिमोहमापन्ना व्याकुला चाभवत्क्षणात् ॥ 6 ॥
3.3.m: She saw the exceedingly charming Kṛṣṇāṃśa, the best of men; / she fell into bewilderment at the sight of him and in an instant became distraught.

3.3.s:
mūrcchitāṃ tāṃ samālokya kṛṣṇāṃśaḥ sarvamohanaḥ ..
svanivāsamupāgamya viprānāhūya pṛṣṭavān .. 7 ..
3.3.d:
मूर्च्छितां तां समालोक्य कृष्णांशः सर्वमोहनः ॥
स्वनिवासमुपागम्य विप्रानाहूय पृष्टवान् ॥ 7 ॥
3.3.m: Seeing her swooned, Kṛṣṇāṃśa, the charmer of all, / went to his dwelling and, having summoned the vipras, asked:

3.3.s:
aṣṭādaśa purāṇāni kena proktāni kiṃ phalam ..
brūta me viduṣāṃ śreṣṭhā vedaśāstraparāyaṇāḥ .. 8 ..
3.3.d:
अष्टादश पुराणानि केन प्रोक्तानि किं फलम् ॥
ब्रूत मे विदुषां श्रेष्ठा वेदशास्त्रपरायणाः ॥ 8 ॥
3.3.m: “By whom were the eighteen Purāṇas spoken, and what is the fruit [of them]? / Tell me, O best of the learned, who are devoted to the Vedas and Śāstras!”

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā vaco ramyaṃ vidvāṃsaḥ śāstrakovidāḥ ..
abruvanvacanaṃ ramyaṃ kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ sarvadharmagam .. 9 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा वचो रम्यं विद्वांसः शास्त्रकोविदाः ॥
अब्रुवन्वचनं रम्यं कृष्णांशं सर्वधर्मगम् ॥ 9 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing these charming words, the learned men, skilled in the Śāstras, / spoke pleasing words to Kṛṣṇāṃśa, who was conversant with all dharma:

3.3.s:
parāśareṇa racitaṃ purāṇaṃ viṣṇudaivatam ..
śivena racitaṃ skāṃdaṃ pādmaṃ brahmamukhodbhavam .. 3.3.28.10 ..
3.3.d:
पराशरेण रचितं पुराणं विष्णुदैवतम् ॥
शिवेन रचितं स्कांदं पाद्मं ब्रह्ममुखोद्भवम् ॥ 3.3.28.10 ॥
3.3.m: “The Purāṇa whose deity is Viṣṇu was composed by Parāśara; / the Skānda was composed by Śiva; the Pādma arose from Brahmā's mouth;
