3.3.s:
śukaproktaṃ bhāgavataṃ brāhmaṃ vai brahmaṇā kṛtam ..
gāruḍaṃ hariṇā proktaṃ ṣaḍ vai sāttvikasaṃbhavāḥ .. 11 ..
3.3.d:
शुकप्रोक्तं भागवतं ब्राह्मं वै ब्रह्मणा कृतम् ॥
गारुडं हरिणा प्रोक्तं षड् वै सात्त्विकसंभवाः ॥ 11 ॥
3.3.m: The Bhāgavata was proclaimed by Śuka; the Brāhma was made by Brahmā; / the Gāruḍa was spoken by Hari. These six are born of sattva.

3.3.s:
matsyaḥ kūrmo nṛsiṃhaśca vāmanaḥ śiva eva ca ..
vāyuretatpurāṇāni vyāsena racitāni vai .. 12 ..
3.3.d:
मत्स्यः कूर्मो नृसिंहश्च वामनः शिव एव च ॥
वायुरेतत्पुराणानि व्यासेन रचितानि वै ॥ 12 ॥
3.3.m: The Matsya, the Kūrma, the Nṛsiṃha, the Vāmana, the Śiva, / and the Vāyu—these Purāṇas were composed by Vyāsa.

3.3.s:
rājasāḥ ṣaṭ smṛtā vīra karmakāṃḍamayā bhuvi ..
mārkaṃṇḍeyaṃ ca vārāhaṃ mārkaṇḍeyena nirmitam .. 13 ..
3.3.d:
राजसाः षट् स्मृता वीर कर्मकांडमया भुवि ॥
मार्कंण्डेयं च वाराहं मार्कण्डेयेन निर्मितम् ॥ 13 ॥
3.3.m: These six are recorded as rājasa on earth, O hero, consisting of the ritual portion. / The Mārkaṇḍeya and the Vārāha were fashioned by Mārkaṇḍeya;

3.3.s:
āgneyamaṃgirāścaiva janayāmāsa cottamam ..
liṃgabrahmāṃḍake cāpi taṃḍinā racite śubhe ..
mahādevena lokārthe bhaviṣyaṃ racitaṃ śubham .. 14 ..
3.3.d:
आग्नेयमंगिराश्चैव जनयामास चोत्तमम् ॥
लिंगब्रह्मांडके चापि तंडिना रचिते शुभे ॥
महादेवेन लोकार्थे भविष्यं रचितं शुभम् ॥ 14 ॥
3.3.m: And Aṅgiras brought forth the excellent Āgneya; / the auspicious Liṅga and Brahmāṇḍa were composed by Taṇḍin; / and for the welfare of the world Mahādeva composed the auspicious Bhaviṣya.

3.3.s:
tāmasāḥ ṣaṭ smṛtāḥ prājñaiḥ śaktidharmaparāyaṇāḥ ..
sarveṣāṃ ca purāṇānāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ bhāgavataṃ smṛtam .. 15 ..
3.3.d:
तामसाः षट् स्मृताः प्राज्ञैः शक्तिधर्मपरायणाः ॥
सर्वेषां च पुराणानां श्रेष्ठं भागवतं स्मृतम् ॥ 15 ॥
3.3.m: These six are remembered by the wise as tāmasa, devoted to the religion of Śakti. / And among all the Purāṇas, the Bhāgavata is held to be the best.

3.3.s:
ghore bhuvi kalau prāpte vikramo nāma bhūpatiḥ ..
kailāsādbhuvamāgatya munīnsarvānsamāhvayat .. 16 ..
3.3.d:
घोरे भुवि कलौ प्राप्ते विक्रमो नाम भूपतिः ॥
कैलासाद्भुवमागत्य मुनीन्सर्वान्समाह्वयत् ॥ 16 ॥
3.3.m: When the terrible Kali [age] arrived on earth, a king named Vikrama / came to earth from Kailāsa and summoned all the sages.

3.3.s:
tadā te munayassarve naimiṣāraṇyavāsinaḥ ..
sūtaṃ sañcodayāmāsusteṣāṃ tacchravaṇāya ca ..
proktānyupapurāṇāni sūtenāṣṭādaśaiva ca .. 17 ..
3.3.d:
तदा ते मुनयस्सर्वे नैमिषारण्यवासिनः ॥
सूतं सञ्चोदयामासुस्तेषां तच्छ्रवणाय च ॥
प्रोक्तान्युपपुराणानि सूतेनाष्टादशैव च ॥ 17 ॥
3.3.m: Then all those sages dwelling in the Naimiṣa forest / urged Sūta that they might hear them, / and eighteen Upapurāṇas were spoken by Sūta.”

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā tu vacanaṃ kṛṣṇāṃśo dharmatatparaḥ ..
śrutvā bhāgavataṃ śāstraṃ saptame'hni mahottamam .. 18 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा तु वचनं कृष्णांशो धर्मतत्परः ॥
श्रुत्वा भागवतं शास्त्रं सप्तमेऽह्नि महोत्तमम् ॥ 18 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing these words, Kṛṣṇāṃśa, intent on righteousness, / listened on the seventh day to that supreme teaching, the Bhāgavata.

3.3.s:
dadau dānāni viprebhyo gosuvarṇamayāni ca ..
brāhmaṇānbhojayāmāsa sahasraṃ vedatatparān ..19..
3.3.d:
ददौ दानानि विप्रेभ्यो गोसुवर्णमयानि च ॥
ब्राह्मणान्भोजयामास सहस्रं वेदतत्परान् ॥19॥
3.3.m: He bestowed gifts consisting of cows and gold upon the vipras, / and fed a thousand brāhmaṇas devoted to the Vedas.

3.3.s:
tadā tu bhikṣukī bhūtvā śobhā nāma madāturā ..
māyāṃ kṛtavatī prāpya kṛṣṇāṃśo yatra vai sthitaḥ .. 3.3.28.20 ..
3.3.d:
तदा तु भिक्षुकी भूत्वा शोभा नाम मदातुरा ॥
मायां कृतवती प्राप्य कृष्णांशो यत्र वै स्थितः ॥ 3.3.28.20 ॥
3.3.m: Then, having become a female mendicant, the passionate Śobhā / went where Kṛṣṇāṃśa was staying and cast an illusion.

3.3.s:
dhyātvā mahāmadaṃ vīraṃ paiśācaṃ rudrakiṃkaram ..
māyāṃ sā janayāmāsa sarvapāṣāṇakāriṇīm .. 21 ..
3.3.d:
ध्यात्वा महामदं वीरं पैशाचं रुद्रकिंकरम् ॥
मायां सा जनयामास सर्वपाषाणकारिणीम् ॥ 21 ॥
3.3.m: Meditating upon the heroic Mahāmada, a piśāca who was a servant of Rudra, / she produced an illusion that turned everything into stone.

3.3.s:
dṛṣṭvā svarṇavatī devī tāṃ māyāṃ śobhayodbhavām ..
chittvā cāhlādya vāmāṃgīṃ svagehaṃ gaṃtumudyatā 22 ..
3.3.d:
दृष्ट्वा स्वर्णवती देवी तां मायां शोभयोद्भवाम् ॥
छित्त्वा चाह्लाद्य वामांगीं स्वगेहं गंतुमुद्यता 22 ॥
3.3.m: Queen Svarṇavatī, seeing that illusion produced by Śobhā, / cut through it, and having gladdened her left side, set out to go to her own home.

3.3.s:
sā veśyā tu śucāviṣṭā tasyāḥ śṛṃgāramuttamam ..
svarṇayaṃtrasthitaṃ ramyaṃ lakṣadravyopamūlyakam ..
saṃhṛtya māyayā dhūrtā deśaṃ vāhlīkamāyayau .. 23 ..
3.3.d:
सा वेश्या तु शुचाविष्टा तस्याः शृंगारमुत्तमम् ॥
स्वर्णयंत्रस्थितं रम्यं लक्षद्रव्योपमूल्यकम् ॥
संहृत्य मायया धूर्ता देशं वाह्लीकमाययौ ॥ 23 ॥
3.3.m: Filled with grief, that rogue of a courtesan / stole away by magic her excellent ornaments, set upon a golden machine and worth a hundred thousand coins, / and fled to the country of Bāhlīka.

3.3.s:
kalpakṣetramupāgamya netrasiṃhasamudbhavā ..
veśyayā mama śṛṃgāraṃ hṛtaṃ jñātvā suduḥkhitā .. 24 ..
3.3.d:
कल्पक्षेत्रमुपागम्य नेत्रसिंहसमुद्भवा ॥
वेश्यया मम शृंगारं हृतं ज्ञात्वा सुदुःखिता ॥ 24 ॥
3.3.m: Having arrived at Kalpakṣetra, the daughter of Netrasiṃha, / deeply distressed upon realizing that her ornaments had been stolen by the courtesan,

3.3.s:
kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ vacanaṃ prāha gacchagaccha mahābala ..
gṛhītvā mama śṛṃgāraṃ śīghramāgaccha māṃ prati .. 25 ..
3.3.d:
कृष्णांशं वचनं प्राह गच्छगच्छ महाबल ॥
गृहीत्वा मम शृंगारं शीघ्रमागच्छ मां प्रति ॥ 25 ॥
3.3.m: Spoke these words to Kṛṣṇāṃśa: “Go, go, O mighty one! / Take back my ornaments and quickly return to me!

3.3.s:
guṭikeyaṃ mayā vīra racitā tāṃ mukhena ca ..
dhūrtamāyāvināśāya tava maṃgalahetave .. 26 ..
3.3.d:
गुटिकेयं मया वीर रचिता तां मुखेन च ॥
धूर्तमायाविनाशाय तव मंगलहेतवे ॥ 26 ॥
3.3.m: I have prepared this pill for [your] mouth, O hero, / for the destruction of the rogue's illusion and for your welfare.”

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā tathā kṛtvā kṛṣṇāṃśassarvamohanaḥ ..
śūkarakṣetramāgamya tatra veśyāṃ dadarśa ha .. 27 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा तथा कृत्वा कृष्णांशस्सर्वमोहनः ॥
शूकरक्षेत्रमागम्य तत्र वेश्यां ददर्श ह ॥ 27 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing this and doing so, Kṛṣṇāṃśa, the charmer of all, / went to Śūkarakṣetra and there saw the courtesan.

3.3.s:
sā tu veśyā ca taṃ vīraṃ dṛṣṭvā kandarpakāriṇam ..
racayitvā punarmāyāṃ tadaṃtikamupāgatā .. 28 ..
3.3.d:
सा तु वेश्या च तं वीरं दृष्ट्वा कन्दर्पकारिणम् ॥
रचयित्वा पुनर्मायां तदंतिकमुपागता ॥ 28 ॥
3.3.m: And that courtesan, seeing that hero who excited love, / fashioned her illusion once more and approached him.

3.3.s:
tadā sā niṣphalībhūya ruroda karuṇaṃ bahu ..
rudatīṃ tāṃ samālokya dayālussa prasannadhīḥ .. 29 ..
3.3.d:
तदा सा निष्फलीभूय रुरोद करुणं बहु ॥
रुदतीं तां समालोक्य दयालुस्स प्रसन्नधीः ॥ 29 ॥
3.3.m: Then, having been foiled, she wept copiously and piteously. / Seeing her weeping, he, compassionate and cheerful-minded,

3.3.s:
gṛhītvā sarvaśṛṃgāraṃ vacanaṃ prāha nirbhayaḥ ..
kiṃ rodiṣi mahābhāge satyaṃ kathaya mā ciram .. 3.3.28.30 ..
3.3.d:
गृहीत्वा सर्वशृंगारं वचनं प्राह निर्भयः ॥
किं रोदिषि महाभागे सत्यं कथय मा चिरम् ॥ 3.3.28.30 ॥
3.3.m: Recovered all the ornaments and, fearless, said: / “Why do you weep, O noble lady? Speak the truth without delay!”

3.3.s:
sāha me saharo nāma bhrātā prāṇasamapriyaḥ ..
nāṭyaiśca pañcasāhasraiḥ sahito maraṇaṃ gataḥ ..31..
3.3.d:
साह मे सहरो नाम भ्राता प्राणसमप्रियः ॥
नाट्यैश्च पञ्चसाहस्रैः सहितो मरणं गतः ॥31॥
3.3.m: She said: “My brother named Sahara, dear to me as my own life, / has died, together with five thousand actors.

3.3.s:
ato raumi mahābhāga saṃprāptā śaraṇaṃ tvayi ..
ityuktvā māyayā dhūrtā kṛtvā śavamayāntyajān .. 32 ..
3.3.d:
अतो रौमि महाभाग संप्राप्ता शरणं त्वयि ॥
इत्युक्त्वा मायया धूर्ता कृत्वा शवमयान्त्यजान् ॥ 32 ॥
3.3.m: Therefore I lament, O noble one, and have sought refuge in you!” / Having said this, that rogue by her illusion created outcasts made of corpses,

3.3.s:
tasmai pradarśayāmāsa nijakāryaparāyaṇā ..
ruditvā ca punastatra prāṇāṃstyaktuṃ samudyatā .. 33 ..
3.3.d:
तस्मै प्रदर्शयामास निजकार्यपरायणा ॥
रुदित्वा च पुनस्तत्र प्राणांस्त्यक्तुं समुद्यता ॥ 33 ॥
3.3.m: And showed them to him, intent upon her own objective; / and having wept again there, she made as if to abandon her life.

3.3.s:
dayālussa ca kṛṣṇāṃśastāmāha karuṇaṃ vacaḥ ..
kathaṃ te jīvayiṣyanti śobhane kathayāśu me .. 34 ..
3.3.d:
दयालुस्स च कृष्णांशस्तामाह करुणं वचः ॥
कथं ते जीवयिष्यन्ति शोभने कथयाशु मे ॥ 34 ॥
3.3.m: Compassionate Kṛṣṇāṃśa addressed piteous words to her: / “How will they revive, O fair one? Tell me quickly!”

3.3.s:
sāha vīra tavāsye tu saṃsthitā guṭikā śubhā ..
dehi me kṛpayā vīra jīvayiṣyanti te tathā .. 35 ..
3.3.d:
साह वीर तवास्ये तु संस्थिता गुटिका शुभा ॥
देहि मे कृपया वीर जीवयिष्यन्ति ते तथा ॥ 35 ॥
3.3.m: She said: “O hero, the auspicious pill that rests in your mouth— / give it to me out of pity, O hero, and then they will revive.”

3.3.s:
ityuktastu tayā vīro dadau tasyai ca tadvasu..
tadā prasannā sā dhūrtā kṛtvā śukamayaṃ vapuḥ ..
paṃjarasthamupādāya kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ kāmavihvalā .. 36 ..
3.3.d:
इत्युक्तस्तु तया वीरो ददौ तस्यै च तद्वसु॥
तदा प्रसन्ना सा धूर्ता कृत्वा शुकमयं वपुः ॥
पंजरस्थमुपादाय कृष्णांशं कामविह्वला ॥ 36 ॥
3.3.m: Thus addressed by her, the hero gave her that treasure. / Then delighted, that rogue, taking the form of a parrot, / took Kṛṣṇāṃśa in a cage, being overcome with passion.

3.3.s:
bāhlīkadeśamāgamya sāraṭṭanagaraṃ śubham ..
uvāsa ca svayaṃ gehe kṛtvā divyamayaṃ vapuḥ .. 37 ..
3.3.d:
बाह्लीकदेशमागम्य सारट्टनगरं शुभम् ॥
उवास च स्वयं गेहे कृत्वा दिव्यमयं वपुः ॥ 37 ॥
3.3.m: Having arrived in the country of Bāhlīka, at the auspicious city of Sāraṭṭa, / she assumed a divine form and lived in her own house.

3.3.s:
niśīthe samanuprāpte kṛtvā taṃ nararūpiṇam ..
āliliṃga hi kāmārtā kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ dharmakovidam .. 38 ..
3.3.d:
निशीथे समनुप्राप्ते कृत्वा तं नररूपिणम् ॥
आलिलिंग हि कामार्ता कृष्णांशं धर्मकोविदम् ॥ 38 ॥
3.3.m: When midnight arrived, she turned him into human form, / and, afflicted with love, she embraced Kṛṣṇāṃśa, who was learned in dharma.

3.3.s:
dṛṣṭvā tāṃ sa tathābhūtāṃ kṛṣṇāṃśo jagadaṃbikām ..
tuṣṭāva manasā dhīro rātrisūktena namradhīḥ ..39..
3.3.d:
दृष्ट्वा तां स तथाभूतां कृष्णांशो जगदंबिकाम् ॥
तुष्टाव मनसा धीरो रात्रिसूक्तेन नम्रधीः ॥39॥
3.3.m: Seeing her in that state, the steadfast Kṛṣṇāṃśa praised the Mother of the Universe in his mind with the Rātrisūkta, his intellect bowed in devotion.

3.3.s:
tadā sā sveḍinī bhūtvā tyaktvā kṛṣṇāṃśamuttamam ..
punaḥ śukamayaṃ kṛtvā ciṃciṇīvṛkṣamāruhat .. 3.3.28.40 ..
3.3.d:
तदा सा स्वेडिनी भूत्वा त्यक्त्वा कृष्णांशमुत्तमम् ॥
पुनः शुकमयं कृत्वा चिंचिणीवृक्षमारुहत् ॥ 3.3.28.40 ॥
3.3.m: Then, becoming a lizard [and] abandoning the noble Kṛṣṇāṃśa, / she turned him back into a parrot and climbed a tamarind tree.

3.3.s:
tadā svarṇavatī devī bodhitā viṣṇumāyayā ..
kṛtvā śyenīmayaṃ rūpaṃ tatra gatvā mudānvitā ..
dadarśa śukabhūtaṃ ca kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ yogatatparam 41 ..
3.3.d:
तदा स्वर्णवती देवी बोधिता विष्णुमायया ॥
कृत्वा श्येनीमयं रूपं तत्र गत्वा मुदान्विता ॥
ददर्श शुकभूतं च कृष्णांशं योगतत्परम् 41 ॥
3.3.m: Then the noble woman Svarṇavatī, awakened by the Māyā of Viṣṇu, / assumed the form of a female falcon and went there full of joy, / and she beheld Kṛṣṇāṃśa, who had become a parrot, intent upon yoga.

3.3.s:
etasminnaṃtare veśyā punaḥ kṛtvā śubhaṃ vapuḥ ..
narabhūtaṃ ca kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ vacanaṃ prāha namradhīḥ .. 42 ..
3.3.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे वेश्या पुनः कृत्वा शुभं वपुः ॥
नरभूतं च कृष्णांशं वचनं प्राह नम्रधीः ॥ 42 ॥
3.3.m: Meanwhile, the courtesan assumed a beautiful form once again, / and, with a bowed mind, spoke these words to Kṛṣṇāṃśa who had become a man:

3.3.s:
aye prāṇapriya svāminbhaja māṃ kāmavihvalām ..
pāhi māṃ ratidānena dharmajñosi bhavānsadā .. 43 ..
3.3.d:
अये प्राणप्रिय स्वामिन्भज मां कामविह्वलाम् ॥
पाहि मां रतिदानेन धर्मज्ञोसि भवान्सदा ॥ 43 ॥
3.3.m: "O lord dear as life, make love to me who am overwhelmed with desire! / Protect me by granting sexual pleasure; you are ever a knower of dharma."

3.3.s:
ityuktassa tu tāmāha vacanaṃ śṛṇu śobhane ..
te āryavartmasthitohaṃ vai vedamārgaparāyaṇaḥ .. 44 ..
3.3.d:
इत्युक्तस्स तु तामाह वचनं शृणु शोभने ॥
ते आर्यवर्त्मस्थितोहं वै वेदमार्गपरायणः ॥ 44 ॥
3.3.m: Being addressed thus, he said to her: "Listen to my words, O fair one! / I abide in the path of the Āryas, devoted to the way of the Veda.

3.3.s:
vivāhitāṃ śubhāṃ nārīṃ yo bhajeta ṛtau na hi ..
sa pāpī narakaṃ yāti tiryyagyonimayaṃ smṛtam ..
ataḥ parastriyā bhogo jñeyo vai nirayapradaḥ .. 45 ..
3.3.d:
विवाहितां शुभां नारीं यो भजेत ऋतौ न हि ॥
स पापी नरकं याति तिर्य्यग्योनिमयं स्मृतम् ॥
अतः परस्त्रिया भोगो ज्ञेयो वै निरयप्रदः ॥ 45 ॥
3.3.m: Whoever does not make love to his lawfully wedded, auspicious wife in her fertile period, / that sinner goes to hell, remembered as being of animal wombs. / Therefore, enjoying another's wife must truly be understood as bringing hell.

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā tu sā prāha viśvāmitreṇa dhīmatā ..
śṛṃgiṇā ca mahāprājña veśyāsaṃgaḥ kṛtaḥ purā ..
na ko'pi narakaṃ prāptastasmānmāṃ bhaja kāminīm .. 46 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा तु सा प्राह विश्वामित्रेण धीमता ॥
शृंगिणा च महाप्राज्ञ वेश्यासंगः कृतः पुरा ॥
न कोऽपि नरकं प्राप्तस्तस्मान्मां भज कामिनीम् ॥ 46 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing this, she said: "By the wise Viśvāmitra / and by Śṛṅgin, O greatly wise one, union with courtesans was performed in ancient times, / and neither went to hell; therefore, make love to me, a woman full of passion!"

3.3.s:
punaścāha sa kṛṣṇāṃśaḥ kṛttaṃ pāpaṃ tapobalāt ..
tābhyāṃ ca muniyugmābhyāmasamartho hi sāṃpratam .. 47 ..
3.3.d:
पुनश्चाह स कृष्णांशः कृत्तं पापं तपोबलात् ॥
ताभ्यां च मुनियुग्माभ्यामसमर्थो हि सांप्रतम् ॥ 47 ॥
3.3.m: Kṛṣṇāṃśa spoke again: "That sin was severed by the power of their austerities / by those two sages, but I am incapable [of that] at present.

3.3.s:
arddhāṃgaṃ puruṣasya strī maithune ca viśeṣataḥ ..
ahamāryaśca bhavatī veśyā ca bahubhoginī .. 48 ..
3.3.d:
अर्द्धांगं पुरुषस्य स्त्री मैथुने च विशेषतः ॥
अहमार्यश्च भवती वेश्या च बहुभोगिनी ॥ 48 ॥
3.3.m: A woman is half the body of a man, especially during sexual union. / I am an Ārya, and you are a courtesan enjoyed by many.

3.3.s:
ṛci śabdaśca pūrvāsyājjāta ṛgjassanātanaḥ ..
yogajaścaiva yaḥ śabdo dakṣiṇāsyādyajurbhavaḥ ..49..
3.3.d:
ऋचि शब्दश्च पूर्वास्याज्जात ऋग्जस्सनातनः ॥
योगजश्चैव यः शब्दो दक्षिणास्याद्यजुर्भवः ॥49॥
3.3.m: The sound born in the ṛc arose from the eastern mouth, born of the Ṛgveda, eternal; / and the sound born of yoga is from the southern mouth, originating from the Yajurveda;

3.3.s:
taddhitāntaśca yaśśabdaḥ paścimāsyācca sāmajaḥ ..
chandobhūtāśca ye śabdās te sarve brāhmaṇapriyāḥ ..
kevalo varṇamātraśca sa śabdo'tharvajaḥ smṛtaḥ .. 3.3.28.50 ..
3.3.d:
तद्धितान्तश्च यश्शब्दः पश्चिमास्याच्च सामजः ॥
छन्दोभूताश्च ये शब्दास् ते सर्वे ब्राह्मणप्रियाः ॥
केवलो वर्णमात्रश्च स शब्दोऽथर्वजः स्मृतः ॥ 3.3.28.50 ॥
3.3.m: and the sound ending in a taddhita suffix is from the western mouth, originating from the Sāmaveda. / And those sounds that consist of metre are all dear to brāhmaṇas; / and that sound which is a mere phoneme is remembered as born from the Atharvaveda.

3.3.s:
pañcamāsyācca ye jātāḥ śabdāḥ saṃsārakāriṇaḥ ..
te sarve prākṛtā jñeyāścaturlakṣavibhedinaḥ .. 51 ..
3.3.d:
पञ्चमास्याच्च ये जाताः शब्दाः संसारकारिणः ॥
ते सर्वे प्राकृता ज्ञेयाश्चतुर्लक्षविभेदिनः ॥ 51 ॥
3.3.m: And the sounds born from the fifth mouth, which bring about worldly existence, / all those are to be known as Prākrit, divided into four hundred thousand varieties.

3.3.s:
hitvā tānyo hi śuddhātmā caturvedaparāyaṇaḥ ..
sa vai bhavāṭavīṃ tyaktvā padaṃ gacchatyanāmayam .. 52 ..
3.3.d:
हित्वा तान्यो हि शुद्धात्मा चतुर्वेदपरायणः ॥
स वै भवाटवीं त्यक्त्वा पदं गच्छत्यनामयम् ॥ 52 ॥
3.3.m: Abandoning those, the pure-souled one who is devoted to the four Vedas / abandons the wilderness of worldly existence and goes to the sorrowless state.

3.3.s:
na vadedyāvanīṃ bhāṣāṃ prāṇaiḥ kaṃṭhagatairapi ..
gajairāpīḍayamāno'pi na gacchejjainamaṃdiram .. 53 ..
3.3.d:
न वदेद्यावनीं भाषां प्राणैः कंठगतैरपि ॥
गजैरापीडयमानोऽपि न गच्छेज्जैनमंदिरम् ॥ 53 ॥
3.3.m: One should not speak the Yāvana tongue even if one's breath reaches one's throat; / even if being crushed by elephants, one should not enter a Jaina temple.

3.3.s:
ityevaṃ smṛtivākyāni muninā paṭhitāni vai ..
kathaṃ tyājyo mayā dharmassarvalokasukhapradaḥ .. 54 ..
3.3.d:
इत्येवं स्मृतिवाक्यानि मुनिना पठितानि वै ॥
कथं त्याज्यो मया धर्मस्सर्वलोकसुखप्रदः ॥ 54 ॥
3.3.m: Thus indeed are the statements of Smṛti recited by the sage! / How can dharma, which grants happiness to all worlds, be abandoned by me?"

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā tu sā veśyā mlecchāyāścāṃśasaṃbhavā ..
śobhanā nāma raṃbhorūrmahākrodhamupāyayau .. 55 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा तु सा वेश्या म्लेच्छायाश्चांशसंभवा ॥
शोभना नाम रंभोरूर्महाक्रोधमुपाययौ ॥ 55 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing this, that courtesan, who arose from a portion of a mleccha woman, / named Śobhanā, having thighs like plantain trunks, fell into a great rage.

3.3.s:
vetasaistāḍayitvā taṃ punaḥ kṛtvā śukaṃ svayam ..
na dadau bhojanaṃ tasmai phalāhāraṃ śukāya vai .. 56 ..
3.3.d:
वेतसैस्ताडयित्वा तं पुनः कृत्वा शुकं स्वयम् ॥
न ददौ भोजनं तस्मै फलाहारं शुकाय वै ॥ 56 ॥
3.3.m: Striking him with canes, turning him into a parrot herself once more, / she gave no food, no meal of fruits to the parrot.

3.3.s:
tadā svarṇavatī devī kṛtvā nārīmayaṃ vapuḥ ..
maśakīkṛtya taṃ vīraṃ tatraivāntardadhe tu sā .. 57 ..
3.3.d:
तदा स्वर्णवती देवी कृत्वा नारीमयं वपुः ॥
मशकीकृत्य तं वीरं तत्रैवान्तर्दधे तु सा ॥ 57 ॥
3.3.m: Then the noble woman Svarṇavatī assumed a female form, / turned that hero into a mosquito, and vanished right there.

3.3.s:
punaḥ śyenīvapuḥ kṛtvā taddeśādyātumudyatā ..
pṛṣṭhamāropya maśakaṃ mayūranagaraṃ yayau .. 58 .
3.3.d:
पुनः श्येनीवपुः कृत्वा तद्देशाद्यातुमुद्यता ॥
पृष्ठमारोप्य मशकं मयूरनगरं ययौ ॥ 58 ।
3.3.m: Assuming once again the body of a female falcon, she prepared to depart from that land; / setting the mosquito on her back, she went to Mayūranagara.

3.3.s:
makaraṃdastu tāṃ dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇāṃśena samanvitām ..
netrapālasya tanayāṃ nāmnā svarṇavatī balī ..
caraṇāvupasaṃgṛhya svagehe tāmavāsayat .. 59 ..
3.3.d:
मकरंदस्तु तां दृष्ट्वा कृष्णांशेन समन्विताम् ॥
नेत्रपालस्य तनयां नाम्ना स्वर्णवती बली ॥
चरणावुपसंगृह्य स्वगेहे तामवासयत् ॥ 59 ॥
3.3.m: Seeing her accompanied by Kṛṣṇāṃśa— / the mighty daughter of Netrapāla, named Svarṇavatī— / Makaranda took hold of her feet and lodged her in his own house.

3.3.s:
śobhanāpi ca saṃbudhya pañjarāntamupasthitā ..
na dadarśa śukaṃ ramyaṃ mūrchitā cāpatadbhuvi .. 3.3.28.60 ..
3.3.d:
शोभनापि च संबुध्य पञ्जरान्तमुपस्थिता ॥
न ददर्श शुकं रम्यं मूर्छिता चापतद्भुवि ॥ 3.3.28.60 ॥
3.3.m: Śobhanā too, having awakened, approached the interior of the cage; / not seeing the charming parrot, she fell fainting to the ground.

3.3.s:
kiṃ karomi kva gacchāmi vinā taṃ ramaṇaṃ param ..
ityeva bahudhālapya madahīnapuraṃ yayau .. 61 ..
3.3.d:
किं करोमि क्व गच्छामि विना तं रमणं परम् ॥
इत्येव बहुधालप्य मदहीनपुरं ययौ ॥ 61 ॥
3.3.m: "What shall I do? Where shall I go without that supreme lover?" / Wailing thus in many ways, she went to the city of Madahīnapura.

3.3.s:
tatra sthitaṃ ca paiśācaṃ māyāmadaviśāradam ..
mahāmadaṃ ca saṃpūjya svadehaṃ tyaktumudyatā .. 62 ..
3.3.d:
तत्र स्थितं च पैशाचं मायामदविशारदम् ॥
महामदं च संपूज्य स्वदेहं त्यक्तुमुद्यता ॥ 62 ॥
3.3.m: Worshipping the Piśāca residing there, Mahāmada, / who was skilled in the madness of illusion, she prepared to give up her body.

3.3.s:
mahāmadastu saṃtuṣṭo gatvā vai śivamaṃdiram ..
marusthaleśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ tuṣṭāvārṣabhabhāṣayā .. 63 ..
3.3.d:
महामदस्तु संतुष्टो गत्वा वै शिवमंदिरम् ॥
मरुस्थलेश्वरं लिंगं तुष्टावार्षभभाषया ॥ 63 ॥
3.3.m: Mahāmada, being well-pleased, went to a temple of Śiva / and praised the liṅga Marusthaleśvara in the language of bulls.

3.3.s:
tadā prasanno bhagavānvacanaṃ prāha sevakam ..
svarṇavatyā hṛto vīraḥ kṛṣṇāṃśaścāryadharmagaḥ ..
mayā saha samāgaccha mayūranagaraṃ prati .. 64 ..
3.3.d:
तदा प्रसन्नो भगवान्वचनं प्राह सेवकम् ॥
स्वर्णवत्या हृतो वीरः कृष्णांशश्चार्यधर्मगः ॥
मया सह समागच्छ मयूरनगरं प्रति ॥ 64 ॥
3.3.m: Then the blessed lord, being pleased, spoke words to his servant: / "The hero Kṛṣṇāṃśa, follower of the Āryan dharma, has been abducted by Svarṇavatī; / come together with me toward Mayūranagara."

3.3.s:
ityuktastena paiśāco naṭaiḥ paṃcasahasrakaiḥ ..
tayā saha yayau tūrṇaṃ sahureṇaṃ samanvitaḥ .. 65 ..
3.3.d:
इत्युक्तस्तेन पैशाचो नटैः पंचसहस्रकैः ॥
तया सह ययौ तूर्णं सहुरेणं समन्वितः ॥ 65 ॥
3.3.m: Addressed thus by him, the Piśāca, with five thousand actors, / accompanied by Sahura, went quickly along with her.

3.3.s:
indulaśca tathāhlādo bodhito viṣṇumāyayā ..
trilakṣabalasaṃyukto devasiṃhena saṃyutaḥ ..
mayūranagaraṃ prāpya makaraṃdamupāyayau ..66..
3.3.d:
इन्दुलश्च तथाह्लादो बोधितो विष्णुमायया ॥
त्रिलक्षबलसंयुक्तो देवसिंहेन संयुतः ॥
मयूरनगरं प्राप्य मकरंदमुपाययौ ॥66॥
3.3.m: Indula and Āhlāda, awakened by the Māyā of Viṣṇu, / accompanied by a force of three hundred thousand, joined by Devasiṃha, / reached Mayūranagara and approached Makaranda.

3.3.s:
tadā tu śobhanā veśyā sahureṇa balaissaha ..
cakāra bhairavīṃ māyāṃ sarvaśatrubhayaṃkarīm ..67..
3.3.d:
तदा तु शोभना वेश्या सहुरेण बलैस्सह ॥
चकार भैरवीं मायां सर्वशत्रुभयंकरीम् ॥67॥
3.3.m: Then the courtesan Śobhanā, together with Sahura and the troops, / produced a fierce Māyā that caused fear in all enemies.

3.3.s:
sarvataścotthito vāto mahāmeghasamanvitaḥ..
pataṃti bahudhā colkāḥ śarkarāvarṣaṇe ratāḥ .. 68
3.3.d:
सर्वतश्चोत्थितो वातो महामेघसमन्वितः॥
पतंति बहुधा चोल्काः शर्करावर्षणे रताः ॥ 68
3.3.m: A wind arose on all sides accompanied by great clouds; / meteors fell in various ways, occupied with raining down gravel.

3.3.s:
dṛṣṭvā tāṃ bhairavīṃ māyāṃ tamobhūtāṃ samantataḥ ..
makarandaśca balavānrathasthaḥ svayamāyayau .. 69 ..
3.3.d:
दृष्ट्वा तां भैरवीं मायां तमोभूतां समन्ततः ॥
मकरन्दश्च बलवान्रथस्थः स्वयमाययौ ॥ 69 ॥
3.3.m: Seeing that fierce Māyā which had turned into darkness on all sides, / the mighty Makaranda came in person, mounted upon his chariot.

3.3.s:
śanibhallena tāṃ māyāṃ bhasma kṛtvā mahābalaḥ ..
gṛhītvā sahuraṃ dhūrtaṃ sabalaṃ gehamāptavān .. 3.3.28.70 ..
3.3.d:
शनिभल्लेन तां मायां भस्म कृत्वा महाबलः ॥
गृहीत्वा सहुरं धूर्तं सबलं गेहमाप्तवान् ॥ 3.3.28.70 ॥
3.3.m: Having reduced that Māyā to ash with his Saturn-spear, the greatly powerful one / seized the rogue Sahura along with his army and reached his home.

3.3.s:
tadā tu śobhanā nārī kāmamāyāṃ cakāra ha ..
bahulāssaṃsthitā veśyā gītanṛtyaviśāradāḥ .. 71 ..
3.3.d:
तदा तु शोभना नारी काममायां चकार ह ॥
बहुलास्संस्थिता वेश्या गीतनृत्यविशारदाः ॥ 71 ॥
3.3.m: Then the woman Śobhanā produced the Māyā of desire; / numerous courtesans stood there, skilled in singing and dancing.

3.3.s:
mohitāḥ kṣatriyāḥ sarve mumuhurlāsyadarśanāt ..
devasiṃhācca kṛṣṇāṃśādṛte te jaḍatāṃ gatāḥ .. ..72..
3.3.d:
मोहिताः क्षत्रियाः सर्वे मुमुहुर्लास्यदर्शनात् ॥
देवसिंहाच्च कृष्णांशादृते ते जडतां गताः ॥ ॥72॥
3.3.m: All the kṣatriyas were bewitched and swooned from beholding the dance; / except for Devasiṃha and Kṛṣṇāṃśa, they lapsed into stupor.

3.3.s:
tadā svarṇavatī devī kāmākṣī dhyānatatparā ..
punarutthāpya tānsarvāngṛhītvā śobhanāṃ punaḥ ..
mayūradhvajamāgamya nigaḍaistānbabaṃdha ha..73..
3.3.d:
तदा स्वर्णवती देवी कामाक्षी ध्यानतत्परा ॥
पुनरुत्थाप्य तान्सर्वान्गृहीत्वा शोभनां पुनः ॥
मयूरध्वजमागम्य निगडैस्तान्बबंध ह॥73॥
3.3.m: Then the noble woman Svarṇavatī, intent on meditating upon Kāmākṣī, / revived them all again, seized Śobhanā once more, / came to Mayūradhvaja, and bound them with iron shackles.

3.3.s:
mahāmadastu tajjñātvā rudradhyānaparāyaṇaḥ ..
cakāra śāmbarīṃ māyāṃ nānāsattvavidhāyinīm ..74..
3.3.d:
महामदस्तु तज्ज्ञात्वा रुद्रध्यानपरायणः ॥
चकार शाम्बरीं मायां नानासत्त्वविधायिनीम् ॥74॥
3.3.m: Knowing that, Mahāmada, intent upon meditating on Rudra, / created an illusory Māyā producing manifold creatures.

3.3.s:
vyāghrāḥ siṃhā varāhāśca vānarā daṃśakā narāḥ ..
sarpā gṛdhrāstathā kākā bhakṣayaṃti samaṃtataḥ .. 75 ..
3.3.d:
व्याघ्राः सिंहा वराहाश्च वानरा दंशका नराः ॥
सर्पा गृध्रास्तथा काका भक्षयंति समंततः ॥ 75 ॥
3.3.m: Tigers, lions, boars, monkeys, biting flies, men, / serpents, vultures, and crows devoured [people] on all sides.

3.3.s:
tadā svarṇavatī devī kāmākṣīdhyānatatparā ..
sasarja smarajāṃ māyāṃ tanmāyādhvaṃsinīṃ raṇe .. ..76..
3.3.d:
तदा स्वर्णवती देवी कामाक्षीध्यानतत्परा ॥
ससर्ज स्मरजां मायां तन्मायाध्वंसिनीं रणे ॥ ॥76॥
3.3.m: Then the noble woman Svarṇavatī, intent upon meditating on Kāmākṣī, / released a Māyā born of desire that destroyed his Māyā in battle.

3.3.s:
tayā tārkṣyāssamutpannāḥ śarabhāśca mahābalāḥ ..
siṃhādīnbhakṣayāmāsurjaghnuścaiva sahasraśaḥ ..77..
3.3.d:
तया तार्क्ष्यास्समुत्पन्नाः शरभाश्च महाबलाः ॥
सिंहादीन्भक्षयामासुर्जघ्नुश्चैव सहस्रशः ॥77॥
3.3.m: From it, eagles and exceedingly strong śarabhas arose; / they devoured the lions and other beasts and slew them by the thousands.

3.3.s:
hāhābhūte ca tatsainye dikṣu vidrāvite sati ..
śobhanā cābhavaddāsī svarṇavatyāśca māyinī .. 78..
3.3.d:
हाहाभूते च तत्सैन्ये दिक्षु विद्राविते सति ॥
शोभना चाभवद्दासी स्वर्णवत्याश्च मायिनी ॥ 78॥
3.3.m: When that army burst into cries of distress and was routed in all directions, / Śobhanā the sorceress became the maidservant of Svarṇavatī.

3.3.s:
sahurastairnaṭaissārddhaṃ cāhlādenaiva cūrṇitaḥ ..
teṣāṃ rudhirakabhāśca? bhūmimadhye samāruhan .. 79 ..
3.3.d:
सहुरस्तैर्नटैस्सार्द्धं चाह्लादेनैव चूर्णितः ॥
तेषां रुधिरकभाश्च? भूमिमध्ये समारुहन् ॥ 79 ॥
3.3.m: Sahura, along with those actors, was crushed by Āhlāda alone; / their pools of blood welled up within the earth.

3.3.s:
evaṃ ca muniśārdūla caturmāssvabhavadraṇaḥ ..
vaiśākhe māsi saṃprāpte te vīrā gehamāyayuḥ ..
iti te kathitaṃ vipra cānyatkiṃ śrotumicchasi .. 3.3.28.80 ..
3.3.d:
एवं च मुनिशार्दूल चतुर्मास्स्वभवद्रणः ॥
वैशाखे मासि संप्राप्ते ते वीरा गेहमाययुः ॥
इति ते कथितं विप्र चान्यत्किं श्रोतुमिच्छसि ॥ 3.3.28.80 ॥
3.3.m: And thus, O tiger among sages, the battle lasted for four months. / When the month of Vaiśākha arrived, those heroes went home. / Thus has it been told to you, O brāhmaṇa; what else do you wish to hear?

3.3.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
kinnarī nāma yā kanyā tvayā proktā mahāmune ..
kutra sthāne kathaṃ jātā tatsarvaṃ kṛpayā vada .. 1 ..
3.3.d:
॥ ऋषय ऊचुः ॥ ॥
किन्नरी नाम या कन्या त्वया प्रोक्ता महामुने ॥
कुत्र स्थाने कथं जाता तत्सर्वं कृपया वद ॥ 1 ॥
3.3.m: The sages said: / The maiden named Kinnarī who was spoken of by you, O great sage, / in what place and how was she born? Please tell us all that, out of kindness.

3.3.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
purā caitrarathe deśe nānājananiṣevite ..
vasaṃtasamaye prāpte krīḍaṃtyatra divaukasaḥ .. 2 ..
3.3.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
पुरा चैत्ररथे देशे नानाजननिषेविते ॥
वसंतसमये प्राप्ते क्रीडंत्यत्र दिवौकसः ॥ 2 ॥
3.3.m: Sūta said: / Long ago, in the region of Caitraratha frequented by various peoples, / when the spring season arrived, the gods were sporting there.

3.3.s:
maṃjughoṣā ca svarveśyā śukasthāne samāgatā ..
dṛṣṭvā taṃ sundaraṃ bālaṃ mohanāya samudyatā .. 3 ..
3.3.d:
मंजुघोषा च स्वर्वेश्या शुकस्थाने समागता ॥
दृष्ट्वा तं सुन्दरं बालं मोहनाय समुद्यता ॥ 3 ॥
3.3.m: And Mañjughoṣā, the celestial courtesan, came to the abode of Śuka. / Seeing that handsome youth, she set about to bewitch him.

3.3.s:
gītanṛtyādirāgāṃśca kṛtvā sā kāmavihvalā ..
prāṃjaliṃ praṇatā baddhvā punastuṣṭāva taṃ munim ..4..
3.3.d:
गीतनृत्यादिरागांश्च कृत्वा सा कामविह्वला ॥
प्रांजलिं प्रणता बद्ध्वा पुनस्तुष्टाव तं मुनिम् ॥4॥
3.3.m: Performing songs, dances, and musical modes, agitated by love, / she bowed down with folded hands and praised that sage again.

3.3.s:
tadā śukastu bhagavānpadyaṃ stuti mayaṃ śubham ..
śrutvā prasannahṛdayo varaṃ brūhīti so'bravīt .. 5 ..
3.3.d:
तदा शुकस्तु भगवान्पद्यं स्तुति मयं शुभम् ॥
श्रुत्वा प्रसन्नहृदयो वरं ब्रूहीति सोऽब्रवीत् ॥ 5 ॥
3.3.m: Then the blessed Śuka, hearing the auspicious verse of praise, / pleased at heart, spoke to her: 'Choose a boon!'

3.3.s:
sā tu śrutvā śubhaṃ vākyaṃ provāca ślakṣṇayā girā ..
patirme bhava he nātha śaraṇāgatavatsala .. 6 ..
3.3.d:
सा तु श्रुत्वा शुभं वाक्यं प्रोवाच श्लक्ष्णया गिरा ॥
पतिर्मे भव हे नाथ शरणागतवत्सल ॥ 6 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing that auspicious speech, she spoke in a soft voice: / 'Be my husband, O master, O you who are affectionate to those who seek refuge!'

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā tu vacanaṃ tathā kṛtvā tayā saha ..
sa reme muniśārdūlaḥ śuko vijñānakovidaḥ .. 7 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा तु वचनं तथा कृत्वा तया सह ॥
स रेमे मुनिशार्दूलः शुको विज्ञानकोविदः ॥ 7 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing that word and doing accordingly, / that tiger among sages, Śuka, skilled in spiritual knowledge, sported with her.

3.3.s:
tayossakāśātsaṃjajñe munirnāma suto'nayoḥ ..
tapaścakāra balavāndvādaśābdaṃ prayatnataḥ .. 8 ..
3.3.d:
तयोस्सकाशात्संजज्ञे मुनिर्नाम सुतोऽनयोः ॥
तपश्चकार बलवान्द्वादशाब्दं प्रयत्नतः ॥ 8 ॥
3.3.m: From the two of them a son named Muni was born. / Powerful, he performed penance diligently for twelve years.

3.3.s:
tasmai dadau tadā patnīṃ svarṇadevasya vai sutām ..
kubero rudrasahitaḥ sa munistu mudānvitaḥ .. 9 ..
3.3.d:
तस्मै ददौ तदा पत्नीं स्वर्णदेवस्य वै सुताम् ॥
कुबेरो रुद्रसहितः स मुनिस्तु मुदान्वितः ॥ 9 ॥
3.3.m: Then Kubera together with Rudra gave him as wife the daughter of Svarṇadeva, / and that sage was filled with joy.

3.3.s:
tayā reme prasannātmā tayorjātā sutottamā ..
kinnarī nāma vikhyātā himatuṃge samudbhavā ..
tapaścacāra sā devī rūpayauvana śālinī .. 3.3.29.10 ..
3.3.d:
तया रेमे प्रसन्नात्मा तयोर्जाता सुतोत्तमा ॥
किन्नरी नाम विख्याता हिमतुंगे समुद्भवा ॥
तपश्चचार सा देवी रूपयौवन शालिनी ॥ 3.3.29.10 ॥
3.3.m: Pleased in soul, he sported with her, and an excellent daughter was born to them, / renowned by the name Kinnarī, born on the Himatuṅga peak. / Possessing beauty and youth, that divine lady performed penance.

3.3.s:
tadā prasanno bhagavāñchaṃkaro lokaśaṃkaraḥ ..
makaraṃdāya dhīrāya dadau tāṃ rucirānanām .. 11 ..
3.3.d:
तदा प्रसन्नो भगवाञ्छंकरो लोकशंकरः ॥
मकरंदाय धीराय ददौ तां रुचिराननाम् ॥ 11 ॥
3.3.m: Then the blessed Śaṅkara, the benefactor of the world, was pleased / and gave that lovely-faced woman to the wise Makaranda.

3.3.s:
munistu śaṃkaraṃ prāha devadeva namo'stu te ..
matsutāyai varaṃ dehi rāṣṭravardhanamuttamam .. 12 ..
3.3.d:
मुनिस्तु शंकरं प्राह देवदेव नमोऽस्तु ते ॥
मत्सुतायै वरं देहि राष्ट्रवर्धनमुत्तमम् ॥ 12 ॥
3.3.m: The sage then said to Śaṅkara: 'O God of gods, homage to you! / Grant an excellent boon to my daughter, one that increases her kingdom.'

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā śivaḥ prāha guruṃḍānte ca bhūtale ..
madhyadeśe ca te rāṣṭraṃ bhaviṣyati sukhapradam ..
triṃśadabdapramāṇena tatpaścātkṣayameṣyati .. 13 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा शिवः प्राह गुरुंडान्ते च भूतले ॥
मध्यदेशे च ते राष्ट्रं भविष्यति सुखप्रदम् ॥
त्रिंशदब्दप्रमाणेन तत्पश्चात्क्षयमेष्यति ॥ 13 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing this, Śiva said: 'On the earth, at the border of Guruṇḍa, / and in the Madhyadeśa, your kingdom will bring happiness. / It will last for a measure of thirty years; after that, it will go to ruin.'

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā tu sa munirhimatuṃganivāsakaḥ ..
makaraṃdena sahitastatra vāsamakārayat..14..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा तु स मुनिर्हिमतुंगनिवासकः ॥
मकरंदेन सहितस्तत्र वासमकारयत्॥14॥
3.3.m: Hearing this, that sage, residing on the Himatuṅga peak, / made his dwelling there together with Makaranda.

3.3.s:
iti te kathitaṃ vipra punaḥ śṛṇu kathāṃ śubhām ..
ūnatriṃśābdakaṃ prāpte kṛṣṇāṃśe raṇakāraṇam .. 15 ..
3.3.d:
इति ते कथितं विप्र पुनः शृणु कथां शुभाम् ॥
ऊनत्रिंशाब्दकं प्राप्ते कृष्णांशे रणकारणम् ॥ 15 ॥
3.3.m: Thus it has been told to you, O brāhmaṇa; hear again the auspicious tale: / the cause of the battle when Kṛṣṇāṃśa reached his twenty-ninth year.

3.3.s:
netrapālasya nagaraṃ nānādhātuvicitritam ..
matvā nyūnapatirbauddho rurodha nagaraṃ śubham .. 16 ..
3.3.d:
नेत्रपालस्य नगरं नानाधातुविचित्रितम् ॥
मत्वा न्यूनपतिर्बौद्धो रुरोध नगरं शुभम् ॥ 16 ॥
3.3.m: Thinking the city of Netrapāla, adorned with various minerals, / to have a weak protector, the Buddhist besieged the fair city.

3.3.s:
saptalakṣayuto rājā bauddhasiṃho mahābalaḥ ..
trilakṣabalasaṃyuktaissārddhaṃ yuddhamacīkarat .. 17 ..
3.3.d:
सप्तलक्षयुतो राजा बौद्धसिंहो महाबलः ॥
त्रिलक्षबलसंयुक्तैस्सार्द्धं युद्धमचीकरत् ॥ 17 ॥
3.3.m: King Bauddhasiṃha, very powerful, endowed with seven hundred thousand [men], / engaged in battle with [kings] endowed with a force of three hundred thousand.

3.3.s:
saptāhorātramabhavatsenāyuddhaṃ bhayānakam ..
yogasiṃho bhogasiṃho vijayaśca mahābalaḥ .. 18 ..
3.3.d:
सप्ताहोरात्रमभवत्सेनायुद्धं भयानकम् ॥
योगसिंहो भोगसिंहो विजयश्च महाबलः ॥ 18 ॥
3.3.m: A terrible battle between the armies lasted for seven days and nights. / Yogasiṃha, Bhogasiṃha, and the very powerful Vijaya

3.3.s:
jaghāna śātravīṃ senāṃ bauddhasiṃhena pālitām ..
etasminnaṃtare prāptāḥ śyāmajāpakadeśagāḥ .. 19 ..
3.3.d:
जघान शात्रवीं सेनां बौद्धसिंहेन पालिताम् ॥
एतस्मिन्नंतरे प्राप्ताः श्यामजापकदेशगाः ॥ 19 ॥
3.3.m: struck down the hostile army protected by Bauddhasiṃha. / In the meantime, there arrived those who lived in the lands of Śyāma and Jāpaka,

3.3.s:
bauddhā māyāvinassarve lokamānyaprapūjakāḥ ..
punarjātaṃ mahadyuddhaṃ māsamekaṃ tayostadā .. 3.3.29.20 ..
3.3.d:
बौद्धा मायाविनस्सर्वे लोकमान्यप्रपूजकाः ॥
पुनर्जातं महद्युद्धं मासमेकं तयोस्तदा ॥ 3.3.29.20 ॥
3.3.m: all of them deceitful Buddhists, worshippers of the revered one of the world. / Then another great battle took place between the two sides for a month.

3.3.s:
netrapālājñayā sarve kṛṣṇāṃśādyāḥ samāgatāḥ ..
kṛṣṇāṃśo biṃdulārūḍho devaḥ svahayasaṃsthitaḥ ..21..
3.3.d:
नेत्रपालाज्ञया सर्वे कृष्णांशाद्याः समागताः ॥
कृष्णांशो बिंदुलारूढो देवः स्वहयसंस्थितः ॥21॥
3.3.m: By command of Netrapāla, Kṛṣṇāṃśa and all the others arrived. / Kṛṣṇāṃśa mounted on Bindula, Deva mounted on his own horse,

3.3.s:
iṃdulaśca karālāśve maṃḍalīko gaje sthitaḥ ..
gautamaśca samāyāto harināgarasaṃsthitaḥ ..22..
3.3.d:
इंदुलश्च करालाश्वे मंडलीको गजे स्थितः ॥
गौतमश्च समायातो हरिनागरसंस्थितः ॥22॥
3.3.m: Indula on a fierce horse, Maṇḍalīka mounted on an elephant; / and Gautama arrived mounted on Harināgara.

3.3.s:
tālanaśca samāyātaḥ siṃhinyupari saṃsthitaḥ ..
dhānyapālastailyakāro yuyutsoraṃśasaṃbhavaḥ ..23..
3.3.d:
तालनश्च समायातः सिंहिन्युपरि संस्थितः ॥
धान्यपालस्तैल्यकारो युयुत्सोरंशसंभवः ॥23॥
3.3.m: And Tālana arrived mounted upon a lioness; / Dhānyapāla the oil-presser, born from a portion of Yuyutsu;

3.3.s:
lallasiṃhaśca balavānkuṃtibhojāṃśasaṃbhavaḥ ..
tāmbūlīyakajātīyo lakṣaṇānujñayā yayau .. 24 ..
3.3.d:
लल्लसिंहश्च बलवान्कुंतिभोजांशसंभवः ॥
ताम्बूलीयकजातीयो लक्षणानुज्ञया ययौ ॥ 24 ॥
3.3.m: and the powerful Lallasiṃha, born from a portion of Kuntibhoja, / belonging to the betel-grower caste, set forth by permission of Lakṣaṇa.

3.3.s:
tadā tu netrasiṃhaśca saptalakṣabalairvṛtaḥ ..
pālitaścāṣṭabhirvīraisteṣāṃ nāśāya cāyayau .. 25 ..
3.3.d:
तदा तु नेत्रसिंहश्च सप्तलक्षबलैर्वृतः ॥
पालितश्चाष्टभिर्वीरैस्तेषां नाशाय चाययौ ॥ 25 ॥
3.3.m: Then Netrasiṃha, surrounded by a force of seven hundred thousand / and protected by eight heroes, advanced for their destruction.

3.3.s:
bhayabhītāśca te bauddhāstyaktvā deśaṃ samantataḥ ..
cīnadeśamupāgamya yuddhabhūmimakārayan .. 26 ..
3.3.d:
भयभीताश्च ते बौद्धास्त्यक्त्वा देशं समन्ततः ॥
चीनदेशमुपागम्य युद्धभूमिमकारयन् ॥ 26 ॥
3.3.m: Frightened by fear, those Buddhists completely abandoned the region, / and having gone to the country of Cīna, they set up a battleground.

3.3.s:
tadanuprayayuste vai hūhānadamupasthitāḥ ..
māghamāse tu saṃprāpte punaryuddhamavartata .. 27 ..
3.3.d:
तदनुप्रययुस्ते वै हूहानदमुपस्थिताः ॥
माघमासे तु संप्राप्ते पुनर्युद्धमवर्तत ॥ 27 ॥
3.3.m: Following them, they arrived at the Hūhā river. / When the month of Māgha arrived, the battle commenced once again.

3.3.s:
śyāmadeśodbhavā lakṣaṃ tathā lakṣaṃ ca jāpakāḥ ..
daśa lakṣāścīnadeśyā yuddhāya samupasthitāḥ .. 28 ..
3.3.d:
श्यामदेशोद्भवा लक्षं तथा लक्षं च जापकाः ॥
दश लक्षाश्चीनदेश्या युद्धाय समुपस्थिताः ॥ 28 ॥
3.3.m: A hundred thousand born in the country of Śyāma, and likewise a hundred thousand Jāpakas, / and one million natives of Cīna stood ready for battle.

3.3.s:
kṛṣṇāṃśo lakṣasenāḍhyo devo lakṣasamanvitaḥ ..
netrapālaśca lakṣāḍhayo yogabhogasamanvitaḥ .. 29 ..
3.3.d:
कृष्णांशो लक्षसेनाढ्यो देवो लक्षसमन्वितः ॥
नेत्रपालश्च लक्षाढयो योगभोगसमन्वितः ॥ 29 ॥
3.3.m: Kṛṣṇāṃśa was accompanied by an army of a hundred thousand; Deva had a hundred thousand; / and Netrapāla had a hundred thousand, accompanied by Yoga and Bhoga.

3.3.s:
maṃḍalīkaścendulena lakṣasainyasamanvitaḥ ..
dhyānapālo lallasiṃho lakṣasainyānvitaḥ sthitaḥ .. 3.3.29.30 ..
3.3.d:
मंडलीकश्चेन्दुलेन लक्षसैन्यसमन्वितः ॥
ध्यानपालो लल्लसिंहो लक्षसैन्यान्वितः स्थितः ॥ 3.3.29.30 ॥
3.3.m: Maṇḍalīka together with Indula was accompanied by an army of a hundred thousand; / Dhyānapāla and Lallasiṃha stood with an army of a hundred thousand.

3.3.s:
jananāyaka evāpi lakṣasainyayutaḥ sthitaḥ ..
tālano lakṣasenāḍhyo yuddhāya samupāgataḥ .. 31 ..
3.3.d:
जननायक एवापि लक्षसैन्ययुतः स्थितः ॥
तालनो लक्षसेनाढ्यो युद्धाय समुपागतः ॥ 31 ॥
3.3.m: Jananāyaka also stood with an army of a hundred thousand; / and Tālana, endowed with an army of a hundred thousand, approached for battle.

3.3.s:
tatra yuddhamabhūdghoraṃ bauddhānāmāryakaissaha ..
pakṣamātraṃ muniśreṣṭha yamalokavivarddhanam .. 32 ..
3.3.d:
तत्र युद्धमभूद्घोरं बौद्धानामार्यकैस्सह ॥
पक्षमात्रं मुनिश्रेष्ठ यमलोकविवर्द्धनम् ॥ 32 ॥
3.3.m: There took place a dreadful battle between the Buddhists and the Āryans / lasting for half a month, O best of sages, enlarging the realm of Yama.

3.3.s:
sapta lakṣaṃ hatā bauddhā dvilakṣaṃ cāryadeśajāḥ ..
tataste bhayabhītāśca tyaktvā yuddhaṃ gṛhaṃ yayuḥ .. 33 ..
3.3.d:
सप्त लक्षं हता बौद्धा द्विलक्षं चार्यदेशजाः ॥
ततस्ते भयभीताश्च त्यक्त्वा युद्धं गृहं ययुः ॥ 33 ॥
3.3.m: Seven hundred thousand Buddhists were slain, and two hundred thousand born in the Āryan land. / Then, frightened by fear, they abandoned the battle and went home.

3.3.s:
kṛtvā dārumayīṃ senāṃ kalayaṃtraprabhāvataḥ ..
gajāśca daśasāhasrā saśūrāḥ kāṣṭhanirmitāḥ .. 34 ..
3.3.d:
कृत्वा दारुमयीं सेनां कलयंत्रप्रभावतः ॥
गजाश्च दशसाहस्रा सशूराः काष्ठनिर्मिताः ॥ 34 ॥
3.3.m: Having created a wooden army by the power of mechanical devices, / ten thousand wooden elephants were made, along with warriors,

3.3.s:
ekalakṣaṃ hayārūḍhā dārupāśca raṇonmukhāḥ ..
sahasraṃ mahiṣārūḍhāssahasraṃ kolapṛṣṭhagāḥ.. 35 ..
3.3.d:
एकलक्षं हयारूढा दारुपाश्च रणोन्मुखाः ॥
सहस्रं महिषारूढास्सहस्रं कोलपृष्ठगाः॥ 35 ॥
3.3.m: one hundred thousand wooden mounted cavalrymen eager for battle, / a thousand mounted on buffaloes, a thousand mounted on the backs of boars,

3.3.s:
siṃhārūḍhāssahasraṃ ca sahasraṃ haṃsavāhanāḥ..
kaṃkagomāyugṛdhrāṇāṃ śyāmārūḍhāḥ pṛthaktathā .. 36 ..
3.3.d:
सिंहारूढास्सहस्रं च सहस्रं हंसवाहनाः॥
कंकगोमायुगृध्राणां श्यामारूढाः पृथक्तथा ॥ 36 ॥
3.3.m: and a thousand mounted on lions, a thousand with geese as mounts, / and similarly, separately mounted on herons, jackals, vultures, and Śyāmā-birds,

3.3.s:
uṣṭrāḥ saptasahasrāṇi saśūrāśca raṇonmukhāḥ ..
evaṃ sapādalakṣaiśca kāṣṭhasainyaiśca mānuṣāḥ .. 37 ..
3.3.d:
उष्ट्राः सप्तसहस्राणि सशूराश्च रणोन्मुखाः ॥
एवं सपादलक्षैश्च काष्ठसैन्यैश्च मानुषाः ॥ 37 ॥
3.3.m: and seven thousand camels along with warriors eager for battle. / Thus, by means of one hundred and twenty-five thousand wooden troops, men

3.3.s:
dvilakṣāṇi kṣayaṃ jagmuḥ kṛṣṇāṃśādyaiḥ surakṣitāḥ ..
tato hāhākṛtaṃ sainyaṃ cāryyāṇāṃ ca nanāśa tat .. .. 38 ..
3.3.d:
द्विलक्षाणि क्षयं जग्मुः कृष्णांशाद्यैः सुरक्षिताः ॥
ततो हाहाकृतं सैन्यं चार्य्याणां च ननाश तत् ॥ ॥ 38 ॥
3.3.m: numbering two hundred thousand, well-protected by Kṛṣṇāṃśa and others, met destruction. / Then that army of the Āryans cried out in distress and was routed.

3.3.s:
dṛṣṭvā tatkautukaṃ ramyaṃ jayanto yuddhakovidaḥ ..
āgneyaṃ śaramādāya kāṣṭhasainyeṣu cākṣipat .. 39 ..
3.3.d:
दृष्ट्वा तत्कौतुकं रम्यं जयन्तो युद्धकोविदः ॥
आग्नेयं शरमादाय काष्ठसैन्येषु चाक्षिपत् ॥ 39 ॥
3.3.m: Seeing that delightful marvel, Jayanta, skilled in battle, / took an arrow of fire and loosed it at the wooden troops.

3.3.s:
bhasmībhūtāśca te sarve tatraiva vilayaṃ gatāḥ ..
trilakṣaṃ kṣatriyāḥ śeṣā jayaṃtaṃ raṇakovidam ..
cakrurjayaravaṃ tatra tuṣṭuvuśca punaḥ punaḥ .. 3.3.29.40 ..
3.3.d:
भस्मीभूताश्च ते सर्वे तत्रैव विलयं गताः ॥
त्रिलक्षं क्षत्रियाः शेषा जयंतं रणकोविदम् ॥
चक्रुर्जयरवं तत्र तुष्टुवुश्च पुनः पुनः ॥ 3.3.29.40 ॥
3.3.m: Turned to ashes, all of them dissolved right there. / The remaining three hundred thousand kṣatriyas shouted cries of victory / to Jayanta, skilled in battle, and praised him again and again.

3.3.s: tadā tu cīnajā bauddhāḥ kṛtvā viṃśatsahasrakān.. hayārūḍhām̐llohamayānpreṣayāmāsurūrjitān .. 41 ..
3.3.d: तदा तु चीनजा बौद्धाः कृत्वा विंशत्सहस्रकान्॥ हयारूढाम्̐ल्लोहमयान्प्रेषयामासुरूर्जितान् ॥ 41 ॥
3.3.m: Then the Buddhists born in China made twenty thousand / iron [warriors] mounted on horses and sent them forth, mighty.

3.3.s:
yogasiṃho gajārūḍho dhanurbāṇadharo valī ..
kaṃṭheṣu lohajānvīrāṃstāḍayāmāsa vai tadā .. .. 42 ..
3.3.d:
योगसिंहो गजारूढो धनुर्बाणधरो वली ॥
कंठेषु लोहजान्वीरांस्ताडयामास वै तदा ॥ ॥ 42 ॥
3.3.m: Strong Yogasiṃha, mounted on an elephant and holding bow and arrows, / then struck those iron-born heroes in the throats.

3.3.s:
mṛtāste paṃcasāhasrā yogasiṃhaśarārditāḥ ..
bauddhasiṃhastadā śūro dṛṣṭvā tasya parākramam ..
kṛtvā lohamayaṃ siṃhaṃ yogasiṃhamapeṣayat ..43..
3.3.d:
मृतास्ते पंचसाहस्रा योगसिंहशरार्दिताः ॥
बौद्धसिंहस्तदा शूरो दृष्ट्वा तस्य पराक्रमम् ॥
कृत्वा लोहमयं सिंहं योगसिंहमपेषयत् ॥43॥
3.3.m: Five thousand of them died, afflicted by Yogasiṃha's arrows. / Then the valiant Bauddhasiṃha, seeing his prowess, / made an iron lion and hurled it at Yogasiṃha.

3.3.s:
pātena tasya siṃhasya sa vīro maraṇaṃ gataḥ ..
tadā tu bhogasiṃhaśca hayārūḍho jagāma ha ..
svabhallena ca taṃ siṃhaṃ hatvā tatra jagarja vai .. 44 ..
3.3.d:
पातेन तस्य सिंहस्य स वीरो मरणं गतः ॥
तदा तु भोगसिंहश्च हयारूढो जगाम ह ॥
स्वभल्लेन च तं सिंहं हत्वा तत्र जगर्ज वै ॥ 44 ॥
3.3.m: By the fall of that lion, that hero met his death. / But then Bhogasiṃha, mounted on a horse, advanced; / slaying that lion with his spear, he roared there.

3.3.s:
tadā tu bauddhasiṃhena śārdūlastatra coditaḥ ..
sahayo bhogasiṃhaśca tenaiva maraṇaṃ gataḥ .. 45 ..
3.3.d:
तदा तु बौद्धसिंहेन शार्दूलस्तत्र चोदितः ॥
सहयो भोगसिंहश्च तेनैव मरणं गतः ॥ 45 ॥
3.3.m: Then Bauddhasiṃha impelled a tiger there; / and Bhogasiṃha, along with his horse, was killed by that very [beast].

3.3.s:
mātulau mṛtyuvaśagau dṛṣṭvā svarṇavatīsutaḥ ..
karālaṃ hayamā ruhya bauddhasiṃhamupāyayau .. 46 ..
3.3.d:
मातुलौ मृत्युवशगौ दृष्ट्वा स्वर्णवतीसुतः ॥
करालं हयमा रुह्य बौद्धसिंहमुपाययौ ॥ 46 ॥
3.3.m: Seeing his maternal uncles fallen under the power of death, the son of Svarṇavatī / mounted a terrible horse and approached Bauddhasiṃha.

3.3.s:
śaramādāya vai śīghraṃ nāmnā saṃmohanaṃ śubham ..
mohayitvā ripubalaṃ bauddhasiṃhasamanvitam .. 47 ..
3.3.d:
शरमादाय वै शीघ्रं नाम्ना संमोहनं शुभम् ॥
मोहयित्वा रिपुबलं बौद्धसिंहसमन्वितम् ॥ 47 ॥
3.3.m: Swiftly taking up an arrow named auspicious Saṃmohana, / having bewildered the enemy army along with Bauddhasiṃha,

3.3.s:
baddhvā tānbauddhasiṃhādīnnṛpāndaśasahasrakam ..
kalayaṃtraṃ ca saṃcūrṇya kṛṣṇāṃ śāṃtikamāyayau .. 48 ..
3.3.d:
बद्ध्वा तान्बौद्धसिंहादीन्नृपान्दशसहस्रकम् ॥
कलयंत्रं च संचूर्ण्य कृष्णां शांतिकमाययौ ॥ 48 ॥
3.3.m: binding those ten thousand kings headed by Bauddhasiṃha / and crushing their mechanical contrivance, he returned near to Kṛṣṇā.

3.3.s:
tadā te harṣitāssarve prapeṣya nagaraṃ yayuḥ ..
tadveśma yojanāyāmaṃ sarvasaṃpatsamanvitam ..
luṇṭhayitvā balātsarve nṛpadurgamupāyayuḥ .. 49 ..
3.3.d:
तदा ते हर्षितास्सर्वे प्रपेष्य नगरं ययुः ॥
तद्वेश्म योजनायामं सर्वसंपत्समन्वितम् ॥
लुण्ठयित्वा बलात्सर्वे नृपदुर्गमुपाययुः ॥ 49 ॥
3.3.m: Then, rejoicing, they all sent [the prisoners ahead] and marched to the city. / Having forcibly plundered that palace, a yojana in extent and endowed with all wealth, / they all went to the king's fortress.

3.3.s:
bauddhasiṃhastadāgatya jayantena vimocitaḥ ..
sutāṃ svāṃ padmajāṃ nāmnā jayantāya dadau mudā .. 3.3.29.50 ..
3.3.d:
बौद्धसिंहस्तदागत्य जयन्तेन विमोचितः ॥
सुतां स्वां पद्मजां नाम्ना जयन्ताय ददौ मुदा ॥ 3.3.29.50 ॥
3.3.m: Then Bauddhasiṃha, having come, was released by Jayanta; / and with joy he gave his daughter named Padmajā to Jayanta,

3.3.s:
daśakoṭīḥ suvarṇasya cāhlādāya tadā dhanam..
sarvaiśca bauddhavṛndaiśca tatraiva śapathaḥ kṛtaḥ .. 51 ..
3.3.d:
दशकोटीः सुवर्णस्य चाह्लादाय तदा धनम्॥
सर्वैश्च बौद्धवृन्दैश्च तत्रैव शपथः कृतः ॥ 51 ॥
3.3.m: and then wealth of one hundred million gold [pieces] to Āhlāda. / And an oath was taken right there by all the hosts of Buddhists:

3.3.s:
āryadeśaṃ na yāsyāmaḥ kadācidrāṣṭrahetave ..
ityuktvā tānpraṇamyāśu saṃprasthānamakārayan ..
trilakṣaiśca yutāste vai netrapālagṛhaṃ gatāḥ .. 52 ..
3.3.d:
आर्यदेशं न यास्यामः कदाचिद्राष्ट्रहेतवे ॥
इत्युक्त्वा तान्प्रणम्याशु संप्रस्थानमकारयन् ॥
त्रिलक्षैश्च युतास्ते वै नेत्रपालगृहं गताः ॥ 52 ॥
3.3.m: "We shall never go to the Aryan land for the sake of kingdom." / Having spoken thus and quickly bowed to them, they had them depart; / and accompanied by three hundred thousand [men], they went to Netrapāla's house.

3.3.s:
.. ṛṣayaḥ ūcuḥ .. ..
indulena kathaṃ sūta tatra prāṇīkṛtā na hi ..
supriyā yogasiṃhādyāstanno vada vicakṣaṇa .. 53 ..
3.3.d:
॥ ऋषयः ऊचुः ॥ ॥
इन्दुलेन कथं सूत तत्र प्राणीकृता न हि ॥
सुप्रिया योगसिंहाद्यास्तन्नो वद विचक्षण ॥ 53 ॥
3.3.m: The sages said: / Why, O Sūta, were their dear [comrades] Yogasiṃha and the rest not restored to life there / by Indula? Tell us that, O wise one!

3.3.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
āgatā yamalokādvai katicitprāṇino bhuvi ..
tadā tu duḥkhito devo maheṃdrāntamupāyayau .. 54 ..
3.3.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
आगता यमलोकाद्वै कतिचित्प्राणिनो भुवि ॥
तदा तु दुःखितो देवो महेंद्रान्तमुपाययौ ॥ 54 ॥
3.3.m: Sūta said: / When certain living beings had returned to earth from the realm of Yama, / then that god [Yama], grieving, went before Mahendra:

3.3.s:
devarāja namastubhyaṃ sarvadevapriyaṃkara ..
jayaṃto jagatīṃ prāpya mṛtāñjīvayati svayam ..
ato vai lokamaryādā viruddhā dṛśyate bhuvi .. 55 ..
3.3.d:
देवराज नमस्तुभ्यं सर्वदेवप्रियंकर ॥
जयंतो जगतीं प्राप्य मृताञ्जीवयति स्वयम् ॥
अतो वै लोकमर्यादा विरुद्धा दृश्यते भुवि ॥ 55 ॥
3.3.m: "O king of gods, homage to you, doer of what is pleasing to all gods! / Jayanta, having reached the earth, revives the dead himself; / therefore the established order of the world appears violated on earth."

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā tu vacanaṃ mahendro devamāyayā ..
vaḍavāmṛtamāhṛtya tathā vai svargagāṃ gatim ..
jayaṃtasya svaputrasya mumoda sa suraiḥ saha .. 56 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा तु वचनं महेन्द्रो देवमायया ॥
वडवामृतमाहृत्य तथा वै स्वर्गगां गतिम् ॥
जयंतस्य स्वपुत्रस्य मुमोद स सुरैः सह ॥ 56 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing this speech, Mahendra, by divine power, / took away the amṛta of the submarine mare as well as the power to ascend to heaven / from his son Jayanta, and rejoiced with the gods.

3.3.s:
indulaśca tadā duḥkhī śāradāṃ sarvamaṃgalām ..
pūjayitvā vidhānena yogadhyāna paro'bhavat .. 57 ..
3.3.d:
इन्दुलश्च तदा दुःखी शारदां सर्वमंगलाम् ॥
पूजयित्वा विधानेन योगध्यान परोऽभवत् ॥ 57 ॥
3.3.m: And Indula, grieving then, worshipped all-auspicious Śāradā / according to rule, and devoted himself to yogic meditation.

3.3.s:
iti te kathitaṃ vipra punaḥ śṛṇu kathāṃ śubhām ..
netrapālaśca balavānbahuputraḥ śucānvitaḥ ..
daśakoṭimitaṃ svarṇaṃ tebhyo dattvā samaṃ samam .. 58 ..
3.3.d:
इति ते कथितं विप्र पुनः शृणु कथां शुभाम् ॥
नेत्रपालश्च बलवान्बहुपुत्रः शुचान्वितः ॥
दशकोटिमितं स्वर्णं तेभ्यो दत्त्वा समं समम् ॥ 58 ॥
3.3.m: Thus has this been told to you, O brāhmaṇa; listen again to the auspicious tale. / Mighty Netrapāla, who had many sons and was filled with sorrow, / gave gold measuring one hundred million equally to them,

3.3.s:
prasthānaṃ kārayāmāsa cāṣṭānāṃ balaśālinām ..
te vai dvilakṣasainyāḍhyāḥ svagehāya yayurmudā .. 59 .. ..
3.3.d:
प्रस्थानं कारयामास चाष्टानां बलशालिनाम् ॥
ते वै द्विलक्षसैन्याढ्याः स्वगेहाय ययुर्मुदा ॥ 59 ॥ ॥
3.3.m: and sent forth the eight mighty warriors. / Abundantly accompanied by an army of two hundred thousand, they went joyfully to their own home.

3.3.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
yadā te cīnadeśasthāstadāhūto nṛpeṇa vai ..
kāmapālena bho vipra lakṣaṇo nakulāṃśakaḥ .. 1 ..
3.3.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
यदा ते चीनदेशस्थास्तदाहूतो नृपेण वै ॥
कामपालेन भो विप्र लक्षणो नकुलांशकः ॥ 1 ॥
3.3.m: Sūta said: / When they were in the country of China, then Lakṣaṇa, a portion of Nakula, / was summoned, O brāhmaṇa, by King Kāmapāla:

3.3.s:
jayacaṃdra mahābhāga sāvadhānaṃ vacaḥ śṛṇu ..
vaiśākhaśukla saptamyāṃ muhūrto'yaṃ dināgame .. 2 ..
3.3.d:
जयचंद्र महाभाग सावधानं वचः शृणु ॥
वैशाखशुक्ल सप्तम्यां मुहूर्तोऽयं दिनागमे ॥ 2 ॥
3.3.m: "O highly fortunate Jayacandra, listen attentively to my word: / On the seventh day of the bright fortnight of Vaiśākha is the auspicious time at daybreak.

3.3.s:
ato vai lakṣaṇo vīraścaikākī māṃ samāpnuyāt ..
gṛhītvā matsutāṃ dolāṃ gamiṣyati tavāṃtikam .. 3 ..
3.3.d:
अतो वै लक्षणो वीरश्चैकाकी मां समाप्नुयात् ॥
गृहीत्वा मत्सुतां दोलां गमिष्यति तवांतिकम् ॥ 3 ॥
3.3.m: Therefore let the heroic Lakṣaṇa come to me alone; / taking my daughter and her litter, he will go to you.

3.3.s:
senānvitaṃ ca taṃ jñātvā mahīrājo mahābalaḥ ..
grahīṣyati parājitya tasmādyogyaṃ vaco mama .. 4 ..
3.3.d:
सेनान्वितं च तं ज्ञात्वा महीराजो महाबलः ॥
ग्रहीष्यति पराजित्य तस्माद्योग्यं वचो मम ॥ 4 ॥
3.3.m: And knowing him to be accompanied by an army, the mighty Mahīrāja / would defeat him and seize [her]; therefore my word is fitting."

3.3.s:
iti tatratyavacanaṃ matvā rājā prasannadhīḥ ..
lakṣaṇaṃ hastinīsaṃsthaṃ śataśūrasamanvitam .. 5 ..
3.3.d:
इति तत्रत्यवचनं मत्वा राजा प्रसन्नधीः ॥
लक्षणं हस्तिनीसंस्थं शतशूरसमन्वितम् ॥ 5 ॥
3.3.m: Thinking thus upon the word [received] from there, the king, pleased in mind, / summoned Lakṣaṇa, who was mounted on a female elephant and accompanied by a hundred heroes,

3.3.s:
āhūya preṣayāmāsa kāmapālāya dhīmate ..
mārge paṃcadinaṃ vīra uṣitvā tadgṛhaṃ yayau .. 6 ..
3.3.d:
आहूय प्रेषयामास कामपालाय धीमते ॥
मार्गे पंचदिनं वीर उषित्वा तद्गृहं ययौ ॥ 6 ॥
3.3.m: and sent him to wise Kāmapāla. / Having stayed five days on the road, the hero went to his house.

3.3.s:
tadā padmākaraḥ śyālo jñātvā lakṣaṇamāgatam ..
bhūmirājaṃ samāhūya tena yuddhamacīkarat .. 7 ..
3.3.d:
तदा पद्माकरः श्यालो ज्ञात्वा लक्षणमागतम् ॥
भूमिराजं समाहूय तेन युद्धमचीकरत् ॥ 7 ॥
3.3.m: Then his brother-in-law Padmākara, knowing that Lakṣaṇa had arrived, / summoned Bhūmirāja and caused a battle with him.

3.3.s:
lakṣaṇo nakulāṃśaśca dṛṣṭvā śatrumupasthitam ..
svaśaraistarpayāmāsa rājarājaṃ mahābalam .. 8 ..
3.3.d:
लक्षणो नकुलांशश्च दृष्ट्वा शत्रुमुपस्थितम् ॥
स्वशरैस्तर्पयामास राजराजं महाबलम् ॥ 8 ॥
3.3.m: And Lakṣaṇa, a portion of Nakula, seeing the enemy arrived, / gratified that mighty king of kings with his arrows.

3.3.s:
mūrcchayitvā mahīrājaṃ hatvā paṃcaśataṃ balī ..
kāmapālaṃ samāgamya natvā vāsamakārayat .. 9 ..
3.3.d:
मूर्च्छयित्वा महीराजं हत्वा पंचशतं बली ॥
कामपालं समागम्य नत्वा वासमकारयत् ॥ 9 ॥
3.3.m: Having rendered Mahīrāja unconscious and slain five hundred [men], the strong one / went to Kāmapāla, bowed, and took up residence.

3.3.s:
utthitaśca mahīrājo gatvā padmākaraṃ prati ..
vacanaṃ prāha kāryārthī śṛṇu mitra vaco mama .. 3.3.30.10 ..
3.3.d:
उत्थितश्च महीराजो गत्वा पद्माकरं प्रति ॥
वचनं प्राह कार्यार्थी शृणु मित्र वचो मम ॥ 3.3.30.10 ॥
3.3.m: And Mahīrāja, having arisen, went to Padmākara / and, seeking his purpose, spoke these words: "Listen, friend, to my word:

3.3.s:
lakṣaṇo me mahāñchatrussa ca tvadgehamāgataḥ ..
yadi dāsyasi taṃ baddhvā tvāṃ madaṃgaṃ karomyaham .. 11 ..
3.3.d:
लक्षणो मे महाञ्छत्रुस्स च त्वद्गेहमागतः ॥
यदि दास्यसि तं बद्ध्वा त्वां मदंगं करोम्यहम् ॥ 11 ॥
3.3.m: Lakṣaṇa is my great enemy, and he has come to your house. / If you give him up bound, I will make you my own ally."

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā sa lobhātmā dattvā hālāhalaṃ viṣam ..
baddhvā taṃ lakṣaṇaṃ vīraṃ mahīrājāya cārpayat ..
hatvā tāñchataśūrāṃśca guptavārtāmakārayan .. 12 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा स लोभात्मा दत्त्वा हालाहलं विषम् ॥
बद्ध्वा तं लक्षणं वीरं महीराजाय चार्पयत् ॥
हत्वा ताञ्छतशूरांश्च गुप्तवार्तामकारयन् ॥ 12 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing this, that greedy-minded one administered hālāhala poison, / bound that heroic Lakṣaṇa, and delivered him to Mahīrāja; / and having slain those hundred heroes, they kept the news secret.

3.3.s:
jñātvā tatpadminī nārī duḥkhitālapya vai bhṛśam ..
caṃḍikāṃ pūjayāmāsa patimaṃgalahetave .. 13 ..
3.3.d:
ज्ञात्वा तत्पद्मिनी नारी दुःखितालप्य वै भृशम् ॥
चंडिकां पूजयामास पतिमंगलहेतवे ॥ 13 ॥
3.3.m: Knowing that, the woman Padminī, deeply distressed and lamenting, / worshipped Caṇḍikā for the auspicious welfare of her husband.

3.3.s:
tadā prasannā sā devī varadā sarvamaṃgalā ..
āśvāsya padminīṃ nārīṃ lakṣaṇāṃtamupāyayau .. 14 ..
3.3.d:
तदा प्रसन्ना सा देवी वरदा सर्वमंगला ॥
आश्वास्य पद्मिनीं नारीं लक्षणांतमुपाययौ ॥ 14 ॥
3.3.m: Then that gracious goddess, boon-giving and all-auspicious, / having consoled the woman Padminī, approached Lakṣaṇa.

3.3.s:
svapne tamāha sā devī hrīṃ phaṭ gheghe japaṃ kuru ..
asya maṃtraprabhāvācca sarvavighnaḥ praṇaśyati .. 15 ..
3.3.d:
स्वप्ने तमाह सा देवी ह्रीं फट् घेघे जपं कुरु ॥
अस्य मंत्रप्रभावाच्च सर्वविघ्नः प्रणश्यति ॥ 15 ॥
3.3.m: In a dream that goddess said to him: "Repeat the mantra 'hrīṃ phaṭ gheghe'! / By the power of this mantra, every obstacle is destroyed."

3.3.s:
sa buddhvā lakṣaṇo vīrastaṃ maṃtraṃ ca jajāpa ha ..
āṣāḍhe māsi saṃprāpte kṛṣṇāṃśādyā gṛhaṃ yayuḥ .. 16 ..
3.3.d:
स बुद्ध्वा लक्षणो वीरस्तं मंत्रं च जजाप ह ॥
आषाढे मासि संप्राप्ते कृष्णांशाद्या गृहं ययुः ॥ 16 ॥
3.3.m: Awakening, that heroic Lakṣaṇa repeated that mantra. / When the month of Āṣāḍha arrived, those led by the portion of Kṛṣṇa went home.

3.3.s:
tālanaśca yutastābhyāṃ kalyakubjamupāyayau ..
na dṛṣṭo lakṣaṇo vīro jayacaṃdrapriyaṃkaraḥ ..
jñātvā tatkāraṇaṃ taiśca kṛtaṃ yogamayaṃ vapuḥ .. 17 ..
3.3.d:
तालनश्च युतस्ताभ्यां कल्यकुब्जमुपाययौ ॥
न दृष्टो लक्षणो वीरो जयचंद्रप्रियंकरः ॥
ज्ञात्वा तत्कारणं तैश्च कृतं योगमयं वपुः ॥ 17 ॥
3.3.m: And Tālana, accompanied by the two of them, arrived at Kalyakubja; / the heroic Lakṣaṇa, dear to Jayacandra, was not seen. / Learning the cause of that, they assumed the guise of yogins.

3.3.s:
dhānyapālaḥ kāṃsyadhārī vīṇādhārī ca tālanaḥ ..
lallasiṃho mṛdaṃgāṃko yayuste vai mahāvatīm .. 18 ..
3.3.d:
धान्यपालः कांस्यधारी वीणाधारी च तालनः ॥
लल्लसिंहो मृदंगांको ययुस्ते वै महावतीम् ॥ 18 ॥
3.3.m: Dhānyapāla holding bronze cymbals, Tālana holding a vīṇā, / and Lallasiṃha marked with a mṛdaṅga drum went to Mahāvatī.

3.3.s:
sabhāṃ parimalasyaiva gatvā te yogarūpiṇaḥ ..
cakrurgānaṃ mudā yuktāḥ sarve te mohamāgatāḥ .. 19 ..
3.3.d:
सभां परिमलस्यैव गत्वा ते योगरूपिणः ॥
चक्रुर्गानं मुदा युक्ताः सर्वे ते मोहमागताः ॥ 19 ॥
3.3.m: Having gone to the assembly of Parimala, those disguised as yogins / sang with joy, and all those [present] were enchanted.

3.3.s:
prasannaśca tadā rājā muktāmālāṃ svakaṇṭhagām ..
tālanāya dadau prītyā tābhyāṃ svarṇāṃgulīyake .. 3.3.30.20 ..
3.3.d:
प्रसन्नश्च तदा राजा मुक्तामालां स्वकण्ठगाम् ॥
तालनाय ददौ प्रीत्या ताभ्यां स्वर्णांगुलीयके ॥ 3.3.30.20 ॥
3.3.m: Pleased, the king then lovingly gave the pearl necklace from his own neck / to Tālana, and two gold rings to the other two.

3.3.s:
tadā te harṣitāḥ sarve kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ prati cāyayuḥ ..
jñātvā kṛṣṇāṃśa evāpi dhṛtvā yogamayaṃ vapuḥ ..
yayau biṃdugaḍhaṃ vīrastālanādyaissamanvitaḥ .. 21 ..
3.3.d:
तदा ते हर्षिताः सर्वे कृष्णांशं प्रति चाययुः ॥
ज्ञात्वा कृष्णांश एवापि धृत्वा योगमयं वपुः ॥
ययौ बिंदुगढं वीरस्तालनाद्यैस्समन्वितः ॥ 21 ॥
3.3.m: Then, rejoicing, all of them came to Kṛṣṇāṃśa. / Having learned [of this], Kṛṣṇāṃśa too assumed an ascetic's form; / the hero went to Bindugaḍha accompanied by Tālana and the others.

3.3.s:
haṭṭamadhye samāgamya kṛtvā rāsotsavaṃ śubham ..
gehaṃ padmākarasyaiva gatvā te nanṛturmudā .. .. 22 ..
3.3.d:
हट्टमध्ये समागम्य कृत्वा रासोत्सवं शुभम् ॥
गेहं पद्माकरस्यैव गत्वा ते ननृतुर्मुदा ॥ ॥ 22 ॥
3.3.m: Arriving in the middle of the market, performing an auspicious rāsa-dance festival, / they went to the house of Padmākara and danced joyfully.

3.3.s:
etasminnaṃtare sarvā yoṣitastatra cāgatāḥ ..
veṇuvādyavṛtaṃvīraṃ kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ dadṛśurmuhuḥ ..
mohitāstasya gānena jaḍībhūtā dhanaṃ daduḥ .. .. 23 ..
3.3.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे सर्वा योषितस्तत्र चागताः ॥
वेणुवाद्यवृतंवीरं कृष्णांशं ददृशुर्मुहुः ॥
मोहितास्तस्य गानेन जडीभूता धनं ददुः ॥ ॥ 23 ॥
3.3.m: Meanwhile, all the women came there; / they repeatedly gazed upon the hero Kṛṣṇāṃśa, surrounded by the music of flutes. / Charmed by his singing, rendered motionless, they gave him wealth.

3.3.s:
tadā tu padminī nārī sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutā ..
jñātvā kṛṣṇāṃśamevāpi ruroda ciramāturā .. 24 ..
3.3.d:
तदा तु पद्मिनी नारी सर्वलक्षणसंयुता ॥
ज्ञात्वा कृष्णांशमेवापि रुरोद चिरमातुरा ॥ 24 ॥
3.3.m: Then the Padminī woman, endowed with all auspicious marks, / recognizing Kṛṣṇāṃśa himself, wept for a long time, distressed.

3.3.s:
uvāca ca vilapyāśu matpatirla kṣaṇo balī ..
mahīrājena śūreṇa kārāgāre balātkṛtaḥ ..
ahaṃ yoṣā bhavānyogī kathaṃ kāryaṃ bhaviṣyati .. 25 ..
3.3.d:
उवाच च विलप्याशु मत्पतिर्ल क्षणो बली ॥
महीराजेन शूरेण कारागारे बलात्कृतः ॥
अहं योषा भवान्योगी कथं कार्यं भविष्यति ॥ 25 ॥
3.3.m: And weeping, she quickly said: "My strong husband, Lakṣaṇa, / has been forcibly put into prison by the valiant Mahīrāja. / I am a woman, you are an ascetic; how will the deed be accomplished?"

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā tu sa nṛpo bhujamutthāpya satvaram ..
āśvāsya padminīṃ nārīṃ yayuste dehalīṃ prati ..
rājadvāramupāgamya kṛṣṇāṃśassa nanarta ha .. 26 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा तु स नृपो भुजमुत्थाप्य सत्वरम् ॥
आश्वास्य पद्मिनीं नारीं ययुस्ते देहलीं प्रति ॥
राजद्वारमुपागम्य कृष्णांशस्स ननर्त ह ॥ 26 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing this, that king swiftly raised his arm, / comforted the Padminī woman, and they set out toward Delhi. / Approaching the royal gate, Kṛṣṇāṃśa danced indeed.

3.3.s:
mahīrājastu balavānprasannastasyalīlayā ..
vāṃchitaṃ brūhi kṛṣṇāṃśa sarvaṃ yogindadāmyaham .. 27 ..
3.3.d:
महीराजस्तु बलवान्प्रसन्नस्तस्यलीलया ॥
वांछितं ब्रूहि कृष्णांश सर्वं योगिन्ददाम्यहम् ॥ 27 ॥
3.3.m: Mighty Mahīrāja, pleased by his playful sport, [said]: / "State what you desire, Kṛṣṇāṃśa, O ascetic; I will give everything."

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā bhūpavaco vihasyovāca taṃ prati..
kārāgāraṃ lohamayaṃ nṛpayogyaṃ ca me nṛpa ..
darśayāśu svakīyaṃ vai bhavānbhūpaśiromaṇiḥ .. 28 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा भूपवचो विहस्योवाच तं प्रति॥
कारागारं लोहमयं नृपयोग्यं च मे नृप ॥
दर्शयाशु स्वकीयं वै भवान्भूपशिरोमणिः ॥ 28 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing the king's words, he laughed and said to him: / "O king, quickly show me your own iron prison, / which is fit for kings; for you are the crest-jewel of kings."

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā sa nṛpatirmohitaḥ kṛṣṇalīlayā ..
darśayitvā ca vai śīpraṃ punastebhyo dadau dhanam .. 29 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा स नृपतिर्मोहितः कृष्णलीलया ॥
दर्शयित्वा च वै शीप्रं पुनस्तेभ्यो ददौ धनम् ॥ 29 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing this, the king, enchanted by the sport of Kṛṣṇa, / quickly showed it, and then gave them wealth again.

3.3.s:
tataste yoginassarve saṃprāpya ca mahāvatīm ..
natvā parimalaṃ bhūpaṃ gaditvā sarvakāraṇam .. .. 3.3.30.30 ..
3.3.d:
ततस्ते योगिनस्सर्वे संप्राप्य च महावतीम् ॥
नत्वा परिमलं भूपं गदित्वा सर्वकारणम् ॥ ॥ 3.3.30.30 ॥
3.3.m: Then all those ascetics, reaching Mahāvatī, / bowed to King Parimala and told the whole matter.

3.3.s:
svasenāṃ sajjayāmāsa cāhlādaśca nṛpājñayā ..
pañcalakṣaṃ mahāvatyā hayārūḍhāssamāsthitāḥ .. 31 ..
3.3.d:
स्वसेनां सज्जयामास चाह्लादश्च नृपाज्ञया ॥
पञ्चलक्षं महावत्या हयारूढास्समास्थिताः ॥ 31 ॥
3.3.m: And by the king's command, Āhlāda readied his army; / five hundred thousand, mounted on horses, stood ready in Mahāvatī.

3.3.s:
tālanassapta lakṣāṇi sainyānyāhūya cāgataḥ ..
evaṃ dvādaśalakṣāṇi kṣatriyā raṇadurmadāḥ ..
dehalīṃ ca samājagmussarvaśastrasamanvitāḥ .. 32 ..
3.3.d:
तालनस्सप्त लक्षाणि सैन्यान्याहूय चागतः ॥
एवं द्वादशलक्षाणि क्षत्रिया रणदुर्मदाः ॥
देहलीं च समाजग्मुस्सर्वशस्त्रसमन्विताः ॥ 32 ॥
3.3.m: Tālana summoned seven hundred thousand troops and arrived; / thus twelve hundred thousand Kṣatriyas, furious in battle, / equipped with all weapons, marched on Delhi.

3.3.s:
etasminnaṃtare mantrī cadrabhaṭṭo viśāradaḥ ..
sarvaśāstrārthakuśalo vaiṣṇavīśaktipūjakaḥ ..33..
3.3.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे मन्त्री चद्रभट्टो विशारदः ॥
सर्वशास्त्रार्थकुशलो वैष्णवीशक्तिपूजकः ॥33॥
3.3.m: Meanwhile, the wise minister Cadrabhaṭṭa, / skilled in the meaning of all śāstras and a worshipper of the Vaiṣṇava Śakti,

3.3.s:
mahīrājaṃ samāgamya vacaḥ prāha śṛṇuṣva bhoḥ ..
mayā vai ca rahaḥ krīḍā dṛṣṭā devīprasādataḥ ..34..
3.3.d:
महीराजं समागम्य वचः प्राह शृणुष्व भोः ॥
मया वै च रहः क्रीडा दृष्टा देवीप्रसादतः ॥34॥
3.3.m: approached Mahīrāja and spoke these words: "Listen, sire! / By the grace of the Devī, I have witnessed a secret sport.

3.3.s:
tatrodayaśca kṛṣṇāṃśaḥ pūrṇabrahmāṇamāgamat ..
vacaḥ prāha prasannātmā śṛṇu tvaṃ sattvavigraha .. 35 ..
3.3.d:
तत्रोदयश्च कृष्णांशः पूर्णब्रह्माणमागमत् ॥
वचः प्राह प्रसन्नात्मा शृणु त्वं सत्त्वविग्रह ॥ 35 ॥
3.3.m: There Udaya, an incarnation of Kṛṣṇa, came to the supreme Brahman; / pleased at heart, he spoke these words: 'Listen, you who are goodness incarnate!

3.3.s:
agnivaṃśavināśāya cādya yāsyāmi dehalīm ..
hatvāhaṃ kauravāṃśāṃśca sthāpayitvā kaliṃ bhuvi .. 36 ..
3.3.d:
अग्निवंशविनाशाय चाद्य यास्यामि देहलीम् ॥
हत्वाहं कौरवांशांश्च स्थापयित्वा कलिं भुवि ॥ 36 ॥
3.3.m: Today I will go to Delhi for the destruction of the fire-lineage; / having slain the portions of the Kauravas and established the Kali [age] on earth,

3.3.s:
punastavāntikaṃ prāpya rahaḥ krīḍāṃ karomyaham ..
ityuktvā biṃdulārūḍhaḥ sa vīrastvāmupa sthitaḥ ..
ityahaṃ dṛṣṭavānbhūpa kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ yoganidrayā .. 37 ..
3.3.d:
पुनस्तवान्तिकं प्राप्य रहः क्रीडां करोम्यहम् ॥
इत्युक्त्वा बिंदुलारूढः स वीरस्त्वामुप स्थितः ॥
इत्यहं दृष्टवान्भूप कृष्णांशं योगनिद्रया ॥ 37 ॥
3.3.m: I will return to your presence and carry out my secret sport.' / Having said this, the hero, mounted on Bindulā, approached you; / thus, O king, did I perceive Kṛṣṇāṃśa through yogic sleep."

3.3.s:
iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā sa bhūpo vismayānvitaḥ ..
bhayabhītaḥ sahasrāṇi śūrānāhūya satvaram ..
tebhyaśca lakṣaṇaṃ dattvā vacanaṃ prāha tānprati .. 38 ..
3.3.d:
इति तस्य वचः श्रुत्वा स भूपो विस्मयान्वितः ॥
भयभीतः सहस्राणि शूरानाहूय सत्वरम् ॥
तेभ्यश्च लक्षणं दत्त्वा वचनं प्राह तान्प्रति ॥ 38 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing his words, that king was filled with amazement; / terrified with fear, he quickly summoned thousands of heroes, / handed Lakṣaṇa over to them, and spoke these words to them:

3.3.s:
padmākarāya bhūpāya gatvā dattvāśu lakṣaṇam ..
mamāntikamupāgamya kāraṇaṃ vadatāśu tat .. 39 ..
3.3.d:
पद्माकराय भूपाय गत्वा दत्त्वाशु लक्षणम् ॥
ममान्तिकमुपागम्य कारणं वदताशु तत् ॥ 39 ॥
3.3.m: "Go quickly, hand Lakṣaṇa over to King Padmākara, / and coming back to my presence, quickly tell me the reason [for this]."

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā tu te sarve vahnivaṃśyā mahābalāḥ ..
gatvā tatra tathā kṛtvā mahīrājamupāgaman .. 3.3.30.40 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा तु ते सर्वे वह्निवंश्या महाबलाः ॥
गत्वा तत्र तथा कृत्वा महीराजमुपागमन् ॥ 3.3.30.40 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing this, all those mighty [heroes] born of the fire-lineage / went there, acted accordingly, and returned to Mahīrāja.

3.3.s:
bhagadaṃtaśca teṣāṃ tu sahasrāṇāṃ ca nāyakaḥ..
mahīrājaṃ vacaḥ prāha śṛṇu tannṛpabhāṣitam ..41..
3.3.d:
भगदंतश्च तेषां तु सहस्राणां च नायकः॥
महीराजं वचः प्राह शृणु तन्नृपभाषितम् ॥41॥
3.3.m: And Bhagadanta, the leader of those thousands, / spoke these words to Mahīrāja; listen to what was said to the king:

3.3.s:
padminī me svasā rājan guptavidyāviśāradā ..
tayā yajñapatirdevaḥ samyagārādhitaḥ purā .. 42 ..
3.3.d:
पद्मिनी मे स्वसा राजन् गुप्तविद्याविशारदा ॥
तया यज्ञपतिर्देवः सम्यगाराधितः पुरा ॥ 42 ॥
3.3.m: "Padminī is my sister, O king, skilled in occult lore; / formerly, she thoroughly worshipped the Lord of Sacrifice, the god.

3.3.s:
dattastena varo ramyo hyantardhānamayaḥ paraḥ ..
sā tu taṃ lakṣaṇaṃ kāṃtamaṃtardhānaṃ kariṣyati ..
iti śrutvā sa nṛpatiḥ paramānandamāptavān .. 43 ..
3.3.d:
दत्तस्तेन वरो रम्यो ह्यन्तर्धानमयः परः ॥
सा तु तं लक्षणं कांतमंतर्धानं करिष्यति ॥
इति श्रुत्वा स नृपतिः परमानन्दमाप्तवान् ॥ 43 ॥
3.3.m: A delightful boon was granted by him, a supreme [boon] of invisibility; / she will make her beloved Lakṣaṇa disappear." / Hearing this, that king attained supreme joy.

3.3.s:
etasminnaṃtare prāptāḥ kṛṣṇāṃśādyā mahābalāḥ ..
rurudhurdehalīṃ sarvāṃ mahīrājena pālitām .. 44 ..
3.3.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे प्राप्ताः कृष्णांशाद्या महाबलाः ॥
रुरुधुर्देहलीं सर्वां महीराजेन पालिताम् ॥ 44 ॥
3.3.m: Meanwhile, the mighty Kṛṣṇāṃśa and others arrived / and besieged all of Delhi, which was ruled by Mahīrāja.

3.3.s:
sa tadā pṛthivīrājo gṛhītvā bahubhūṣaṇam ..
sarvebhyaśca dadau premṇā vacanaṃ prāha namradhīḥ .. 45 ..
3.3.d:
स तदा पृथिवीराजो गृहीत्वा बहुभूषणम् ॥
सर्वेभ्यश्च ददौ प्रेम्णा वचनं प्राह नम्रधीः ॥ 45 ॥
3.3.m: Then Pṛthivīrāja, taking many ornaments, / gave them affectionately to all, and spoke these words with a humble mind:

3.3.s:
lakṣaṇo nāma te rājā kārāgāre na vai mama ..
yadi mannagare cāsti tarhi te roṣa īdṛśaḥ .. 46 ..
3.3.d:
लक्षणो नाम ते राजा कारागारे न वै मम ॥
यदि मन्नगरे चास्ति तर्हि ते रोष ईदृशः ॥ 46 ॥
3.3.m: "The king named Lakṣaṇa is indeed not in my prison; / why [then] is there such anger in you if he is [not] in my city?"

3.3.s:
ityuktvā taṃ ca kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ darśayāmāsa vai gṛham. ..
mahādevasya śapathaṃ kṛtavānbhūpatirbhayāt .. 47 ..
3.3.d:
इत्युक्त्वा तं च कृष्णांशं दर्शयामास वै गृहम्॥।
महादेवस्य शपथं कृतवान्भूपतिर्भयात् ॥ 47 ॥
3.3.m: Having said this, he showed that house to Kṛṣṇāṃśa; / the king swore an oath by Mahādeva out of fear.

3.3.s:
tadodayo bhūpavacaḥ satyaṃ matvā suduḥkhitaḥ ..
svakīyaiḥ saha saṃprāpto grāmaṃ biṃdugaḍhaṃ śubham .. 48.
3.3.d:
तदोदयो भूपवचः सत्यं मत्वा सुदुःखितः ॥
स्वकीयैः सह संप्राप्तो ग्रामं बिंदुगढं शुभम् ॥ 48.
3.3.m: Believing the king's words to be true, Udaya, very sorrowful, / returned together with his men to the fair village of Bindugaḍha.

3.3.s:
kāmapālastu tacchrutvā kṛṣṇāṃśāgamanaṃ balī ..
baliṃ bahuṃ gṛhītvāśu kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayau ..
prāṃjaliḥ praṇato bhūtvā vacanaṃ prāha bhīrukaḥ .. 49 ..
3.3.d:
कामपालस्तु तच्छ्रुत्वा कृष्णांशागमनं बली ॥
बलिं बहुं गृहीत्वाशु कृष्णांशं शरणं ययौ ॥
प्रांजलिः प्रणतो भूत्वा वचनं प्राह भीरुकः ॥ 49 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing of Kṛṣṇāṃśa's arrival, the strong Kāmapāla / quickly took many offerings and sought refuge with Kṛṣṇāṃśa; / terrified, folding his hands and bowing low, he spoke these words:

3.3.s:
sutā me padminī nārī lakṣaṇena samanvitā ..
na jñātvā kva gatā'smābhissatyaṃ satyaṃ bravīmyaham ..3.3.30.50..
3.3.d:
सुता मे पद्मिनी नारी लक्षणेन समन्विता ॥
न ज्ञात्वा क्व गताऽस्माभिस्सत्यं सत्यं ब्रवीम्यहम् ॥3.3.30.50॥
3.3.m: "My daughter, the Padminī woman, along with Lakṣaṇa— / where they have gone is not known by us; truly, truly I speak!"

3.3.s:
iti tadvacanaṃ śrutvā kṛṣṇāṃśaḥ svabalaissaha ..
kānyakubjaṃ samāgatya jayacandramuvāca ha .. 51 ..
3.3.d:
इति तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा कृष्णांशः स्वबलैस्सह ॥
कान्यकुब्जं समागत्य जयचन्द्रमुवाच ह ॥ 51 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing his words, Kṛṣṇāṃśa with his forces / went to Kānyakubja and said to Jayacandra:

3.3.s:
bhrātṛjastava bhūpāla padminyā lakṣaṇo'nvitaḥ ..
kāmapālagṛhe nāsti niścito bahudhā mayā .. 52 ..
3.3.d:
भ्रातृजस्तव भूपाल पद्मिन्या लक्षणोऽन्वितः ॥
कामपालगृहे नास्ति निश्चितो बहुधा मया ॥ 52 ॥
3.3.m: "O king, your brother's son Lakṣaṇa, along with Padminī, / is not in Kāmapāla's house; this has been thoroughly verified by me.

3.3.s:
na jāne kva gato rājā mama prāṇasamo bhuvi ..
yadi bhūpa na paśyāmi satyaṃ prāṇāṃstyajāmyaham .. 53 ..
3.3.d:
न जाने क्व गतो राजा मम प्राणसमो भुवि ॥
यदि भूप न पश्यामि सत्यं प्राणांस्त्यजाम्यहम् ॥ 53 ॥
3.3.m: I do not know where the king, who is dear as my own life on earth, has gone; / if I do not see him, O king, truly I shall give up my life.

3.3.s:
hā ratnabhānutanaya viṣṇubhakta śubhaṃkara ..
svamitraṃ māṃ parityajya kāṃ diśaṃ gatavānbhavān ..
ityuktvā mūrchitaścāsītkṛṣṇāṃśo vaiṣṇavapriyaḥ .. 54 ..
3.3.d:
हा रत्नभानुतनय विष्णुभक्त शुभंकर ॥
स्वमित्रं मां परित्यज्य कां दिशं गतवान्भवान् ॥
इत्युक्त्वा मूर्छितश्चासीत्कृष्णांशो वैष्णवप्रियः ॥ 54 ॥
3.3.m: Alas, son of Ratnabhānu, devotee of Viṣṇu, maker of auspiciousness! / Having abandoned me, your friend, to which direction have you gone?" / Having spoken thus, Kṛṣṇāṃśa, beloved of Vaiṣṇavas, fainted.

3.3.s:
tadā svarṇavatī devī svadāsyā śobhayā saha ..
dhṛtvā śukamayaṃ rūpaṃ tatrāgatya svamūrtigā .. 55 ..
3.3.d:
तदा स्वर्णवती देवी स्वदास्या शोभया सह ॥
धृत्वा शुकमयं रूपं तत्रागत्य स्वमूर्तिगा ॥ 55 ॥
3.3.m: Then Queen Svarṇavatī, accompanied by her maid Śobhā, / assumed the form of a parrot, came there, and returned to her own form.

3.3.s:
tayā saṃpreṣitā śobhā mlecchamāyāviśāradā ..
jayacaṃdramupāgamya dhṛtvā divyamayaṃ vapuḥ .. 56 ..
3.3.d:
तया संप्रेषिता शोभा म्लेच्छमायाविशारदा ॥
जयचंद्रमुपागम्य धृत्वा दिव्यमयं वपुः ॥ 56 ॥
3.3.m: Sent by her, Śobhā, skilled in the sorcery of the barbarians, / approached Jayacandra, assuming a divine form,

3.3.s:
uvāca vacanaṃ tatra śṛṇu bhūpaśiromaṇe ..
māyāvinī ca māṃ viddhi śobhanāṃ nāma viśrutām .. 57..
3.3.d:
उवाच वचनं तत्र शृणु भूपशिरोमणे ॥
मायाविनी च मां विद्धि शोभनां नाम विश्रुताम् ॥ 57॥
3.3.m: and spoke these words there: "Listen, O crest-jewel of kings! / Know me to be a sorceress, renowned by the name Śobhanā.

3.3.s:
daṃpatī tava bhūpāla saṃhṛtau yena yatra vai ..
tatrāhaṃ ca gamiṣyāmi mahāmadasamanvitā .. 58 ..
3.3.d:
दंपती तव भूपाल संहृतौ येन यत्र वै ॥
तत्राहं च गमिष्यामि महामदसमन्विता ॥ 58 ॥
3.3.m: Wherever and by whomsoever your couple has been taken away, O king, / thither I will go, filled with great zeal.

3.3.s:
āhlādaścendulo vīro devo vai tālano balī ..
kṛṣṇāṃśapālitāssarve yāsyāmo bhūpate vayam .. 59..
3.3.d:
आह्लादश्चेन्दुलो वीरो देवो वै तालनो बली ॥
कृष्णांशपालितास्सर्वे यास्यामो भूपते वयम् ॥ 59॥
3.3.m: Āhlāda, the hero Indula, Deva, and mighty Tālana— / all of us, protected by Kṛṣṇāṃśa, will go, O king!"

3.3.s:
ityuktvā śobhanā veśyā kṛtvā yogamayaṃ vapuḥ ..
mahāmadaṃ samāruhya paiśācaṃ rudrakiṃkaram ..
prayayau tānpuraskṛtya yogiveṣānmahāba lān.. 3.3.30.60 ..
3.3.d:
इत्युक्त्वा शोभना वेश्या कृत्वा योगमयं वपुः ॥
महामदं समारुह्य पैशाचं रुद्रकिंकरम् ॥
प्रययौ तान्पुरस्कृत्य योगिवेषान्महाब लान्॥ 3.3.30.60 ॥
3.3.m: Having spoken thus, the courtesan Śobhanā, assuming a body made of yoga, / mounted Mahāmada, a demonic servant of Rudra, / and set out, placing those mighty warriors in ascetics' garb at the head.

3.3.s:
āhlādo gajasaṃstho vai karālārūḍha indulaḥ ..
tālanaḥ siṃhinīsaṃstho devasiṃho manorathe ..
kṛṣṇāṃśo bindulārūḍho nartayāmāsa taṃ hayam.. 61 ..
3.3.d:
आह्लादो गजसंस्थो वै करालारूढ इन्दुलः ॥
तालनः सिंहिनीसंस्थो देवसिंहो मनोरथे ॥
कृष्णांशो बिन्दुलारूढो नर्तयामास तं हयम्॥ 61 ॥
3.3.m: Āhlāda rode an elephant, Indula mounted Karālā, / Tālana rode a lioness, Devasiṃha a chariot, / and Kṛṣṇāṃśa, mounted on Bindulā, made that horse dance.

3.3.s:
kāmarūpamayaṃ deśaṃ śatayojanagāminaḥ ..
balavaṃtaśca saṃprāptā gehegehe janejane ..
lakṣaṇaṃ śodhayāmāsurna prāptāstatra taṃ nṛpam .. 62 ..
3.3.d:
कामरूपमयं देशं शतयोजनगामिनः ॥
बलवंतश्च संप्राप्ता गेहेगेहे जनेजने ॥
लक्षणं शोधयामासुर्न प्राप्तास्तत्र तं नृपम् ॥ 62 ॥
3.3.m: Moving a hundred leagues, those mighty warriors arrived / at the land of Kāmarūpa; in house after house, among person after person, / they searched for Lakṣaṇa, but did not find the king there.

3.3.s:
punarmayūranagaraṃ śobhanā taiḥ samanvitā ..
cinvatī taṃ manuṣyeṣu na prāptā tatra vai nṛpam .. 63 ..
3.3.d:
पुनर्मयूरनगरं शोभना तैः समन्विता ॥
चिन्वती तं मनुष्येषु न प्राप्ता तत्र वै नृपम् ॥ 63 ॥
3.3.m: Then, accompanied by them, Śobhanā went to the city of Mayūra; / searching for him among the people, she did not find the king there.

3.3.s:
punarinnagaḍhagrāmaṃ śobhanā ca janejane ..
lakṣaṇaṃ mṛgayāmāsa na prāpa tatra lakṣaṇam.. 64 ..
3.3.d:
पुनरिन्नगढग्रामं शोभना च जनेजने ॥
लक्षणं मृगयामास न प्राप तत्र लक्षणम्॥ 64 ॥
3.3.m: Then in the village of Innagaḍha, Śobhanā, person by person, / hunted for Lakṣaṇa, but did not find Lakṣaṇa there.

3.3.s:
gatvā bāhlīkanagaraṃ śobhanā taissamanvitā ..
lakṣaṇaṃ ca nṛpaśreṣṭhaṃ nāpaśyattatra duḥkhitā .. 65 ..
3.3.d:
गत्वा बाह्लीकनगरं शोभना तैस्समन्विता ॥
लक्षणं च नृपश्रेष्ठं नापश्यत्तत्र दुःखिता ॥ 65 ॥
3.3.m: Having gone to the city of Bāhlīka, Śobhanā, accompanied by them, / did not see the excellent king Lakṣaṇa there and was sorrowful.

3.3.s:
punaḥ svadeśamāgamya bāhlīkaṃ mlecchavāsinam ..
markaṭeśvaramīśānaṃ tatrāha vanavāsinam ..
pūjayitvā ca sā veśyā gānanṛtyaparābhavat .. 66 ..
3.3.d:
पुनः स्वदेशमागम्य बाह्लीकं म्लेच्छवासिनम् ॥
मर्कटेश्वरमीशानं तत्राह वनवासिनम् ॥
पूजयित्वा च सा वेश्या गाननृत्यपराभवत् ॥ 66 ॥
3.3.m: Returning again to her own land of Bāhlīka inhabited by mlecchas, / she spoke there to the forest-dwelling lord Markaṭeśvara. / Having worshipped [him], the courtesan devoted herself to singing and dancing.

3.3.s:
sa devo bhūmimadhyāt samāgamya mudānvitaḥ ..
kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ praṇato bhūtvā'bravīnmlecchaprapūjitaḥ .. 67 ..
3.3.d:
स देवो भूमिमध्यात् समागम्य मुदान्वितः ॥
कृष्णांशं प्रणतो भूत्वाऽब्रवीन्म्लेच्छप्रपूजितः ॥ 67 ॥
3.3.m: That god, coming forth from within the earth filled with joy, / bowed down to Kṛṣṇāṃśa and spoke, he who was worshipped by mlecchas:

3.3.s:
ahaṃ kālāgnirudreṇa bhūmigarte suropitaḥ ..
asamarthaṃ ca māṃ viddhi gaccha vīra yathāsukham .. 68 ..
3.3.d:
अहं कालाग्निरुद्रेण भूमिगर्ते सुरोपितः ॥
असमर्थं च मां विद्धि गच्छ वीर यथासुखम् ॥ 68 ॥
3.3.m: "I have been placed in a hole in the earth by Kālāgnirudra. / Know that I am powerless; go, hero, at your pleasure."

3.3.s: iti śrutvā ca sā śobhā nirāśābhūttadā svayam .. 69 ..
3.3.d: इति श्रुत्वा च सा शोभा निराशाभूत्तदा स्वयम् ॥ 69 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing this, Śobhā herself then became hopeless.

3.3.s:
punaḥ svarṇavatīṃ prāpya sarvamevā dito'bravīt ..
triṃśadabdaiśca kṛṣṇāṃśe caitraśukla samāgate .. 3.3.30.70 ..
3.3.d:
पुनः स्वर्णवतीं प्राप्य सर्वमेवा दितोऽब्रवीत् ॥
त्रिंशदब्दैश्च कृष्णांशे चैत्रशुक्ल समागते ॥ 3.3.30.70 ॥
3.3.m: Reaching Svarṇavatī once more, she told everything from the beginning. / When thirty years [had passed] for Kṛṣṇāṃśa, and the bright [fortnight] of Caitra had arrived,

3.3.s:
tānāśvāsya suvarṇāṃgī pūjayāmāsa caṃḍikām ..
navarātraṃ gataṃ tasyā bhojanācchādanaṃ vinā ..
niśīthānte tamaḥprāpte gatvāha jagadambikā .. 71 ..
3.3.d:
तानाश्वास्य सुवर्णांगी पूजयामास चंडिकाम् ॥
नवरात्रं गतं तस्या भोजनाच्छादनं विना ॥
निशीथान्ते तमःप्राप्ते गत्वाह जगदम्बिका ॥ 71 ॥
3.3.m: having comforted them, the golden-limbed woman worshipped Caṇḍikā. / Her Navarātra passed without food or clothing. / At the end of midnight, when darkness arrived, the Mother of the Universe went and said:

3.3.s:
padminī nāma yā nārī maṇidevasya vai priyā ..
jātā sā kāmapālasya gṛhe yajñāvamānitā .. 72 ..
3.3.d:
पद्मिनी नाम या नारी मणिदेवस्य वै प्रिया ॥
जाता सा कामपालस्य गृहे यज्ञावमानिता ॥ 72 ॥
3.3.m: "The woman named Padminī, the beloved of Maṇideva, / was born in the house of Kāmapāla, having been dishonoured at a sacrifice.

3.3.s:
senāpatiḥ kuberasya maṇidevo hi sa smṛtaḥ ..
pūrvaṃ hi bhīmasenena yakṣayuddheṣu ghātitaḥ .. 73 ..
3.3.d:
सेनापतिः कुबेरस्य मणिदेवो हि स स्मृतः ॥
पूर्वं हि भीमसेनेन यक्षयुद्धेषु घातितः ॥ 73 ॥
3.3.m: Maṇideva is remembered as the general of Kubera; / long ago he was slain by Bhīmasena in the battles with the yakṣas.

3.3.s:
tadā tatpadminī nārī devadevamumāpatim ..
tuṣṭāva ca nirāhārā matpatiṃ dehi śaṃkara .. 74 ..
3.3.d:
तदा तत्पद्मिनी नारी देवदेवमुमापतिम् ॥
तुष्टाव च निराहारा मत्पतिं देहि शंकर ॥ 74 ॥
3.3.m: Then that woman Padminī, abstaining from food, praised / the god of gods, the lord of Umā: 'Grant me my husband, O Śaṅkara!'

3.3.s:
śatavarṣāṃtare devo mahādeva uvāca tām ..
kalau vikramakāle hi śatadvādaśake'ntike .. 75 ..
3.3.d:
शतवर्षांतरे देवो महादेव उवाच ताम् ॥
कलौ विक्रमकाले हि शतद्वादशकेऽन्तिके ॥ 75 ॥
3.3.m: After a hundred years, the god Mahādeva said to her: / 'In the Kali [age], at the time of Vikrama, near the twelfth hundred [year],

3.3.s:
nakulāṃśaṃ ca saṃprāpya bhuktvā tena mahatsukham ..
tadviyogena saṃtyajya dehaṃ padmānuvāsitam ..
svapatiṃ ca tadā prāpya kailāsaṃ punareṣyasi .. 76 ..
3.3.d:
नकुलांशं च संप्राप्य भुक्त्वा तेन महत्सुखम् ॥
तद्वियोगेन संत्यज्य देहं पद्मानुवासितम् ॥
स्वपतिं च तदा प्राप्य कैलासं पुनरेष्यसि ॥ 76 ॥
3.3.m: having obtained a portion of Nakula and enjoyed great pleasure with him, / you will abandon this body perfumed with lotus on separation from him; / and having then obtained your husband, you will return to Kailāsa.

3.3.s:
mahāvatīṃ purīṃ ramyāṃ rāṣṭrapālāya śāradā ..
kariṣyati tadā devī maṇidevastu tvatpatiḥ .. 77 ..
3.3.d:
महावतीं पुरीं रम्यां राष्ट्रपालाय शारदा ॥
करिष्यति तदा देवी मणिदेवस्तु त्वत्पतिः ॥ 77 ॥
3.3.m: The goddess Śāradā will then make the delightful city of Mahāvatī / for Rāṣṭrapāla; but your husband Maṇideva,

3.3.s:
tayā viracito bhūmau grāmarakṣārthamudyataḥ ..
prāptastvāṃ padminīṃ nārīṃ kailāsaṃ punareṣyati .. 78 ..
3.3.d:
तया विरचितो भूमौ ग्रामरक्षार्थमुद्यतः ॥
प्राप्तस्त्वां पद्मिनीं नारीं कैलासं पुनरेष्यति ॥ 78 ॥
3.3.m: fashioned by her on earth, intent upon protecting the villages, / having obtained you, the woman Padminī, will return to Kailāsa.'

3.3.s:
ataḥ svarṇavati tvaṃ vai kailāsaṃ guhyakālayam ..
gatvāśu padminīṃ tatra bodhayāśu vacaḥ kuru .. 79 ..
3.3.d:
अतः स्वर्णवति त्वं वै कैलासं गुह्यकालयम् ॥
गत्वाशु पद्मिनीं तत्र बोधयाशु वचः कुरु ॥ 79 ॥
3.3.m: Therefore, O Svarṇavatī, go quickly to Kailāsa, the abode of the Guhyakas; / awaken Padminī there and carry out my word."

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā svarṇavatī padminīṃ prati cāgamat ..
vṛttāṃtaṃ kathayitvāgre padminīṃ tu dayāturā .. 3.3.30.80 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा स्वर्णवती पद्मिनीं प्रति चागमत् ॥
वृत्तांतं कथयित्वाग्रे पद्मिनीं तु दयातुरा ॥ 3.3.30.80 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing this, Svarṇavatī went to Padminī. / Overcome with compassion, she recounted the story to Padminī;

3.3.s:
kāmapālagṛhaṃ prāpya tatra vāsamakārayat ..
svarṇavatyapi saṃprāptā tadā śīghraṃ mahāvatīm .. 81 ..
3.3.d:
कामपालगृहं प्राप्य तत्र वासमकारयत् ॥
स्वर्णवत्यपि संप्राप्ता तदा शीघ्रं महावतीम् ॥ 81 ॥
3.3.m: reaching the house of Kāmapāla, she made her residence there. / Svarṇavatī too then quickly arrived at Mahāvatī.

3.3.s:
tasyāṃ gatāyāṃ gehe vai padminyā likhitaṃ śubham ..
patraṃ parimalo rājā vartayāmāsa harṣitaḥ ..83..
3.3.d:
तस्यां गतायां गेहे वै पद्मिन्या लिखितं शुभम् ॥
पत्रं परिमलो राजा वर्तयामास हर्षितः ॥83॥
3.3.m: When she had gone to her home, King Parimala, / filled with joy, delivered the auspicious letter written by Padminī:

3.3.s:
āgaccha senayā sārddhaṃ kṛṣṇāṃśa balavattara ..
jitvā padmākaraṃ baṃdhuṃ matpatiṃ mocayāśu vai..
bhūtale lakṣaṇo rājā sthitaḥ padmākarārtigaḥ .. 83 ..
3.3.d:
आगच्छ सेनया सार्द्धं कृष्णांश बलवत्तर ॥
जित्वा पद्माकरं बंधुं मत्पतिं मोचयाशु वै॥
भूतले लक्षणो राजा स्थितः पद्माकरार्तिगः ॥ 83 ॥
3.3.m: "Come with your army, O most mighty Kṛṣṇāṃśa! / Conquer our kinsman Padmākara and swiftly release my husband! / King Lakṣaṇa is on earth, suffering affliction from Padmākara."

3.3.s:
iti jñātvā ca kṛṣṇāṃśo lakṣadvādaśasenayā ..
rurodha nagarīṃ sarvāṃ kāmapālena rakṣitām .. 84 ..
3.3.d:
इति ज्ञात्वा च कृष्णांशो लक्षद्वादशसेनया ॥
रुरोध नगरीं सर्वां कामपालेन रक्षिताम् ॥ 84 ॥
3.3.m: Knowing this, Kṛṣṇāṃśa with an army of twelve hundred thousand / besieged the entire city guarded by Kāmapāla.

3.3.s:
kāmapālastu balavāṃstrilakṣabalasaṃyutaḥ ..
sutājñayā yayau yuddhaṃ sārddhaṃ padmākareṇa vai .. 85..
3.3.d:
कामपालस्तु बलवांस्त्रिलक्षबलसंयुतः ॥
सुताज्ञया ययौ युद्धं सार्द्धं पद्माकरेण वै ॥ 85॥
3.3.m: Then the mighty Kāmapāla, accompanied by a force of three hundred thousand, / went out to battle together with Padmākara at his daughter's command.

3.3.s:
tayoścāsīnmahadyuddhaṃ senayorubhayostadā ..
ahorātrapramāṇena bhūpasenā parājitā .. 86 ..
3.3.d:
तयोश्चासीन्महद्युद्धं सेनयोरुभयोस्तदा ॥
अहोरात्रप्रमाणेन भूपसेना पराजिता ॥ 86 ॥
3.3.m: Then a great battle took place between the two armies; / in the measure of a day and night, the king's army was defeated.

3.3.s:
padminīṃ śaraṇaṃ prāpya tadā bhrātā pitā sthitaḥ ..
tayorvijayamevāśu yathāprāptaṃ cakāra sā ..
antarddhānamayaṃ patraṃ tayorarthe ca sā dadau .. 87 ..
3.3.d:
पद्मिनीं शरणं प्राप्य तदा भ्राता पिता स्थितः ॥
तयोर्विजयमेवाशु यथाप्राप्तं चकार सा ॥
अन्तर्द्धानमयं पत्रं तयोरर्थे च सा ददौ ॥ 87 ॥
