3.3.m: Then the brother and father stood, having taken refuge with Padminī. / She swiftly brought about their victory as it had been obtained: / she gave them a leaf that possessed [the power of] invisibility.

3.3.s:
tau tatrāntarhitau bhūtvā svakhaḍgena riporbalam ..
ayutaṃ jaghnaturmattau tadā te vismayaṃ gatāḥ ..88..
3.3.d:
तौ तत्रान्तर्हितौ भूत्वा स्वखड्गेन रिपोर्बलम् ॥
अयुतं जघ्नतुर्मत्तौ तदा ते विस्मयं गताः ॥88॥
3.3.m: The two, having become invisible there, struck down ten thousand / of the enemy's force with their own swords, intoxicated [with battle]; then they were astonished.

3.3.s:
tālanādyā raṇaṃ tyaktvā kṛṣṇāṃṇaśaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ ..
kṛṣṇāṃśo'pi tadā duḥkhī dhyātvā sarvamayīṃ śivām .. 89 ..
3.3.d:
तालनाद्या रणं त्यक्त्वा कृष्णांणशं शरणं ययुः ॥
कृष्णांशोऽपि तदा दुःखी ध्यात्वा सर्वमयीं शिवाम् ॥ 89 ॥
3.3.m: Tālana and the others abandoned the battle and fled to Kṛṣṇāṃśa for refuge. / Kṛṣṇāṃśa too, grieving then, meditated upon Śivā, who consists of all things.

3.3.s:
divyadṛṣṭistato jātaḥ saṃprāpya tamayudhyata ..
nabhogataṃ kāmapālaṃ tathā padmākaraṃ nṛpam .. 3.3.30.90 ..
3.3.d:
दिव्यदृष्टिस्ततो जातः संप्राप्य तमयुध्यत ॥
नभोगतं कामपालं तथा पद्माकरं नृपम् ॥ 3.3.30.90 ॥
3.3.m: Endowed with divine sight as a result, he reached and fought / Kāmapāla who had gone into the sky, and likewise King Padmākara.

3.3.s:
baddhvā tatra mudāviṣṭo lakṣaṇaṃ prāpya nirbhayaḥ ..
dolāmāropya tāṃ devīṃ svagehāya mudā yayau .. 91 ..
3.3.d:
बद्ध्वा तत्र मुदाविष्टो लक्षणं प्राप्य निर्भयः ॥
दोलामारोप्य तां देवीं स्वगेहाय मुदा ययौ ॥ 91 ॥
3.3.m: Having bound [them] there, filled with joy, fearless after finding Lakṣaṇa, / and placing that lady in a palanquin, he went with joy to his own home.

3.3.s:
jayacaṃdrāya bhūpāya dattvā vai tau ca daṃpatī ..
lakṣaṇaṃ padminīṃ caiva kṛtakṛtyastadābhavat .. 92 ..
3.3.d:
जयचंद्राय भूपाय दत्त्वा वै तौ च दंपती ॥
लक्षणं पद्मिनीं चैव कृतकृत्यस्तदाभवत् ॥ 92 ॥
3.3.m: Having given that couple, Lakṣaṇa and Padminī, / to King Jayacandra, he then accomplished his purpose.

3.3.s:
jayacaṃdro'pi balavāndṛṣṭvā gehe svadaṃpatī ..
dadau dānaṃ dvijātibhyo bhūpatiṃ samamocayat ..
jyeṣṭhe māsi site pakṣe kṛṣṇāṃśo gehamāgataḥ .. 93 ..
3.3.d:
जयचंद्रोऽपि बलवान्दृष्ट्वा गेहे स्वदंपती ॥
ददौ दानं द्विजातिभ्यो भूपतिं सममोचयत् ॥
ज्येष्ठे मासि सिते पक्षे कृष्णांशो गेहमागतः ॥ 93 ॥
3.3.m: The mighty Jayacandra too, seeing the couple in his own home, / gave gifts to the twice-born and released the king. / In the month of Jyeṣṭha, in the bright fortnight, Kṛṣṇāṃśa returned home.

3.3.s:
iti te kathitaṃ vipra kṛṣṇāṃśacaritaṃ śubham ..
punaste kathayiṣyāmi dṛṣṭaṃ yogabalena vai ..94..
3.3.d:
इति ते कथितं विप्र कृष्णांशचरितं शुभम् ॥
पुनस्ते कथयिष्यामि दृष्टं योगबलेन वै ॥94॥
3.3.m: Thus has the auspicious deeds of Kṛṣṇāṃśa been told to you, O brāhmaṇa. / I shall tell you again what was seen by the power of yoga.

3.3.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
śṛṇu vipra mahābhāga caṃdrabhaṭṭastadā svayam ..
mahīrājaṃ sadaḥsthaṃ taṃ candratulyassamāgataḥ .. 1 ..
3.3.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
शृणु विप्र महाभाग चंद्रभट्टस्तदा स्वयम् ॥
महीराजं सदःस्थं तं चन्द्रतुल्यस्समागतः ॥ 1 ॥
3.3.m: Sūta said: / Listen, O greatly fortunate brāhmaṇa: Candrabhaṭṭa himself then, / equal to the moon, came to King Mahīrāja as he sat in assembly.

3.3.s:
tamāgataṃ samālokya sa rājā śokatatparaḥ ..
uvāca vacanaṃ ramyaṃ śṛṇu maṃtrivara prabho .. 2 ..
3.3.d:
तमागतं समालोक्य स राजा शोकतत्परः ॥
उवाच वचनं रम्यं शृणु मंत्रिवर प्रभो ॥ 2 ॥
3.3.m: Seeing him arrive, that king, intent on sorrow, / spoke charming words: "Listen, O best of ministers, O lord!

3.3.s:
kṛṣṇāṃśādyairmahāśūrairmadgrāme bhayamāgatam ..
kadā te ca mariṣyaṃti kaṃṭakā mama dāruṇāḥ .. 3 ..
3.3.d:
कृष्णांशाद्यैर्महाशूरैर्मद्ग्रामे भयमागतम् ॥
कदा ते च मरिष्यंति कंटका मम दारुणाः ॥ 3 ॥
3.3.m: Because of Kṛṣṇāṃśa and the other great heroes, fear has come upon my village. / When will those terrible thorns of mine die?"

3.3.s:
ityuktassa tu śuddhātmā dhyātvā sarvamayīṃ śivām ..
vacanaṃ prāha rājānaṃ stha bhūpaśiromaṇe .. 4 ..
3.3.d:
इत्युक्तस्स तु शुद्धात्मा ध्यात्वा सर्वमयीं शिवाम् ॥
वचनं प्राह राजानं स्थ भूपशिरोमणे ॥ 4 ॥
3.3.m: Having been addressed thus, that pure-souled one, having meditated upon Śivā who consists of all things, / spoke these words to the king: "Wait, O crest-jewel of kings!"

3.3.s:
jiṣṇoraṃśātsamudbhūto brahmānaṃdo mahāvatīm ..
sa kṛṣṇāṃśasakhaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ sarvadā tatpriye rataḥ .. 5 ..
3.3.d:
जिष्णोरंशात्समुद्भूतो ब्रह्मानंदो महावतीम् ॥
स कृष्णांशसखः श्रेष्ठः सर्वदा तत्प्रिये रतः ॥ 5 ॥
3.3.m:
Born from a portion of Jiṣṇu, Brahmānanda [dwells in] Mahāvatī.
He is the foremost friend of Kṛṣṇāṃśa, always devoted to his welfare.

3.3.s:
yadā ca malanāputro dehaṃ tyaktvā gamiṣyati ..
tadā te sarvadevāṃśā gamiṣyaṃti yato gatāḥ .. 6 ..
3.3.d:
यदा च मलनापुत्रो देहं त्यक्त्वा गमिष्यति ॥
तदा ते सर्वदेवांशा गमिष्यंति यतो गताः ॥ 6 ॥
3.3.m:
And when the son of Malanā abandons his body and departs,
then all those portions of the gods will depart whence they came.

3.3.s:
ityevaṃvādinaṃ dhīramamātyaṃ ca mahīpatiḥ ..
vacanaṃ prāha namrātmā ko'pyarthaściṃtito mayā .. 7 .. .
3.3.d:
इत्येवंवादिनं धीरममात्यं च महीपतिः ॥
वचनं प्राह नम्रात्मा कोऽप्यर्थश्चिंतितो मया ॥ 7 ॥ ।
3.3.m:
To the wise minister speaking thus, the king,
humbling himself, said these words: “A plan has been conceived by me.

3.3.s:
ekākinaṃ mahāśūraṃ brahmānaṃdaṃ nṛpottamam ..
samāhūya mahīrājo dvirāgamanahetave ..
chadmanā ghātayitvā taṃ kṛtakṛtyo bhaviṣyati .. 8 ..
3.3.d:
एकाकिनं महाशूरं ब्रह्मानंदं नृपोत्तमम् ॥
समाहूय महीराजो द्विरागमनहेतवे ॥
छद्मना घातयित्वा तं कृतकृत्यो भविष्यति ॥ 8 ॥
3.3.m:
Summoning the lone, heroic, best of kings, Brahmānanda,
on the pretext of the second-homecoming rite,
King Mahīrāja, having him killed by deceit, will have accomplished his purpose.”

3.3.s:
ityukte nṛpatiṃ prāha mahīrājaḥ prasannadhīḥ ..
vacanaṃ śṛṇu bho mitra gaccha śīghraṃ mahāvatīm .. 9 ..
3.3.d:
इत्युक्ते नृपतिं प्राह महीराजः प्रसन्नधीः ॥
वचनं शृणु भो मित्र गच्छ शीघ्रं महावतीम् ॥ 9 ॥
3.3.m:
When this was said, Mahīrāja, with a pleased mind, said to the king:
“Listen to my words, O friend: go quickly to Mahāvatī,

3.3.s:
malanāṃ ca samāgatya bodhayitvā tu tāṃ svayam ..
mamāntikamupāgamya ciraṃ jīva sukhībhava .. 3.3.31.10 ..
3.3.d:
मलनां च समागत्य बोधयित्वा तु तां स्वयम् ॥
ममान्तिकमुपागम्य चिरं जीव सुखीभव ॥ 3.3.31.10 ॥
3.3.m:
and having approached Malanā and instructed her yourself,
come back to my side; live long and be happy!”

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā tu vacanaṃ natvā taṃ ca mahīpatiḥ ..
rātrau ghoraṃ muniśreṣṭha malanāṃ prāha nirbhayaḥ ..11 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा तु वचनं नत्वा तं च महीपतिः ॥
रात्रौ घोरं मुनिश्रेष्ठ मलनां प्राह निर्भयः ॥11 ॥
3.3.m:
Having heard those words and bowed to him, that king,
fearless, in the dreadful night, O best of sages, said to Malanā:

3.3.s:
vadhūstava mahārājñi velā nāma surūpiṇī ..
saṃprāptā yauvanavatī patiyogyā śubhānanā .. 12 ..
3.3.d:
वधूस्तव महाराज्ञि वेला नाम सुरूपिणी ॥
संप्राप्ता यौवनवती पतियोग्या शुभानना ॥ 12 ॥
3.3.m:
“O queen, your daughter-in-law, beautiful, named Velā,
has attained her youth; she is fit for a husband, with an auspicious face.

3.3.s:
kujātiścaiva kṛṣṇāṃśaḥ śruto rājñā mahātmanā ..
ato na preṣitā putrī tava putrāya dhīmate ..
ato madvacanaṃ matvā kuru kāryaṃ tava priyam .. 13 ..
3.3.d:
कुजातिश्चैव कृष्णांशः श्रुतो राज्ञा महात्मना ॥
अतो न प्रेषिता पुत्री तव पुत्राय धीमते ॥
अतो मद्वचनं मत्वा कुरु कार्यं तव प्रियम् ॥ 13 ॥

3.3.s:
mayā sārddhaṃ tava suto brahmānaṃdo mahābalaḥ ..
urvīyāṃ nagarīṃ prāpya tadā matsainyasaṃyutaḥ .. 14 ..
3.3.d:
मया सार्द्धं तव सुतो ब्रह्मानंदो महाबलः ॥
उर्वीयां नगरीं प्राप्य तदा मत्सैन्यसंयुतः ॥ 14 ॥
3.3.m:
Together with me, your mighty son Brahmānanda,
having reached the city in the land, accompanied by my army,

3.3.s:
mahīrājamupāgamya patnīṃ śīghramavāpsyati ..
no cenmamājñayā velā tyaktvā kāntaṃ mariṣyati .. 15 ..
3.3.d:
महीराजमुपागम्य पत्नीं शीघ्रमवाप्स्यति ॥
नो चेन्ममाज्ञया वेला त्यक्त्वा कान्तं मरिष्यति ॥ 15 ॥
3.3.m:
and approaching Mahīrāja, will quickly obtain his wife;
otherwise, by my command, Velā will abandon her lover and die.”

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā tu sā rājñī mohitā devamāyayā ..
rājānaṃ samupāgamya bhrāturvacanamuttamam ..
kathayāmāsa vai sarvaṃ śrutvā bhūpo'bravīdidam .. 16 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा तु सा राज्ञी मोहिता देवमायया ॥
राजानं समुपागम्य भ्रातुर्वचनमुत्तमम् ॥
कथयामास वै सर्वं श्रुत्वा भूपोऽब्रवीदिदम् ॥ 16 ॥
3.3.m:
Hearing this, that queen, bewildered by the illusion of the gods,
went to the king and told him all the excellent words
of her brother; having heard it, the king said this:

3.3.s:
mahīpatirmahādhūrto madvināśāya codyataḥ ..
tasya vārtā na me ramyā kapaṭastena nirmitaḥ .. 17 ..
3.3.d:
महीपतिर्महाधूर्तो मद्विनाशाय चोद्यतः ॥
तस्य वार्ता न मे रम्या कपटस्तेन निर्मितः ॥ 17 ॥
3.3.m:
“The ruler is an utter rogue, intent upon my destruction.
His report does not please me; a fraud has been concocted by him.”

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā ca malanā rājānaṃ kopasaṃyutam ..
vacanaṃ prāha bho rājanyathā baṃdhustathā hyaham..
vacanaṃ kuru me rājanno cetprāṇāṃstyajāmyaham..18..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा च मलना राजानं कोपसंयुतम् ॥
वचनं प्राह भो राजन्यथा बंधुस्तथा ह्यहम्॥
वचनं कुरु मे राजन्नो चेत्प्राणांस्त्यजाम्यहम्॥18॥

3.3.s:
ityuktavādinīṃ rātrau tadā parimalo nṛpaḥ ..
brahmānandaṃ dadau tasmai sa suto mātṛvatsalaḥ .. 19 ..
3.3.d:
इत्युक्तवादिनीं रात्रौ तदा परिमलो नृपः ॥
ब्रह्मानन्दं ददौ तस्मै स सुतो मातृवत्सलः ॥ 19 ॥
3.3.m:
To her who spoke thus in the night, King Parimala then
surrendered Brahmānanda; that son was devoted to his mother.

3.3.s:
māturājñāṃ puraskṛtya mātulena samanvitaḥ ..
rātrau ca mātulagrāmaṃ saṃprāpya mudito'bhavat ..3.3.31.20..
3.3.d:
मातुराज्ञां पुरस्कृत्य मातुलेन समन्वितः ॥
रात्रौ च मातुलग्रामं संप्राप्य मुदितोऽभवत् ॥3.3.31.20॥
3.3.m:
Placing his mother’s command foremost, accompanied by his maternal uncle,
he arrived at his uncle’s village in the night and was glad.

3.3.s:
prātaḥkāle ca saṃprāpte harināgaramāsthitaḥ ..
ekākī dehalīṃ ramyāṃ prayayau devamohitaḥ .. 21 ..
3.3.d:
प्रातःकाले च संप्राप्ते हरिनागरमास्थितः ॥
एकाकी देहलीं रम्यां प्रययौ देवमोहितः ॥ 21 ॥
3.3.m:
And when morning arrived, mounted on Harināgara,
alone, enchanted by the gods, he set out for lovely Dehalī.

3.3.s:
sāyaṃkāle tu saṃprāpte mahīrājasya maṃdire ..
agamāṃ darśayāmāsa surūpāṃ divyavigrahām .. 22 ..
3.3.d:
सायंकाले तु संप्राप्ते महीराजस्य मंदिरे ॥
अगमां दर्शयामास सुरूपां दिव्यविग्रहाम् ॥ 22 ॥
3.3.m:
When evening arrived at the mansion of Mahīrāja,
[the king] presented Agamā, of lovely form and divine body.

3.3.s:
agamā ca samālokya paraṃ harṣamupāyayau ..
māghaśuklasya cāṣṭamyāṃ brahmānaṃdaśca nirbhayaḥ ..
śyālānāṃ yoṣitaḥ sapta dadarśa rucirānanā .. 23 ..
3.3.d:
अगमा च समालोक्य परं हर्षमुपाययौ ॥
माघशुक्लस्य चाष्टम्यां ब्रह्मानंदश्च निर्भयः ॥
श्यालानां योषितः सप्त ददर्श रुचिरानना ॥ 23 ॥
3.3.m:
And Agamā, seeing [him], felt supreme joy.
On the eighth day of the bright fortnight of Māgha, fearless Brahmānanda
saw the seven charming-faced wives of his brothers-in-law.

3.3.s:
tisro nāryaśca vidhavāścatasro dhavasaṃyutāḥ ..
brahmānaṃdaṃ śarumayaṃ vākyamūcurmudānvitāḥ .. 24 ..
3.3.d:
तिस्रो नार्यश्च विधवाश्चतस्रो धवसंयुताः ॥
ब्रह्मानंदं शरुमयं वाक्यमूचुर्मुदान्विताः ॥ 24 ॥
3.3.m:
Three women were widows, and four were with husbands;
filled with joy, they spoke words sharp as arrows to Brahmānanda:

3.3.s:
brahmānaṃda mahābhāga sāvadhānaṃ vacaḥ śṛṇu ..
tava patnī svayaṃ kālī velā kalaharūpiṇī ..
saṃjahāra dhavāneva no vayaṃ tu suduḥkhitā .. 25 ..
3.3.d:
ब्रह्मानंद महाभाग सावधानं वचः शृणु ॥
तव पत्नी स्वयं काली वेला कलहरूपिणी ॥
संजहार धवानेव नो वयं तु सुदुःखिता ॥ 25 ॥

3.3.s:
sāpatnyamastu tattasyā gṛhāṇāsmānmanohara ..
dhavānvidehi no vīra patirbhava mudānvitaḥ .. 26 ..
3.3.d:
सापत्न्यमस्तु तत्तस्या गृहाणास्मान्मनोहर ॥
धवान्विदेहि नो वीर पतिर्भव मुदान्वितः ॥ 26 ॥
3.3.m:
Let that be co-wifehood for her; accept us, O handsome one!
Make us possessors of husbands, O hero; become our husband with joy!”

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā vacastāsāṃ brahmānaṃdo mahābalaḥ ..
uvāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ śrutismṛtisamanvitam .. 27 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा वचस्तासां ब्रह्मानंदो महाबलः ॥
उवाच मधुरं वाक्यं श्रुतिस्मृतिसमन्वितम् ॥ 27 ॥
3.3.m:
Hearing those words of theirs, the mighty Brahmānanda
spoke sweet words consistent with the Śruti and Smṛti:

3.3.s:
purā satyayuge nārī cottamā ca pativratā ..
tretāyāṃ madhyamā jātā nikṛṣṭā dvāpare punaḥ .. 28 ..
3.3.d:
पुरा सत्ययुगे नारी चोत्तमा च पतिव्रता ॥
त्रेतायां मध्यमा जाता निकृष्टा द्वापरे पुनः ॥ 28 ॥
3.3.m:
“In ancient times, in the Satya Yuga, a woman was supreme and devoted to her husband;
in the Tretā she became mediocre, and in the Dvāpara, degenerate.

3.3.s:
adhamā hi kalau nārī parapuṃsopabhoginī ..
atastu kalikāle vai vihāho? vidhavāstriyāḥ ..
devalena śubhaḥ proktaścāsitena svayaṃ smṛtau ..29..
3.3.d:
अधमा हि कलौ नारी परपुंसोपभोगिनी ॥
अतस्तु कलिकाले वै विहाहो? विधवास्त्रियाः ॥
देवलेन शुभः प्रोक्तश्चासितेन स्वयं स्मृतौ ॥29॥

3.3.s: satī satye tu sā proktā tretāyāṃ patibhasmagā ..3.3.31.30..
3.3.d: सती सत्ये तु सा प्रोक्ता त्रेतायां पतिभस्मगा ॥3.3.31.30॥
3.3.m: She was declared a satī in the Satya; in the Tretā, she reduced herself to ashes with her husband;

3.3.s:
satī sā madhyamā proktā dvāpare vidhavā satī ..
brahmacaryaparā jñeyā kalau nāsti satīvratam .. 31 ..
3.3.d:
सती सा मध्यमा प्रोक्ता द्वापरे विधवा सती ॥
ब्रह्मचर्यपरा ज्ञेया कलौ नास्ति सतीव्रतम् ॥ 31 ॥
3.3.m:
she was declared a mediocre satī; in the Dvāpara, a widowed satī
should be known as devoted to celibacy; in the Kali age, there is no vow of a satī.

3.3.s:
ato yūyaṃ mayā sārddhaṃ bhuṃkṣadhvamamalaṃ sukham ..
iti śrutvā priyaṃ vākyaṃ tisrastā vidhavāḥ striyaḥ .. 32 ..
3.3.d:
अतो यूयं मया सार्द्धं भुंक्षध्वममलं सुखम् ॥
इति श्रुत्वा प्रियं वाक्यं तिस्रस्ता विधवाः स्त्रियः ॥ 32 ॥
3.3.m:
Therefore, enjoy spotless pleasure together with me!”
Hearing these agreeable words, those three widowed women,

3.3.s:
kṛtvā śṛṃgāra rūpāṇi bhūṣaṇāni ca sarvaśaḥ ..
brahmānaṃdamupāgamya samāliṃganatatparāḥ ..33..
3.3.d:
कृत्वा शृंगार रूपाणि भूषणानि च सर्वशः ॥
ब्रह्मानंदमुपागम्य समालिंगनतत्पराः ॥33॥
3.3.m:
putting on erotic attire and all kinds of ornaments,
approached Brahmānanda, intent on embracing him.

3.3.s: tā dṛṣṭvā malanāputro vacanaṃ prāha nirbhayaḥ ..34..
3.3.d: ता दृष्ट्वा मलनापुत्रो वचनं प्राह निर्भयः ॥34॥
3.3.m: Seeing them, the son of Malanā spoke fearlessly:

3.3.s: yuṣmābhiḥ patayo muktā ye ca madbaṃdhunā hatāḥ .. 35 ..
3.3.d: युष्माभिः पतयो मुक्ता ये च मद्बंधुना हताः ॥ 35 ॥
3.3.m: “Your husbands were abandoned by you, and they were slain by my kinsman;

3.3.s:
yuṣmānato na gṛhṇīyāṃ satyaṃsatyaṃ bravīmyaham..
iti śrutvā vaco ghoraṃ hāsyayuktaṃ ca yoṣitaḥ ..36..
3.3.d:
युष्मानतो न गृह्णीयां सत्यंसत्यं ब्रवीम्यहम्॥
इति श्रुत्वा वचो घोरं हास्ययुक्तं च योषितः ॥36॥
3.3.m:
therefore I will not take you; truly, truly I say [this]!”
Hearing this dread and mocking speech, the women,

3.3.s:
mahīrājantamāgamya rurudurbhṛśaduḥkhitāḥ..
rājanvelāpatirdhūrto mama dharmaṃ jahāti vai ..
daṃḍaṃ dehi ca dhūrtāya no cetprāṇāṃstyajāmyaham .. 37 ..
3.3.d:
महीराजन्तमागम्य रुरुदुर्भृशदुःखिताः॥
राजन्वेलापतिर्धूर्तो मम धर्मं जहाति वै ॥
दंडं देहि च धूर्ताय नो चेत्प्राणांस्त्यजाम्यहम् ॥ 37 ॥
3.3.m:
approaching Mahīrāja, wept, exceedingly afflicted:
“O King, Velā’s husband is a rogue; indeed, he violates my virtue!
Inflict punishment on that rogue; otherwise I shall abandon my life-breaths!”

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā mahīrājo brahmānandaṃ mahābalam ..
samāhūya vacaḥ prāha bhavānbhūpakulādhamaḥ .. 38 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा महीराजो ब्रह्मानन्दं महाबलम् ॥
समाहूय वचः प्राह भवान्भूपकुलाधमः ॥ 38 ॥
3.3.m:
Hearing this, Mahīrāja summoned the mighty Brahmānanda
and spoke these words: “You are the lowest of the royal line!

3.3.s:
parastriyaṃ ca yo bhuṃkte sa yāti yamamaṃdiram ..
adyaiva tvaṃ sutākānta kārāgṛhamavāpnuyāḥ .. 39 ..
3.3.d:
परस्त्रियं च यो भुंक्ते स याति यममंदिरम् ॥
अद्यैव त्वं सुताकान्त कारागृहमवाप्नुयाः ॥ 39 ॥
3.3.m:
He who enjoys another’s wife goes to the abode of Yama.
This very day, O son-in-law, you shall be cast into prison!”

3.3.s:
itiśrutvā vaco ghoraṃ brahmānaṃdo mahābalaḥ ..
satsaroḥ khaḍgamutsṛjya mahīrājamadhāvata .. 3.3.31.40 ..
3.3.d:
इतिश्रुत्वा वचो घोरं ब्रह्मानंदो महाबलः ॥
सत्सरोः खड्गमुत्सृज्य महीराजमधावत ॥ 3.3.31.40 ॥
3.3.m:
Hearing these dreadful words, the mighty Brahmānanda
drew his sword from its scabbard and rushed at Mahīrāja.

3.3.s:
dṛṣṭvā bhayāturo rājā cāmuṃḍāntamupāyayau..
kapāṭaṃ dṛḍhamācchādya tatra vāsamakārayat .. 41 ..
3.3.d:
दृष्ट्वा भयातुरो राजा चामुंडान्तमुपाययौ॥
कपाटं दृढमाच्छाद्य तत्र वासमकारयत् ॥ 41 ॥
3.3.m:
Seeing [him], the king, overcome with terror, fled to Cāmuṇḍā;
firmly shutting the door-leaf, he remained there.

3.3.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ.. .. ..
tāsāṃ kathaṃ vivāhāḥ syustattvaṃ no brūhi vistarāt..
kutratyāstāḥ kimaṃśāśca dṛṣṭā yogena vai tvayā .. 42..
3.3.d:
॥ ऋषय ऊचुः॥ ॥ ॥
तासां कथं विवाहाः स्युस्तत्त्वं नो ब्रूहि विस्तरात्॥
कुत्रत्यास्ताः किमंशाश्च दृष्टा योगेन वै त्वया ॥ 42॥
3.3.m:
The sages said:
How did their marriages take place? Tell us the truth in detail.
From where were they, and of what were they portions, as seen by you through yoga?

3.3.s:
.. sūta uvāca. ..
aṃgadeśe muniśreṣṭha māyāvarmanṛpo'bhavat ..
tāmasīṃ pūjayitvā vai śaktiṃ sarvavimohinīm .. 43 ..
3.3.d:
॥ सूत उवाच॥।
अंगदेशे मुनिश्रेष्ठ मायावर्मनृपोऽभवत् ॥
तामसीं पूजयित्वा वै शक्तिं सर्वविमोहिनीम् ॥ 43 ॥
3.3.m:
Sūta said:
In the country of Aṅga, O best of sages, there was a king named Māyāvarman.
Having worshipped the dark Power who deludes all,

3.3.s:
varmottamaṃ tayā dattaṃ sarvasattvabhayaṃkaram.
gṛhītvā sa tu bhūpālaḥ prasthito'bhūnmahītale ..44..
3.3.d:
वर्मोत्तमं तया दत्तं सर्वसत्त्वभयंकरम्।
गृहीत्वा स तु भूपालः प्रस्थितोऽभून्महीतले ॥44॥
3.3.m:
he was given an excellent armour by her, which struck terror into all beings;
having received it, that king set forth on the earth.

3.3.s:
pramadā nāma tatpatnī daśa putrānasūṣuvat ..
kauravāṃśānmahābhāga varṣānte nāma me śṛṇu ..45..
3.3.d:
प्रमदा नाम तत्पत्नी दश पुत्रानसूषुवत् ॥
कौरवांशान्महाभाग वर्षान्ते नाम मे शृणु ॥45॥
3.3.m:
His wife, named Pramadā, gave birth to ten sons,
portions of the Kauravas, O noble one, at the end of the year; hear their names from me:

3.3.s:
mattaḥ pramatta unmatta sumatto durmadastathā..
durmukho durdharo bāhuḥ suratho virathaḥ kramāt.
teṣāṃ svasānujā cāsītsunāmnā madirekṣaṇā..46..
3.3.d:
मत्तः प्रमत्त उन्मत्त सुमत्तो दुर्मदस्तथा॥
दुर्मुखो दुर्धरो बाहुः सुरथो विरथः क्रमात्।
तेषां स्वसानुजा चासीत्सुनाम्ना मदिरेक्षणा॥46॥

3.3.s:
tasyā vai suṃdaraṃ rūpaṃ madāghūrṇitalocanam ..
kitavo nāma vai daityo dṛṣṭvā mohamupāgataḥ .. 47..
3.3.d:
तस्या वै सुंदरं रूपं मदाघूर्णितलोचनम् ॥
कितवो नाम वै दैत्यो दृष्ट्वा मोहमुपागतः ॥ 47॥
3.3.m: Seeing her beautiful form, with eyes rolling from intoxication, / a daitya named Kitava fell under the sway of delusion.

3.3.s:
māyāvarmāṇamāgatya vacanaṃ prāha namradhīḥ ..
yadi tvaṃ me svatanayāṃ dehi kāmāturāya ca ..48..
3.3.d:
मायावर्माणमागत्य वचनं प्राह नम्रधीः ॥
यदि त्वं मे स्वतनयां देहि कामातुराय च ॥48॥
3.3.m: Approaching Māyāvarman, he said with a humble mind: / “If you give me your daughter, afflicted as I am with desire,

3.3.s:
tarhi te sakalaṃ kāryaṃ kariṣyāmi na saṃśayaḥ ..
iti śrutvā tadā bhūpo dadau tasmai svakanyakām..49..
3.3.d:
तर्हि ते सकलं कार्यं करिष्यामि न संशयः ॥
इति श्रुत्वा तदा भूपो ददौ तस्मै स्वकन्यकाम्॥49॥
3.3.m: then I will accomplish all your tasks—of this there is no doubt.” / Hearing this, the king then gave him his daughter.

3.3.s:
kitavo gahvarāvāsī rātrau ghore tamovṛte ..
nṛpagehamupāgamya bubhuje smaravihvalaḥ ..
prātaḥkāle tu tāṃ tyaktvā kandarāntamupāyayau..3.3.31.50..
3.3.d:
कितवो गह्वरावासी रात्रौ घोरे तमोवृते ॥
नृपगेहमुपागम्य बुभुजे स्मरविह्वलः ॥
प्रातःकाले तु तां त्यक्त्वा कन्दरान्तमुपाययौ॥3.3.31.50॥
3.3.m: Kitava, dwelling in a cave, approached the king’s abode / at night in thick darkness and, frantic with passion, enjoyed her; / but at dawn he abandoned her and went back to his cave.

3.3.s:
varmadevamate jāte tato rājā madāturaḥ..
purohitaṃ samāhūya lakṣadravyasamanvitam ..
mahīrājāya saṃpreṣya tārakaṃ sa samāvṛṇot ..51..
3.3.d:
वर्मदेवमते जाते ततो राजा मदातुरः॥
पुरोहितं समाहूय लक्षद्रव्यसमन्वितम् ॥
महीराजाय संप्रेष्य तारकं स समावृणोत् ॥51॥
3.3.m: When Varman was inclined, the king, overcome with passion, / summoned the royal priest and sent him to Mahīrāja with a hundred thousand in wealth, / choosing Tāraka [for her].

3.3.s:
mahīrājastu balavām̐llakṣaṣoḍaśasainyapaḥ..
saṃyutaḥ śatabhūpālairmāsānte samupāgamat ..52..
3.3.d:
महीराजस्तु बलवाम्̐ल्लक्षषोडशसैन्यपः॥
संयुतः शतभूपालैर्मासान्ते समुपागमत् ॥52॥
3.3.m: Mahīrāja, mighty and commander of an army of one million six hundred thousand, / accompanied by a hundred kings, arrived at the end of the month.

3.3.s:
kṛṣṇāṃśe paṃcadaśake saṃprāpte vratatatpare..
tārakaśca vivāhāya bahubhūpoṃgamānayat..53..
3.3.d:
कृष्णांशे पंचदशके संप्राप्ते व्रततत्परे॥
तारकश्च विवाहाय बहुभूपोंगमानयत्॥53॥
3.3.m: When the fifteenth [tithi] arrived in the dark fortnight, devoted to his vow, / Tāraka brought along many kings for the marriage.

3.3.s:
māyāvarmā ca taṃ dṛṣṭvā tārakaṃ bhūpasaṃyutam..
vacanaṃ prāha balavānrājarāja vacaḥ śṛṇu.. 54..
3.3.d:
मायावर्मा च तं दृष्ट्वा तारकं भूपसंयुतम्॥
वचनं प्राह बलवान्राजराज वचः शृणु॥ 54॥
3.3.m: Seeing Tāraka accompanied by the kings, / mighty Māyāvarman said: “King of kings, hear my words!

3.3.s:
kitavo nāma medhāvī daityavaṃśayaśaskaraḥ..
tena me pīḍitā bālā rātrau ghoratamovṛte ..55..
3.3.d:
कितवो नाम मेधावी दैत्यवंशयशस्करः॥
तेन मे पीडिता बाला रात्रौ घोरतमोवृते ॥55॥
3.3.m: A wise [demon] named Kitava, the glorifier of the daitya race, / has tormented my girl at night in the thick darkness.

3.3.s:
hatā bhūpakumārāśca matsutārthaṃ samāgatāḥ..
bhakṣitāstena daityena saṃyayuste yamālayam.. 56 ..
3.3.d:
हता भूपकुमाराश्च मत्सुतार्थं समागताः॥
भक्षितास्तेन दैत्येन संययुस्ते यमालयम्॥ 56 ॥
3.3.m: The princes who came for my daughter’s sake were slain, / devoured by that daitya, and went to Yama’s abode.

3.3.s:
teṣāṃ ca bahudhā dravyaṃ luṃṭhayitvā madāturaḥ..
matsutāyai dadau sarvaṃ tasmāttvaṃ ditijaṃ jahi..57..
3.3.d:
तेषां च बहुधा द्रव्यं लुंठयित्वा मदातुरः॥
मत्सुतायै ददौ सर्वं तस्मात्त्वं दितिजं जहि॥57॥
3.3.m: Having looted their wealth in many ways, mad with passion, / he gave it all to my daughter; therefore, slay that son of Diti!”

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā mahīrājassarvasainyasamanvitaḥ ..
kitavaṃ ca samāhūya mahadyuddhamacīkarat ..58..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा महीराजस्सर्वसैन्यसमन्वितः ॥
कितवं च समाहूय महद्युद्धमचीकरत् ॥58॥
3.3.m: Hearing this, Mahīrāja, accompanied by his entire army, / challenged Kitava and waged a great battle.

3.3.s:
kitavassa tu māyāvī jitvā sarvānmahābalān..
tārakaṃ ca samāhṛtya guhāyāṃ samupāgamat .. 59 ..
3.3.d:
कितवस्स तु मायावी जित्वा सर्वान्महाबलान्॥
तारकं च समाहृत्य गुहायां समुपागमत् ॥ 59 ॥
3.3.m: Kitava, that sorcerer, having defeated all those mighty men / and seized Tāraka, retreated into his cave.

3.3.s:
tārakaśca tadā duḥkhī dhyātvā śaṃkaramuttamam ..
pāṣāṇabhūto hyagamanmahādevaprasādataḥ .. 3.3.31.60 ..
3.3.d:
तारकश्च तदा दुःखी ध्यात्वा शंकरमुत्तमम् ॥
पाषाणभूतो ह्यगमन्महादेवप्रसादतः ॥ 3.3.31.60 ॥
3.3.m: Then sorrowful Tāraka, meditating on the supreme Śaṅkara, / turned to stone by the grace of Mahādeva.

3.3.s:
etasminnaṃtare prāptā mahāvatīnivāsinaḥ ..
kṣatriyā daśasāhasrā kṛṣṇāṃśādyaiśca pālitāḥ .. 61 ..
3.3.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे प्राप्ता महावतीनिवासिनः ॥
क्षत्रिया दशसाहस्रा कृष्णांशाद्यैश्च पालिताः ॥ 61 ॥
3.3.m: In the meantime, ten thousand kṣatriyas residing in Mahāvatī, / protected by Kṛṣṇāṃśa and the others, arrived.

3.3.s:
mahīrājastu tāndṛṣṭvā balakhāniṃ mahābalam ..
uvāca vacanaṃ premṇā putraśokena duḥkhitaḥ .. 62 ..
3.3.d:
महीराजस्तु तान्दृष्ट्वा बलखानिं महाबलम् ॥
उवाच वचनं प्रेम्णा पुत्रशोकेन दुःखितः ॥ 62 ॥
3.3.m: Seeing them and the mighty Balakhāni, / Mahīrāja, grieved by sorrow for his son, spoke words with affection:

3.3.s:
tārakaḥ kitavenaiva saṃhṛto ditijena vai ..
yadi tvaṃ me sutaṃ dehi koṭisvarṇaṃ dadāmi tat ..63..
3.3.d:
तारकः कितवेनैव संहृतो दितिजेन वै ॥
यदि त्वं मे सुतं देहि कोटिस्वर्णं ददामि तत् ॥63॥
3.3.m: “Tāraka has indeed been carried off by that son of Diti, Kitava. / If you give me back my son, I will give ten million in gold.”

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā tu te dhīrāḥ kṛṣṇāṃśo devasiṃhakaḥ ..
vatsajau ca tathāgamya kitavaṃ rurudhurbalāt ..64..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा तु ते धीराः कृष्णांशो देवसिंहकः ॥
वत्सजौ च तथागम्य कितवं रुरुधुर्बलात् ॥64॥
3.3.m: Hearing this, those resolute heroes—Kṛṣṇāṃśa, Devasiṃhaka, / and the two sons of Vatsa—went and besieged Kitava by force.

3.3.s:
ahorātramabhūdyuddhaṃ teṣāṃ tena samanvitam ..
kitavastu ruṣāviṣṭaḥ kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ devasiṃhakam ..
balakhāniṃ mohayitvā jagarja ca punaḥpunaḥ .. 65 ..
3.3.d:
अहोरात्रमभूद्युद्धं तेषां तेन समन्वितम् ॥
कितवस्तु रुषाविष्टः कृष्णांशं देवसिंहकम् ॥
बलखानिं मोहयित्वा जगर्ज च पुनःपुनः ॥ 65 ॥
3.3.m: A battle took place between them and him for a day and a night. / Filled with fury, Kitava bewitched Kṛṣṇāṃśa, Devasiṃhaka, / and Balakhāni, and roared repeatedly.

3.3.s:
sukhakhānistadā śūraḥ kitavaṃ balavattaram ..
svakhaḍgena śirastasya chittvā rājānamāgamat .. 66 ..
3.3.d:
सुखखानिस्तदा शूरः कितवं बलवत्तरम् ॥
स्वखड्गेन शिरस्तस्य छित्त्वा राजानमागमत् ॥ 66 ॥
3.3.m: Then heroic Sukhakhāni, severing the head of the exceedingly mighty Kitava / with his sword, approached the king.

3.3.s:
trayaste sukhino bhūtvā sukhakhāniṃ praśasya ca ..
mahīrājāya ca dadau tārakaṃ kaitavaṃ śiraḥ .. .. 67 ..
3.3.d:
त्रयस्ते सुखिनो भूत्वा सुखखानिं प्रशस्य च ॥
महीराजाय च ददौ तारकं कैतवं शिरः ॥ ॥ 67 ॥
3.3.m: Those three rejoiced, praised Sukhakhāni, / and delivered Tāraka and the head of Kitava to Mahīrāja.

3.3.s:
tadā bhūpasutā devī sukhakhāniṃ samāvṛṇot ..
mahīpatistadāgatya tatsutāṃ madirekṣaṇām .. 68 ..
3.3.d:
तदा भूपसुता देवी सुखखानिं समावृणोत् ॥
महीपतिस्तदागत्य तत्सुतां मदिरेक्षणाम् ॥ 68 ॥
3.3.m: Then the king’s daughter, a lady, chose Sukhakhāni. / The ruler of the earth, coming to his daughter with eyes rolling in intoxication,

3.3.s:
saṃbodhya vividhairvākyairbhūmirājāṃtamāgamat ..
tārakasya tayā sārddhaṃ vivāho mudito'bhavat .. 69 ..
3.3.d:
संबोध्य विविधैर्वाक्यैर्भूमिराजांतमागमत् ॥
तारकस्य तया सार्द्धं विवाहो मुदितोऽभवत् ॥ 69 ॥
3.3.m: and comforting her with various words, went before King Mahīrāja; / and the marriage of Tāraka with her was joyfully celebrated.

3.3.s:
koṭisvarṇaṃ nṛpātprāpya balakhānirmahābalaḥ ..
prayayau baṃdhubhissārddhaṃ śirīṣākhyapuraṃ śubham .. 3.3.31.70 ..
3.3.d:
कोटिस्वर्णं नृपात्प्राप्य बलखानिर्महाबलः ॥
प्रययौ बंधुभिस्सार्द्धं शिरीषाख्यपुरं शुभम् ॥ 3.3.31.70 ॥
3.3.m: Having received ten million in gold from the king, the mighty Balakhāni / departed along with his kinsmen for the auspicious city named Śirīṣa.

3.3.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
gurjare nṛpatiścāsīnmūlavarmā mahābalaḥ ..
prabhāvatī tasya sutā daśaputrānujābhavat .. 71 ..
3.3.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
गुर्जरे नृपतिश्चासीन्मूलवर्मा महाबलः ॥
प्रभावती तस्य सुता दशपुत्रानुजाभवत् ॥ 71 ॥
3.3.m: Sūta said: / In Gurjara there was a mighty king named Mūlavarman. / He had a daughter named Prabhāvatī, the younger sister of ten sons:

3.3.s:
balaśca prabalaścaiva subalo balavānbalī ..
sumūlaśca mahābhūlo durgo bhīmo bhayaṃkaraḥ .. 72 ..
3.3.d:
बलश्च प्रबलश्चैव सुबलो बलवान्बली ॥
सुमूलश्च महाभूलो दुर्गो भीमो भयंकरः ॥ 72 ॥
3.3.m: Bala, Prabala, Subala, Balavān, Balī, / Sumūla, Mahāmūla, Durga, Bhīma, and Bhayaṅkara.

3.3.s:
karabho nāma vai yakṣo lallarājasya sevakaḥ ..
prabhāvatīṃ samālokya mumoha madavihvalaḥ ..
pañcavarṣāṃtare jāte tena bhuktā kumārikā .. 73 ..
3.3.d:
करभो नाम वै यक्षो लल्लराजस्य सेवकः ॥
प्रभावतीं समालोक्य मुमोह मदविह्वलः ॥
पञ्चवर्षांतरे जाते तेन भुक्ता कुमारिका ॥ 73 ॥
3.3.m: A yakṣa named Karabho, a servant of King Lalla, / saw Prabhāvatī and was bewitched, frantic with passion; / when five years had elapsed, he enjoyed the young girl.

3.3.s:
mūlavarmā mahīrājaṃ samāhūya sasainyakam ..
vacanaṃ prāha namrātmā rājarāja vacaḥ kuru .. 74 ..
3.3.d:
मूलवर्मा महीराजं समाहूय ससैन्यकम् ॥
वचनं प्राह नम्रात्मा राजराज वचः कुरु ॥ 74 ॥
3.3.m: Mūlavarman summoned Mahīrāja along with his army, / and with a humble spirit said: “King of kings, grant my request!

3.3.s:
prabhāvatīṃ śubhāṃ kanyāṃ nṛharāya dadāmyaham ..
ityuktvā nṛharaṃ putraṃ samāhūya svamaṃdire ..
dadau vedavidhānena sutāṃ ca nṛharāya vai .. .. 75 ..
3.3.d:
प्रभावतीं शुभां कन्यां नृहराय ददाम्यहम् ॥
इत्युक्त्वा नृहरं पुत्रं समाहूय स्वमंदिरे ॥
ददौ वेदविधानेन सुतां च नृहराय वै ॥ ॥ 75 ॥
3.3.m: I give my auspicious daughter Prabhāvatī to Nṛhari.” / Having spoken thus, he summoned his son Nṛhari into his palace / and gave his daughter to Nṛhari according to Vedic rites.

3.3.s:
pakṣamātrāṃtare yakṣaḥ karabhastatra cāgataḥ ..
daṃpatī pīḍayāmāsa jitvā sarvamahīpatīn .. 76 ..
3.3.d:
पक्षमात्रांतरे यक्षः करभस्तत्र चागतः ॥
दंपती पीडयामास जित्वा सर्वमहीपतीन् ॥ 76 ॥
3.3.m: Within a fortnight the yakṣa Karabho arrived there; / defeating all the rulers of the earth, he tormented the couple.

3.3.s:
mahīrājastadā duḥkhī vatsajau balavattarau ..
samāhūya kathitvāgre ruroda balavānbalī .. 77 ..
3.3.d:
महीराजस्तदा दुःखी वत्सजौ बलवत्तरौ ॥
समाहूय कथित्वाग्रे रुरोद बलवान्बली ॥ 77 ॥
3.3.m: Then sorrowful Mahīrāja summoned the two exceedingly mighty sons of Vatsa, / spoke before them, and the powerful man wept.

3.3.s:
dayālū vatsajau vīrau karabhāṃtamupeyatuḥ ..
karabhastau samālokya tatraivāṃtardhimāgamat ..
nāgapāśena tau baddhvā pīḍayāmāsa daṃpatī .. 7 ..
3.3.d:
दयालू वत्सजौ वीरौ करभांतमुपेयतुः ॥
करभस्तौ समालोक्य तत्रैवांतर्धिमागमत् ॥
नागपाशेन तौ बद्ध्वा पीडयामास दंपती ॥ 7 ॥
3.3.m: The two compassionate and heroic sons of Vatsa went to Karabho. / Seeing them, Karabho disappeared on the spot; / binding the two with a serpent-noose, he tormented the couple.

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā sa kṛṣṇāṃśaḥ karabhaṃ yakṣakiṃkaram ..
baddhvā yogabalenaiva mocayāmāsa dampatī .. 79 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा स कृष्णांशः करभं यक्षकिंकरम् ॥
बद्ध्वा योगबलेनैव मोचयामास दम्पती ॥ 79 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing of this, Kṛṣṇāṃśa bound the yakṣa-servant Karabho / by the power of yoga alone and released the couple.

3.3.s:
bhrātarau tau samāgamya nāgapāśaṃ tu cāsinā ..
chittvā mumoda balavānkoṭisvarṇaṃ gṛhītavān..
bhūmirājaḥ prasannātmā dehalīṃ mudito'gamat.. 3.3.31.80 .. ..
3.3.d:
भ्रातरौ तौ समागम्य नागपाशं तु चासिना ॥
छित्त्वा मुमोद बलवान्कोटिस्वर्णं गृहीतवान्॥
भूमिराजः प्रसन्नात्मा देहलीं मुदितोऽगमत्॥ 3.3.31.80 ॥ ॥
3.3.m: Approaching the two brothers, he cut the serpent-noose with a sword; / the mighty one rejoiced and received ten million in gold. / King Mahīrāja, his heart pleased, joyfully departed for Delhi.

3.3.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
kāśmīre ca nṛpaścāsītkaikayo nāma viśrutaḥ ..
daśa putrāśca tasyaiva kanyā ca madanāvatī .. 81 ..
3.3.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
काश्मीरे च नृपश्चासीत्कैकयो नाम विश्रुतः ॥
दश पुत्राश्च तस्यैव कन्या च मदनावती ॥ 81 ॥
3.3.m: Sūta said: / In Kaśmīra there was a renowned king named Kaikaya; / he had ten sons and a daughter named Madanāvatī:

3.3.s:
kāmaḥ prakāmaḥ sakāmo niṣkāmo nirapatrapaḥ ..
jayaśca vijayaścaiva jayanto jayavāñjayaḥ .. 82 ..
3.3.d:
कामः प्रकामः सकामो निष्कामो निरपत्रपः ॥
जयश्च विजयश्चैव जयन्तो जयवाञ्जयः ॥ 82 ॥
3.3.m: Kāma, Prakāma, Sakāma, Niṣkāma, Nirapatrapa, / Jaya, Vijaya, Jayanta, Jayavān, and Jaya.

3.3.s:
sa bhūpo bhūmirājaṃ ca samāhūya vaco'bravīt ..
putraste vai saradano matkanyāṃ prāptumarhati .. 83 ..
3.3.d:
स भूपो भूमिराजं च समाहूय वचोऽब्रवीत् ॥
पुत्रस्ते वै सरदनो मत्कन्यां प्राप्तुमर्हति ॥ 83 ॥
3.3.m: That king summoned King Mahīrāja and spoke these words: / “Your son Saradana is worthy to win my daughter.

3.3.s:
gaṃdharvassukalo nāma matkanyāṃ ca śubhānanām ..
jyotsnāyāṃ niśi saṃhṛtya tayā sārddhaṃ hi dīvyati .. 84 ..
3.3.d:
गंधर्वस्सुकलो नाम मत्कन्यां च शुभाननाम् ॥
ज्योत्स्नायां निशि संहृत्य तया सार्द्धं हि दीव्यति ॥ 84 ॥
3.3.m: A gandharva named Sukala carries off my fair-faced daughter / on moonlit nights and sports with her.

3.3.s:
pūrṇimāyāṃ ca saṃprāptaḥ sa vai citrarathapriyaḥ ..
vaiśākhasyāsite pakṣe cāṣṭamī cādya maṃgalā ..
vadhaṃ kuru nṛpaśreṣṭha dehalīṃ gaṃtumarhasi .. 85 ..
3.3.d:
पूर्णिमायां च संप्राप्तः स वै चित्ररथप्रियः ॥
वैशाखस्यासिते पक्षे चाष्टमी चाद्य मंगला ॥
वधं कुरु नृपश्रेष्ठ देहलीं गंतुमर्हसि ॥ 85 ॥
3.3.m: He, the favorite of Citraratha, arrives on the full moon. / Today is the auspicious aṣṭamī of the dark fortnight of Vaiśākha; / slay him, best of kings, and then you may go to Delhi.”

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā mahīrājo lakṣasainyasamanvitaḥ ..
gṛhītvā daṃpatī śīghraṃ dehalīnagaraṃ yayau .. 86 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा महीराजो लक्षसैन्यसमन्वितः ॥
गृहीत्वा दंपती शीघ्रं देहलीनगरं ययौ ॥ 86 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing this, Mahīrāja, accompanied by an army of a hundred thousand, / quickly took the couple and went to the city of Delhi.

3.3.s:
vaiśākhyāṃ sukhajātāyāṃ sukalonāma vīryavān ..
gaṃdharvo daśa sāhasrai rurodha nagaraṃ ruṣā .. 87 ..
3.3.d:
वैशाख्यां सुखजातायां सुकलोनाम वीर्यवान् ॥
गंधर्वो दश साहस्रै रुरोध नगरं रुषा ॥ 87 ॥
3.3.m: When the full moon of Vaiśākha peacefully arrived, the valiant / gandharva named Sukala furiously besieged the city with ten thousand [troops].

3.3.s:
nagarācca bahirjātā ye śūrā madavihvalāḥ ..
hatvā tānsukalaḥ śīghraṃ rājñe duḥkhaṃ cakāra ha .. 88 ..
3.3.d:
नगराच्च बहिर्जाता ये शूरा मदविह्वलाः ॥
हत्वा तान्सुकलः शीघ्रं राज्ञे दुःखं चकार ह ॥ 88 ॥
3.3.m: And whatever warriors went outside the city, bewildered with pride, / Sukala quickly slew them, causing distress to the king.

3.3.s:
bhayabhīto mahīrājo dhyātvā sarvamayīṃ śivām ..
suṣvāpa niśi śuddhātmā tuṣṭābhūjjagadaṃbikā .. 89 ..
3.3.d:
भयभीतो महीराजो ध्यात्वा सर्वमयीं शिवाम् ॥
सुष्वाप निशि शुद्धात्मा तुष्टाभूज्जगदंबिका ॥ 89 ॥
3.3.m: Terrified with fear, Mahīrāja meditated on Śivā, who embodies all things, / and slept at night, pure in spirit; the mother of the universe was pleased.

3.3.s:
kṛṣṇāṃśādīnbodhayitvā taiśca sārdhaṃ samāgamat ..
teṣāṃ cāsīnmahadyuddhaṃ gaṃdharveṇa tadāhnikam.. 3.3.31.90 ..
3.3.d:
कृष्णांशादीन्बोधयित्वा तैश्च सार्धं समागमत् ॥
तेषां चासीन्महद्युद्धं गंधर्वेण तदाह्निकम्॥ 3.3.31.90 ॥
3.3.m: She awakened Kṛṣṇāṃśa and the others, and came together with them; / and a great daytime battle ensued between them and the gandharva.

3.3.s:
balakhāniśca balavāñchatagaṃdharvamuttamam ..
tridināṃte ca saṃhatya sukhakhānistathaiva ca .. 91 ...
3.3.d:
बलखानिश्च बलवाञ्छतगंधर्वमुत्तमम् ॥
त्रिदिनांते च संहत्य सुखखानिस्तथैव च ॥ 91 ॥।
3.3.m: The mighty Balakhāni, having slain a hundred noble gandharvas / at the end of three days, and likewise Sukhakhāni,

3.3.s:
sukalaśca tadā kruddho gāṃdharvīṃ ca sasarja ha ..
bahudhā te hi gaṃdharvāstaiśca sārddhaṃ samārudhan .. 92 ..
3.3.d:
सुकलश्च तदा क्रुद्धो गांधर्वीं च ससर्ज ह ॥
बहुधा ते हि गंधर्वास्तैश्च सार्द्धं समारुधन् ॥ 92 ॥
3.3.m: Sukala then, enraged, released Gandharva illusions; / in manifold forms indeed, those gandharvas besieged them together.

3.3.s:
bhayabhītāstadā sarve rāmāṃśaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ ..
āhlādaśca prasannātmā śāradāṃ sarvamaṃgalām .. 93 ..
3.3.d:
भयभीतास्तदा सर्वे रामांशं शरणं ययुः ॥
आह्लादश्च प्रसन्नात्मा शारदां सर्वमंगलाम् ॥ 93 ॥
3.3.m: Then, terrified with fear, they all took refuge with Rāmāṃśa; / and Āhlāda, pleased in spirit, [praised] Śāradā, who is all-auspicious,

3.3.s:
divāsūktena tuṣṭāva tadā prādurabhūcchivā. ..
gaṃdharvānmohayitvāśu drāvayāmāsa śāradā .. 94 ..
3.3.d:
दिवासूक्तेन तुष्टाव तदा प्रादुरभूच्छिवा॥।
गंधर्वान्मोहयित्वाशु द्रावयामास शारदा ॥ 94 ॥
3.3.m: praising her with the hymn to the Sun; then Śivā appeared. / Bewildering the gandharvas, Śāradā quickly put them to flight.

3.3.s:
parājite ca gaṃdharve kṛṣṇāṃśo janamohanaḥ ..
mahīrājamupāgamya koṭisvarṇaṃ gṛhītavān .. 95 ..
3.3.d:
पराजिते च गंधर्वे कृष्णांशो जनमोहनः ॥
महीराजमुपागम्य कोटिस्वर्णं गृहीतवान् ॥ 95 ॥
3.3.m: When the gandharva was defeated, Kṛṣṇāṃśa, the charmer of men, / approached Mahīrāja and received ten million gold pieces.

3.3.s:
ṣoḍaśābde ca kṛṣṇāṃśe saṃprāpte devipūjake ..
mārgamāsaṃ tu saṃprāpte mardanaśca vivāhitaḥ .. 96 ..
3.3.d:
षोडशाब्दे च कृष्णांशे संप्राप्ते देविपूजके ॥
मार्गमासं तु संप्राप्ते मर्दनश्च विवाहितः ॥ 96 ॥
3.3.m: When Kṛṣṇāṃśa, the worshipper of the goddess, reached his sixteenth year, / and the month of Mārga arrived, Mardana was married.

3.3.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
puṃḍradeśe mahārājo nāgavarmā mahābalaḥ ..
babhūva takṣakaparo dharmavāñjagatītale ...1 .. 97 ..
3.3.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
पुंड्रदेशे महाराजो नागवर्मा महाबलः ॥
बभूव तक्षकपरो धर्मवाञ्जगतीतले ॥.1 ॥ 97 ॥
3.3.m: Sūta said: / In the Puṇḍra country, there was a mighty king named Nāgavarmā, / devoted to Takṣaka, righteous upon the surface of the earth.

3.3.s:
patnī nāgavatī tasya takṣakasya sutā śubhā ..
pituḥ śāpena sañjātā kaliṃgādhipateḥ sutā .. 98 ..
3.3.d:
पत्नी नागवती तस्य तक्षकस्य सुता शुभा ॥
पितुः शापेन सञ्जाता कलिंगाधिपतेः सुता ॥ 98 ॥
3.3.m: His wife was Nāgavatī, the auspicious daughter of Takṣaka; / by her father’s curse, she was born as the daughter of the ruler of Kaliṅga.

3.3.s:
daśaiva tanayāścāsankanyā tasya śubhānanā ..
suvelā nāma vikhyātā rūpayauvanaśālinī .. 99 ..
3.3.d:
दशैव तनयाश्चासन्कन्या तस्य शुभानना ॥
सुवेला नाम विख्याता रूपयौवनशालिनी ॥ 99 ॥
3.3.m: He had ten sons, and an auspicious-faced daughter / renowned by the name Suvelā, endowed with beauty and youth.

3.3.s:
purohitaṃ samāhūya mahīrājāya praiṣayat ..
sa gatvā kathayitvāgre mardano vīrato mayā .. 3.3.31.100 ..
3.3.d:
पुरोहितं समाहूय महीराजाय प्रैषयत् ॥
स गत्वा कथयित्वाग्रे मर्दनो वीरतो मया ॥ 3.3.31.100 ॥
3.3.m: Summoning his family priest, he dispatched him to Mahīrāja; / going there, he announced beforehand: “Mardana, the hero, [is chosen] by me.”

3.3.s:
mahīrājastu tacchrutvā trilakṣabalasaṃyutaḥ ..
maṃgalaṃ kārayāmāsa gatvā nāgapure śubhe .. 101 ..
3.3.d:
महीराजस्तु तच्छ्रुत्वा त्रिलक्षबलसंयुतः ॥
मंगलं कारयामास गत्वा नागपुरे शुभे ॥ 101 ॥
3.3.m: Having heard that, Mahīrāja, accompanied by an army of three hundred thousand, / went to the auspicious city of Nāgapura and arranged the auspicious ceremonies.

3.3.s:
suvelā pitaraṃ prāha dehi me nāgabhūṣaṇam..
vivāhaṃ hi kariṣyāmi nocetprāṇāṃstyajāmyaham .. 102 ..
3.3.d:
सुवेला पितरं प्राह देहि मे नागभूषणम्॥
विवाहं हि करिष्यामि नोचेत्प्राणांस्त्यजाम्यहम् ॥ 102 ॥
3.3.m: Suvelā said to her father: “Give me the serpent ornament! / [Then] I will perform the marriage; otherwise, I shall give up my life.”

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā nāgavarmā mahīrājāntamāyayau ..
suvelāyā abhiprāyaṃ varṇayāmāsa vistarāt .. 103 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा नागवर्मा महीराजान्तमाययौ ॥
सुवेलाया अभिप्रायं वर्णयामास विस्तरात् ॥ 103 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing this, Nāgavarmā came into the presence of Mahīrāja; / he described in detail Suvelā’s intention.

3.3.s:
ityuktaḥ sa mahīrājo vismitobhūtsuduḥkhitaḥ ..
preṣayāmāsa vai patraṃ yatrāhlādādayaḥ sthitāḥ .. 104 ..
3.3.d:
इत्युक्तः स महीराजो विस्मितोभूत्सुदुःखितः ॥
प्रेषयामास वै पत्रं यत्राह्लादादयः स्थिताः ॥ 104 ॥
3.3.m: Being told this, King Mahīrāja was astonished and deeply grieved; / he sent a letter to where Āhlāda and the others dwelt.

3.3.s:
iti jñātvā tadā''hlādaḥ śūrapaṃcaśatāvṛtaḥ ..
kṛṣṇāṃśavatsajaissārddhaṃ dināṃte ca samāgamat .. 105 ..
3.3.d:
इति ज्ञात्वा तदा'ऽह्लादः शूरपंचशतावृतः ॥
कृष्णांशवत्सजैस्सार्द्धं दिनांते च समागमत् ॥ 105 ॥
3.3.m: Having learned this, Āhlāda, surrounded by five hundred heroes / along with the descendants of Kṛṣṇāṃśa and Vatsa, arrived at the end of the day.

3.3.s:
śatayojanagāminyo vājinyaśca dviyāmake ....
sahasrayojanaṃ vīryaṃ tāsāṃ caiva dine niśi..106..
3.3.d:
शतयोजनगामिन्यो वाजिन्यश्च द्वियामके ॥॥
सहस्रयोजनं वीर्यं तासां चैव दिने निशि॥106॥
3.3.m: The mares traversed a hundred yojanas in two watches of the day; / their power indeed was a thousand yojanas in a day and night.

3.3.s:
kalāṃśādudbhavā aśvā vājinā ca hareḥ svayam..
ratnāśvasya kalāṃśaśca kapoto haraṇībhavaḥ..107..
3.3.d:
कलांशादुद्भवा अश्वा वाजिना च हरेः स्वयम्॥
रत्नाश्वस्य कलांशश्च कपोतो हरणीभवः॥107॥
3.3.m: The horses were born from portions of the part of Hari himself; / Kapota, born of Haraṇī, was a portion of the part of the Jewel-Horse.

3.3.s:
gāyatro yobhavadvājī kālacakrapravartakaḥ ..
tatkalāṃśātsamudbhūto ravidattaḥ papīhakaḥ ..
hariṇī nāma tacchaktiḥ kalāṃśādbhūmimāgatā .. 108 ...
3.3.d:
गायत्रो योभवद्वाजी कालचक्रप्रवर्तकः ॥
तत्कलांशात्समुद्भूतो रविदत्तः पपीहकः ॥
हरिणी नाम तच्छक्तिः कलांशाद्भूमिमागता ॥ 108 ॥।
3.3.m: The horse named Gāyatra, who sets in motion the wheel of Time— / from a portion of his part arose Papīhaka, given by the Sun; / and the potency named Hariṇī came to earth from a portion of his part.

3.3.s:
sukhakhāniḥ papīhastho balakhāniḥ kapotagaḥ..
āhlādaśca karālastho biṃdulastho hareḥ kalā ..109..
3.3.d:
सुखखानिः पपीहस्थो बलखानिः कपोतगः॥
आह्लादश्च करालस्थो बिंदुलस्थो हरेः कला ॥109॥
3.3.m: Sukhakhāni mounted Papīha, and Balakhāni mounted Kapota; / Āhlāda mounted Karāla, and the portion of Hari mounted Biṃdula.

3.3.s:
gatvā te tu mahīrājaṃ natvā tuṃgāsanāṃ yayuḥ ..
prasannaḥ sa mahīrājo vacanaṃ prāha namradhīḥ .. 3.3.31.110 ..
3.3.d:
गत्वा ते तु महीराजं नत्वा तुंगासनां ययुः ॥
प्रसन्नः स महीराजो वचनं प्राह नम्रधीः ॥ 3.3.31.110 ॥
3.3.m: Having gone and bowed to Mahīrāja, they took high seats; / pleased, Mahīrāja addressed them with humble mind:

3.3.s:
mama putrāśca yuṣmābhistrayaḥ śūrā vivāhitāḥ ..
tathaiva mardanaṃ vīraṃ samudvāhya sukhī bhava ..111..
3.3.d:
मम पुत्राश्च युष्माभिस्त्रयः शूरा विवाहिताः ॥
तथैव मर्दनं वीरं समुद्वाह्य सुखी भव ॥111॥
3.3.m: “My three heroic sons have been married by you; / likewise, having married off the hero Mardana, be happy!”

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā sa āhlādo gatvā bhūtalamuttamam ..
rasātalaṃ ca vikhyātaṃ nāginīṃ prāha nirbhayaḥ .. 112 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा स आह्लादो गत्वा भूतलमुत्तमम् ॥
रसातलं च विख्यातं नागिनीं प्राह निर्भयः ॥ 112 ॥
3.3.m: Having heard this, Āhlāda went to the noble netherworld / known as Rasātala, and, fearless, spoke to the serpent queen:

3.3.s:
supto hi tava bhartā ca puṃḍarīkaḥ śubhānanaḥ ..
bodhayāśu mahārājñi nāgānāṃ no dayāṃ kuru ..113..
3.3.d:
सुप्तो हि तव भर्ता च पुंडरीकः शुभाननः ॥
बोधयाशु महाराज्ञि नागानां नो दयां कुरु ॥113॥
3.3.m: “Your handsome husband Puṇḍarīka is asleep; / awaken him quickly, O great queen, and have mercy upon us serpents!”

3.3.s:
ityuktā sāha taṃ vīraṃ puṃḍarīkaśca matpatiḥ ..
ruṣāviṣṭaśca balavāndāhayecca vapustava .. 114 ..
3.3.d:
इत्युक्ता साह तं वीरं पुंडरीकश्च मत्पतिः ॥
रुषाविष्टश्च बलवान्दाहयेच्च वपुस्तव ॥ 114 ॥
3.3.m: Thus addressed, she said to the hero: “Puṇḍarīka is my husband; / seized with anger, powerful as he is, he would burn up your body.”

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā vihasyāha tava bharturna no bhayam ..
ityevaṃ vacanaṃ kṛtvā padbhyāṃ pucchamatāḍayat .. 115 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा विहस्याह तव भर्तुर्न नो भयम् ॥
इत्येवं वचनं कृत्वा पद्भ्यां पुच्छमताडयत् ॥ 115 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing this, he laughed and said: “We have no fear of your husband”; / having spoken thus, he struck the serpent’s tail with his two feet.

3.3.s:
prabuddhaśca tadā rājā nāgānāṃ ca mahābalaḥ..
jvālāmālāṃ svadehācca janayāmāsa vīryavān..116..
3.3.d:
प्रबुद्धश्च तदा राजा नागानां च महाबलः॥
ज्वालामालां स्वदेहाच्च जनयामास वीर्यवान्॥116॥
3.3.m: Then the mighty king of the serpents was awakened; / valorous, he produced a wreath of flames from his body.

3.3.s:
dṛṣṭvā tadviṣamujjvālaṃ sa dhyātvā sarvamaṃgalām..
śamayāmāsa balavāndevīpūjanatatparaḥ ..117..
3.3.d:
दृष्ट्वा तद्विषमुज्ज्वालं स ध्यात्वा सर्वमंगलाम्॥
शमयामास बलवान्देवीपूजनतत्परः ॥117॥
3.3.m: Seeing that fierce, blazing poison, the mighty one, intent on worshipping the goddess, / meditated upon the all-auspicious goddess and pacified it.

3.3.s:
puṃḍarīkaḥ prasannātmā nāgabhūṣaṇamuttamam ..
āhlādāya dadau śīghraṃ sarvaśṛṅgārasaṃyutam .. 118 ..
3.3.d:
पुंडरीकः प्रसन्नात्मा नागभूषणमुत्तमम् ॥
आह्लादाय ददौ शीघ्रं सर्वशृङ्गारसंयुतम् ॥ 118 ॥
3.3.m: Puṇḍarīka, pleased in spirit, quickly gave the excellent serpent ornament, / complete with all decorations, to Āhlāda.

3.3.s:
āhlādastu hayārūḍho mahīrājāya dattavān ..
vivāhaṃ kārayāmāsa vaivāhikavidhānataḥ ..
koṭisvarṇaṃ nṛpātprāptaṃ gṛhītvā śīghramāyayau .. 119 ..
3.3.d:
आह्लादस्तु हयारूढो महीराजाय दत्तवान् ॥
विवाहं कारयामास वैवाहिकविधानतः ॥
कोटिस्वर्णं नृपात्प्राप्तं गृहीत्वा शीघ्रमाययौ ॥ 119 ॥
3.3.m: Mounted on his horse, Āhlāda gave it to Mahīrāja; / he performed the marriage in accordance with the bridal rites, / and having received ten million gold coins from the king, he returned swiftly.

3.3.s:
hayavidyāsamārūḍhāste hayā gehamāgatāḥ ..
jñeyāḥ paṃcaśataṃ sarve saśūrā gṛhamāyayuḥ .. 3.3.31.120 ..
3.3.d:
हयविद्यासमारूढास्ते हया गेहमागताः ॥
ज्ञेयाः पंचशतं सर्वे सशूरा गृहमाययुः ॥ 3.3.31.120 ॥
3.3.m: Ridden with equestrian skill, those horses came home; / five hundred in all, together with the warriors, they returned home.

3.3.s:
sūta uvāca ..
madradeśeṣu yaścāsīnmadrakeśo mahābalaḥ..
pañcābdaṃ pūjayāmāsa svargavaidyau surottamau .. 121 ..
3.3.d:
सूत उवाच ॥
मद्रदेशेषु यश्चासीन्मद्रकेशो महाबलः॥
पञ्चाब्दं पूजयामास स्वर्गवैद्यौ सुरोत्तमौ ॥ 121 ॥
3.3.m: Sūta said: / In the Madra country, there was the mighty Madrakeśa; / for five years he worshipped the two heavenly physicians, the best of gods.

3.3.s:
tayośca varadānena daśa putrā babhūvire ..
sutā kāntimatī jātā rūpayauvanaśālinī ..122..
3.3.d:
तयोश्च वरदानेन दश पुत्रा बभूविरे ॥
सुता कान्तिमती जाता रूपयौवनशालिनी ॥122॥
3.3.m: By the boon granted by the two, ten sons were born to him; / a daughter was born, Kāntimatī, endowed with beauty and youth.

3.3.s:
sa mahīrājamāhūya trilakṣabalasaṃyutam ..
dadau kanyāṃ vidhānena madreśaḥ sūryavarmaṇe ..123..
3.3.d:
स महीराजमाहूय त्रिलक्षबलसंयुतम् ॥
ददौ कन्यां विधानेन मद्रेशः सूर्यवर्मणे ॥123॥
3.3.m: Having summoned Mahīrāja, who was accompanied by three hundred thousand troops, / the lord of Madra duly gave his daughter to Sūryavarmā.

3.3.s:
navoḍhāṃ tu tadā patnīṃ sūryavarmā gṛhītavān..
svagehāya yayau śīghraṃ mahīrājo balaissaha .. 124 ..
3.3.d:
नवोढां तु तदा पत्नीं सूर्यवर्मा गृहीतवान्॥
स्वगेहाय ययौ शीघ्रं महीराजो बलैस्सह ॥ 124 ॥
3.3.m: Then Sūryavarmā took his newly wedded wife; / Mahīrāja quickly departed for his own home along with his forces.

3.3.s:
karburonāma māyāvī vibhīṣaṇasuto balī ..
rākṣasastatra saṃprāpto dṛṣṭvā kāṃtimatīṃ śubhām .. 125 ..
3.3.d:
कर्बुरोनाम मायावी विभीषणसुतो बली ॥
राक्षसस्तत्र संप्राप्तो दृष्ट्वा कांतिमतीं शुभाम् ॥ 125 ॥
3.3.m: A deceitful and mighty rākṣasa named Karbura, son of Vibhīṣaṇa, / arrived there, and having seen the auspicious Kāntimatī,

3.3.s:
madrakeśasya tanayāṃ divyaśobhāsamanvi tām ..
jahāra paśyatāṃ teṣāṃ sahyādrigirimāyayau .. 126 ..
3.3.d:
मद्रकेशस्य तनयां दिव्यशोभासमन्वि ताम् ॥
जहार पश्यतां तेषां सह्याद्रिगिरिमाययौ ॥ 126 ॥
3.3.m: the daughter of Madrakeśa, endowed with divine splendour, / he abducted her before their eyes and went to Mount Sahyādri.

3.3.s:
mahīrājastadā duḥkhī vilalāpa bhṛśaṃ muhuḥ ..
dehalīgehamāgamya dūtamāhūya satva ram .. 127 ..
3.3.d:
महीराजस्तदा दुःखी विललाप भृशं मुहुः ॥
देहलीगेहमागम्य दूतमाहूय सत्व रम् ॥ 127 ॥
3.3.m: Then Mahīrāja, deeply grieving, lamented aloud repeatedly; / having returned to his abode in Delhi, he quickly summoned a messenger,

3.3.s:
kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ preṣayāmāsa sa gatvā samavarṇayat ..
jñātvā te tu hayārūḍhāḥ śūrāḥ paṃcaśatāvṛtāḥ .. 128 ..
3.3.d:
कृष्णांशं प्रेषयामास स गत्वा समवर्णयत् ॥
ज्ञात्वा ते तु हयारूढाः शूराः पंचशतावृताः ॥ 128 ॥
3.3.m: and dispatched him to Kṛṣṇāṃśa; he went and recounted everything. / Having learned this, the warriors, five hundred in number, mounted their horses,

3.3.s:
sahyādrigirimāgamya kṛṣṇāṃ śaḥ karburaṃ prati ..
nirbhayo vacanaṃ prāha śṛṇu rākṣasasattama .. 129 ..
3.3.d:
सह्याद्रिगिरिमागम्य कृष्णां शः कर्बुरं प्रति ॥
निर्भयो वचनं प्राह शृणु राक्षससत्तम ॥ 129 ॥
3.3.m: and coming to Mount Sahyādri, Kṛṣṇāṃśa, fearless, / addressed Karbura: “Listen, O best of rākṣasas!

3.3.s:
vibhīṣaṇo bhaktarājastasya tvaṃ dayitaḥ sutaḥ ..
tasmāttvayā na kartavyaṃ pāpaṃ vaṃśa vināśanam ..
rāvaṇena purā sītā saṃhṛtā viditaṃ tava .. 3.3.31.130 ..
3.3.d:
विभीषणो भक्तराजस्तस्य त्वं दयितः सुतः ॥
तस्मात्त्वया न कर्तव्यं पापं वंश विनाशनम् ॥
रावणेन पुरा सीता संहृता विदितं तव ॥ 3.3.31.130 ॥
3.3.m: Vibhīṣaṇa is the king of devotees, and you are his beloved son; / therefore, you must not commit a sin that destroys your lineage! / Formerly Sītā was abducted by Rāvaṇa, as is known to you.

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā sa hovāca pureyaṃ dayitā priyā ..
mama gaṃdharvatanayā muniśāpānmahīṃ gatā .. 131 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा स होवाच पुरेयं दयिता प्रिया ॥
मम गंधर्वतनया मुनिशापान्महीं गता ॥ 131 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing this, he spoke: "Formerly she was my cherished beloved, / a daughter of a gandharva who came to earth through a sage's curse.

3.3.s:
ato'haṃ tadviyogena tyaktvā laṃkāṃ mahāpurīm ..
madrakeśamahaṃ prāpya madrakeśabhayādaham ..
na jahāra priyāṃ ramyāṃ tatroṣitvā dinaṃ bahu .. 132 ..
3.3.d:
अतोऽहं तद्वियोगेन त्यक्त्वा लंकां महापुरीम् ॥
मद्रकेशमहं प्राप्य मद्रकेशभयादहम् ॥
न जहार प्रियां रम्यां तत्रोषित्वा दिनं बहु ॥ 132 ॥
3.3.m: Therefore, separated from her, I abandoned the great city of Laṅkā. / Reaching the lord of Madraka, out of fear of the lord of Madraka, / I did not seize my lovely beloved, having dwelt there for many days.

3.3.s:
adya me vaśagā sābhūnnāmnā kāṃtimatī śubhā ..
jitvā māṃ ca gṛhāṇāśu samarthāśca vayaṃ sadā .. 133 ..
3.3.d:
अद्य मे वशगा साभून्नाम्ना कांतिमती शुभा ॥
जित्वा मां च गृहाणाशु समर्थाश्च वयं सदा ॥ 133 ॥
3.3.m: Today she has come under my power, the auspicious one named Kāntimatī. / Defeating me, take [her] swiftly; we are always capable!"

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā sa kṛṣṇāṃśaḥ khaḍgayuddhamacīkarat ..
saptarātreṇa taṃ jitvā labdhvā kāṃtimatīṃ śubhām ..
tadā ca dehalīṃ prāpya mahīrājāntamāyayau ..134..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा स कृष्णांशः खड्गयुद्धमचीकरत् ॥
सप्तरात्रेण तं जित्वा लब्ध्वा कांतिमतीं शुभाम् ॥
तदा च देहलीं प्राप्य महीराजान्तमाययौ ॥134॥
3.3.m: Hearing this, that portion of Kṛṣṇa waged a sword-fight. / Conquering him in seven nights and winning the auspicious Kāntimatī, / he then went to Dehalī and came before Mahīrāja.

3.3.s:
koṭisvarṇaṃ dadau rājā kṛṣṇāṃśāya mahātmane ..
sa vīro baṃdhubhiḥ sārdhaṃ pramadāvanamāyayau ..135..
3.3.d:
कोटिस्वर्णं ददौ राजा कृष्णांशाय महात्मने ॥
स वीरो बंधुभिः सार्धं प्रमदावनमाययौ ॥135॥
3.3.m: The king gave ten million in gold to the great-souled portion of Kṛṣṇa. / That hero, together with his kinsmen, went to Pramadavana.

3.3.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
paṭṭanākhyapure rājā nāmnā pūrṇāmalo balī ..
vasūnārādhāyāmāsa paṃcavarṣāntare mudā ..
tadā prasannāste devā dadustasmai varaṃ śubham .. 136 ..
3.3.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
पट्टनाख्यपुरे राजा नाम्ना पूर्णामलो बली ॥
वसूनाराधायामास पंचवर्षान्तरे मुदा ॥
तदा प्रसन्नास्ते देवा ददुस्तस्मै वरं शुभम् ॥ 136 ॥
3.3.m: Sūta said: / In the city named Paṭṭana was a mighty king named Pūrṇāmala. / He worshipped the Vasus with joy within five years. / Then those pleased gods granted him an auspicious boon.

3.3.s:
varadānācca sañjātā daśa putrā mahīpateḥ ..
vidyunmālā sutā jātā rūpayauvanaśālinī .. 137
3.3.d:
वरदानाच्च सञ्जाता दश पुत्रा महीपतेः ॥
विद्युन्माला सुता जाता रूपयौवनशालिनी ॥ 137
3.3.m: And from the granting of the boon, ten sons were born to the king, / [and] a daughter, Vidyunmālā, endowed with beauty and youth, was born.

3.3.s:
tadvivāhārthamāhūya mahīrājaṃ mahābalam ..
saptalakṣabalaiḥ sārddhaṃ tatputrāya sutāṃ dadau .. 138 ..
3.3.d:
तद्विवाहार्थमाहूय महीराजं महाबलम् ॥
सप्तलक्षबलैः सार्द्धं तत्पुत्राय सुतां ददौ ॥ 138 ॥
3.3.m: Having summoned the mighty Mahīrāja for her wedding, / he gave his daughter to his son along with an army of seven hundred thousand.

3.3.s:
mahīrājasuto bhīmaḥ patnīṃ prāpya manoramām ..
gehamāgamya taiḥ sārddhaṃ dehalīṃ harṣamāptavān .. 139 ..
3.3.d:
महीराजसुतो भीमः पत्नीं प्राप्य मनोरमाम् ॥
गेहमागम्य तैः सार्द्धं देहलीं हर्षमाप्तवान् ॥ 139 ॥
3.3.m: Mahīrāja's son Bhīma, having obtained his charming wife, / returned home with them to Dehalī and attained joy.

3.3.s:
tadā paiśācadeśasthaḥ sahodaśca mahīpatiḥ ..
mlecchaiśca daśasāhasrairvidyunmālārthamudyataḥ ..3.3.31.140..
3.3.d:
तदा पैशाचदेशस्थः सहोदश्च महीपतिः ॥
म्लेच्छैश्च दशसाहस्रैर्विद्युन्मालार्थमुद्यतः ॥3.3.31.140॥
3.3.m: Then King Sahoda, who dwelt in the Paiśāca country, / prepared [for battle] for the sake of Vidyunmālā with ten thousand mlecchas.

3.3.s:
balidaityājñayā prāptaḥ kurukṣetraṃ śubhasthalam ..
bhittvā mūrtīḥ surāṇāṃ goraktaistīrthajalaṃ kṛtam .. .. 141 ..
3.3.d:
बलिदैत्याज्ञया प्राप्तः कुरुक्षेत्रं शुभस्थलम् ॥
भित्त्वा मूर्तीः सुराणां गोरक्तैस्तीर्थजलं कृतम् ॥ ॥ 141 ॥
3.3.m: By command of the Daitya Bali, he reached the auspicious place Kurukṣetra. / Breaking the images of the gods, he turned the holy water into the blood of cows.

3.3.s:
patramālikhya balavānmahīrājāya dharmiṇe ..
svadūtaḥ preṣitastena śrutvā bhūpo'bravīdidam .. 142 ..
3.3.d:
पत्रमालिख्य बलवान्महीराजाय धर्मिणे ॥
स्वदूतः प्रेषितस्तेन श्रुत्वा भूपोऽब्रवीदिदम् ॥ 142 ॥
3.3.m: Having written a letter to the righteous Mahīrāja, / the mighty one sent his messenger. Hearing it, the king said this:

3.3.s:
bhavānmlecchapatī rājā vidyunmālārthamudyataḥ ..
māṃ śabdavedhinaṃ viddhi cauryadeśadhuraṃdharam .. 143 ..
3.3.d:
भवान्म्लेच्छपती राजा विद्युन्मालार्थमुद्यतः ॥
मां शब्दवेधिनं विद्धि चौर्यदेशधुरंधरम् ॥ 143 ॥
3.3.m: "You are a king who is a lord of mlecchas, prepared [to fight] for the sake of Vidyunmālā. / Know that I pierce by sound alone, foremost in the country of Cauryadeśa!"

3.3.s:
ityuktvā sa trilakṣaiśca kurukṣetramupāgataḥ ..
tayoścāsīnmahadyuddhamahorātraṃ bhayānakam .. 144 ..
3.3.d:
इत्युक्त्वा स त्रिलक्षैश्च कुरुक्षेत्रमुपागतः ॥
तयोश्चासीन्महद्युद्धमहोरात्रं भयानकम् ॥ 144 ॥
3.3.m: Having spoken thus, he went to Kurukṣetra with three hundred thousand [warriors]. / And between the two of them there occurred a great, dreadful battle day and night.

3.3.s:
niśīthe samanuprāpte jyeṣṭhe māsi tamomaye ..
pātālādbalirāgatya daityāyutasamanvitaḥ .. 145 ..
3.3.d:
निशीथे समनुप्राप्ते ज्येष्ठे मासि तमोमये ॥
पातालाद्बलिरागत्य दैत्यायुतसमन्वितः ॥ 145 ॥
3.3.m: When midnight arrived in the dark month of Jyeṣṭha, / Bali came from Pātāla accompanied by ten thousand Daityas.

3.3.s:
nṛpasainyaṃ jaghānāśu bhakṣayitvā punaḥ punaḥ ..
bhayabhītastadā rājā śāradāṃ śaraṇaṃ yayau .. 146 ..
3.3.d:
नृपसैन्यं जघानाशु भक्षयित्वा पुनः पुनः ॥
भयभीतस्तदा राजा शारदां शरणं ययौ ॥ 146 ॥
3.3.m: He swiftly slew the king's army, devouring [them] again and again. / Terrified with fear, the king then went to Śāradā for refuge.

3.3.s:
etasminnaṃtare devāḥ kṛṣṇāṃśādyā mahābalāḥ ..
kṣaṇamātreṇa saṃprāptāstadā padacarā mune .. 147 ..
3.3.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे देवाः कृष्णांशाद्या महाबलाः ॥
क्षणमात्रेण संप्राप्तास्तदा पदचरा मुने ॥ 147 ॥
3.3.m: In the meantime, the mighty gods led by the portion of Kṛṣṇa, / moving on foot, arrived in a mere moment, O sage!

3.3.s:
hatvā daityasahasrāṇi balidaityamupāyayuḥ ..
deśajau vatsajau vīrau devasiṃhastathaiva ca ..
svakhaḍgaistarpayāmāsa daityarājaṃ mahābalam .. 148 ..
3.3.d:
हत्वा दैत्यसहस्राणि बलिदैत्यमुपाययुः ॥
देशजौ वत्सजौ वीरौ देवसिंहस्तथैव च ॥
स्वखड्गैस्तर्पयामास दैत्यराजं महाबलम् ॥ 148 ॥
3.3.m: Having slain thousands of Daityas, they approached the Daitya Bali. / The two heroes born in the land, born of Vatsa, and likewise Devingha, / gratified the mighty king of Daityas with their swords.

3.3.s:
tadā prasanno balavāndaityarājo baliḥ svayam ..
varaṃ vṛṇuta tānāha te tu śrutvābruvanvacaḥ ..149..
3.3.d:
तदा प्रसन्नो बलवान्दैत्यराजो बलिः स्वयम् ॥
वरं वृणुत तानाह ते तु श्रुत्वाब्रुवन्वचः ॥149॥
3.3.m: Then the mighty Bali himself, king of the Daityas, became pleased. / "Choose a boon!" he said to them, and they, hearing [him], spoke these words:

3.3.s:
āryadeśaṃ ca te daityā nāgacchantu tvayā saha..
mlecchadeśaṃ sadā prāpya bhakṣadhvaṃ mlecchadharmagān .. 3.3.31.150 ..
3.3.d:
आर्यदेशं च ते दैत्या नागच्छन्तु त्वया सह॥
म्लेच्छदेशं सदा प्राप्य भक्षध्वं म्लेच्छधर्मगान् ॥ 3.3.31.150 ॥
3.3.m: "Let your Daityas not enter the land of the Āryas with you! / Having always gone to the mleccha country, devour those who follow the mleccha religion!"

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā vaco ghoraṃ vipriyaṃ ca baliḥ svayam ..
kṛṣṇāṃśamudayaṃ gatvā tuṣṭāva parayā girā .. 151 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा वचो घोरं विप्रियं च बलिः स्वयम् ॥
कृष्णांशमुदयं गत्वा तुष्टाव परया गिरा ॥ 151 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing this terrible and unwelcome statement, Bali himself / approached the noble portion of Kṛṣṇa and praised [him] with supreme speech.

3.3.s:
tadā prasannaḥ kṛṣṇāṃśo vacanaṃ prāha nirbhayaḥ ..
yāvadahaṃ bhūmivāsī tāvattvaṃ gehamāvasa ..
tatpaścādbhūmimāgatya yathāyogyaṃ kuruṣva bhoḥ .. 152 ..
3.3.d:
तदा प्रसन्नः कृष्णांशो वचनं प्राह निर्भयः ॥
यावदहं भूमिवासी तावत्त्वं गेहमावस ॥
तत्पश्चाद्भूमिमागत्य यथायोग्यं कुरुष्व भोः ॥ 152 ॥
3.3.m: Then the pleased portion of Kṛṣṇa, fearless, spoke these words: / "As long as I dwell on earth, so long do you dwell in your abode. / After that, having come to earth, do whatever is fitting, O sir!"

3.3.s:
iti tadvacanaṃ śrutvā sahodo nīlasaṃyutaḥ ..
paiśācaṃ deśamagamatpunaḥ prāpto rasātalam .. 153 ..
3.3.d:
इति तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा सहोदो नीलसंयुतः ॥
पैशाचं देशमगमत्पुनः प्राप्तो रसातलम् ॥ 153 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing his words, Sahoda, accompanied by Nīla, / went to the Paiśāca country and returned again to Rasātala.

3.3.s:
bhūmirājaḥ prasannātmā koṭisvarṇaṃ dadau tadā ..
gajārūḍhāśca te paṃca saṃyayuśca mahāvatīm .. 154 ..
3.3.d:
भूमिराजः प्रसन्नात्मा कोटिस्वर्णं ददौ तदा ॥
गजारूढाश्च ते पंच संययुश्च महावतीम् ॥ 154 ॥
3.3.m: Bhūmirāja, pleased in heart, then gave ten million in gold. / Mounted on elephants, those five departed for Mahāvatī.

3.3.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
varddhano bhūmirājasya sutaḥ sarvebhya uttamaḥ..
paṃcamābdavayā bhūtvā śrīdaṃ tuṣṭāva bhaktitaḥ..
varṣāṃtare ca bhagavāndadau sarvaṃ śubhaṃ nidhim ..155..
3.3.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
वर्द्धनो भूमिराजस्य सुतः सर्वेभ्य उत्तमः॥
पंचमाब्दवया भूत्वा श्रीदं तुष्टाव भक्तितः॥
वर्षांतरे च भगवान्ददौ सर्वं शुभं निधिम् ॥155॥
3.3.m: Sūta said: / Vardhana, the son of Bhūmirāja, was the best of all. / When he was five years of age, he praised Śrīda with devotion. / And after a year, the Lord gave every auspicious treasure.

3.3.s:
tatsarvanidhibhāvena nṛpakośaḥ samantataḥ ..
pūrṇo babhūva kanakai rājarājaprabhāvataḥ ..156..
3.3.d:
तत्सर्वनिधिभावेन नृपकोशः समन्ततः ॥
पूर्णो बभूव कनकै राजराजप्रभावतः ॥156॥
3.3.m: Because of all those treasures, the king's treasury on all sides / became filled with gold by the power of the king of kings.

3.3.s:
kiṃnarī nāma yā kanyā maṃkaṇasya prakīrtitā ..
kuberaśca dadau tasmai varddhanāya priyāya ca ..
iti te kathitaṃ sarvaṃ vivāhacaritaṃ mune .. 157 ..
3.3.d:
किंनरी नाम या कन्या मंकणस्य प्रकीर्तिता ॥
कुबेरश्च ददौ तस्मै वर्द्धनाय प्रियाय च ॥
इति ते कथितं सर्वं विवाहचरितं मुने ॥ 157 ॥
3.3.m: And Kubera gave that maiden named Kinnarī, celebrated as [daughter] of Maṅkaṇa, / to him, his dear Vardhana. / Thus all the details of the marriage have been told to you, O sage!

3.3.s:
dhundhukāro mahāśūro lakṣasainyasamanvitaḥ ..
brahmānaṃdamupāgamya yuddhārthāya tamāhvayat.. 158 ..
3.3.d:
धुन्धुकारो महाशूरो लक्षसैन्यसमन्वितः ॥
ब्रह्मानंदमुपागम्य युद्धार्थाय तमाह्वयत्॥ 158 ॥
3.3.m: Dhundhukāra, a great hero accompanied by an army of one hundred thousand, / approached Brahmānanda and challenged him to battle.

3.3.s:
ekatriṃśābdake prāpte kṛṣṇāṃśe balavattare ..
ekākī malanāputro dṛṣṭvā sainyamupasthitam ..
brahmāstraṃ cāpa ādhāya cārdhasainyamadāhayat .. 159 ..
3.3.d:
एकत्रिंशाब्दके प्राप्ते कृष्णांशे बलवत्तरे ॥
एकाकी मलनापुत्रो दृष्ट्वा सैन्यमुपस्थितम् ॥
ब्रह्मास्त्रं चाप आधाय चार्धसैन्यमदाहयत् ॥ 159 ॥
3.3.m: When the portion of Kṛṣṇa reached thirty-one years and was even mightier, / the son of Malanā, alone, seeing the army arrived, / set the Brahmā weapon to his bow and incinerated half the army.

3.3.s:
paṃcāyutāśca te śūrā bhayabhītā diśo gatāḥ ..
dhundhukāro raṇaṃ tvaktvā bhūmirājamupāgamat .. 3.3.31.160 ..
3.3.d:
पंचायुताश्च ते शूरा भयभीता दिशो गताः ॥
धुन्धुकारो रणं त्वक्त्वा भूमिराजमुपागमत् ॥ 3.3.31.160 ॥
3.3.m: And those fifty thousand heroes fled in all directions, terrified with fear. / Abandoning the battle, Dhundhukāra went to Bhūmirāja.

3.3.s:
mahīrājastadā duḥkhī bhayabhītaḥ samaṃtataḥ ..
mahīpatiṃ samāhūya candrabhaṭṭaṃ ca so'bravīt .. 161 ..
3.3.d:
महीराजस्तदा दुःखी भयभीतः समंततः ॥
महीपतिं समाहूय चन्द्रभट्टं च सोऽब्रवीत् ॥ 161 ॥
3.3.m: Then Mahīrāja, sorrowful and terrified on all sides, / summoned the ruler of the earth and spoke to Candrabhaṭṭa:

3.3.s:
kathaṃ jayo me bhavitā tatsarvaṃ maṃtrayāśu vai ..
mahīpatistadā prāha śṛṇu bhūpaśiromaṇe .. .. 162 ..
3.3.d:
कथं जयो मे भविता तत्सर्वं मंत्रयाशु वै ॥
महीपतिस्तदा प्राह शृणु भूपशिरोमणे ॥ ॥ 162 ॥
3.3.m: "How will my victory come to be? Counsel all of that swiftly!" / Then the ruler of the earth said: "Listen, O crest-jewel of kings!

3.3.s:
kṛtvā nārīmayaṃ veṣaṃ cāmuṇḍaṃ balaśālinam ..
velāṃ matvā ca taddolāṃ brahmānaṃdāya cārpaya .. 163 ..
3.3.d:
कृत्वा नारीमयं वेषं चामुण्डं बलशालिनम् ॥
वेलां मत्वा च तद्दोलां ब्रह्मानंदाय चार्पय ॥ 163 ॥
3.3.m: Having assumed a woman's disguise, disguise the mighty Cāmuṇḍa / as Velā, and deliver that palanquin to Brahmānanda!

3.3.s:
catvāraste sutāḥ śūrā dhuṃdhukāreṇa saṃyutā ..
chadmanā ca svaśastraiśca ghātayeyustamūrjitāḥ .. 164 ..
3.3.d:
चत्वारस्ते सुताः शूरा धुंधुकारेण संयुता ॥
छद्मना च स्वशस्त्रैश्च घातयेयुस्तमूर्जिताः ॥ 164 ॥
3.3.m: Your four heroic sons, accompanied by Dhundhukāra, / being powerful, should slay him by deceit and with their weapons!"

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā mahīrājo brahmānaṃdāya harṣitaḥ ..
tathā kṛtvā dadau dolāṃ paṃcaśūraiśca pālitām .. 165 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा महीराजो ब्रह्मानंदाय हर्षितः ॥
तथा कृत्वा ददौ दोलां पंचशूरैश्च पालिताम् ॥ 165 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing this, Mahīrāja, delighted, did so / and presented the palanquin, guarded by the five heroes, to Brahmānanda.

3.3.s:
sāyaṃkāle tu saṃprāpte māghaśuklāṣṭamīdine ..
velāvaṃśaśca cāmuṇḍo brahmānaṃdamupāyayau .. 166 ..
3.3.d:
सायंकाले तु संप्राप्ते माघशुक्लाष्टमीदिने ॥
वेलावंशश्च चामुण्डो ब्रह्मानंदमुपाययौ ॥ 166 ॥
3.3.m: When evening arrived on the day of the bright aṣṭamī of Māgha, / Cāmuṇḍa, disguised as Velā, approached Brahmānanda.

3.3.s:
chadmanā ca triśūlaṃ ca balātkṛtvā ripūdare ..
ruroda balavāñchūraste tu śūrāḥ samāgatāḥ .. 167 ..
3.3.d:
छद्मना च त्रिशूलं च बलात्कृत्वा रिपूदरे ॥
रुरोद बलवाञ्छूरस्ते तु शूराः समागताः ॥ 167 ॥
3.3.m: And by deceit, having forcefully thrust a trident into the enemy's belly, / the mighty hero wept, and those heroes arrived.

3.3.s:
tārako hṛdi taṃ bāṇaiḥ sūryavarmā ca tomaraiḥ ..
bhīmaśca gadayā cātra varddhanaśca tadāsinā ..
dhuṃdhukāraśca bhallena jaghāna ripumūrddhani .. 168 ..
3.3.d:
तारको हृदि तं बाणैः सूर्यवर्मा च तोमरैः ॥
भीमश्च गदया चात्र वर्द्धनश्च तदासिना ॥
धुंधुकारश्च भल्लेन जघान रिपुमूर्द्धनि ॥ 168 ॥
3.3.m: Tāraka struck the enemy on the chest with arrows, Sūryavarmā with javelins, / Bhīma with a mace, Vardhana with a sword, / and Dhundhukāra with a spear on the head.

3.3.s:
mūrchitaḥ patito bhūmau bahmānaṃdo mahābalaḥ ..
mahadvraṇayutastatra svakhaṅgaṃ ca samādadat .. 169 ..
3.3.d:
मूर्छितः पतितो भूमौ बह्मानंदो महाबलः ॥
महद्व्रणयुतस्तत्र स्वखङ्गं च समाददत् ॥ 169 ॥
3.3.m: Fainting, the mighty Brahmānanda fell to the ground, / covered in severe wounds there, and grasped his sword.

3.3.s:
bhīmasya ca śiraḥ kāyādvarddhanasya tathaiva ca ..
chittvā tathaiva bhūmadhye sūryavarmāṇamāgataṃḥ .. 3.3.31.170 ..
3.3.d:
भीमस्य च शिरः कायाद्वर्द्धनस्य तथैव च ॥
छित्त्वा तथैव भूमध्ये सूर्यवर्माणमागतंः ॥ 3.3.31.170 ॥
3.3.m: And severing Bhīma's head from his trunk, and likewise Vardhana's, / and Sūryavarman's as he came upon the ground,

3.3.s:
tārako dhuṃdhukāraśca cāmu ṇḍaśca tathaiva ca ..
brahmānaṃdaṃ tadā tyaktvā mahīrājāntamāyayau .. 171 ..
3.3.d:
तारको धुंधुकारश्च चामु ण्डश्च तथैव च ॥
ब्रह्मानंदं तदा त्यक्त्वा महीराजान्तमाययौ ॥ 171 ॥
3.3.m: Tāraka, Dhuṃdhukāra, and Cāmuṇḍa as well / then abandoned Brahmānanda and went to King Mahīrāja.

3.3.s:
hateṣu teṣu putreṣu mahīrājo bhayāturaḥ ..
velāpārśvamupāgamya ruroda bahu duḥkhitaḥ .. 172 ..
3.3.d:
हतेषु तेषु पुत्रेषु महीराजो भयातुरः ॥
वेलापार्श्वमुपागम्य रुरोद बहु दुःखितः ॥ 172 ॥
3.3.m: When those sons were slain, Mahīrāja was stricken with fear; / approaching Velā's side, deeply grieved, he wept aloud.

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā tadā velā dolāmāruhya satvaram ..
brahmānaṃdaṃ yayau śīghraṃ mūrcchitaṃ taṃ dadarśa ha .. 173 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा तदा वेला दोलामारुह्य सत्वरम् ॥
ब्रह्मानंदं ययौ शीघ्रं मूर्च्छितं तं ददर्श ह ॥ 173 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing this, Velā at once mounted a litter; / she went swiftly to Brahmānanda and saw him lying in a swoon.

3.3.s:
kaniṣṭhāmṛtabhāvena velāyā balavāṃstadā ..
utthāya rudatīṃ nārīṃ dadarśa rucirānvitām .. 174 ..
3.3.d:
कनिष्ठामृतभावेन वेलाया बलवांस्तदा ॥
उत्थाय रुदतीं नारीं ददर्श रुचिरान्विताम् ॥ 174 ॥
3.3.m: Then, through the nectar-like touch of Velā's little finger, the mighty warrior / arose and beheld the lovely woman weeping.

3.3.s:
kā tvaṃ kasya sutā ramyā saṃgrāme māmupasthitā ..
jalaṃ dehi mahā subhūrvacanaṃ kuru supriyam .. 175 ..
3.3.d:
का त्वं कस्य सुता रम्या संग्रामे मामुपस्थिता ॥
जलं देहि महा सुभूर्वचनं कुरु सुप्रियम् ॥ 175 ॥
3.3.m: "Who are you, fair lady? Whose daughter are you, that have come to me in battle? / Give me water, O lady of fair brow; speak words most dear."

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā tadā velā jalaṃ dattvā śucānvitā ..
vacanaṃ prāha vai rātrau śṛṇu tvaṃ malanāsuta .. 176 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा तदा वेला जलं दत्त्वा शुचान्विता ॥
वचनं प्राह वै रात्रौ शृणु त्वं मलनासुत ॥ 176 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing this, Velā gave him water, filled with sorrow, / and at night she spoke these words: "Listen, O son of Malanā!

3.3.s:
velā nāma mahībhartuḥ sutāhaṃ tvāmupasthitā ..
matpatiśca bhavāndhīraśchadmanā vaṃcakairhataḥ ..
jīvanaṃ kuru rājeṃdra bhuṃkṣva bhogānmayā saha .. 177 ..
3.3.d:
वेला नाम महीभर्तुः सुताहं त्वामुपस्थिता ॥
मत्पतिश्च भवान्धीरश्छद्मना वंचकैर्हतः ॥
जीवनं कुरु राजेंद्र भुंक्ष्व भोगान्मया सह ॥ 177 ॥
3.3.m: I am Velā by name, the daughter of the king, who have come to you. / You, the resolute one, are my husband, struck down deceitfully by treacherous men. / Return to life, O lord of kings; enjoy pleasures with me!"

3.3.s:
ityuktaḥ sa tu tāmāha kalikāle samāgate ..
jīvanānmaraṇaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ tasmānmadvacanaṃ kuru .. 178 ..
3.3.d:
इत्युक्तः स तु तामाह कलिकाले समागते ॥
जीवनान्मरणं श्रेष्ठं तस्मान्मद्वचनं कुरु ॥ 178 ॥
3.3.m: Thus addressed, he said to her: "Now that the Kali age has arrived, / death is better than life; therefore heed my words.

3.3.s:
harināgaramāruhya mayā sārddhaṃ śubhānane ..
gatvā tīrthāni ramyāṇi saṃtyajāmi kalevaram..179..
3.3.d:
हरिनागरमारुह्य मया सार्द्धं शुभानने ॥
गत्वा तीर्थानि रम्याणि संत्यजामि कलेवरम्॥179॥
3.3.m: Mounting the steed Harināgara together with me, O fair-faced one, / having gone to the delightful pilgrimage sites, I shall cast off my body."

3.3.s:
itpuktvā tau samāruhya pūrve ca kapilāntikam..
gatvā snātvā ca vidhivattatodhye jagmaturmudā..3.3.31.180..
3.3.d:
इत्पुक्त्वा तौ समारुह्य पूर्वे च कपिलान्तिकम्॥
गत्वा स्नात्वा च विधिवत्ततोध्ये जग्मतुर्मुदा॥3.3.31.180॥
3.3.m: Having spoken thus, the two mounted it and went eastward to Kapilā's presence; / having bathed according to rule, they then proceeded with joy.

3.3.s:
pṛthakpṛthaksutārthāni snātvā dattvā ca .jagmatuḥ ..
dakṣiṇe setubaṃdhānte paścime dvārikāmanu .. 181 ..
3.3.d:
पृथक्पृथक्सुतार्थानि स्नात्वा दत्त्वा च ।जग्मतुः ॥
दक्षिणे सेतुबंधान्ते पश्चिमे द्वारिकामनु ॥ 181 ॥
3.3.m: Having bathed at the various sacred shrines and given [gifts], they proceeded / southward as far as Setubandha, and westward to Dvārikā.

3.3.s:
uttare badarīsthāne snātvā tīrthāni jagmatuḥ ..
gaṃdhamādanamāgatya brahmānaṃdo mahābalaḥ .. 182 ..
3.3.d:
उत्तरे बदरीस्थाने स्नात्वा तीर्थानि जग्मतुः ॥
गंधमादनमागत्य ब्रह्मानंदो महाबलः ॥ 182 ॥
3.3.m: In the north, having bathed at the site of Badarī, they visited the pilgrimage places; / and reaching Gandhamādana, the mighty Brahmānanda

3.3.s:
velāmuvāca vacanaṃ bhādraśuklāṣṭamīdine ..
dehaṃ tyajāmi bho rājñi tārakaṃ jahi bhūtale ..183..
3.3.d:
वेलामुवाच वचनं भाद्रशुक्लाष्टमीदिने ॥
देहं त्यजामि भो राज्ञि तारकं जहि भूतले ॥183॥
3.3.m: spoke these words to Velā: "On the day of the bright aṣṭamī of Bhādra, / I shall cast off my body, O queen; slay Tāraka upon the earth!"

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā tu sā prāha svāminmadvacanaṃ kuru ..
kurukṣetraṃ mayā sārddhaṃ bhavānvai gaṃtumarhati ..184..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा तु सा प्राह स्वामिन्मद्वचनं कुरु ॥
कुरुक्षेत्रं मया सार्द्धं भवान्वै गंतुमर्हति ॥184॥
3.3.m: Hearing this, she said: "O lord, do as I say: / you ought to go with me to Kurukṣetra.

3.3.s:
sthitvā tatra samasvānto bhaja tvaṃ sarvamaṃgalām ..
ahaṃ mahāvatīṃ prāpya punarvai dehalīṃ prati .. 185 ..
3.3.d:
स्थित्वा तत्र समस्वान्तो भज त्वं सर्वमंगलाम् ॥
अहं महावतीं प्राप्य पुनर्वै देहलीं प्रति ॥ 185 ॥
3.3.m: Remaining there with calm mind, worship Sarvamaṅgalā. / Reaching Mahāvatī, and then once more toward Delhi,

3.3.s:
tārakaṃ ca tathā hatvā tvatsamīpaṃ vrajāmyaham ..
ityuktaḥ sa tathetyuktvā brahmadhyānaparo'bhavat .. 186 ..
3.3.d:
तारकं च तथा हत्वा त्वत्समीपं व्रजाम्यहम् ॥
इत्युक्तः स तथेत्युक्त्वा ब्रह्मध्यानपरोऽभवत् ॥ 186 ॥
3.3.m: and slaying Tāraka, I shall return to your presence." / Thus addressed, he said, "So be it," and became devoted to meditation on Brahman.

3.3.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
dvātriṃśābde ca kṛṣṇāṃśe saṃprāpte yogarūpiṇī ..
velā nāma śubhā nārī harināgarasaṃsthitā ..
mahāvatīṃ samāgamya sabhāyāṃ tatra cāviśat .. 1 ..
3.3.d:
॥ सूत उवाच ॥ ॥
द्वात्रिंशाब्दे च कृष्णांशे संप्राप्ते योगरूपिणी ॥
वेला नाम शुभा नारी हरिनागरसंस्थिता ॥
महावतीं समागम्य सभायां तत्र चाविशत् ॥ 1 ॥
3.3.m: Sūta said: / In the thirty-second year, when Kṛṣṇāṃśa had arrived, the auspicious woman / named Velā, embodiment of yoga, mounted on Harināgara, / reached Mahāvatī and entered the assembly there.

3.3.s:
etasminnaṃtare prāptāḥ kṛṣṇāṃśādyā mahābalāḥ ..
natvā parimalaṃ bhūpaṃ velā vacanamabravīt .. 2 ..
3.3.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे प्राप्ताः कृष्णांशाद्या महाबलाः ॥
नत्वा परिमलं भूपं वेला वचनमब्रवीत् ॥ 2 ॥
3.3.m: Meanwhile, the mighty warriors led by Kṛṣṇāṃśa arrived; / having bowed to King Parimala, Velā spoke these words:

3.3.s:
mahīpatiṃ priyaṃ matvā kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ nṛpa duṣpriyam ..
tvayā me ghātito bhartā brahmānaṃdo mahābalaḥ .. 3 ..
3.3.d:
महीपतिं प्रियं मत्वा कृष्णांशं नृप दुष्प्रियम् ॥
त्वया मे घातितो भर्ता ब्रह्मानंदो महाबलः ॥ 3 ॥
3.3.m: "Thinking the ruler of the earth to be dear, and Kṛṣṇāṃśa disliked, O king, / you caused my husband, the mighty Brahmānanda, to be slain

3.3.s:
mahīrājasutairdhūrtaistārakādyairmahābalaiḥ ..
nārīveṣaṃ ca cāmuṇḍo dhuṃdhukāreṇa kāritaḥ .. 4 ..
3.3.d:
महीराजसुतैर्धूर्तैस्तारकाद्यैर्महाबलैः ॥
नारीवेषं च चामुण्डो धुंधुकारेण कारितः ॥ 4 ॥
3.3.m: by the deceitful sons of Mahīrāja, the mighty Tāraka and the others. / And Cāmuṇḍa was made by Dhuṃdhukāra to disguise himself as a woman.

3.3.s:
svāminaṃ prati cāgamya te jagmuśchadmanā priyam ..
kurukṣetraṃ sthitaḥ svāmī mahatyā mūrchayānvitaḥ ..
tasmādyūyaṃ mayā sārddhaṃ gaṃtumarhatha taṃ prati .. 5 ..
3.3.d:
स्वामिनं प्रति चागम्य ते जग्मुश्छद्मना प्रियम् ॥
कुरुक्षेत्रं स्थितः स्वामी महत्या मूर्छयान्वितः ॥
तस्माद्यूयं मया सार्द्धं गंतुमर्हथ तं प्रति ॥ 5 ॥
3.3.m: Approaching my husband, they went deceitfully to my beloved. / My husband stays at Kurukṣetra, overcome with a deep swoon; / therefore you ought to go with me to him."

3.3.s:
iti ghoratamaṃ vākyaṃ śrutvā sarve śucānvitāḥ ..
dhigbhūpatiṃ ca malanāṃ tābhyāṃ no ghātitaḥ sakhā .. 6 ..
3.3.d:
इति घोरतमं वाक्यं श्रुत्वा सर्वे शुचान्विताः ॥
धिग्भूपतिं च मलनां ताभ्यां नो घातितः सखा ॥ 6 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing these most terrible words, all were filled with sorrow: / "Fie upon the king and upon Malanā! By those two our friend was slain!"

3.3.s:
ityuktvoccaiśca ruruduḥ kṛṣṇāṃśādyā mahābalāḥ ..
patrāṇi preṣayāmāsuḥ svakīyānbhūpatī nprati .. 7 ..
3.3.d:
इत्युक्त्वोच्चैश्च रुरुदुः कृष्णांशाद्या महाबलाः ॥
पत्राणि प्रेषयामासुः स्वकीयान्भूपती न्प्रति ॥ 7 ॥
3.3.m: Having said this, the mighty warriors led by Kṛṣṇāṃśa wept aloud; / they dispatched letters to their own kings.

3.3.s:
krodhayuktā tadā velā likhitvā patramulbaṇam ..
mahīrājāya saṃpreṣya malanāgehamāgamat .. 8 ..
3.3.d:
क्रोधयुक्ता तदा वेला लिखित्वा पत्रमुल्बणम् ॥
महीराजाय संप्रेष्य मलनागेहमागमत् ॥ 8 ॥
3.3.m: Then Velā, filled with wrath, wrote a fierce letter, / sent it to Mahīrāja, and went to Malanā's house.

3.3.s:
tatpatraṃ ca mahīrājo vācayitvā vidhānataḥ ..
jñātvā tatkāraṇaṃ sarvaṃ tanniśamya viśāmpatiḥ .. 9 ..
3.3.d:
तत्पत्रं च महीराजो वाचयित्वा विधानतः ॥
ज्ञात्वा तत्कारणं सर्वं तन्निशम्य विशाम्पतिः ॥ 9 ॥
3.3.m: Mahīrāja had that letter read according to rule; / knowing the whole reason for it, when he heard it, the lord of men

3.3.s:
cintākalevaraṃ prāpya sukhanidrāṃ vyanāśayat ..
āhūya bhūpatīnsarvānghorayuddhonmukho'bhavat .. 3.3.32.10 ..
3.3.d:
चिन्ताकलेवरं प्राप्य सुखनिद्रां व्यनाशयत् ॥
आहूय भूपतीन्सर्वान्घोरयुद्धोन्मुखोऽभवत् ॥ 3.3.32.10 ॥
3.3.m: became an embodiment of anxiety and lost his peaceful sleep; / summoning all the kings, he resolved upon a terrible war.

3.3.s:
caturviṃśatilakṣaiśca śūrairbhūpasamanvitaiḥ ..
kurukṣetraṃ yayau śīghraṃ dhṛtarāṣṭrāṃśasaṃbhavaḥ .. 11 ..
3.3.d:
चतुर्विंशतिलक्षैश्च शूरैर्भूपसमन्वितैः ॥
कुरुक्षेत्रं ययौ शीघ्रं धृतराष्ट्रांशसंभवः ॥ 11 ॥
3.3.m: Born of the portion of Dhṛtarāṣṭra, he went quickly to Kurukṣetra / with twenty-four hundred thousand heroes accompanied by kings.

3.3.s:
tathā parimalo bhūpo lakṣaṣoḍaśasainyapaḥ ..
drupadāṃśo yayau śīghraṃ velayā svakulaiḥ saha .. 12 ..
3.3.d:
तथा परिमलो भूपो लक्षषोडशसैन्यपः ॥
द्रुपदांशो ययौ शीघ्रं वेलया स्वकुलैः सह ॥ 12 ॥
3.3.m: Likewise King Parimala, commander of an army of sixteen hundred thousand, / an incarnation of Drupada, went swiftly with Velā and his kinsmen.

3.3.s:
syamantapaṃcake tīrthe śibirāṇi cakāra ha ..
brahmānaṃdaḥ sthito yatra samādhidhyānatatparaḥ .. 13 ..
3.3.d:
स्यमन्तपंचके तीर्थे शिबिराणि चकार ह ॥
ब्रह्मानंदः स्थितो यत्र समाधिध्यानतत्परः ॥ 13 ॥
3.3.m: He pitched his camp at the sacred site of Syamantapañcaka, / where Brahmānanda remained, absorbed in meditation and concentration.

3.3.s:
gaṃgākūle ca te sarve kauravāṃśā mahābalāḥ ..
śibirāṇi vicitrāṇi cakruste vijayaiṣiṇaḥ ..14..
3.3.d:
गंगाकूले च ते सर्वे कौरवांशा महाबलाः ॥
शिबिराणि विचित्राणि चक्रुस्ते विजयैषिणः ॥14॥
3.3.m: And on the bank of the Gaṅgā, all those mighty warriors born of the Kauravas' portion / made manifold camps, eager for victory.

3.3.s:
kṛtvā te kārtikīsnānaṃ dattvā dānānyanekaśaḥ ..
mārgakṛṣṇadvitīyāyāṃ yuddhabhūmimupāyayuḥ .. 15 ..
3.3.d:
कृत्वा ते कार्तिकीस्नानं दत्त्वा दानान्यनेकशः ॥
मार्गकृष्णद्वितीयायां युद्धभूमिमुपाययुः ॥ 15 ॥
3.3.m: Having performed the bath on the Kārtikī day and given numerous gifts, / on the second lunar day of the dark fortnight of Mārgaśīrṣa they advanced to the battlefield.

3.3.s:
viṣvaksenīyabhūpālo laharastatra cāgataḥ ..
kauravāṃśāśca tatputrāḥ ṣoḍaśaiva mahābalāḥ ..
pūrvajanmani yannāma tannāmnā praśritā iha .. 16 ..
3.3.d:
विष्वक्सेनीयभूपालो लहरस्तत्र चागतः ॥
कौरवांशाश्च तत्पुत्राः षोडशैव महाबलाः ॥
पूर्वजन्मनि यन्नाम तन्नाम्ना प्रश्रिता इह ॥ 16 ॥
3.3.m: Lahara, a king of Viṣvaksena's lineage, arrived there, / and his sixteen mighty sons, incarnations of the Kauravas; / with the names they bore in their previous birth, they were renowned here:

3.3.s:
dussaho duśśalaścaiva jalasaṃdhaḥ samaḥ sahaḥ ..
viṃdastathānuviṃdaśca subāhurduṣpradharṣaṇaḥ .. 17 ..
3.3.d:
दुस्सहो दुश्शलश्चैव जलसंधः समः सहः ॥
विंदस्तथानुविंदश्च सुबाहुर्दुष्प्रधर्षणः ॥ 17 ॥
3.3.m: Dussaha, Duśśala, Jalasaṃdha, Sama, Saha, / Vinda, and Anuvinda, Subāhu, Duṣpradharṣaṇa,

3.3.s:
durmarṣaṇaśca duṣkarṇaḥ somakīrtiranūdaraḥ ..
śalaḥ sattvo vivitsuśca kramājjñeyā mahābalāḥ .. 18 ..
3.3.d:
दुर्मर्षणश्च दुष्कर्णः सोमकीर्तिरनूदरः ॥
शलः सत्त्वो विवित्सुश्च क्रमाज्ज्ञेया महाबलाः ॥ 18 ॥
3.3.m: Durmarṣaṇa, Duṣkarṇa, Somakīrti, Anūdara, / Śala, Sattva, and Vivitsu are to be known in order, mighty in valour.

3.3.s:
tomarānvayabhūpālo bāhlīkapatirāgataḥ ..
trilakṣaiśca tathā sainyaiḥ saptaputraiśca bhūpatiḥ .. 19 ..
3.3.d:
तोमरान्वयभूपालो बाह्लीकपतिरागतः ॥
त्रिलक्षैश्च तथा सैन्यैः सप्तपुत्रैश्च भूपतिः ॥ 19 ॥
3.3.m: The king born of the Tomara lineage, ruler of Bāhlīka, arrived, / a king with three hundred thousand troops and seven sons:

3.3.s:
citropacitrau citrākṣaścāruścitraḥ śarāsanaḥ ..
sulocanaḥ savarṇaśca pūrvajanmani kauravāḥ .. 3.3.32.20 ..
3.3.d:
चित्रोपचित्रौ चित्राक्षश्चारुश्चित्रः शरासनः ॥
सुलोचनः सवर्णश्च पूर्वजन्मनि कौरवाः ॥ 3.3.32.20 ॥
3.3.m: Citra, Upacitra, Citrākṣa, Cārucitra, Śarāsana, / Sulocana, and Savarṇa, who were Kauravas in their previous birth.

3.3.s:
teṣāmaṃśāḥ kramājjātā abhinaṃdanadehajāḥ ..
mahānaṃdaśca naṃdaśca parānaṃdopanaṃdakau ..
sunaṃdaśca surānandaḥ pranaṃdaḥ kauravāṃśakaḥ .. 21 ..
3.3.d:
तेषामंशाः क्रमाज्जाता अभिनंदनदेहजाः ॥
महानंदश्च नंदश्च परानंदोपनंदकौ ॥
सुनंदश्च सुरानन्दः प्रनंदः कौरवांशकः ॥ 21 ॥
3.3.m: Born as their portions in order from the body of Abhinandana were / Mahānanda, Nanda, Parānanda, Upanandaka, / Sunanda, Surānanda, and Prananda, incarnations of the Kauravas.

3.3.s:
nṛpaḥ pariharavaṃśīyo māyāvarmā mahābalī ..
lakṣa sainyayutaḥ prāpto daśaputrasamanvitaḥ .. 22 ..
3.3.d:
नृपः परिहरवंशीयो मायावर्मा महाबली ॥
लक्ष सैन्ययुतः प्राप्तो दशपुत्रसमन्वितः ॥ 22 ॥
3.3.m: The mighty King Māyāvarman of the Parihāra dynasty / arrived accompanied by an army of one hundred thousand and ten sons:

3.3.s:
durmado durvigāhaśca naṃdaśca vikaṭānanaḥ ..
citravarmā suvarmā ca sudurmocana eva ca .. 23 ..
3.3.d:
दुर्मदो दुर्विगाहश्च नंदश्च विकटाननः ॥
चित्रवर्मा सुवर्मा च सुदुर्मोचन एव च ॥ 23 ॥
3.3.m: Durmada, Durvigāha, Nanda, Vikaṭānana, / Citravarman, Suvarman, and Sudurmocana,

3.3.s:
ūrṇanābhaḥ sunābhaśca copanaṃdaśca kauravāḥ ..
teṣāmaṃśāḥ kramājjātāḥ sutā aṃgapateḥ smṛtāḥ 24 ..
3.3.d:
ऊर्णनाभः सुनाभश्च चोपनंदश्च कौरवाः ॥
तेषामंशाः क्रमाज्जाताः सुता अंगपतेः स्मृताः 24 ॥
3.3.m: Ūrṇanābha, Sunābha, and Upananda were Kauravas; / portions of them, born in succession, are commemorated as the sons of the lord of Aṅga:

3.3.s:
mattaḥ pramatta unmattaḥ sumatto durmadastathā..
durmukho durdaro vāyuḥ suratho virathaḥ kramāt .. 25 ..
3.3.d:
मत्तः प्रमत्त उन्मत्तः सुमत्तो दुर्मदस्तथा॥
दुर्मुखो दुर्दरो वायुः सुरथो विरथः क्रमात् ॥ 25 ॥
3.3.m: Matta, Pramatta, Unmatta, Sumatta, and Durmada, / Durmukha, Durdhara, Vāyu, Suratha, and Viratha in order.

3.3.s:
śuklavaṃśīyabhūpālo mūlavarmā samāgataḥ ..
lakṣasainyaiśca balavāndaśaputrasamanvitaḥ .. 26 ..
3.3.d:
शुक्लवंशीयभूपालो मूलवर्मा समागतः ॥
लक्षसैन्यैश्च बलवान्दशपुत्रसमन्वितः ॥ 26 ॥
3.3.m: King Mūlavarman, born of the Śukla lineage, arrived, / powerful, accompanied by an army of one hundred thousand, along with ten sons:

3.3.s:
ayobāhurmahābāhuścitrāṃgaścitrakuṇḍalaḥ ..
citrāyudho niṣaṃgī ca pāśī vṛndārakastathā .. 27 ..
3.3.d:
अयोबाहुर्महाबाहुश्चित्रांगश्चित्रकुण्डलः ॥
चित्रायुधो निषंगी च पाशी वृन्दारकस्तथा ॥ 27 ॥
3.3.m: Ayobāhu, Mahābāhu, Citrāṅga, Citrakuṇḍala, / Citrāyudha, Niṣaṅgin, Pāśin, Vṛndāraka,

3.3.s:
dṛḍhavarmā dṛḍhakṣatraḥ pūrvajanmani kauravāḥ ..
teṣāmaṃśā mahīṃ jātā gṛhe te mūlavarmaṇaḥ .. 28 ..
3.3.d:
दृढवर्मा दृढक्षत्रः पूर्वजन्मनि कौरवाः ॥
तेषामंशा महीं जाता गृहे ते मूलवर्मणः ॥ 28 ॥
3.3.m: Dṛḍhavarman, and Dṛḍhakṣatra were Kauravas in a former birth; / portions of them were born on earth in the house of Mūlavarman:

3.3.s:
balaśca prabalaścaiva subalo balavānbalī ..
sumūlaśca mahāmūlo durgo bhīmo bhayaṃkaraḥ .. 29 ..
3.3.d:
बलश्च प्रबलश्चैव सुबलो बलवान्बली ॥
सुमूलश्च महामूलो दुर्गो भीमो भयंकरः ॥ 29 ॥
3.3.m: Bala, Prabala, Subala, Balavat, Balin, / Sumūla, Mahāmūla, Durga, Bhīma, and Bhayaṅkara.

3.3.s:
kaikayaścaṃdravaṃśīyo lakṣasainyasamanvitaḥ ..
daśaputrānvitaḥ prāptaḥ kurukṣetre mahā raṇe .. 3.3.32.30 ..
3.3.d:
कैकयश्चंद्रवंशीयो लक्षसैन्यसमन्वितः ॥
दशपुत्रान्वितः प्राप्तः कुरुक्षेत्रे महा रणे ॥ 3.3.32.30 ॥
3.3.m: Kaikaya, born of the Lunar lineage, accompanied by an army of one hundred thousand / and accompanied by ten sons, arrived at Kurukṣetra for the great battle:

3.3.s:
bhīmavego bhīmabalo balākī balavarddhanaḥ ..
ugrāyudho daṃḍadharo dṛḍhasaṃdho mahīdharaḥ ..31..
3.3.d:
भीमवेगो भीमबलो बलाकी बलवर्द्धनः ॥
उग्रायुधो दंडधरो दृढसंधो महीधरः ॥31॥
3.3.m: Bhīmavega, Bhīmabala, Balākin, Balavardhana, / Ugrāyudha, Daṇḍadhara, Dṛḍhasaṃdha, Mahīdhara,

3.3.s:
jarāsaṃdhaḥ satyasaṃdhaḥ pūrvajanmani kauravāḥ ..
teṣāmaṃśāḥ samudbhūtāḥ kaikayasya gṛhe śubhe .. 32 ..
3.3.d:
जरासंधः सत्यसंधः पूर्वजन्मनि कौरवाः ॥
तेषामंशाः समुद्भूताः कैकयस्य गृहे शुभे ॥ 32 ॥
3.3.m: Jarāsaṃdha, and Satyasaṃdha were Kauravas in a former birth; / portions of them were born in the auspicious house of Kaikaya:

3.3.s:
kāmaḥ prakāmaḥ saṃkāmo niṣkāmo nirapatrapaḥ ..
jayaśca vijayaścaiva jayaṃto jayavāñjayaḥ .. 33 ..
3.3.d:
