कामः प्रकामः संकामो निष्कामो निरपत्रपः ॥
जयश्च विजयश्चैव जयंतो जयवाञ्जयः ॥ 33 ॥
3.3.m: Kāma, Prakāma, Saṅkāma, Niṣkāma, Nirapatrapa, / Jaya, Vijaya, Jayanta, Jayavat, and Jaya.

3.3.s:
nāgavaṃśīyabhūpālo nāgavarmā samāgataḥ ..
lakṣasenānvitaḥ prāpto daśaputrasamanvitaḥ ..34..
3.3.d:
नागवंशीयभूपालो नागवर्मा समागतः ॥
लक्षसेनान्वितः प्राप्तो दशपुत्रसमन्वितः ॥34॥
3.3.m: King Nāgavarman, born of the Nāga lineage, arrived, / accompanied by an army of one hundred thousand, along with ten sons.

3.3.s:
pūrvajanmani yannāmnā tannāmnā kauravā bhuvi..
puṃḍradeśapateḥ putrā jātā daśa śivājñayā ..35..
3.3.d:
पूर्वजन्मनि यन्नाम्ना तन्नाम्ना कौरवा भुवि॥
पुंड्रदेशपतेः पुत्रा जाता दश शिवाज्ञया ॥35॥
3.3.m: Those Kauravas, by whatever name they had in a former birth, / were born on earth with the same names as ten sons of the lord of the Puṇḍra country by order of Śiva:

3.3.s:
ugraśravā ugrasenaḥ senānīrduṣparāyaṇaḥ..
aparājitaḥ kuṇḍaśāyī viśālākṣo durādharaḥ..36..
3.3.d:
उग्रश्रवा उग्रसेनः सेनानीर्दुष्परायणः॥
अपराजितः कुण्डशायी विशालाक्षो दुराधरः॥36॥
3.3.m: Ugraśravas, Ugrasena, Senānī, Duṣparāyaṇa, / Aparājita, Kuṇḍaśāyin, Viśālākṣa, Durādhara,

3.3.s: dṛḍhahastaḥ suhastaśca sutāste nāgavarmaṇaḥ .. 37 ..
3.3.d: दृढहस्तः सुहस्तश्च सुतास्ते नागवर्मणः ॥ 37 ॥
3.3.m: Dṛḍhahasta, and Suhasta—these were the sons of Nāgavarman.

3.3.s:
madrakeśaḥ samāyātastomarānvayasaṃbhavaḥ ..
lakṣasainyairyuto rājā daśaputrasamanvitaḥ .. 38 ..
3.3.d:
मद्रकेशः समायातस्तोमरान्वयसंभवः ॥
लक्षसैन्यैर्युतो राजा दशपुत्रसमन्वितः ॥ 38 ॥
3.3.m: Madrakeśa arrived, born of the Tomara lineage; / the king, accompanied by an army of one hundred thousand, was endowed with ten sons:

3.3.s:
vātavegaḥ suvarcāśca nāgadaṃtograyājakaḥ ..
ādiketuśca vakśī ca kavacī krātha eva ca .. 39 ..
3.3.d:
वातवेगः सुवर्चाश्च नागदंतोग्रयाजकः ॥
आदिकेतुश्च वक्शी च कवची क्राथ एव च ॥ 39 ॥
3.3.m: Vātavega, Suvarcas, Nāgadanta, Ugrayājaka, / Ādiketu, Vakśin, Kavacī, and Krātha,

3.3.s:
kuṇḍaśca kuṇḍadhāraśca kauravāḥ pūrvajanmani ..
tannāmnā bhuvi vai jātā madra keśasya maṃdire .. 3.3.32.40 ..
3.3.d:
कुण्डश्च कुण्डधारश्च कौरवाः पूर्वजन्मनि ॥
तन्नाम्ना भुवि वै जाता मद्र केशस्य मंदिरे ॥ 3.3.32.40 ॥
3.3.m: Kuṇḍa, and Kuṇḍadhāra were Kauravas in a former birth; / with those very names they were indeed born on earth in the palace of Madrakeśa.

3.3.s:
nṛpaḥ śārdūlavaṃśīyau lakṣasainyasamanvitaḥ ..
pūrṇāmalo māgadheśo daśaputrānvito yayau .. 41 ..
3.3.d:
नृपः शार्दूलवंशीयौ लक्षसैन्यसमन्वितः ॥
पूर्णामलो मागधेशो दशपुत्रान्वितो ययौ ॥ 41 ॥
3.3.m: The king born of the Śārdūla lineage, accompanied by an army of one hundred thousand, / Pūrṇāmala, lord of Magadha, departed accompanied by ten sons:

3.3.s:
vīrabāhurbhīmarathaścograścaiva dhanurdharaḥ..
raudrakarmā dṛḍharatho'lolupaścābhayastathā..42..
3.3.d:
वीरबाहुर्भीमरथश्चोग्रश्चैव धनुर्धरः॥
रौद्रकर्मा दृढरथोऽलोलुपश्चाभयस्तथा॥42॥
3.3.m: Vīrabāhu, Bhīmaratha, Ugra, Dhanurdhara, / Raudrakarman, Dṛḍharatha, Alolupa, Abhaya,

3.3.s:
anādhṛṣṭaḥ kuṇḍabhedī kauravāḥ pūrvajanmani..
pūrṇāmalasya vai gehe tannāmnā bhuvi saṃbhava..43..
3.3.d:
अनाधृष्टः कुण्डभेदी कौरवाः पूर्वजन्मनि॥
पूर्णामलस्य वै गेहे तन्नाम्ना भुवि संभव॥43॥
3.3.m: Anādhṛṣṭa, and Kuṇḍabhedin were Kauravas in a former birth; / with those very names their birth took place on earth in the house of Pūrṇāmala.

3.3.s:
maṃkaṇaḥ kiṃnaro nāma rūpadeśe mahīpatiḥ ..
cīnadeśātpare pāre rūmadeśaḥ smṛto budhaiḥ ..
naraḥ kinnarajātīyo vasati priyadarśanaḥ .. 44 ..
3.3.d:
मंकणः किंनरो नाम रूपदेशे महीपतिः ॥
चीनदेशात्परे पारे रूमदेशः स्मृतो बुधैः ॥
नरः किन्नरजातीयो वसति प्रियदर्शनः ॥ 44 ॥
3.3.m: A kinnara named Maṅkaṇa was a monarch in the country of Rūma; / across the further bank from the country of Cīna, the country of Rūma is remembered by the wise, / where men of the kinnara class, handsome in appearance, dwell.

3.3.s:
maṃkaṇaśca tadā prāptaḥ kinnarāyutasaṃyutaḥ ..
aṣṭaputrānvitaḥ prāpto yatra sarvanṛpāḥ sthitāḥ .. 45 ..
3.3.d:
मंकणश्च तदा प्राप्तः किन्नरायुतसंयुतः ॥
अष्टपुत्रान्वितः प्राप्तो यत्र सर्वनृपाः स्थिताः ॥ 45 ॥
3.3.m: Then Maṅkaṇa arrived, accompanied by ten thousand kinnaras, / endowed with eight sons, [he] arrived where all the kings stood:

3.3.s:
virāvī prathamaścaiva pramāthī dīrgharomakaḥ ..
dīrghabāhurmahābāhurvyūḍhorāḥ kanakadhvajaḥ .. 46 ..
3.3.d:
विरावी प्रथमश्चैव प्रमाथी दीर्घरोमकः ॥
दीर्घबाहुर्महाबाहुर्व्यूढोराः कनकध्वजः ॥ 46 ॥
3.3.m: Virāvin was first, and Pramāthin, Dīrgharoman, / Dīrghabāhu, Mahābāhu, Vyūḍhoraska, and Kanakadhvaja.

3.3.s:
pūrvajanmani yannāmnā tannāmnā kinnarā bhuvi ..
virajoṃśaśca yo jāto maṃkaṇo nāma kinnaraḥ ..47..
3.3.d:
पूर्वजन्मनि यन्नाम्ना तन्नाम्ना किन्नरा भुवि ॥
विरजोंशश्च यो जातो मंकणो नाम किन्नरः ॥47॥
3.3.m: By whatever names [they were called] in a former birth, with those names the kinnaras [appeared] on earth; / and he who was born as a portion of Virajas was the kinnara named Maṅkaṇa.

3.3.s:
netrasiṃhaḥ samāyāto lakṣasainyasamanvitaḥ ..
śalyāṃśaḥ sa tu vijñeyaḥ śārdūlānvayasaṃbhavaḥ .. 48 ..
3.3.d:
नेत्रसिंहः समायातो लक्षसैन्यसमन्वितः ॥
शल्यांशः स तु विज्ञेयः शार्दूलान्वयसंभवः ॥ 48 ॥
3.3.m: Netrasiṃha arrived, accompanied by an army of one hundred thousand; / he should be known as a portion of Śalya, born of the Śārdūla lineage.

3.3.s:
tadā gajapatī rājā lakṣasainyasamanvitaḥ..
saṃprāptaḥ śakuneraṃśastyaktvā gehe svaputrakān ..49..
3.3.d:
तदा गजपती राजा लक्षसैन्यसमन्वितः॥
संप्राप्तः शकुनेरंशस्त्यक्त्वा गेहे स्वपुत्रकान् ॥49॥
3.3.m: Then King Gajapati, accompanied by an army of one hundred thousand, / arrived, an incarnation of Śakuni, having left his own sons at home.

3.3.s:
mayūradhvaja evāpi lakṣasainyasamanvitaḥ ..
makaraṃdaṃ gṛhe tyaktvā virāṭāṃśaḥ samāgataḥ .. 3.3.32.50 ..
3.3.d:
मयूरध्वज एवापि लक्षसैन्यसमन्वितः ॥
मकरंदं गृहे त्यक्त्वा विराटांशः समागतः ॥ 3.3.32.50 ॥
3.3.m: Mayūradhvaja as well, accompanied by an army of one hundred thousand, / an incarnation of Virāṭa, arrived, having left Makaranda at home.

3.3.s:
vīrasenaḥ samāyātaḥ kāmasenasamanvitaḥ ..
lakṣasenānvitastatra cograsenāṃśasaṃbhavaḥ ..51..
3.3.d:
वीरसेनः समायातः कामसेनसमन्वितः ॥
लक्षसेनान्वितस्तत्र चोग्रसेनांशसंभवः ॥51॥
3.3.m: Vīrasena arrived, accompanied by Kāmasena / and an army of one hundred thousand there, an incarnation of Ugrasena.

3.3.s:
lakṣaṇaśca samāyātaḥ saptalakṣabalairyutaḥ ..
saṃtyajya padminīṃ nārīṃ mahā kaṣṭena bhūpatiḥ ..52..
3.3.d:
लक्षणश्च समायातः सप्तलक्षबलैर्युतः ॥
संत्यज्य पद्मिनीं नारीं महा कष्टेन भूपतिः ॥52॥
3.3.m: And Lakṣaṇa arrived, endowed with forces of seven hundred thousand; / abandoning the lotus-like woman [Padminī] with great hardship, the monarch [came].

3.3.s:
tālano dhānyapālaśca lallasiṃhastathaiva ca ..
bhīmasyāṃśo yuyutsośca kuṃtibhojasya vai kramāt ..53 ..
3.3.d:
तालनो धान्यपालश्च लल्लसिंहस्तथैव च ॥
भीमस्यांशो युयुत्सोश्च कुंतिभोजस्य वै क्रमात् ॥53 ॥
3.3.m: Tālana, Dhānyapāla, and likewise Lallasiṃha / were portions of Bhīma, Yuyutsu, and Kuntibhoja respectively in order.

3.3.s:
āhlādaśca samāyātaḥ kṛṣṇāṃśena samanvitaḥ ..
jayantena ca vai vīro lakṣasainyānvito balī .. 54 ..
3.3.d:
आह्लादश्च समायातः कृष्णांशेन समन्वितः ॥
जयन्तेन च वै वीरो लक्षसैन्यान्वितो बली ॥ 54 ॥
3.3.m: And Āhlāda arrived, endowed with a portion of Kṛṣṇa, / along with Jayanta—the hero was mighty, accompanied by an army of one hundred thousand.

3.3.s:
jagannāyaka evāpi śūrāyutasamanvitaḥ ..
saṃprāpto bhagadattāṃśo gautamānvayasaṃbhavaḥ .. 55 ..
3.3.d:
जगन्नायक एवापि शूरायुतसमन्वितः ॥
संप्राप्तो भगदत्तांशो गौतमान्वयसंभवः ॥ 55 ॥
3.3.m: Jagannāyaka as well, accompanied by ten thousand warriors, / arrived, an incarnation of Bhagadatta, born of the Gautama lineage.

3.3.s:
anye ca kṣudrabhūpāśca sahasrāḍhyāḥ pṛthakpṛthak ..
kurukṣetraṃ paraṃ sthānaṃ saṃyayurmadavihvalāḥ .. 56 ..
3.3.d:
अन्ये च क्षुद्रभूपाश्च सहस्राढ्याः पृथक्पृथक् ॥
कुरुक्षेत्रं परं स्थानं संययुर्मदविह्वलाः ॥ 56 ॥
3.3.m: And other minor kings, each possessing thousands [of troops], / went to Kurukṣetra, the supreme place, agitated with warrior-frenzy.

3.3.s:
mūlavarmā ca nṛpatiḥ saputro lakṣasainyapaḥ ..
nṛpaṃ parimalaṃ prāpya saṃyukto dehalīpateḥ .. 57 ..
3.3.d:
मूलवर्मा च नृपतिः सपुत्रो लक्षसैन्यपः ॥
नृपं परिमलं प्राप्य संयुक्तो देहलीपतेः ॥ 57 ॥
3.3.m: King Mūlavarman, with his sons, commander of an army of one hundred thousand, / having reached King Parimala, joined the side of the lord of Dehalī.

3.3.s:
kaikayo lakṣasenāḍhyaḥ saputro nṛpatiḥ svayam ..
nṛpaṃ parimalaṃ prāpya sa yuddhārthamupasthitaḥ .. 58 ..
3.3.d:
कैकयो लक्षसेनाढ्यः सपुत्रो नृपतिः स्वयम् ॥
नृपं परिमलं प्राप्य स युद्धार्थमुपस्थितः ॥ 58 ॥
3.3.m: Kaikaya himself, the king endowed with an army of one hundred thousand, with his sons, / having reached King Parimala, presented himself for battle.

3.3.s:
netrasiṃhaśca nṛpatiḥ sa vīro lakṣasainyapaḥ ..
mayūradhvaja evāpi lakṣapaḥ śaśivaṃśinam .. 59 ..
3.3.d:
नेत्रसिंहश्च नृपतिः स वीरो लक्षसैन्यपः ॥
मयूरध्वज एवापि लक्षपः शशिवंशिनम् ॥ 59 ॥
3.3.m: And King Netrasiṃha, that hero, commander of one hundred thousand, / and also Mayūradhvaja, commander of one hundred thousand, [joined] the descendant of the Moon.

3.3.s:
vīrasenaśca lakṣāḍhyaḥ saputraścāṃdripakṣagaḥ ..
lakṣaṇaḥ saptalakṣāḍhyo yuddhārthaṃ samupasthitaḥ .. 3.3.32.60 ..
3.3.d:
वीरसेनश्च लक्षाढ्यः सपुत्रश्चांद्रिपक्षगः ॥
लक्षणः सप्तलक्षाढ्यो युद्धार्थं समुपस्थितः ॥ 3.3.32.60 ॥
3.3.m: Vīrasena, possessing one hundred thousand, with his sons, took the side of the king; / Lakṣaṇa, possessing seven hundred thousand, stood ready for battle.

3.3.s:
āhlādo lakṣasainyāḍhyaḥ pakṣagaścaṃdravaṃśinaḥ ..
dvilakṣasaṃyuto rājā candravaṃśo raṇonmukhaḥ ..
evaṃ ṣoḍaśalakṣāḍhyaḥ sthitaḥ parimalo raṇe .. 61 ..
3.3.d:
आह्लादो लक्षसैन्याढ्यः पक्षगश्चंद्रवंशिनः ॥
द्विलक्षसंयुतो राजा चन्द्रवंशो रणोन्मुखः ॥
एवं षोडशलक्षाढ्यः स्थितः परिमलो रणे ॥ 61 ॥
3.3.m: Āhlāda, endowed with an army of one hundred thousand, was an ally of the descendant of the Moon; / the king, born of the Lunar lineage, facing battle, was joined by two hundred thousand; / thus Parimala stood in battle, endowed with one million six hundred thousand [warriors].

3.3.s:
laharo bhūpatiśreṣṭho lakṣapaḥ putrasaṃyutaḥ ..
mahīrājamupāgamya yuddhārthaṃ samupasthitaḥ .. 62 ..
3.3.d:
लहरो भूपतिश्रेष्ठो लक्षपः पुत्रसंयुतः ॥
महीराजमुपागम्य युद्धार्थं समुपस्थितः ॥ 62 ॥
3.3.m: Lahandhara, the best of monarchs, commander of one hundred thousand, with his sons, / having approached Mahīrāja, stood ready for battle.

3.3.s:
abhinandana evāpi saputro lakṣasainyapaḥ ..
māyāvarmā ca nṛpatiḥ saputro lakṣasainyapaḥ .. 63 ..
3.3.d:
अभिनन्दन एवापि सपुत्रो लक्षसैन्यपः ॥
मायावर्मा च नृपतिः सपुत्रो लक्षसैन्यपः ॥ 63 ॥
3.3.m: Abhinandana as well, with his sons, commander of an army of one hundred thousand, / and King Māyāvarman, with his sons, commander of an army of one hundred thousand,

3.3.s:
nāgavarmā samāyātaḥ saputro lakṣasainyapaḥ ..
madrakeśaḥ saputraśca lakṣasainyo raṇonmukhaḥ .. 64 ..
3.3.d:
नागवर्मा समायातः सपुत्रो लक्षसैन्यपः ॥
मद्रकेशः सपुत्रश्च लक्षसैन्यो रणोन्मुखः ॥ 64 ॥
3.3.m: Nāgavarman arrived, with his sons, commander of an army of one hundred thousand; / Madrakeśa, with his sons, accompanied by one hundred thousand troops, turned his face to battle.

3.3.s:
pūrṇāmalaḥ saputraśca lakṣapaścaiva pakṣagaḥ ..
maṃkaṇaḥ kinnaro nāma saputrastatra saṃsthitaḥ .. 65 ..
3.3.d:
पूर्णामलः सपुत्रश्च लक्षपश्चैव पक्षगः ॥
मंकणः किन्नरो नाम सपुत्रस्तत्र संस्थितः ॥ 65 ॥
3.3.m: Pūrṇāmala, with his sons, commander of one hundred thousand, was an ally; / the kinnara named Maṅkaṇa, with his sons, took his stand there.

3.3.s:
gajarājaḥ samāyāto mahīrājaṃ hi lakṣapaḥ ..
dhuṃdhukāraḥ samāyātaḥ pañcalakṣapatiḥ svayam .. 66 ..
3.3.d:
गजराजः समायातो महीराजं हि लक्षपः ॥
धुंधुकारः समायातः पञ्चलक्षपतिः स्वयम् ॥ 66 ॥
3.3.m: Gajarāja arrived to support Mahīrāja, commander of one hundred thousand; / Dhundhukāra arrived in person, master of five hundred thousand.

3.3.s:
putraḥ kṛṣṇakumārasya bhagadattaḥ samāgataḥ ..
trilakṣabalasaṃyukto mahīrājaṃ mahīpatim .. 67 ..
3.3.d:
पुत्रः कृष्णकुमारस्य भगदत्तः समागतः ॥
त्रिलक्षबलसंयुक्तो महीराजं महीपतिम् ॥ 67 ॥
3.3.m: Bhagadatta, the son of Kṛṣṇakumāra, arrived, / endowed with a force of three hundred thousand, to King Mahīrāja.

3.3.s:
balavāhanaputraśca daśagopālasaṃsthitaḥ ..
aṃgadastatra saṃprāptaḥ sāyuto devakī priyaḥ ..
mahīrājamupāgamya yuddhārthaṃ samupasthitaḥ ..68..
3.3.d:
बलवाहनपुत्रश्च दशगोपालसंस्थितः ॥
अंगदस्तत्र संप्राप्तः सायुतो देवकी प्रियः ॥
महीराजमुपागम्य युद्धार्थं समुपस्थितः ॥68॥
3.3.m: And Balavāhana's son, stationed with ten herdsmen, / Aṅgada, dear to Devakī, arrived there with ten thousand. / Having approached Mahīrāja, he stood ready for battle.

3.3.s:
kaliṃgaśca nṛpaḥ prāptastrikoṇaśca tathaiva ca ..
śrīpatiśca tathā rājā śrītāraśca tathā gataḥ .. .. 69 ..
3.3.d:
कलिंगश्च नृपः प्राप्तस्त्रिकोणश्च तथैव च ॥
श्रीपतिश्च तथा राजा श्रीतारश्च तथा गतः ॥ ॥ 69 ॥
3.3.m: And King Kaliṅga arrived, and likewise Trikoṇa; / King Śrīpati also, and Śrītāra went there as well.

3.3.s:
mukundaśca suketuśca ruhilo guhilastathā ..
induvāraśca valavāñjayaṃtaśca tathāvidhaḥ ..
sarve daśasahasrāḍhyā mahīrājamupasthitāḥ .. 3.3.32.70 ..
3.3.d:
मुकुन्दश्च सुकेतुश्च रुहिलो गुहिलस्तथा ॥
इन्दुवारश्च वलवाञ्जयंतश्च तथाविधः ॥
सर्वे दशसहस्राढ्या महीराजमुपस्थिताः ॥ 3.3.32.70 ॥
3.3.m: Mukunda, Suketu, Ruhila, and Guhila, / the mighty Induvāra, and Jayanta of similar kind— / all endowed with ten thousand [troops] attended upon Mahīrāja.

3.3.s:
mahīrājasya pakṣe tu sahasraṃ kṣudrabhūmipāḥ ..
te tu sāhasrasenāḍhyā mahīrājamupasthitāḥ .. 71 ..
3.3.d:
महीराजस्य पक्षे तु सहस्रं क्षुद्रभूमिपाः ॥
ते तु साहस्रसेनाढ्या महीराजमुपस्थिताः ॥ 71 ॥
3.3.m: On Mahīrāja's side, however, were a thousand petty kings; / endowed with armies of thousands, they attended upon Mahīrāja.

3.3.s:
teṣāṃ madhye ca vai bhūpāndviśatāndehalīṃ prati ..
sasainyānpreṣayāmāsa rāṣṭrarakṣaṇahetave ..
evaṃ sa dehalīrājaścaturviṃśatilakṣapaḥ .. 72 ..
3.3.d:
तेषां मध्ये च वै भूपान्द्विशतान्देहलीं प्रति ॥
ससैन्यान्प्रेषयामास राष्ट्ररक्षणहेतवे ॥
एवं स देहलीराजश्चतुर्विंशतिलक्षपः ॥ 72 ॥
3.3.m: From among them, he sent two hundred kings towards Delhi / with their armies for the sake of protecting the realm. / Thus that king of Delhi commanded twenty-four hundred thousand.

3.3.s:
yuddhamaṣṭādaśāhāni sañjātaṃ sarvasaṃkṣayam ..
śṛṇu yuddhakathāṃ ramyāṃ bhṛguvarya suvistarāt .. 73 ..
3.3.d:
युद्धमष्टादशाहानि सञ्जातं सर्वसंक्षयम् ॥
शृणु युद्धकथां रम्यां भृगुवर्य सुविस्तरात् ॥ 73 ॥
3.3.m: A battle lasting eighteen days took place, bringing total destruction. / Hear in detail, O best of the Bhṛgus, the captivating tale of the war:

3.3.s:
mārgakṛṣṇadvitīyāyāṃ mahīrājo mahābalaḥ ..
āhūya laharaṃ bhūpaṃ vacanaṃ prāha nirbhayaḥ ..9..
3.3.d:
मार्गकृष्णद्वितीयायां महीराजो महाबलः ॥
आहूय लहरं भूपं वचनं प्राह निर्भयः ॥9॥
3.3.m: On the second lunar day of the dark fortnight of Mārgaśīrṣa, the mighty Mahīrāja, / having summoned King Lahara, spoke fearless words:

3.3.s:
bhavānsaputraḥ senāḍhyo dhuṃdhukāreṇa rakṣitaḥ ..
cāmuṇḍena yuto yuddhe gantumarhati sattama ..
iti śrutvā yayau śīghraṃ kurukṣetre mahāraṇe .. 75 ..
3.3.d:
भवान्सपुत्रः सेनाढ्यो धुंधुकारेण रक्षितः ॥
चामुण्डेन युतो युद्धे गन्तुमर्हति सत्तम ॥
इति श्रुत्वा ययौ शीघ्रं कुरुक्षेत्रे महारणे ॥ 75 ॥
3.3.m: "Accompanied by your sons, endowed with an army, protected by Dhuṃdhukāra, / and joined by Cāmuṇḍa, you ought to go to battle, O best of men." / Having heard this, he quickly went to the great battlefield at Kurukṣetra.

3.3.s:
tadā parimalo rājā mayūradhvajameva hi ..
samāhūya vacaḥ prāha śṛṇu pārthivasattama .. 76 ..
3.3.d:
तदा परिमलो राजा मयूरध्वजमेव हि ॥
समाहूय वचः प्राह शृणु पार्थिवसत्तम ॥ 76 ॥
3.3.m: Then King Parimala, summoning Mayūradhvaja, / spoke these words: "Hear, O best of kings:

3.3.s:
kṛṣṇāṃśena jayaṃtena devasiṃhena rakṣitaḥ ..
sa bhavām̐llakṣasainyāḍhyo gaṃtumarhati vai raṇe .. .. 77 ..
3.3.d:
कृष्णांशेन जयंतेन देवसिंहेन रक्षितः ॥
स भवाम्̐ल्लक्षसैन्याढ्यो गंतुमर्हति वै रणे ॥ ॥ 77 ॥
3.3.m: Protected by Jayanta, an expansion of Kṛṣṇa, and by Devasiṃha, / you, endowed with a hundred thousand troops, ought to go to battle."

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā tu vacanaṃ mayūradhvaja eva hi ..
lakṣasainyānvitaḥ prāpto laharaṃ nṛpatiṃ prati .. 78 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा तु वचनं मयूरध्वज एव हि ॥
लक्षसैन्यान्वितः प्राप्तो लहरं नृपतिं प्रति ॥ 78 ॥
3.3.m: Having heard these words, Mayūradhvaja, / accompanied by a hundred thousand troops, advanced against King Lahara.

3.3.s:
tayoścāsīnmahadyuddhaṃ senayorubhayo raṇe ..
senā tu lakṣavīrasya tatra yuddhe prakīrtitā .. 79 ..
3.3.d:
तयोश्चासीन्महद्युद्धं सेनयोरुभयो रणे ॥
सेना तु लक्षवीरस्य तत्र युद्धे प्रकीर्तिता ॥ 79 ॥
3.3.m: And a great battle between those two armies took place in the war. / The army of a hundred thousand warriors in that battle was thus described:

3.3.s:
eko ratho gajāstatra jñeyāḥ pañcaśataṃ raṇe..
hayāśca pañcasāhasrā pattayastadgaṇā daśa ..
ete sainyā narā jñeyā sainyapāṃśca śṛṇuṣva bhoḥ ..3.3.32.80..
3.3.d:
एको रथो गजास्तत्र ज्ञेयाः पञ्चशतं रणे॥
हयाश्च पञ्चसाहस्रा पत्तयस्तद्गणा दश ॥
एते सैन्या नरा ज्ञेया सैन्यपांश्च शृणुष्व भोः ॥3.3.32.80॥
3.3.m: One chariot, five hundred elephants are to be known there in the battle, / five thousand horses, and ten times as many foot-soldiers; / these men are to be known as the troops, and hear now of the troop commanders, O dear one!

3.3.s:
daśānāṃ paccarāṇāṃ ca patirnāmnā sa pattipaḥ ..
paṃcānāṃ ca hayānāṃ ca patirnāmnā sa gulmapaḥ..81..
3.3.d:
दशानां पच्चराणां च पतिर्नाम्ना स पत्तिपः ॥
पंचानां च हयानां च पतिर्नाम्ना स गुल्मपः॥81॥
3.3.m: The master over ten foot-soldiers is called a pattipa; / and the master over five horses is called a gulmapa.

3.3.s:
paṃcānāṃ ca gajānāṃ ca patirnāmnā gajādhipaḥ ..
etaiḥ sārddhaṃ rathī jñeyo raṇe'smindāruṇe kalau ..82..
3.3.d:
पंचानां च गजानां च पतिर्नाम्ना गजाधिपः ॥
एतैः सार्द्धं रथी ज्ञेयो रणेऽस्मिन्दारुणे कलौ ॥82॥
3.3.m: And the master over five elephants is called a gajādhipa; / together with these, a chariot-fighter is to be recognized in this dreadful Kali age of battle.

3.3.s:
uṣṭrārūḍhāḥ smṛtā dūtāścatvāriṃśacca tadbale ..
śataghnyastatra sāhasrāsteṣāṃ madhye pṛthakpṛthak ..
ṣaḍtriṃśadvai padacarāsteṣāṃ karmāṇi me śṛṇu .. 83 ..
3.3.d:
उष्ट्रारूढाः स्मृता दूताश्चत्वारिंशच्च तद्बले ॥
शतघ्न्यस्तत्र साहस्रास्तेषां मध्ये पृथक्पृथक् ॥
षड्त्रिंशद्वै पदचरास्तेषां कर्माणि मे शृणु ॥ 83 ॥
3.3.m: Forty messengers mounted on camels are remembered in that force; / there were a thousand śataghnīs, and among them, separately, / thirty-six footmen. Hear from me their duties:

3.3.s:
daśa golakadātāro daśatatpuṣṭikārakāḥ ..
daśa cārdrakarāstāṃ vai trayaste vahnidāyinaḥ ..
trayo dṛṣṭikarā jñeyāstriyāmeṣu pṛthakpṛthak .. 84 ..
3.3.d:
दश गोलकदातारो दशतत्पुष्टिकारकाः ॥
दश चार्द्रकरास्तां वै त्रयस्ते वह्निदायिनः ॥
त्रयो दृष्टिकरा ज्ञेयास्त्रियामेषु पृथक्पृथक् ॥ 84 ॥
3.3.m: Ten supply the balls, ten load them, / ten moisten them, and three provide the fire; / three are known to keep watch, separately throughout the watches of the night.

3.3.s:
śeṣāḥ śūdrāstu senānāṃ śūrakṛtyaparāyaṇāḥ ..
evaṃ ca lakṣavīrāṇāṃ senā tatra prakīrtitā .. 85 ..
3.3.d:
शेषाः शूद्रास्तु सेनानां शूरकृत्यपरायणाः ॥
एवं च लक्षवीराणां सेना तत्र प्रकीर्तिता ॥ 85 ॥
3.3.m: The rest of the troops are Śūdras, devoted to the actions of heroes. / In this way was described the army of a hundred thousand warriors there.

3.3.s:
tatrāsīttumulaṃ yuddhaṃ dharmeṇa ca samantataḥ ..
prātaḥkālātsamārabhya madhyāhnaṃ sainyayordvayoḥ .. 86 ..
3.3.d:
तत्रासीत्तुमुलं युद्धं धर्मेण च समन्ततः ॥
प्रातःकालात्समारभ्य मध्याह्नं सैन्ययोर्द्वयोः ॥ 86 ॥
3.3.m: There was a tumultuous battle fought according to righteousness on all sides / between the two armies, from morning until noon.

3.3.s:
tatpaścādyāmamātreṇa sainyapā yuddhamāgatāḥ ..
tatpaścācca mahāśūrā dhuṃdhukārādayo balāḥ ..87..
3.3.d:
तत्पश्चाद्याममात्रेण सैन्यपा युद्धमागताः ॥
तत्पश्चाच्च महाशूरा धुंधुकारादयो बलाः ॥87॥
3.3.m: After that, within merely a watch, the commanders arrived for battle; / and after that, the great heroes, Dhuṃdhukāra and the other mighty ones,

3.3.s:
yāmamātraṃ ca yuddhāya saṃsthitā raṇamūrdhani ..
cāmuṇḍena ca kṛṣṇāṃśo dhuṃdhukāreṇa cendulaḥ .. 88 ..
3.3.d:
याममात्रं च युद्धाय संस्थिता रणमूर्धनि ॥
चामुण्डेन च कृष्णांशो धुंधुकारेण चेन्दुलः ॥ 88 ॥
3.3.m: stood at the forefront of the battle for merely a watch to fight: / Kṛṣṇāṃśa with Cāmuṇḍa, and Indula with Dhuṃdhukāra;

3.3.s:
bhagadattena vai devaḥ kṛtavānyuddhamuttamam ..
sāyaṃkāle tu saṃprāpte sarve śūrāḥ kṣayaṃ gatāḥ .. 89 ..
3.3.d:
भगदत्तेन वै देवः कृतवान्युद्धमुत्तमम् ॥
सायंकाले तु संप्राप्ते सर्वे शूराः क्षयं गताः ॥ 89 ॥
3.3.m: and Deva fought a preeminent battle with Bhagadatta. / When evening arrived, all the warriors were exhausted.

3.3.s:
kṛṣṇāṃśastatra cāmuṇḍaṃ jitvā tu laharātmajān ..
ṣoḍaśaiva jaghānāśu ghaṭīmātreṇa vīryavān ..
dadhmau śaṃkhaṃ prasannātmā lakṣaṇāntamupāyayau ..3.3.32.90..
3.3.d:
कृष्णांशस्तत्र चामुण्डं जित्वा तु लहरात्मजान् ॥
षोडशैव जघानाशु घटीमात्रेण वीर्यवान् ॥
दध्मौ शंखं प्रसन्नात्मा लक्षणान्तमुपाययौ ॥3.3.32.90॥
3.3.m: Having conquered Cāmuṇḍa there, the heroic Kṛṣṇāṃśa / quickly slew the sixteen sons of Lahara within merely a ghaṭikā. / He blew his conch, gladdened in heart, and approached Lakṣaṇa.

3.3.s:
cāmuṃḍo dhuṃdhukāraśca bhagadatto yutaḥ śataiḥ ..
mahīrājamupāgamya suṣupurniśi nirbhayāḥ .. 91 ..
3.3.d:
चामुंडो धुंधुकारश्च भगदत्तो युतः शतैः ॥
महीराजमुपागम्य सुषुपुर्निशि निर्भयाः ॥ 91 ॥
3.3.m: Cāmuṇḍa, Dhuṃdhukāra, and Bhagadatta, accompanied by hundreds, / approached Mahīrāja and slept fearlessly at night.

3.3.s:
iṃdulo devasiṃhaśca sahasraiḥ saṃyutau mudā ..
gatvā parimalaṃ bhūpaṃ rātrau suṣupatustadā .. 92 ..
3.3.d:
इंदुलो देवसिंहश्च सहस्रैः संयुतौ मुदा ॥
गत्वा परिमलं भूपं रात्रौ सुषुपतुस्तदा ॥ 92 ॥
3.3.m: Indula and Devasiṃha, joyfully accompanied by thousands, / went to King Parimala and then slept at night.

3.3.s:
prātaḥkāle tu saṃprāpte tṛtīyāyāṃ bhayaṃkare ..
mahīrājastadāhūya nṛpaṃ gajapatiṃ balī .. 93 ..
3.3.d:
प्रातःकाले तु संप्राप्ते तृतीयायां भयंकरे ॥
महीराजस्तदाहूय नृपं गजपतिं बली ॥ 93 ॥
3.3.m: When morning arrived on the terrifying third [lunar day], / the mighty Mahīrāja then summoned King Gajapati,

3.3.s:
vacanaṃ prāha bho rājam̐stvaṃ trivīraiḥ surakṣitaḥ ..
svakīyairlakṣasainyaiśca gaṃtumarhasi vai raṇe ..94 ..
3.3.d:
वचनं प्राह भो राजम्̐स्त्वं त्रिवीरैः सुरक्षितः ॥
स्वकीयैर्लक्षसैन्यैश्च गंतुमर्हसि वै रणे ॥94 ॥
3.3.m: and spoke these words: "O king, well protected by the three heroes / and with your own hundred thousand troops, you ought to go to battle."

3.3.s:
tadā parimalo bhūpo netrasiṃhaṃ mahīpatim ..
yuddhāyājñāpayāmāsa kṛṣṇāṃśādyaiḥ surakṣitam .. 95 ..
3.3.d:
तदा परिमलो भूपो नेत्रसिंहं महीपतिम् ॥
युद्धायाज्ञापयामास कृष्णांशाद्यैः सुरक्षितम् ॥ 95 ॥
3.3.m: Then King Parimala commanded King Netrasiṃha, / who was well protected by Kṛṣṇāṃśa and the others, to fight.

3.3.s:
tayoścāsīnmahayuddhaṃ senayorubhayoḥ kramāt ..
hayā hayaiḥ kṣayaṃ jagmurgajāścaiva tathā gajaiḥ ..
paccarāḥ paccaraiḥ sārddhaṃ śataghnyaśca śataghnibhiḥ ..96..
3.3.d:
तयोश्चासीन्महयुद्धं सेनयोरुभयोः क्रमात् ॥
हया हयैः क्षयं जग्मुर्गजाश्चैव तथा गजैः ॥
पच्चराः पच्चरैः सार्द्धं शतघ्न्यश्च शतघ्निभिः ॥96॥
3.3.m: And a great battle took place between their two armies in succession: / horses were destroyed by horses, and elephants likewise by elephants, / foot-soldiers together with foot-soldiers, and śataghnīs with śataghnīs.

3.3.s:
aparāhne muniśreṣṭha netrasiṃho mahābalaḥ ..
mahāgajaṃ gajapatiṃ gatvā yuddhamacīkarat ..97..
3.3.d:
अपराह्ने मुनिश्रेष्ठ नेत्रसिंहो महाबलः ॥
महागजं गजपतिं गत्वा युद्धमचीकरत् ॥97॥
3.3.m: In the afternoon, O best of sages, the mighty Netrasiṃha, / having gone up to Gajapati who was upon his great elephant, joined battle.

3.3.s:
parasparaṃ ca virathau saṃchinnadhanuṣau tadā ..
khaḍgahastau mahīṃ prāpya cakratū raṇamulbaṇam ..
anyonyena vadhaṃ kṛtvā svargalokamupāgatau .. 98 ..
3.3.d:
परस्परं च विरथौ संछिन्नधनुषौ तदा ॥
खड्गहस्तौ महीं प्राप्य चक्रतू रणमुल्बणम् ॥
अन्योन्येन वधं कृत्वा स्वर्गलोकमुपागतौ ॥ 98 ॥
3.3.m: Deprived of their chariots and their bows cut to pieces, / they reached the ground, took swords in hand, and fought a fierce combat. / Having slain each other, both went to the heavenly realm.

3.3.s:
indulastaṃ tu cāmuṃḍaṃ devo vai dhuṃdhukaṃ tathā ..
kṛṣṇāṃśo bhagadattaṃ ca jitvā rājānamāyayuḥ .. 99 ..
3.3.d:
इन्दुलस्तं तु चामुंडं देवो वै धुंधुकं तथा ॥
कृष्णांशो भगदत्तं च जित्वा राजानमाययुः ॥ 99 ॥
3.3.m: Indula, having conquered Cāmuṇḍa, Deva having conquered Dhuṃdhuka, / and Kṛṣṇāṃśa having conquered Bhagadatta, returned to the king.

3.3.s:
śeṣaiḥ paṃcaśataiḥ śūraistaiḥ sārddhaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ prati ..
parājitāśca te sarve sahasraiḥ sahitā yayuḥ .. 3.3.32.100..
3.3.d:
शेषैः पंचशतैः शूरैस्तैः सार्द्धं लक्षणं प्रति ॥
पराजिताश्च ते सर्वे सहस्रैः सहिता ययुः ॥ 3.3.32.100॥
3.3.m: Together with the remaining five hundred warriors they went towards Lakṣaṇa; / and having all been defeated, they retreated together with thousands.

3.3.s:
prātaḥkāle tu saṃprāpte mahīrājo mahābalaḥ ..
māyāvarmāṇamāhūya vacanaṃ prāha nirbhayaḥ .. 101 ..
3.3.d:
प्रातःकाले तु संप्राप्ते महीराजो महाबलः ॥
मायावर्माणमाहूय वचनं प्राह निर्भयः ॥ 101 ॥
3.3.m: When morning arrived, the mighty Mahīrāja, / having summoned Māyāvarmā, spoke fearless words:

3.3.s:
bhavāndaśasutairvīrairlakṣasainyaiśca saṃyutaḥ ..
sarvaśatruvināśāya gaṃtumarhati sattama ..
iti śrutvā sa nṛpatirvādyānsaṃvādya cāyayau .. 102 ..
3.3.d:
भवान्दशसुतैर्वीरैर्लक्षसैन्यैश्च संयुतः ॥
सर्वशत्रुविनाशाय गंतुमर्हति सत्तम ॥
इति श्रुत्वा स नृपतिर्वाद्यान्संवाद्य चाययौ ॥ 102 ॥
3.3.m: "Endowed with ten heroic sons and a hundred thousand troops, / you ought to go forth for the destruction of all enemies, O best of men." / Having heard this, that king sounded his musical instruments and advanced.

3.3.s:
dṛṣṭvā parimalo bhūpo māyāvarmāṇamāgatam ..
jagannāyakamāhūya vacanaṃ prāha nirbhayaḥ .. 103 ..
3.3.d:
दृष्ट्वा परिमलो भूपो मायावर्माणमागतम् ॥
जगन्नायकमाहूय वचनं प्राह निर्भयः ॥ 103 ॥
3.3.m: Seeing that Māyāvarmā had arrived, King Parimala, / having summoned Jagannāyaka, spoke fearless words:

3.3.s:
bhavāndaśasahasraiśca sārddhaṃ taistribhiranvitaḥ ..
gantumarhati yuddhāya śīghraṃ madvijayaṃ kuru .. 104 ..
3.3.d:
भवान्दशसहस्रैश्च सार्द्धं तैस्त्रिभिरन्वितः ॥
गन्तुमर्हति युद्धाय शीघ्रं मद्विजयं कुरु ॥ 104 ॥
3.3.m: "Accompanied by ten thousand troops and joined by those three, / you ought to go to battle; bring me swift victory."

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā yayau śīghraṃ senayorubhayormahat ..
yuddhaṃ cāsīnmuniśreṣṭha yāmamātraṃ bhayānakam .. 105 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा ययौ शीघ्रं सेनयोरुभयोर्महत् ॥
युद्धं चासीन्मुनिश्रेष्ठ याममात्रं भयानकम् ॥ 105 ॥
3.3.m: Having heard this, he quickly set out; between both armies, O best of sages, / a great and terrifying battle took place lasting merely a watch.

3.3.s:
hatāste daśasāhasrā kṛṣṇāṃśādyaiḥ surakṣitāḥ .. śaṃ
khāndadhmuśca te sarve cāṃgadeśanivāsinaḥ .. 106 ..
3.3.d:
हतास्ते दशसाहस्रा कृष्णांशाद्यैः सुरक्षिताः ॥ शं
खान्दध्मुश्च ते सर्वे चांगदेशनिवासिनः ॥ 106 ॥
3.3.m: Protected by Kṛṣṇāṃśa and the others, those ten thousand were slain; / and all those inhabitants of the Aṅga country blew their conches.

3.3.s:
etasminnaṃtare dhīrāḥ kṛṣṇāṃśādyāsturīyakāḥ ..
yāmamātreṇa saṃjaghnurlakṣasainyaṃ ripostadā .. 107 ..
aparāhṇe mahārājo māyāvarmā sutaiḥ saha..
kṛṣṇāṃśaṃ devasiṃhaṃ ca saṃprāpto jaganāyakam ..1 08..
athāṅgabhūpaṃ daśaputrayuktaṃ kṛṣṇāṃśa evāśu jagāma śīghram ..
hayasthito vīravaraḥ pramāthī kalaikajāto madhusūdanasya ..1 09..
3.3.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे धीराः कृष्णांशाद्यास्तुरीयकाः ॥
याममात्रेण संजघ्नुर्लक्षसैन्यं रिपोस्तदा ॥ 107 ॥
अपराह्णे महाराजो मायावर्मा सुतैः सह॥
कृष्णांशं देवसिंहं च संप्राप्तो जगनायकम् ॥1 08॥
अथाङ्गभूपं दशपुत्रयुक्तं कृष्णांश एवाशु जगाम शीघ्रम् ॥
हयस्थितो वीरवरः प्रमाथी कलैकजातो मधुसूदनस्य ॥1 09॥
3.3.m:
In the meantime, the steadfast ones, Kṛṣṇāṃśa and the rest of the fourth rank, / then slaughtered a hundred thousand of the enemy’s troops within just one watch.
In the afternoon, the great king Māyāvarmā, accompanied by his sons, / came up against Kṛṣṇāṃśa, Devasiṃha, and Jaganāyaka.
Then Kṛṣṇāṃśa, mounted on his horse, swiftly advanced against the king of Aṅga, who was accompanied by his ten sons— / [Kṛṣṇāṃśa] the foremost hero, the crusher of foes, born of a single part of Madhusūdana.

3.3.s:
tatoṃgabhūpastribhireva bāṇairatāḍayanmūrdhni ca pārśvayorvai ..
amarṣa māṇo balavānmahīpatirdaṃḍairhataḥ kāla ivāśu sarpaḥ.. .. 3.3.32.110 ..
3.3.d:
ततोंगभूपस्त्रिभिरेव बाणैरताडयन्मूर्ध्नि च पार्श्वयोर्वै ॥
अमर्ष माणो बलवान्महीपतिर्दंडैर्हतः काल इवाशु सर्पः॥ ॥ 3.3.32.110 ॥
3.3.m: Then the king of Aṅga struck him with just three arrows upon the head and on both flanks; / the powerful lord of the earth, unable to endure [it], was struck like the black serpent of Death by rods.

3.3.s:
hayaṃ samuḍḍīya su puṣkarāntaṃ tatobhyagāttaṃ nṛpatiṃ rathastham ..
hayasya pātairvirathī cakāra sa eva bhūpo'simupādadhānaḥ .. 111 ..
3.3.d:
हयं समुड्डीय सु पुष्करान्तं ततोभ्यगात्तं नृपतिं रथस्थम् ॥
हयस्य पातैर्विरथी चकार स एव भूपोऽसिमुपादधानः ॥ 111 ॥
3.3.m: Making his horse leap up to the tip of his lotus [bow], he then charged that king stationed in his chariot; / by the leaps of his horse he deprived him of his chariot, and that very king drew his sword.

3.3.s:
svenāsinā biṃdulamaṃgaśalyaṃ kṛtvā sa kṛṣṇāṃśamuvāca vākyam ..
kallolamāyāttava nāśanāya tvayā jitā bhūpatayaḥ pradhānāḥ ..1 12..
3.3.d:
स्वेनासिना बिंदुलमंगशल्यं कृत्वा स कृष्णांशमुवाच वाक्यम् ॥
कल्लोलमायात्तव नाशनाय त्वया जिता भूपतयः प्रधानाः ॥1 12॥
3.3.m: Having wounded Bindula with his sword, the thorn in the side of Aṅga spoke these words to Kṛṣṇāṃśa: / "The principal kings were conquered by you through the illusion of waves to bring about your destruction.

3.3.s:
tadaiva kīrtirbhavitā mamāśu hatvā bhavaṃtaṃ ca sukhī bhavāmi ..
ityuktavantaṃ nṛpatiṃ mahāntaṃ svenāsinā tasya śiro jahāra .. 113 ..
3.3.d:
तदैव कीर्तिर्भविता ममाशु हत्वा भवंतं च सुखी भवामि ॥
इत्युक्तवन्तं नृपतिं महान्तं स्वेनासिना तस्य शिरो जहार ॥ 113 ॥
3.3.m: Only then will my fame be instantly achieved, and having slain you, I shall be happy." / When the great king had spoken thus, [Kṛṣṇāṃśa] severed his head with his sword.

3.3.s:
hate'ṅgabhūpe daśa tasya putrāstameva jagmuryudhi kauravāṃśāḥ ..
tānāgatāniṃdula eva paṃca jaghāna bāṇaistu tadā samanyuḥ .. 114..
3.3.d:
हतेऽङ्गभूपे दश तस्य पुत्रास्तमेव जग्मुर्युधि कौरवांशाः ॥
तानागतानिंदुल एव पंच जघान बाणैस्तु तदा समन्युः ॥ 114॥
3.3.m: When the king of Aṅga was slain, his ten sons, portions of the Kauravas, advanced against him in battle; / Indula himself, filled with wrath, then struck down five of them as they approached with his arrows.

3.3.s:
ubhau ca devastu jaghāna tatra bhallena siddhena nṛpātmajau ca..
jyeṣṭhaṃ sutaṃ gautama eva hatvā dvau yau sa kṛṣṇāṃśa upājaghāna..115..
3.3.d:
उभौ च देवस्तु जघान तत्र भल्लेन सिद्धेन नृपात्मजौ च॥
ज्येष्ठं सुतं गौतम एव हत्वा द्वौ यौ स कृष्णांश उपाजघान॥115॥
3.3.m: And the lord there slew two sons of the king with a perfected broad-headed arrow; / Gautama slew the eldest son, and Kṛṣṇāṃśa struck down the two who [remained].

3.3.s:
śaṃkhānpradadhmū rucirānanāste pradoṣakāle śibirāṇi jagmuḥ..
śramānvitāste suṣupurniśāyāṃ prātaḥ samutthāya svakarma kṛtvā..116..
3.3.d:
शंखान्प्रदध्मू रुचिराननास्ते प्रदोषकाले शिबिराणि जग्मुः॥
श्रमान्वितास्ते सुषुपुर्निशायां प्रातः समुत्थाय स्वकर्म कृत्वा॥116॥
3.3.m: Those [heroes] with radiant faces blew their conches, and at dusk they returned to their encampments; / overcome with weariness, they slept through the night, and rising in the morning, they performed their regular duties.

3.3.s:
gatvā sabhāyāṃ nṛpatiṃ praṇamya vākyaṃ samūcuḥ śṛṇu caṃdravaṃśin..
adyaiva senāpatirasti ko vai cājñāpayāsmānnṛpa tasya guptyai..117..
3.3.d:
गत्वा सभायां नृपतिं प्रणम्य वाक्यं समूचुः शृणु चंद्रवंशिन्॥
अद्यैव सेनापतिरस्ति को वै चाज्ञापयास्मान्नृप तस्य गुप्त्यै॥117॥
3.3.m: Going to the assembly hall and bowing to the king, they spoke these words: "Listen, O descendant of the Lunar dynasty! / Who indeed is the commander of the army today? Command us, O king, for his protection."

3.3.s:
śrutvāha bhūpodya tu vīrasenaḥ sakāmasenaḥ svabalaiḥ sametaḥ..
raṇaṃ kariṣyatyacireṇa vīrāstasmātsurakṣadhvamaribhya eva.. 118
3.3.d:
श्रुत्वाह भूपोद्य तु वीरसेनः सकामसेनः स्वबलैः समेतः॥
रणं करिष्यत्यचिरेण वीरास्तस्मात्सुरक्षध्वमरिभ्य एव॥ 118
3.3.m: Hearing this, the king said: "Today Vīrasena, accompanied by Kāmasena and his own forces, / will shortly do battle, O heroes; therefore protect him well from the enemies."

3.3.s:
sa vīraseno nṛpatiṃ praṇamya lakṣaiḥ svasainyairyudhi saṃjagāma..
tadā mahīrājanṛpaḥ pratāpī sa nāgavarmāṇamuvāca tāpī .. 119 ..
3.3.d:
स वीरसेनो नृपतिं प्रणम्य लक्षैः स्वसैन्यैर्युधि संजगाम॥
तदा महीराजनृपः प्रतापी स नागवर्माणमुवाच तापी ॥ 119 ॥
3.3.m: That Vīrasena, having bowed to the king, set out for battle with hundred-thousands of his own troops; / then the glorious, tormenting king Mahīrāja said to Nāgavarmā:

3.3.s:
raṇāya gacchāśu sutaiḥ sameto lakṣaiḥ svasainyairuta bhūpavarya ..
hatvā ripuṃ ghoratamaṃ hi vīraṃ patiṃ mahāntaṃ yudhi vīrasenam .. 3.3.32.120 ..
3.3.d:
रणाय गच्छाशु सुतैः समेतो लक्षैः स्वसैन्यैरुत भूपवर्य ॥
हत्वा रिपुं घोरतमं हि वीरं पतिं महान्तं युधि वीरसेनम् ॥ 3.3.32.120 ॥
3.3.m: "Go swiftly into battle accompanied by your sons, along with hundred-thousands of your own troops, O best of kings, / to slay in battle that most dreadful hero, the mighty commander, the enemy Vīrasena."

3.3.s:
ityuktavaṃtaṃ nṛpatiṃ praṇamya suvādayāmāsa tadā hi vīraḥ ..
tayorbabhūvāśu raṇo mahānvai susenayoḥ saṃkulayuddhakartroḥ .. 121 ..
3.3.d:
इत्युक्तवंतं नृपतिं प्रणम्य सुवादयामास तदा हि वीरः ॥
तयोर्बभूवाशु रणो महान्वै सुसेनयोः संकुलयुद्धकर्त्रोः ॥ 121 ॥
3.3.m: Bowing to the king who had spoken thus, the hero then caused [the war drums] to be sounded; / between the two excellent armies, engaged in tumultuous combat, a great battle immediately arose.

3.3.s:
triyāmamātreṇa hatāśca sarve vimānamāruhya yayuśca nākam ..
hateṣu sarveṣu ca nāgavarmā suteṣu vai yādavabhūpamāha .. 122 ..
3.3.d:
त्रियाममात्रेण हताश्च सर्वे विमानमारुह्य ययुश्च नाकम् ॥
हतेषु सर्वेषु च नागवर्मा सुतेषु वै यादवभूपमाह ॥ 122 ॥
3.3.m: Within just three watches, all were slain, and mounting celestial chariots, they went to heaven; / and when all his sons had been killed, Nāgavarmā spoke to the Yādava king:

3.3.s:
bhavānvisainyaśca tathaiva cāhaṃ bhavānsaputraśca tathāhameva ..
saṃsmṛtya dharmaṃ kuru yuddhamāśu tato rathasthaḥ sudhanurgṛhītvā .. 123 ..
3.3.d:
भवान्विसैन्यश्च तथैव चाहं भवान्सपुत्रश्च तथाहमेव ॥
संस्मृत्य धर्मं कुरु युद्धमाशु ततो रथस्थः सुधनुर्गृहीत्वा ॥ 123 ॥
3.3.m: "You are without an army, and so am I; you are with your son, and so am I; / recollecting righteousness, fight swiftly!" Then, standing in his chariot and taking up his fine bow,

3.3.s:
bāṇaiśca bāṇānbhuvi tau ca chittvā babhūvastustau virathau nṛpāgryau ..
khaḍgena khaḍgaṃ ca tathaiva chittvā vimānamāruhya gatau hi nākam .. 124 ..
3.3.d:
बाणैश्च बाणान्भुवि तौ च छित्त्वा बभूवस्तुस्तौ विरथौ नृपाग्र्यौ ॥
खड्गेन खड्गं च तथैव छित्त्वा विमानमारुह्य गतौ हि नाकम् ॥ 124 ॥
3.3.m: the two foremost kings cut down each other’s arrows on the earth with arrows, and both were deprived of their chariots; / then, having similarly shattered sword with sword, they mounted celestial chariots and went to heaven.

3.3.s:
sa kāmasenaḥ svaripośca putrāñjaghāna bāṇaiśca tadāṣṭasaṃkhyān ..
jyeṣṭhau tadā kopasamanvitau taṃ gṛhītakhaḍgau ca samīyatuśca .. 125 ..
3.3.d:
स कामसेनः स्वरिपोश्च पुत्राञ्जघान बाणैश्च तदाष्टसंख्यान् ॥
ज्येष्ठौ तदा कोपसमन्वितौ तं गृहीतखड्गौ च समीयतुश्च ॥ 125 ॥
3.3.m: That Kāmasena then slew eight of his enemy's sons with his arrows; / then the two eldest, filled with rage, took up their swords and rushed at him.

3.3.s:
ripoḥ śiro jahraturugravegī sa kāmasenaśca kabaṃdha eva ..
hatvā ripū tau ca tadā militvā svargaṃ yayuste ca vimānarūḍhāḥ .. 126 ..
3.3.d:
रिपोः शिरो जह्रतुरुग्रवेगी स कामसेनश्च कबंध एव ॥
हत्वा रिपू तौ च तदा मिलित्वा स्वर्गं ययुस्ते च विमानरूढाः ॥ 126 ॥
3.3.m: Moving with fierce speed, they severed their enemy’s head; and that Kāmasena, even as a headless torso, / having slain those two enemies, then joined them, and mounted on celestial chariots, they went to heaven.

3.3.s:
hateṣu sarveṣu tadā trayaste cāmuṃḍakādyā jaganāyakaṃ te ..
ruddhā sametāḥ svaśaraiḥ kaṭhorairjaghnustamaśvaṃ harināgaraṃ ca .. 127 ..
3.3.d:
हतेषु सर्वेषु तदा त्रयस्ते चामुंडकाद्या जगनायकं ते ॥
रुद्धा समेताः स्वशरैः कठोरैर्जघ्नुस्तमश्वं हरिनागरं च ॥ 127 ॥
3.3.m: When all were slain, those three, Cāmuṇḍaka and the others, surrounded Jaganāyaka; / coming together, they struck him and his horse Harināgara with their harsh arrows.

3.3.s:
sa divyavājī ca tadā svapakṣau prasāryya khenāśu ripuṃ jagāma ..
sa puṃdhukārasya gajaṃ vihatya cāmuṃḍakasyaiva gajaṃ vimardya ..128 ..
3.3.d:
स दिव्यवाजी च तदा स्वपक्षौ प्रसार्य्य खेनाशु रिपुं जगाम ॥
स पुंधुकारस्य गजं विहत्य चामुंडकस्यैव गजं विमर्द्य ॥128 ॥
3.3.m: That divine steed then spread its two wings and quickly flew through the sky toward the enemy; / slaying the elephant of Pundhukāra, and crushing the elephant of Cāmuṇḍaka,

3.3.s:
rathaṃ ca bhūmau bhagadattakasya vicūrṇya śīghraṃ ca nabho jagāma ..
pravādya śaṃkhaṃ jaganāyakaśca kṛṣṇāṃśamāgamya kathāṃ cakāra ..129..
3.3.d:
रथं च भूमौ भगदत्तकस्य विचूर्ण्य शीघ्रं च नभो जगाम ॥
प्रवाद्य शंखं जगनायकश्च कृष्णांशमागम्य कथां चकार ॥129॥
3.3.m: and swiftly smashing the chariot of Bhagadattaka to dust upon the earth, it flew into the sky; / and blowing his conch, Jaganāyaka approached Kṛṣṇāṃśa and told the tale.

3.3.s:
niśāmuṣitvā jaganāyakādyāḥ prātaḥ samutthāya raṇaṃ prajagmuḥ ..
tadā mahīrāja utāśukā rī sa kinnareśaṃ kaṇakaṃ saputram ..3.3.32.130..
3.3.d:
निशामुषित्वा जगनायकाद्याः प्रातः समुत्थाय रणं प्रजग्मुः ॥
तदा महीराज उताशुका री स किन्नरेशं कणकं सपुत्रम् ॥3.3.32.130॥
3.3.m: Having spent the night, Jaganāyaka and the others rose in the morning and set out for battle; / then Mahīrāja, the swift-acting king, [spoke] to the lord of the kinnaras, Kaṇaka, along with his sons.

3.3.s:
uvāca rājañchṛṇu kinnarāṇāṃ mahābalāste ripavo mamaite ..
vināśayāśu prabalārighātāndevairna sārddhaṃ yudhi vai manuṣyāḥ .. 131 ..
3.3.d:
उवाच राजञ्छृणु किन्नराणां महाबलास्ते रिपवो ममैते ॥
विनाशयाशु प्रबलारिघातान्देवैर्न सार्द्धं युधि वै मनुष्याः ॥ 131 ॥
3.3.m: He said: "O king of the kinnaras, listen! These enemies of mine are of great strength; / swiftly destroy those slayers of powerful foes; humans do not [usually] fight with deities in battle."

3.3.s:
ityuktavānmaṃkaṇabhūpatistu yayau saputro'yutasainyapaśca ..
tamāgataṃ tatra vilokya rājā vīrānsvakīyāṃśca samādideśa ..132..
3.3.d:
इत्युक्तवान्मंकणभूपतिस्तु ययौ सपुत्रोऽयुतसैन्यपश्च ॥
तमागतं तत्र विलोक्य राजा वीरान्स्वकीयांश्च समादिदेश ॥132॥
3.3.m: Having been spoken to thus, King Maṅkaṇa, commander of ten thousand troops, set out with his sons; / seeing him arrived there, the king ordered his own heroes.

3.3.s:
manorathastho jaganāyakaśca sa tālano vai vaḍavāṃ vigṛhya ..
karālasaṃsthaśca tadā jayanto vigṛhya cāpaṃ tarasā jagāma..133..
3.3.d:
मनोरथस्थो जगनायकश्च स तालनो वै वडवां विगृह्य ॥
करालसंस्थश्च तदा जयन्तो विगृह्य चापं तरसा जगाम॥133॥
3.3.m: Jaganāyaka, mounted on Manoratha, and Tālana, taking up a mare, / and then Jayanta, seated on Karāla and grasping his bow, set forth with speed.

3.3.s:
papīhakasthaśca sa rūpaṇo vai jagāma kṛṣṇāṃśasamanvitaśca ..
sa lallasiṃho gajamattasaṃsthaḥ sa dhānyapālo hayamāruroha .. 134 ..
3.3.d:
पपीहकस्थश्च स रूपणो वै जगाम कृष्णांशसमन्वितश्च ॥
स लल्लसिंहो गजमत्तसंस्थः स धान्यपालो हयमारुरोह ॥ 134 ॥
3.3.m: Rūpaṇa, mounted on Papīhaka, went forth accompanied by Kṛṣṇāṃśa; / Lallasiṃha was mounted on a furious elephant, and Dhānyapāla mounted a horse.

3.3.s:
samaṃtataḥ kinnarasainyaghoraṃ vināśayāmāsurupāṃśukhaḍgaiḥ..
vinaśyamāne trisahasrasainye sa kinnareśastarasā jagāma ..135..
3.3.d:
समंततः किन्नरसैन्यघोरं विनाशयामासुरुपांशुखड्गैः॥
विनश्यमाने त्रिसहस्रसैन्ये स किन्नरेशस्तरसा जगाम ॥135॥
3.3.m: On all sides they destroyed the dreadful army of the kinnaras with silent swords; / as his three-thousand-strong army was being destroyed, the lord of the kinnaras rushed forward with speed.

3.3.s: dhyātvā kuberaṃ ca gṛhītacāpo nabhogatastatra babhūva sūkṣmaḥ..136..
3.3.d: ध्यात्वा कुबेरं च गृहीतचापो नभोगतस्तत्र बभूव सूक्ष्मः॥136॥
3.3.m: Meditating on Kubera and taking up his bow, he flew into the sky and became subtle there.

3.3.s:
adṛśyamānaḥ svaśaraiḥ kaṭhorairvinardya sarvānhi nanarda ghoram ..
vilapyamāne ca samastaśūre jayanta evāśu jagāma śatruma .. 137 ..
3.3.d:
अदृश्यमानः स्वशरैः कठोरैर्विनर्द्य सर्वान्हि ननर्द घोरम् ॥
विलप्यमाने च समस्तशूरे जयन्त एवाशु जगाम शत्रुम ॥ 137 ॥
3.3.m: Remaining invisible, crushing everyone with his harsh arrows, he roared terribly; / and as all the warriors were lamenting, Jayanta swiftly went after the enemy.

3.3.s:
dhyātvā maheṃdraṃ kaṇakaṃ ca baddhvā kṛṣṇāṃśamāgamya padau nanāma ..
tadā tu te śatrusahasrasainye niśamya baddhaṃ kaṇakaṃ nijeṃdram .. 138 ..
3.3.d:
ध्यात्वा महेंद्रं कणकं च बद्ध्वा कृष्णांशमागम्य पदौ ननाम ॥
तदा तु ते शत्रुसहस्रसैन्ये निशम्य बद्धं कणकं निजेंद्रम् ॥ 138 ॥
3.3.m: Meditating on Mahendra, he bound Kaṇaka, approached Kṛṣṇāṃśa, and bowed at his feet; / then the enemy’s thousand-strong army, hearing that their own lord Kaṇaka was bound,

3.3.s:
vinargha ghoraṃ rurudhuśca sarvānmāyā vino guhyakamastramūhuḥ ..
dineṣu sapteṣu tathā niśāsu babhūva yuddhaṃ ca samaṃtatastaiḥ .. 139 ..
3.3.d:
विनर्घ घोरं रुरुधुश्च सर्वान्माया विनो गुह्यकमस्त्रमूहुः ॥
दिनेषु सप्तेषु तथा निशासु बभूव युद्धं च समंततस्तैः ॥ 139 ॥
3.3.m: roared dreadfully and held back all [the warriors]; skilled in illusion, they discharged the guhyaka missile; / for seven days and nights, battle raged with them on all sides.

3.3.s:
śramānvitāḥ sapta mahāpravīrā hateṣu sarveṣu suṣupuśca vai yadā..
tadā kuberaṃ kaṇakaśca dhyātvā labdhvā varaṃ baṃdhanamāśu chittvā .. 3.3.32.140 ..
3.3.d:
श्रमान्विताः सप्त महाप्रवीरा हतेषु सर्वेषु सुषुपुश्च वै यदा॥
तदा कुबेरं कणकश्च ध्यात्वा लब्ध्वा वरं बंधनमाशु छित्त्वा ॥ 3.3.32.140 ॥
3.3.m: When, exhausted with fatigue, the seven great warriors fell asleep after all [the foes] were slain, / then Kaṇaka, meditating on Kubera, obtained a boon and quickly severed his bonds.

3.3.s:
suptānsamutthāya ca sapta śūrānniśīthakāle sa cakāra yuddham ..
jitvā ca tānṣaṭ sa varaprabhāvāttadeṃdulenaiva raṇaṃ cakāra .. 141 ..
3.3.d:
सुप्तान्समुत्थाय च सप्त शूरान्निशीथकाले स चकार युद्धम् ॥
जित्वा च तान्षट् स वरप्रभावात्तदेंदुलेनैव रणं चकार ॥ 141 ॥
3.3.m: Rising up, he fought at midnight against the seven sleeping warriors. / Having conquered the six of them by the power of his boon, he then fought with Indula alone.

3.3.s:
gṛhītakhaḍgau raṇaghoramattau hatvā tato vai bhuvi ceyatuśca ..
prajagmaturnākamupāntadevau saṃstūyamānau surasattamaiśca .. 142 ..
3.3.d:
गृहीतखड्गौ रणघोरमत्तौ हत्वा ततो वै भुवि चेयतुश्च ॥
प्रजग्मतुर्नाकमुपान्तदेवौ संस्तूयमानौ सुरसत्तमैश्च ॥ 142 ॥
3.3.m: Taking their swords, furious and terrible in battle, having struck [each other], both fell to the earth. / Attended by the gods, praised by the foremost among the gods, they went to heaven.

3.3.s:
tataḥ prabhāte vimale vijāte ruroda rāmāṃśa utālalāpa ..
pāpaiḥ kalāpaiḥ parīpīḍyamānaḥ kulānvitaḥ sarva yuto munīṃdra .. 143 ..
3.3.d:
ततः प्रभाते विमले विजाते रुरोद रामांश उताललाप ॥
पापैः कलापैः परीपीड्यमानः कुलान्वितः सर्व युतो मुनींद्र ॥ 143 ॥
3.3.m: Then, when the bright dawn appeared, the portion of Rāma wept and lamented, / tormented by a multitude of wicked deeds, along with his family and accompanied by all, O prince of sages.

3.3.s:
sa paṃcaśabdaṃ gajamāruroha trilakṣasainyaistarasā jagāma ..
tadā mahīrāja utāha śṛṇvangacchadhvamadyaiva mayā sametāḥ .. .. 144 ..
3.3.d:
स पंचशब्दं गजमारुरोह त्रिलक्षसैन्यैस्तरसा जगाम ॥
तदा महीराज उताह शृण्वन्गच्छध्वमद्यैव मया समेताः ॥ ॥ 144 ॥
3.3.m: He mounted the elephant Pañcaśabda and swiftly set out with an army of three hundred thousand. / Then king Mahīrāja, listening, said: 'March forth this very day, accompanied by me!'

3.3.s:
svapaṃcalakṣaiḥ prabalaiśca śūraiḥ sārddhaṃ rurodhāśu ripośca senām ..
tayorbabhūvāśu raṇaḥ praghoro vinardatoryudanimittamāśu .. 145 ..
3.3.d:
स्वपंचलक्षैः प्रबलैश्च शूरैः सार्द्धं रुरोधाशु रिपोश्च सेनाम् ॥
तयोर्बभूवाशु रणः प्रघोरो विनर्दतोर्युदनिमित्तमाशु ॥ 145 ॥
3.3.m: Together with his five hundred thousand mighty warriors, he swiftly blocked the enemy's army. / A very terrible battle quickly took place between the two, who were roaring for the sake of war.

3.3.s:
triyāma mātreṇa hatāśca sarve dvayośca pakṣā balaśālinaśca ..
tadā mahīrāja utāyayau vai samaṃḍalīkaśca dhanurvigṛhya .. 146 ..
3.3.d:
त्रियाम मात्रेण हताश्च सर्वे द्वयोश्च पक्षा बलशालिनश्च ॥
तदा महीराज उताययौ वै समंडलीकश्च धनुर्विगृह्य ॥ 146 ॥
3.3.m: In the span of just three watches, all the mighty warriors of both sides were slain. / Then king Mahīrāja advanced with his vassals, grasping his bow.

3.3.s:
sa dhuṃdhukāraśca tadājagāma ratha sthitaṃ lakṣaṇamugravīram ..
tadodayo vai bhagadattameva cāmuṃḍakaṃ bhīṣmakarājasūnuḥ .. 147 ..
3.3.d:
स धुंधुकारश्च तदाजगाम रथ स्थितं लक्षणमुग्रवीरम् ॥
तदोदयो वै भगदत्तमेव चामुंडकं भीष्मकराजसूनुः ॥ 147 ॥
3.3.m: Then Dhundhukāra advanced against the fierce hero Lakṣaṇa who stood on his chariot. / Then Udaya [advanced] against Bhagadatta, and the son of king Bhīṣmaka against Cāmuṇḍaka.

3.3.s:
sa paṃcaśabdaṃ gajamāsthito vai gataḥ sa evāśu jagāma bhūpam ..
dhanurvigṛhyāśugamulbaṇaṃ ca nṛpasthitaścātha bhayaṃkaraṃ ca .. 148 ..
3.3.d:
स पंचशब्दं गजमास्थितो वै गतः स एवाशु जगाम भूपम् ॥
धनुर्विगृह्याशुगमुल्बणं च नृपस्थितश्चाथ भयंकरं च ॥ 148 ॥
3.3.m: Mounted upon the elephant Pañcaśabda, he quickly marched against the king, / taking up his formidable bow and swift arrows, standing terrifyingly before the king.

3.3.s:
gajaṃ pramattaṃ śivadattamugramāhlādahantāramuvāca vākyam ..
aye pramattāgragajeṃdra śūra jayaṃ ca me dehi śivapradatta .. 149 ..
3.3.d:
गजं प्रमत्तं शिवदत्तमुग्रमाह्लादहन्तारमुवाच वाक्यम् ॥
अये प्रमत्ताग्रगजेंद्र शूर जयं च मे देहि शिवप्रदत्त ॥ 149 ॥
3.3.m: He spoke these words to the rutting elephant Śivadatta, fierce slayer of Āhlāda: / 'O foremost of rutting lordly elephants, O hero granted by Śiva, grant me victory!

3.3.s:
sa maṃḍalīko raṇadurmadaśca rāmāṃśa āhlāda iti prasiddhaḥ..
tasmācca māṃ rakṣa javena hastinmahābalātkāla rasācca vīrāt .. 3.3.32.150 ..
3.3.d:
स मंडलीको रणदुर्मदश्च रामांश आह्लाद इति प्रसिद्धः॥
तस्माच्च मां रक्ष जवेन हस्तिन्महाबलात्काल रसाच्च वीरात् ॥ 3.3.32.150 ॥
3.3.m: He is a sovereign lord, intoxicated with battle, a portion of Rāma known as Āhlāda. / Therefore, swiftly protect me, O elephant, from that mighty hero of death-like vigor!'

3.3.s:
ityevamukto nṛpatiṃ sa hastī vacastamāhāśu śṛṇuṣva rājan..
yāvadahaṃ vai tanujīvadhārī tāvadbhavāñchatrubhayaṃkaraśca..151..
3.3.d:
इत्येवमुक्तो नृपतिं स हस्ती वचस्तमाहाशु शृणुष्व राजन्॥
यावदहं वै तनुजीवधारी तावद्भवाञ्छत्रुभयंकरश्च॥151॥
3.3.m: Addressed in this manner, that elephant spoke quickly to the king: 'Listen, O king! / As long as I maintain life in this body, so long shall you cause terror to your enemies.'

3.3.s:
ityuktavaṃtaṃ ca gajaṃ pramattaṃ sa paṃcaśabdaśca tadā svadaṃtaiḥ ..
mukhaṃ caturbhiśca vidārya śatrornanarda ghoraṃ sa maheṃdradattaḥ .. 152 ..
3.3.d:
इत्युक्तवंतं च गजं प्रमत्तं स पंचशब्दश्च तदा स्वदंतैः ॥
मुखं चतुर्भिश्च विदार्य शत्रोर्ननर्द घोरं स महेंद्रदत्तः ॥ 152 ॥
3.3.m: To the rutting elephant who had spoken thus, Pañcaśabda then, with his own tusks— / tearing open the enemy's face with four [tusks]—roared terribly, that elephant given by Mahendra.

3.3.s:
sa rudradattaśca gajaḥ pramatto ruṣānvadhāvattarasā gajeṃdram ..
ripuṃ svapadbhyāṃ ca cakhāna kuṃbhaiḥ svatuṃḍadaṃḍena tudaṃ prakurvan .. 153 ..
3.3.d:
स रुद्रदत्तश्च गजः प्रमत्तो रुषान्वधावत्तरसा गजेंद्रम् ॥
रिपुं स्वपद्भ्यां च चखान कुंभैः स्वतुंडदंडेन तुदं प्रकुर्वन् ॥ 153 ॥
3.3.m: That rutting elephant given by Rudra quickly charged the lordly elephant in rage; / with his feet he dug into the enemy, striking his frontal globes with his trunk-club.

3.3.s:
avāpa mūrchāṃ ca sa paṃcaśabdastadāśu bhūpaṃ prati maṃḍalīkaḥ ..
svatomareṇāṃgavraṇaṃ pradāya khaḍgena hatvā gajarājamugram ..
jagāma padbhyāṃ sa ripupramāthī yatra sthitaścendula ugradhanvā .. .. 154 ..
3.3.d:
अवाप मूर्छां च स पंचशब्दस्तदाशु भूपं प्रति मंडलीकः ॥
स्वतोमरेणांगव्रणं प्रदाय खड्गेन हत्वा गजराजमुग्रम् ॥
जगाम पद्भ्यां स रिपुप्रमाथी यत्र स्थितश्चेन्दुल उग्रधन्वा ॥ ॥ 154 ॥
3.3.m: Pañcaśabda then fell unconscious; quickly facing the king, the sovereign lord, / inflicting a wound on his body with his javelin and striking down the fierce lord of elephants with his sword, / that crusher of foes went on foot to where Indula of fierce bow stood.

3.3.s:
utthāpya putraṃ ca vilapyamānāṃ patnīṃ svakīyāṃ prati cājagāma ..
tadā pramattau ca gajau samūrchāṃ tyaktvā punaścakratureva yuddham .. .. 155 ..
3.3.d:
उत्थाप्य पुत्रं च विलप्यमानां पत्नीं स्वकीयां प्रति चाजगाम ॥
तदा प्रमत्तौ च गजौ समूर्छां त्यक्त्वा पुनश्चक्रतुरेव युद्धम् ॥ ॥ 155 ॥
3.3.m: Raising up his son, he went toward his lamenting wife. / Then the two rutting elephants, casting off their stupor, resumed fighting again.

3.3.s:
sa lakṣaṇaḥ khaḍgavareṇa bāṇānripośca chittvā nijavaiṣṇavāstram ..
dadhāra cāpe ca sumaṃtrayitvā sadhuṃdhukāraṃ ca gajaṃ dadāha .. 156 ..
3.3.d:
स लक्षणः खड्गवरेण बाणान्रिपोश्च छित्त्वा निजवैष्णवास्त्रम् ॥
दधार चापे च सुमंत्रयित्वा सधुंधुकारं च गजं ददाह ॥ 156 ॥
3.3.m: Lakṣaṇa, having severed the enemy's arrows with his excellent sword, fitted his Vaiṣṇava missile / upon his bow, reciting the proper mantra, and burnt Dhundhukāra along with his elephant.

3.3.s:
hate ca tasminnijamukhyabaṃdhau sabhūmirājaśca gṛhītacāpaḥ ..
śareṇa raudreṇa ca lakṣaṇaṃ taṃ jaghāna tatrādibhayaṃkarasthaḥ .. 157 ..
3.3.d:
हते च तस्मिन्निजमुख्यबंधौ सभूमिराजश्च गृहीतचापः ॥
शरेण रौद्रेण च लक्षणं तं जघान तत्रादिभयंकरस्थः ॥ 157 ॥
3.3.m: When that chief kinsman of his was slain, king Mahīrāja took up his bow; / standing formidable at the vanguard, he struck Lakṣaṇa there with a terrible arrow.

3.3.s:
sa mūrchitaḥ śukla kuleṣu sūryastadodayo vai bhagadattameva ..
sumūrchayitvā ca jagāma śīghraṃ yatra sthito lakṣaṇa ekavīraḥ .. 158 ..
3.3.d:
स मूर्छितः शुक्ल कुलेषु सूर्यस्तदोदयो वै भगदत्तमेव ॥
सुमूर्छयित्वा च जगाम शीघ्रं यत्र स्थितो लक्षण एकवीरः ॥ 158 ॥
3.3.m: He, the sun among the Śukla lineage, swooned. Then Udaya, having knocked / Bhagadatta into a deep faint, went quickly where the sole hero Lakṣaṇa stood.

3.3.s:
bhayānvitastaṃ ca vilokya rājā javena dudrāva ca raktabījam ..
tadā sudevaṃ ca sa raktabījo jitvā tu kṛṣṇāṃśayutaṃ jagāma .. 159 ..
3.3.d:
भयान्वितस्तं च विलोक्य राजा जवेन दुद्राव च रक्तबीजम् ॥
तदा सुदेवं च स रक्तबीजो जित्वा तु कृष्णांशयुतं जगाम ॥ 159 ॥
3.3.m: Seeing him, the king, terrified, quickly ran toward Raktabīja. / Then Raktabīja, having defeated Sudeva, went together with the portion of Kṛṣṇa.

3.3.s:
bāṇena śīghraṃ sa ca mūrcchayitvā punaśca devaṃ ca sa mūrchayitvā ..
tadbaṃdhanāyodyata āśukārī sa lakṣaṇastatra tadā jagāma .. 3.3.32.160 ..
3.3.d:
बाणेन शीघ्रं स च मूर्च्छयित्वा पुनश्च देवं च स मूर्छयित्वा ॥
तद्बंधनायोद्यत आशुकारी स लक्षणस्तत्र तदा जगाम ॥ 3.3.32.160 ॥
3.3.m: Quickly causing him to swoon with an arrow, and again causing Deva to swoon, / he prepared to bind him; then swift-acting Lakṣaṇa went there.

3.3.s:
pradhāya cāpe ca sa vaiṣṇavāstraṃ pracodayāmāsa ca raktabīje ..
tadā sa sāmantasuto balīyānraṇaṃ vihāyāśu vilokya saṃdhyām ..
bhayānvitaḥ svaiśca yuto yayau vai yatra sthitā bhūpatayaḥ sakopāḥ .. 161 ..
3.3.d:
प्रधाय चापे च स वैष्णवास्त्रं प्रचोदयामास च रक्तबीजे ॥
तदा स सामन्तसुतो बलीयान्रणं विहायाशु विलोक्य संध्याम् ॥
भयान्वितः स्वैश्च युतो ययौ वै यत्र स्थिता भूपतयः सकोपाः ॥ 161 ॥
3.3.m: Placing the Vaiṣṇava missile on his bow, he hurled it at Raktabīja. / Then that mighty son of a feudatory, beholding the twilight, quickly abandoned the battle; / filled with fear, accompanied by his men, he went where the wrathful kings were stationed.

3.3.s:
vilokya śatruṃ ca sa ratnabhānoḥ suto yayau vai śibirāṇi yuktaḥ ..
niśāmya bhūpaḥ sa ca caṃdravaṃśī jayaṃ svakīyaṃ suṣupustu te vai ..
prātaśca kāle sa ca caṃdravaṃśī vilokya śuklānvayamāha bhūpam..162..
3.3.d:
विलोक्य शत्रुं च स रत्नभानोः सुतो ययौ वै शिबिराणि युक्तः ॥
निशाम्य भूपः स च चंद्रवंशी जयं स्वकीयं सुषुपुस्तु ते वै ॥
प्रातश्च काले स च चंद्रवंशी विलोक्य शुक्लान्वयमाह भूपम्॥162॥
3.3.m: Beholding the enemy, the son of Ratnabhānu went to the tents with his troops. / Having heard of their victory, that king of the Lunar dynasty and his men went to sleep. / In the morning, that scion of the Lunar race, beholding the king of the Śukla lineage, said:

3.3.s:
aye gurjaradeśīya mūlavarmansutaiḥ saha..
lakṣasainyānvito bhūtvā gantumarhatu vai bhavān.. 163..
3.3.d:
अये गुर्जरदेशीय मूलवर्मन्सुतैः सह॥
लक्षसैन्यान्वितो भूत्वा गन्तुमर्हतु वै भवान्॥ 163॥
3.3.m: 'O Mūlavarman of the Gurjara country, along with your sons, / accompanied by an army of one hundred thousand, you ought to advance!'

3.3.s:
ityuktaḥ sa tu bhūpālo yuddhabhūmimupāyayau..
mahīrājājñayā prāpto nāmnā pūrṇāmalo balī.. 164..
3.3.d:
इत्युक्तः स तु भूपालो युद्धभूमिमुपाययौ॥
महीराजाज्ञया प्राप्तो नाम्ना पूर्णामलो बली॥ 164॥
3.3.m: Thus addressed, that king went to the battlefield; / by order of Mahīrāja, the mighty warrior named Pūrṇāmala arrived,

3.3.s:
daśaputrānvito yuddhe sainya lakṣeṇa saṃyutḥ..
tayoścāsīnmahadyuddhaṃ yāmadvayamupasthitam..165..
3.3.d:
दशपुत्रान्वितो युद्धे सैन्य लक्षेण संयुत्ः॥
तयोश्चासीन्महद्युद्धं यामद्वयमुपस्थितम्॥165॥
3.3.m: accompanied by his ten sons in battle and joined by an army of one hundred thousand. / A great battle ensued between the two, which lasted for two watches.

3.3.s:
hateṣu teṣu sarveṣu tau nṛpau sasutairbalau ..
anonyena raṇaṃ kṛtvā yamaloka mupāgatau .. 166 ..
3.3.d:
हतेषु तेषु सर्वेषु तौ नृपौ ससुतैर्बलौ ॥
अनोन्येन रणं कृत्वा यमलोक मुपागतौ ॥ 166 ॥
3.3.m: When all those [soldiers] were slain, those two mighty kings, together with their sons, / having fought one another, departed to the realm of Yama.

3.3.s:
mārgakṛṣṇacaturdaśyāṃ prabhāte vimale ravau ..
kaikayo lakṣasenāḍhyo dayāputrasamanvitaḥ ..
lakṣaṇānujñayā prāptastasminyudhi bhayānake .. 167 ..
3.3.d:
मार्गकृष्णचतुर्दश्यां प्रभाते विमले रवौ ॥
कैकयो लक्षसेनाढ्यो दयापुत्रसमन्वितः ॥
लक्षणानुज्ञया प्राप्तस्तस्मिन्युधि भयानके ॥ 167 ॥
3.3.m: On the fourteenth day of the dark fortnight of Mārgaśīrṣa, when the clear sun rose in the morning, / the Kaikaya king, endowed with an army of one hundred thousand and accompanied by the sons of Dayā, / arrived at that terrible battle by permission of Lakṣaṇa.

3.3.s:
madrakeśastadā rājā daśaputrasamanvitaḥ ..
lakṣasainyānvitastatra yatra yuddhaṃ samanvabhūt..
parasparaṃ hatāḥ sarve dinānte kṣatriyā raṇe .. 168 ..
3.3.d:
मद्रकेशस्तदा राजा दशपुत्रसमन्वितः ॥
लक्षसैन्यान्वितस्तत्र यत्र युद्धं समन्वभूत्॥
परस्परं हताः सर्वे दिनान्ते क्षत्रिया रणे ॥ 168 ॥
3.3.m: Then the king of the Madras, accompanied by his ten sons / and accompanied by an army of one hundred thousand, [arrived] where the battle took place. / At the end of the day, all those kṣatriyas were slain by one another in battle.

3.3.s:
punaḥ prabhāte vimale bhagadatto mahābalī ..
trilakṣabalasaṃyukto jagarjja raṇamūrddhani.. 169..
3.3.d:
पुनः प्रभाते विमले भगदत्तो महाबली ॥
त्रिलक्षबलसंयुक्तो जगर्ज्ज रणमूर्द्धनि॥ 169॥
3.3.m: Again, at clear dawn, the mighty Bhagadatta, / joined by a force of three hundred thousand, roared at the head of the battle.

3.3.s:
dṛṣṭvā taṃ lakṣaṇo vīrastrilakṣabalasaṃyutaḥ ..
cakāra tumulaṃ ghoraṃ senayā ca svakīyayā .. 3.3.32.170 ..
3.3.d:
दृष्ट्वा तं लक्षणो वीरस्त्रिलक्षबलसंयुतः ॥
चकार तुमुलं घोरं सेनया च स्वकीयया ॥ 3.3.32.170 ॥
3.3.m: Seeing him, the hero Lakṣaṇa, accompanied by a force of three hundred thousand, / engaged in a fierce, tumultuous combat with his army.

3.3.s:
aparāhṇe hatāḥ sarve sainikā nṛpayostadā ..
bhagadattaḥ svayaṃ kruddho rathastho lakṣaṇaṃ yayau .. 171 ..
3.3.d:
अपराह्णे हताः सर्वे सैनिका नृपयोस्तदा ॥
भगदत्तः स्वयं क्रुद्धो रथस्थो लक्षणं ययौ ॥ 171 ॥
3.3.m: In the afternoon, all the soldiers of both kings were slain. / Bhagadatta himself, enraged, mounted his chariot and advanced against Lakṣaṇa.

3.3.s:
lakṣaṇo rathamāruhya svapituḥ śatrujaṃ nṛpam ..
tribhirbāṇaiśca saṃtodya bhallena samatāḍayat .. .172 ..
3.3.d:
लक्षणो रथमारुह्य स्वपितुः शत्रुजं नृपम् ॥
त्रिभिर्बाणैश्च संतोद्य भल्लेन समताडयत् ॥ .172 ॥
3.3.m: Mounting his chariot, Lakṣaṇa pierced the king born of his father's enemy / with three arrows and struck him with a broad-headed shaft.

3.3.s:
bhagadattastadā kruddho virathaṃ taṃ cakāra ha ..
kruddhavaṃtaṃ ripuṃ ghoraṃ lakṣaṇaḥ khaṅgapāṇikaḥ ..
hatvā hayāṃstathā sūtaṃ bhagadattamupāyayau .. 173 ..
3.3.d:
भगदत्तस्तदा क्रुद्धो विरथं तं चकार ह ॥
क्रुद्धवंतं रिपुं घोरं लक्षणः खङ्गपाणिकः ॥
हत्वा हयांस्तथा सूतं भगदत्तमुपाययौ ॥ 173 ॥
3.3.m: Bhagadatta then, enraged, deprived him of his chariot. / Lakṣaṇa, sword in hand, slaying the horses and charioteer / of his terrible, wrathful enemy, advanced on Bhagadatta.

3.3.s:
mardayitvā ca taccarma cchittvā varma tadudbhavam ..
tridhā cakāra balavānbhagadattaṃ ripossutam .. 174 ..
3.3.d:
मर्दयित्वा च तच्चर्म च्छित्त्वा वर्म तदुद्भवम् ॥
त्रिधा चकार बलवान्भगदत्तं रिपोस्सुतम् ॥ 174 ॥
3.3.m:
And crushing his shield and cutting through his armour,
the mighty one cut Bhagadatta, the enemy's son, into three pieces.

3.3.s:
saṃdhyākāle hate tasmim̐llakṣaṇastvarayānvitaḥ ..
ekākī śiviraṃ prāpto hastinyupari saṃsthitaḥ .. 175 ..
3.3.d:
संध्याकाले हते तस्मिम्̐ल्लक्षणस्त्वरयान्वितः ॥
एकाकी शिविरं प्राप्तो हस्तिन्युपरि संस्थितः ॥ 175 ॥
3.3.m:
When he was slain at twilight, Lakṣaṇa, filled with haste,
mounted upon an elephant, reached his camp alone.

3.3.s:
bhagadatte hate tasminsa rājā krodhamūrchitaḥ ..
svakīyānsarvabhūpāṃśca cāmuṃḍena samanvitān ..
preṣayāmāsa yuddhāya mārge ca pratipaddine .. 176 ..
3.3.d:
भगदत्ते हते तस्मिन्स राजा क्रोधमूर्छितः ॥
स्वकीयान्सर्वभूपांश्च चामुंडेन समन्वितान् ॥
प्रेषयामास युद्धाय मार्गे च प्रतिपद्दिने ॥ 176 ॥
3.3.m:
When Bhagadatta was slain, that king, overcome with fury,
sent all his own kings, together with Cāmuṇḍa,
into battle on the road on the pratipad lunar day.

3.3.s:
aṃgadaśca kaliṃgaśca trikoṇaḥ śrīpatistathā ..
śrītāraśca mukuṃdañca ruhilo guhilastathā .. 177 ..
3.3.d:
अंगदश्च कलिंगश्च त्रिकोणः श्रीपतिस्तथा ॥
श्रीतारश्च मुकुंदञ्च रुहिलो गुहिलस्तथा ॥ 177 ॥
3.3.m:
Aṅgada and Kaliṅga, Trikoṇa and Śrīpati,
Śrītāra and Mukuṃda, Ruhila and Guhila,

3.3.s:
suketurnava bhūpāste navāyutabalairyutāḥ ..
vādyāni vādayāmāsustasminyuddhamahotsave .. 178 ..
3.3.d:
सुकेतुर्नव भूपास्ते नवायुतबलैर्युताः ॥
वाद्यानि वादयामासुस्तस्मिन्युद्धमहोत्सवे ॥ 178 ॥
3.3.m:
and Suketu: those nine kings, accompanied by forces of ninety thousand,
played musical instruments in that great festival of battle.

3.3.s:
dṛṣṭvā tām̐llakṣaṇo vīro rājabhiśca svakīyakaiḥ ..
sārddhaṃ jagāma yuddhāya tathā vyūhyāyudhadripūn .. 179 ..
3.3.d:
दृष्ट्वा ताम्̐ल्लक्षणो वीरो राजभिश्च स्वकीयकैः ॥
सार्द्धं जगाम युद्धाय तथा व्यूह्यायुधद्रिपून् ॥ 179 ॥
3.3.m:
Seeing them, the heroic Lakṣaṇa, together with his own kings,
arraying the enemy soldiers, advanced to battle.

3.3.s:
rudravarmā ca nṛpatiḥ śūrairdaśasahasrakaiḥ ..
aṃgadaṃ vairiṇaṃ matvā tena sārddhamayudhyata .. 3.3.32.180 ..
3.3.d:
रुद्रवर्मा च नृपतिः शूरैर्दशसहस्रकैः ॥
अंगदं वैरिणं मत्वा तेन सार्द्धमयुध्यत ॥ 3.3.32.180 ॥
3.3.m:
And King Rudravarmā, with ten thousand warriors,
regarding Aṅgada as his enemy, fought with him.

3.3.s:
kālīvarmā'yutaissārdhaṃ kaliṃgaṃ pratyabudhyata ..
vīrasiṃho'yutaissārddhaṃ trikoṇaṃ pratyayudhyata .. 181 ..
3.3.d:
कालीवर्माऽयुतैस्सार्धं कलिंगं प्रत्यबुध्यत ॥
वीरसिंहोऽयुतैस्सार्द्धं त्रिकोणं प्रत्ययुध्यत ॥ 181 ॥
3.3.m:
Kālīvarmā fought against Kaliṅga with ten thousand;
Vīrasiṃha fought against Trikoṇa with ten thousand.

3.3.s:
tatonujaḥ pravīraśca śrīpatiṃ so'yutaissaha ..
nṛpaḥ sūryo dharo vīro'yutāḍhayo balavānraṇe ..
śrītāraṃ nṛpamāsādya mahadyuddhamacīkarat ..182..
3.3.d:
ततोनुजः प्रवीरश्च श्रीपतिं सोऽयुतैस्सह ॥
नृपः सूर्यो धरो वीरोऽयुताढयो बलवान्रणे ॥
श्रीतारं नृपमासाद्य महद्युद्धमचीकरत् ॥182॥
3.3.m:
Then his younger brother, the mighty hero, along with ten thousand, [fought] Śrīpati.
King Sūryadhara, heroic and mighty, rich with ten thousand in battle,
approaching King Śrītāra, waged a great fight.

3.3.s:
vāmanoyutasaṃyukto mukuṃdaṃ prati so'gamat ..
gaṃgāsiṃhaśca balavānmahilaṃ prati sāyutaḥ ..183..
3.3.d:
वामनोयुतसंयुक्तो मुकुंदं प्रति सोऽगमत् ॥
गंगासिंहश्च बलवान्महिलं प्रति सायुतः ॥183॥
3.3.m:
Vāmana, accompanied by ten thousand, advanced against Mukuṃda;
and the mighty Gaṅgāsiṃha, along with ten thousand, [advanced] against Mahila.

3.3.s:
lallasiṃhoyutaissārddhaṃ guhilaṃ prati so'gamat ..
triśatāni tato bhūpāḥ sahasrāḍhyāḥ pṛthakpṛthak ..184..
3.3.d:
लल्लसिंहोयुतैस्सार्द्धं गुहिलं प्रति सोऽगमत् ॥
त्रिशतानि ततो भूपाः सहस्राढ्याः पृथक्पृथक् ॥184॥
3.3.m:
Lallasiṃha, together with ten thousand, advanced against Guhila.
Then three hundred kings, each rich with a thousand [men],

3.3.s:
kṣudrabhūpāḥ kṣudrabhūpāṃstriśatāni samāyayuḥ ..
anyonyena hatāḥ sarve kṛtvā yuddhaṃ bhayānakam.. 185 ..
3.3.d:
क्षुद्रभूपाः क्षुद्रभूपांस्त्रिशतानि समाययुः ॥
अन्योन्येन हताः सर्वे कृत्वा युद्धं भयानकम्॥ 185 ॥
3.3.m:
three hundred petty kings came upon petty kings;
having fought a terrifying battle, they were all slain by one another.

3.3.s:
cāmuṃḍastu tadā dṛṣṭvā mṛtakānsarvabhūpatīn ..
lakṣaṇāntamupāgamya mahadyuddhaṃ cakāra ha ..186.
3.3.d:
चामुंडस्तु तदा दृष्ट्वा मृतकान्सर्वभूपतीन् ॥
लक्षणान्तमुपागम्य महद्युद्धं चकार ह ॥186.
3.3.m:
Then Cāmuṇḍa, seeing that all the kings were dead,
approached near Lakṣaṇa and waged a great battle.

3.3.s:
lakṣaṇo raktabījaṃ taṃ jñātvā brāhmaṇasaṃmatam ..
vaiṣṇavāstraṃ tadā tasmai na dadau tena pīḍita..187..
3.3.d:
लक्षणो रक्तबीजं तं ज्ञात्वा ब्राह्मणसंमतम् ॥
वैष्णवास्त्रं तदा तस्मै न ददौ तेन पीडित॥187॥
3.3.m:
Lakṣaṇa, knowing him to be Raktabīja, approved by the brahmins,
though tormented by him, did not release the Vaiṣṇava missile against him then.

3.3.s:
sāyaṃkāle tu saṃprāpte lakṣaṇo hastinīsthitaḥ ..
ekākī śiviraṃ prāptaścāmuṃḍaṃ nṛpamāyayau .. 188 ..
3.3.d:
सायंकाले तु संप्राप्ते लक्षणो हस्तिनीस्थितः ॥
एकाकी शिविरं प्राप्तश्चामुंडं नृपमाययौ ॥ 188 ॥
3.3.m:
When evening arrived, Lakṣaṇa, seated upon a female elephant,
reached his camp alone; [and] Cāmuṇḍa came to the king.

3.3.s:
dvitīyāyāṃ prabhāte ca kṛṣṇāṃśo devasaṃyutaḥ ..
śūrairdaśasahasraiśca yuddhabhūmimupāyayau .. 189 ..
3.3.d:
द्वितीयायां प्रभाते च कृष्णांशो देवसंयुतः ॥
शूरैर्दशसहस्रैश्च युद्धभूमिमुपाययौ ॥ 189 ॥
3.3.m:
And at dawn on the dvitīyā, Kṛṣṇāṃśa, accompanied by Devasiṃha
and with ten thousand heroes, went to the battlefield.

3.3.s:
tārakaśca sacāmuṃḍo dvilakṣabalasaṃyutaḥ ..
dviśataiśca tathā bhūpaiḥ sārddhaṃ yuddhamupasthitau..3.3.32.190..
3.3.d:
तारकश्च सचामुंडो द्विलक्षबलसंयुतः ॥
द्विशतैश्च तथा भूपैः सार्द्धं युद्धमुपस्थितौ॥3.3.32.190॥
3.3.m:
And Tāraka, along with Cāmuṇḍa, possessing a force of two hundred thousand
and with two hundred kings, stood ready for battle.

3.3.s:
puraskṛtya ,nṛpānsarvānsasainyau balavattarau ..
teṣāmanu sthitau yuddhe tatra jāto mahāraṇaḥ .. 191 ..
3.3.d:
पुरस्कृत्य ,नृपान्सर्वान्ससैन्यौ बलवत्तरौ ॥
तेषामनु स्थितौ युद्धे तत्र जातो महारणः ॥ 191 ॥
3.3.m:
Placing all the kings in front, those two very powerful warriors with their army
stood behind them in battle; there a great combat took place.

3.3.s:
yāmamātreṇa tau vīrau hatvā sarvamahīpatīn ..
lakṣasainyāṃstathā hatvā saṃsthitau śramakarṣitau..192..
3.3.d:
याममात्रेण तौ वीरौ हत्वा सर्वमहीपतीन् ॥
लक्षसैन्यांस्तथा हत्वा संस्थितौ श्रमकर्षितौ॥192॥
3.3.m:
In merely a single watch, those two heroes, having slain all the kings
and having killed an army of a hundred thousand, stood exhausted by fatigue.

3.3.s:
cāmuṃḍastārako dhūrtaḥ saṃprāptau chidradarśinau ..
tābhyāṃ śramānvitābhyāṃ ca cakratustau samaṃ raṇam..193..
3.3.d:
चामुंडस्तारको धूर्तः संप्राप्तौ छिद्रदर्शिनौ ॥
ताभ्यां श्रमान्विताभ्यां च चक्रतुस्तौ समं रणम्॥193॥
3.3.m:
The rogue Cāmuṇḍa and Tāraka, watching for a weakness, arrived;
the two fought an equal battle with those two who were afflicted by fatigue.

3.3.s:
teṣāṃ triyāmamātreṇa saṃbabhūva mahānraṇaḥ ..
sāyaṃkāle tu saṃprāpte kṛṣṇāṃśaśca nirāyudhaḥ ..
talaprahāreṇa ripuṃ mūrcchayāmāsa vīryavān ..194..
3.3.d:
तेषां त्रियाममात्रेण संबभूव महान्रणः ॥
सायंकाले तु संप्राप्ते कृष्णांशश्च निरायुधः ॥
तलप्रहारेण रिपुं मूर्च्छयामास वीर्यवान् ॥194॥

3.3.s:
etasminnaṃtare vīrastārako devasiṃhakam ..
hayaṃ manorathaṃ hatvā śaṃkhaśabdamathākarot .. 195 ..
3.3.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे वीरस्तारको देवसिंहकम् ॥
हयं मनोरथं हत्वा शंखशब्दमथाकरोत् ॥ 195 ॥
3.3.m:
In the meantime, the heroic Tāraka, having slain Devasiṃhaka
and his horse Manoratha, blew his conch.

3.3.s:
tacchabdātsa ca cāmuṃḍastyaktvā mūrchāṃ mahābalaḥ ..
kṛṣṇāṃśasya śiraḥ kāyādapahṛtya ca vegavān ..
tayorgṛhītvā śirasī mahīrājamupāyayau .. 196 ..
3.3.d:
तच्छब्दात्स च चामुंडस्त्यक्त्वा मूर्छां महाबलः ॥
कृष्णांशस्य शिरः कायादपहृत्य च वेगवान् ॥
तयोर्गृहीत्वा शिरसी महीराजमुपाययौ ॥ 196 ॥
3.3.m:
At that sound, the mighty Cāmuṇḍa recovered from his faint,
swiftly severed Kṛṣṇāṃśa's head from his body,
and taking both their heads, went to Mahīrāja.

3.3.s:
mahīrājastu te dṛṣṭvā paramānaṃdanirbharaḥ ..
dattvā dānaṃ dvijātibhyo mahotsavamakārayat .. 197 ..
3.3.d:
महीराजस्तु ते दृष्ट्वा परमानंदनिर्भरः ॥
दत्त्वा दानं द्विजातिभ्यो महोत्सवमकारयत् ॥ 197 ॥
3.3.m:
And Mahīrāja, seeing them, filled with supreme joy,
gave gifts to the twice-born and held a great festival.

3.3.s:
lakṣaṇasya tadā sainye hāhāśabdo mahānabhūt ..
śrutvā kolāhalaṃ teṣāṃ jñātvā tau ca hatau nṛpaḥ ..
brahmānaṃdastadā mūrcchāṃ tyaktvā velāmuvāca ha .. 198 ..
3.3.d:
लक्षणस्य तदा सैन्ये हाहाशब्दो महानभूत् ॥
श्रुत्वा कोलाहलं तेषां ज्ञात्वा तौ च हतौ नृपः ॥
ब्रह्मानंदस्तदा मूर्च्छां त्यक्त्वा वेलामुवाच ह ॥ 198 ॥

3.3.s:
priye gaccha raṇaṃ śīghraṃ harināgaramāsthitā ..
mama veṣaṃ śubhaṃ kṛtvā tārakaṃ jahi mā ciram .. 199 ..
3.3.d:
प्रिये गच्छ रणं शीघ्रं हरिनागरमास्थिता ॥
मम वेषं शुभं कृत्वा तारकं जहि मा चिरम् ॥ 199 ॥
3.3.m:
“Beloved, go quickly to battle, riding the Harināgara horse;
assuming my auspicious guise, slay Tāraka without delay!”

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā tu sā velā rāmāṃśena samanvitā ..
sahasraśūrasahitā yuddhabhūmimupāyayau .. 3.3.32.200 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा तु सा वेला रामांशेन समन्विता ॥
सहस्रशूरसहिता युद्धभूमिमुपाययौ ॥ 3.3.32.200 ॥
3.3.m:
Having heard this, Velā, accompanied by Rāmāṃśa
and with a thousand heroes, went to the battlefield.

3.3.s:
śrutvā sa lakṣaṇo vīrastālanena samanvitaḥ ..
sainyaiśca daśasāhasrairmahīrājamupāyayau ..201..
3.3.d:
श्रुत्वा स लक्षणो वीरस्तालनेन समन्वितः ॥
सैन्यैश्च दशसाहस्रैर्महीराजमुपाययौ ॥201॥
3.3.m:
Hearing [this], the heroic Lakṣaṇa, accompanied by Tālana
and with armies of ten thousand, advanced against Mahīrāja.

3.3.s:
tṛtīyāyāṃ prabhāte ca tārako balavattaraḥ ..
brahmānaṃdaṃ ca taṃ matvā mahadyuddhamacī karat .. 202 ..
3.3.d:
तृतीयायां प्रभाते च तारको बलवत्तरः ॥
ब्रह्मानंदं च तं मत्वा महद्युद्धमची करत् ॥ 202 ॥
3.3.m:
And at dawn on the tṛtīyā, the very mighty Tāraka,
thinking her to be Brahmānanda, waged a great battle.

3.3.s:
raktabījaśca cāmuṃḍo rāmāṃśo balavattaraḥ ..
cakāra dāruṇaṃ yuddhaṃ tasminvīrasamāgame .. 203 ..
3.3.d:
रक्तबीजश्च चामुंडो रामांशो बलवत्तरः ॥
चकार दारुणं युद्धं तस्मिन्वीरसमागमे ॥ 203 ॥
3.3.m:
And Cāmuṇḍa, who was Raktabīja, [and] the very powerful Rāmāṃśa
fought a dread battle in that clash of heroes.

3.3.s:
yāmamātreṇa rāmāṃśo hatvā tasya mahāgajam ..
tacchastrāṇi tathā cchitvā mallayuddhamacīkarat .. 204 ..
3.3.d:
याममात्रेण रामांशो हत्वा तस्य महागजम् ॥
तच्छस्त्राणि तथा च्छित्वा मल्लयुद्धमचीकरत् ॥ 204 ॥
3.3.m:
In merely a watch, Rāmāṃśa, having killed his great elephant
and destroyed his weapons, engaged in wrestling.

3.3.s:
triyāmamātreṇa tadā sāyaṃkāle samāgate ..
mamaṃtha bhrātṛhantāraṃ sa ca vīro mamāra ha .. 205 ..
3.3.d:
त्रियाममात्रेण तदा सायंकाले समागते ॥
ममंथ भ्रातृहन्तारं स च वीरो ममार ह ॥ 205 ॥
3.3.m:
In merely three watches, as evening then arrived,
he crushed the slayer of his brother, and that hero died.

3.3.s:
tadā velā mahāśatruṃ tārakaṃ balavattaram ..
chittvāstrāṇi svakhaḍgena śiraḥ kāyādapāharat .. 206 ..
3.3.d:
तदा वेला महाशत्रुं तारकं बलवत्तरम् ॥
छित्त्वास्त्राणि स्वखड्गेन शिरः कायादपाहरत् ॥ 206 ॥
3.3.m:
Then Velā, severing the weapons of the very mighty enemy Tāraka
with her sword, struck off his head from his body.

3.3.s:
citāṃ kṛtvā vidhānena sā devī drupadātmajā ..
brahmānaṃdaṃ namaskṛtya taccitāyāṃ samāruhat .. 207 ..
3.3.d:
चितां कृत्वा विधानेन सा देवी द्रुपदात्मजा ॥
ब्रह्मानंदं नमस्कृत्य तच्चितायां समारुहत् ॥ 207 ॥
3.3.m:
Having prepared the pyre according to rite, that goddess, the daughter of Drupada,
bowing to Brahmānanda, mounted his pyre.

3.3.s:
tena sārddhaṃ ca sā śuddhā śvaśurasyājñayā mudā ..
saptajanmakathāṃ kṛtvā svapatestu dadāha vai .. 208 ..
3.3.d:
तेन सार्द्धं च सा शुद्धा श्वशुरस्याज्ञया मुदा ॥
सप्तजन्मकथां कृत्वा स्वपतेस्तु ददाह वै ॥ 208 ॥
3.3.m:
And with him, that pure woman, by the order of her father-in-law, joyfully
recounting the story of seven births, burned herself with her husband.

3.3.s:
taccitāyāṃ ca bhartāramiṃdulaṃ balavattaram ..
saṃsthāpya dāhayāmāsa tena sārddhaṃ kalevaram .. 209 ..
3.3.d:
तच्चितायां च भर्तारमिंदुलं बलवत्तरम् ॥
संस्थाप्य दाहयामास तेन सार्द्धं कलेवरम् ॥ 209 ॥
3.3.m:
And placing her husband Indula, the very mighty one, upon that pyre,
she caused her body to be burned together with him.

3.3.s:
rātrau parimalo rājā lakṣaṇena samanvitaḥ ..
mahīrājamupāgamya mahadyuddhamakārayat .. 3.3.32.210 ..
3.3.d:
रात्रौ परिमलो राजा लक्षणेन समन्वितः ॥
महीराजमुपागम्य महद्युद्धमकारयत् ॥ 3.3.32.210 ॥
3.3.m:
At night, King Parimala, accompanied by Lakṣaṇa,
approached Mahīrāja and fought a great battle.

3.3.s:
sapādalakṣāśca tadā hataśeṣā mahābalāḥ ..
trilakṣairhataśeṣaiśca sārddhaṃ yoddhumupasthitāḥ..211..
3.3.d:
सपादलक्षाश्च तदा हतशेषा महाबलाः ॥
त्रिलक्षैर्हतशेषैश्च सार्द्धं योद्धुमुपस्थिताः॥211॥
3.3.m:
And then one hundred and twenty-five thousand survivors, men of great might,
stood ready to fight with three hundred thousand survivors.

3.3.s:
dhānyapālaḥ śataṃ bhūpām̐llakṣaṇaśca tathā śatam..
tālanaśca śataṃ bhūpānhatvā rājānamāyayau..212..
3.3.d:
धान्यपालः शतं भूपाम्̐ल्लक्षणश्च तथा शतम्॥
तालनश्च शतं भूपान्हत्वा राजानमाययौ॥212॥
3.3.m:
Dhānyapāla [slew] a hundred kings, and Lakṣaṇa likewise a hundred;
and Tālana, having slain a hundred kings, advanced toward the king.

3.3.s:
mahīrājastadā duḥkhī dhyātvā rudraṃ maheśvaram..
niśīthe samanuprāpte hataśeṣaissamāgataḥ..
ekākī gajamāruhya yayau cādibhayaṃkaram.. 213..
3.3.d:
महीराजस्तदा दुःखी ध्यात्वा रुद्रं महेश्वरम्॥
निशीथे समनुप्राप्ते हतशेषैस्समागतः॥
एकाकी गजमारुह्य ययौ चादिभयंकरम्॥ 213॥
3.3.m:
Then Mahīrāja, sorrowful, meditating upon Rudra Maheśvara,
when midnight arrived, joined by those who remained,
mounting an elephant alone, went forth, causing primeval terror.

3.3.s:
rudradattena bāṇena hatvā parimalaṃ nṛpam..
dhānyapālaṃ tathā hatvā tālanaṃ balavattaram ..
lakṣaṇāntamupāgamya mahadyuddhamacīkarat .. 214 ..
3.3.d:
रुद्रदत्तेन बाणेन हत्वा परिमलं नृपम्॥
धान्यपालं तथा हत्वा तालनं बलवत्तरम् ॥
लक्षणान्तमुपागम्य महद्युद्धमचीकरत् ॥ 214 ॥
3.3.m:
Slaying King Parimala with an arrow given by Rudra,
and likewise slaying Dhānyapāla and the very powerful Tālana,
he approached near Lakṣaṇa and waged a great battle.

3.3.s:
mahīrājasya raudrāstraissainyāssarve kṣayaṃ gatāḥ ..
lakṣaṇaṃ prati raudrāstraṃ mahīrājaḥ samādadhe .. 215 ..
3.3.d:
महीराजस्य रौद्रास्त्रैस्सैन्यास्सर्वे क्षयं गताः ॥
लक्षणं प्रति रौद्रास्त्रं महीराजः समादधे ॥ 215 ॥
3.3.m: All the troops were destroyed by the Raudra missiles of Mahīrāja. / Mahīrāja aimed a Raudra missile against Lakṣaṇa.

3.3.s:
tadā tu lakṣaṇo vīro vaiṣṇavāstraṃ samādadhe ..
tenāstreṇa kṣayaṃ jāto mahīrājasya sāyakaḥ ..
tenāstratejasā rājā mahāsaṃtāpamāptavān .. 216 ..
3.3.d:
तदा तु लक्षणो वीरो वैष्णवास्त्रं समादधे ॥
तेनास्त्रेण क्षयं जातो महीराजस्य सायकः ॥
तेनास्त्रतेजसा राजा महासंतापमाप्तवान् ॥ 216 ॥
3.3.m: Then, however, the hero Lakṣaṇa aimed a Vaiṣṇava missile. / By that missile the arrow of Mahīrāja was destroyed; / by the splendour of that missile the king suffered great torment.

3.3.s:
dhyātvā rudraṃ mahādevaṃ tyaktvā vidyāṃ ca vaiṣṇavīm ..
svabhallena śiraḥ kāyādapāharata bhūmipaḥ .. 217 ..
3.3.d:
ध्यात्वा रुद्रं महादेवं त्यक्त्वा विद्यां च वैष्णवीम् ॥
स्वभल्लेन शिरः कायादपाहरत भूमिपः ॥ 217 ॥
3.3.m: Meditating upon Rudra, the Great God, and relinquishing the Vaiṣṇava lore, / the ruler of the earth severed his [own] head from his body with his spear.

3.3.s:
hastinī ca tadā ruṣṭā gajamādibhayaṃkaram ..
gatvā yuddhaṃ muhūrtena kṛtvā svargamupāyayau .. 218 ..
3.3.d:
हस्तिनी च तदा रुष्टा गजमादिभयंकरम् ॥
गत्वा युद्धं मुहूर्तेन कृत्वा स्वर्गमुपाययौ ॥ 218 ॥
3.3.m: And then the enraged female elephant, having gone to battle / with the elephant Ādibhayaṅkara, died within an hour and ascended to heaven.

3.3.s:
uṣaḥkāle ca saṃprāpte malanā patimuttamam ..
taccitāyāṃ samāropya dadāha svaṃ kalevaram.. 219 ..
3.3.d:
उषःकाले च संप्राप्ते मलना पतिमुत्तमम् ॥
तच्चितायां समारोप्य ददाह स्वं कलेवरम्॥ 219 ॥
3.3.m: And when the time of dawn arrived, Malanā, placing her excellent husband / upon his funeral pyre, burned her own body.

3.3.s:
tadā tu devakī śuddhaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ balavattaram..
tālanādīṃstathā hutvā dadāha svaṃ kalevaram .. 3.3.32.220 ..
3.3.d:
तदा तु देवकी शुद्धं लक्षणं बलवत्तरम्॥
तालनादींस्तथा हुत्वा ददाह स्वं कलेवरम् ॥ 3.3.32.220 ॥
3.3.m: Then Devakī consigned the pure, exceedingly mighty Lakṣaṇa, / as well as Tālana and the others, [to the fire] and burned her own body.

3.3.s:
prabhāte vimale jāte caturthe bhaumavāsare ..
tathā hutvā svarṇavatī kṛtvā teṣāṃ tilāṃjalim ..
dhyātvā sarvamayīṃ devīṃ sthirībhūya svayaṃ sthitaḥ .. 221 ..
3.3.d:
प्रभाते विमले जाते चतुर्थे भौमवासरे ॥
तथा हुत्वा स्वर्णवती कृत्वा तेषां तिलांजलिम् ॥
ध्यात्वा सर्वमयीं देवीं स्थिरीभूय स्वयं स्थितः ॥ 221 ॥
3.3.m: When the clear dawn arose on the fourth day, a Tuesday, / Svarṇavatī, likewise offering [them] and making a water-and-sesame libation for them, / meditated on the goddess consisting of all things and stood firm by herself.

3.3.s:
etasminnaṃtare tatra kalirbhāryāsamanvitaḥ ..
vāṃchitaṃ phalamāgamya tuṣṭāva ślakṣṇayā girā .. 222 ..
3.3.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे तत्र कलिर्भार्यासमन्वितः ॥
वांछितं फलमागम्य तुष्टाव श्लक्ष्णया गिरा ॥ 222 ॥
3.3.m: Meanwhile, Kali arrived there accompanied by his wife, / and having attained his desired fruit, praised [Āhlāda] with sweet words:

3.3.s:
.. kaliruvāca .. ..
nama āhlāda mahate sarvānaṃdapradāyine ..
yogeśvarāya śuddhāya mahāvatīnivāsine .. 223 ..
3.3.d:
॥ कलिरुवाच ॥ ॥
नम आह्लाद महते सर्वानंदप्रदायिने ॥
योगेश्वराय शुद्धाय महावतीनिवासिने ॥ 223 ॥
3.3.m: Kali said: / “Homage to the great Āhlāda, the granter of all bliss, / the lord of yoga, the pure one, the dweller of Mahāvatī!

3.3.s:
rāmāṃśastvaṃ mahābāho mama pālanatatparaḥ ..
kalaikayā samāgamya bhuvo bhārastvayā hṛtaḥ .. 224 ..
3.3.d:
रामांशस्त्वं महाबाहो मम पालनतत्परः ॥
कलैकया समागम्य भुवो भारस्त्वया हृतः ॥ 224 ॥
3.3.m: You are a portion of Balarāma, O mighty-armed one, devoted to protecting me! / Having arrived as a single portion, the burden of the earth has been lifted by you.

3.3.s:
rājānaḥ pāvakīyāśca tapobalasamanvitāḥ ..
hatvā tānpañcasāhasrānkṣudrabhūpānanekaśaḥ ..
yogamadhye samāsīno namastasmai mahātmane .. 225 ..
3.3.d:
राजानः पावकीयाश्च तपोबलसमन्विताः ॥
हत्वा तान्पञ्चसाहस्रान्क्षुद्रभूपाननेकशः ॥
योगमध्ये समासीनो नमस्तस्मै महात्मने ॥ 225 ॥
3.3.m: The kings descended from fire, endowed with the power of asceticism— / having slain those five thousand, and numerous petty kings, / you sit immersed in yoga; homage to that great-souled one!

3.3.s:
teṣāṃ sainyāḥ ṣaṣṭilakṣāḥ kramādvīra tvayā hatāḥ ..
varaṃ brūhi mahā bhāga yatte manasi vartate .. 226 ..
3.3.d:
तेषां सैन्याः षष्टिलक्षाः क्रमाद्वीर त्वया हताः ॥
वरं ब्रूहि महा भाग यत्ते मनसि वर्तते ॥ 226 ॥
3.3.m: Their armies, numbering six million, were slain by you in succession, O hero. / Choose a boon, O fortunate one, whatever is in your mind.”

3.3.s:
iti śrutvā sa āhlādo vacanaṃ prāha nirbhayaḥ ..
mama kīrtistvayā deva kartavyā ca jane jane .. 227 ..
3.3.d:
इति श्रुत्वा स आह्लादो वचनं प्राह निर्भयः ॥
मम कीर्तिस्त्वया देव कर्तव्या च जने जने ॥ 227 ॥
3.3.m: Hearing this, Āhlāda spoke [these] words without fear: / “My fame, O lord, must be spread by you from person to person.

3.3.s:
punaste kāryamatulaṃ kariṣyāmi śṛṇuṣva bhoḥ ..
mahīrājaśca dharmātmā śivabhaktiparāyaṇaḥ ..
tasya netre mayā śuddhe kartavye nīlarūpake .. 228 ..
3.3.d:
पुनस्ते कार्यमतुलं करिष्यामि शृणुष्व भोः ॥
महीराजश्च धर्मात्मा शिवभक्तिपरायणः ॥
तस्य नेत्रे मया शुद्धे कर्तव्ये नीलरूपके ॥ 228 ॥
3.3.m: Listen, sir, I shall perform another incomparable deed for you: / Mahīrāja is righteous, devoted to the worship of Śiva; / his eyes must be made by me into pure blue ones.

3.3.s:
tava priyaḥ sadā nīlastathaiva ca mama priyaḥ ..
devānāṃ duḥkhado deva daityānāṃ harṣavarddhanaḥ .. 229 ..
3.3.d:
तव प्रियः सदा नीलस्तथैव च मम प्रियः ॥
देवानां दुःखदो देव दैत्यानां हर्षवर्द्धनः ॥ 229 ॥
3.3.m: Blue is ever dear to you, and likewise it is dear to me; / it brings grief to the gods, O lord, and increases the joy of the Daityas.”

3.3.s:
ityuktvā sa tu rāmāṃśo gajamāruhya vegataḥ ..
mahīrājamupāgamya mahadyuddhaṃ cakāra ha .. 3.3.32.230 ..
3.3.d:
इत्युक्त्वा स तु रामांशो गजमारुह्य वेगतः ॥
महीराजमुपागम्य महद्युद्धं चकार ह ॥ 3.3.32.230 ॥
3.3.m: Having spoken thus, that portion of Balarāma swiftly mounted his elephant, / approached Mahīrāja, and fought a great battle.

3.3.s:
rudradatto gajastūrṇaṃ paṃcaśabdamupasthitaḥ ..
padmadaṃtānsamāruhya yuyudhāte parasparam.. 231 ..
3.3.d:
रुद्रदत्तो गजस्तूर्णं पंचशब्दमुपस्थितः ॥
पद्मदंतान्समारुह्य युयुधाते परस्परम्॥ 231 ॥
3.3.m: The elephant given by Rudra quickly arrived [at the place of] five sounds; / mounting [their elephants with] lotus tusks, they fought one another.

3.3.s: anyonyena tathā hatvā gajau svargamupeyatuḥ .. 232 ..
3.3.d: अन्योन्येन तथा हत्वा गजौ स्वर्गमुपेयतुः ॥ 232 ॥
3.3.m: Having thus slain each other, the two elephants went to heaven.

3.3.s:
tadā bhayāturo rājā tyaktvā yuddhaṃ bhayaṃkaram..
sa tu dudrāva vegena rāmāṃśo'nuyayau tataḥ .. 233 ..
3.3.d:
तदा भयातुरो राजा त्यक्त्वा युद्धं भयंकरम्॥
स तु दुद्राव वेगेन रामांशोऽनुययौ ततः ॥ 233 ॥
3.3.m: Then the king, stricken with terror, abandoned the frightful battle / and fled with speed; the portion of Balarāma then pursued him.

3.3.s:
keśeṣu ca mahīrājaṃ gṛhītvā tarasā balī ..
kalidattaṃ mahānīlaṃ netrayostena tatkṛtam .. 234 ..
3.3.d:
केशेषु च महीराजं गृहीत्वा तरसा बली ॥
कलिदत्तं महानीलं नेत्रयोस्तेन तत्कृतम् ॥ 234 ॥
3.3.m: Seizing Mahīrāja by the hair with swift force, the mighty one / applied to his two eyes the great blue substance given by Kali.

3.3.s:
tadāprabhṛti vai śambhuraśuddhaṃ nṛpatiṃ priyam ..
matvā tyaktvā yayau sthāne kailāse guhyakālaye .. 235 ..
3.3.d:
तदाप्रभृति वै शम्भुरशुद्धं नृपतिं प्रियम् ॥
मत्वा त्यक्त्वा ययौ स्थाने कैलासे गुह्यकालये ॥ 235 ॥
3.3.m: From that time forth, Śambhu, considering his beloved king / to be impure, abandoned him and departed to his abode on Kailāsa, the dwelling of the Guhyakas.

3.3.s:
āhlādaḥ kalinā sārddhaṃ kadalīvanamuttamam..
gatvā yogaṃ cakārāśu parvate gaṃdhamādane .. 236 ..
3.3.d:
आह्लादः कलिना सार्द्धं कदलीवनमुत्तमम्॥
गत्वा योगं चकाराशु पर्वते गंधमादने ॥ 236 ॥
3.3.m: Āhlāda, together with Kali, went to the excellent Kadalī forest / on Mount Gandhamādana and quickly practised yoga.

3.3.s:
tathābhūtaṃ ca rāmāṃśaṃ kalirdṛṣṭvā mudānvitaḥ ..
balipārśvamupāgamya varṇayāmāsa sarvaśaḥ .. 237 ..
3.3.d:
तथाभूतं च रामांशं कलिर्दृष्ट्वा मुदान्वितः ॥
बलिपार्श्वमुपागम्य वर्णयामास सर्वशः ॥ 237 ॥
3.3.m: Seeing that portion of Balarāma in such a state, Kali, filled with joy, / approached Bali and described everything in full.

3.3.s:
sa vai balirdaityarājo'yutaiḥ saha vinirgataḥ ..
gaura deśamupāgamya sahoḍḍīnamuvāca ha .. 238 ..
3.3.d:
स वै बलिर्दैत्यराजोऽयुतैः सह विनिर्गतः ॥
गौर देशमुपागम्य सहोड्डीनमुवाच ह ॥ 238 ॥
3.3.m: That Daitya king Bali set forth with myriads [of warriors]; / arriving in the Gaura country, he said to Sahoḍḍīna:

3.3.s:
gaccha vīra balaissārddhaṃ niśāyāṃ rakṣito mayā ..
hatvā bhūpaṃ mahīrājaṃ vidyunmālāṃ gṛhāṇa bhoḥ ..239..
3.3.d:
गच्छ वीर बलैस्सार्द्धं निशायां रक्षितो मया ॥

3.3.m: “Go, O hero, together with the troops, protected by me in the night! / Having slain King Mahīrāja, seize Vidyunmālā, sir!”
